english: Vecna: Nest of the Eldritch Eye
zh_tw: 維克那：妖眼魔窟

english: {@i Vecna: Nest of the Eldritch Eye} is a fifth edition Dungeons & Dragons adventure for four to six characters of level 3. This adventure takes place in the city of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast. A sinister cult has crept into the city's bowels, and the characters must infiltrate the cult's hideout and root out its members before harm befalls the city.
zh_tw: 《{@i 維克那：妖眼魔窟}》是一篇龍與地下城第五版冒險，適用於4-6名3級角色。這場冒險發生在劍灣的無冬城。一支罪惡的邪教已經悄無聲息地刺入了城市的內臟，而角色們必須滲透進邪教的藏身處，在他們危害城市安全之前將其連根拔起。

english: The information presented here is for the DM's eyes only. If you're planning to play through the adventure with someone else as your DM, stop reading now!
zh_tw: 這裡所展示的資訊只能由地下城主入眼。若你計劃讓別人作為地下城主來遊玩整篇冒險，請立即停止閱讀！

english: Running the Adventure
zh_tw: 運作冒險

english: This adventure is designed to be playable in two or three hours. The characters are contracted by Lord Protector Dagult Neverember of Neverwinter to patrol the city. When a dead man is found clutching a withered eyeball, the characters are tasked with uncovering the cause of the man's death. This leads the characters to investigate the city's old catacombs and confront cultists of the lich-god Vecna.
zh_tw: 這篇冒險設計遊玩時間為2-3小時。角色們和無冬城的護國公達格魯特·無燼簽訂了合同，保衛這座城市。角色們會發現一個死去的男人，手中緊緊攥著一顆乾癟的眼球，而他們的任務就是揭開這個男人死亡的原因。由此，角色們將會被引去調查這座城市眾多古老的地下墓穴，並直面巫妖之神維克那的邪教徒。

english: Text that appears in a box like this is meant to be read aloud or paraphrased for the players when their characters first arrive at a location or under a specific circumstance, as described in the text.
zh_tw: 在這樣方框中的文段，是在玩家角色們第一次到達某地區或在特定情況時，為其讀出或解釋的內容。

english: When a creature's name appears in {@b bold} type, that's a visual clue pointing you to its stat block as a way of saying, "Hey, DM, get this creature's stat block ready. You're going to need it." All monster stat blocks referenced in this adventure can be found in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}.
zh_tw: 當一個生物的名字以{@b 粗體}表示，這種視覺標識代表著這段文字將你指向該生物的資料，就像是對你說"嘿DM，準備好這個生物的資料。你會需要它的。"本篇冒險中所有的怪物資料都可以在《{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}》中找到

english: You can make the adventure easier or harder, or adjust it for smaller or larger groups of player characters, by adjusting the number of monsters or by adding or removing encounters.
zh_tw: 你可以調整冒險的難度使其變得更難或簡單，或是調整其來適應更大或更小的玩家角色隊伍。透過調整怪物數量或增減遭遇的數量就可以做到。

english: Beginning the Adventure
zh_tw: 開始冒險

english: Begin the adventure by reading aloud the following:
zh_tw: 冒險開始時，請朗讀下列文字：

english: The city of Neverwinter stands proudly on the Sword Coast, west and north of Dessarin Valley. Fifty years ago, the city was nearly destroyed by the eruption of Mount Hotenow. Today, the city stands mostly rebuilt. It bustles with skilled tradespeople, intrepid adventurers, and hardy townsfolk.
zh_tw: 無冬城在劍灣德沙林河谷的西北方傲然挺立著。50年前，這座城市由於霍特諾火山的噴發而瀕臨毀滅。如今，這座城市已經幾近重建完成。老練的工匠，無畏的冒險者與堅忍不拔的平民在城中絡繹不絕。

english: Leadership in Neverwinter falls to Dagult Neverember, lord protector of the city—and your employer. The city lacks a formal militia, so Lord Neverember often hires mercenaries and adventurers such as yourselves to keep the city secure.
zh_tw: 領導無冬城的責任落在了這座城市的護國公——也是你們的僱主——達格魯特·無燼的身上。這座城市缺少一支正式的軍事力量，因此無燼領主經常會招募像你們這樣的僱傭兵和冒險者來維持城市治安。

english: Regardless of whether the characters know each other prior to their arrival in Neverwinter, they are assigned to patrol the city together. The first few days of the patrol are uneventful (unless you decide otherwise), allowing the characters to familiarize themselves with the city.
zh_tw: 無論角色在抵達無冬城時是否會想認識，他們都會被一起指派去巡邏城市。巡邏隊頭幾天一切太平（除非你另有打算），請允許角色們逐漸熟悉這座城市。

english: Dead Man's Message
zh_tw: 死者的訊息

english: After the characters' first few days patrolling the city, tragedy strikes. Read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 在角色們度過了巡邏城市的頭幾天後，悲劇發生了。朗讀或複述下列文字：

english: An anguished scream erupts from a nearby alley. The sound comes from a slender human woman clad in the light leather armor of a scout or investigator. Clutched in her arms is the dead body of a human man clad in a tattered gray robe. The man and woman bear a striking resemblance to each other.
zh_tw: 附近的小巷傳來一聲驚恐的尖叫。這聲音來自一名身穿著輕便皮甲的瘦高人類女性斥候或調查員。在她的懷中緊抱著一具男性人類屍體，屍體身上穿著破舊的灰色長袍。這對男女外貌驚人地相似。

english: With a dull thump, a desiccated eyeball rolls out of the dead man's palm.
zh_tw: 隨著一聲悶響，一顆乾癟的眼球從死者的手中滾落到地上。

english: The dead man is Delvin Fearnehart, an investigator in Lord Neverember's employ; the woman holding his body is Kevori Fearnehart, Delvin's sister. A character who succeeds on a {@dc 8} Intelligence ({@skill History}) check recognizes both Delvin and Kevori as mercenaries employed by Lord Neverember to patrol the city.
zh_tw: 死者是戴爾文·費內哈特，一名由無燼領主僱傭的調查員；緊抱著他的女人是珂沃莉·費內哈特，戴爾文的姐妹。成功透過一次{@dc 8}的智力（{@skill History||歷史}）檢定的角色會想起來戴爾文和珂沃莉都是無燼領主僱來巡邏城市的僱傭兵。

english: If the characters question Kevori (neutral good, human {@creature scout}), she shares the following information:
zh_tw: 如果角色詢問珂沃莉（中立善良，人類{@creature scout||斥侯}），她會分享以下資訊：

english: Investigators for Hire
zh_tw: 僱來的調查員

english: Kevori and her brother were tasked by Lord Neverember to investigate suspicious cult activity in the city.
zh_tw: 珂沃莉和她的兄弟被無燼領主派來調查在城市中活躍的可疑的邪教徒。

english: Rendezvous Gone Wrong
zh_tw: 接頭失敗

english: Kevori came here to rendezvous with Delvin after he'd infiltrated a potential cult hideout.
zh_tw: 珂沃莉在發現了一個邪教徒窩點後，來這裡和戴爾文接頭。

english: What She Knows
zh_tw: 她知道什麼

english: The only clue Kevori has is the desiccated eyeball that dropped from Delvin's hand.
zh_tw: 珂沃莉唯一的線索就是從戴爾文手中掉落的乾癟眼珠。

english: Kevori requests the characters' aid in uncovering who or what killed her brother while she returns to the Hall of Justice to inform Lord Neverember of these developments. She implores the characters to avenge her brother's death, but she also reminds the characters that Lord Neverember values information and will pay more for capturing cultists alive.
zh_tw: 珂沃莉請求角色們幫助她揪出殺害她兄弟的幕後黑手，無論其是否是人類，同時她還要返回正義殿，向無燼領主彙報這些發現。她懇請角色們為她兄弟的死復仇，不過她也提醒角色們，無燼領主視情報為千金，如果能活捉邪教徒，他願意付更多的報酬。

english: Investigating the Eyeball
zh_tw: 調查眼球

english: The eyeball serves as both a map and a key to the cult's hideout. When a creature holding the eyeball speaks the key phrase, "Hail the Undying," the eyeball glows with green light before spinning to look in the direction of the cult's hideout (acting like a compass).
zh_tw: 這顆眼球既是通往邪教藏身處的地圖，也是鑰匙。持握眼球的生物說出通關口令「不死者萬歲」時，眼球便會泛起綠光，隨後轉向邪教藏身處的方向，如同指南針一般。

english: A {@spell Detect Magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of divination magic around the eyeball. Casting {@spell Identify} while targeting the eyeball reveals its function and its key phrase. Alternatively, a character can rifle through Delvin's pockets and find a slip of parchment with the key phrase scribbled on it.
zh_tw: 一道{@spell Detect Magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效應會揭露眼球上的預言系魔法靈光。對這顆眼球施放{@spell Identify||鑑定術}可以揭示出其功用以及口令語。或者，一名角色可以翻找戴爾文的口袋找到一張潦草地寫著口令語的羊皮紙片。

english: Following the activated eyeball's directions leads the characters to a catacomb entrance in one of the still-ruined sections of Neverwinter (see "Into Neverwinter's Catacombs").
zh_tw: 跟隨啟用的眼球的方向會將角色們帶到無冬城地下一座已然被破壞的地下墓穴的入口。（見"進入無冬城地下墓穴"）

english: Into Neverwinter's Catacombs
zh_tw: 進入無冬城地下墓穴

english: Several months ago, cultists dedicated to Vecna commandeered sections of Neverwinter's catacombs for their nefarious purposes. The sect the characters are pursuing is in the western ruins of the city.
zh_tw: 幾個月之前，一夥獻身於維克那的邪教徒們佔領了無冬城地下墓穴的一些區域，來完成他們的邪惡目的。角色們正在追查的教派紮根在城市西部的廢墟中。

english: Unless you decide otherwise, the characters encounter no difficulties following the eyeball's directions to a dilapidated entrance into the city's western catacombs. Read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 除非你另有打算，否則在眼球的指引下，角色們前往城市西部的地下墓穴的毀壞入口時不會遇到任何困難。請朗讀或複述下列文字：

english: The withered eyeball aims its empty gaze down an alley strewn with rubble. Rats scurry between chunks of old stone and dusty crates. At the back of the alley is a set of moldering wood boards, propped up just enough to block a dark tunnel leading below the surface.
zh_tw: 乾癟的眼球將空洞的目光投向了一條瓦礫遍佈的小巷。老鼠在老舊的碎石和滿是塵土的板條箱之間遊走。在小巷深處，立著一排腐爛的木板，剛好擋住了一條通往地下的幽暗隧道。

english: The boards blocking the entrance to the catacombs can be moved easily, revealing a sloping tunnel ({@area area N1|011|x}).
zh_tw: 擋著地下墓穴入口的木板可以輕易挪開，露出後面傾斜向下的甬道（{@area 區域N1|011|x}）。

english: Area Features
zh_tw: 區域特徵

english: This adventure explores only a small section of Neverwinter's sprawling catacombs. Unless otherwise stated, areas of the catacombs shown in this adventure have the following features:
zh_tw: 本篇冒險只探索了無冬城綿延不絕的地下墓穴中的一小部分。除非另有說明，否則本篇冒險中出現的地下墓穴區域都具有以下特徵：

english: Ceilings
zh_tw: 天花板

english: The ceilings throughout the catacombs are 10 feet high and made of roughly hewn stone.
zh_tw: 地下墓穴的天花板高10尺，由粗糙開鑿的石頭製成。

english: Eyeball Compass
zh_tw: 眼球指南針

english: The activated eyeball continuously points in the direction of the cult hideout's entrance ({@area area N11|02d|x}). The eyeball is also needed to unlock the door in area N11.
zh_tw: 啟用的眼球持續指向邪教徒窩點的入口（{@area 區域N11|02d|x}）。區域N11的大門同樣需要眼球來開啟。

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: Rusted wall sconces hold lit torches. The area is dimly lit.
zh_tw: 鏽跡斑斑的燈座上點著火把。這個區域是微光光照。

english: Walls and Floors
zh_tw: 牆壁和地板

english: Walls are constructed of stone blocks and are slick with moisture, making climbing impossible without magic or gear. Floors are made from a mix of stone slabs and packed earth.
zh_tw: 牆壁由石磚砌成，十分潮溼，不借助魔法或裝備無法攀爬。地板由石板和壓實的泥土組成。

english: Area Locations
zh_tw: 區域地點

english: The following locations are keyed to the Nest of the Eldritch Eye map.
zh_tw: 以下地點已經在妖眼魔窟地圖上標出。

english: Map: Nest of the Eldritch Eye
zh_tw: 地圖：妖眼魔窟

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: N1: Entrance Tunnel
zh_tw: N1: 入口隧道

english: The tunnel proceeds at a downward slope, bringing the characters 20 feet beneath street level.
zh_tw: 隧道斜向下延申，將角色引向街道下方20尺深處。

english: N2: Half-Collapsed Chamber
zh_tw: N2: 半毀的房間

english: The soft lapping of water echoes through this wide chamber. Wood and stone debris from collapsed buildings litter the area. Brackish water floods nearly half of the chamber, getting deeper toward a dark tunnel to the west.
zh_tw: 輕柔的潺潺水聲迴盪在這個寬敞的房間裡。建築物崩毀留下的石材和木材滿地都是。鹹水淹沒了房間將近一半的面積，在通向西邊的幽暗隧道中越來越深。

english: Characters who have a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 12 or higher notice the entrance to a cramped tunnel hidden behind some collapsed rubble to the south. A character who spends 1 minute clearing the rubble opens the entrance to a crawlspace ({@area area N7|024|x}).
zh_tw: 被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）在12或以上的角色會注意到南邊一些崩毀的瓦礫後面掩藏著一條狹窄的隧道入口。一名角色可以花費1分鐘來清理乾淨瓦礫開啟通往爬行空間（{@area 區域N7|024|x}）的入口。

english: Making a Skiff
zh_tw: 製作木筏

english: Characters have the option of assembling a makeshift skiff from the debris here to make traversing the flooded area easier. A character attempting to assemble a skiff must make a {@dc 11} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check. On a successful check, the character makes a skiff sturdy enough to support up to two Medium or smaller creatures.
zh_tw: 角色們可以選擇收集這裡的建築碎片組裝一支臨時木筏，以便更輕鬆地穿越這片被淹沒的區域。嘗試組裝木筏的角色必須成功透過一次{@dc 11}的感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定。若成功，那麼該角色製作的木筏堅固程度足以承載至多兩名中型或更小的生物。

english: While riding a skiff, a creature can use its movement to propel the skiff up to 20 feet in a direction of its choice.
zh_tw: 在木筏上時，一個生物可以使用其移動力帶動木筏在其所選擇的方向上移動至多20尺。

english: N3: Flooded Tunnel
zh_tw: N3: 被淹沒的隧道

english: The water filling this tunnel is 3 feet deep; without the use of a skiff or other water vehicle, the water counts as {@book difficult terrain|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain} for Medium or larger creatures that lack a swimming speed, while Small and smaller creatures must swim to traverse the tunnel.
zh_tw: 淹沒隧道的水深3尺；不使用木筏或其他水運載具的情況下，水體對於沒有游泳速度的中型或更大的生物被視為{@book 困難地形|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}，而小型或更小的生物必須游泳才能透過隧道。

english: Water Weird
zh_tw: 水詭

english: A neutral evil {@creature water weird} lurks here. It tries to ambush and kill any creature that enters the tunnel.
zh_tw: 一隻中立邪惡的{@creature water weird||水詭}潛伏於此。它試圖伏擊並殺死任何進入隧道的生物。

english: Upon entering the tunnel for the first time, a character who has a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 15 or higher notices odd waves and currents that suggest the presence of a creature in the water. If a character's passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score is lower than 15, the character has disadvantage on their initiative roll when the water weird attacks.
zh_tw: 在第一次進入隧道時，被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）為15或更高的角色會注意到奇怪的波浪和水流，這表明水中有生物存在。若角色的被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）低於15，則其在被水詭攻擊時進行的先攻檢定中具有劣勢。

english: N4: Cinerary Rotunda
zh_tw: N4: 圓頂骨灰堂

english: Glossy urns and cinerary boxes line the walls of this vaulted rotunda. Drifting in the center of the room above a drain is a ghostly, transparent, humanoid figure. The figure is clad in plate armor, and where a head should be, there is instead a featureless, luminescent orb.
zh_tw: 這座圓頂大廳的牆壁上排滿了發著微光的骨灰甕和骨灰盒。房間中央的下水口上方漂浮著一個幽靈般的透明類人生物人影。人影穿著一身板甲，本該是頭的地方現在只有一個沒有任何特徵的光球。

english: The neutral {@creature ghost} haunting this area has no memory of its name or existence in life—a fact which pains it greatly. Upon noticing the characters enter, the ghost beseeches them for help in recovering its previous identity. If the characters refuse, the ghost sulks but isn't hostile.
zh_tw: 這個盤踞在這裡的絕對中立的{@creature ghost||幽魂}沒有任何關於它的名字或生前的記憶——這讓他痛苦萬分。當它注意到角色們進入時，這個幽魂懇求角色們幫助他找回生前的身份。若角色們拒絕了它幽魂就會開始生悶氣，但並不會敵對。

english: Discovering the Ghost's Identity
zh_tw: 揭露幽魂的身份

english: The ghost is the spirit of the knight entombed in {@area area N6|01f|x}. Clues regarding the ghost's identity can be found in areas N5 and N6. A character who searches the rotunda for 10 minutes finds no clues related to the ghost in this room.
zh_tw: 幽魂是被葬在{@area 區域N6|01f|x}中騎士的精魂。關於幽魂身份的資訊可以在區域N5和N6中找到。一名角色搜尋10分鐘圓頂大廳可以確定這裡沒有關於幽魂的線索。

english: To regain its identity, the ghost must hear its full name: Chanelle Hallwinter. If a character speaks this name aloud within 20 feet of the ghost, the featureless orb of the ghost's head coalesces into the face of a middle-aged human woman with braided hair, and the ghost's memories return. The ghost is grateful to the characters and resolves to aid them.
zh_tw: 要重獲它的身份，這個幽魂必須聽到它的全名：香奈兒·海爾溫特。如果一名角色在幽魂20尺內大聲念出這個名字，這名幽魂就會感謝角色們並決定援助他們。

english: What the Ghost Knows
zh_tw: 幽魂知道什麼

english: At first, the ghost remembers nothing about Delvin, the cult, or the catacombs. Once the ghost's identity has been restored, it remembers not only its life as Chanelle Hallwinter but also what it has witnessed while haunting these catacombs. The ghost can share the following information with the characters:
zh_tw: 一開始，這個幽魂不記得任何關於戴爾文，邪教，或者地下墓穴的任何事。一旦幽魂的身份被召回，它不僅會想起自己叫香奈兒·海爾溫特，還會想起他在地下墓穴中游蕩時所目擊到的食物。這個幽魂可以和角色們分享以下資訊：

english: Catacomb Invaders
zh_tw: 地下墓穴入侵者

english: A small group of Humanoids descended into the catacombs several months ago, whispering about strange rituals and secrets.
zh_tw: 一小股類人生物幾個月前進入了地下墓穴，竊竊私語著有關怪異的儀式和秘密的資訊。

english: Delvin
zh_tw: 戴爾文

english: Chanelle saw a man matching Delvin's description flee through the rotunda from deeper within the catacombs, pursued by an individual in a hooded gray robe.
zh_tw: 香奈兒看到一個與戴爾文描述相符的人從地下墓穴深處穿過圓形大廳，身後追著一個身穿兜帽黑袍的入侵者。

english: Zombie Infestation
zh_tw: 殭屍侵擾

english: The crypt to the south of the rotunda was desecrated and now swarms with zombies.
zh_tw: 圓頂大廳南邊的墓室被褻瀆了，現在裡面擠滿了殭屍。

english: N5: Tomb of the Mage
zh_tw: N5: 魔法師之墓

english: The smell of old parchment fills this tomb. Bookshelves carrying various tomes and scholarly implements stand against the walls. At the center is a stone, gold-painted sarcophagus, the sides of which bear a beautiful relief carving of two humanoid women exploring a forest together.
zh_tw: 這座墳墓飄蕩著一股舊羊皮紙的氣味。靠牆的書架上擺滿了各式典籍和學術用具。墓室中央是一尊金色的彩繪石棺，側面雕刻著兩個類人生物女性一起探索森林的美麗浮雕。

english: This is the tomb of Makalia Siannodel, a female elf mage and the partner of the knight entombed in area N6.
zh_tw: 這座墳墓屬於瑪卡莉亞·希亞諾戴爾，一名女性精靈魔法師，也是葬在區域N6的騎士的同伴。

english: Discovering the Ghost's Identity
zh_tw: 揭露幽魂的身份

english: Characters who search this tomb find treasure (see "Treasure" below) and the following clues:
zh_tw: 搜尋這間墓室的角色會發現財寶（見下文"寶藏"）並發現如下線索：

english: Golden Locket
zh_tw: 黃金吊墜

english: A heart-shaped golden locket sits on one of the bookshelves. The locket is locked but can be either pried open with a successful {@dc 11} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check or picked open with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check using thieves' tools. Inside is a small portrait of a human woman, next to which is the inscription, "My dearest Chanelle."
zh_tw: 一座書架上有一條心形的金色吊墜。這個吊墜上了鎖，但是可以成功透過一次{@dc 11}的力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定或使用盜賊工具併成功透過一次{@dc 10}的敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定來開啟弔墜。吊墜裡面有一張人類女性的肖像畫，旁邊刻著"我最親愛的香奈兒。"

english: Relief Details
zh_tw: 浮雕細節

english: One of the figures depicted in the sarcophagus's relief carving wears armor that matches the armor of the ghost in area N4.
zh_tw: 石棺上的浮雕描繪的其中一個人物所穿的盔甲款式和區域N4的幽魂盔甲吻合。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Nestled among the bookshelves are five incense sticks (worth 10 gp each) and a {@item component pouch|PHB}. A character who inspects the area and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check also finds a hidden compartment in one of the shelved books. Inside is a {@item Spell Scroll} of {@spell Protection from Evil and Good}.
zh_tw: 書架間有五支薰香（每支價值10gp）和一個{@item component pouch|PHB|材料包}。一名仔細檢查併成功透過{@dc 15}的智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定的角色還能在其中一本書後發現一個暗格，裡面有一張{@spell Protection from Evil and Good||防護善惡}的{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}。

english: N6: Tomb of the Knight
zh_tw: N6: 騎士之墓

english: A stone, gold-painted sarcophagus rests in the center of this tomb. The sides of the sarcophagus bear a relief depicting two women gazing lovingly over a field and a city, and the lid has a faintly distinguishable family crest carved into it. Old weapons and decorated armor line the walls of this room.
zh_tw: 墓室中央是一尊金色的彩繪石棺，側面雕刻著兩個女性深情地凝視著原野和城市的浮雕，棺蓋上還刻著一個模糊可辨的家族紋章。房間的牆壁上掛滿了老舊的武器和裝飾過的鎧甲。

english: This is the tomb of Chanelle Hallwinter, a female human knight and the partner of the mage entombed in area N5. This is also the tomb of the ghost found in {@area area N4|017|x}.
zh_tw: 這間是香奈兒·海爾溫特的墓室，是葬在區域N5中的魔法師的人類女性騎士夥伴。這裡也是{@area 區域N4|017|x}中幽魂的墓室。

english: Discovering the Ghost's Identity
zh_tw: 揭露幽魂的身份

english: Characters who search this tomb for clues find the following pieces of information:
zh_tw: 在這間墓室中搜查的角色會獲得以下資訊：

english: Family Crest
zh_tw: 家族紋章

english: Engraved on the lid of the sarcophagus is a coat of arms depicting a blunted six-point crown. A character who succeeds on a {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill History}) check recognizes this symbol as the crest of the Hallwinter family, whose lineage produced renowned knights throughout the Sword Coast.
zh_tw: 石棺的蓋子上刻著一枚盾徽，上面有一個圓鈍的六角王冠的圖案。一名成功透過一次{@dc 10}的智力（{@skill History||歷史}）檢定的角色會認出這枚徽記是海爾溫特家族的紋章，許多劍灣的著名騎士都誕生於這個家族的血統。

english: Relief Details
zh_tw: 浮雕細節

english: One of the figures depicted in the sarcophagus's relief carving wears armor that matches the armor of the ghost in area N4.
zh_tw: 石棺上的浮雕描繪的其中一個人物所穿的盔甲款式和區域N4的幽魂盔甲吻合。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Most items stored in this tomb have rusted, but one shield remains intact. This shield is a cursed {@item Shield of Missile Attraction}; however, if the characters restore the ghost's identity, Chanelle Hallwinter gratefully gives the shield to the characters and removes the curse, transforming the shield into a {@item +1 Shield}.
zh_tw: 這座墳墓中放置的大部分物品都已生鏽，但只有一面盾牌依舊如初。這面盾牌是一面受到詛咒的{@item Shield of Missile Attraction||引彈盾}，不過如果角色們找回了幽靈的身份，香奈兒·海爾溫特就會感激地將盾牌交給角色們，並解除其上的詛咒，將其轉化為一面{@item +1 Shield||+1 盾牌}。

english: Secret Passage
zh_tw: 秘密通道

english: A character who searches the tomb for secret doors and succeeds on a {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check sees the faint outline of a doorway at the back of the tomb. The door is unlocked, swings open with a gentle push, and leads to {@area area N8|026|x}.
zh_tw: 一名角色可以搜尋墓穴尋找暗門，成功透過一次{@dc 14}的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定會看到墓穴後牆上有一道隱約的門輪廓。門沒有上鎖，輕輕一推即可開啟，通往 {@area 區域N8|026|x}。

english: N7: Crawlspace
zh_tw: N7: 爬行空間

english: The cramped passage is large enough to accommodate Small and smaller creatures; Medium creatures must squeeze to move through it.
zh_tw: 這條狹窄的通道的大小隻有小型及以下體型的生物可以正常透過；中型生物只能躋身透過這一通道。

english: Disturbed Rubble
zh_tw: 碎石坍塌

english: When a creature enters the crawlspace for the first time, its movement disturbs some of the rubble above. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw to reach the other side of the crawlspace unscathed. On a failed save, the creature takes 7 ({@dice 3d4}) bludgeoning damage from the falling rubble.
zh_tw: 首次有生物進入爬行空間時，它的移動會導致窄道頂上的碎石坍塌下來。該生物必須透過一次{@dc 12}的敏捷豁免併成功才能毫髮無損的到達窄道的另一端。豁免失敗時，該生物將因墜落的碎石而受到7（{@dice 3d4}）點鈍擊傷害。

english: N8: Forked Tunnel
zh_tw: N8: 岔道

english: The tunnel splits three ways: north toward a tight crawlspace, west toward a stone door, and south toward a foul-smelling chamber.
zh_tw: 這條通道有三條路：北邊的路通往一條狹窄的爬行空間，西邊的路有一扇石門，而南邊的路有著一個散發著惡臭的房間。

english: At the end of the west tunnel is a secret door to area N6. From this side, the door is clearly visible and pulls open easily.
zh_tw: 通道西邊的那道門是通往區域N6的暗門，只不過從這裡可以清晰的看到這扇門，這扇門也很容易就能被拉開

english: N9: Sewerage Chamber
zh_tw: N9: 下水道房間

english: A foul stench rises from the murky sewage that fills most of this large chamber. Three four-foot-tall burbling masses slink through the muck.
zh_tw: 這個房間的地面上覆蓋著一層渾濁的汙水，散發著一股惡臭的氣味。三隻有約4尺高的巨物身著淤泥，蠕動著，冒著泡。

english: The sewage is 1 foot deep and {@book difficult terrain|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}.
zh_tw: 這片汙水有1尺深，屬於{@book 困難地形|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}。

english: The three burbling masses are awakened piles of undead sludge, sloughed from the cult's twisted experiments (each uses the {@creature gray ooze} stat block but is an Undead instead of Ooze). The masses ignore the room's {@quickref difficult terrain||3} and attack if approached.
zh_tw: 這三個咕嘟作響的團塊是從邪教的扭曲實驗中脫落、覺醒的不死生物汙泥堆（每個使用{@creature gray ooze||灰泥怪}資料卡，但屬於不死生物而非泥怪）。這些團塊無視房間的{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}，並在被接近時發動攻擊。

english: N10: Crypt of the Silenced Singers
zh_tw: N10: 寂靜歌者的墓室

english: What was once a serene crypt now lies in ruin. Two chipped stone pillars brace the vaulted ceiling. Tombs are cracked open, and reanimated corpses prowl the room. At the center of the room's back wall is a dirtied and desecrated shrine bearing the image of a blank scroll.
zh_tw: 這座曾經的平靜墓室現已坍塌成了廢墟。兩根破損的石柱。棺槨早已裂開，那些屍體重新活了過來，在房間內遊蕩著。在房間後牆的中央，有一個骯髒的、被褻瀆的神龕，神龕上方繪製著一個"空卷軸"的影象。

english: Eight {@creature Zombie||zombies} shamble around this crypt. The zombies are hungry and immediately attack upon seeing a creature unless that creature succeeds on a {@dc 16} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check.
zh_tw: 這個墓室內有八隻{@creature Zombie||喪屍}在這蹣跚遊蕩。這些殭屍非常飢餓，只要看見生物就會立刻發起攻擊。生物可以透過一次{@dc 16}的敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定來避免被這群殭屍發現。

english: Shrine to Oghma
zh_tw: 歐格瑪的神龕

english: A character who examines the shrine and succeeds on a {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill Religion}) check recognizes the image on the shrine as the holy symbol of Oghma, god of knowledge and patron to bards and wizards. If the check succeeds by 3 or more, the character intuits that rededicating the shrine to Oghma could help against the zombies in the area.
zh_tw: 檢查神龕的角色可以透過一次{@dc 10}的智力（{@skill Religion||宗教}）檢定，若成功，他將得知這個神龕上繪製的圖案是歐格瑪的聖徽，歐格瑪是知識之神，也是眷顧著吟遊詩人與法師們的神祇。如果檢定成功並比DC高出了至少3點，該角色還將感知到可以利用歐格瑪的神龕來擺平這片區域的殭屍。

english: To rededicate the shrine, a creature must first use an action to clean it. Once the filth is cleaned off, a creature can use an action to do one of the following:
zh_tw: 要利用這個神龕，生物必須先用一個動作清理他。汙穢被清理完畢後，生物就可以用一個動作來進行以下操作之一：

english: Make a {@dc 14} Charisma ({@skill Performance}) check using an instrument within 5 feet of the shrine, performing a song dedicated to Oghma.
zh_tw: 在神龕5尺周圍，使用樂器進行一次{@dc 14}的魅力（{@skill Performance||表演}）檢定，演奏一段歌頌歐格瑪的歌曲。

english: Touch the shrine and expend a spell slot of 1st level or higher.
zh_tw: 觸碰神龕，並消耗一枚環階至少為1環的法術位。

english: Once one of the two options has been done successfully, the shrine glows with white light, and all zombies in the area immediately collapse with the {@condition unconscious} condition for 24 hours. The condition ends early for a zombie if it takes damage.
zh_tw: 一旦兩個操作都被完成，神龕就會散發出白色的閃光，這片區域內的所有殭屍都會立刻倒下，陷入{@condition unconscious||昏迷}狀態24小時。如果殭屍受到傷害，該殭屍的昏迷狀態會提前結束。

english: N11: Door of the Eldritch Eye
zh_tw: N11: 妖眼之門

english: A double door made of green-tinged stone seals off further progression into the catacombs. Facing the double door is a large carving of a grinning skull; one eye socket bears a wide eyeball with a jeweled iris, while the other is an empty divot.
zh_tw: 一扇由青苔覆蓋的雙開石頭門攔住了通往地下墓穴下層的通道。門扉對側的牆上有著一個咧嘴大笑的巨大頭骨雕塑；那雕塑的一隻眼窩裡擺著一顆巨大的眼球，其虹膜由寶石構成，而另一隻眼窩裡空無一物。

english: The double door is locked and has no keyholes. To open the door from the north side, a desiccated eyeball (such as the one obtained from Delvin) must be placed in the divot of the grinning skull. Once placed there, the eyeball pulses with sickly green light, and the double door swings open to reveal a staircase leading further down. If the eyeball is removed from the divot, the door remains open for 1 minute before closing and locking on its own. A {@spell Knock} spell or similar magic also opens the door.
zh_tw: 這扇雙開門被上鎖了，且它的上方沒有鎖孔。要從北側開啟這扇門的話，必須將一顆乾枯的眼球（比如那顆從戴爾文身上拿到的眼球）放置在那個頭骨雕塑的空眼窩之內。一旦放上去，那顆眼球將釋放出一股微弱的綠色光芒，隨後那扇雙開門將開啟，展露出後方通往下層的階梯。如果從眼窩中將眼球取走，那扇門會保持開啟狀態1分鐘，之後會自動的再次關閉並上鎖。一次法術{@spell Knock||敲擊術}或類似的魔法也可以開啟這扇門。

english: Neither magic nor an eyeball is needed to open the double door from the south. On the door's south side is a stone pedal; stepping on it causes the double door to swing open.
zh_tw: 而從南側開啟這扇門既不需要魔法也不需要眼球，在南側門邊有一塊石質踏板，只要踩上去這扇雙開門便會開啟。

english: N12: Hall of the Whispered One
zh_tw: N12: 耳語者的廳堂

english: The bottom of the stairway opens into a wide sanctuary with a vaulted ceiling. Stone pews are arranged in orderly rows. Black candles burning green flames occupy niches along the walls. Atop a pulpit at the far end of the hall stands a jagged sculpture of an emaciated hand with one eyeball in its palm.
zh_tw: 樓梯的盡頭是一處寬闊的、有著拱形天花板的聖堂。石質的長椅有序的排列在道路兩側，壁龕中擺放著許多燃著翠焰的黑色蠟燭。聖堂的後方中央的佈道壇上擺放著一尊嶙峋的雕像，那是一隻乾癟的手，手心上還抓握著一顆眼球。

english: A character who succeeds on a {@dc 11} Intelligence ({@skill Religion}) check recognizes the sculpture as the symbol of Vecna, a powerful lich and god of secrets known and feared on many worlds.
zh_tw: 角色可以透過一次{@dc 11}的智力（{@skill Religion||宗教}）檢定，若成功便能發覺到這座雕塑是維克那的徽記。維克那，一個強大的巫妖，同時也是聞名無數世界、令無數世界為之畏懼的秘密之神。

english: Any loud noises here awaken the cultists in area N13, who investigate at once.
zh_tw: 任何較大的聲響都可能喚醒區域N13的邪教徒；它們醒來後會立刻調查聲響的源頭。

english: N13: Cultist Quarters
zh_tw: N13: 邪教徒的宿舍

english: If the occupants of this room were lured to area N12 by noise there, omit the last sentence of the following boxed text:
zh_tw: 如果這個房間的住戶被區域N12的聲響吸引了過去，則請忽略框中的最後一段文字:

english: Makeshift cots are strewn about two adjoining caverns separated by an open doorway. Several individuals in gray robes slumber here peacefully despite the flickering torchlight.
zh_tw: 臨時搭建的小床散落在這兩個相鄰的洞窟之中，中間有一扇敞開著的門。儘管這裡有些許搖曳的火光，但這些穿著灰色長跑的傢伙在此安靜的睡著覺。

english: Seven {@creature Cultist||cultists} sleep in these two chambers. Each cultist wears a hooded gray robe that has a desiccated eyeball (like the one obtained from Delvin) tucked in one pocket.
zh_tw: 這兩個空間裡睡著七名{@creature Cultist||邪教徒}。每個邪教徒都穿著有兜帽的灰色長袍，並在各自的口袋裡都放著一顆乾癟的眼球（和戴爾文的那顆類似）。

english: Being Sneaky
zh_tw: 悄無聲息

english: To move through these rooms without waking the cultists, a creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check. On a failed check, {@dice 1d4} of the cultists wake up.
zh_tw: 如果要在不喚醒這群邪教徒的情況下穿過這些房間的話，生物必須成功透過一次{@dc 14}的敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定。如果檢定失敗，將有{@dice 1d4}名邪教徒因此醒來。

english: Awake cultists are hostile but easily cowed. A character can use an action to make a {@dc 12} Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check. On a successful check, all awake cultists that can see or hear the character surrender.
zh_tw: 這些醒來的邪教徒雖然是敵對的，但很膽小。角色可以用一個動作，進行一次{@dc 12}的魅力（{@skill Intimidation||威嚇}）檢定。若檢定成功，所有醒來的、能看到或聽到該角色的邪教徒都將立刻投降。

english: Interrogating the Cultists
zh_tw: 審問邪教徒

english: Characters can attempt to glean more information from captured cultists by making a {@dc 10} Charisma ({@skill Intimidation} or {@skill Persuasion}) check. On a successful check, a character learns one of the following pieces of information:
zh_tw: 角色可以嘗試從俘獲的邪教徒身上獲取情報，為此，他們可以透過一次{@dc 10}的魅力（{@skill Intimidation||威嚇}或{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定。若檢定成功，一名角色可以從他們嘴中問出一下情報之一：

english: Cult Leader
zh_tw: 邪教頭目

english: The cult's leader is Zalryr, who is conducting a profane experiment in the ritual chamber ({@area area N15|039|x}). Zalryr aims to "draw secrets from the depths of the mortal soul."
zh_tw: 這個邪教的頭目是扎利亞，一個正在儀式廳（{@area 區域N15|039|x}）內進行褻瀆實驗的人。扎利亞的目標是"從凡人靈魂的深處汲取秘密"。

english: Cult Worship
zh_tw: 邪教的信仰

english: The cultists all serve Vecna, whom they refer to as the Whispered One.
zh_tw: 這群邪教徒均信仰著維克那，且他們稱呼維克那為"耳語者"。

english: Delvin's Fate
zh_tw: 戴爾文的命運

english: Zalryr uncovered the presence of a spy recently. That spy was chased from the catacombs and assassinated for his transgression. The cultists' description of the spy confirms it was Delvin Fearnehart.
zh_tw: 扎利亞前不久發現了一名間諜。這個"罪孽深重"的間諜被追殺著逃出了墓穴，但最終還是被人刺殺了。這些邪教徒會描述這位間諜的形象，以便角色們確認這個間諜就是戴爾文·費內哈特。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A character who searches these rooms and makes a successful {@dc 12} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check finds two gray cultist robes and three gaudy jeweled rings worth 10 gp each. If the check succeeds by 3 or more, the character also finds a {@item Hat of Disguise} tucked beneath one of the unused cots.
zh_tw: 角色們可以搜尋這個房間，並透過一次{@dc 12}的智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，來找到兩件灰色的邪教徒長袍，以及三枚非常花裡胡哨的珠寶戒指（每個價值10gp）。如果檢定成功並比DC高出了至少3點，角色還會在一張閒置的小床下發現一頂{@item Hat of Disguise||易容帽}。

english: N14: Eldritch Library
zh_tw: N14: 詭秘書屋

english: Crooked shelves filled with books and scrolls stand against the walls. In the center of the room is a square table covered in scribbled notes and ink-stained parchment.
zh_tw: 牆邊歪斜的書架上擺滿了書籍與卷軸。整個房間的中央有一塊方形的桌子，上面鋪滿了字跡潦草的筆記與被墨水浸潤的羊皮紙。

english: The notes spread across the table detail the cult's experiments and history. A character who spends at least 10 minutes studying the notes learns the following:
zh_tw: 鋪在桌子上的這些筆記詳細描述了邪教的實驗與歷史。如果有角色花費至少10分鐘來研究這些筆記，他便能獲得以下的資訊：

english: Cult Experiments
zh_tw: 邪教的實驗

english: The cult's leader, Zalryr, is experimenting with ways to magically siphon secrets from an individual's soul. Early experiments reduced volunteers to piles of necrotic sludge, which were disposed of in the sewerage ({@area area N9|028|x}).
zh_tw: 邪教頭目扎利亞正在研究從人身上魔法性的提取出秘密的方法。而早期的一些實驗讓它們的受驗者化為了一團又一團得死靈淤泥——也就是被廢棄在汙水房間（{@area 區域N9|028|x}）的那些東西。

english: Others?
zh_tw: 別的呢？

english: The cultists here are but one sect of many that have infiltrated Neverwinter. The other sects have chosen different areas of the city's catacombs as their respective hideouts.
zh_tw: 這些邪教徒只是該邪教侵入無冬城的眾多教團之一，這座城市下還有不少其他教團佔領了不同的地下墓穴，將其作為藏身之處。

english: Trapped Lockbox
zh_tw: 陷阱與鎖盒

english: A character who inspects the shelves and succeeds on a {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check finds a small ebony box. The box is locked; Zalryr in area N15 has the key. The box can be picked open by a creature that makes a successful {@dc 13} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check using thieves' tools, or it can be forced open with a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 如果有角色檢查了這些書架，併成功透過一次{@dc 10}的智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，他會找到一個小烏木盒子。這個盒子上鎖了；區域15的扎利亞身上有它的鑰匙。用盜賊工具成功透過一次{@dc 13}的敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定可以撬開這個上鎖的盒子，成功透過一次{@dc 15}的力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定也可以強行開啟它。

english: The box is trapped. A creature that opens the box by any means other than using the proper key must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw, taking 7 ({@dice 2d6}) necrotic damage on a failed saved or half as much damage on a successful one. This trap can't be detected or disarmed.
zh_tw: 只不過這個盒子被設定了陷阱。除了使用鑰匙以外，任何生物以任何方式開啟這個盒子時都必須透過一次{@dc 13}的體質豁免，豁免失敗將受到7（{@dice 2d6}）點暗蝕傷害，豁免成功則只受半數傷害。這一陷阱無法被偵測也無法被解除。

english: Inside the box are two {@item Potion of Greater Healing||Potions of Healing (greater)}.
zh_tw: 這個箱子裡擺放著兩瓶{@item Potion of Greater Healing||高等治療藥水}。

english: N15: Ritual Chamber
zh_tw: N15: 儀式廳

english: Cacophonous whispers echo through this expansive cave. An imposing human cultist in a sweeping robe stands against the wall, chanting. His oily hair is slicked back, and his skin is gaunt and gray.
zh_tw: 嘈雜的低語聲迴盪在這個寬闊的洞窟之中。一個長袍拖地的人類邪教徒站在牆邊，嘴中不斷唸叨著什麼。他有著一身憔悴而灰暗的皮膚，與一個鋥光油亮的大背頭。

english: Carved into the floor before him is a runic circle that pulses with sickly green light. Two cultists—one human, one elf—stand inside the circle, heads thrown back and mouths agape. Their leader commands, "Now! Release your secrets unto me! Let the truths hidden in your soul come forth and become stronger!" As if in response, the cultists' silhouettes warp into two lanky shadowy entities.
zh_tw: 他面前的地板上刻印著一個巨大的、散發著微弱綠光的符文法陣。兩名邪教徒——一個人類，一個精靈——站在法陣內，它們的頭向後高仰，嘴巴張大。那個頭目命令道，"現在！釋放出你們的秘密予我！讓你們那魂中隱匿的真實湧出，化為更加強大的姿態吧！"。你們看到那兩個邪教徒的影子恍惚不定，扭曲成了兩個瘦長的陰影實體。

english: Zalryr (neutral evil, human {@creature cult fanatic}) stands at the north end of the room, conducting an experiment on the two {@creature Cultist||cultists} standing inside the runic circle. Zalryr's experiment has magically siphoned the secrets from the cultists' souls to create the two shadowy entities (each uses the {@creature shadow} stat block).
zh_tw: 扎利亞（中立邪惡，人類{@creature cult fanatic||邪教狂信者}）站在這個房間的南牆邊，正在對符文法陣上的兩個{@creature Cultist||邪教徒}進行實驗。扎利亞的實驗會魔法性的將邪教徒們靈魂之中的秘密抽取出來，將它們創造成兩具陰影實體（均使用{@creature shadow||幽影}的資料）。

english: Each cultist, including Zalryr, wears a hooded gray robe that has a desiccated eyeball (like the one obtained from Delvin) tucked in one pocket.
zh_tw: 每個邪教徒（包括扎利亞）都穿著帶兜帽的灰色的長袍，並且他們各自的口袋裡都放著一顆乾癟的眼球（和戴爾文的那顆類似）。

english: Upon noticing the characters, Zalryr commands the cultists and the shadowy entities to attack. The cultists and entities fight to their deaths, but Zalryr surrenders when he is reduced to 10 hit points or fewer.
zh_tw: 一旦扎利亞發現了角色，扎利亞會立刻下令讓邪教徒與陰影實體發起攻擊。其他邪教徒們與實體會戰至死亡，但扎利亞只要它他的血量不超過10點就會立刻投降。

english: Vecna Appears
zh_tw: 維克那登場

english: When Zalryr either surrenders or is slain, read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 當扎利亞投降時，或是被殺死時，請閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: The runic circle suddenly hisses and flashes with lurid light. As if being extinguished, the glow of the runes dims as shadowy smoke rises from the carvings. The smoke gathers in the center of the chamber, where it coalesces into an apparition of an emaciated skull with one glowing green eye.
zh_tw: 地上的符文法陣突然開始發出嘶嘶響聲，光芒詭異般的閃爍了起來。突然，符文的光芒如同熄滅了一般，變得黯淡無光，陰影般的煙霧從雕像上湧出來。煙霧匯聚到了空間的中央，凝聚成一個猙獰的頭顱，那顆頭顱的一隻眼睛散發著綠色的光芒。

english: The apparition speaks in a hissing baritone. "Good news, Zalryr. Though your efforts have been disappointing, you have brought me new... points of interest." The apparition swivels to look at each of you in turn. "Yes, there is great potential here. May we meet again—but until then, I have my eye on you." The apparition then explodes into streaks of shadow, passing through each of you with a whispered scream before vanishing.
zh_tw: 那"鬼魂"用嘶嘶作響男中音開口說道："真是好訊息啊，扎利亞。我本以為你那無聊的努力只有令人失望的份，沒想到你能給我帶來了新的...興趣點"。"鬼魂"轉過頭來，依次望向你們每個人。"呵，你們可真是一群潛力股。也許未來我們會再見——但在那之前，我會著'眼'於你們每個人..."隨後，那"鬼魂"化作幾道陰影，隨著一聲耳語般的低嘯消散而去。

english: Vecna bestows one of two supernatural gifts on each character. Have each player roll a die, with the result determining which charm their character receives: the {@reward Charm of the Creeping Hand|VNotEE} if the die roll is an odd number or the {@reward Charm of the Eldritch Eye|VNotEE} if the die roll is an even number. While in possession of either charm, the character has the unshakeable feeling that they are being watched. See the next section for descriptions of these charms.
zh_tw: 維克那會各贈與每個角色兩種超自然贈禮之一。讓每個玩家投擲一枚骰子，骰值的奇偶（單雙）會決定該角色獲得的護咒：如果骰出的是奇數（單數），角色將獲得{@reward Charm of the Creeping Hand|VNotEE|巫手護咒}；如果骰出的是偶數（雙數），角色將獲得{@reward Charm of the Eldritch Eye|VNotEE|妖眼護咒}。只要擁有著這兩個護咒，角色就會有一種無法擺脫的、被某人監視著的感覺。見下一章節來獲取這些護咒的具體描述。

english: Vecna's Supernatural Gifts
zh_tw: 維克那的超自然贈禮

english: Vecna is known to bestow supernatural gifts on mortals who impress him, regardless of their affiliations. The following charms are two of his favorites.
zh_tw: 據傳，維克那會賜予那些給他留下印象的凡人一些超自然贈禮，且無關乎那些凡人是否從屬於他。以下兩種護咒是維克那最常賜予凡人的贈禮。

english: {@reward Charm of the Creeping Hand|VNotEE}
zh_tw: {@reward Charm of the Creeping Hand|VNotEE|巫手護咒}

english: {@reward Charm of the Eldritch Eye|VNotEE}
zh_tw: {@reward Charm of the Eldritch Eye|VNotEE|妖眼護咒}

english: Concluding the Adventure
zh_tw: 結束冒險

english: The characters can take any captives, leave the catacombs, and report to Lord Neverember without further incident. Lord Neverember is grateful for the characters' efforts and pays each character a base sum of 100 gp for the job, plus an additional 10 gp each for each cultist captured alive (25 gp each for Zalryr).
zh_tw: 角色們可以帶走所有俘虜，離開地下墓穴，並向無燼領主彙報此事已結。無燼領主會感謝角色們的效勞，並支付每個角色100gp作為工作的基本報酬，每帶回來一個邪教徒，每人就能額外拿到10gp報酬（扎利亞為每人額外25gp）。

english: Continuing the Campaign
zh_tw: 繼續戰役

english: Though this sect of cultists has been neutralized, others still lurk in the shadows of Neverwinter, with even more nefarious schemes in service of Vecna. Lord Neverember might call on the characters to continue rooting out these cultists, culminating in an adventure through the sprawling catacombs beneath Neverwinter's Neverdeath Graveyard. If you need help planning further, {@adventure Vecna: Eve of Ruin|VEoR} contains more information about cult activities in Neverdeath Graveyard and provides an excellent campaign that follows Vecna's machinations.
zh_tw: 雖然這一教派已被消滅，但其他邪教徒依舊潛伏在無冬城之中，實施著維克那的那些更為邪惡的陰謀詭計。無燼領主也許會呼喚角色們繼續根除這群邪教徒，冒險將繼續在無冬城無冬墓園的那些地下墓穴之中。如果你需要進一步的詳細計劃，《{@adventure 維克那：毀滅前夕|VEoR}》之中記載了更多有關無冬墓園中這些邪教活動的資訊，並提供了一場探尋維克那陰謀的絕佳戰役。

english: Introduction: Danger to the Multiverse
zh_tw: 介紹：對多元宇宙的威脅

english: The characters are destined to become embroiled in the legendary hatred between the lich-god Vecna and the warlord Kas
zh_tw: 角色們註定會捲入巫妖神維克那與戰爭領主凱斯之間的傳奇仇恨之中

english: This adventure celebrates fifty years of Dungeons & Dragons history. The story spans many beloved settings and wondrous planes of existence. Its cast includes characters iconic to longtime fans. This adventure's stakes involve the fate of all worlds—in other words, the multiverse. If the player characters finish this adventure successfully, they'll reach 20th level and will have thwarted one of the most notorious villains in D&D's history.
zh_tw: 這次冒險慶祝了《龍與地下城》五十年的歷史。故事跨越了許多深受喜愛的設定和奇妙的存在平面。其角色陣容包括對長期粉絲來說標誌性的角色。這次冒險的賭注涉及所有世界的命運——換句話說，就是多元宇宙。如果玩家角色成功完成這次冒險，他們將達到20級，並且將挫敗《龍與地下城》歷史上最聲名狼藉的惡棍之一。

english: The information in this book is intended for the Dungeon Master only. If you're planning to play through the adventure with someone else as your DM, stop reading now!
zh_tw: 這本書中的資訊僅供地下城主使用。如果你打算和別人一起玩這場冒險，請立即停止閱讀！

english: {@i Vecna: Eve of Ruin} is a Dungeons & Dragons adventure optimized for four to six characters. Characters begin at 10th level and gain a level at the end of each of this book's chapters.
zh_tw: {@i 維克那：毀滅前夕} 是一款為四到六名角色最佳化的《龍與地下城》冒險。角色從10級開始，並且在這本書的每個章節結束時獲得一個等級。

english: The characters are the heroes of the story. This book describes the locations the characters explore and the challenges they must overcome to successfully complete the adventure. All pertinent details about the adventures' settings and locations are covered in this book.
zh_tw: 角色們是故事中的英雄。這本書描述了角色們探索的地點以及他們必須克服的挑戰，以成功完成冒險。所有與冒險背景和地點相關的細節都在這本書中被涵蓋。

english: Existence in Peril
zh_tw: 存在受到威脅

english: For many years, the lich Vecna has imagined remaking existence. When this adventure starts, Vecna is already a god. Never truly satisfied, he yearns to become the most powerful being in the multiverse. Unfortunately for his enemies, Vecna recently devised the Ritual of Remaking to turn his dreams into reality.
zh_tw: 多年來，巫妖維克那一直夢想著重塑存在。當這次冒險開始時，維克那已經是一位神。他從未真正滿足過，渴望成為多元宇宙中最強大的存在。不幸的是，對於他的敵人來說，維克那最近設計了重塑儀式，將他的夢想變為現實。

english: The Ritual of Remaking
zh_tw: 重塑儀式

english: Vecna's Ritual of Remaking involves gathering powerful secrets, extracting energy from them, and interweaving this energy with the lich's essence and magic. After Vecna and his cultists extract enough secrets, the lich plans to weave the ritual alone in the Cave of Shattered Reflection on the plane of Pandemonium.
zh_tw: 維克那的重塑儀式涉及收集強大的秘密，從它們中提取能量，並將這些能量與巫妖的本質和魔法交織在一起。在維克那和他的邪教徒提取了足夠的秘密後，巫妖計劃獨自在喧癲空隧上的破碎倒影洞中編織這個儀式。

english: The cave holds the power to harness energy and reveal fundamental truths, making it the perfect location for the ritual. The combined power of Vecna's magic and the collected secrets reaches critical mass at the end of the ritual, triggering an explosion of sufficient magnitude to destroy Pandemonium and unravel the multiverse. Vecna, with his consciousness preserved inside a magical singularity, can then reknit the multiverse exactly as he wants, sealing the multiverse's terrible fate.
zh_tw: 洞穴擁有匯聚能量和揭示基本真理的力量，使其成為儀式的完美地點。在儀式的最後，維克那的魔法和收集到的秘密的力量達到臨界質量，觸發了足夠規模的爆炸，以摧毀喧癲空隧並解開多元宇宙。維克那，他的意識儲存在一個魔法奇點內，然後可以按照他的願望重新編織多元宇宙，封印了多元宇宙的可怕命運。

english: Vecna plans to elevate himself above all others and to rewrite the histories and details of the entire multiverse. In Vecna's new reality, all people serve him, he has never known defeat, and all who oppose him live in torment.
zh_tw: 維克那計劃將自己提升至所有人之上，並重寫整個多元宇宙的歷史和細節。在維克那的新現實中，所有人都為他服務，他從未嘗過失敗，所有反對他的人都生活在痛苦之中。

english: By the time this adventure begins, the lich has gathered a hoard of secrets and is nearly ready to begin the Ritual of Remaking. Only the characters can stop Vecna's evil plan.
zh_tw: 當這場冒險開始時，巫妖已經收集了一堆秘密，並且幾乎準備好開始重塑儀式。只有角色們才能阻止維克那的邪惡計劃。

english: Vecna's History
zh_tw: 維克那的歷史

english: Throughout the adventure, Vecna proceeds with his plans as if nothing can stop him. However, the waves of magic the lich and his cult unleash in preparing for the Ritual of Remaking garner the attention of powerful individuals.
zh_tw: 在整個冒險中，維克那繼續他的計劃，彷彿沒有什麼能阻止他。然而，巫妖和他的邪教在準備重塑儀式時釋放的魔法波動引起了強大個體的注意。

english: One is Kas, a vampire warrior who once served Vecna but is now Vecna's eternal enemy. Kas learns the details of Vecna's plans and plots to co-opt the ritual for himself.
zh_tw: 一個是凱斯，一個曾經為維克那服務的吸血鬼戰士，但現在是維克那的永恆敵人。凱斯得知了維克那計劃的細節，並計劃為自己奪取這個儀式。

english: Kas and Vecna
zh_tw: 凱斯和維克那

english: A young Kas and Vecna muse about the destruction of Oerth
zh_tw: 年輕的凱斯和維克那沉思著奧斯的毀滅

english: Hundreds of years ago, Vecna and Kas were close associates. They were driven men who shared similar evil outlooks. Kas admired Vecna's sadism and thirst for power, while Vecna valued Kas's ferocity and cruelty.
zh_tw: 數百年前，維克那和凱斯是親密的同夥。他們是有驅動力的人，擁有相似的邪惡觀點。凱斯欽佩維克那的虐待狂和對權力的渴望，而維克那則重視凱斯的兇猛和殘忍。

english: By the time Vecna became a lich and the despotic ruler of an empire on the world of Oerth, Kas was the leader of Vecna's armies and the lich's most trusted lieutenant. Kas pledged his life to Vecna, and Vecna gave Kas generous gifts. The lich created the {@item Sword of Kas} (see the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}) for his lieutenant. This intelligent artifact of pure evil was meant to serve Kas unquestioningly, but the sword soon developed other ideas.
zh_tw: 當維克那成為了巫妖，並且成為了奧斯世界帝國的暴君統治者時，凱斯是維克那軍隊的領袖，也是巫妖最信任的副手。凱斯向維克那發誓效忠，維克那則給予了凱斯豐厚的禮物。巫妖為他的副手創造了{@item Sword of Kas||凱斯之劍}（見{@book 城主指南|DMG}）。這個純粹的邪惡的智慧神器本應無條件地為凱斯服務，但劍很快發展出了其他想法。

english: Over time, Kas and Vecna began disagreeing about strategies to expand the lich's empire. Convinced Kas was more gullible than Vecna, the sword urged Kas to kill and supplant Vecna. The sword wanted nothing less than full control of Vecna's empire through Kas.
zh_tw: 隨著時間的推移，凱斯和維克那開始在擴大巫妖帝國的戰略上產生分歧。劍認為凱斯比維克那更容易受騙，於是慫恿凱斯殺死並取代維克那。劍想要的無非是透過凱斯完全控制維克那的帝國。

english: Kas finally betrayed his liege when he confronted Vecna in the lich's tower. Kas killed Vecna, but before Vecna died, Vecna flung Kas across the multiverse. Kas lost the {@i Sword of Kas} in his flight. All that was left of Vecna after he died was one hand and one eye. These eventually became artifacts known as the {@item Eye and Hand of Vecna} (see the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}).
zh_tw: 凱斯最終背叛了他的領主，當他在巫妖的塔中面對維克那時。凱斯殺死了維克那，但在維克那死之前，維克那將凱斯拋向了多元宇宙。凱斯在逃亡中丟失了{@i 凱斯之劍}。維克那死後留下的只有一隻手和一隻眼睛。這些最終成為了被稱為{@item Eye and Hand of Vecna||維克那法眼和魔掌}的神器（見{@book 城主指南|DMG}）。

english: In the aftermath of this battle, Kas transformed into a vampire. He became the ruler and prisoner of a Domain of Dread (a mist-bordered realm in the Shadowfell) called Tovag. Eventually, the Dark Powers whispered to Kas that Vecna had risen again, becoming an evil god of secrets and magic on Oerth.
zh_tw: 在這場戰鬥之後，凱斯變成了一個吸血鬼。他成為了恐懼領域（一個以霧為界的墮影冥界）託瓦格的統治者和囚犯。最終，黑暗力量向凱斯耳語，維克那再次崛起，成為了奧斯上的秘密和魔法的邪惡神。

english: Vecna's defeat of Kas grates on the warlord's ego. Kas aches to annihilate Vecna. Meanwhile, Vecna has been building his power, though the lich yearns to finally destroy his former lieutenant.
zh_tw: 維克那擊敗凱斯讓這位軍閥的自尊心受到極大的打擊。凱斯渴望徹底消滅維克那。與此同時，維克那一直在增強自己的力量，儘管這位巫妖渴望最終摧毀他以前的副手。

english: Kas's Plan
zh_tw: 凱斯的計劃

english: The Dark Powers have gifted Kas a powerful artifact to help him destroy Vecna
zh_tw: 黑暗力量贈予凱斯一個強大的神器，以幫助他摧毀維克那

english: Shortly after Vecna began traversing the multiverse to gather secrets, Kas learned of the lich-god's plan from the Dark Powers. Upon working out a bargain with those powers, Kas devised a plot to usurp the power Vecna was gathering.
zh_tw: 在維克那開始穿越多元宇宙收集秘密後不久，凱斯從黑暗力量那裡得知了這位巫妖神的計劃。在與這些力量達成協議後，凱斯策劃了一個陰謀來篡奪維克那正在收集的力量。

english: The moment before the lich unravels existence, Kas plans to slay Vecna and step into the lich's place, reshaping the multiverse to his own whims.
zh_tw: 在巫妖解開存在的瞬間之前，凱斯計劃殺死維克那並取代巫妖的位置，按照自己的奇想來重塑多元宇宙。

english: Domain of Dread Parolee
zh_tw: 恐懼領域：假釋者之域

english: Kas uses an artifact called the {@item Crown of Lies|VEoR} to impersonate a powerful wizard and manipulate others into retrieving an item that will allow him to free a demon lord ally named Miska the Wolf-Spider. Together, the two can defeat Vecna. Kas is attuned to the crown throughout this adventure.
zh_tw: 凱斯使用一個名為{@item Crown of Lies|VEoR|謊言之冠}的神器來冒充一個強大的法師，並操縱他人去取回一個物品，這個物品將允許他釋放一個名叫米斯卡，狼蛛的惡魔領主盟友。兩者聯手可以擊敗維克那。在這次冒險中，凱斯始終與這頂王冠保持共鳴。

english: The Wizards Three
zh_tw: 三巫師

english: When the Dark Powers divulged Vecna's plan to Kas, the powers also whispered that Lady Alustriel Silverhand was marshaling allies to stop the lich. Kas didn't relish the thought of facing the might of one of the multiverse's most powerful good-aligned spellcasters, so the warlord devised a plot to trick Alustriel into helping him defeat Vecna.
zh_tw: 當黑暗勢力向凱斯透露了維克那的計劃時，這些勢力還低語說，艾拉斯卓·銀手女士正在集結盟友來阻止巫妖。凱斯並不渴望面對多元宇宙中最強大的善良陣營施法者之一的力量，於是這位軍閥設計了一個詭計，誘使艾拉斯卓幫助他擊敗維克那。

english: With the help of spies, Kas learned that Alustriel intended to summon two powerful friends to oppose Vecna: the wizards Tasha and Mordenkainen. (For more information about {@area Alustriel|558|x}, {@area Tasha|568|x}, and {@area Mordenkainen|563|x}, see {@adventure appendix B|VEoR|13}.)
zh_tw: 在間諜的幫助下，凱斯得知艾拉斯卓打算召喚兩位強大的朋友來對抗維克那：法師塔莎與魔鄧肯。（關於{@area 艾拉斯卓|558|x}、{@area 塔莎|568|x}和{@area 魔鄧肯|563|x}的更多資訊，請參閱{@adventure 附錄 B|VEoR|13}。）

english: Kas knows Tasha only by reputation, and he holds a grudging respect for the daughter of Baba Yaga. Kas is more familiar with Mordenkainen, as the two have clashed on Oerth in the past.
zh_tw: 凱斯只聽說過塔莎的名聲，他對巴巴·亞加的女兒抱有一種勉強的尊重。凱斯對魔鄧肯更為熟悉，因為過去在奧斯他們曾有過沖突。

english: Kas disguised himself as Mordenkainen using the {@item Crown of Lies|VEoR} and received Alustriel's summons to her sanctum in Sigil, the City of Doors. Throughout this adventure, the real Mordenkainen is traveling the multiverse, unaware of Kas's impersonation.
zh_tw: 凱斯使用{@item Crown of Lies|VEoR|謊言之冠}偽裝成魔鄧肯，並收到了艾拉斯卓召喚他前往法印城，門之城市的聖所。在這次冒險中，真正的魔鄧肯正在穿越多元宇宙，對凱斯的偽裝一無所知。

english: When Kas arrives in the sanctum, he realizes that Alustriel plans to combine her magic with Tasha's and Mordenkainen's to craft a {@spell Wish} spell to thwart Vecna. Alustriel intends to dispel the collective power of the secrets Vecna gathered, rendering the lich's Ritual of Remaking useless.
zh_tw: 當凱斯到達聖所時，他意識到艾拉斯卓計劃將她的魔法與塔莎和魔鄧肯的魔法結合起來，施展一個{@spell Wish||祈願術}法術來挫敗維克那。艾拉斯卓打算驅散維克那收集的秘密的集體力量，使巫妖的重塑儀式變得無效。

english: Despite looking identical to Mordenkainen, Kas has no significant magical power. This lack sabotages the {@i Wish} spell exactly as the warlord hoped, allowing him to suggest an alternate course of action: reassemble the artifact called the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} and use it to defeat Vecna instead. Kas is lying; he wants the rod only for his own selfish ends.
zh_tw: 儘管看起來與魔鄧肯完全相同，凱斯並沒有強大的魔法力量。這種缺乏正如軍閥所希望的那樣破壞了{@i 祈願術}法術，使他能夠提出另一種行動方案：重新組裝名為{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的神器，並用它來擊敗維克那。凱斯在撒謊；他想要權杖只是為了他個人的自私目的。

english: Kas's Sword
zh_tw: 凱斯之劍

english: Kas isn't in possession of the legendary artifact called the {@i Sword of Kas} during this adventure. However, if the characters wish to find it and use it against the warlord, you might place the artifact somewhere in this adventure for them to find. See the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG} for more information about the {@item Sword of Kas}.
zh_tw: 在這次冒險中，凱斯並沒有擁有被稱為{@i 凱斯之劍}的傳奇神器。然而，如果角色們希望找到它並用它來對抗軍閥，你可以在這次冒險的某個地方放置這個神器供他們尋找。有關{@item Sword of Kas||凱斯之劍}的更多資訊，請參見{@book 城主指南|DMG}。

english: Confronting Vecna
zh_tw: 面對維克那

english: When the spellcasters' {@spell Wish} spell goes awry in chapter 2 of this adventure, the player characters are shunted to the sanctum in Sigil. Kas doesn't expect this development, but the characters are the perfect patsies. Kas planned to retrieve the pieces of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} himself, but now he sends the characters to do so. Kas plans to use the rod to free the demon lord Miska the Wolf-Spider, his ally against Vecna, though he falsely claims that the rod is the key to stopping Vecna. (Read more about Kas's plan in {@adventure chapters 2|VEoR|2} and {@adventure 9|VEoR|9}.)
zh_tw: 當施法者的{@spell Wish||祈願術}法術在這次冒險的第二章出現問題時，玩家角色被傳送到了法印城的聖所。凱斯沒有預料到這一發展，但這些角色是完美的替罪羊。凱斯原本計劃自己取回{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的各個部分，但現在他派角色們去做。凱斯計劃使用這根法杖來釋放惡魔領主米斯卡，狼蛛，這是他對抗維克那的盟友，儘管他錯誤地聲稱這根法杖是阻止維克那的關鍵。（在{@adventure 第二章|VEoR|2}和{@adventure 9|VEoR|9}中閱讀更多關於凱斯計劃的資訊。）

english: Adventure Summary
zh_tw: 冒險摘要

english: The adventure is split into three narrative components:
zh_tw: 冒險分為三個敘述部分：

english: Discovering Vecna's Activity
zh_tw: 發現維克那的活動

english: In {@adventure chapter 1|VEoR|1}, the characters stumble upon a cult of Vecna performing a ritual to extract secrets. When the characters clash with the cult, they become linked to the lich, which sets them on the path to discover Vecna's plot to remake the multiverse.
zh_tw: 在{@adventure 第一章|VEoR|1}中，角色們偶然發現了一個維克那的邪教正在進行一個儀式，以提取秘密。當角色們與邪教發生衝突時，他們與巫妖產生了聯絡，這使他們踏上了發現維克那重塑多元宇宙計劃的道路。

english: Seeking the Rod
zh_tw: 尋找法杖

english: In {@adventure chapter 2|VEoR|2}, the characters' link to Vecna shunts them to Sigil when powerful spellcasters botch a {@spell Wish} spell to stop the lich. The characters are asked to retrieve the pieces of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, as detailed in chapters 2 through 8.
zh_tw: 在{@adventure 第二章|VEoR|2}中，角色們與維克那的連結將他們傳送到法印城，當時強大的施法者試圖透過{@spell Wish||祈願術}來阻止巫妖，但失敗了。正如第2章到第8章詳細描述的那樣，角色們被要求找回{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的各個部分。

english: Stopping the Ritual of Remaking
zh_tw: 阻止重塑儀式

english: In {@adventure chapter 9|VEoR|9}, "Mordenkainen" reveals himself as Kas in disguise. Kas steals the reassembled rod and heads to the plane of Pandemonium to co-opt Vecna's ritual. The characters can chase and confront Kas, but they must stop the Ritual of Remaking from being completed.
zh_tw: 在{@adventure 第九章|VEoR|9}中，"魔鄧肯"揭示了自己其實是偽裝的凱斯。凱斯偷走了重新組裝的魔杖，並前往喧癲空隧位面，企圖接管維克那的儀式。角色們可以追趕並面對凱斯，但他們必須阻止重塑儀式的完成。

english: Chapter 1 Summary
zh_tw: 第一章摘要

english: {@adventure Chapter 1|VEoR|1} takes place in Neverwinter, a city on the Sword Coast on the world of Toril. The characters are investigating the disappearance of high-ranking nobles in Neverwinter when they stumble upon a cult of Vecna. The characters stop the cult from performing a ritual to steal a kidnap victim's secrets. In so doing, they are shunted to Evernight, a gloomy version of Neverwinter in the Shadowfell, and receive Vecna's Link, which ties their fate to that of the lich-god.
zh_tw: {@adventure 第一章|VEoR|1}發生在託瑞爾世界的劍海岸上的無冬城。角色們正在調查無冬城的高階貴族失蹤事件時，偶然發現了一個崇拜維克那的邪教。角色們阻止了邪教進行儀式，以竊取被綁架受害者的秘密。透過這樣做，他們被傳送到了永夜城，這是位於墮影冥界的無冬城的陰鬱版本，並獲得了維克那的連結，這將他們的命運與巫妖神的命運繫結在一起。

english: Chapter 2 Summary
zh_tw: 第二章摘要

english: The first part of {@adventure chapter 2|VEoR|2} takes place in a secret sanctum in Sigil, the City of Doors. The second part takes place in the Underdark on Toril. When two powerful spellcasters and an impostor try to cast a {@spell Wish} spell to stop Vecna's plot, the botched spell latches on to Vecna's Link and pulls the characters to the trio's location. Lady Alustriel Silverhand, Tasha, and Mordenkainen (secretly Kas) are baffled by this development, but Mordenkainen pretends to improvise a plan to stop Vecna. He falsely claims that the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, a powerful artifact, might be the only way to stop Vecna now. He knows the location of the first piece, which is in a covert base for Lolth operatives, and sends the characters after it. Each rod piece will point the way to the next piece, and all pieces are in different locations in multiverse.
zh_tw: {@adventure 第二章|VEoR|2}的第一部分發生在法印城——門城的一個秘密聖所中。第二部分則發生在託瑞爾地下的幽暗地域。當兩位強大的施法者和一個冒充者試圖施展{@spell Wish||祈願術}來阻止維克那的陰謀時，失敗的魔法與維克那的連結相連，將角色們拉到了三人的所在地。艾拉斯卓·銀手夫人、塔莎和魔鄧肯（實際上是凱斯）對這一發展感到困惑，但魔鄧肯假裝即興制定了一個阻止維克那的計劃。他虛假地宣稱，{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}這一強大的神器可能是現在阻止維克那的唯一方法。他知道第一件法杖的位置，那是在羅絲特工的秘密基地中，並派遣角色們去獲取它。每一節法杖都會指引下一節的位置，所有碎片都位於多元宇宙中的不同地點。

english: Kas disguises himself flawlessly as Mordenkainen using the Crown of Lies
zh_tw: 凱斯利用謊言之冠完美地偽裝成魔鄧肯

english: Chapter 3 Summary
zh_tw: 第三章摘要

english: {@adventure Chapter 3|VEoR|3} takes place on the Astral Plane. The characters learn that the second rod piece is in the wreckage of a spelljamming ship called the {@i Lambent Zenith}. The ship was carrying the piece when it crashed into a dying god's body adrift on the Astral Sea. The characters soon discover that a dragon-like creature devoured the piece and retreated into the heart of the god. The characters must confront the creature and retrieve the rod piece.
zh_tw: {@adventure 第三章|VEoR|3}的故事發生在星界。角色們瞭解到第二根權杖碎片位於一艘名為{@i 輝耀天頂號}的咒船殘骸中。這艘船在墜毀於漂流於星海的一個瀕死神明的軀體時正攜帶著該碎片。角色們很快發現一種似龍生物吞噬了碎片並撤退至神明的心臟處。角色們必須對抗該生物並取回權杖碎片。

english: Chapter 4 Summary
zh_tw: 第四章摘要

english: {@adventure Chapter 4|VEoR|4} takes place on the continent of Khorvaire in the world of Eberron. The characters learn that the third rod piece is located in the Mournland, a magical wasteland. Eventually, the characters discover that the piece is located within an enormous, deactivated construct called Landro. The characters must navigate this colossus and retrieve the rod piece from Landro's engine room.
zh_tw: {@adventure 第四章|VEoR|4}發生在艾伯倫世界的科瓦雷大陸。角色們得知第三根法杖碎片位於悲悼荒原，一個魔法荒原。最終，角色們發現碎片位於一個名為蘭德羅的巨大、已停止運作的構裝體內部。角色們必須穿越這個龐然大物，並從蘭德羅的引擎室中取回法杖碎片。

english: Chapter 5 Summary
zh_tw: 第五章摘要

english: {@adventure Chapter 5|VEoR|5} takes place in Barovia, a Domain of Dread. The characters learn that the fourth rod piece was taken to a haunted residence called Death House. Cultists and the infamous vampire lord Strahd von Zarovich hope to obtain the rod piece themselves, and the characters must thwart all threats before they can claim the piece.
zh_tw: {@adventure 第五章|VEoR|5}發生在巴洛維亞，一個令人恐懼的領域。角色們得知第四部分法杖被帶到了一個被稱為死亡之屋的鬧鬼住所。邪教徒和臭名昭著的吸血鬼領主施特拉德·馮·扎洛維奇希望親自獲得這部分法杖，角色們必須在聲稱這部分之前挫敗所有威脅。

english: Chapter 6 Summary
zh_tw: 第六章摘要

english: {@adventure Chapter 6|VEoR|6} takes place on the world of Krynn. The characters believe the fifth rod piece is inside a gigantic tree, but with the help of good-aligned werewolves, they learn that an evil group loyal to the mighty warlord Lord Soth took the piece to a complex called Three Moons Vault. The characters must infiltrate the complex and retrieve the rod piece, perhaps freeing a resistance leader in the process.
zh_tw: {@adventure 第六章|VEoR|6}發生在克萊恩世界。角色們相信第五塊魔杖部件位於一棵巨大的樹內，但在善良的狼人的幫助下，他們得知一個效忠於強大的軍閥索思領主的邪惡團體將部件帶到了名為三月亮金庫的複雜建築中。角色們必須潛入該建築並取回魔杖部件，在此過程中可能還會解救一位抵抗組織的領袖。

english: Chapter 7 Summary
zh_tw: 第七章摘要

english: {@adventure Chapter 7|VEoR|7} takes place on the Isle of Serpents on the world of Oerth. The characters learn that the sixth rod piece is in the crypt vault of the Tomb of Wayward Souls, a dungeon created by the lich Acererak. The characters must defeat a false lich that calls himself Rerak—a less-powerful version of the Acererak—before they can claim the rod piece.
zh_tw: {@adventure 第七章|VEoR|7} 發生在奧斯的蛇島上。角色們得知第六根法杖的碎片位於迷失靈魂之墓的墓穴金庫中，這是一個由巫妖阿瑟瑞克建立的地牢。角色們必須先擊敗一個自稱是瑞拉克的假巫妖——阿瑟瑞克的一個較弱版本——才能獲得法杖碎片。

english: Chapter 8 Summary
zh_tw: 第八章摘要

english: {@adventure Chapter 8|VEoR|8} takes place near the dragon god Tiamat's lair in Avernus, the first layer of the Nine Hells. The characters learn Tiamat obtained the seventh rod piece and stashed it somewhere near her lair. The characters discover that the rod piece is inside a casino called the Red Belvedere. They must infiltrate a members-only section and either defeat a champion of Tiamat or convince the champion to surrender the rod piece.
zh_tw: {@adventure 第八章|VEoR|8}發生在九層地獄第一層阿弗納斯，靠近龍神提亞馬特的巢穴。角色們得知提亞馬特獲得了第七部分法杖，並將其藏在她的巢穴附近。角色們發現這部分法杖位於一個名為紅貝爾維迪爾的賭場內。他們必須潛入僅限會員的區域，要麼擊敗提亞馬特的冠軍，要麼說服冠軍交出這部分法杖。

english: Chapter 9 Summary
zh_tw: 第9章摘要

english: {@adventure Chapter 9|VEoR|9} starts in Sigil and continues in Pandesmos, the first layer of the chaotic plane of Pandemonium. The rest of the adventure takes place on that plane. With all pieces of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} retrieved, the characters must allow the spellcasters to examine the rod—or so "Mordenkainen" claims. The archmage reveals himself as Kas and uses the rod to subdue Alustriel and Tasha. Kas flees to Pandemonium to free Miska the Wolf-Spider and usurp Vecna's ritual. The characters must race to Pandemonium in pursuit of Kas, who has discovered where Vecna's ritual is taking place.
zh_tw: {@adventure 第九章|VEoR|9}開始於法印城，並在潘德斯莫斯，即喧癲空隧混沌位面的第一層繼續展開。剩餘的冒險都發生在該位面。隨著{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的所有部件被找回，角色們必須讓施法者們檢查這根法杖——或者據"魔鄧肯"所言。這位大法師揭示自己實際上是凱斯，並利用法杖制服了艾拉斯卓和塔莎。凱斯逃往喧癲空隧，釋放了米斯卡，狼蛛，並篡奪了維克那的儀式。角色們必須競速趕往喧癲空隧，追擊凱斯，因為凱斯已經發現了維克那儀式的地點。

english: Chapter 10 Summary
zh_tw: 第10章概要

english: In {@adventure chapter 10|VEoR|10}, the characters follow Kas through Pandemonium toward the Ruinous Sea, an ocean of swirling, impassable, chaotic magic. On the coast, a battle rages between the demonic forces of Kas, who is attempting to free Miska the Wolf-Spider from his prison in the nearby Ruinous Citadel, and the demon-god Lolth, who is allied with Vecna. The characters can manipulate the battle, or they can race straight to Kas, who eventually reveals the location of Vecna's ritual.
zh_tw: 在{@adventure 第十章|VEoR|10}中，角色們跟隨凱斯穿越喧癲空隧，前往毀滅之海，這是一片旋轉、無法通行、混亂魔法的海洋。在海岸上，凱斯的惡魔力量與惡魔神羅絲之間發生了一場激戰，凱斯試圖從附近的毀滅堡壘中釋放米斯卡，狼蛛，而羅絲與維克那結盟。角色們可以操縱這場戰鬥，或者他們可以直接衝向凱斯，凱斯最終會透露維克那儀式的位置。

english: Chapter 11 Summary
zh_tw: 第11章概要

english: In {@adventure chapter 11|VEoR|11}, the characters must descend into the Cave of Shattered Reflection, where Vecna weaves his Ritual of Remaking. The ritual is nearing its end, and the lich-god has created several demiplanes that offer glimpses of the multiverse he is creating. The characters must navigate these demiplanes to find the key to entering Vecna's ritual chamber. Once inside, the characters must stop the ritual, which has left the lich-god in a weakened state.
zh_tw: 在{@adventure 第十一章|VEoR|11}中，角色們必須深入破碎倒影洞，維克那在那裡進行他的重塑儀式。儀式即將完成，這位巫妖之神已經創造了數個半位面，這些半位面展示了他正在構建的多重宇宙的片段。角色們必須穿梭於這些半位面，找到進入維克那儀式大廳的鑰匙。一旦進入，角色們必須阻止儀式，這讓巫妖之神處於虛弱狀態。

english: Running the Adventure
zh_tw: 運作冒險

english: Lady Alustriel Silverhand, Tasha, and Mordenkainen have discovered Vecna's plan to remake the multiverse. Mordenkainen is an impostor who hopes to co-opt the lich's ritual
zh_tw: 艾拉斯卓·銀手女士、塔莎和魔鄧肯已經發現了維克那重塑多元宇宙的計劃。魔鄧肯是一個冒名頂替者，他希望利用巫妖的儀式。

english: To run this adventure, you need the fifth edition core rulebooks ({@book Player's Handbook|PHB}, {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}, and {@book Monster Manual|MM}).
zh_tw: 要進行這次冒險，你需要第五版核心規則書（{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}, {@book 城主指南|DMG}, 和 {@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}）。

english: Text that appears in a box like this is meant to be read aloud or paraphrased for the players when their characters first arrive at a location or under specific circumstances, as described in the text.
zh_tw: 像這樣出現在方框中的文字意味著在角色首次到達某個地點或在文字描述的特定情況下，應該大聲朗讀或為玩家轉述。

english: The {@book Monster Manual|MM} contains stat blocks for most of the creatures encountered in this adventure. The remaining stat blocks can be found in {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12} or {@adventure B|VEoR|13}, as indicated in the text, or in the encounters in which they appear.
zh_tw: 《{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}》包含了本次冒險中遇到的大多數怪物的狀態列。其餘的狀態列可以在《{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}》或《{@adventure B|VEoR|13}》中找到，如正文所述，或者出現在它們出現的遭遇中。

english: When a creature's name appears in {@b bold} type, that's a visual clue pointing you to its stat block as a way of saying, "Hey, DM, you better get this creature's stat block ready. You're going to need it."
zh_tw: 當一個生物的名字以{@b 粗體}字型出現時，這是一個視覺提示，指引你檢視它的狀態塊，作為一種方式說：'嘿，地下城主，你最好準備好這個生物的狀態塊。你會需要它的。'

english: Spells and equipment mentioned in the adventure are described in the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}. Magic items not described in the adventure's text are described in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}.
zh_tw: 冒險中提到的法術和裝備在{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}中有描述。未在冒險文字中描述的魔法物品在{@book 城主指南|DMG}中有描述。

english: Using the Maps
zh_tw: 使用地圖

english: This book contains a number of interior maps.
zh_tw: 這本書包含了一些內部地圖。

english: Interior Maps
zh_tw: 內頁地圖

english: Maps that appear in this book are for the DM only. As the characters explore locations on a given map, you can redraw portions of the map on graph paper, an erasable mat, or another surface to help your players visualize locations with unusual shapes or features. Your hand-drawn maps needn't be faithful to the originals, and you can alter a map's features as you see fit. Nor do your maps need to be painstakingly rendered. Omit details that aren't readily visible (such as secret doors and other hidden features) until the characters detect and interact with them. For example, locked doors are indicated on the maps with dots, but you need not include this detail in your hand-drawn maps.
zh_tw: 這本書中出現的地圖僅供地下城主使用。當角色在給定地圖上探索地點時，你可以在方格紙上、可擦寫墊或另一個表面上重繪地圖的部分，以幫助你的玩家視覺化具有不尋常形狀或特徵的地點。你手繪的地圖不需要忠於原作，你可以根據自己的判斷改變地圖的特徵。你的地圖也不需要精心渲染。省略那些不容易看到的細節（如秘密門和其他隱藏特徵），直到角色發現並與之互動。例如，地圖上用點表示鎖著的門，但你不需要在手繪地圖中包含這個細節。

english: One of the maps within shows the sanctum in Sigil that serves as the characters' home base for most of this adventure. This map is further described in {@adventure chapter 2|VEoR|2|Map 2.1: The Sanctum}, but don't share information with the players that their characters wouldn't know. For example, the characters wouldn't know which magic items Alustriel keeps in {@area area S3|0da|x} of the sanctum unless they examine that area carefully. The map shows the sanctum as it is before the characters arrive.
zh_tw: 其中一張地圖展示了位於法印城的聖所，這是角色們在這次冒險中大部分時間的基地。這張地圖在{@adventure 第二章|VEoR|2|Map 2.1: The Sanctum}中有更詳細的描述，但不要與玩家分享他們的角色不會知道的資訊。例如，角色們不會知道艾拉斯卓在聖所的{@area 區域S3|0da|x}裡保管哪些魔法物品，除非他們仔細檢查那個區域。地圖顯示的是角色們到達之前聖所的樣子。

english: Nondeadly Resolutions
zh_tw: 非致命解決方式

english: This adventure sets up a number of encounters for the characters to fight their foes. However, other nondeadly resolutions are equally valid ways to resolve enemy encounters. The characters might knock out enemies, intimidate them into running away, bribe them for information, or otherwise find creative ways to resolve conflicts. Use your discretion, and if the characters attempt to resolve encounters without violence, go with it if the story allows.
zh_tw: 這場冒險為角色們設定了一系列戰鬥遭遇，讓他們與敵人作戰。然而，其他非致命的解決方案同樣是解決敵人遭遇的有效方式。角色們可能會擊昏敵人，恐嚇他們逃跑，賄賂他們以獲取資訊，或者以其他創造性的方式解決衝突。請自行判斷，如果角色們嘗試在不使用暴力的情況下解決遭遇，如果故事允許，就順應他們的嘗試。

english: Character Creation
zh_tw: 建立角色

english: Before starting this adventure, consider spending your first game session helping your players create characters. This adventure recommends 10th-level characters to start, so make sure your players have appropriately leveled characters before play begins. {@adventure Chapter 1|VEoR|1} provides instructions for starting this adventure with 7th-, 8th-, 9th-, or 11th-level characters.
zh_tw: 在開始這次冒險之前，考慮花你的第一次遊戲會議幫助玩家創造角色。這次冒險推薦從10級角色開始，所以確保玩家在遊戲開始前有適當等級的角色。{@adventure 第一章|VEoR|1}提供了以7級、8級、9級或11級角色開始這次冒險的說明。

english: Existing Characters
zh_tw: 現有角色

english: One or more of your players might want to continue playing characters who have successfully completed previous D&D adventures, and that's fine! Any character from any campaign setting is appropriate for this adventure, as long as they aren't higher than 11th level.
zh_tw: 您的一個或多個玩家可能希望繼續扮演那些已經成功完成過之前D&D冒險的角色，這是完全可以的！任何來自任何戰役設定的角色都適合這次冒險，只要他們不超過11級。

english: The beginning of this adventure takes place in the city of Neverwinter on the world of Toril (in the Forgotten Realms campaign setting). If a character is from a different world or is from somewhere else in that setting, work with the player to devise a reason why that character is in Neverwinter and answers Lord Neverember's call for help in solving the disappearance of several nobles. The reason might range from the magical (an unexpected magical backlash transports them to the city) to the mundane (a family connection brings them there).
zh_tw: 這場冒險的開始發生在託瑞爾世界（在被遺忘的國度戰役設定中）的無冬城市。如果一個角色來自不同的世界，或者來自那個設定中的其他地方，與玩家合作想出一個原因，解釋為什麼這個角色在無冬城，並響應無燼領主的號召，幫助解決幾位貴族失蹤的問題。原因可能從魔法（意外的魔法反彈將他們傳送到城市）到平凡（家庭關係將他們帶到那裡）。

english: If a character takes a break after their previous adventure, consider rolling on or picking an option from the {@adventure Purpose in Neverwinter|VEoR|0|Purpose in Neverwinter} table, expanding on it as necessary, to provide a reason the character has come to Neverwinter.
zh_tw: 如果一個角色在之前的冒險之後休息，考慮從{@adventure 在《無冬城》中的目的|VEoR|0|Purpose in Neverwinter}表格中擲骰子或選擇一個選項，並根據需要擴充套件它，以提供一個角色來到無冬城的理由。

english: New Characters
zh_tw: 新角色

english: Players might create a 10th-level character from scratch for this adventure. For ease of introduction, the character might be from Neverwinter or somewhere else nearby.
zh_tw: 玩家可能會為這次冒險從頭開始建立一個10級的字元。為了方便介紹，這個角色可能來自無冬城或附近的其他地方。

english: If one or more of your players want to create characters from more distant lands, use the suggestions provided in the previous section for why the characters are now in Neverwinter. If they don't already have one, the characters need a reason for Lord Neverember to request their help in {@adventure chapter 1|VEoR|1}, even if it's simply because their heroics are widely known.
zh_tw: 如果一位或多位玩家想要建立來自更遙遠地區的角色，可以使用前一節中的建議來解釋為什麼這些角色現在在無冬城。如果他們還缺少一個理由，角色們需要一個讓無燼勳爵在{@adventure 第一章|VEoR|1}中請求他們幫助的原因，即使僅僅是因為他們的英勇事蹟廣為人知。

english: Regardless, 10th-level characters have already had long careers and earned their abilities through experience. These characters have likely accomplished impressive deeds, so encourage your players to describe how the characters reached 10th level.
zh_tw: 無論如何，10級角色已經擁有長期的職業經歷，並透過經驗獲得了他們的技能。這些角色很可能完成了令人印象深刻的壯舉，所以鼓勵你的玩家描述角色是如何達到10級。

english: The 10th-Level Backstories table contains sample backstories for new characters. Roll on the table or pick your favorite option when working with your players to determine their characters' backstories.
zh_tw: 10級背景故事表包含新角色的樣本背景故事。在與玩家合作確定他們角色的背景故事時，可以在表上擲骰子或選擇您最喜歡的選項。

english: 10th-Level Backstories
zh_tw: 10級背景故事

english: d6
zh_tw: d6

english: Deeds Accomplished
zh_tw: 完成的事蹟

english: The character began their adventuring career investigating zombies that rose from a once-peaceful graveyard. Their investigations revealed a cult. The character fought the cultists and defeated the cult's archmage leader.
zh_tw: 這個角色開始他們的冒險生涯，調查從曾經和平的墓地中升起的殭屍。他們的調查揭示了一個邪教。這個角色與邪教徒戰鬥並擊敗了邪教的大法師領袖。

english: As a bodyguard for a high-ranking political or business figure, the character has staved off attacks from assassins and demons.
zh_tw: 作為一個高階政治或商業人物的保鏢，這個角色已經抵禦了來自刺客和惡魔的攻擊。

english: The character hunts evil dragons or another dangerous kind of creature.
zh_tw: 角色追獵邪惡的龍或另一種危險的生物。

english: The character is a private investigator who, for the right price, retrieves kidnapped loved ones and recovers stolen documents and items from crafty villains.
zh_tw: 這個角色是一名私家偵探，只要價格合適，他就能從狡猾的反派手中找回被綁架的親人，以及追回被盜的檔案和物品。

english: The character studies and preserves nonmagical historical artifacts and has traveled widely in pursuit of rare items of deep significance. While securing items for local museums, the character has thwarted threats ranging from {@creature Ettin||ettins} to {@creature Glabrezu||glabrezus}.
zh_tw: 角色研究並保護非魔法的歷史文物，併為了追尋具有深遠意義的稀有物品而廣泛旅行。在為當地博物館保護物品的過程中，角色挫敗了從{@creature Ettin||雙頭巨人}到{@creature Glabrezu||迷誘魔}的各種威脅。

english: The character is in the service of a god and on a mission to protect the helpless. The work doesn't pay well, but the character has saved children from hungry monsters, thwarted rampaging monsters in villages, and protected the poor from greedy overlords.
zh_tw: 這個角色在一位神的服侍中，並且正在執行一項保護無助者的使命。這份工作報酬不高，但這個角色已經從飢餓的怪物手中救出了兒童，阻止了在村莊中肆虐的怪物，並保護了窮人免受貪婪領主的壓迫。

english: Purpose in Neverwinter
zh_tw: 在《無冬城》中的目的

english: d6
zh_tw: d6

english: Reason
zh_tw: 原因

english: The character is in the employ of a powerful merchant, mage, or monarch who sent the character to Lord Neverember as a favor. Neverember needed the character's help to handle growing problems with undead in Neverwinter. The emergency involving the missing nobles is the character's most recent assignment.
zh_tw: 角色受僱於一位有權勢的商人、法師或君主，對方為了賣無燼領主一個人情，派角色前去效力。無燼需要角色協助處理無冬城日益嚴重的不死生物問題；貴族失蹤的緊急事件就是角色最近接到的任務。

english: After a long struggle, the character defeated a powerful sorcerer. In the throes of death, the sorcerer's magic backfired, opening a portal and shunting the character to Neverwinter. The character has been working for Lord Neverember as a mercenary while figuring out what to do next.
zh_tw: 經過一番長時間的鬥爭，角色擊敗了一位強大的巫師。在臨終之際，巫師的魔法反噬，開啟了一個傳送門，將角色傳送到了無冬城。角色一直在作為僱傭兵為無燼領主工作，同時在考慮下一步該怎麼做。

english: The character fought an adult black dragon. The fight wasn't going well, and nothingness enveloped the character as the character was about to die. Instead of dying, the character woke up in Neverwinter outside Lord Neverember's villa. It's up to you to decide why; perhaps a god's or spellcaster's intervention is involved.
zh_tw: 這個角色與一隻成年黑龍戰鬥。戰鬥進行得並不順利，當角色即將死去時，虛無包圍了他們。但角色並沒有死去，而是在無冬城外，無燼勳爵的別墅醒來。至於為什麼會這樣，由你來決定原因；可能是神的或施法者的幹預。

english: The character defeated an evil leader and was given the pick of the spoils from the villain's lair. While examining the items, the character stumbled upon a {@item Cubic Gate} that sent them to Neverwinter. The character agreed to work for Lord Neverember in exchange for the spellcasting services they need to return home.
zh_tw: 這個角色擊敗了一個邪惡的領袖，並被允許從反派的巢穴中挑選戰利品。在檢查這些物品時，角色偶然發現了一個{@item Cubic Gate||異界之門魔方}，它將他們傳送到了無冬城。角色同意為無燼工作，以換取他們需要的施法服務，以便返回家園。

english: The character is an expert at retrieving kidnapped individuals, even those on other planes of existence. The family of one of the kidnapped nobles in {@adventure chapter 1|VEoR|1} reached out to the Harpers, who recommended the character's services. The family promised a high price for the character to come to Neverwinter and look for the missing loved one.
zh_tw: 這個角色擅長解救被綁架的人，甚至是那些存在於其他位面的人。在{@adventure 第一章|VEoR|1}中，一名被綁架的貴族的家人向豎琴手聯盟同盟求助，他們推薦了這個角色的服務。這家人承諾以高價請角色來到無冬城，尋找失蹤的親人。

english: The character is an explorer charting the multiverse. During their travels, they've come to recognize the foreboding sense of danger they feel whenever they're about to encounter evil. The character can't shake a sense of dread about Neverwinter, so they've come to the city to ask Lord Neverember if there's a threat.
zh_tw: 這個角色是一位探索多元宇宙的探險家。在他們的旅途中，他們開始意識到每當即將遇到邪惡時，他們都會有一種不祥的危險感。角色無法擺脫對無冬城的恐懼感，所以他們來到這座城市詢問無燼勳爵是否有威脅。

english: The Power of Secrets
zh_tw: 秘密的力量

english: Cults of Vecna everywhere are conducting rituals to siphon victims' secrets, which will fuel the lich's ritual to remake the multiverse
zh_tw: 各地的維克那邪教正在舉行儀式，抽取受害者的秘密，這些秘密將為巫妖重塑多元宇宙的儀式提供動力。

english: Vecna uses stolen secrets to power his ritual to remake the multiverse. When the characters stumble on the cult of Vecna, whose members are trying to extract secrets from a captive, they gain access to magic fueled by powerful secrets. The characters can spend secrets like currency once they receive Vecna's Link in {@adventure chapter 1|VEoR|1}.
zh_tw: 維克那使用竊取的秘密來為他重塑多元宇宙的儀式提供能量。當角色們偶然發現維克那的邪教，其成員正試圖從一個俘虜那裡提取秘密時，他們獲得了由強大秘密驅動的魔法。一旦角色們在{@adventure 第一章|VEoR|1}中獲得維克那的連結，他們就可以像使用貨幣一樣使用秘密。

english: Throughout the adventure, the characters can learn many secrets. Each chapter's beginning includes a "Power of Secrets" section that lists each secret that can be used with these rules. The Secrets Tracker in {@adventure appendix C|VEoR|14} helps you keep track of secrets the characters have learned. The Secrets Tracker includes spoilers, so keep it hidden from the players.
zh_tw: 在整個冒險過程中，角色們可以學到許多秘密。每一章的開頭都包含一個"秘密的力量"部分，列出了可以與這些規則一起使用的每個秘密。{@adventure 附錄C|VEoR|14}中的秘密追蹤器可以幫助你記錄角色們所學的秘密。秘密追蹤器包含劇透，因此請將其對玩家隱藏。

english: Learning Secrets
zh_tw: 學習秘密

english: Every time the characters learn a powerful secret, note it on the Secrets Tracker. Once the characters learn a secret, they can't learn it again. When one character learns a secret, it counts as a secret learned for the whole party.
zh_tw: 每當角色們得知一個強大的秘密，就將它記錄在秘密追蹤表上。同一個秘密只能計入一次；只要一名角色得知該秘密，就視為整個隊伍都已得知。

english: Revealing Secrets
zh_tw: 揭示秘密

english: A character can magically spend a secret like currency, revealing it to the multiverse to gain a momentary boon. To do this, the character must use an action to whisper the secret into the wind. The secret is then gone from the minds of every character in the party. There is one exception; if the characters spend the secret they learn from Kas in {@adventure chapter 10|VEoR|10} about Vecna's location, they still know where the lich-god weaves his ritual.
zh_tw: 一個角色可以神奇地像使用貨幣一樣花費一個秘密，將其揭示給多元宇宙以獲得短暫的恩惠。要做到這一點，角色必須使用一個動作將秘密低聲告訴風。然後這個秘密就會從隊伍中每個角色的腦海中消失。有一個例外；如果角色們花費了他們在{@adventure 第十章|VEoR|10}中從凱斯那裡學到的關於維克那位置的秘密，他們仍然知道巫妖神在哪裡編織他的儀式。

english: When a character spends a secret, every character in the party gains advantage on {@dice d20} rolls for 1 minute.
zh_tw: 當一個角色使用一個秘密時，隊伍中的每個角色在接下來的1分鐘內，在進行{@dice d20}擲骰時都會獲得優勢。

english: The characters might hear the information from the secret again, but they can't spend a secret more than once. If the characters share a secret with a nonplayer character, that secret immediately loses its power and counts as revealed. It remains in the minds of every character in the party, but the characters gain no benefit from revealing the secret.
zh_tw: 角色們可能會再次聽到這個秘密的資訊，但他們不能重複使用同一個秘密。如果角色們與非玩家角色分享了一個秘密，那個秘密立即失去其力量並被視為已揭示。它仍然存在於每個隊伍成員的腦海中，但角色們從揭示秘密中不會獲得任何好處。

english: Keeping Secrets
zh_tw: 保守秘密

english: When the characters confront Vecna in the Cave of Shattered Reflection in chapter 11, they can use any number of secrets they've kept to help thwart the lich-god's Ritual of Remaking. See {@adventure chapter 11|VEoR|11} for more details about how secrets the characters kept can affect their confrontation with Vecna.
zh_tw: 當角色們在第11章的破碎倒影洞中面對維克那時，他們可以使用他們保留的任何秘密來幫助挫敗巫妖神的重塑儀式。有關角色保留的秘密如何影響他們與維克那對峙的更多詳細資訊，請參見{@adventure 第十一章|VEoR|11}。

english: Linked to Vecna
zh_tw: 與維克那相連

english: Once the characters are metaphysically linked to Vecna and can spend powerful secrets, their connection to the lich-god might manifest in additional ways, at your discretion.
zh_tw: 一旦角色們與維克那在形而上學上建立了聯絡，並且能夠使用強大的秘密，他們與這位巫妖神的聯絡可能會以其他方式表現出來，這取決於你的判斷。

english: For instance, the characters might periodically see mental images of Vecna weaving his ritual in a mysterious, crystal-filled cave. Or the characters might dream about foreboding Vecnan images, including the lich-god's unholy symbol or robed cultists worshiping Vecna. Reminding the characters periodically about the lich-god's evil plan adds a sense of urgency to the adventure.
zh_tw: 例如，角色們可能會定期看到維克那在充滿神秘水晶的洞穴中編織他的儀式的心理影像。或者角色們可能會夢到不祥的維克那影象，包括巫妖神的邪惡符號或穿著長袍的邪教徒崇拜維克那。定期提醒角色們關於巫妖神的邪惡計劃，為冒險增添了緊迫感。

english: Challenge Ratings
zh_tw: 挑戰等級

english: The Stat Blocks by Challenge Rating table sorts the creatures in this book by challenge rating. It also lists their creature type and where in the book they appear.
zh_tw: 《按挑戰等級排序的統計資料塊表》按挑戰等級對本書中的生物進行排序。它還列出了它們的生物型別以及它們在書中出現的位置。
