english: Chapter 1: Return from Neverdeath Graveyard
zh_tw: 第1章：從無冬墓園歸來

english: A bizarre ritual reveals the cult of Vecna's terrifying activities
zh_tw: 一個奇異的儀式揭示了維克那邪教的可怕活動

english: As the adventure begins, the characters are established heroes currently in the city of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast. Several calamities have battered Neverwinter in the recent past. The greatest was the eruption of nearby Mount Hotenow, which nearly destroyed the city forty years ago, though most of the damage has since been repaired.
zh_tw: 當冒險開始時，角色們是已確立的英雄，目前位於劍海岸的無冬城市。最近，無冬城遭受了幾場災難。最大的災難是附近霍特諾火山的爆發，這幾乎在四十年前摧毀了這座城市，儘管此後大部分損害已經修復。

english: Neverwinter is ruled by its Lord Protector, Dagult Neverember. Rising to power through a tenuous claim of descendance from one of Neverwinter's past heroes, Lord Neverember has nevertheless provided stable leadership.
zh_tw: 無冬城由其保護者領主達格魯特無燼統治。透過聲稱自己是無冬城過去英雄之一的微弱血統，無燼領主已經提供了穩定的領導。

english: Unknown to the authorities, a cult of Vecna operates in the catacombs beneath Neverwinter's sprawling Neverdeath Graveyard. Cult members have been kidnapping city residents who carry significant secrets, draining their knowledge and their souls in a fell ritual and passing the collected secrets to Vecna as he gathers power for his {@area Ritual of Remaking|002|x}. (See the {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0} for more information about Vecna's plot.) In the process, the kidnap victims become creatures robbed of their knowledge and volition.
zh_tw: 當局不知情的是，一個維克那的邪教在無冬城廣闊的無冬墓園墓地下的地下墓穴中活動。邪教成員一直在綁架攜帶重要秘密的城市居民，在一場邪惡的儀式中吸取他們的知識和靈魂，並將收集到的秘密傳遞給維克那，因為他正在為他的{@area 重塑儀式|002|x}聚集力量。（有關維克那陰謀的更多資訊，請參見{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}。）在這個過程中，被綁架的受害者變成了被剝奪了知識和意志的生物。

english: Running This Chapter
zh_tw: 運作本章

english: In this chapter, the characters discover a cult of Vecna preparing four kidnap victims for a ritual in the catacombs beneath Hallix Mausoleum. Disrupting this ritual hurls the characters and an elf scholar named Eldon Keyward into Evernight, Neverwinter's sinister reflection in the Shadowfell. To return home, the characters must confront the lonely legacy of the Dolindar family and find a rift that leads back to Neverwinter.
zh_tw: 在這一章中，角色們發現了一個維克那邪教，在哈利克斯陵墓下的地下墓穴中為一個儀式準備四名被綁架的受害者。打亂這個儀式將角色和一個名叫埃爾登·基沃德的精靈學者拋入永夜城，這是無冬城在墮影冥界中的邪惡倒影。為了回家，角色們必須面對多林達爾家族的孤獨遺產，並找到一個通往無冬城的裂縫。

english: Character Advancement
zh_tw: 角色升級

english: The characters should be 10th level when this chapter begins; see the "{@area Lower-Level and Higher-Level Characters|032|x}" sidebar for accommodating characters of other levels. If the characters are 10th level or below, they gain a level after returning to Neverwinter from Evernight.
zh_tw: 當本章開始時，角色們應該是10級；請參見"{@area 低等級和高等級角色|032|x}"側邊欄，以適應其他等級的角色。如果角色們是10級或以下，他們在從永夜城返回無冬城後將獲得一個等級。

english: Power of Secrets
zh_tw: 秘密的力量

english: The characters can learn three secrets in this chapter applicable to the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules found in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}. These secrets are tied to three NPCs whom the characters encounter in the Neverdeath Catacombs:
zh_tw: 在這一章中，角色們可以學到三個適用於本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則的秘密。這些秘密與角色在無冬墓園中遇到的三個NPC有關：

english: Indrina's Secret
zh_tw: 因德里娜的秘密

english: A prisoner named Indrina knows that Lord Neverember doesn't have a legitimate claim to his title. The characters can learn this secret in {@area area C20|07d|x}.
zh_tw: 一個名叫因德里娜的囚犯知道無燼勳爵沒有合法的頭銜。角色們可以在{@area 區域C20|07d|x}中瞭解到這個秘密。

english: Sarcelle's Secret
zh_tw: 薩塞勒的秘密

english: A prisoner named Sarcelle recently received a disturbing vision. The characters can learn about Sarcelle's recent vision in {@area area C5|04c|x}.
zh_tw: 一個名叫薩塞勒的囚犯最近收到了一個令人不安的幻象。角色們可以在{@area 區域C5|04c|x}瞭解到薩塞勒最近的幻象。

english: Umberto's Secret
zh_tw: 翁貝托的秘密

english: The characters can learn about Umberto's secret role as a historian of Vecna in {@area area C11|061|x}.
zh_tw: 角色們可以在{@area 區域C11|061|x}瞭解到翁貝托作為維克那歷史學家的秘密角色。

english: The first time the characters learn one of these secrets, they feel a sense that the information they've discovered is important. Describe the Power of Secrets rules to the players at this time, but don't let them spend any secrets yet. When the characters receive Vecna's Link, they can spend secrets using the Power of Secrets rules, as described in the introduction.
zh_tw: 當角色們第一次學到這些秘密之一時，他們會感覺到他們發現的資訊很重要。在這個時候向玩家們描述秘密的力量規則，但不要讓他們現在就使用任何秘密。當角色們收到維克那的連結時，他們可以使用秘密的力量規則來使用秘密，如引言中所述。

english: Getting Started
zh_tw: 開始

english: This adventure begins when Lord Dagult Neverember summons the characters to his modest villa in Neverwinter. Several local guards are present, as are three priests of Oghma—a god of inspiration, invention, and knowledge—from Neverwinter's House of Knowledge.
zh_tw: 冒險開始時，達格魯特·無燼領主召角色們前往他位於無冬城的樸素別墅。現場有幾名本地守衛，還有三位來自無冬城知識殿堂、信奉靈感、發明與知識之神歐格瑪的祭司。

english: When the characters enter his audience chamber, Lord Neverember is busy discussing politics with his advisers. He breaks off the discussion, gives the characters a smile of recognition, and says the following:
zh_tw: 當角色們進入他的接見室時，無燼領主正忙於和他的顧問討論政治。他中斷了討論，向角色們露出了認可的微笑，並說了以下的話：

english: "Greetings, my heroic friends! I'm so glad you came. I daresay, terrible events are afoot. Specifically, four prominent citizens have been kidnapped in the past several days. May I count on your help in rescuing them?"
zh_tw: "問候，我的英雄朋友們！很高興你們來了。我敢說，可怕的事件正在發生。具體來說，過去幾天有四位傑出的市民被綁架了。我可以指望你們幫忙解救他們嗎？"

english: Lord Neverember describes the kidnap victims as follows:
zh_tw: 無燼勳爵如下描述被綁架的受害者：

english: {@b Eldon Keyward} is a highly knowledgeable scholar who specializes in the Outer Planes.
zh_tw: {@b 埃爾登·基沃德} 是一位專門研究外層位面的博學多才的學者。

english: {@b Indrina Lamsensettle} is a human actor who moves in Neverwinter's highest social circles.
zh_tw: {@b 因德里娜·蘭姆森特} 是一位在無冬城最高社交圈活動的人類演員。

english: {@b Sarcelle Malinosh} is a human wild-magic sorcerer who plumbs the mysteries of the Outer Planes.
zh_tw: {@b 薩塞勒·馬利諾什} 是一位探究外層位面奧秘的人類野魔法師。

english: {@b Umberto Noblin} is a gnome historian who has written books on various deities.
zh_tw: {@b 翁貝托·諾布林} 是一位侏儒歷史學家，他撰寫了關於各種神祇的書籍。

english: Lord Neverember confirms that each victim was kidnapped at night. The victims don't know each other, and there appears to be no connection between them.
zh_tw: 無燼領主確認每位受害者都是在夜間被綁架的。受害者們彼此不認識，他們之間似乎沒有任何聯絡。

english: Lord Neverember funded divinations from the House of Knowledge, hoping to find the victims. The priests reported that the mystical trail of the victims ends at a specific place: Hallix Mausoleum in Neverdeath Graveyard. The priests worry that their inability to see inside this mausoleum means that an unknown opponent is blocking their divinations.
zh_tw: 無燼領主資助了來自知識之屋的占卜，希望找到受害者。祭司們報告說，受害者的神秘蹤跡在無冬墓園墓地的哈利克斯陵墓結束。祭司們擔心他們無法看到這個陵墓內部意味著一個未知的對手正在阻止他們的占卜。

english: Lord Neverember asks the characters to investigate the disappearances at Hallix Mausoleum. He promises each character a fine house in Neverwinter if they can recover the four missing townspeople and bring the kidnappers to justice.
zh_tw: 無燼領主請求角色們調查哈利克斯陵墓中的失蹤事件。他承諾，如果他們能夠找到四名失蹤的鎮民並將綁架者繩之以法，每位角色都將在無冬城得到一座精美的房子。

english: Neverdeath Graveyard
zh_tw: 無冬墓園

english: Lord Neverember and the priests provide an overview of Neverdeath Graveyard, which contains two sprawling, connected cemeteries: the Main Graveyard and the Pauper's Graveyard. A thick stone wall separates the crypts of the wealthy from the graves of the poor.
zh_tw: 無燼領主和祭司們提供了無冬墓園的概況，它包含兩個龐大且相連的墓地：主墓地和貧民墓地。一堵厚實的石牆將富人的墓穴與窮人的墳墓分隔開來。

english: The Main Graveyard holds several mausoleums, some with expansive underground chambers. The Pauper's Graveyard features numerous simple headstones, but a few civic-minded citizens funded communal catacombs when the graveyard was first built.
zh_tw: 主墓地擁有幾座陵墓，其中一些帶有寬敞的地下房間。貧民墓地設有許多簡單的墓碑，但一些具有公民意識的市民在墓地最初建造時資助了公共地下墓穴。

english: The cult of Vecna has kidnapped four nobles in Neverwinter: Eldon Keyward, Indrina Lamsensettle, Sarcelle Malinosh, and Umberto Noblin
zh_tw: 維克那的邪教在無冬城綁架了四位貴族：埃爾登·基沃德、因德里娜·蘭姆森特、薩塞勒·馬利諾什和翁貝托·諾布林。

english: In the Graveyard
zh_tw: 在墓地

english: The wandering zombies and skeletons of Neverdeath Graveyard don't pose a challenge to a higher-level party, so the characters can reach Hallix Mausoleum without trouble. The characters don't yet realize that the mausoleum leads to a network of catacombs that extends beneath both the Main Graveyard and the Pauper's Graveyard.
zh_tw: 無冬墓園中徘徊的殭屍和骷髏對於高等級的隊伍來說並不構成挑戰，因此角色們可以毫無困難地到達哈利克斯陵墓。角色們還沒有意識到，這個陵墓通向一個地下墓穴網路，這個網路延伸在主墓地和貧民墓地之下。

english: General Features
zh_tw: 通用特徵

english: The following features are common throughout the catacombs and chambers.
zh_tw: 以下特點在整個地下墓穴和房間中都很常見。

english: Broken Stone
zh_tw: 殘破石

english: The old stones used to build the subterranean areas don't fit together well, leaving space for mold or tangled roots. Vecna's cultists have scribbled symbols on the walls, depicting staring eyes and left hands.
zh_tw: 用來建造地下區域的古老石頭之間並不緊密貼合，留下了生長黴菌或糾結的樹根的空間。維克那的邪教徒在牆上塗畫了符號，描繪了凝視的眼睛和左手。

english: Ceilings
zh_tw: 天花板

english: Ceilings are 10 feet high in passages and 15 feet high in rooms unless otherwise noted.
zh_tw: 除非另有說明，通道的天花板高度為10尺，房間的天花板高度為15尺。

english: Doors
zh_tw: 門

english: Doors throughout the area are made of heavy stone with metal hinges. The cult keeps the doors well-oiled, so they don't make noise when opened. All doors are unlocked unless otherwise noted.
zh_tw: 整個區域的門都是由沉重的石頭製成，帶有金屬鉸鏈。邪教徒們保持門的良好潤滑，所以開門時不會產生噪音。除非另有說明，否則所有門都是未上鎖的。

english: Lighting
zh_tw: 光照

english: Areas C1–C12 are dark, and characters must have {@sense darkvision} or a light source to see. Cult members frequent areas C13–C26, so lanterns hung on wall hooks create {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light} there.
zh_tw: 區域C1至C12是黑暗的，角色必須擁有{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}或一個光源才能看見。邪教成員經常出沒於區域C13至C26，因此掛在牆鉤上的提燈在那裡創造了{@quickref Vision and Light||2||明亮光照}。

english: Vestiges of the Waterclock Guild
zh_tw: 水鍾公會的遺蹟

english: Part of the catacombs once belonged to an occult organization called the Waterclock Guild. The guild members are gone, though their bound elementals and clockwork mechanisms remain. A network of pipes runs through areas C7–C12 and C14–C15, indicated on map 1.1 by solid lines. The sound of dripping water echoes throughout these areas.
zh_tw: 地下墓穴的一部分曾經屬於一個名為水鍾公會的秘密組織。公會成員已經不在，但他們繫結的元素生物和發條機械裝置仍然存在。一個管道網路穿過C7至C12區域以及C14至C15區域，在地圖1.1上以實線表示。滴水聲在這些區域迴響。

english: Neverdeath Catacomb Locations
zh_tw: 無冬墓園地下墓穴位置

english: The following locations are keyed to map 1.1.
zh_tw: 以下地點對應於地圖 1.1。

english: Map 1.1: Neverdeath Catacombs
zh_tw: 地圖 1.1: 無冬墓園地下墓穴

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: C1: Hallix Mausoleum
zh_tw: C1: 哈利克斯陵墓

english: The towering stone mausoleums in Neverdeath Graveyard cluster near the wall separating the Main Graveyard from the Pauper's Graveyard to the west. Hallix Mausoleum is a squat, unassuming granite block in the shadow of larger monuments to the west and south. Its metal double door bears a rusty broken chain and a padlock that hangs off the door.
zh_tw: 在無冬墓園中，高聳的石制陵墓聚集在將主墓地與西側貧民墓地分隔開的牆附近。哈利克斯陵墓是一個矮胖、不起眼的花崗巖塊，位於西側和南側較大的紀念物的陰影下。它的金屬雙門上掛著一條生鏽的斷鏈和一把掛在門上的掛鎖。

english: The well-oiled door opens noiselessly. The crypt interior is dusty, with numerous tracks leading to a descending staircase at the rear of the room.
zh_tw: 這扇塗有潤滑油的門無聲地開啟了。墓穴內部佈滿灰塵，眾多足跡通向房間後部的下行樓梯。

english: Against the walls rest six stone coffins, three on each side. A stone slab engraved with a name, birth year, and death year covers each coffin. These members of the Hallix family died forty years ago, after Mount Hotenow erupted. The coffins are empty except for scraps of cloth and bits of bone; the cult's ghouls ate the former occupants.
zh_tw: 靠牆放置著六具石棺，每邊各三具。每具棺材上都刻有名字、出生年份和死亡年份的石板。這些哈利克斯家族的成員在四十年前，霍特諾山爆發後去世。除了一些碎布和骨頭碎片外，棺材是空的；邪教的食屍鬼吃掉了原來的居住者。

english: Noisy Investigations
zh_tw: 嘈雜的調查

english: If the characters make a lot of noise here, the {@creature Wight||wights} in area C2 investigate.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在這裡製造很多噪音，C2區域的{@creature Wight||屍妖}會過來調查。

english: C2: Lower Mausoleum
zh_tw: C2: 下層陵墓

english: If the wights described below moved to investigate area C1, omit the last sentence when reading aloud:
zh_tw: 如果下面描述的屍妖移動到調查C1區域，請在大聲朗讀時省略最後一句話：

english: Stone stairs descend from Hallix Mausoleum to a large subterranean chamber with stone coffins sitting on sturdy shelves. Part of the west wall has collapsed, creating an opening into another chamber. Marching around the chamber are five pale, desiccated warriors wearing wicked-looking armor.
zh_tw: 從哈利克斯陵墓下來的石樓梯通向一個大型地下房間，石棺放在堅固的架子上。西牆的一部分已經倒塌，形成了通往另一個房間的開口。五個面色蒼白、乾癟的戰士穿著看起來邪惡的盔甲在房間裡巡邏。

english: The cult pressed five {@creature Wight||wights} into service as guards. The wights know the cultists by appearance and don't attack them, but they attack anyone else.
zh_tw: 邪教強迫五個{@creature Wight||屍妖}作為守衛服役。屍妖透過外表認識邪教徒，不會攻擊他們，但會攻擊其他任何人。

english: The older Hallix corpses once buried here were fed to the cult's ghouls.
zh_tw: 這裡曾經埋葬的較老的哈利克斯家族的屍體被餵給了邪教的食屍鬼。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: One of the empty coffins contains no evidence of a former occupant. The back of this coffin hides a panel with a latch that causes the wall behind it to swing aside. A character who searches the coffin or wall and succeeds on a {@dc 18} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) or Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check finds this secret door. Neither the cultists nor the wights are aware of it. The passageway beyond ends at another secret door that is easily spotted and opened from inside the tunnel. It leads to {@area area C9|059|x}.
zh_tw: 其中一個空棺材內沒有任何先前的居住者痕跡。這個棺材的背面隱藏著一個帶有插銷的面板，拉動插銷會使後面的牆壁側滑開啟。一個搜尋棺材或牆壁併成功透過 {@dc 18} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）或感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定的人物會發現這個密門。邪教徒和屍妖都不知道它的存在。通道的另一端是另一個密門，從隧道內部很容易發現並開啟。它通向 {@area 區域C9|059|x}。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: One open coffin contains four wool cloaks worth 10 gp each and two wide hats worth 5 gp each, which the cultists use to travel inconspicuously aboveground. There is also a {@item Potion of Invisibility} the cultists were saving for an emergency.
zh_tw: 一個開啟的棺材裡裝有四件羊毛斗篷，每件價值10金幣，還有兩頂寬邊帽，每頂價值5金幣，邪教徒用它們在地上行走時不引人注目。還有一瓶{@item Potion of Invisibility||隱形藥水}，邪教徒為緊急情況而儲存的。

english: C3: Uneven Chamber
zh_tw: C3: 不均勻的房間

english: Roots protrude through cracks in the ceiling here. A stone stairway in the southeast corner has collapsed, and the nearby walls have crumbled. Three doors in the north wall are shut, and the middle door bears a new padlock. To the west, stairs lead to a small balcony that overlooks the room from five feet above, with just enough room for a door painted with an eye.
zh_tw: 這裡的天花板裂縫中突出著樹根。東南角的石樓梯已經坍塌，附近的牆壁也已經崩塌。北牆上有三扇門是關閉的，中間的門上掛著一把新掛鎖。往西邊，樓梯通向一個小陽臺，從五尺高的地方俯瞰著這個房間，那裡剛好有足夠的空間放置一扇畫有眼睛的門。

english: This room is inaccessible from the surface since the stairway leading upward has collapsed. See {@area area C5|04c|x} for more about the padlocked door.
zh_tw: 由於通往地面的樓梯已經坍塌，這個房間無法從地面進入。有關上鎖門的更多資訊，請參見{@area 區域C5|04c|x}。

english: C4: Trapped Grate
zh_tw: C4: 困住的格柵

english: A metal grate in the floor of this ten-foot-square room blocks access to a shallow stone pit holding a small gold harp, a handful of loose papers, and a piece of bloody cloth.
zh_tw: 這個十尺見方的房間地板上有一個金屬格柵，擋住了通往一個淺石坑的通道，石坑裡有一個小型金豎琴、一些散亂的紙張和一塊血跡斑斑的布。

english: The iron grate covers a pit that's 5 feet square and 3 feet deep. The openings in the iron grate are 5 inches square. A character who can reach the harp can carefully tilt it and slide it through the grate with a successful {@dc 18} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. If this check fails by 5 or more, the harp falls back into the pit.
zh_tw: 鐵柵欄覆蓋著一個5尺見方、3尺深的坑。鐵柵欄的開口是5吋見方。能夠夠到豎琴的角色可以小心地傾斜它，並透過一次成功的力量值（{@dc 18}敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}））檢定將其從柵欄中滑出。如果此檢定失敗且差距達到5或更多，豎琴將掉回坑中。

english: A cultist of Vecna tried to lever the harp from the pit but fell victim to the trap on the grate. The trap tore away half of the cultist's jacket—the bloody cloth now at the pit's bottom—and papers tumbled from the cultist's pocket and through the grate. After that mishap, the cultists decided not to press their luck and left the treasure alone.
zh_tw: 一位維克那的邪教徒試圖從坑裡撬起豎琴，但不幸落入了格柵上的陷阱。陷阱撕掉了邪教徒夾克的一半——現在坑底的血跡斑斑的布——口袋裡的紙張也從邪教徒的口袋中掉落，穿過了格柵。那次不幸之後，邪教徒決定不再冒險，就不再碰那些財寶了。

english: Grate Trap
zh_tw: 格柵陷阱

english: A character can detect the grate's trap by examining the grate and succeeding on a {@dc 14} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check. The trap activates when more than 10 pounds of pressure is placed on the grate. Poisoned blades extend from grooves in the grate, dealing 14 ({@dice 4d6}) slashing damage to whatever triggered the trap, and if the target of the trap is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 14 ({@dice 4d6}) poison damage. The trap resets after 1 minute.
zh_tw: 角色可以透過檢查柵格並透過一個 {@dc 14} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定來發現柵格的陷阱。當柵格上承受超過10磅的壓力時，陷阱會啟用。帶毒的刀刃從柵格的凹槽中伸出，對觸發陷阱的目標造成14點（{@dice 4d6}）的揮砍傷害，如果陷阱的目標是生物，則它必須成功透過一個 {@dc 14} 體質豁免檢定，否則將受到14點（{@dice 4d6}）的毒素傷害。陷阱在1分鐘後重置。

english: Notes
zh_tw: 備註

english: The papers detail plans to kidnap a Neverwinter aristocrat named Indrina Lamsensettle. The notes include a map of her estate, schedules of her movements, and suggestions that she knows an important secret about Lord Neverember. A scrawl in the margin of a note claims that "her secrets will make a worthy sacrifice." (The characters can learn more by examining Jerot's papers in {@area area C25|08b|x}.)
zh_tw: 檔案詳細描述了綁架一位名為因德里娜·蘭姆森特的無冬城貴族的計劃。筆記中包括了她莊園的地圖、她的行動時間表，以及暗示她知道有關無燼領主的重要秘密。一個筆記邊緣的潦草字跡聲稱"她的秘密將是一個值得的犧牲。"（角色可以透過檢查傑羅特的檔案在{@area 區域C25|08b|x}瞭解更多。）

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The harp is worth 2,500 gp.
zh_tw: 這把豎琴價值2,500金幣。

english: C5: Sarcelle's Cell
zh_tw: C5: 薩塞勒的牢房

english: This room's only door is padlocked from the outside. As an action, a character with thieves' tools can use them to try to open the lock, doing so with a successful {@dc 18} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. The cult's four mages (in {@area areas C14|06a|x}, {@area C16|070|x}, and {@area C26|08f|x}) each carry a key to the lock. Because the stone is unevenly set around this door, a character could use an action to try to pull the door aside, doing so with a successful {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 這個房間唯一的門從外面被掛鎖鎖住了。作為一個動作，一個擁有盜賊工具的角色可以使用它們嘗試開啟鎖，成功的 {@dc 18} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定可以做到。邪教的四位法師（在 {@area 區域C14|06a|x}、{@area C16|070|x} 和 {@area C26|08f|x} 中）每人攜帶一把鎖的鑰匙。由於這扇門周圍的石頭鋪設不均勻，一個角色可以使用一個動作嘗試將門拉開，成功的 {@dc 17} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定可以做到。

english: This old crypt holds a single open coffin containing a few tattered blankets. A pouf of wild black hair sprouts from the end of one of the blankets.
zh_tw: 這座古老的墓穴裡有一個單獨的開著的棺材，裡面放著幾床破舊的毯子。一端的毯子上長著一團蓬鬆的黑色頭髮。

english: Sarcelle Malinosh
zh_tw: 薩塞勒·馬利諾什

english: The cultists repurposed this crypt into a cell for one of their intended ritual victims, Sarcelle Malinosh. Sarcelle is dozing inside the coffin, wrapped in the blankets so only her hair is visible.
zh_tw: 邪教徒將這個墓穴重新用作他們計劃儀式的受害者之一，薩塞勒·馬利諾什的牢房。薩塞勒在棺材裡打盹，被毯子包裹著，只露出她的頭髮。

english: Sarcelle is a human wild-magic sorcerer whose spellcasting power was stripped during a recent excursion to a distant plane. Until her magic naturally returns, Sarcelle has the game statistics of a neutral {@creature mage} without Spellcasting. She responds to some questions with cryptic-sounding predictions, but she tries to keep this irritating habit in check.
zh_tw: 薩塞勒是一位人類野魔法術士，她在最近一次前往遙遠位面的探險中失去了施法能力。在她自然恢復魔法之前，薩塞勒擁有一箇中立的{@creature mage||魔法師}的遊戲具體數值，但不包括施法能力。她有時會用聽起來很神秘的預言來回答一些問題，但她試圖控制這種令人煩惱的習慣。

english: Sarcelle wants help freeing herself; she explains that without her magic, she feels uneasy and would appreciate being escorted from Neverdeath Graveyard. She can make her way home from there.
zh_tw: 薩塞勒希望得到幫助以解放自己；她解釋說，沒有她的魔法，她感到不安，並希望有人能護送她離開無冬墓園。從那裡她可以自己回家。

english: Sarcelle's Secret
zh_tw: 薩塞勒的秘密

english: Sarcelle's psychic explorations showed her a glimpse of a dreadful future. She saw the desiccated figure of a man levitating off the ground, gathering evil energy around himself in glowing wisps. The desiccated man then screamed and the energy exploded, causing something terrible to happen. This vision terrified Sarcelle. A character who interacts with Sarcelle and succeeds on a {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check realizes that something is bothering the sorcerer. If asked about what's upsetting her, Sarcelle shares her vision.
zh_tw: 薩塞勒的靈能探索讓她瞥見了一個可怕的未來。她看到一個乾枯的男性形象從地面漂浮起來，周身聚集著邪惡的能量，形成發光的縷縷光芒。接著，那個乾枯的男人尖叫著，能量爆炸，導致某種可怕的事情發生。這個景象令薩塞勒感到恐懼。一個與薩塞勒互動併成功透過 {@dc 14} 感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定的角色會意識到有些事情困擾著這位術士。如果被問到是什麼讓她心煩意亂，薩塞勒會分享她的幻象。

english: Learning of Sarcelle's vision counts as a secret for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules found in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
zh_tw: 得知薩塞勒的幻象在這本書的{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中發現的{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則中被視為一個秘密。

english: C6: Supply Room
zh_tw: C6: 補給室

english: Stone shelves in this room contain boxes and bags. A few crates are stacked against the wall.
zh_tw: 這個房間的石架上放著盒子和袋子。一些板條箱堆靠在牆上。

english: The cultists emptied this servants' crypt to store supplies such as lantern oil, chains, and manacles.
zh_tw: 邪教徒清空了這個僕人墓穴，用來存放諸如燈籠油、鏈條和手銬等物資。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Among the supplies are two {@item Potion of Poison||Potions of Poison} labeled "Healing Use Only."
zh_tw: 在這些補給品中有兩個標有"僅限治療使用"的{@item Potion of Poison||毒藥藥水}。

english: C7: Fountain Room
zh_tw: C7: 噴泉室

english: If the characters minimized the water pressure in area C8, omit the first sentence when reading aloud:
zh_tw: 如果角色們在區域C8減少了水壓，請在大聲朗讀時省略第一句話：

english: Rusted pipes run along the walls and ceiling, and water flows from nozzles in the ceiling pipes. In the center of the room is a deep stone basin that's set into the floor and filled to the brim. The surface ripples, revealing several watery creatures inside. To the south, a closed door is padlocked.
zh_tw: 生鏽的管道沿著牆壁和天花板延伸，水從天花板管道的噴嘴裡流出。房間中央是一個深石盆，嵌入地板中，水滿到邊緣。水面泛起漣漪，露出了裡面幾個水生生物。房間的南側有一扇被掛鎖鎖住的門。

english: See {@area area C11|061|x} for more information about the padlocked door.
zh_tw: 有關掛鎖門的更多資訊，請參考{@area 區域C11|061|x}。

english: A {@creature water elemental} and two {@creature Water Weird||water weirds} live in the 25-foot-deep fountain. These creatures are indifferent toward intruders and attack only in self-defense. Once bound to serve the Waterclock Guild, they're now free but enjoy the perpetual "rain" here. The cult bullies these Elementals, so they remain sulking under the water's surface. Determined not to stand for further intrusion, the Elementals rise to attack anyone other than cultists. The water weirds consider the water elemental their leader. If reduced to fewer than 50 hit points, the water elemental retreats to the basin's bottom with any surviving water weirds.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature Water Weird||水詭}和兩個{@creature water elemental||水元素}居住在這個深25尺的噴泉中。這些生物對入侵者漠不關心，只有在自衛時才會攻擊。它們曾被繫結為水鍾公會服務，現在雖然自由了，但它們喜歡這裡不斷的"雨"。邪教徒欺負這些元素生物，所以它們在水面下悶悶不樂。決心不再容忍進一步的入侵，這些元素生物會攻擊除了邪教徒之外的任何人。水怪異們將水詭視為它們的領袖。如果水詭的生命值降至50點以下，它將帶著任何倖存的水怪異撤退到盆底。

english: The water elemental enjoys conversation but speaks Aquan only. Characters who are able to communicate with the water elemental can learn the following from it:
zh_tw: 水元素喜歡交談，但只說水族語。能夠與水元素交流的角色可以從它那裡瞭解到以下資訊：

english: Cult Activity
zh_tw: 邪教活動

english: Cultists who worship a god whose symbol is a hand and an eye recently moved into nearby rooms.
zh_tw: 崇拜一個以手和眼為象徵的神的邪教徒最近搬進了附近的房間。

english: Neighbor
zh_tw: 鄰居

english: A fish-headed creature named Shanzezim lives in {@area area C10|05c|x}.
zh_tw: 一個名為珊澤辛的魚頭生物居住在{@area 區域C10|05c|x}。

english: Prisoner
zh_tw: 囚犯

english: The cultists locked a small creature in an adjacent room ({@area area C11|061|x}).
zh_tw: 邪教徒在隔壁房間（{@area 區域C11|061|x}）鎖住了一隻小動物。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A silver bracelet set with seven small diamonds fell to the bottom of the basin. It's worth 150 gp.
zh_tw: 一隻鑲嵌有七顆小鑽石的銀色手鐲掉入了盆底。它值150金幣。

english: C8: East Pressure Room
zh_tw: C8: 東壓力室

english: Pipes along the south wall of this room disappear into the walls near the ceiling. A complicated series of cogs and four hand-turned wheels connect to the pipes.
zh_tw: 這個房間南牆上的管道在接近天花板的地方消失在牆壁中。一系列複雜的齒輪和四個手動轉動的輪子與管道相連。

english: Many of Vecna's cultists in Neverdeath Graveyard bear tattoos of the lich-god's unholy symbol
zh_tw: 在無冬墓園中，許多崇拜維克那的邪教徒身上都有巫妖神的不潔象徵的紋身。

english: The wheels control the water pressure through the pipes, but they lack gauges to show how turning the wheels affects the pressure. A character can determine that the water flows west, as well as how to maximize or minimize the water pressure, with an hour of trial and error. A character who succeeds on a {@dc 16} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check discovers this information in only 10 minutes. Alternatively, the {@creature marid} Shanzezim in {@area area C10|05c|x} can describe how to work the wheels.
zh_tw: 輪子透過管道控制水壓，但它們缺少儀表來顯示轉動輪子如何影響水壓。一個角色可以透過一小時的試驗和錯誤來確定水流向西，以及如何最大化或最小化水壓。一個成功透過 {@dc 16} 智力 ({@skill Investigation||調查}) 檢定的角色可以在僅僅10分鐘內發現這個資訊。或者，位於 {@area 區域C10|05c|x} 的 {@creature marid||水巨靈} 珊澤辛可以描述如何操作這些輪子。

english: Minimum Pressure
zh_tw: 最小壓力

english: If the characters minimize the water pressure, the nozzles in area C7 stop flowing.
zh_tw: 如果角色們最小化水壓，區域C7的噴嘴就會停止流水。

english: Maximum Pressure
zh_tw: 最大壓力

english: If the characters maximize the water pressure here and in {@area area C12|064|x}, the basins in areas {@area C14|06a|x} and {@area C15|06e|x} start to overflow. After 10 minutes, those areas become {@book difficult terrain|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain} due to flooding. Five minutes after that, the denizens of area C14 come to investigate areas C8 and C12, bringing along both ghouls from area {@area C17|073|x}. The cultists shout about "teaching those meddling elementals a lesson" as they arrive, allowing the characters time to set up an ambush or another ploy.
zh_tw: 如果角色在這裡和{@area 區域C12|064|x}最大化水壓，那麼{@area C14|06a|x}和{@area C15|06e|x}的盆子開始溢位。10分鐘後，這些區域由於洪水變成了《玩家手冊》中第8頁所述的{@book 困難地形|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}。5分鐘後，區域C14的居民來到調查區域C8和C12，並帶來了來自區域{@area C17|073|x}的食屍鬼。邪教徒在到達時高喊要"教訓那些多管閒事的元素生物"，這給角色們留下了設定伏擊或其它計策的時間。

english: C9: Clockwork Alcove
zh_tw: C9: 發條壁龕

english: Rusty standpipes and interlocking cogs cover the walls of this small alcove.
zh_tw: 這個小壁龕的牆上覆蓋著生鏽的立管和相互齧合的齒輪。

english: The cogs here are jammed together and don't move. Whatever mechanism they connect to is inoperable.
zh_tw: 這裡的齒輪卡住了，無法移動。它們連線的任何機械裝置都無法操作。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: One cog on the north wall doesn't connect to anything else on the wall around it. A creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check to find this loose cog. When turned, the cog causes part of the wall to slide away as a secret door. The cultists aren't aware of this door. The small passageway beyond ends at another secret door that is easily spotted and opened from inside the tunnel. It leads to {@area area C2|041|x}.
zh_tw: 北牆上的一個齒輪沒有連線到周圍的任何其他部分。一個生物必須成功透過 {@dc 14} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定才能發現這個鬆動的齒輪。當轉動時，齒輪會使部分牆壁滑開，形成一個秘密門。邪教徒並未察覺到這扇門。通道的另一端通向另一個秘密門，該門從隧道內部很容易發現和開啟，通往 {@area 區域C2|041|x}。

english: C10: Improvised Workshop
zh_tw: C10: 臨時工作室

english: The marid Shanzezim is bound to the crypts and spends time tinkering with clocks in an improvised workshop
zh_tw: 水巨靈珊澤辛被束縛在墓穴中，並在一個臨時的工作坊裡花時間修理鐘錶。

english: Rubble chokes the southeast corner of the room, leaving only a small gap near the uneven ceiling. Some of the rubble has been reassembled into a low table, which bears small clockwork components. A hulking, fish-headed creature wearing exquisite silk finery carefully examines the tiny parts.
zh_tw: 碎石堵塞了房間的東南角，只在不平整的天花板附近留下了一個小縫隙。一些碎石被重新組裝成一個低矮的桌子，桌子上放著小型的機械零件。一個笨重的、魚頭的生物穿著精緻的絲綢服裝，正在仔細檢查這些微小的部件。

english: The creature is a {@creature marid} named Shanzezim. The marid was bound by the Waterclock Guild and can't leave the crypts belonging to that organization, even though Shanzezim believes the Waterclock Guild has been defunct for years. Not quite ready to test the binding to make an escape, the marid spends time here trying to reassemble one of the Waterclock Guild's most intricate clocks.
zh_tw: 這個生物是一個名叫珊澤辛的{@creature marid||水巨靈}。水巨靈被水鍾公會束縛，不能離開屬於該組織的墓穴，儘管珊澤辛相信水鍾公會已經解散多年。水巨靈還沒有準備好測試束縛以嘗試逃跑，它在這裡花費時間試圖重新組裝水鍾公會最複雜的時鐘之一。

english: If the {@creature water elemental} in {@area area C7|052|x} fled here, it informed Shanzezim about intruders in the area, so the marid attacks right away to drive off the characters. Otherwise, the marid asks the characters what they want. If a fight breaks out, the marid surrenders if reduced to fewer than 100 hit points or if the characters insist that they aren't with the cult.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature water elemental||水元素}在{@area 區域C7|052|x}逃到這裡，它告知了珊澤辛有關區域的入侵者，所以這個水巨靈會立即攻擊以驅趕角色。否則，水巨靈會問角色他們想要什麼。如果發生戰鬥，當水巨靈的生命值降至100點以下，或者角色堅持說他們不是邪教成員時，水巨靈會投降。

english: Shanzezim's Lore
zh_tw: 珊澤辛的傳說

english: If the characters talk to the marid and reassure Shanzezim they're not part of the cult, Shanzezim offers the characters a gold-colored flywheel from the disassembled clock. The marid is chatty and can share the following pieces of information:
zh_tw: 如果角色與水巨靈交談並向珊澤辛保證他們不是邪教的一部分，珊澤辛會向角色提供一個從拆卸的鐘表中取出的金色飛輪。這個水巨靈很健談，可以分享以下資訊：

english: Clock Assembly
zh_tw: 鐘錶組裝

english: Shanzezim decided to reassemble a mechanical clock the Waterclock Guild left behind. The marid believes the thousands of parts are all here and reassembly shouldn't take more than another few years. The length of time doesn't bother Shanzezim, since the marid enjoys the work.
zh_tw: 珊澤辛決定重新組裝水鍾公會留下的一個機械鐘。水巨靈相信成千上萬的零件都在這裡，重新組裝不需要超過幾年時間。時間的長短並不打擾珊澤辛，因為水巨靈喜歡這項工作。

english: Cult Activity
zh_tw: 邪教活動

english: Cruel cultists bully the Elementals in the next room and are keeping a prisoner nearby. The prisoner is a gnome whom Shanzezim hasn't yet met.
zh_tw: 殘忍的邪教徒在隔壁房間欺負元素生物，並在附近關押了一名囚犯。這名囚犯是一個侏儒，珊澤辛還沒有見過。

english: Pipe System
zh_tw: 管道系統

english: The pipes running through this area lead to a part of the crypt where Shanzezim can't go, but to which the pipes' water flows. Shanzezim describes how to maximize and minimize the water pressure in {@area areas C8|055|x} and {@area C12|064|x}, opining with delight that turning the flow to maximum pressure in both areas should flood out the recently arrived cultists in short order.
zh_tw: 穿過這個區域的管道通向一個墓穴的部分，珊澤辛不能去，但管道的水流向那裡。珊澤辛描述了如何在{@area 區域C8|055|x}和{@area C12|064|x}最大化和最小化水壓，並高興地認為，在兩個區域都將流量調至最大壓力，應該很快就能淹沒最近到達的邪教徒。

english: Waterclock Guild
zh_tw: 水鍾公會

english: Shanzezim is bound to a portion of the catacombs once controlled by a vanished organization of artificers and geomancers called the Waterclock Guild. Additional guild catacombs lie past the collapsed portion of this room, but they hold nothing of interest.
zh_tw: 珊澤辛被束縛在一部分曾經由一個叫做水鍾公會的消失的工匠和地師組織控制的地下墓穴中。公會的其他墓穴位於這個房間坍塌部分的另一邊，但那裡沒有什麼有趣的東西。

english: Beyond the Rubble
zh_tw: 瓦礫之外

english: It takes several days of labor to clear the rubble so creatures can pass through it, but Shanzezim is right about there being nothing relevant beyond it. If the characters are determined to explore the other Waterclock Guild chambers, you can invent water-themed or clockwork-based denizens and traps for them to encounter.
zh_tw: 清除瓦礫以便生物透過需要幾天的勞動，但珊澤辛說得對，瓦礫那邊沒有什麼相關的東西。如果角色們決心探索其他的水鍾公會的房間，你可以為它們發明以水為主題的或基於發條機制的居民和陷阱，讓它們遇到。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The clock parts include a gold-colored flywheel that isn't a part of the clock Shanzezim is trying to assemble. The flywheel thus doesn't interest the marid, who gives it to the characters. The gold-colored flywheel is magical and has the properties of a {@item Stone of Good Luck}.
zh_tw: 這些鐘錶零件包括一個金色的飛輪，它不是珊澤辛試圖組裝的鐘表的一部分。因此，這個飛輪對水巨靈沒有興趣，他把它給了角色們。這個金色的飛輪具有魔法屬性，具有一個{@item Stone of Good Luck||吉運之石}的特性。

english: C11: Umberto's Cell
zh_tw: C11: 翁貝托的牢房

english: This room's only door is padlocked from the outside with a new, sturdy lock. As an action, a character with thieves' tools can try to use them to open the lock, doing so with a successful {@dc 18} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. The cult's four mages (in {@area areas C14|06a|x}, {@area C16|070|x}, and {@area C26|08f|x}) each carry a key that unlocks it. If the characters are friendly with the {@creature water elemental} (see {@area area C7|052|x}) or Shanzezim (see area C10), either is happy to flow into the crack around the door and burst it open from the inside, much to the surprise of this room's occupant, Umberto Noblin.
zh_tw: 這個房間唯一的門被從外面用一把新的堅固鎖具鎖上了。作為一個動作，擁有盜賊工具的角色可以嘗試使用它們來開啟鎖，需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 18} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定。邪教的四名法師（位於 {@area 區域C14|06a|x}、{@area C16|070|x} 和 {@area C26|08f|x}）各自攜帶一把可以開啟它的鑰匙。如果角色與 {@creature water elemental||水元素}（見 {@area 區域C7|052|x}）或珊澤辛（見區域 C10）友好，它們會很高興地從門縫中流入並從內部將門爆開，這讓房間的居住者翁貝托·諾布林大為驚訝。

english: Water leaks down the walls of this cell and pools on the floor near a rusty drain. A dejected gnome sits on a sodden mattress in one corner.
zh_tw: 水從這個牢房的牆壁上滲漏下來，在靠近一個生鏽的排水口的地板上積聚成池。一個沮喪的侏儒坐在一個角落的溼床墊上。

english: Umberto Noblin
zh_tw: 翁貝托·諾布林

english: Umberto Noblin is a gnome historian who is eager to escape Neverdeath Graveyard. Umberto has the game statistics of a lawful neutral {@creature mage} without Spellcasting.
zh_tw: 翁貝托·諾布林是一位侏儒歷史學家，他渴望逃離無冬墓園。翁貝托擁有一個守序中立的{@creature mage||魔法師}的遊戲具體數值，但不包括施法能力。

english: Umberto's Secret
zh_tw: 翁貝托的秘密

english: Umberto knows that cultists of Vecna are his kidnappers, as he's one of Neverwinter's preeminent experts on Vecna's history. He initially keeps his expertise from the characters lest they think he's in league with the cult.
zh_tw: 翁貝托知道綁架他的是維克那的邪教徒，因為他是無冬城關於維克那歷史的傑出專家之一。他最初沒有向角色們透露自己的專長，以免他們認為他與邪教有勾結。

english: To keep his mind off of the nightmare of his capture and imprisonment, Umberto focuses on complaining about the poor cuisine. If the characters free Umberto and share some tasty food with him, he reveals his expertise in Vecna's history. Umberto especially likes food created with or by magic, such as berries from the {@spell Goodberry} spell.
zh_tw: 為了讓自己不去想被俘和監禁的噩夢，翁貝托專注於抱怨糟糕的食物。如果角色們釋放了翁貝托並與他分享一些美味的食物，他將透露自己在維克那歷史上的專長。翁貝托特別喜歡用魔法或透過魔法創造的食物，例如使用{@spell Goodberry||神莓術}法術生長的漿果。

english: If Umberto reveals his role as a historian of Vecna, it's all he can talk about. He discusses his latest clandestine research project: the ancient rivalry between Vecna and his treacherous lieutenant, the vampire Kas. The historian has kept this research to himself so other scholars don't beat him to publication; Umberto knows he's a slow writer. The gnome's chattering should be endearing rather than irritating, and you can use Umberto to impart basic history about Vecna and Kas as described in the {@area introduction|004|x}.
zh_tw: 如果翁貝托透露了他作為維克那歷史學家的角色，這就是他唯一能談論的話題。他討論了他最新的秘密研究專案：維克那和他的叛徒副手，吸血鬼凱斯之間的古老競爭。這位歷史學家一直將這項研究保密，以免其他學者在他之前發表；翁貝托知道他是一個寫作速度慢的人。侏儒的喋喋不休應該是討人喜歡而不是令人討厭的，你可以利用翁貝托來傳授關於維克那和凱斯的基本歷史，正如在{@area 簡介|004|x}中描述的那樣。

english: Learning about Umberto's secret research topic counts as a secret for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
zh_tw: 瞭解翁貝托的秘密研究課題在這本書的{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中發現的{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則中被視為一個秘密。

english: C12: West Pressure Room
zh_tw: C12: 西側壓力室

english: Pipes climb the north wall, disappearing near the ceiling. A complicated series of cogs and three hand-turned wheels connect to the pipes.
zh_tw: 管道沿著北牆上升，在接近天花板的地方消失。一系列複雜的齒輪和三個手動轉動的輪子與管道相連。

english: The wheels control the pipes' water pressure. As in {@area area C8|055|x}, a character can determine how to maximize or minimize the water pressure with an hour of trial and error, with 10 minutes of trial and error if a character succeeds on a {@dc 14} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation} check), or with Shanzezim's instructions.
zh_tw: 輪子控制著管道的水壓。如同在 {@area 區域C8|055|x} 中，角色可以透過一小時的試錯來確定如何最大化或最小化水壓，如果角色在 {@dc 14} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查} 檢定）中成功，則只需10分鐘的試錯，或者使用珊澤辛的指示。

english: Minimum Pressure
zh_tw: 最小壓力

english: Minimizing the pressure here doesn't affect the nozzles in {@area area C7|052|x}.
zh_tw: 在這裡最小化壓力不會影響{@area 區域C7|052|x}的噴嘴。

english: Maximum Pressure
zh_tw: 最大壓力

english: If the characters maximize the water pressure both here and in area C12, the basins in {@area areas C14|06a|x} and {@area C15|06e|x} start to overflow (see {@area area C8|055|x} for more information).
zh_tw: 如果角色在此處和區域 C12 中最大化水壓，{@area 區域C14|06a|x} 和 {@area C15|06e|x} 中的水池將開始溢位（更多資訊請參見 {@area 區域C8|055|x}）。

english: C13: Wall Crossing
zh_tw: C13: 牆壁穿越

english: This small room appears to be a crossroads between different parts of the graveyard. Steep stairs descend from the east and west sides of this room. Four bells of different sizes hang from leather cords affixed to the ceiling.
zh_tw: 這個小房間似乎是墓地不同部分之間的交叉路口。陡峭的樓梯從這個房間的東邊和西邊下降。四個大小不一的鈴鐺懸掛在固定在天花板上的皮繩上。

english: This room is set into the wall separating Neverdeath's Main Graveyard and Pauper's Graveyard. This room lets the cultists pass between the two graveyards without venturing aboveground.
zh_tw: 這個房間位於分隔無冬墓園主墓地和貧民墓地的牆壁內。這個房間讓邪教徒能夠在不冒險到地面的情況下在兩個墓地之間穿行。

english: Arriving cultists ring specific bells in a predetermined pattern, based on their rank, so cultists in the common room (area C14) can prepare an appropriate welcome. If the characters ring the bells without knowing their significance and patterns, the cultists in area C14 are alert to trouble.
zh_tw: 到達的邪教徒會根據他們的等級，按照預定的模式敲響特定的鐘聲，以便在公共休息室（區域C14）的邪教徒可以準備適當的歡迎。如果角色們在不瞭解鐘聲的意義和模式的情況下敲響鐘聲，區域C14的邪教徒會警覺到麻煩。

english: C14: Common Room
zh_tw: C14: 公共休息室

english: Tables and chairs in this crypt are arranged to create a meeting room or mess hall. Water drips from a pipe into a basin in the southeast corner beneath a detailed image of a staring eye gripped in a withered hand. Five robed cultists are in this room, with one bullying the rest.
zh_tw: 這個墓穴中的桌子和椅子被排列成會議室或食堂。水從一根管道滴入東南角的一個盆中，盆下方是一隻枯萎的手緊握著一個瞪大眼睛的詳細影象。這個房間裡有五個穿著長袍的邪教徒，其中一個正在欺負其他人。

english: A neutral evil {@creature mage} and four neutral evil {@creature Cult Fanatic||cult fanatics} occupy this room. The mage, a sneering, human bully named Oxtu, insists the cult fanatics call him by his formal title of "Teeth of Vecna." In turn, he refers to them as "Memories of Vecna," their rank. Oxtu likes to describe violent methods of coercing secrets from people, and the cult fanatics hang on his words. Oxtu carries keys that unlock all the prisoner cells ({@area areas C5|04c|x}, {@area C11|061|x}, {@area C18|077|x}, and {@area C20|07d|x}).
zh_tw: 一箇中立邪惡的{@creature mage||魔法師}和四名中立邪惡的{@creature Cult Fanatic||邪教狂信者}佔據了這個房間。這位法師是一個嘲笑的、名叫奧克圖的人類惡霸，他堅持讓邪教狂信者用他的正式頭銜"維克那之牙"稱呼他。反過來，他稱他們為"維克那的記憶"，這是他們的等級。奧克圖喜歡描述從人們那裡強迫獲取秘密的暴力方法，邪教狂信者們則緊隨他的話語。奧克圖攜帶的鑰匙可以開啟所有的囚犯牢房（{@area 區域C5|04c|x}、{@area C11|061|x}、{@area C18|077|x}和{@area C20|07d|x}）。

english: The cultists are quick to fight intruders. The fanatics try to stay out of the way of Oxtu's spells, but Oxtu makes no effort to exclude them. The cultists all fight to the death.
zh_tw: 邪教徒們迅速與入侵者戰鬥。這些狂熱者試圖避開奧克圖的法術，但奧克圖並沒有努力排除他們。所有邪教徒都戰鬥到死。

english: A Noisy Fight
zh_tw: 一場喧鬧的戰鬥

english: Loud noise here rouses the two {@creature Mage||mages} dozing in {@area area C16|070|x}.
zh_tw: 這裡的大聲喧鬧會驚醒在{@area 區域C16|070|x}打盹的兩位{@creature Mage||魔法師}。

english: Unholy Basin
zh_tw: 不潔之盆

english: The cultists desecrated the basin by placing iconography of Vecna above it. Creatures that aren't devotees of Vecna that drink from the basin must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition poisoned} condition for 1 hour. Cultists who suspect a lack of true devotion from their compatriots challenge each other to drink from the basin to prove their faith. If the characters come in disguise as devotees of Vecna, the cultists demand that they prove their faith by taking a drink.
zh_tw: 邪教徒透過在聖盆上方放置維克那的聖像來褻瀆它。非維克那信徒的生物若飲用聖盆中的水，必須成功透過一個 {@dc 17} 的體質豁免檢定，否則將陷入 {@condition poisoned||中毒} 狀態，持續1小時。懷疑同伴缺乏真正信仰的邪教徒會挑戰彼此飲用聖盆中的水以證明其信仰。如果角色偽裝成維克那信徒進入，邪教徒會要求他們透過飲水來證明他們的信仰。

english: C15: Kitchen
zh_tw: C15: 廚房

english: This small crypt has been converted into a kitchen. Dirty utensils soak in a large basin to the east. A stone coffin serves as a firepit; the coffin's lid has been repurposed as a table, which bears platters of dried fruit, nuts, and meat.
zh_tw: 這個小墓穴已經被改造成了一個廚房。髒的廚具在東邊的一個大型水盆裡浸泡。一個石棺被用作火坑；棺材蓋被重新用作桌子，上面擺放著乾果、堅果和肉的盤子。

english: This kitchen remains empty except during mealtimes, and no one bothers to keep it clean. Removing the utensils from the basin reveals a wide drain.
zh_tw: 這個廚房除了用餐時間外都是空的，而且沒有人會費心保持它的清潔。從盆中移開餐具會露出一個寬敞的排水口。

english: C16: Subleader Quarters
zh_tw: C16: 副領導宿舍

english: Bones in nooks along this wall were pushed aside to make room for folded robes and other personal effects. Four narrow cots lie against the north wall. A robed human and a robed elf each rest on a cot.
zh_tw: 牆壁上的壁龕中的骨頭被移開，以便為摺疊的長袍和其他個人物品騰出空間。四個狹窄的床鋪靠在北牆上。一個穿著長袍的人類和一個穿著長袍的精靈各自在一張床上休息。

english: Two neutral evil {@creature Mage||mages}, an elf man named Hannel and a human woman named Algra, rest here. They are surly, taciturn zealots who venerated Vecna in secret for decades before joining the cult. They love exercising their authority over junior cultists. Each wears a necklace of human teeth in honor of their titles within the cult hierarchy as "Teeth of Vecna." They each carry a key to the prisoner cells ({@area areas C5|04c|x}, {@area C11|061|x}, {@area C18|077|x}, and {@area C20|07d|x}).
zh_tw: 兩位中立邪惡的{@creature Mage||魔法師}，一位名叫漢內爾的精靈男性和一位名叫阿爾格拉的人類女性，在這裡休息。他們是脾氣暴躁、沉默寡言的狂熱分子，曾在秘密中崇拜維克那數十年後才加入邪教。他們喜歡在初級邪教徒上行使他們的權威。他們每個人都佩戴著一串人牙項鍊，以紀念他們在邪教等級制度中作為"維克那之牙"的頭銜。他們每人都攜帶著通往囚犯牢房（{@area 區域C5|04c|x}, {@area C11|061|x}, {@area C18|077|x}, 和 {@area C20|07d|x}）的鑰匙。

english: The mages are quick to fight if they spot intruders, since they don't want the cult exposed. They are determined to vanquish intruders and prove their worth to the cult, even if it means fighting to the death.
zh_tw: 如果這些法師發現有入侵者，他們會迅速投入戰鬥，因為他們不想讓邪教被暴露。他們決心要擊敗入侵者，並向邪教證明他們的價值，即使這意味著戰鬥到死。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: An urn in a nook on the south wall rotates, sliding aside a wall panel that leads to a short tunnel between this room and {@area area C25|08b|x}. A character who searches the room and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check finds the secret door and the means to open it. The mages know about the secret passage, but none of the cult fanatics do. At the far end of the secret passage is another secret door easily spotted and opened from inside the tunnel.
zh_tw: 南牆凹處的一個甕旋轉著，滑開了一面牆板，通往這個房間與{@area 區域C25|08b|x}之間的一條短隧道。一個搜尋房間並在{@dc 15}感知 ({@skill Perception||感知})檢定中成功的角色會發現這扇秘密門及其開啟方法。法師們知道這條秘密通道，但邪教徒狂熱者無人知曉。在秘密通道的盡頭是另一扇秘密門，從隧道內部很容易發現和開啟。

english: C17: Library
zh_tw: C17: 圖書館

english: Vecnan cultists keep a repository of information and scrolls in a makeshift library in the catacombs
zh_tw: 維克那的邪教徒在地下墓穴中設立了一個臨時圖書館，用來存放資訊和卷軸。

english: The long, low shelves of this room are canted at irregular angles due to the uneven stones in the floor. The shelves are crammed with books, scrolls, and folios. Four robed cultists stand near the south shelves instructing two ghouls to tidy up the books.
zh_tw: 這個房間的長而低的架子因為地面上的不平整石頭而以不規則角度傾斜。架子上塞滿了書籍、卷軸和資料夾。四個穿著長袍的邪教徒站在南邊的架子附近，指導兩個食屍鬼整理書籍。

english: A stone coffin rests against the north wall, its top carved to look like pages of an open book. Engraved on the book's pages is a name: Ayren Griffynstone.
zh_tw: 一個石棺靠在北牆上，它的頂部雕刻得像是一本開啟的書的頁面。在書頁上刻著一個名字：艾倫·格里芬石。

english: Four chaotic evil {@creature Cult Fanatic||cult fanatics} are supervising two {@creature Ghoul||ghouls} trying to reorganize the jumble of books the cultists brought to this tomb. The library belongs to Ayren Griffynstone, a human Neverwinter historian. The room hasn't fared well in the graveyard's upheavals, and the uneven floor makes this room {@book difficult terrain|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}.
zh_tw: 四個混亂邪惡的{@creature Cult Fanatic||邪教狂信者}正在監督兩個{@creature Ghoul||食屍鬼}試圖重新整理邪教徒帶到這個墓穴的雜亂書籍。這個圖書館屬於艾倫·格里芬石，一個人類無冬城歷史學家。由於墓地的動盪，這個房間的狀況並不好，不平整的地板使得這個房間成為{@book 困難地形|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}。

english: As Vecna is a god of knowledge as well as secrets, the cultists all contributed their personal libraries to this collection. Each of the cult fanatics has their own ideas about how this hodgepodge of eclectic works should be organized, so the ghouls labor under constant streams of conflicting directions.
zh_tw: 由於維克那既是知識之神也是秘密之神，邪教徒們都將自己個人的藏書貢獻給了這個收藏。每一位邪教狂信者對於這些雜亂無章的多樣化作品該如何組織都有自己的想法，因此食屍鬼在不斷的矛盾指令下辛勤勞作。

english: Everyone here is on edge and grateful for the distraction of a fight. If the fight turns against the fanatics, one tries to escape through the secret door to fetch the demons in {@area area C19|07a|x}.
zh_tw: 這裡的每個人都處於緊張狀態，並且對戰鬥的幹擾感到感激。如果戰鬥對狂熱者不利，其中一個會試圖透過秘密門逃跑，以召喚{@area 區域C19|07a|x}中的惡魔。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: One shelf swings back to reveal a secret passage to area C19. A character who searches the shelves and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check finds the secret door and the means to open it. All the cultists know about this secret door. At the far end of the secret passage is another secret door easily spotted and opened from inside the tunnel.
zh_tw: 一個書架向後擺動，露出了通往區域C19的秘道。一個搜尋書架併成功透過{@dc 15}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定的角色會發現這扇秘密門和開啟它的方法。所有的邪教徒都知道這扇秘密門。在秘道的盡頭是另一扇秘密門，從隧道內部很容易發現並開啟。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The collection of sinister books, many of which are duplicates, includes a few valuable tomes. A book describing the {@item Eye of Vecna} and {@item Hand of Vecna} is a masterpiece of writing and artistic illumination worth 450 gp. A book of nonsensical poetry titled Quite Good Verse has a gold-plated cover and is worth 200 gp. A book about Neverwinter's history contains a {@item Spell Scroll} of {@spell Greater Invisibility} and a {@item Spell Scroll} of {@spell Major Image} folded in its pages. The characters can find these treasures with 10 minutes of dedicated searching.
zh_tw: 這些邪惡的書籍收藏中，有許多是副本，其中包括一些珍貴的書籍。一本描述了{@item Eye of Vecna||維克那法眼}和{@item Hand of Vecna||維克那魔掌}的書是寫作和藝術插圖的傑作，價值450金幣。一本標題為《相當不錯的詩篇》的無意義詩歌集有金質封面，價值200金幣。一本關於無冬城歷史的書在其頁面中夾有一張{@spell Greater Invisibility||高等隱形術}的{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}和一張{@spell Major Image||高等幻影}的{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}。角色們可以透過10分鐘的專注搜尋找到這些寶藏。

english: C18: Vacant Cell
zh_tw: C18: 空置牢房

english: This room has a padlock outside like the other prisoner cells, but the lock hangs open.
zh_tw: 這個房間像其他囚犯牢房一樣，外面有掛鎖，但是鎖是開著的。

english: This squalid cell contains nothing but a bucket and a small heap of filthy blankets.
zh_tw: 這個骯髒的牢房除了一個桶和一小堆髒毯子外，什麼都沒有。

english: The planar scholar Eldon Keyward occupied this cell for many miserable days. He was taken to the ritual cage in {@area area C26|08f|x}, so his cell isn't locked.
zh_tw: 位面學者埃爾登·基沃德曾在這個牢房裡度過了許多痛苦的日子。他被帶到{@area 區域C26|08f|x}的儀式籠中，所以他的牢房沒有上鎖。

english: Eldon's Notebook
zh_tw: 埃爾登的筆記本

english: Anyone searching the blankets finds Eldon's prize possession: a small notebook filled with his cramped writing about extraplanar intersections, planar conjunctions, and similar esoterica.
zh_tw: 任何搜尋毯子的人都會找到埃爾登的珍貴財產：一本小筆記本，裡面密密麻麻地寫著他關於位面交叉、位面結合以及類似深奧主題的筆記。

english: C19: Demon Lair
zh_tw: C19: 惡魔巢穴

english: Hundreds of names are etched into metal plates set into the walls of this room, many scratched over and unreadable. Two hulking, red-furred, apelike creatures stalk around the room.
zh_tw: 成百上千的名字被刻在嵌入這房間牆壁的金屬板上，許多被劃掉且無法辨讀。兩隻笨重的、紅色毛髮的、類人猿生物在房間裡徘徊。

english: The two {@creature Barlgura||barlguras} here work as the cult's kidnappers. With little to do until the next kidnapping spree other than guard the imprisoned aristocrat in area C20, the demons spend their time scratching out the names on the memorial plates with their claws.
zh_tw: 這裡的兩個{@creature Barlgura||惡猿魔}充當邪教的綁架者。除了守衛區域C20中被囚禁的貴族外，這些惡魔在下一次綁架狂潮之前幾乎沒有什麼可做的，它們用爪子劃掉紀念牌上的名字來打發時間。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: One of the nameplates pivots to reveal a secret passage to {@area area C17|073|x}. A character who searches the room and succeeds on a {@dc 17} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check finds the secret door and the means to open it. The demons don't know about the secret door, but the cultists do. At the far end of the secret passage is another secret door easily spotted and opened from inside the tunnel.
zh_tw: 其中一個銘牌轉動，顯露出通往 {@area 區域C17|073|x} 的秘密通道。一個搜尋房間並在 {@dc 17} 感知 ({@skill Perception||感知}) 檢定中成功的角色會發現這扇秘密門以及開啟它的方法。惡魔們不知道這扇秘密門，但邪教徒們知道。在秘密通道的遠端是另一扇秘密門，從隧道內很容易發現並開啟。

english: C20: Indrina's Cell
zh_tw: C20: 因德里娜的牢房

english: This room's only obvious door is padlocked from the outside with a sturdy, new lock. As an action, a character with thieves' tools can use them to try to open the lock, doing so with a successful {@dc 18} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. Each of the cult's four mages (in {@area areas C14|06a|x}, {@area C16|070|x}, and {@area C26|08f|x}) carries a key to it. Once the characters open the door, read the following:
zh_tw: 這個房間唯一明顯的門從外面用一把堅固的新鎖鎖住了。作為一個動作，一個擁有盜賊工具的角色可以使用它們嘗試開啟鎖，做一個成功的 {@dc 18} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定即可。邪教組織的四位法師（分別在 {@area 區域C14|06a|x}、{@area C16|070|x} 和 {@area C26|08f|x}）各自攜帶了一把鑰匙。一旦角色們開啟了門，請閱讀以下內容：

english: This crypt smells like a sewer. A woman sits on a mattress atop a low shelf, her once-fine clothing in tatters and a silk scarf wrapped around her face.
zh_tw: 這個墓穴聞起來像下水道。一個女人坐在一個低架上的床墊上，她曾經華麗的衣服已經破爛不堪，臉上圍著一條絲綢圍巾。

english: Indrina Lamsensettle
zh_tw: 因德里娜·蘭姆森特

english: The prisoner is a human actor named Indrina Lamsensettle. Indrina's normally haughty demeanor has diminished in her imprisonment, though she's determined to make the cult pay once she escapes. Indrina dreams of returning to her estate, cleaning up, and dousing herself in perfumes. She doesn't know anything about Vecna or what the cult has in store for her; she believes that Lord Neverember is behind her imprisonment. Indrina has the game statistics of a lawful neutral {@creature noble} but is unarmed and unarmored.
zh_tw: 這名囚犯是一位名叫因德里娜·蘭姆森特的人類演員。因德里娜通常傲慢的態度在她的囚禁中已經減弱，儘管她決心一旦逃脫就讓邪教付出代價。因德里娜夢想著回到她的莊園，清理乾淨，並用香水灑滿自己。她對維克那或邪教為她準備了什麼一無所知；她認為無燼領主是她被囚禁的幕後黑手。因德里娜擁有一個守序中立的{@creature noble||貴族}的遊戲具體數值，但手無寸鐵且沒有護甲。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: Part of the south wall swings aside when shoved. The short hall beyond leads to the {@area latrine|083|x} and smells even worse than Indrina's cell. A character who searches this room and succeeds on a {@dc 18} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check finds the secret door. Indrina doesn't know the door is there.
zh_tw: 當用力推動時，南牆的一部分會向旁邊擺動。後面的短走廊通向{@area 廁所|083|x}，氣味甚至比因德里娜的牢房還要糟糕。一個搜尋此房間並在{@dc 18} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定中成功的角色會發現秘密門。因德里娜並不知道門的存在。

english: Indrina's Secret
zh_tw: 因德里娜的秘密

english: Indrina collected information from skilled genealogists and assembled proof that Lord Neverember isn't descended from Neverwinter's great hero, Lord Nasher Alagondar, as he claims. Indrina assumes Lord Neverember wants to silence her for what she's discovered.
zh_tw: 因德里娜從熟練的譜系學家那裡收集資訊，並整理出了證據，證明無燼領主並非如他所聲稱的那樣是無冬城偉大英雄納舍爾·阿拉貢達爾領主的後裔。因德里娜認為無燼領主想要因為她發現的事情而讓她沉默。

english: If the characters admit to working for Lord Neverember, Indrina doesn't reveal what she knows. A character who asks why Indrina is here without revealing who hired the characters can attempt a {@dc 18} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check, with advantage if Indrina is given perfume or otherwise removed from the cell's offensive smell. On a success, Indrina reveals her secret knowledge.
zh_tw: 如果角色們承認在為領主無燼工作，因德里娜不會透露她所知的資訊。如果角色詢問因德里娜為何在此，且不透露是誰僱傭了他們，則可以嘗試進行一次{@dc 18}魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，若給予因德里娜香水或以其他方式消除牢房的難聞氣味，則具有優勢。若成功，因德里娜會透露她的秘密知識。

english: Learning Indrina's discovery counts as a secret for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}. Lord Neverember casually dismisses Indrina's accusation if it's later brought to his attention, insisting that the woman can't prove anything.
zh_tw: 瞭解因德里娜的發現在這本書的{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中發現的{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則中被視為一個秘密。如果後來有人向無燼領主提出因德里娜的指控，他會不以為意地駁回，堅稱那位女士無法證明任何事情。

english: C21: Haunted Room
zh_tw: C21: 鬧鬼的房間

english: The outside of this door bears a large "X" painted on it in red.
zh_tw: 這扇門的外面用紅色畫著一個大大的'X'。

english: Several urns lie shattered across the floor of this room amid heaps of ash and bone dust.
zh_tw: 這個房間的地板上散落著幾個破碎的骨灰甕，周圍是成堆的灰燼和骨灰。

english: The cultists disturbed two {@creature Wraith||wraiths} bound to the urns while ransacking the room. The cultists quickly retreated and haven't been back. The wraiths emerge from the dust and ash when anyone opens the door, shrieking, "Vecnans, die!" They vent their rage on nearby creatures, preferring to attack cultists. The wraiths fight until destroyed.
zh_tw: 邪教徒在洗劫房間時驚擾了兩個附著在甕上的{@creature Wraith||邪靈}。邪教徒迅速撤退，並且沒有再回來。當任何人開啟門時，怨靈會從灰塵和灰燼中出現，尖叫著'維克那ns，去死！'它們將怒火發洩在附近的生物身上，更傾向於攻擊邪教徒。怨靈會戰鬥到被摧毀為止。

english: C22: Latrine
zh_tw: C22: 廁所

english: This filthy latrine is merely a deep pit with a few boards across it. The stink is overpowering.
zh_tw: 這個骯髒的廁所只是一個深坑，上面鋪著幾塊木板。臭味令人難以忍受。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: The north wall of this disgusting room swings aside when a particular stone is pressed. A character who searches the room and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check finds the secret door. All the cultists know about this secret door and open it from time to time to waft the smell into Indrina's cell ({@area area C20|07d|x}).
zh_tw: 這個噁心房間的北牆在按下特定石頭時會向一側開啟。一個搜尋房間併成功透過 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定的角色會發現這個秘密門。所有邪教徒都知道這個秘密門，並時不時開啟它，將氣味吹進因德里娜的牢房（{@area 區域C20|07d|x}）。

english: C23: Corridor
zh_tw: C23: 走廊

english: A shuffling cultist bearing a vacant expression moves through the corridor. Several narrow doorways lead off this long hall.
zh_tw: 一個拖著腳步、面無表情的邪教徒穿過走廊。幾個狹窄的門道從這條長廊延伸出去。

english: The Vecnan cult leader, Jerot Galgin, used a dreadful ritual to drain the cultist of her knowledge and vitality. This cultist, as well as other people whose secrets the cult have sacrificed to Vecna, has the game statistics of a {@creature zombie}. The cultist is a Humanoid rather than Undead and isn't immune to poison damage or the {@condition poisoned} condition. She is dressed like the other cult members and doesn't attack anyone dressed like cultists.
zh_tw: 維克那邪教領袖，傑羅特·加爾金，使用了一個可怕的儀式來耗盡邪教徒的知識和活力。這個邪教徒，以及其他那些邪教為了向維克那獻祭而犧牲秘密的人，擁有{@creature zombie||喪屍}的遊戲具體數值。邪教徒是一個類人生物而不是不死生物，並且對毒素傷害或{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態沒有免疫。她穿著和其他邪教成員一樣的衣服，不會攻擊穿著邪教徒服裝的人。

english: Made an Example
zh_tw: 樹立了榜樣

english: Raina Kairls was caught planning to betray the cult to Neverwinter's guards. Jerot first tested the sacrificial ritual on Raina and thinks she serves as a useful reminder of the price of betrayal.
zh_tw: 蕾娜·凱爾斯因計劃向無冬城的守衛出賣邪教而被抓獲。傑羅特首先在蕾娜身上測試了祭祀儀式，並認為她作為一個有用的提醒，展示了背叛的代價。

english: C24: Empty Crypts
zh_tw: C24: 空墓穴

english: This narrow doorway leads into a small, empty crypt.
zh_tw: 這個狹窄的門道通向一個小巧且空無一物的墓穴。

english: These four rooms are empty.
zh_tw: 這四個房間都是空的。

english: C25: Leader's Room
zh_tw: C25: 領袖的房間

english: This large room has been furnished to resemble a cozy bedroom and study. Stooped over a desk and scribbling furiously on a parchment is a gaunt, robed human man. Standing next to the desk is a one-eyed, bipedal horror with spikes growing out of its back. Tapestries depicting feasting undead creatures hang on the wall.
zh_tw: 這個大房間佈置得像一個舒適的臥室和書房。一個瘦削、穿著長袍的人類男子正彎腰在一張桌子上，瘋狂地在羊皮紙上寫著什麼。站在桌子旁邊的是一個獨眼、兩足行走的怪物，它的背上長著尖刺。牆上掛著描繪著宴享不死生物的掛毯。

english: Jerot Galgin
zh_tw: 傑羅特·加爾金

english: The cult's leader is a neutral evil, human {@creature necromancer wizard|MPMM} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) named Jerot Galgin. A loyal {@creature nothic} assistant named Maszundrin never leaves Jerot's side. A devotee of Vecna, Maszundrin learned Common while lurking in the catacombs for decades and considers the cultists vital servants of the lich-god.
zh_tw: 邪教的領袖是一箇中立邪惡的人類{@creature necromancer wizard|MPMM|死靈師}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}），名叫傑羅特·加爾金。一個忠誠的{@creature nothic||諾斯怪}助手名叫馬茲恩德林，從不離傑羅特的身邊。作為維克那的信徒，馬茲恩德林在地下墓穴潛伏了幾十年，學會了通用語，並且認為邪教徒是巫妖神的重要僕人。

english: Jerot is an aristocrat who has lived his entire life in Neverwinter. He has built his deep faith in Vecna and vast necromantic knowledge over many years, right under the noses of his peers. He's engaging in this current research while his friends and family believe him to be on an extended trip to Waterdeep. Jerot considers his secret life as a cult leader, or the "Thought of Vecna," to be yet another way to honor his evil patron.
zh_tw: 傑羅特是一位貴族，他的一生都在無冬城度過。多年來，他在同齡人的眼皮底下建立了對維克那的深厚信仰和廣泛的死靈法術知識。當他的朋友和家人以為他去深水城長途旅行時，他正在進行這項研究。傑羅特認為他作為邪教領袖，或者說是"維克那之思"，是他向邪惡守護神表示敬意的另一種方式。

english: Jerot is refining the ritual occurring in the Sacrifice Gallery (area C26) and is too focused on his work to be distracted by combat elsewhere in the catacombs. He trusts his minions to handle any trouble. If intruders reach Jerot's personal chamber, he commands the {@creature nothic} to enter melee while he fights from a distance, summoning Undead defenders if the nothic falls. Jerot fears exposure more than anything else and thus fights to the death.
zh_tw: 傑羅特正在完善在祭祀畫廊（區域C26）進行的儀式，他太專注於自己的工作，不會被墓穴其他地方的戰鬥分心。他相信他的手下能夠處理任何麻煩。如果入侵者到達傑羅特的私人房間，他會命令{@creature nothic||諾斯怪}進入近戰，而他自己則從遠處戰鬥，如果諾斯怪倒下，他會召喚不死生物守衛。傑羅特最害怕的是曝光，因此他會戰鬥到死。

english: Jerot's Papers
zh_tw: 傑羅特的檔案

english: Jerot's notes on the ritual describe draining and sacrificing a victim's secrets and knowledge to Vecna. His notes illustrate the first test of the ritual, which used a disloyal cultist as the victim. For his future attempts, Jerot has chosen townspeople from Neverwinter whom he believes have particularly meaningful secrets. Their secrets are the cultists' best offerings to Vecna.
zh_tw: 傑羅特關於儀式的筆記描述了將一個受害者的秘密和知識耗盡並獻祭給維克那的過程。他的筆記展示了儀式的第一次測試，使用了一位不忠的邪教徒作為受害者。對於他未來的嘗試，傑羅特選擇了他認為擁有特別有意義秘密的無冬城鎮民。他們的秘密是邪教徒給維克那最好的獻祭。

english: A character who examines Jerot's notes and succeeds on a {@dc 14} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check finds mention of magical phenomena called "Crevices of Dusk" that sometimes appear in Neverwinter. The notes indicate that these magical gateways connect to a plane populated by Undead, but it's clear Jerot doesn't know much more than that. His notes indicate his resolve to learn more after he finishes his current experiments in stealing and offering secrets to Vecna.
zh_tw: 一名角色如果檢查傑羅特的筆記併成功透過一次 {@dc 14} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，會發現提到一種名為"暮色裂隙"的魔法現象，這種裂隙有時會出現在無冬城。筆記中指出，這些魔法通道連線到一個由不死生物棲息的位面，但顯然傑羅特對此知之甚少。他的筆記表明，他決心在完成當前的實驗後，透過竊取並向維克那獻上秘密來進一步研究。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A tapestry depicting a feasting ghoul conceals a secret, sliding door leading to a short tunnel between this room and {@area area C16|070|x}. A character who searches behind the tapestry and succeeds on a {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check finds the secret door. Once inside the secret passage, a character can easily spot and open the secret door at the opposite end.
zh_tw: 一幅描繪食屍鬼盛宴的掛毯隱藏著一扇通往此房間與 {@area 區域C16|070|x} 之間短隧道的滑門。一個在掛毯後搜尋併成功透過 {@dc 10} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定的角色會發現這扇密門。一旦進入秘密通道，角色可以輕鬆發現並開啟另一端的密門。

english: C26: Sacrifice Gallery
zh_tw: C26: 獻祭畫廊

english: This enormous room features raised galleries at the east and west ends. Six chanting figures ring the east gallery, their hands raised toward a spherical cage hanging from the 30-foot-tall ceiling. The ritual's leader chants from the west balcony, surrounded by hunched, one-eyed creatures with knobby hides. A terrified elf struggles in the dangling cage.
zh_tw: 這個巨大的房間在東端和西端設有升高的廊臺。六個吟唱的身影圍繞著東廊臺，他們的手舉向懸掛在30尺高的天花板上的球形籠子。儀式的領導者在西廊臺吟唱，周圍是彎腰的、獨眼的、皮膚粗糙的生物。一個驚恐的精靈在懸掛的籠子裡掙扎。

english: Eldon Keyward
zh_tw: 埃爾登·基沃德

english: This room's floor is 10 feet lower than the raised galleries.
zh_tw: 這個房間的地板比升高的廊臺低10尺。

english: The room is filled with cultists engaged in an extensive, hours-long ritual to sacrifice the elf Eldon Keyward's secrets to Vecna. The ritual leader is a tall, proud, neutral evil {@creature mage} named Kendri Nex. The five {@creature Nothic||nothics} around her attack intruders on sight. Kendri uses her magic defensively, retreating to the room's floor if pressed. Kendri carries keys that unlock all the prisoner cells ({@area areas C5|04c|x}, {@area C11|061|x}, {@area C18|077|x}, and {@area C20|07d|x}), but if the characters haven't already rescued the other prisoners, they might not have the chance to do so, as the encounter likely ends with them being shunted through a planar rift.
zh_tw: 這個房間充滿了參與一場漫長儀式的邪教徒，他們正在進行數小時的儀式，將精靈埃爾登·基沃德的秘密獻祭給維克那。儀式的領導者是一個高大、自豪的中立邪惡{@creature mage||魔法師}，名叫肯德莉·內克斯。她周圍的五個{@creature Nothic||諾斯怪}會立即攻擊入侵者。肯德莉以防禦性地使用她的魔法，如果受到壓力，她會退到房間的地板上。肯德莉攜帶著能開啟所有囚犯牢房的鑰匙（{@area 區域C5|04c|x}, {@area C11|061|x}, {@area C18|077|x}, 和 {@area C20|07d|x}），但如果角色們還沒有救出其他囚犯，他們可能沒有機會這樣做，因為這次遭遇很可能以他們被送入一個位面裂縫而結束。

english: The six neutral evil {@creature Cult Fanatic||cult fanatics} on the raised east gallery don't fight, since they fear interrupting the complicated ritual. They maintain their chanting and wild gesticulations.
zh_tw: 站在東廊臺上的六個中立邪惡的{@creature Cult Fanatic||邪教狂信者}不參與戰鬥，因為他們擔心會打斷複雜的儀式。他們保持著吟唱和狂野的手勢。

english: The Cage
zh_tw: 籠子

english: Eldon is a lawful good elf {@creature priest} who follows Deneir, a god of writing and knowledge. He can't cast spells while he's in the cage. Eldon's cage hangs from a sturdy chain that ends 20 feet above the ground. The door on the cage's side is latched but not locked. Any character who can reach the cage can open its door as an action.
zh_tw: 埃爾登是一個守序善良的精靈{@creature priest||祭司}，他追隨迪尼爾，一位寫作和知識的神。當他在籠子裡時，無法施放法術。埃爾登的籠子懸掛在一根堅固的鏈條上，鏈條末端距離地面20尺。籠子側面的門是扣上的但沒有上鎖。任何能夠到達籠子的角色都可以作為一個動作開啟它的門。

english: Fight's End
zh_tw: 戰鬥的結束

english: This fight ends immediately if the characters kill Kendri, silence any of the cult fanatics, or attempt to free Eldon. Energy from the interrupted ritual opens a latent planar rift that shunts Eldon and the characters into the Shadowfell:
zh_tw: 如果角色們殺死了肯德莉，讓任何邪教狂信者沉默，或者試圖釋放埃爾登，這場戰鬥會立即結束。被打斷的儀式中的能量開啟了一個潛在的位面裂縫，將埃爾登和角色們送入墮影冥界：

english: A riot of silvery-purple energy fills the room. You feel a sense of space tearing open—then you're falling, and everything goes dark.
zh_tw: 房間內充滿了銀色和紫色的能量。你感到空間正在撕裂開——然後你開始下墜，一切變得黑暗。

english: Escaping Evernight
zh_tw: 逃離永夜城

english: The cult's disrupted ritual thrusts the characters (along with Eldon) through a Crevice of Dusk, a gap between the Material Plane and the Shadowfell city of Evernight, a gloomy reflection of Neverwinter. The Crevice of Dusk closes immediately after shunting the characters.
zh_tw: 邪教的儀式被打斷，將角色們（連同埃爾登）推入了黃昏裂縫，這是物質界和墮影冥界的永夜城之間的一個間隙，是無冬城陰鬱的反映。黃昏裂縫在將角色們送入後立即關閉。

english: The characters experience the following vision:
zh_tw: 角色們經歷了以下幻象：

english: Around the world and across the planes, you perceive innumerable cults of Vecna. They snatch away people and strip their secrets in rituals like the one you stopped. Behind them, the withered form of Vecna gathers the secrets like threads, adding them to a glowing sphere of hidden knowledge in some impossibly distant place. The vision fades into darkness, leaving only Vecna's glaring left eye.
zh_tw: 在世界各地和各個位面，你感知到無數維克那的邪教。他們擄走人們並在像你阻止的那樣的儀式中剝奪他們的秘密。在他們背後，維克那的枯萎形態像收集線頭一樣收集秘密，將它們新增到某個不可思議的遙遠之地的隱藏知識發光球體中。幻象消失在黑暗中，只留下維克那那顯眼的左眼。

english: Link to Vecna
zh_tw: 與維克那的連結

english: The characters each gain a metaphysical link to Vecna, which follows the rules for {@book blessings|DMG|7|Blessings} presented in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}. Vecna's Link is the result of feedback from the interrupted ritual. Vecna is unaware the characters—or anyone, for that matter—are linked with him, so the god has no reason to sever the tie. The link can manifest as subtly or as obviously as each player wishes, from the sensation of a specific smell when the character thinks of Vecna to a loud noise only they hear when the lich's name is uttered.
zh_tw: 每個角色都與維克那建立了一種形而上學的連線，該連線遵循{@book 祝福|DMG|7|Blessings}（見{@book 城主指南|DMG}）的規則。維克那的連結是儀式被打斷後反饋的結果。維克那並不知道這些角色——或任何與此相關的人——與他建立了連線，因此這位神祇沒有理由切斷這種聯絡。這種連線可以表現得非常微妙，也可以非常明顯，具體取決於每個玩家的意願，從角色想到維克那時感受到的一種特定氣味，到當巫妖的名字被提起時只有他們才能聽到的巨大噪音。

english: Vecna's Link
zh_tw: 維克那的連結

english: You gain a special intuition for secrets. You have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks. In addition, you can use an action to cast {@spell See Invisibility} without expending a spell slot. Once you cast that spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.
zh_tw: 你對秘密獲得特殊的直覺。你進行感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定時具有優勢。此外，你可以使用一個動作施放{@spell See Invisibility||識破隱形}，不需消耗法術位。以此方式施放後，必須完成一次長休，才能再次如此施放。

english: When the characters acquire this link, remind them about the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules. Allow them to spend any secrets they've gained so far as usual.
zh_tw: 當角色們獲得這個連結時，提醒他們關於{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}的規則。允許他們像往常一樣花費到目前為止獲得的任何秘密。

english: Evernight
zh_tw: 永夜城

english: Evernight is a dismal mirror in the Shadowfell of the city of Neverwinter. The sun never shines here, and ashen fog chokes the sky
zh_tw: 永夜城是無冬城市的墮影冥界中的一個陰鬱的映象。這裡太陽從不照耀，灰燼般的霧氣瀰漫在天空中。

english: Evernight is a forlorn metropolis in the Shadowfell. It has geography similar to Neverwinter's, but it presents as Neverwinter's dismal opposite. The sun never shines on Evernight, and ash-laden fog rises from lava flowing through the city in place of Neverwinter River, choking the city.
zh_tw: 永夜城是墮影冥界中的一個淒涼大都市。它的地理特徵與無冬城相似，但卻呈現出無冬城陰鬱的對立面。永夜城上空從未有過陽光，而攜帶著灰燼的霧氣從流經城市的熔岩中升起，取代了無冬城河，令這座城市窒息。

english: While Neverwinter is filled with living creatures trying to build a better future, Evernight is populated by Undead—primarily vampires and ghouls—who prey on each other and on travelers.
zh_tw: 當無冬城充滿了努力建設更好未來的生物時，永夜城卻居住著不死生物——主要是吸血鬼和食屍鬼——它們互相捕食以及捕食旅行者。

english: Evernight is a crossroads of trade in the Shadowfell and hosts numerous markets, including the lively Corpse Market. There, undead merchants trade in the bodies and blood of the dead—sometimes, the very recently dead.
zh_tw: 永夜城是墮影冥界中的貿易十字路口，擁有眾多市場，包括熱鬧的屍體市場。在那裡，不死生物商人交易死者的屍體和血液——有時甚至是最近才死去的人。

english: Evernight Awakening
zh_tw: 永夜城覺醒

english: Since the characters were underground in Neverwinter's graveyard when shunted to Evernight, they're similarly underground in Evernight's graveyard.
zh_tw: 由於角色們在被傳送到永夜城時位於無冬城的墓地下，他們在永夜城的墓地下也是類似的。

english: Each character appears within an open coffin. The coffins are jumbled near each other in a large, 10-foot-deep grave pit.
zh_tw: 每個角色都出現在一個開啟的棺材裡。這些棺材雜亂地堆在一個大型的、10尺深的墓穴坑中。

english: Twelve {@creature Ghoul||ghouls} prowl the area around the party's grave pit. Characters in the grave pit hear the hungry shouts and slavering of approaching ghouls, and you can further ramp up the tension by concealing the total number of ghouls until a character emerges from the pit to look around. The coffin-filled bottom of the grave pit is {@book difficult terrain|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}. The muddy, sloping sides require a successful {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to ascend, but moving down them doesn't require a check.
zh_tw: 十二隻{@creature Ghoul||食屍鬼}在隊伍墓地坑四周徘徊。在墓地坑中的角色能聽到逼近的食屍鬼的飢餓喊叫和流涎聲，你可以透過隱瞞食屍鬼的總數來進一步加劇緊張感，直到一個角色從坑中出來環顧四周。墓地坑底部滿是棺材，屬於{@book 困難地形|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}。泥濘的斜坡面需要一次成功的{@dc 10}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定才能攀爬上去，但下坡則不需要檢定。

english: Eldon's Latest Imprisonment
zh_tw: 埃爾登的最新囚禁

english: In addition to the open coffins for each character, the grave pit contains another coffin wedged into the dirt and nailed shut. Eldon Keyward is confined within it.
zh_tw: 除了每個角色的開放式棺材外，墓坑裡還有另一口被楔入土中並釘死的棺材。埃爾登·基沃德被禁錮在其中。

english: Eldon grunts for aid and pounds at the wood. Unless a character uses an action to open Eldon's coffin, he kicks a side panel free and squirms out after 1 minute of effort. If the fight with the ghouls is still going on, Eldon helps as best he can.
zh_tw: 埃爾登發出求助的咕噥聲並敲打著木頭。除非有角色採取行動開啟埃爾登的棺材，否則他會在1分鐘的努力後踢開一個側板並掙脫出來。如果與食屍鬼的戰鬥仍在繼續，埃爾登會盡他所能提供幫助。

english: Once the fight is over, Eldon shares the following information, either all at once or in fragments:
zh_tw: 戰鬥結束後，埃爾登分享了以下資訊，可以一次性全部分享，或者分片段逐步透露：

english: "Very bad, but not surprising. I don't know if the cultists planned to send us here, but here we are. Neverwinter has cracks between our world and the Shadowfell—Crevices of Dusk, they're called. Planar travelers sometimes slip through.
zh_tw: "情況非常糟糕，但並不令人意外。我不知道邪教徒是否計劃將我們送到這兒，但我們已經在這裡了。無冬城有我們世界和墮影冥界之間的裂縫——它們被稱為黃昏裂縫。位面旅行者有時會從中滑過。"

english: "We're in a nasty city called Evernight. It's an evil echo of Neverwinter, populated by undead. We arrived in Evernight's graveyard because we left from Neverwinter's graveyard.
zh_tw: "我們在一個叫做永夜城的糟糕城市裡。它是無冬城的邪惡迴響，居住著不死生物。我們之所以來到永夜城的墓地，是因為我們從無冬城的墓地出發。"

english: "There's no evidence of the crevice we came through. It doesn't surprise me that it's gone; stable crevices are rarer than spontaneous ones. But we need a stable one to get back to Neverwinter.
zh_tw: "我們沒有找到我們穿過的裂縫的任何證據。它消失了，這並不讓我感到驚訝；穩定的裂縫比自發出現的要罕見得多。但我們要想回到無冬城，就需要一個穩定的裂縫。"

english: "We shouldn't spend a lot of time traipsing through an undead-infested metropolis, hoping to stumble across a gateway to Neverwinter. That feels unsafe. Maybe we should ask around inconspicuously. There's a market east of the Neverwinter Graveyard, which means it's likely there's a market east of Evernight's graveyard, too. But we should be careful."
zh_tw: "我們不應該在一個充滿不死生物的大都市裡漫無目的地遊蕩，指望偶然發現通往無冬城的門戶。那樣感覺不安全。也許我們應該不引人注意地四處打聽。無冬城墓地的東邊有一個市場，這意味著永夜城墓地的東邊很可能也有一個市場。但我們應該小心。"

english: The characters have little to go on other than Eldon's suggestion. Other explorations of Evernight are both dangerous and fruitless, so you should eventually steer the party back to the market even if they venture elsewhere.
zh_tw: 除了埃爾登的建議，角色們幾乎沒有其他線索。對永夜城的其他探索既危險又徒勞，所以即使他們去其他地方冒險，你最終也應該引導隊伍回到市場。

english: The characters don't have other encounters as they make their way through Evernight's graveyard, though they hear howls and cries through the fog that let them know the graveyard isn't a safe place to linger.
zh_tw: 角色們在穿越永夜城的墓地時沒有遇到其他情況，儘管他們聽到了霧中的嚎叫聲和哭喊聲，這些聲音讓他們知道墓地不是一個久留的安全之地。

english: Eldon's Notebook
zh_tw: 埃爾登的筆記本

english: If the characters found Eldon's notebook and return it to him, he's grateful and immediately starts adding notes about the Shadowfell and Evernight.
zh_tw: 如果角色們找到了埃爾登的筆記本並將其歸還給他，他會非常感激，並立即開始新增有關墮影冥界和永夜城的筆記。

english: The Corpse Market
zh_tw: 屍體市場

english: The wall around Evernight's graveyard is riddled with gaps, and the ground near it is covered in fallen rubble, so leaving the graveyard is easy. Directly east of the graveyard, a large market stretches for blocks in every direction. Tattered canvas and shrouds separate the numerous stalls. Feeble moonlight and flickering torches illuminate the city, regardless of the time of day.
zh_tw: 永夜城墓地周圍的牆壁上佈滿了缺口，靠近它的地面上覆蓋著倒塌的碎石，所以離開墓地很容易。墓地正東方向，一個大型市場延伸了好幾個街區。破舊的帆布和裹屍布分隔開了眾多的攤位。微弱的月光和閃爍的火把照亮了這座城市，無論白天還是夜晚。

english: Everything in the market exhibits pale, subdued colors, but the atmosphere is lively as ghouls, skeletons, and vampires meander from stall to stall.
zh_tw: 市場上的一切商品都呈現出蒼白、柔和的色彩，但氣氛卻很活躍，因為食屍鬼、骷髏和吸血鬼在攤位間閒逛。

english: The Market's Goods
zh_tw: 市場的商品

english: Goods for sale in the Corpse Market include ghoulish remains intended for consumption, such as fingers pickled in brine, jars of blood, and wrapped organs. Shops sell bouquets of dead flowers, frayed burial finery, jewelry displayed on severed hands, elegant canopic jars, and the like.
zh_tw: 屍體市場上出售的商品包括供食用的食屍鬼殘骸，如用鹽水泡製的手指、血罐和包裝好的器官。商店出售枯萎的死花束、磨損的葬禮服飾、在斷手上展示的珠寶、優雅的卡諾皮克罐等。

english: Market Clientele
zh_tw: 市場顧客

english: The Corpse Market occasionally sees living visitors, though the characters are the only ones present now. If the characters don't attempt to hide or disguise themselves, they receive sidelong stares from merchants and customers. Everyone assumes the characters wouldn't be here unless they were under the protection of an influential figure in the city or were powerful travelers in their own right.
zh_tw: 屍體市場偶爾也會有活著的訪客，儘管現在只有角色們在場。如果角色們不嘗試隱藏或偽裝自己，他們會從商人和顧客那裡收到斜視的目光。每個人都認為角色們除非是在城市中有影響力的人物的保護下，或者是他們自己本身就實力強大的旅行者，否則不會出現在這裡。

english: Meeting Sangora
zh_tw: 遇見桑戈拉

english: Shortly after the characters enter the Corpse Market, they draw the attention of a vampire merchant named Sangora. When she sees the characters, she spreads her cloak wide and shows sharp fangs in her smile. She says:
zh_tw: 角色們一進入屍體市場不久，就引起了一位名叫桑戈拉的吸血鬼商人的注意。當她看到角色們時，她展開她的斗篷，露出笑容中鋒利的獠牙。她說：

english: "I am Sangora, proprietor of Sangora Sanguinaries. You're not likely interested in a cup of warm blood, but perhaps you need something else? Something more ephemeral, like directions? Or knowledge? I've been in this city a long, long time."
zh_tw: "我是桑戈拉，桑戈拉血液製品店的店主。你們可能對一杯溫暖的血液不感興趣，但或許你們需要其他東西？一些更短暫的東西，比如指引？或者知識？我在這座城市已經待了很久很久。"

english: Sangora is a centuries-old {@creature vampire} with sunken eyes and a shock of long, white hair. She is inquisitive and happy to gossip.
zh_tw: 桑戈拉是一個擁有數百年曆史的{@creature vampire||吸血鬼}，眼窩深陷，滿頭白髮。她好奇心強，樂於閒聊。

english: Sangora
zh_tw: 桑戈拉

english: If the characters don't seem inclined to speak with Sangora, Eldon blurts out a question about finding a Crevice of Dusk.
zh_tw: 如果角色們似乎不願意與桑戈拉交談，埃爾登突然提出了一個關於尋找黃昏裂縫的問題。

english: Sangora sells information at a higher profit than she sells blood, and she's full of useful tidbits about the city. She charges 20 gp for each question she answers, but she also accepts an answer to a probing question instead of payment (primarily about where the characters came from, how they got here, and what they're looking for in Evernight). Sangora isn't looking for a fight.
zh_tw: 桑戈拉以比賣血更高的利潤出售資訊，她對這座城市充滿了有用的小道訊息。她每個回答的問題收費20金幣，但她也接受一個探究性問題的答案作為支付（主要是關於角色們來自哪裡，他們是如何來到這裡的，以及他們在永夜城尋找什麼）。桑戈拉並不尋求戰鬥。

english: Sangora can share the following points:
zh_tw: 桑戈拉可以分享以下幾點：

english: Evernight
zh_tw: 永夜城

english: Sangora provides background about the city of Evernight, as presented above.
zh_tw: 桑戈拉提供瞭如上所述的永夜城城市的背景資訊。

english: Neverwinter
zh_tw: 無冬城

english: Sangora hasn't been to Neverwinter in more than a decade and remembers the place as a lawless ruin. At that time, the populace viewed Lord Neverember as a manipulative tyrant. Sangora knows that gateways called Crevices of Dusk occasionally appear in Evernight and allow passage to and from Neverwinter.
zh_tw: 桑戈拉十多年沒有去過無冬城了，記憶中那裡是一個無法無天的廢墟。當時，人們認為無燼是一個操縱一切的暴君。桑戈拉知道，被稱為黃昏裂縫的傳送門偶爾出現在永夜城之地，允許人們進出無冬城。

english: Crevices of Dusk
zh_tw: 黃昏的裂縫

english: Sangora explains that residents of both Evernight and Neverwinter dislike these portals being used indiscriminately. Those who know the location of stable Crevices of Dusk either guard or hide them.
zh_tw: 桑戈拉解釋說，永夜城之地和無冬城的居民都不喜歡這些傳送門被隨意使用。那些知道穩定黃昏裂縫位置的人要麼守護它們，要麼將它們隱藏起來。

english: Stable Crevice of Dusk
zh_tw: 穩定的黃昏裂縫

english: Sangora tilts her head with a thoughtful look before revealing that she knows of a stable Crevice of Dusk in a tomb of one of Evernight's former living families, the Dolindars. The Dolindar tomb is in Evernight's graveyard, and Sangora provides true directions to it.
zh_tw: 桑戈拉沉思地歪著頭，然後透露她知道在永夜城一個前活人家族，多林達爾家族的墓穴中有一個穩定的黃昏裂縫。多林達爾的墓穴位於永夜城的墓地中，桑戈拉提供了前往那裡的正確方向。

english: Dolindars
zh_tw: 多林達爾

english: Sangora explains that the Dolindar family was exiled to the Shadowfell for reasons they never shared. The family studied wizardry and knew much about planar gates despite being unable to use them due to a family curse. They were miserable and lonely in life.
zh_tw: 桑戈拉解釋說，多林達爾家族因為一些他們從未透露的原因被流放到了墮影冥界。這個家族研究魔法，並儘管由於家族詛咒而無法使用，但對位面之門瞭解甚多。他們在生前感到痛苦和孤獨。

english: Dolindar Tomb
zh_tw: 多林達爾墓穴

english: The party's best next stop is the Dolindar tomb, in a part of Evernight's graveyard the characters haven't yet seen. When the characters are ready to explore the Dolindar tomb, Sangora can point the way.
zh_tw: 隊伍的下一個最佳目的地是多林達爾家族的墓穴，位於永夜城之地的墓地中，角色們尚未探索過的區域。當角色們準備好探索多林達爾家族墓穴時，桑戈拉可以指引方向。

english: General Features
zh_tw: 通用特徵

english: The following features are common throughout the Dolindar tomb.
zh_tw: 多林達爾墓穴中普遍存在以下特點。

english: Unending Isolation
zh_tw: 無盡的孤獨

english: The tomb isn't precisely haunted, but the isolation the Dolindars felt living in a city of the dead suffuses their tomb. Creatures in the tomb or the portico outside it can't muster the will to support others and thus can't take the {@action Help} action.
zh_tw: 這座墓穴並不是真的鬧鬼，但是多林達爾家族在死者之城中感受到的孤立瀰漫在他們的墓穴中。墓穴內或外面的門廊裡的生物無法鼓起支援他人的意志，因此不能採取{@action Help||協助}行動。

english: Stone Construction
zh_tw: 石質結構

english: The tomb is made of old, durable stone.
zh_tw: 墓穴由古老而堅固的石頭建造而成。

english: Lighting
zh_tw: 光照

english: The tomb is dark. Area descriptions assume the characters have a light source or some other means of seeing in the dark.
zh_tw: 這座墓穴很黑暗。區域描述假設角色們有光源或者有其他在黑暗中看見事物的手段。

english: Doors
zh_tw: 門

english: The heavy doors throughout the tomb are made of stone and grind noisily when open and shut. No doors are locked except the puzzle door in {@area area B5|0b9|x}.
zh_tw: 墓穴中各處的沉重石門在開啟和關閉時會發出刺耳的摩擦聲。除了位於{@area 區域B5|0b9|x}的謎題門之外，沒有其他門是上鎖的。

english: Ceilings
zh_tw: 天花板

english: Ceilings are 10 feet high throughout the tomb.
zh_tw: 墓穴中所有地方的天花板高度都是10尺。

english: Dolindar Tomb Locations
zh_tw: 多林達爾墓穴位置

english: The following locations are keyed to map 1.2.
zh_tw: 以下地點對應於地圖1.2上的關鍵點。

english: Map 1.2: Dolindar Tomb
zh_tw: 地圖 1.2: 多林達爾墓穴

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: B1: Portico
zh_tw: B1: 門廊

english: A roof supported by stone pillars extends from the Dolindar tomb into the weedy yard of uneven earth. The stone door to the tomb is engraved with the word "DOLINDAR" above it.
zh_tw: 一個由石柱支撐的屋頂從多林達爾墓穴延伸到不平整的雜草叢生的院子中。墓穴的石門上刻有"多林達爾"這個詞在它的上方。

english: Four {@creature vampire spawn} catch up to the party when the characters reach the door to the tomb. After the characters left her, Sangora detailed her conversation to her vampire spawn assistants. The spawn decided to make a meal of the characters, assuming that Sangora would never discover their perfidy.
zh_tw: 當角色們到達墓穴的門前時，四隻{@creature vampire spawn||初生吸血鬼}追上了他們。在角色們離開桑戈拉後，她向她的吸血鬼後代助手詳細描述了對話內容。這些後代決定將角色們當作一頓美餐，認為桑戈拉永遠不會發現他們的背叛。

english: The ground in the portico is swept and free of weeds, thanks to the efforts of the ghost Newmy (see area B2). The entrance to the tomb isn't locked. It opens onto a small room containing a steep spiral staircase leading 20 feet downward.
zh_tw: 由於幽靈紐米（見區域B2）的努力，門廊的地面被打掃得乾淨，沒有雜草。墓穴的入口沒有上鎖。它通向一個含有一個陡峭螺旋樓梯的小房間，向下延伸20尺。

english: B2: Hall
zh_tw: B2: 大廳

english: Upright slabs are set into the walls of this large burial chamber. Each slab is carved with the faded likeness of a different robed human above indecipherable writing. One of these slabs is blank with a piece of paper stuck to it.
zh_tw: 這個大型墓室的牆壁上嵌有直立的石板。每塊石板上都刻著一個穿著長袍的人類模糊的肖像，上方是難以辨認的文字。其中有一塊石板是空白的，上面貼著一張紙。

english: The lesser-known Dolindars are interred here, buried in the alcoves behind the slabs. The images of the dead and their names have worn away. If the characters open these slabs, they find only dust and bones inside.
zh_tw: 較少人知曉的多林達爾家族成員被安葬在這裡，他們的遺體被埋在石板後面的壁龕中。逝者的形象和名字已經磨損不見。如果角色們開啟這些石板，他們會發現裡面只有灰塵和骨頭。

english: The piece of paper is on a slab in front of an open nook that never held a dead Dolindar. Instead, a ghost custodian named Newmy lives inside. She's affixed a piece of paper with "Newmy's Room" written on it in Common. If anyone approaches the slab, Newmy pops out, sputtering apologies.
zh_tw: 這張紙貼在一塊石板上，石板前是一個空著的壁龕，這裡從未安置過死去的多林達爾家族成員。相反，一個名叫紐米（紐米）的幽靈管理員居住在這裡。她在紙上用通用語寫著"紐米的房間"，並將其貼在石板上。如果有人接近這塊石板，紐米會突然冒出來，結結巴巴地道歉。

english: Newmy is a lawful neutral {@creature ghost} who was once a moon elf. She can cast {@spell Prestidigitation} at will. Newmy isn't quite five feet tall, and she has frizzy blue hair and pale skin shot through with blue veins. She's not interested in fighting, since fights make messes.
zh_tw: 紐米是一個守序中立的{@creature ghost||幽魂}，她曾是一位月精靈。她可以隨意施放{@spell Prestidigitation||魔法伎倆}法術。紐米身高不足五尺，她有蓬鬆的藍色頭髮和佈滿藍色血管的蒼白皮膚。她對戰鬥不感興趣，因為戰鬥會製造混亂。

english: Newmy
zh_tw: 紐米

english: Talking with Newmy
zh_tw: 與紐米交談

english: Newmy would rather talk than fight. She shares the following points:
