zh_tw: 紐米更願意交談而不是戰鬥。她分享了以下幾點：

english: Crypt Cleaner
zh_tw: 墓穴清潔工

english: The Dolindars hired Newmy and paid her several lifetimes of wages up-front to keep their tomb clean shortly after the tomb was built—more years ago than Newmy can remember. When Newmy died, she returned as a ghost to continue her duties for as long as she was contracted.
zh_tw: 多林達爾家族在墓穴建成後不久就僱傭了紐米，並提前支付了她幾個世紀的工資，讓她保持墓穴的清潔——這比紐米能記住的年頭還要久遠。當紐米去世後，她以幽靈的形式回來，繼續履行她的職責，直到她的合同期滿。

english: Lonely Family
zh_tw: 孤獨的家族

english: The Dolindars were all lonely, and there weren't many of them. They didn't like Evernight but couldn't leave it for some reason.
zh_tw: 多林達爾家族的成員都很孤獨，而且人數不多。他們不喜歡永夜城之地，但由於某種原因無法離開。

english: Puzzle Buttons
zh_tw: 謎題按鈕

english: Newmy doesn't know anything about a rift or a Crevice of Dusk, but she remembers some "puzzle buttons" deeper in the tomb that she doesn't know how to work. Maybe they lead somewhere special.
zh_tw: 紐米對裂縫或黃昏裂縫一無所知，但她記得在墓穴更深處有一些她不知道如何使用的"謎題按鈕"。也許它們通向某個特別的地方。

english: Restless Dead
zh_tw: 不眠亡者

english: Newmy doesn't go through the doors at the end of the hall anymore. The Dolindars buried down there "aren't resting right," and Newmy is afraid of them. She hasn't been that way in years and doesn't remember what's there.
zh_tw: 紐米不再穿過大廳盡頭的門了。多林達爾家族埋葬在那裡的人"沒有安息"，紐米害怕他們。她已經好幾年沒有去過那邊，也不記得那裡有什麼。

english: Newmy's Room
zh_tw: 紐米的房間

english: Newmy rests in a burial nook large enough to hold the corpse of a Medium creature. The nook contains old rags and a decrepit broom. Newmy considers it her personal space and grumbles if anyone seems intent on disturbing it.
zh_tw: 紐米在一個足夠容納一箇中等體型生物屍體的墓穴壁龕中休息。壁龕裡有一些舊布和一把破舊的掃帚。紐米認為這是她的私人空間，如果有人似乎打算打擾它，她會抱怨。

english: B3: Lost Dolindars
zh_tw: B3: 迷失的多林達爾

english: Two stone coffins in this room have been broken open, littering the floor with rubble and dust. A creature with too many arms and spikes in place of hands taps at the room's walls.
zh_tw: 這個房間裡的兩個石棺已經被砸開，碎石和灰塵散落在地板上。一個手臂過多，手部位置長有尖刺的生物正在敲打房間的牆壁。

english: The Dolindar siblings buried here were warped into two {@creature lost sorrowsworn|MPMM} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}). A visible sorrowsworn shrieks in rage and attacks anyone she can see. A second sorrowsworn is resting inside one of the broken coffins, initially out of sight but quick to join his sibling in a fight. The sorrowsworn fight until destroyed.
zh_tw: 埋葬在這裡的多林達爾兄妹被扭曲成了兩個{@creature lost sorrowsworn|MPMM|迷失之哀慟魔}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）。一個可見的哀慟魔因憤怒而尖叫並攻擊她能看到的任何人。第二個哀慟魔最初隱藏在破碎的棺材內休息，但很快就會加入戰鬥，與他的兄妹並肩作戰。哀慟魔會戰鬥直到被摧毀。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The rubble includes the nameplates that once adorned the coffins. One reads, "Nolan Dolindar, Beloved Brother" and the other reads, "Evisha Dolindar, Beloved Sister." Each silver nameplate is worth 75 gp.
zh_tw: 這些碎石中包括曾經裝飾在棺材上的名牌。一個上面寫著"諾蘭·多林達爾，親愛的兄弟"，另一個寫著"埃維莎·多林達爾，親愛的姐妹"。每塊銀質名牌價值75金幣。

english: B4: Vault
zh_tw: B4: 金庫

english: This vault contains six pedestals, each bearing treasure.
zh_tw: 這個金庫包含六個基座，每個上面都承載著寶藏。

english: Carvings encircling the base of each pedestal read, "What good are treasures when home is denied?"
zh_tw: 環繞每個基座底部的雕刻上寫著："當家園被剝奪時，寶藏又有何用？

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The following Dolindar family treasures sit atop the pedestals:
zh_tw: 以下多林達爾家族的寶藏位於基座之上：

english: 2,200 gp in neatly stacked piles
zh_tw: 2200金幣，整齊地堆疊

english: A golden helmet worth 280 gp
zh_tw: 一個價值280 gp的金頭盔

english: A {@item Driftglobe} with a map of the gate towns of the Outlands carved on it
zh_tw: 一個帶有外域門城地圖雕刻的{@item Driftglobe||漂浮之球}

english: A {@item Necklace of Adaptation} bearing the inscription "My breath is yours, Kevetta—take it"
zh_tw: 一條刻有銘文"我的呼吸是你的，凱維塔——拿去吧"的{@item Necklace of Adaptation||適應項鍊}

english: A book titled {@i Out of the Endless Prison}, outlining methods of escaping the prison-plane of Carceri, worth 500 gp to a planar scholar (such as Eldon, who promises to buy the book once returned to Neverwinter)
zh_tw: 一本名為{@i 逃離無盡的監獄}的書，概述了逃離監獄位面卡瑟利的方法，對於一位位面學者（比如埃爾登）來說價值500金幣，他承諾一旦回到無冬城就會購買這本書

english: A snow globe containing a miniature replica of the city of Neverwinter, worth 350 gp
zh_tw: 一個包含無冬城微型複製品的雪球，價值350 gp

english: B5: Puzzle Door
zh_tw: B5: 謎題門

english: The door in the east wall of this otherwise empty room bears the inscription "DOLINDAR" above "NO WORLD TO RETURN." Every letter of each word is set into the wall on a separate tile.
zh_tw: 這個房間除此之外空無一物。東牆上的門刻著「DOLINDAR」，下方是「NO WORLD TO RETURN.」——多林達爾，無處可歸。每個單字中的每個字母，都各自刻在一塊嵌入牆內的石磚上。

english: The door is sealed with a puzzle that requires pushing the right letter tiles in sequence. A pushed letter makes its whole word sink into the door with a click. The door unlocks when the correct combination is input. (Pushing a second letter in the same word doesn't do anything.) The correct combination, which causes the wall to slide aside, is to push the letters spelling ALONE in this order:
zh_tw: 這扇門由一道謎題封住，必須依序按下正確的字母磚才能開啟。按下一個字母時，該字母所屬的整個單字會喀嚓一聲陷入門中。輸入正確組合後，門便會解鎖。（再按同一單字中的第二個字母不會產生效果。）依下列順序按下字母，拼出ALONE（孤獨），牆壁就會滑開：

english: {@b A} in DOLINDAR
zh_tw: {@b A} 在 DOLINDAR 中

english: {@b L} in WORLD
zh_tw: {@b L} 在 WORLD 中

english: {@b O} in TO
zh_tw: {@b O} 在 TO 中

english: {@b N} in NO
zh_tw: {@b N} 在 NO 中

english: {@b E} in RETURN
zh_tw: {@b E} 在 RETURN 中

english: If the five words sink into the wall in the wrong order, or if the wrong letters are used to push them in, all five words reset with a wave of painful loneliness. Creatures in the room must make a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw, taking 22 ({@dice 4d10}) psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. If the characters have a hard time figuring out this puzzle, Eldon gives them hints. Eldon stays at a safe distance from the trap and doesn't take damage if it's triggered.
zh_tw: 如果這五個單詞以錯誤的順序嵌入牆壁，或者使用了錯誤的字母推動它們，所有五個單詞將重新設定，並伴隨一陣痛苦的孤獨感。房間內的生物必須進行一次 {@dc 16} 魅力豁免檢定，若失敗則受到22點（{@dice 4d10}）精神傷害，成功則受到一半傷害。如果角色在解開這個謎題時遇到困難，埃爾登會提供提示。埃爾登與陷阱保持安全距離，如果陷阱被觸發，他不會受到傷害。

english: The first time a character pushes the tiles incorrectly, they see a small mechanism below the phrase "NO WORLD TO RETURN." This mechanism is a lock. As an action, a character with thieves' tools can use them to try to pick the lock, doing so with a successful {@dc 16} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. Picking the lock has the same effect as solving the puzzle, granting access to area B6.
zh_tw: 角色第一次按錯字母磚時，會注意到「NO WORLD TO RETURN.」下方有個小機關，那是一道鎖。持有盜賊工具的角色可以用一個動作嘗試撬鎖，成功透過{@dc 16}敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定即可開啟。撬開鎖與解開謎題的效果相同，都能讓角色進入B6區域。

english: B6: Matriarch's Chamber
zh_tw: B6: 女族長的房間

english: The matriarch Kevetta Dolindar has become a monster called a lonely sorrowsworn
zh_tw: 族長凱維塔·多林達爾已經變成了一個被稱為孤獨哀悼者的怪物

english: On the far side of this room rests a stone coffin. Between the door and the coffin, the floor is studded with a sharp metal blades. A person-shaped figure with elongated arms lurks near the coffin.
zh_tw: 在這個房間的遠端放著一個石棺。在門和棺材之間，地板上佈滿了鋒利的金屬刀片。一個有著長臂的人形身影潛伏在棺材附近。

english: Isolation warped the matriarch of the Dolindar family, Kevetta, into a {@creature lonely sorrowsworn|MPMM} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}). She remains near her coffin and uses her harpoon arms to attack anyone who enters the room. She fights until destroyed but doesn't pursue foes who flee.
zh_tw: 孤立將多林達爾家族的族長凱維塔扭曲成了一個名為孤獨哀悼者的怪物{@creature lonely sorrowsworn|MPMM|孤獨之哀慟魔}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）。她留在她的棺材附近，並使用她的魚叉臂攻擊任何進入房間的人。她會戰鬥直到被摧毀，但不會追擊逃跑的敵人。

english: Blades
zh_tw: 刀刃

english: The blades on the floor are {@book difficult terrain|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}. When a creature moves into or through the blades on its turn, it takes 5 ({@dice 2d4}) slashing damage for every 5 feet it travels. A character can use an action to pull a lever behind the stone coffin to cause the blades to retract into the floor or to raise them again.
zh_tw: 地板上的刀片是{@book 困難地形|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}。當生物在其回合移動進入或透過刀片時，它每移動5尺就受到5（{@dice 2d4}）點揮砍傷害。角色可以使用動作拉動石棺後面的槓桿，使刀片收回至地板或再次升起。

english: In the Coffin
zh_tw: 在棺材裡

english: Kevetta's coffin still bears her name, but not her body. Instead, the coffin's bottom is a roiling swirl of silvery-purple energy. Eldon confirms what the characters might guess: this is a Crevice of Dusk leading to Neverwinter.
zh_tw: 凱維塔的棺材上仍然刻有她的名字，但她的身體已經不在了。相反，棺材底部是一片翻滾的銀紫色能量旋渦。埃爾登證實了角色們可能猜測的事情：這是一個通往無冬城的黃昏裂縫。

english: Creatures and objects placed into Kevetta's coffin appear in a dusty, nondescript tomb in Neverwinter's Pauper's Graveyard. The name on the tomb is illegible due to advanced age, but the carved phrase "Home Again, To Rest Forever" is barely legible above the tomb's doorway.
zh_tw: 放入凱維塔棺材中的生物和物體會出現在無冬城的貧民墓地一個佈滿灰塵、不起眼的墓穴中。由於年代久遠，墓穴上的名字已經無法辨認，但是墓穴門楣上雕刻的短語"再次回家，永遠安息"勉強可以辨認。

english: The Cult Scatters
zh_tw: 邪教四散

english: Though any remaining cultists believe they've successfully stolen Eldon's and the characters' secrets, it doesn't take them long to realize the significance of the characters' presence, which implies that important figures in Neverwinter know about the cult.
zh_tw: 儘管任何剩餘的邪教徒相信他們已經成功地偷走了埃爾登和角色們的秘密，但他們很快就意識到角色們出現的重要性，這意味著無冬城的重要人物已經知道了邪教的存在。

english: The cultists flee Neverwinter shortly after the ritual's abrupt end. By the time the characters return to the catacombs, the cultists are gone, along with any loose treasure. Other monsters such as the demons and nothics might still lurk in the graveyard, but they don't know anything about what the cult is doing or why the cultists departed so suddenly.
zh_tw: 儀式突然結束後不久，邪教徒逃離了無冬城。當角色們返回地下墓穴時，邪教徒已經不見了，連同任何散落的寶藏也一併消失。其他怪物，如惡魔和諾斯人，可能仍然潛伏在墓地中，但他們對邪教在做什麼或為什麼邪教徒突然離去一無所知。

english: Before scattering, the cultists murder any kidnapped townspeople the characters didn't free from their cells. After all, the cult needs to keep its secrets.
zh_tw: 在四散之前，邪教徒殺害了角色們沒有從牢房中解救出來的所有被綁架的鎮民。畢竟，邪教需要保守其秘密。

english: What's Next?
zh_tw: 後續？

english: Apart from a few loose ends, the characters' adventure is over when they return to Neverwinter. Grateful that the characters have ended the kidnapping threat, Lord Neverember rewards each character with a large house in Neverwinter. These houses can be adjacent to each other or spread around the city, as the characters prefer—Neverwinter contains a considerable number of vacant residences. Lord Neverember also pays for a small army of construction workers and renovators to restore the houses.
zh_tw: 除了一些未了結的小問題，角色們的冒險在他們返回無冬城時就結束了。無燼感激角色們結束了綁架威脅，獎勵每個角色在無冬城的一棟大房子。這些房子可以彼此相鄰，也可以根據角色們的喜好分佈在城市各處——無冬城有許多空置的住宅。無燼還支付了一小支建築工人和翻新者的軍隊來修復這些房子。

english: The rescued nobles and their families are grateful for the characters' efforts and give them 9,000 gp in total as a reward.
zh_tw: 被解救的貴族及其家人對角色們的努力表示感謝，並總共給予他們9000金幣作為獎勵。

english: Although this chapter is concluded, each character retains their Vecna's Link. Unknown to the characters, they are about to become embroiled in the rivalry between Vecna and Kas.
zh_tw: 儘管這一章節已經結束，每個角色仍然保留著他們的維克那的連結。角色們不知道，他們即將捲入維克那和凱斯之間的競爭之中。

english: If the characters aren't yet 11th level, more adventure awaits; there's no end of work in a frontier city such as Neverwinter. Alternatively, you can award the characters a milestone level-up and move ahead with the action of the next chapter.
zh_tw: 如果角色們還沒有達到11級，更多的冒險在等待著他們；像無冬城這樣的邊境城市總有做不完的工作。或者，你可以授予角色們一個里程碑式的升級，並繼續下一章節的行動。

english: Chapter 2: The Wizards Three
zh_tw: 第2章：三巫師

english: Alustriel and Tasha desperately cast a Wish spell to try to stop Vecna's evil plan. Mordenkainen, who is Kas in disguise, secretly sabotages the spell
zh_tw: 艾拉斯卓和塔莎拼命施放了一個願望法術，試圖阻止維克那的邪惡計劃。魔鄧肯，即偽裝成凱斯的人，暗中破壞了這個法術。

english: Time has passed since the characters' experience in Neverdeath Graveyard. That ordeal might seem firmly in the past, but the characters receiving Vecna's Link is the harbinger of events none could predict. In this chapter, the characters become involved in three powerful wizards' desperate bid to stop the remaking of existence at the hands of the lich-god Vecna. The characters are soon led to believe that retrieving and reconstructing a legendary artifact is the only way to avoid a bleak future for the entire multiverse.
zh_tw: 自從角色們在無冬墓園的經歷以來，時間已經過去了。那段磨難可能看起來已經牢固地成為過去，但角色們收到維克那的連結是不可預測事件的前兆。在這一章中，角色們捲入了三位強大法師絕望的嘗試中，以阻止巫妖神維克那重塑存在的計劃。角色們很快就被引導相信，取回並重建一個傳說中的神器是避免整個多元宇宙面臨悲慘未來的唯一方式。

english: Running This Chapter
zh_tw: 運作本章

english: This chapter begins sometime after the characters' adventure in Neverwinter—days, months, or years, at your discretion. After you and the players determine what the characters have been doing following their Neverwinter escapades, the heroes are abruptly shunted to a mysterious sanctum in Sigil, the city at the center of the multiverse (see the "{@area Surprise Development|0ec|x}" section later in this chapter).
zh_tw: 這一章開始於角色們在無冬城的冒險之後——可能是幾天、幾個月或幾年，由你決定。在你和玩家確定角色們在無冬城冒險之後做了什麼之後，英雄們突然被傳送到位於多元宇宙中心的神秘聖所——法印城（參見本章後面的"意外發展{@area 意外發展|0ec|x}"部分）。

english: The characters learn a sobering fact from the renowned wizards Alustriel Silverhand, Mordenkainen, and Tasha: the lich-god Vecna is planning to remake the multiverse and emerge as its most powerful being, subjugating all existence. Mordenkainen, who is actually the vampire Kas in disguise, believes the characters are the only ones who can stop Vecna's plans using the fabled {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, pieces of which are scattered throughout the multiverse.
zh_tw: 角色們從著名的法師艾拉斯卓·銀手、魔鄧肯和塔莎那裡得知了一個令人清醒的事實：巫妖神維克那計劃重塑多元宇宙，併成為其中最強大的存在，征服所有存在。實際上，魔鄧肯是偽裝成吸血鬼凱斯的，他認為角色們是唯一能夠使用傳說中的{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}來阻止維克那計劃的人，這個法杖的碎片遍佈整個多元宇宙。

english: Alustriel, Mordenkainen, and Tasha aid the characters in their task. This quest leads the characters deep into the Underdark in Faerûn, where the first piece of the rod is hidden in Web's Edge, a secret haven for cultists of the demon-god Lolth.
zh_tw: 艾拉斯卓、魔鄧肯和塔莎在他們的任務中幫助角色們。這個任務引導角色們深入費倫的地下黑暗——幽暗地域，在那裡，法杖的第一塊碎片隱藏在蛛網邊緣，這是惡魔神羅絲的邪教徒的秘密避難所。

english: Character Advancement
zh_tw: 角色升級

english: The characters should be 11th level when this chapter begins. The characters gain a level after they retrieve the first piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} from Web's Edge in the Underdark.
zh_tw: 當這一章開始時，角色們應該是11級。在角色們從幽暗地域的蛛網邊緣取回{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第一塊碎片後，他們將獲得一個等級的提升。

english: Power of Secrets
zh_tw: 秘密的力量

english: The characters can learn two secrets in this chapter or later that are applicable to the rules in "{@area The Power of Secrets|028|x}" section in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}:
zh_tw: 角色們可以在這一章或之後的章節中瞭解到兩個適用於本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中"秘密的力量{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}"部分規則的秘密：

english: Gertrude's Secret
zh_tw: 格特魯德的秘密

english: The characters can learn that Gertrude, the lone survivor of an ambushed caravan, and her friend Rockzanna knew about an imminent attack by Lolth's cultists but said nothing (see {@area area W6a|117|x} in {@area Web's Edge|0f8|x}).
zh_tw: 角色們可以得知，格特魯德，一個被伏擊的商隊的唯一生還者，以及她的朋友洛克贊娜知道羅絲的邪教徒即將發動的攻擊，但卻沒有透露任何資訊（見{@area 蛛網邊緣|0f8|x}中的{@area 區域W6a|117|x}）。

english: Mordenkainen's Secret
zh_tw: 魔鄧肯的秘密

english: Mordenkainen is duping Alustriel, Tasha, and the characters and is actually Kas in disguise. (The characters aren't likely to learn this until later in the adventure.)
zh_tw: 魔鄧肯正在欺騙艾拉斯卓、塔莎和角色們，實際上他是偽裝成凱斯的。（角色們不太可能在冒險的後期之前得知這一點。）

english: First Rod Piece
zh_tw: 第一部分法杖

english: The {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|first piece} of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} is in {@area area W12|130|x} of Web's Edge later in this chapter. For more information about the rod and the spell this piece allows its wielder to cast, see this book's {@area introduction|00e|x}.
zh_tw: {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|第一部分}（屬於{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}）位於本章稍後提到的{@area 區域W12|130|x}。有關此杖及其持有者可以施放的法術的更多資訊，請參閱本書的{@area 簡介|00e|x}。

english: After Neverdeath
zh_tw: 無冬墓園事件之後

english: It's up to you whether the events of this chapter happen after some time passes or immediately following the characters' experience in Neverdeath Graveyard. If you wish to emphasize urgency, this chapter's events happen a few days after the characters report their success to Lord Neverember in Neverwinter. If you'd rather emphasize the methodical nature of an eternal lich-god planning his dominance over the multiverse, months or years could pass before the characters arrive in Sigil.
zh_tw: 這一章節的事件發生在一段時間後，還是角色們在無冬墓園的經歷之後，這取決於你。如果你想強調緊迫性，這一章節的事件是在角色們向無冬城的無燼領主報告他們的成功後幾天內發生的。如果你想強調一個永恆的巫妖神計劃統治多元宇宙的系統性本質，角色們到達法印城之前可能會過去幾個月甚至幾年。

english: Vecna's Link
zh_tw: 維克那的連結

english: Before resolving how the characters spend the time between their Neverwinter adventure and the events of this chapter, reiterate that each character retains their Vecna's Link. At various times throughout the interim period, the characters are reminded that they're metaphysically linked to Vecna. However you narrate this, make it clear that there's something supernatural about this connection. The link can't be removed, and attempts to research the link are unsuccessful. The characters don't know it yet, but they'll soon learn that the link is a harbinger of events to come.
zh_tw: 在確定角色們在無冬城冒險和本章事件之間的時間如何度過之前，重申每個角色都保留了他們的維克那的連結。在整個間歇期間的不同時間，角色們會被提醒他們與維克那在形而上學上是相連的。無論你如何敘述這一點，都要明確這種聯絡是超自然的。這個連結無法被移除，試圖研究這個連結的嘗試也是不成功的。角色們還不知道，但他們很快就會瞭解到這個連結是即將到來的事件的前兆。

english: During the Interim
zh_tw: 在過渡期間

english: If months or years pass before the characters meet the Wizards Three (see the "{@area Surprise Development|0ec|x}" section later in this chapter), ask the players what their characters did during this time. The party might have stayed together and gone on further adventures, or each character could have gone their own way.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在遇到三巫師（見本章後面的"意外發展{@area 意外發展|0ec|x}"部分）之前過去了幾個月或幾年，請詢問玩家他們的角色在這段時間裡做了什麼。隊伍可能一直在一起並繼續進行更多的冒險，或者每個角色可能都選擇了自己的道路。

english: If the players aren't sure or you'd like to offer them suggestions, consult the Interim Events table below. Choose your favorite result or roll randomly as you see fit.
zh_tw: 如果玩家們不確定或者你想要給他們提供一些建議，請參考下面的間歇事件表。選擇你最喜歡的結果，或者根據你認為合適的方式隨機決定。

english: Interim Events
zh_tw: 過渡期事件

english: d6
zh_tw: d6

english: Event
zh_tw: 事件

english: Determined to find answers about what happened to them, the characters worked as protection for gravediggers in Neverdeath Graveyard. They fought undead, grave robbers, and sometimes even devils who served evil cultists.
zh_tw: 決心找出發生在他們身上的事情，角色們在無冬墓園擔任掘墓人的保護工作。他們與不死生物、盜墓者，有時甚至是為邪惡邪教徒服務的惡魔作戰。

english: Hoping to put their Neverwinter experiences behind them, the characters hopped on a ship to the Moonshae Isles and escorted traders around the Sword Coast area. They fought privateers and oceanic monsters in their bid for high adventure.
zh_tw: 角色們希望把他們在無冬城的經歷拋在腦後，於是他們登上了前往月影群島群島的船隻，並在劍岸地區護送商人。他們為了追求高冒險，與私掠船和海怪戰鬥。

english: The characters became obsessed with the cult of Vecna, researching it in prominent libraries and memorizing historical accounts of its activities. As a result, they know everything the Wizards Three tell the party about Vecna except his attempts to re-create the multiverse.
zh_tw: 角色們對維克那的邪教產生了迷戀，他們在著名的圖書館中研究它，並記住了有關其活動的歷叐記載。因此，他們知道三巫師告訴隊伍關於維克那的所有事情，除了他重新創造多元宇宙的企圖。

english: Sobered by their experiences, the characters passed the time peacefully in the houses Lord Neverember granted them in Neverwinter. Adventure became less of a priority as they settled into domestic life.
zh_tw: 角色們因他們的經歷而變得清醒，他們在無燼領主在無冬城賜予他們的房子裡平靜地度過時光。隨著他們安頓下來過上家庭生活，冒險變得不那麼重要了。

english: Obsessed with the concept of the multiverse, the characters studied the realms that make up existence, traveling between them to learn more. As a result, they know everything the Wizards Three tell the party about the planes where the pieces of the rod are located.
zh_tw: 角色們對多元宇宙的概念著迷，他們研究構成存在的領域，並在它們之間旅行以瞭解更多。因此，他們知道三巫師告訴隊伍關於法杖碎片所在位面的所有事情。

english: Hoping to put their experiences behind them, the characters accepted a call for heroes to confront a murderous young red dragon named Rhagaermati in the wilds outside Myth Drannor. They are fighting the dragon when they experience the events described in the "{@area Surprise Development|0ec|x}" section.
zh_tw: 希望將他們的經歷拋在腦後，角色們響應了英雄的召喚，去對抗一個名叫拉蓋爾瑪提的年輕紅龍，它在迷斯·卓諾野外犯下了謀殺。當他們與龍戰鬥時，他們經歷了"意外發展{@area 意外發展|0ec|x}"部分所描述的事件。

english: Rise of the Lich-God
zh_tw: 巫妖神的崛起

english: Regardless of the characters' activities after their Neverwinter adventure, key plots elements of this adventure progress in the background. While the characters live their lives, a powerful wizard and former ruler of the city of Silverymoon, {@creature Alustriel Silverhand|VEoR}, detects a sinister wave of magic rippling through the multiverse.
zh_tw: 不管角色們在無冬城的冒險之後做了什麼，這次冒險的關鍵情節元素都在背景中推進。當角色們過著自己的生活時，一位強大的法師，銀月城的前統治者，{@creature Alustriel Silverhand|VEoR|艾拉斯卓·銀手}，探測到一股邪惡的魔法波動在多元宇宙中擴散。

english: Using her divining abilities, Alustriel eventually traces the magical pulse to Vecna. She learns that Vecna's activities span multiple realms. After a period of investigation, Alustriel discovers the sobering truth: using stolen secrets, Vecna and his cults have siphoned incredible amounts of power from individuals throughout the multiverse. Worse, Alustriel eventually stops detecting these activities, leading the archmage to believe that Vecna plans to unleash this power for a heinous purpose. Alustriel realizes this could unravel the entire multiverse, elevating Vecna and cowing all others to his will.
zh_tw: 利用她的占卜能力，艾拉斯卓最終將魔法脈動追蹤到維克那。她瞭解到維克那的活動跨越了多個領域。經過一段時間的調查，艾拉斯卓發現了令人清醒的真相：利用偷來的秘密，維克那和他的邪教徒們從多元宇宙中的個體那裡吸取了難以置信的力量。更糟糕的是，艾拉斯卓最終停止了探測到這些活動，這使得大法師相信維克那計劃為了一個邪惡的目的釋放這股力量。艾拉斯卓意識到這可能會解開整個多元宇宙的結構，提升維克那的地位，使所有其他人屈服於他的意志。

english: The Archmages' Desperation
zh_tw: 大法師們的絕望

english: Determined to oppose Vecna but unsure how the lich-god intends to unleash his amassed magic, Alustriel contacts her most powerful allies. Answering her call are the archmages Mordenkainen and a version of {@creature Tasha the Witch|VEoR|Tasha} from Oerth, though Alustriel and Tasha don't yet know that Mordenkainen is {@creature Kas the Betrayer|VEoR|Kas the Destroyer} in disguise. These Wizards Three retreat to a sanctum Alustriel keeps in Sigil. Using their combined magic, the archmages weave a {@spell Wish} spell in hopes of sabotaging Vecna's accumulated power and defusing his ritual.
zh_tw: 決心對抗維克那，但不清楚這位巫妖之神打算如何釋放他積累的魔法，艾拉斯卓聯絡了她最強大的盟友。回應她召喚的是大法師魔鄧肯和來自奧斯的{@creature Tasha the Witch|VEoR|塔莎}的某個版本，儘管艾拉斯卓和塔莎還不知道魔鄧肯其實是偽裝的{@creature Kas the Betrayer|VEoR|毀滅者凱斯}。這三巫師撤退到艾拉斯卓在法印城中的庇護所。運用他們聯合的魔法，大法師們編織了一個{@spell Wish||祈願術}法術，希望破壞維克那積累的力量並瓦解他的儀式。

english: Instead of any expected effect, the {@i Wish} spell shunts the characters to Alustriel Silverhand's Sigil sanctum, as explained in the "{@area Surprise Development|0ec|x}" section later in this chapter. With time of the essence and the archmages weakened, Mordenkainen suggests a desperate contingency plan. The characters could use the fabled {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} to stop Vecna. The rod's seven pieces are scattered throughout the multiverse, but Mordenkainen knows where the first piece is located.
zh_tw: 與預期的任何效果不同，{@i 祈願術}法術將角色們傳送到艾拉斯卓·銀手位於法印城的聖所，正如本章後面的"{@area 意外發展|0ec|x}"部分所解釋的。時間緊迫，大法師們力量削弱，魔鄧肯提出了一個絕望的應急計劃。角色們可以使用傳說中的{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}來阻止維克那。法杖的七個部分遍佈在多元宇宙中，但魔鄧肯知道第一部分的位置。

english: The Sigil Sanctum
zh_tw: 法印城聖所

english: Hundreds of years ago, Lady Alustriel of Silverymoon needed a secure place to conduct sensitive magic work and research. After discovering a portal from Silverymoon to Sigil, Alustriel traveled to Sigil. There she spent decades creating a private sanctum around the portal.
zh_tw: 數百年前，銀月城的艾拉斯卓女士需要一個安全的地方進行敏感的魔法工作和研究。在發現從銀月城到法印城的傳送門後，艾拉斯卓前往了法印城。在那裡，她花了幾十年時間圍繞傳送門建立了一個私人聖所。

english: Alustriel magically fused the portal in her sanctum with a {@item Well of Many Worlds}, destroying the magic item in the process. As a result, the portal now leads to numerous locations throughout the multiverse. Further, the portal reacts to magic items and artifacts, allowing those who carry such objects to step through the portal to the exact places they wish to travel. Alustriel carefully maintains the sanctum's secrecy, bringing guests here only after first meeting them in a neutral location. So far, either her portal's strange teleportation properties have gone unnoticed by Sigil's Lady of Pain and her agents, or the Lady of Pain is allowing the portal to function this way for reasons of her own.
zh_tw: 奧露絲瑞爾（艾拉斯卓）在她的聖所中神奇地將一個門戶與{@item Well of Many Worlds||諸界之井}融合，在這一過程中摧毀了這件魔法物品。結果，這個門戶現在可以通向多元宇宙中的無數地點。此外，這個門戶對魔法物品和神器有反應，允許攜帶這些物品的人透過門戶到達他們希望前往的精確地點。奧露絲瑞爾小心翼翼地維護著聖所的保密性，只有在先前在中立地點會面之後才會將客人帶到這裡。到目前為止，她的門戶的奇怪傳送特性要麼未被法印城的痛苦女士及其特工注意，要麼痛苦女士出於自己的原因允許這個門戶以這種方式運作。

english: Magic in the Sanctum
zh_tw: 聖所中的魔法

english: Planar magic functions differently in Sigil. For instance, the only way to reach Sigil is through portals; teleporting into or out of the city doesn't work. Since the characters might spend significant time in Sigil, take note of how the following types of magic work in the city:
zh_tw: 位面魔法在法印城中的作用有所不同。例如，到達法印城的唯一方式是透過傳送門；直接傳送進城或出城是不起作用的。由於角色們可能會在法印城中花費大量時間，請注意以下型別的魔法在城市中的運作方式：

english: Lady Alustriel Silverhand
zh_tw: 艾拉斯卓·銀手女士

english: Banishment
zh_tw: 放逐術

english: Effects that banish a target from Sigil treat the target as if Sigil were its home plane.
zh_tw: 把目標放逐出法印城的效應，會將法印城視為目標的家園位面。

english: Extradimensional Space
zh_tw: 異次元空間

english: Extradimensional spaces, demiplanes, and pocket dimensions—such as those created by a {@item Bag of Holding} or the {@spell Rope Trick} spell—function within Sigil, but those spaces follow these restrictions as if they were part of the city.
zh_tw: 額外維度空間、半位面和口袋維度——比如由{@item Bag of Holding||次元袋}或{@spell Rope Trick||魔繩術}法術創造的空間——在法印城內起作用，但這些空間遵循以下限制，就好像它們是城市的一部分一樣。

english: Planar Travel
zh_tw: 位面旅行

english: Effects that allow interplanar travel, such as the {@spell Astral Projection} and {@spell Plane Shift} spells, fail if used to try to enter or leave Sigil, with one exception (see "Teleportation Circles" below).
zh_tw: 允許跨位面旅行的效果，如{@spell Astral Projection||星界投影}和{@spell Plane Shift||位面轉移}法術，如果用來嘗試進入或離開法印城則失敗，有一個例外（見下文的"傳送圓環"）。

english: Summoning
zh_tw: 召喚

english: Spells, magic items, and effects that summon creatures or objects from other planes, such as a {@item Ring of Djinni Summoning}, instead summon targets from within Sigil if possible or otherwise fail. Effects that summon a specific target from outside Sigil, such as the {@spell Drawmij's Instant Summons} and {@spell Leomund's Secret Chest} spells, automatically fail.
zh_tw: 法術、魔法物品以及從其他位面召喚生物或物品的效果，例如{@item Ring of Djinni Summoning||召喚氣巨靈戒指}，如果可能的話，改為從法印城內部召喚目標，否則就會失敗。那些從法印城外部召喚特定目標的效果，如{@spell Drawmij's Instant Summons||卓姆吉瞬間召喚}和{@spell Leomund's Secret Chest||李歐蒙秘藏箱}法術，會自動失敗。

english: Teleportation
zh_tw: 傳送

english: Attempts to teleport into or out of Sigil fail, but such magic functions normally when teleporting within the city.
zh_tw: 嘗試傳送進入或離開法印城都會失敗，但是這種魔法在城市內部進行傳送時可以正常運作。

english: Teleportation Circles
zh_tw: 傳送法陣

english: Permanent teleportation circles exist within Sigil, but attempts to create new ones fail. If the Lady of Pain permits, they can be used to enter the city via the {@spell Plane Shift} spell but not to leave.
zh_tw: 法印城記憶體在永久性的傳送圈，但嘗試建立新的傳送圈將會失敗。如果痛苦女士允許，可以使用它們透過{@spell Plane Shift||位面轉移}法術進入城市，但不能用來離開。

english: General Features
zh_tw: 通用特徵

english: The features of Alustriel's sanctum are described in the following sections.
zh_tw: 艾拉斯卓的聖所的特徵在以下各節中進行了描述。

english: Ceilings
zh_tw: 天花板

english: The ceilings on the first floor of the sanctum are 20 feet high. The ceilings on the upper floor are 10 feet high.
zh_tw: 聖所一樓的天花板高度為20尺。上層的天花板高度為10尺。

english: Doors
zh_tw: 門

english: No doors separate areas S1–S3 of the sanctum, though open archways set off each area. The doors in areas S5–S7 of the sanctum are unlocked. The door to {@area area S8|0df|x}, Mordenkainen's room, is sealed with an {@spell Arcane Lock} spell that requires a successful {@dc 30} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check using thieves' tools to open.
zh_tw: 聖所的區域 S1 至 S3 之間沒有門，但每處區域都以開放的拱門分隔。聖所區域 S5 至 S7 的門並未上鎖。通往 {@area 區域S8|0df|x}，即魔鄧肯的房間的門，被一道 {@spell Arcane Lock||秘法鎖} 法術封印，需要使用盜賊工具並透過一次 {@dc 30} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定才能開啟。

english: Lighting
zh_tw: 光照

english: {@spell Continual Flame} spells cast on sconces bathe most areas in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light}. Only {@area area S8|0df|x} is unlit.
zh_tw: 施放在壁燈上的{@spell Continual Flame||不滅明焰}法術使大部分區域沐浴在{@quickref Vision and Light||2||明亮光照}中。只有{@area 區域S8|0df|x}區域未被照亮。

english: Safe from Prying Eyes
zh_tw: 免受窺探的安全

english: Everyone in the sanctum is under the effect of a {@spell Nondetection} spell while they remain inside the structure.
zh_tw: 在聖所內，每個人都受到{@spell Nondetection||迴避偵測}法術的影響，只要他們待在結構內部。

english: Walls
zh_tw: 牆壁

english: Alustriel magically reinforced the walls of the sanctum, which are made of a combination of brick and layers of cement. Only exceedingly powerful destructive magic could harm the sanctum's structural integrity.
zh_tw: 艾拉斯卓使用魔法加固了聖所的牆壁，這些牆壁由磚塊和水泥層組成。只有極其強大的破壞性魔法才能損害聖所的結構完整性。

english: Sanctum Locations
zh_tw: 聖所地點

english: The following locations are keyed to map 2.1.
zh_tw: 以下位置對應於地圖2.1上的關鍵點。

english: Map 2.1: The Sanctum
zh_tw: 地圖 2.1: 聖所

english: S1: Library
zh_tw: S1: 圖書館

english: Gleaming, floor-to-ceiling bookshelves filled with leather-bound tomes wrap around the sanctum's west end, while marble pillars hold up vaulted ceilings to the east. Spiral staircases in the corners lead upward.
zh_tw: 閃閃發光的從地板到天花板的書架，擺滿了皮革裝幀的書籍，環繞在聖所的西端，而大理石柱子支撐著東邊的拱形天花板。角落裡的螺旋樓梯向上延伸。

english: This section of the sanctum holds Alustriel's collection of rare books. The books aren't magical, but the characters can use them to research any esoteric topic.
zh_tw: 這個聖所的部分收藏了艾拉斯卓的稀有書籍。這些書籍沒有魔法，但角色可以使用它們來研究任何深奧的話題。

english: If a character researches a specific topic, roll a {@dice d4}. On a roll of 1 or 2, the character finds information about the topic. At your discretion, this might grant the character advantage for the rest of the day on any ability checks made to recall or use the information they've learned.
zh_tw: 如果一個角色研究一個特定的主題，擲一個{@dice d4}。如果是1或2點，角色找到了關於該主題的資訊。根據您的判斷，這可能會在當天剩餘時間裡，為角色在任何屬性檢定上獲得優勢，以回憶或使用他們學到的資訊。

english: S2: Parlor
zh_tw: S2: 客廳

english: Plush, antique furniture, including sofas and footstools, is arranged here. To the north is a grand staircase. To the south, a garden of ferns and flowering plants grows around a raised marble dais.
zh_tw: 這裡擺放著柔軟的古董傢俱，包括沙發和腳踏凳。向北是一個宏偉的樓梯。向南，一個蕨類植物和開花植物的花園圍繞著一個高臺大理石平臺生長。

english: When Alustriel invites dignitaries into her sanctum, she holds business and political discussions in this parlor. The grand staircase ascends to {@area area S4|0dd|x}.
zh_tw: 當艾拉斯卓邀請顯要人物進入她的聖所時，她會在這個客廳裡進行商務和政治討論。宏偉的樓梯通往{@area 區域S4|0dd|x}。

english: Dais
zh_tw: 講臺

english: The dais in the center of the garden is the site of the portal Alustriel has tweaked to lead to numerous multiplanar locations.
zh_tw: 花園中心的高臺是艾拉斯卓調整過的傳送門的所在地，它可以通往眾多多面位面的位置。

english: Garden
zh_tw: 種植園

english: The greenery is the result of Alustriel's dabbling in magical gardening. The plants here need no tending.
zh_tw: 這些綠色植物是艾拉斯卓在魔法園藝中嘗試的結果。這裡的植物不需要照料。

english: What mischief is Mordenkainen up to?
zh_tw: 魔鄧肯在搞什麼惡作劇？

english: S3: Workspace
zh_tw: S3: 工作區

english: A desk covered in paperwork and books sits in the middle of this work area. Nearby are curio cabinets filled with magical trinkets—everything from necklaces and brooches to sparkling stones and shoes.
zh_tw: 這個工作區域的中央有一張堆滿了檔案和書籍的桌子。附近是裝滿了魔法小玩意兒的古董櫃——從項鍊和胸針到閃閃發光的石頭和鞋子，應有盡有。

english: Characters transported to the sanctum by the failed {@spell Wish} spell appear here (see the "{@area Surprise Development|0ec|x}" section later in this chapter).
zh_tw: 透過失敗的{@spell Wish||祈願術}法術傳送到聖所的角色會出現在這裡（見本章後面的"{@area 意外發展|0ec|x}"部分）。

english: Curio Cabinets
zh_tw: 古董櫃

english: Alustriel keeps an impressive collection of magic items here. If the characters ask, Alustriel allows each character to borrow their choice of any single magic item of rare or lower rarity from the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}. Later in this chapter, Kas, disguised as Mordenkainen, retrieves the {@item Chime of Exile|VEoR} from one of these cabinets.
zh_tw: 艾拉斯卓在這裡儲存著一系列令人印象深刻的魔法物品。如果角色們提出請求，艾拉斯卓允許每位角色從{@book 城主指南|DMG}中借用任意一件稀有或更低稀有度的魔法物品。在本章的後續部分，化身為魔鄧肯的凱斯從其中一個櫃子中取回了{@item Chime of Exile|VEoR|放逐鐘琴}。

english: S4: Lounge
zh_tw: S4: 休息室

english: Roaring fireplaces are built into the east and west walls of this lounge. Comfortable couches and chairs are artfully arranged before a grand staircase that leads downward.
zh_tw: 這個休息室的東牆和西牆上建有熊熊燃燒的壁爐。舒適的沙發和椅子巧妙地擺放在通向下方的宏偉樓梯前。

english: Alustriel and her friends socialize, dine, and relax in this lounge. Alustriel is known for her sumptuous dinner parties. Discreet drawers in the bottoms of the couches store fine china and cutlery for when Alustriel transforms the center table into a dining table. Additional storage is in the northwest corner.
zh_tw: 艾拉斯卓和她的朋友們在這個休息室社交、用餐和放鬆。艾拉斯卓以其豪華的晚宴派對而聞名。沙發底部的抽屜裡藏著精緻的瓷器和餐具，當艾拉斯卓將中央桌子變成餐桌時使用。額外的儲物空間位於西北角。

english: When the characters are shunted to the sanctum, Alustriel offers them use of the lounge.
zh_tw: 當角色們被傳送到聖所時，艾拉斯卓提供給他們使用休息室。

english: S5–S8: Bedrooms
zh_tw: S5–S8: 臥室

english: These small but comfortable bedrooms are where Alustriel and her guests stay when they need personal quarters, whether it's to sleep or be alone.
zh_tw: 這些小巧但舒適的臥室是艾拉斯卓和她的客人在需要私人空間時使用的，無論是為了睡覺還是獨處。

english: Area S5 is the bedroom of Alustriel and her wife, Malaina van Talstiv. A retired adventurer, Malaina is a neutral good human who uses the {@creature assassin} stat block. Malaina is meeting with associates to thwart a scheme against Waterdeep when the characters arrive. When the characters return, Malaina speaks with them (see the "{@area Next Steps|134|x}" section at the end of this chapter).
zh_tw: 區域S5是艾拉斯卓和她的妻子瑪萊娜·範·塔爾斯蒂夫的臥室。瑪萊娜是一位退休的冒險家，是一箇中立善良的人類，使用{@creature assassin||刺客}的統計資料塊。當角色們到達時，瑪萊娜正在與同伴們會面，以挫敗一個針對深水城的陰謀。當角色們回來時，瑪萊娜會與他們交談（見本章末尾的"{@area 下一步|134|x}"部分）。

english: Area S6 is Tasha's room. Area S7 is an empty room, which Alustriel offers to the characters for their use. Area S8 is Mordenkainen's bedroom, which contains clues hinting at subterfuge (see the "{@area Evidence of Deception|0e7|x}" section later in this chapter).
zh_tw: 區域S6是塔莎的房間。區域S7是一個空房間，艾拉斯卓提供給角色們使用。區域S8是魔鄧肯的臥室，其中包含暗示著欺騙的線索（見本章後面的"{@area 欺騙的證據|0e7|x}"部分）。

english: The Wizards Three
zh_tw: 三巫師

english: Three legendary archmages serve as the characters' allies throughout the rest of this adventure, though one of these individuals is an impostor. (See the "{@area Kas the Destroyer|0e4|x}" section.) More information about each spellcaster follows.
zh_tw: 三位傳奇大法師在這次冒險的剩餘部分中作為角色的盟友，儘管其中一人是冒名頂替者。（見"{@area 毀滅者凱斯|0e4|x}"部分。）接下來將提供每位施法者更多的資訊。

english: Alustriel Silverhand
zh_tw: 艾拉斯卓·銀手

english: More than seven centuries old, Lady {@creature Alustriel Silverhand|VEoR} is beloved throughout Faerûn for her kindliness and for using her incredible spellcasting power to protect the innocent. Alustriel is an immortal daughter of Mystra, a god of magic, and is a chaotic good, human wizard. Alustriel served as High Mage of Silverymoon, battled demons on the Outer Planes, and prevented the lich Larloch from ascending to godhood. She has seen the rise and fall of evil powers, though Vecna's plot troubles her greatly. More about Alustriel, including her stat block, appears in {@adventure appendix B|VEoR|13}.
zh_tw: 超過七百年的歲月，{@creature Alustriel Silverhand|VEoR|艾拉斯卓·銀手}因其仁慈以及使用她難以置信的法術力量保護無辜而在整個費倫受到愛戴。艾拉斯卓是魔法之神密斯特拉的不朽女兒，是一個混亂善良的人類女巫。艾拉斯卓曾擔任銀月城的高階法師，與外層位面的惡魔戰鬥，並阻止了巫妖拉爾洛克升為神格。她見證了邪惡勢力的興衰，儘管維克那的陰謀讓她非常煩惱。關於艾拉斯卓的更多資訊，包括她的資料塊，出現在{@adventure 附錄 B|VEoR|13}。

english: Mordenkainen
zh_tw: 魔鄧肯

english: Renowned for his bravery but not his judgment, Mordenkainen is a powerful spellcaster from Oerth. The chaotic neutral, human wizard led a council of famous archmages known as the Circle of Eight. He later became trapped in the dread realm of Barovia, where he lost his spellbook and staff as well as his grip on reality and wandered adrift for some time. Alustriel trusts Mordenkainen and respects his gumption, even though he occasionally embarks on tasks that outstrip his capabilities. The real Mordenkainen doesn't appear in this adventure, though the characters likely believe they're interacting with him.
zh_tw: 魔鄧肯以其勇氣而非判斷力而聞名，他是來自奧斯世界的一位強大施法者。這位混亂中立的人類法師曾領導一個名為八人議會的著名大法師團體。後來，他被困在可怕的巴洛維亞領域，在那裡他失去了他的法術書和法杖，以及對現實的把握，漂泊了一段時間。艾拉斯卓信任魔鄧肯，並尊重他的勇氣，儘管他偶爾會承擔超出自己能力的任務。真正的魔鄧肯沒有出現在這次冒險中，儘管角色們可能認為他們正在與他互動。

english: Tasha
zh_tw: 塔莎

english: {@creature Tasha the Witch|VEoR|Tasha} is a chaotic neutral archmage from Oerth, a renowned demonologist, and the adopted daughter of Baba Yaga. Tasha is widely considered the multiverse's foremost authority on the Abyss, having authored the fabled {@item Demonomicon of Iggwilv|TCE}. Although Tasha's motives are fickle, Alustriel has found Tasha an unparalleled ally when their interests align, as Tasha can access and influence places where even the daughter of Mystra dares not tread. The version of Tasha who answers Alustriel's summons is from the past, before Tasha became Iggwilv the Witch Queen. More about Tasha, including her stat block, can be found in {@adventure appendix B|VEoR|13}.
zh_tw: {@creature Tasha the Witch|VEoR|塔莎}是來自奧斯的一位混亂中立的大法師，是一位著名的惡魔學家，也是巴巴·亞加的養女。塔莎被廣泛認為是多元宇宙中關於無底深淵的權威，她撰寫了傳說中的{@item Demonomicon of Iggwilv|TCE|伊格薇爾伏惡魔志}。儘管塔莎的動機變化無常，但當她們的利益一致時，艾拉斯卓發現塔莎是一個無與倫比的盟友，因為塔莎能夠進入甚至密斯特拉的女兒也不敢涉足的地方並施加影響。響應艾拉斯卓召喚的塔莎版本來自過去，那時塔莎還未成為女巫女王伊格維爾。關於塔莎的更多資訊，包括她的資料塊，可以在{@adventure 附錄 B|VEoR|13}中找到。

english: Tasha
zh_tw: 塔莎

english: Kas the Destroyer
zh_tw: 毀滅者凱斯

english: The vampire warlord {@creature Kas the Betrayer|VEoR|Kas} maintains his masquerade as Mordenkainen, likely fooling the characters until the events of {@adventure chapter 9|VEoR|9}. The blood feud between Kas and Vecna stretches back centuries to a time when Kas served as Vecna's first lieutenant. More about Kas, including his stat block, appears in {@adventure appendix B|VEoR|13}.
zh_tw: 吸血鬼軍閥{@creature Kas the Betrayer|VEoR|凱斯}以魔鄧肯的身份偽裝，很可能會一直欺騙角色們，直到{@adventure 第九章|VEoR|9}的事件。凱斯和維克那之間的血海深仇可以追溯到幾個世紀前，當時凱斯擔任維克那的首席副官。關於凱斯的更多資訊，包括他的資料塊，出現在{@adventure 附錄 B|VEoR|13}。

english: Manipulation in Motion
zh_tw: 操縱在行動

english: After the Dark Powers released him, Kas tracked down a cell of Vecna's cultists, who told the vampire more about the lich-god's planned ritual. The vampire used the {@item Crown of Lies|VEoR} to intercept a message from Alustriel to Mordenkainen, then used the crown to mimic Mordenkainen. Kas then met with Alustriel and gained her confidence.
zh_tw: 黑暗力量釋放他之後，凱斯追蹤到了一個維克那邪教徒的小組，他們告訴了這位吸血鬼有關巫妖神計劃儀式的更多資訊。吸血鬼使用{@item Crown of Lies|VEoR|謊言之冠}截獲了艾拉斯卓發給魔鄧肯的資訊，然後利用皇冠模仿魔鄧肯。之後凱斯會見了艾拉斯卓，並贏得了她的信任。

english: While posing as Mordenkainen, Kas sabotages the archmages' {@spell Wish} spell. As a consequence, the spell shunts the characters to Alustriel's sanctum. Suspecting that the characters are somehow linked to Vecna, Kas urges them to retrieve the pieces of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}. As Mordenkainen, Kas claims that the rod is the only way to weaken Vecna to the point where the characters might thwart his ritual and banish the lich-god to Oerth.
zh_tw: 在偽裝成魔鄧肯的同時，凱斯破壞了大法師們的{@spell Wish||祈願術}法術。結果，法術將角色們傳送到了艾拉斯卓的聖所。凱斯懷疑角色們以某種方式與維克那有關，便敦促他們去取回{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的碎片。作為魔鄧肯，凱斯聲稱法杖是削弱維克那的唯一方法，以至於角色們可能破壞他的儀式，並將巫妖神驅逐到奧斯。

english: In truth, Kas intends to steal the {@i Rod of Seven Parts} once he has all the pieces. He plans to whisk the artifact to the plane of Pandemonium, use it to free the demon known as Miska the Wolf-Spider, and kill Vecna. Kas doesn't yet know the site of Vecna's ritual is also on Pandemonium, the same plane where Miska is imprisoned, but the vampire finds out later in this adventure.
zh_tw: 實際上，凱斯打算一旦得到所有的碎片，就偷走{@i 七碎片之杖}。他計劃將這件神器帶到喧癲空隧，用它釋放被稱為米斯卡，狼蛛的惡魔，並殺死維克那。凱斯還不知道維克那的儀式地點也在喧癲空隧，也就是米斯卡被囚禁的同一層面，但這位吸血鬼在這次冒險中稍後會發現。

english: Kas in the Sanctum
zh_tw: 聖所中的凱斯

english: While disguised as Mordenkainen, Kas never lets his guard down or removes the {@item Crown of Lies|VEoR}. Occasionally during this adventure, Mordenkainen is absent from the sanctum. During these interludes, the vampire warlord travels to other realms and eventually deduces where Vecna plans to enact the multiverse-unraveling ritual. This sets into motion the betrayal that takes place in {@adventure chapter 9|VEoR|9}.
zh_tw: 在偽裝成魔鄧肯時，凱斯從不放鬆警惕或摘下{@item Crown of Lies|VEoR|謊言之冠}。在這次冒險中，偶爾魔鄧肯會不在聖所。在這些間歇期間，這位吸血鬼軍閥會前往其他領域，並最終推斷出維克那計劃實施解構多元宇宙儀式的地點。這觸發了{@adventure 第九章|VEoR|9}中發生的背叛。

english: Evidence of Deception
zh_tw: 欺騙的證據

english: While in the sanctum, Kas is careful to leave no direct evidence that he's not Mordenkainen. In Mordenkainen's quarters ({@area area S8|0df|x}), Kas leaves spellbooks and collections of notes spread across the desk to reinforce his fake identity.
zh_tw: 在聖所內，凱斯小心不留下任何直接證據表明他不是魔鄧肯。在魔鄧肯的住處（{@area 區域S8|0df|x}），凱斯在桌子上散佈著魔法書和筆記集，以加強他的假身份。

english: However, a character who searches Mordenkainen's quarters and succeeds on a {@dc 30} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check notices that none of the famed spells Mordenkainen authored are mentioned in these spellbooks or notes. The jumbled notes are written awkwardly, while Mordenkainen is known for his academic, methodical style.
zh_tw: 然而，一個角色如果搜尋了魔鄧肯的住處並在一次 {@dc 30} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定中成功，會注意到這些法術書或筆記中沒有提到任何魔鄧肯所著的著名法術。這些混亂的筆記寫得很生硬，而魔鄧肯以其學術性、有條理的風格著稱。

english: Any thorough search of Mordenkainen's quarters yields a black {@item Bag of Holding} tucked underneath the mattress. Inside the bag is a mundane silver chain bearing a sword-shaped pendant inlaid with black diamonds, worth 5,000 gp total. Also inside is a magically preserved, leather-bound journal.
zh_tw: 對魔鄧肯的住處進行徹底搜尋，會發現床墊下藏著一個黑色的{@item Bag of Holding||次元袋}。袋子裡有一個普通的銀色鏈子，上面掛著一個鑲有黑色鑽石的劍形吊墜，總價值為5000金幣。袋子裡還有一個魔法儲存的皮革封面日記本。

english: The journal's contents are written in a cipher. A character who spends at least 1 hour examining the text can make a successful {@dc 30} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check, decoding it on a success. The journal tells the story of two people called "K." and "V." who once crafted murderous battle plans together, but then parted bitterly and became enemies. A successful {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill History}) check reveals that this story refers to Kas and Vecna.
zh_tw: 日記的內容是用密碼寫成的。一個角色花費至少1小時檢查文字，可以嘗試進行一次成功的 {@dc 30} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，成功時即可破譯。日記講述了兩個名為"K."和"V."的人的故事，他們曾一起策劃了血腥的戰鬥計劃，但後來分道揚鑣併成為敵人。成功的 {@dc 20} 智力（{@skill History||歷史}）檢定揭示這個故事指的是凱斯和維克那。

english: Mordenkainen's Secret
zh_tw: 魔鄧肯的秘密

english: If the characters find out at any point in this adventure that Mordenkainen is Kas in disguise, it counts as a secret for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
zh_tw: 如果在這次冒險的任何時候，角色們發現魔鄧肯實際上是偽裝的凱斯，這將被視為本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中提到的{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則的秘密。

english: If They Find Out?
zh_tw: 如果他們發現了？

english: Malaina van Talstiv
zh_tw: 瑪萊娜·範·塔爾斯蒂夫

english: Although it's unlikely, the characters might become suspicious of Mordenkainen and question him. The characters could investigate the wizard's activities outside the Sigil sanctum, or they might find the strange personal items in Mordenkainen's {@item Bag of Holding}. If the characters put sufficient effort into their investigations, consider allowing them to discover before {@adventure chapter 9|VEoR|9} that Mordenkainen is an impostor.
zh_tw: 雖然不太可能，角色們可能會對魔鄧肯產生懷疑並質問他。角色們可以調查這位法師在法印城聖所之外的活動，或者他們可能會在魔鄧肯的{@item Bag of Holding||次元袋}中找到奇怪的個人物品。如果角色們在調查中投入了足夠的努力，考慮允許他們在{@adventure 第九章|VEoR|9}之前發現魔鄧肯是個冒名頂替者。

english: Kas Defeats the Characters
zh_tw: 凱斯擊敗角色們

english: If the characters confront Kas before chapter 9, allow the battle to play out using the stat block for {@creature Kas the Betrayer|VEoR|Kas} in {@adventure appendix B|VEoR|13}. If Kas defeats the characters, he kills them and absconds to Pandemonium. Alustriel has the clerics of Silverymoon bring the characters back to life, apologetic for not discovering Kas's ruse and angry she was duped. Alustriel suspects Kas knows where Vecna weaves his ritual and encourages the characters to follow the vampire to Pandemonium when they can.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在第9章之前面對凱斯，允許使用{@adventure 附錄 B|VEoR|13}中{@creature Kas the Betrayer|VEoR|凱斯}的資料塊來進行戰鬥。如果凱斯擊敗了角色們，他會殺死他們並逃往喧癲空隧。艾拉斯卓讓銀月城的牧師們使角色們復活，對於沒有發現凱斯的詭計感到歉意，並對自己被欺騙感到憤怒。艾拉斯卓懷疑凱斯知道維克那編織儀式的地點，並鼓勵角色們在能夠的時候跟隨吸血鬼前往喧癲空隧。

english: In this case, Kas lacks the completed {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}. Adjust {@adventure chapter 10|VEoR|10} to reflect that Miska never begins to escape his prison. The characters' priority remains stopping Vecna, but if they don't permanently destroy Kas, at some point the vampire hunts down the characters. Once the characters eventually defeat Kas, they learn where Vecna weaves his ritual and can proceed to {@adventure chapter 11|VEoR|11}.
zh_tw: 在這種情況下，凱斯沒有完成的{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}。調整{@adventure 第十章|VEoR|10}以反映米斯卡從未開始逃離他的監獄。角色們的首要任務仍然是阻止維克那，但如果他們不能永久性地摧毀凱斯，那麼在某個時刻，這個吸血鬼會追捕角色們。一旦角色們最終擊敗凱斯，他們就會瞭解到維克那編織他的儀式的地方，並可以繼續進行{@adventure 第十一章|VEoR|11}。

english: The Characters Defeat Kas
zh_tw: 角色們擊敗凱斯

english: If the characters defeat Kas, allow them to decide how to proceed. They might still want to reassemble the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} to use its power against the lich-god. However, to reinforce the story's sense of urgency, feel free to skip the characters ahead to {@adventure chapter 10|VEoR|10}. If you do, award the characters the appropriate number of milestone level-ups so they have a fair chance of defeating the threats in the adventure's final chapters.
zh_tw: 如果角色們擊敗了凱斯，允許他們決定如何繼續。他們可能仍然想要重新組裝{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}以利用其力量對抗巫妖神。然而，為了加強故事的緊迫感，你可以自由地讓角色們跳到{@adventure 第十章|VEoR|10}。如果你這樣做了，給予角色們適當的里程碑等級提升，以便他們有公平的機會擊敗冒險最後幾章中的威脅。

english: Surprise Development
zh_tw: 意外發展

english: When the failed {@spell Wish} spell transports the characters to Alustriel's sanctum, read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 當失敗的{@spell Wish||祈願術}法術將角色們傳送到艾拉斯卓的聖所時，請閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: With a flash of multicolored light, the world winks out of existence. Nothingness envelops your senses, though you feel the thrum of magic rushing like an electric spark through your veins.
zh_tw: 隨著一道多彩的光芒閃爍，世界從存在中消失了。虛無包圍了你的感官，儘管你感覺到魔法的震動，就像電流火花一樣在你的血管中疾馳。

english: When you regain focus, you stand in a plush, candlelit parlor. A stately woman in blue robes leans toward you, her brow furrowed in confusion and concern. In the blurry background stand a frowning woman in a flowing, black dress and a man tugging in confusion at his high, crimson collar.
zh_tw: 當你重新集中注意力時，你站在一個裝飾豪華、燭光閃爍的客廳裡。一位穿著藍色長袍的莊重女士向你傾斜，她的眉頭緊鎖，顯得困惑和擔憂。在模糊的背景中，一位穿著飄逸的黑色連衣裙的女士皺著眉頭，還有一位男士困惑地拉著他那高高的深紅色領子。

english: The characters appear in {@area area S3|0da|x} of the Sigil sanctum. The woman leaning toward the characters is Alustriel, and the two individuals behind her are Tasha and Mordenkainen. "You can't be the answer to our {@i Wish}," Tasha sneers, while Alustriel shushes her and ushers the characters toward the sanctum's comfortable lounge furniture.
zh_tw: 角色們出現在法印城聖所的{@area 區域S3|0da|x}區域。向角色們傾斜的女人是艾拉斯卓，她身後的兩個人是塔莎和魔鄧肯。"你們不可能是我們的{@i 祈願術}的答案，"塔莎嘲諷道，而艾拉斯卓讓她安靜下來，引導角色們走向聖所的舒適休息區。

english: Some Answers
zh_tw: 一些答案

english: At this point, Alustriel explains where the characters are and how they arrived, though she doesn't understand why they teleported to the sanctum as a result of the {@spell Wish} spell. She then introduces herself and her wizardly companions.
zh_tw: 在這一點上，艾拉斯卓解釋了角色們所在的位置以及他們是如何到達的，儘管她不理解為什麼他們會因為{@spell Wish||祈願術}法術而傳送到聖所。然後她介紹了自己和她的法師同伴們。

english: Kas
zh_tw: 凱斯

english: As the characters try to figure out what's going on, Alustriel asks whether they have any ties to Vecna. If the characters mention Vecna's Link, Alustriel reasons that the characters' fate must somehow be interwoven with Vecna's. She surmises that since the {@i Wish} was unable to fulfill its parameters, it instead found beings tied to Vecna and brought them to Sigil. She then explains everything she knows as described in "{@area Rise of the Lich-God|0c9|x}" earlier in this chapter.
zh_tw: 當角色們試圖弄清楚發生了什麼時，艾拉斯卓詢問他們是否與維克那有任何聯絡。如果角色們提到了維克那的連結，艾拉斯卓推斷角色們的命運必然以某種方式與維克那交織在一起。她推測，由於{@i 祈願術}法術無法完成其引數，它反而找到了與維克那有聯絡的生物，並將他們帶到了法印城。然後，她解釋了她所知道的一切，正如本章前面"{@area 巫妖神的崛起|0c9|x}"部分所描述的。

english: Aftermath of a Wish
zh_tw: 願望的後果

english: As the characters interact with Alustriel, Tasha stands near them, aloof and occasionally interjecting acerbic comments. Mordenkainen remains silent, focusing intensely on everything the characters say.
zh_tw: 當角色們與艾拉斯卓互動時，塔莎站在他們附近，冷漠且偶爾插話發表尖刻的評論。魔鄧肯保持沉默，專注地關注角色們所說的一切。

english: After a few minutes of conversation, the characters notice that the Wizards Three seem tired and weakened. Any character proficient in the {@skill Medicine} skill understands that the wizards are extremely fatigued. Any character proficient in the {@skill Arcana} skill realizes that the wizards expended a great deal of arcane energy casting the {@i Wish} spell. (Mordenkainen is faking his fatigue, but in the context of Alustriel and Tasha's real physical weakness, it seems legitimate.)
zh_tw: 經過幾分鐘的對話後，角色們注意到三巫師看起來疲憊不堪，力量減弱。任何精通{@skill Medicine||醫療}技能的角色都會明白這些法師極度疲勞。任何精通{@skill Arcana||奧秘}技能的角色都會意識到這些法師在施放{@i 祈願術}法術時消耗了大量的奧術能量。（魔鄧肯在偽裝自己的疲勞，但在艾拉斯卓和塔莎真正身體虛弱的背景下，這看起來是合理的。）

english: A New Plan
zh_tw: 新計劃

english: After the characters absorb their situation, Alustriel expresses concern that the wizards can't stop Vecna. Mordenkainen says, "I have an alternative plan."
zh_tw: 在角色們理解了他們所處的情況後，艾拉斯卓表達了對法師們無法阻止維克那的擔憂。魔鄧肯說：'我有一個替代計劃。'

english: Mordenkainen strides over to a cabinet full of magic items and picks up a silver chime. He then approaches the characters, displays the chime, and says the following:
zh_tw: 魔鄧肯大步走向一個裝滿魔法物品的櫃子，拿起一個銀色的鈴鐺。然後他走向角色們，展示鈴鐺，並說以下的話：

english: "I worried that perhaps our {@i Wish} wouldn't stop one as powerful as Vecna. Alustriel, please forgive me, but I did plan a contingency.
zh_tw: "我擔心我們的{@i 祈願術}可能無法阻止像維克那這樣強大的存在。艾拉斯卓，請原諒我，但我確實制定了一個應急計劃。"

english: "Vecna is too powerful to stop directly at this point. However, no power is absolute. I suspect Vecna will be vulnerable while he weaves his ritual. If you confront and weaken him, this {@i Chime of Exile} can banish him to Oerth. He would no longer be able to affect multiple realms at once. His plan to remake the multiverse would fail."
zh_tw: "維克那現在太強大了，直接阻止他幾乎不可能。然而，沒有力量是絕對的。我懷疑維克那在編織他的儀式時會有所脆弱。如果你們面對並削弱他，這個{@i 放逐鐘琴}可以將他驅逐到奧斯。他將不再能夠同時影響多個領域。他重塑多元宇宙的計劃將會失敗。"

english: Mordenkainen's eyes gleam with excitement as he continues:
zh_tw: 魔鄧肯的眼睛閃爍著興奮，他繼續說道：

english: "There is an artifact that is, I believe, the only way to weaken Vecna so the chime can be used against him. It's called the {@i Rod of Seven Parts}. Unfortunately, its component pieces are scattered across existence.
zh_tw: "我認為有一個神器是唯一能夠削弱維克那，讓鐘聲能夠對他使用的方法。它被稱為{@i 七碎片之杖}。不幸的是，它的組成部分分散在存在的各個角落。"

english: "While my esteemed colleagues researched the magic needed to cast a {@i Wish} spell powerful enough to stop Vecna, I looked into finding the rod's pieces should we need them. The first piece is deep in the Underdark, somewhere inside a hidden safe house for worshipers of the demon-god Lolth. Web's Edge, it's called.
zh_tw: "當我尊敬的同事們研究施展足夠強大的{@i 祈願術}以阻止維克那的時候，我則是在尋找這根法杖的碎片，以備我們需要它們。第一塊碎片深藏於幽暗地域，位於惡魔之神羅絲的信徒的隱秘安全屋中。那裡被稱為網之邊緣。"

english: "Find that first piece of the rod, my friends. The portal on the dais will take you to it. Once you locate the first piece, the magic inherent in the artifact will point you to the second piece, and then to the third, and so on. This sanctum's portal reacts to powerful magic such as this artifact, so as you find each piece, this portal will lead to the next. No need to use another key; the most recent piece of the rod will suffice.
zh_tw: "找到那根法杖的第一片，我的朋友們。講臺上的傳送門將帶你們去那裡。一旦你們找到第一片，法杖中固有的魔法將會指引你們找到第二片，然後是第三片，以此類推。這個聖所的傳送門對這種強大的魔法有反應，所以當你們找到每一片時，這個傳送門將引導你們去下一片。不需要使用另一個鑰匙；最近的那片法杖就足夠了。"

english: "There's no time to waste. Once you've reassembled the rod, we can all confront Vecna and stop his heinous plan. You'll be the heroes of the multiverse! How does that sound?"
zh_tw: "沒有時間可以浪費了。一旦你們重新組裝了法杖，我們就可以一起面對維克那，阻止他那邪惡的計劃。你們將成為多元宇宙的英雄！聽起來怎麼樣？

english: Subtle evidence of Mordenkainen's true identity is hidden in the sanctum
zh_tw: 魔鄧肯真實身份的微妙證據隱藏在聖所中

english: Although taken aback at how much work Mordenkainen has done on this contingency, Alustriel and Tasha admit that the plan Mordenkainen has laid out is the best hope to stop Vecna. Alustriel compliments Mordenkainen on his foresight.
zh_tw: 儘管對魔鄧肯在這一應急計劃上所做的工作感到吃驚，艾拉斯卓和塔莎承認魔鄧肯制定的計劃是阻止維克那的最佳希望。艾拉斯卓讚揚魔鄧肯的遠見。

english: The wizards answer the characters' questions to the best of their ability. Like Mordenkainen, Alustriel and Tasha urge the characters to make haste, though they help the characters prepare for their journey any way they can. Mordenkainen, Alustriel, and Tasha explain that while the characters reassemble the rod, the archmages must continue to research Vecna's plans and potential weaknesses.
zh_tw: 這些法師盡其所能回答角色們的問題。像魔鄧肯一樣，艾拉斯卓和塔莎敦促角色們加快速度，儘管他們以各種方式幫助角色們為旅程做好準備。魔鄧肯、艾拉斯卓和塔莎解釋說，雖然角色們重新組裝法杖，大法師們必須繼續研究維克那的計劃和潛在的弱點。

english: Before the characters depart for Web's Edge, Alustriel relays any information they haven't yet learned, including the details found in "{@area Magic in the Sanctum|0cc|x}" earlier in this chapter.
zh_tw: 在角色們前往蛛網邊緣之前，艾拉斯卓傳達了他們尚未瞭解到的任何資訊，包括本章早些時候在"{@area 聖所中的魔法|0cc|x}"中發現的細節。

english: A Significant Lie
zh_tw: 一個重大的謊言

english: In the guise of Mordenkainen, Kas has lied to the characters about the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}. While the rod is useful against Vecna, Kas simply wants the characters to retrieve the rod so he can use it to free Miska.
zh_tw: 在偽裝成魔鄧肯時，凱斯對角色們關於{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}撒了謊。雖然這根法杖對對抗維克那很有用，但凱斯只是想讓角色們取回法杖，這樣他就可以利用它釋放米斯卡。

english: Kas doesn't know that Vecna is weakened to pre-god status while weaving the Ritual of Remaking. The characters will learn this when they confront Vecna in {@adventure chapter 11|VEoR|11}.
zh_tw: 凱斯不知道維克那在編織重塑儀式時被削弱到了前神狀態。角色們將在{@adventure 第十一章|VEoR|11}面對維克那時得知這一點。

english: Sending Vecna Back
zh_tw: 將維克那送回

english: The {@item Chime of Exile|VEoR} is Alustriel's property and ultimately can send Vecna back to Oerth, interrupting his ritual. The interruption would dissipate the secret-based magic Vecna is weaving, significantly setting back his plot and leaving the lich-god in a weakened state. If the characters wish to take the chime with them, Alustriel assents.
zh_tw: {@item Chime of Exile|VEoR|放逐鐘琴}是艾拉斯卓的財產，最終可以將維克那送回奧斯，打斷他的儀式。這個打斷會驅散維克那正在編織的秘密基礎魔法，大大推遲他的計劃，使這位巫妖神處於虛弱狀態。如果角色們希望帶走這個鍾，艾拉斯卓會同意。

english: Chime of Exile
zh_tw: 放逐鐘琴

english: Toward Web's Edge
zh_tw: 向蛛網邊緣

english: Alustriel's Chime of Exile might help the characters defeat Vecna
zh_tw: 艾拉斯卓的流放之鈴可能幫助角色們擊敗維克那

english: After stepping through the portal, the characters emerge deep in the Underdark in Faerûn. The rod piece is hidden in Web's Edge, a nearby safe house for agents of the demon-god Lolth.
zh_tw: 穿過傳送門後，角色們出現在費倫的幽暗地域深處。法杖碎片隱藏在蛛網邊緣，一個附近的惡魔神羅絲的代理人的安全屋。

english: The characters initially emerge through a door-shaped fissure in one wall of a claustrophobic, seemingly abandoned corridor outside the hidden entrance to Web's Edge. There is no light source, and the invisible portal back to Sigil remains open.
zh_tw: 角色們最初透過一個牆上的門形裂縫出現在一個幽閉恐怖、看似被遺棄的走廊中，這是通往蛛網邊緣隱藏入口的外部。沒有光源，回到法印城的隱形傳送門保持開啟。

english: Web's Edge Entrance
zh_tw: 蛛網邊緣入口

english: The entrance to Web's Edge is hidden mere steps from where the characters arrive in the Underdark. The 10-foot-wide doorway is closed and cloaked with a permanent invisibility effect. Those who can perceive invisible objects see a nondescript iron door. The door is sealed with an {@spell Arcane Lock} spell and requires a successful {@dc 22} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check using thieves' tools to open.
zh_tw: 網路邊緣的入口隱藏在角色們抵達幽暗地域的幾步之遙。這扇10尺寬的門被關閉並籠罩在永久隱形效果中。那些能感知隱形物體的人會看到一扇普通的鐵門。門被施以{@spell Arcane Lock||秘法鎖}法術，並使用盜賊工具成功進行一次{@dc 22}敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定才能開啟。

english: Visible to characters who can see invisible objects are eight symbols subtly carved into the rock above the doorway. Tiny Undercommon characters are embedded in each symbol. When touched in the order that spells out "Web's Edge," the doorway opens.
zh_tw: 能夠看見隱形物體的角色可以看到，在門楣上巧妙地雕刻著八個符號。每個符號中都嵌入了微小的幽暗地域通用語字元。按照拼出"蛛網邊緣"的順序觸控這些符號，門就會開啟。

english: Web's Edge
zh_tw: 蛛網邊緣

english: Chime of Exile
zh_tw: 放逐鐘琴

english: Web's Edge is a hidden meeting place for agents of Lolth who operate throughout the Underdark beneath the Sword Coast, pursuing missions for the glory of their demon-god. These agents use Web's Edge to plot infiltration missions targeting virtuous clerical orders; to sabotage efforts to quash Lolth's worship; to orchestrate the upheaval of good-aligned governments; and to plan large-scale conversion efforts in Underdark cities, including Blingdenstone, Gracklstugh, and Mithral Hall.
zh_tw: 蛛網邊緣是羅絲的代理人的秘密會面地點，他們在劍海岸下方的幽暗地域中活動，執行任務以榮耀他們的惡魔神。這些代理人利用蛛網邊緣策劃滲透任務，目標是針對善良的神職人員秩序；破壞壓制羅絲崇拜的努力；策劃顛覆善良陣營政府；以及在幽暗地域城市，包括布靈登石城、格拉克羅絲特和米斯拉爾大廳，計劃大規模的轉變信仰的努力。

english: Agents might spend a few hours in Web's Edge, attending tactical meetings before dispersing. Others stay for 14 days or more while they await the arrival of colleagues from all reaches of the Underdark. A few spend months at a time in Web's Edge, using its barrack to lie low while authorities elsewhere hunt for them.
zh_tw: 代理人可能在蛛網邊緣花費幾個小時，參加戰術會議，然後散去。其他人則可能逗留14天或更長時間，等待來自幽暗地域各個角落的同事到來。還有一些人可能會在蛛網邊緣逗留數月，利用它的兵營躲避追捕，同時其他地方的當局正在追捕他們。

english: Owing to the highly sensitive and wicked work that takes place here, Web's Edge is a carefully guarded secret. Only the highest-ranking covert operatives and members of Lolth's clergy know about it, though powerful demons and devils allied with the Spider Queen are also aware of Web's Edge. A few cultists live in Web's Edge to maintain its facilities and serve as support staff to the operatives. These cultists are confined to the facility for life—a sacrifice they make willingly to show their devotion to the Spider Queen.
zh_tw: 由於這裡進行的是非常敏感和邪惡的工作，蛛網邊緣是一個被小心守護的秘密。只有最高階別的秘密特工和羅絲的神職人員知道它，儘管與蜘蛛女王結盟的強大惡魔和魔鬼也瞭解蛛網邊緣。一些邪教徒居住在蛛網邊緣，以維護其設施並作為特工的支援人員。這些邪教徒被終身限制在設施中——這是他們為了顯示對蜘蛛女王的忠誠而自願做出的犧牲。

english: General Features
zh_tw: 通用特徵

english: Recurring features of Web's Edge are described in the following sections.
zh_tw: 蛛網邊緣的重複特徵在以下各節中進行了描述。

english: Agents and Cultists
zh_tw: 特工與邪教徒

english: No matter why they're in Web's Edge, all Lolth worshipers here are fanatics devoted to the demon-god. In a battle against the characters, these fanatics always fight to the death.
zh_tw: 無論他們為何來到蛛網邊緣，所有羅絲的信徒都是對這位惡魔神極度狂熱的。在與角色們的戰鬥中，這些狂熱者總是戰鬥到死。

english: Ceilings
zh_tw: 天花板

english: The ceilings in most areas of Web's Edge are 20 feet high, with stalactites occasionally jutting down a few feet. The ceilings in the fodder chamber ({@area area W9|126|x}) and Sacred Web Hall ({@area area W12|130|x}) are 50 feet tall and relatively smooth.
zh_tw: 蛛網邊緣大部分區域的天花板高度為20尺，偶爾有石鐘乳向下突出幾尺。飼料室（{@area 區域W9|126|x}）和聖網大廳（{@area 區域W12|130|x}）的天花板高度為50尺，相對平滑。

english: Doors
zh_tw: 門

english: The doors in Web's Edge are made of iron. The doors to {@area areas W3|10a|x}, {@area W4|10e|x}, and {@area W5|111|x} are sealed with {@spell Arcane Lock} spells, requiring a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check using thieves' tools to unlock. Additionally, areas W6a–W6d are locked and each require a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check using thieves' tools to unlock. The {@creature nalfeshnee} in {@area area W5|111|x} carries keys to all the cells in {@area area W6|114|x}. All other doors in Web's Edge are unlocked.
zh_tw: 在蛛網邊緣之門由鐵製成。通往 {@area 區域W3|10a|x}、{@area W4|10e|x} 和 {@area W5|111|x} 的門都被{@spell Arcane Lock||秘法鎖}法術封印，需要成功透過{@dc 20} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定並使用盜賊工具來解鎖。此外，區域 W6a–W6d 被鎖上，每個區域都需要成功透過{@dc 15} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定並使用盜賊工具來解鎖。位於{@area 區域W5|111|x}的{@creature nalfeshnee||判魂魔}攜帶著{@area 區域W6|114|x}中所有牢房的鑰匙。蛛網邊緣的其他門都是未上鎖的。

english: Lighting
zh_tw: 光照

english: There are no natural or magical light sources in the complex. Area descriptions assume the characters have a light source or some other means of seeing in the dark. Light sources bring the attention of the complex's denizens, although the characters might not immediately be recognized as intruders (see "{@area Infiltrating Web's Edge|100|x}" below).
zh_tw: 在這個建築群中沒有自然或魔法光源。區域描述假設角色們有光源或在黑暗中視物的其他方式。光源會吸引建築群居民的注意，儘管角色們可能不會立即被識別為入侵者（見下文"{@area 潛入蛛網邊緣|100|x}"）。

english: Safe from Prying Eyes
zh_tw: 免受窺探的安全

english: Everyone in Web's Edge is under the effect of a {@spell Nondetection} spell while inside the structure.
zh_tw: 在蛛網邊緣內，每個人都受到一個{@spell Nondetection||迴避偵測}法術的效果影響。

english: Walls
zh_tw: 牆壁

english: The walls in Web's Edge are rocky, jagged, and uneven. Decades ago, Lolth's faithful enlarged the chamber that contains Sacred Web Hall ({@area area W12|130|x}) using the {@spell Stone Shape} spell. As such, the walls in area W12 are smooth.
zh_tw: 蛛網邊緣的牆壁是岩石質地的，參差不齊且不平整。幾十年前，羅絲的信徒使用{@spell Stone Shape||塑石術}法術擴大了包含聖網大廳（{@area 區域W12|130|x}）的房間。因此，W12區域的牆壁是平滑的。

english: Infiltrating Web's Edge
zh_tw: 潛入蛛網邊緣

english: Heroes who stumble into Web's Edge unaware of its dangers usually meet a gruesome end
zh_tw: 英雄們如果不瞭解蛛網邊緣的危險而誤入其中，通常會遭遇悲慘的結局。

english: Web's Edge is a dangerous place. If the characters burst into the complex without a plan, they're unlikely to survive the experience, let alone retrieve the first piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}. See the advice below for handling strategies the characters might adopt.
zh_tw: 蛛網邊緣是一個危險的地方。如果角色們沒有計劃就衝進這個建築群，他們不太可能在經歷中生存下來，更不用說取回{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第一片了。請參閱下面的建議，以處理角色們可能採取的策略。

english: Being Sneaky
zh_tw: 悄無聲息

english: If the characters are careful, they might be able to sneak through Web's Edge and steal the rod piece without anyone catching them.
zh_tw: 如果角色們小心行事，他們可能能夠潛行穿過蛛網邊緣並偷走法杖碎片而不被任何人發現。

english: If any devotees in Web's Edge spot the characters infiltrating the safe house, they scream for help to any denizen within earshot and attack unless otherwise noted.
zh_tw: 如果蛛網邊緣內的任何信徒發現角色們潛入安全屋，他們會大聲呼救並攻擊任何能聽到的人，除非另有說明。

english: Impersonating Worshipers
zh_tw: 冒充信徒

english: Masquerading as devotees of Lolth could be an effective strategy. Creatures of all backgrounds and origins use Web's Edge as a meeting place, a safe house, and a place of worship. Web's Edge has only a handful of permanent attendants, none of whom could possibly be familiar with every Lolth agent in the Underdark.
zh_tw: 偽裝成羅絲的信徒可能是一個有效的策略。各種背景和起源的生物使用蛛網邊緣作為會議地點、安全屋和禮拜場所。蛛網邊緣只有少數幾個常駐人員，他們不可能熟悉幽暗地域中每一個羅絲的代理人。

english: If the characters want to blend in with the Lolth worshipers, any disguises they use (magical or otherwise) should include spider-shaped paraphernalia. A successful {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Religion}) or Intelligence ({@skill History}) check reveals that "The Spider Queen smiles on you" is a typical religious greeting that those in Web's Edge expect to hear from fellow devotees. Any creature in Web's Edge who sees a character wearing something spider-shaped or hears the character speak this greeting has disadvantage on ability checks to see through the characters' disguises.
zh_tw: 如果角色想要融入羅絲信徒之中，他們使用的任何偽裝（魔法或其他）都應包括蜘蛛形狀的飾品。一個成功的 {@dc 14} 感知（{@skill Religion||宗教}）或智力（{@skill History||歷史}）檢定揭示出"蜘蛛女王對你微笑"是蛛網邊緣地區的信徒們期待聽到的典型宗教問候語。任何在蛛網邊緣地區看到角色穿著蜘蛛形狀物品或聽到角色說出這句問候語的生物，在識破角色偽裝的能力檢定上處於劣勢。

english: Devotees in Web's Edge who identify the characters as impostors scream for help and attack.
zh_tw: 在蛛網邊緣，識別角色為冒名頂替者的信徒會呼救並攻擊。

english: Web's Edge Locations
zh_tw: 蛛網邊緣地點

english: The following locations are keyed to map 2.2.
zh_tw: 下列地點對應地圖2.2。

english: Map 2.2: Web's Edge
zh_tw: 地圖 2.2: 蛛網邊緣

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: W1: False Front
zh_tw: W1: 假門面

english: The remains of mold-covered broken wagons and barrels languish in this large foyer. Humanoid skeletal remains lie strewn about, their swords and armor bent and rusted. Something gleams next to the bodies propped along the northern wall. Double doors on the east, northeast, and southeast walls are rusted shut, and a semicircular chamber that opens in the southwest wall contains a shrine.
zh_tw: 這個大堂裡散落著被黴菌覆蓋的破舊馬車和酒桶。類人生物的骨骼殘骸四處散落，他們的劍和盔甲彎曲變形且生鏽。在靠北牆支撐的屍體旁邊有東西在閃爍。東牆、東北牆和東南牆上的雙扇門都生鏽了，而西南牆上的一個半圓形房間內有一個神龕。

english: To convince unwelcome visitors that this cave is unused, the facility's cultists created a false front in this foyer. The skeletal remains and rusted gear belong to five long-dead adventurers whom the characters can identify as two dwarves, an elf, a gnome, and a tiefling.
zh_tw: 為了說服不受歡迎的訪客這個洞穴是廢棄的，這個設施的邪教徒在這個門廳裡製造了一個假象。骨骼殘骸和生鏽的裝備屬於五個早已死去的冒險家，角色們可以識別出他們分別是兩個矮人、一個精靈、一個侏儒和一個提夫林。

english: Traps
zh_tw: 陷阱

english: The gleams in the northern part of the chamber are magical traps placed on fist-size, fake rubies tucked conspicuously next to two skeletons. The fake rubies are fixed to the floor and can't be removed. Any character who touches one of the rubies must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 54 ({@dice 12d8}) lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 房間北面的光芒是魔法陷阱，放置在拳頭大小的假紅寶石上，這些假紅寶石顯眼地安置在兩具骨架旁邊。假紅寶石固定在地板上，無法移除。任何角色觸控其中一個紅寶石時必須進行{@dc 20}的敏捷豁免，若豁免失敗將受到54點（{@dice 12d8}）的閃電傷害，若豁免成功則受到一半的傷害。

english: The traps can't be disabled, but a character who comes within 5 feet of one of the rubies and examines it can make a {@dc 18} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check. On a success, the character deduces that the ruby is fake, worthless, and magically trapped to release a violent electric shock.
zh_tw: 陷阱無法被解除，但當角色靠近至距離紅寶石5尺內並仔細觀察時，可以進行一次{@dc 18}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定。成功時，角色推斷出這塊紅寶石是假的、無價值的，並且被魔法陷阱所束縛，會釋放出強烈的電擊。

english: W2: Lolth Shrine
zh_tw: W2: 羅絲神殿

english: This semicircular chamber forms a natural alcove. Shelves carved into the wall from floor to ceiling hold small, repulsive items, including bloody baubles, shriveled fingers, and idols carved from bone. Two figures crouch before the shelves.
zh_tw: 這個半圓形的房間形成了一個天然的凹室。從地板到天花板雕刻在牆上的架子上擺放著一些小型、令人厭惡的物品，包括血跡斑斑的小飾品、乾癟的手指和用骨頭雕刻的偶像。兩個身影蹲在架子前。

english: Two agents of Lolth have come to pray at this shrine. They are Makubli Khee, a chaotic evil, hobgoblin {@creature assassin}, and Torkner Ironteeth, a chaotic evil, duergar {@creature mage}. Because they're engrossed in their prayers, Makubli and Torkner don't notice the characters unless a member of the party deliberately hails them or the characters have a light source.
zh_tw: 兩位羅絲的代理人來到這個神龕祈禱。他們是馬庫布利·克希，一個混亂邪惡的大地精{@creature assassin||刺客}，和托克納·鐵齒，一個混亂邪惡的灰矮人{@creature mage||魔法師}。因為他們全神貫注於祈禱，馬庫布利和托克納除非隊伍中有成員故意向他們打招呼，或者角色們有光源，否則不會注意到角色們。

english: The items on the shelves are nonmagical. Any character who looks at the ceiling and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check spots a small, spider-shaped carving in the rock—a hint of this shrine's purpose.
zh_tw: 架子上的物品是非魔法的。任何觀察天花板併成功透過 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定的角色會發現岩石中有一個小型的蜘蛛形狀雕刻——這是這個神殿用途的線索。

english: Makubli and Torkner
zh_tw: 馬庫布利和托克納

english: Both Makubli and Torkner operate along the well-traveled route between Menzoberranzan and Blingdenstone, sabotaging supply caravans and generally causing mayhem. They usually kill or convert victims who survive their initial attacks, although Makubli recently turned over custody of a cyclops to the Web's Edge prison (see {@area area W6a|117|x}). Makubli and Torkner dislike each other intensely. Neither knows many other covert Lolth operatives, so clever characters could masquerade as allies (see "{@area Impersonating Worshipers|102|x}" earlier in this chapter).
zh_tw: 馬庫布利和托克納沿著魔索布萊城和布靈登石城之間常走的路線活動，破壞補給商隊，通常製造混亂。他們通常會殺死或轉化那些在初次攻擊中倖存下來的受害者，儘管馬庫布利最近將一個獨眼巨人的監護權交給了蛛網邊緣的監獄（見{@area 區域W6a|117|x}）。馬庫布利和托克納非常不喜歡對方。他們倆都不太瞭解其他秘密的羅絲特工，所以聰明的人物可以偽裝成盟友（見本章前面的"{@area 冒充信徒|102|x}"）。

english: The cultists who maintain Web's Edge are friendly with both agents, making Makubli and Torkner good candidates for the characters to impersonate. If either agent suspects that the characters aren't fellow Lolth operatives, they attack.
zh_tw: 維護蛛網邊緣的邪教徒對特工們都很友好，使得馬庫布利和托克納成為角色們偽裝的好選擇。如果任何一位特工懷疑角色們不是羅絲的同僚，他們會發起攻擊。

english: Makubli Khee
zh_tw: 馬庫布利·克希

english: Torkner Ironteeth
zh_tw: 托克納·鐵齒

english: W3: Summoning Chamber
zh_tw: W3: 召喚室

english: An enormous pentagram drawn in chalk, with stubby unlit candles placed at each of its five points, covers the floor of this open chamber. A hooded figure hunches over a cluttered table in the southwest corner, mumbling profane phrases.
zh_tw: 這個開闊的房間地板上畫著一個巨大的五角星，每個角都放著一支粗短的未點燃的蠟燭。一個戴著兜帽的身影彎腰在西南角的一張雜亂的桌子上，喃喃自語著褻瀆的詞句。

english: Cultists and agents gather here to commune with Lolth's Abyssal servants and occasionally summon Fiends to assist with missions. The figure at the table is Grottenelle Stonecutter, a chaotic evil, svirfneblin {@creature mage} who serves as the facility's high summoner.
zh_tw: 邪教徒與密探聚集於此，與羅絲的深淵僕從交流，有時也會召喚邪魔協助執行任務。桌旁的人是格羅特妮爾·鑿石，一名混亂邪惡的地底侏儒{@creature mage||魔法師}，擔任此地的高階召喚師。

english: Summoning in Progress
zh_tw: 正在進行召喚

english: Grottenelle is in the middle of a summoning ritual. Have Grottenelle and the characters roll initiative. If the characters attack or otherwise interrupt Grottenelle before the start of her first turn, the summoning fails. Otherwise, a {@creature glabrezu} appears in the center of the pentagram at the start of Grottenelle's turn. Grottenelle attacks intruders and commands the glabrezu to do the same if the summoning is successful.
zh_tw: 格羅特妮爾正在進行一個召喚儀式。讓格羅特妮爾和角色們擲先攻。如果角色們在格羅特妮爾的首個回合開始前攻擊或以其他方式打斷她，召喚就會失敗。否則，如果召喚成功，一個{@creature glabrezu||迷誘魔}會在格羅特妮爾回合開始時出現在五角星的中心。格羅特妮爾會攻擊入侵者，並命令迷誘魔做同樣的事情。

english: High Summoner Grottenelle Stonecutter calls on a glabrezu to help with an evil mission the Lolth cultists are planning
zh_tw: 高階召喚師格羅特妮爾·鑿石正在召喚一個迷誘魔，以幫助羅絲邪教徒計劃的邪惡任務。

english: Grottenelle needs the glabrezu to assist in the operation being planned in {@area area W7|123|x}. At your discretion, the noise from a battle might alert the agents in that area, prompting them to investigate.
zh_tw: 格羅特妮爾需要迷誘魔來協助在{@area 區域W7|123|x}計劃的行動。根據您的判斷，戰鬥的噪音可能會提醒那個區域的特工，促使他們進行調查。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Grottenelle's table holds a {@item Spell Scroll} of {@spell Circle of Death}, an ornate {@item +2 Dagger}, and an assortment of unguents and oils worth 500 gp.
zh_tw: 格羅特妮爾的桌子上放著一張{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}，上面寫著{@spell Circle of Death||死亡法陣}，一把精美的{@item +2 Dagger||+2 匕首}，以及一些總價值500金幣的藥膏和油。

english: W4: Corridor
zh_tw: W4: 走廊

english: This corridor is empty. Heavy iron double doors bookend the western and eastern access points.
zh_tw: 這條走廊是空的。沉重的鐵製雙扇門位於西方和東方的入口處。

english: Additionally, if the characters haven't yet explored area W3, read the following aloud:
zh_tw: 此外，如果角色們還沒有探索過W3區域，請大聲朗讀以下內容：

english: From the north, you hear a faint voice mumbling profane phrases.
zh_tw: 你從北方聽到一個微弱的聲音在喃喃自語著褻瀆的詞句。

english: The cultists keep the door to the fodder chamber ({@area area W9|126|x}) closed in case the food intended for Ker-arach in the Sacred Web Hall ({@area area W12|130|x}) tries to escape.
zh_tw: 邪教徒們將飼料室（{@area 區域W9|126|x}）的門保持關閉，以防為聖網大廳（{@area 區域W12|130|x}）中的凱拉赫克準備的食物試圖逃跑。

english: W5: Guardian Chamber
zh_tw: W5: 守衛室

english: An enormous, winged biped with a boar's head paces in front of a barred prison door to the southwest. A ring of keys hangs from a hook on the creature's trident.
zh_tw: 一個巨大的有翼雙足動物，長著野豬的頭，在西南方向的監獄門前來回踱步。一串鑰匙掛在這個生物的三叉戟上的鉤子上。

english: The creature is a {@creature nalfeshnee} named Maaltok, the guardian and keeper of the prison cells (areas W6a–W6d). Sometime in the last few decades, Maaltok switched allegiance from Graz'zt to Lolth. Since he is a recent recruit, Maaltok's yochlol handlers assigned him guard duty, which he performs grudgingly.
zh_tw: 這個生物是一隻名為馬爾托克的{@creature nalfeshnee||判魂魔}，是監獄牢房（區域W6a-W6d）的守衛和看守。在過去幾十年的某個時候，馬爾托克從格拉茲特（格拉茲特）轉而效忠於羅絲（羅絲）。由於他是新近招募的，馬爾托克的蠟融妖管理者分配給他守衛任務，他勉強執行著。

english: Maaltok knows each of the prison cells' inhabitants and doesn't expect infiltrators. If the characters are impersonating devotees of Lolth, Maaltok tells them who's imprisoned in each cell.
zh_tw: 馬爾托克知道每個監獄牢房裡的囚犯，並且不預期會有潛入者。如果角色們偽裝成羅絲的信徒，馬爾托克會告訴他們每個牢房裡關著的是誰。

english: Cell Keys
zh_tw: 牢房鑰匙

english: Maaltok carries keys to each of the cells in the prison (areas W6a–W6d). Stealing Maaltok's key ring without his knowledge requires a successful {@dc 16} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check.
zh_tw: 馬爾托克攜帶著監獄中每個牢房的鑰匙（區域W6a至W6d）。在他不知情的情況下偷走馬爾托克的鑰匙串需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 16} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定。

english: W6: Holding Cells
zh_tw: W6: 拘留室

english: Four jail cells are arrayed along the south wall of this cavern. The first holds a cyclops; the second holds a dead elf; the third holds a bugbear slumped against a bench; and the fourth holds a hunched, gray-skinned figure in robes. A worn chest sits along the room's northwest wall. Leaning next to it is a giant-size club.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴的南牆邊排列著四個牢房。第一個牢房裡關著一個獨眼巨人；第二個牢房裡關著一個死去的精靈；第三個牢房裡關著一個靠在長凳上的地精；第四個牢房裡關著一個彎腰駝背、膚色灰暗、穿著長袍的身影。一個磨損的箱子放在房間的西北牆邊。旁邊靠著一把巨人尺寸的棍棒。

english: The chest contains confiscated weapons and equipment from prisoners kept in the nearby cells. It's locked and requires a {@dc 20} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check using thieves' tools to open.
zh_tw: 這個箱子裡面裝著從附近牢房中的囚犯那裡沒收的武器和裝備。它被鎖上了，需要使用盜賊工具進行一次 {@dc 20} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定來開啟。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Inside the chest are a {@item +1 Dagger} and a {@item +1 Longsword} confiscated from the recently deceased elf prisoner, Fernil, whose body is in {@area area W6b|11b|x}. The giant-size club next to the chest is a {@item +2 Greatclub} that belongs to Gertrude, the cyclops imprisoned in area W6a. The greatclub resizes to serve its wielder.
zh_tw: 箱子裡面有一把從最近去世的精靈囚犯費爾尼爾（費爾尼爾）那裡沒收的{@item +1 Dagger||+1 匕首}和{@item +1 Longsword||+1 長劍}，費爾尼爾的屍體在{@area 區域W6b|11b|x}。箱子旁邊的巨人尺寸的棍棒是一把屬於被關在區域W6a的獨眼巨人格特魯德（格特魯德）的{@item +2 Greatclub||+2 巨棒}。這把巨棍可以根據使用者的大小進行調整。

english: W6a: Holding Cell A
zh_tw: W6a: 拘留室 A

english: A burly cyclops sits on a bench in this jail cell, shackled to the walls by her hands and legs. She holds her head in her hands, looking defeated.
zh_tw: 一個魁梧的獨眼巨人坐在這間牢房的長凳上，她的手腳都被銬在牆上。她雙手抱頭，看起來被打敗了。

english: This jail cell contains a bench and a bucket. The inhabitant is Gertrude, a chaotic neutral {@creature cyclops} who was the lone survivor of an attack on a supply caravan near the ruins of the city of Ched Nasad. Makubli (see {@area area W2|107|x}) captured Gertrude weeks ago and brought her here as a prisoner, hoping she would reveal information about Blingdenstone's interest in Ched Nasad. Gertrude is a caravan guard and has no information the cultists can use; as soon as they realize this, they'll kill Gertrude, and she knows it. Her prized {@item +2 Greatclub} is stashed in the chest in area W6.
zh_tw: 這個牢房裡有一個長凳和一個桶。居住者是格特魯德，一個混亂中立的{@creature cyclops||獨眼巨人}，她是切德納薩德城廢墟附近一個補給商隊遇襲事件的唯一生還者。馬庫布利（見{@area 區域W2|107|x}）幾周前捕獲了格特魯德，並把她作為囚犯帶到這裡，希望她能透露有關布靈登石城對切德納薩德的興趣的資訊。格特魯德是一個商隊護衛，沒有邪教徒可以使用的資訊；一旦他們意識到這一點，他們會殺了格特魯德，她也知道這一點。她珍貴的{@item +2 Greatclub||+2 巨棒}存放在W6區域的箱子裡。

english: Recruiting Gertrude
zh_tw: 招募格特魯德

english: Gertrude hates Lolth and is eager to escape Web's Edge. If she realizes the characters are infiltrators, she begs them to free her. In exchange for her freedom, Gertrude offers to help the characters, including giving them her greatclub from the chest in area W6.
zh_tw: 格特魯德憎恨羅絲，並且渴望逃離蛛網邊緣。如果她意識到角色們是潛入者，她會懇求他們釋放她。作為自由的交換，格特魯德願意幫助角色們，包括把她在區域W6箱子裡的大棒給他們。

english: Gertrude's Secret
zh_tw: 格特魯德的秘密

english: Even if the characters free her, Gertrude remains despondent. If the characters ask her what's wrong, Gertrude reveals that her friend, a svirfneblin named Rockzanna, was involved in a nearby mining operation and discovered that two of the operation's leaders were secret Lolth cultists planning an attack on the operation. Rockzanna was too scared to tell anyone besides Gertrude, and the cyclops fears a terrible fate for the miners.
zh_tw: 即使角色們釋放了她，格特魯德仍然感到絕望。如果角色們問她怎麼了，格特魯德透露她的朋友，一個名叫洛克贊娜的斯維爾芬布靈，在附近的一次採礦行動中發現了兩個行動領導者是秘密的羅絲邪教徒，他們正計劃對這次行動發動攻擊。洛克贊娜太害怕了，除了格特魯德之外，她不敢告訴任何人，而這個獨眼巨人擔心礦工們將面臨可怕的命運。

english: Regardless of the characters' reaction to this revelation, learning it counts for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}. The mining operation is the same one the cultists in {@area area W7|123|x} are discussing.
zh_tw: 無論角色們對這個揭示的反應如何，瞭解它都算作本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則的目的。這個採礦作業與{@area 區域W7|123|x}中的邪教徒正在討論的是同一個。

english: W6b: Holding Cell B
zh_tw: W6b: 拘留室B

english: This jail cell contains a bench and a tattered blanket. The desiccated corpse of an elf lies on the floor.
zh_tw: 這個牢房裡有一個長凳和一條破爛的毯子。一個乾枯的精靈屍體躺在地板上。

english: The body was once an elf named Fernil Orellian, an adventurer and priest of Corellon Larethian. A cloaker in the Underdark injured Fernil and killed his companions. An agent of Lolth came upon Fernil and marched him to Web's Edge, where he died shortly thereafter.
zh_tw: 這具屍體曾是一位名叫費爾尼爾·奧雷利安的精靈，一位冒險家，也是科瑞隆·拉瑞斯安的牧師。在幽暗地域，一名斗篷怪攻擊了費爾尼爾並殺害了他的同伴。羅絲的一名代理人發現了費爾尼爾並將他帶到蛛網邊緣，不久之後他便死在那裡。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Any character who examines the body and succeeds on a {@dc 16} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check notices a vial tucked into the corpse's belt. This is a {@item Potion of Fire Resistance}—the agent of Lolth never noticed it.
zh_tw: 任何檢查屍體的角色，如果成功進行了{@dc 16}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，會注意到屍體腰帶上藏有一個小瓶。這是一瓶{@item Potion of Fire Resistance||火焰抗性藥水}—羅絲的代理人從未注意到它。

english: W6c: Holding Cell C
zh_tw: W6c: 拘留室 C

english: A bugbear with thick eyebrows is slumped on the bench against the wall in this jail cell.
zh_tw: 一個眉毛濃密的地精靠在這個牢房牆壁邊的長凳上。

english: Although she looks like she's sleeping, the bugbear in this cell, Rothgral, is dead. She deserted a band of mercenaries based near Mithral Hall after meeting a persuasive duergar agent of Lolth named Vundren. Vundren brought Rothgral here, but the cultists determined the bugbear didn't have the skills necessary to become a covert Lolth operative. The cultists imprisoned her until they could determine what to do with her, and she died about a day ago due to neglect.
zh_tw: 儘管看起來像是在睡覺，但這個牢房裡的地精羅斯格拉爾已經死了。她在遇到一個有說服力的羅絲灰矮人代理人馮德倫後，離開了一個位於米斯拉爾大廳附近的僱傭兵團隊。馮德倫帶羅斯格拉爾來到這裡，但邪教徒們判斷這個地精沒有成為秘密羅絲特工所需的技能。邪教徒們將她關押起來，直到他們能決定如何處理她，她大約在一天前因被忽視而死亡。

english: W6d: Holding Cell D
zh_tw: W6d: 拘留室D

english: A gray-skinned creature with stringy, black hair and cultist's robes sits hunched in a corner of this cell.
zh_tw: 一個膚色灰暗、頭髮細黑、身穿邪教徒長袍的生物蜷縮在這個牢房的角落裡。

english: This prisoner is Sril Brayspoke, a chaotic evil {@creature grimlock}. Until a week ago, Sril was a cultist in residence at Web's Edge devoted to serving the Spider Queen. However, the bumbling Sril accidentally insulted the yochlol in {@area area W12|130|x}. The powerful Fiend had Sril thrown into jail, and the cultists are considering feeding him to Ker-arach to appease Lolth.
zh_tw: 這名囚犯是斯里爾·佈雷斯普克，一個混亂邪惡的{@creature grimlock||幽邃盲族}。直到一週前，斯里爾還是蛛網邊緣的一名邪教徒，致力於侍奉蜘蛛女王。然而，笨拙的斯里爾不小心冒犯了{@area 區域W12|130|x}中的蠟融妖。這個強大的惡魔讓斯里爾被投入監獄，邪教徒們正在考慮將他餵給凱拉赫克，以安撫羅絲。

english: Recruiting Sril
zh_tw: 招募斯里爾

english: Whether the characters are masquerading as Lolth worshipers or not, Sril begs to join the characters. A character who succeeds on a {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check knows that Sril is still devoted to Lolth and will betray the characters if necessary to return to the cultists' good graces. If Sril is freed and knows the characters are impostors, he reveals their charade as soon as he sees another Lolth devotee.
zh_tw: 無論角色是否偽裝成信仰羅絲的教徒，斯里爾都懇求加入他們的隊伍。成功透過 {@dc 14} 感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定的角色會知道，斯里爾仍然忠於羅絲，並且會在必要時背叛角色以重新獲得邪教徒的信任。如果斯里爾被釋放並且知道角色是冒充者，他會在見到其他羅絲信徒時立即揭穿他們的偽裝。
