english: W7: Meeting Room
zh_tw: W7: 會議室

english: The Lolth cultists are planning an assault on a nearby svirfneblin mining operation
zh_tw: 羅絲的邪教徒們正計劃對附近的斯涅布力採礦作業發起攻擊

english: Relief carvings of spiders in webs decorate this chamber's walls, which are papered over with tactical maps and schematics. Gathered around a paperwork-covered table in the room's center are several cloaked figures as well as a horned, winged devil with a whip on her belt.
zh_tw: 蜘蛛在蛛網上的浮雕裝飾著這個房間的牆壁，牆壁上貼滿了戰術地圖和示意圖。在房間中心的桌子周圍，聚集著幾個披著斗篷的身影以及一個長角、有翅膀的惡魔，她的腰帶上掛著一根鞭子。

english: Jolera Hartoph
zh_tw: 喬勒拉·哈托夫

english: Seven Lolth devotees are meeting in this room to plan an assault on a svirfneblin mining operation located about 20 miles from Web's Edge. The devotees have coordinated with two Lolth operatives embedded in the mining operation. The devotees plan to kidnap the most powerful miners and feed them to Ker-arach in {@area area W12|130|x}. They'll kill any remaining miners who don't worship Lolth.
zh_tw: 七名羅絲的信徒正在這個房間裡策劃對位於蛛網邊緣大約20英里外的斯涅布力採礦作業的襲擊。信徒們已經與潛入採礦作業的兩名羅絲特工協調好了。他們計劃綁架最強大的礦工，並將他們餵給位於{@area 區域W12|130|x}的凱拉赫克。他們將殺死任何不崇拜羅絲的剩餘礦工。

english: The devotees include a chaotic evil, elf {@creature assassin} named Jolera Hartoph; two {@creature Mage||mages} named Bromtok and Shiroktu, who are chaotic evil orcs; two {@creature Grimlock||grimlocks} named Roltharni and Sharlotte, who are chaotic evil; and an {@creature erinyes} named Fernitha.
zh_tw: 信徒中包括一位名為喬勒拉·哈托夫的混亂邪惡的精靈{@creature assassin||刺客}；兩個名為布羅姆托克和希羅克圖的混亂邪惡的獸人{@creature Mage||魔法師}；兩個名為羅薩爾尼和夏洛特的混亂邪惡的{@creature Grimlock||幽邃盲族}；以及一個名為費爾妮莎的{@creature erinyes||罪魔}。

english: Fernitha, Bromtok, and Shiroktu plan to attack the svirfneblin while the deep gnomes rest. If the characters eavesdrop on the planning before they investigate the summoning chamber ({@area area W3|10a|x}), they learn that the high summoner, Grottenelle Stonecutter, is summoning a glabrezu to help with the operation.
zh_tw: 費爾妮莎、布羅姆托克和希羅克圖計劃在地底侏儒休息時攻擊他們。如果角色們在調查召喚室（{@area 區域W3|10a|x}）之前偷聽到計劃，他們會得知高階召喚師格羅特妮爾·鑿石正在召喚一個迷誘魔來協助行動。

english: The Lolth devotees here attack any apparent interlopers. The {@creature glabrezu} summoned in area W3 joins the fight if the characters haven't already defeated the demon (or prevented its summoning).
zh_tw: 這裡的羅絲信徒會攻擊任何明顯的入侵者。如果在區域W3召喚的{@creature glabrezu||迷誘魔}（一種惡魔生物）尚未被角色們擊敗（或阻止其召喚），它將加入戰鬥。

english: W8: Mission Hall
zh_tw: W8: 任務大廳

english: The east end of this hallway holds a secret door that leads into the Sacred Web Hall ({@area area W12|130|x}). A character who examines the wall and succeeds on a {@dc 16} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check finds the door, which serves as an escape for the cultists who attend to Ker-arach when the creature is in a particularly foul mood.
zh_tw: 這個走廊的東端有一扇通往神聖之網大廳（{@area 區域W12|130|x}）的密門。一個角色如果檢查牆壁併成功透過一次 {@dc 16} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，就能發現這扇門，當凱拉赫克處於特別糟糕的情緒時，這扇門會成為照料它的教徒們的逃生通道。

english: W9: Fodder Chamber
zh_tw: W9: 飼料室

english: Peering from this rocky room's center are four large lizards. The pungent smell of raw meat hangs in the air.
zh_tw: 從這個岩石房間的中心窺視的是四隻大型蜥蜴。生肉的刺鼻氣味瀰漫在空氣中。

english: The cultists keep a supply of prey creatures here to feed Ker-arach. Right now, the chamber is occupied by four {@creature Giant Lizard||giant lizards}. The cultists release a lizard into the Sacred Web Hall ({@area area W12|130|x}) whenever Ker-arach is grumpy, providing her with recreation and a meal.
zh_tw: 邪教徒們在這裡存放了一些獵物生物，用來餵養凱拉赫克。目前，這個房間被四隻{@creature Giant Lizard||巨蜥}佔據。每當凱拉赫克不高興時，邪教徒們就會將一隻蜥蜴放入聖蛛大廳（{@area 區域W12|130|x}），為她提供娛樂和食物。

english: Releasing the Lizards
zh_tw: 釋放蜥蜴

english: The cultists recently fed the lizards raw meat from the pantry in area W10, so the creatures are complacent. A character who holds raw meat near a giant lizard can successfully give that lizard simple commands (such as "follow me," "go where I point," or "bite her") for 10 minutes without giving the lizard the meat. If the lizard doesn't get the meat after 10 minutes, it attacks that character.
zh_tw: 邪教徒最近用W10區域的儲藏室裡的生肉餵了這些蜥蜴，所以這些生物現在很溫順。一個角色如果拿著生肉靠近一隻巨型蜥蜴，可以在不給蜥蜴肉的情況下，成功地給那隻蜥蜴下達簡單的指令（比如"跟我來"、"去我指的地方"或"咬她"）持續10分鐘。如果10分鐘後蜥蜴沒有得到肉，它會攻擊那個角色。

english: If either exit is left open, the lizards meander into the complex. If a lizard wanders into {@area area W12|130|x}, Ker-arach has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks and initiative rolls made in relation to the characters, since she is distracted while trying to capture the lizard and cocoon it in the chamber's central web.
zh_tw: 如果任一出口被留開，蜥蜴就會在建築群中漫無目的地遊蕩。如果一隻蜥蜴遊蕩到{@area 區域W12|130|x}，凱拉赫克在與角色相關的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定和先攻骰上會有劣勢，因為她在試圖捕捉蜥蜴並將其包裹在房間中央的蛛網中時會分心。

english: W10: Barrack of the Faithful
zh_tw: W10: 忠誠者營房

english: Five bedrolls, each with a small chest beside it, are tucked into this room. A large desk stands near the east wall. A small room to the south holds a long table with chairs around it.
zh_tw: 這個房間裡放置了五個鋪蓋，每個鋪蓋旁邊都有一個小箱子。東牆附近有一張大桌子。南邊的一個小房間內有一張長桌，周圍擺放著椅子。

english: This meager barrack houses the cultists who live in Web's Edge.
zh_tw: 這個簡陋的兵營是居住在蛛網邊緣的邪教徒的住所。

english: Chests
zh_tw: 寶箱

english: The chests contain the personal belongings of each cultist. Each chest is locked and requires a successful {@dc 18} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check using thieves' tools to open.
zh_tw: 箱子中裝有每個邪教徒的個人物品。每個箱子都上了鎖，需要使用盜賊工具進行一次成功的 {@dc 18} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定才能開啟。

english: Each chest contains a ceremonial holy symbol of Lolth worth 50 gp. The chest near the bedroll closest to the entrance also contains two {@item Potion of Superior Healing||Potions of Healing (superior)}. The chest near the southernmost bedroll contains a {@item Gem of Seeing}.
zh_tw: 每個箱子裡都裝有一個價值50金幣的羅絲儀式聖徽。靠近入口處最近床鋪的箱子裡還有兩瓶{@item Gem of Seeing||真視寶石}。最南邊床鋪附近的箱子裡裝有一顆{@item Potion of Superior Healing||治療藥水（強效）}。

english: Desk
zh_tw: 書桌

english: A {@spell Detect Magic} spell reveals an aura of conjuration magic around the desk, which bears a magical trap. Any character who touches the desk releases a swarm of spiders and must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 20 ({@dice 8d4}) poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The trap triggers once, after which the spiders disappear and the desk becomes nonmagical. Casting {@spell Dispel Magic} on the desk removes the trap.
zh_tw: 一個{@spell Detect Magic||偵測魔法}法術會揭示桌子周圍環繞著一股咒法魔法的靈光，這表明桌子帶有一個魔法陷阱。任何觸碰桌子的角色會釋放出一群蜘蛛，並且必須進行一次{@dc 18}敏捷豁免，豁免失敗則受到20點（{@dice 8d4}）毒素傷害，豁免成功則只受到一半傷害。陷阱只會觸發一次，之後蜘蛛會消失，桌子也會變為無魔法狀態。對桌子施放{@spell Dispel Magic||解除魔法}可以移除陷阱。

english: The desk contains notes about covert missions the Lolth worshipers are planning in the next few months. Additionally, it contains gold- and gem-encrusted, spider-shaped knickknacks worth 500 gp total.
zh_tw: 這張桌子上有關於羅絲崇拜者在接下來的幾個月裡計劃的秘密任務的筆記。此外，它還包含了總價值500金幣的鑲有金子和寶石、形狀像蜘蛛的小裝飾品。

english: Dining Area
zh_tw: 用餐區

english: The resident cultists eat and store their food in the room to the south. Characters who search the room find boxes of dried meat and other shelf-stable provisions. An ice box in the southeast corner is full of raw meat, which the characters can use to command the giant lizards in area W9.
zh_tw: 居住的邪教徒在南方的房間裡吃飯和儲存食物。搜尋房間的角色發現了裝有乾肉和其他耐儲存食品的箱子。東南角的冰箱裡面裝滿了生肉，角色們可以用這些生肉來指揮區域W9中的巨型蜥蜴。

english: W11: Passageway
zh_tw: W11: 通道

english: At the east end of this hallway is an enormous pile of bones.
zh_tw: 在這條走廊的東端是一堆巨大的骨頭。

english: The bones are remnants of meals eaten by Ker-arach, the spiderdragon in area W12.
zh_tw: 這些骨頭是凱拉赫克，即W12區域的蜘蛛龍所吃食物的殘餘。

english: W12: Sacred Web Hall
zh_tw: W12: 聖網大廳

english: An enormous web stretches across this open cavern's center, its strands plastered over stalagmites and stalactites. Crawling on the web is a gigantic reptilian creature with eight legs. Near that creature stands a smaller, one-eyed creature with a body that resembles melting wax.
zh_tw: 一個巨大的蜘蛛網橫跨在這個開放洞穴的中心，它的絲線覆蓋在石筍和石鐘乳上。在蜘蛛網上爬行的是一個巨大的爬行動物，有八條腿。在那個生物附近站著一個較小的，一隻眼睛的生物，它的身體看起來像融化的蠟。

english: This cavern's ceilings are 50 feet tall. The cavern is the lair of Ker-arach, the {@creature spiderdragon|VEoR} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}). Ker-arach crawled into this cavern through a temporary rift to the Abyss that opened during a ritual conducted here about half a year ago. Ker-arach brought with her a piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, which she uses to answer questions posed directly to the Spider Queen. Ker-arach is essentially a tourist attraction for the few Lolth devotees who know she exists. The cultists consider her a sign of Lolth's favor, even though she eats hundreds of pounds of meat every few days and doesn't otherwise contribute to the complex.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴的天花板高50尺。洞穴是凱拉赫克的巢穴，即{@creature spiderdragon|VEoR|蜘蛛龍}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）。大約半年前，在一個儀式中，一個通往無底深淵的臨時裂縫開啟，凱拉赫克透過這個裂縫爬進了這個洞穴。凱拉赫克帶來了{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的一部分，她用它來回答直接向蜘蛛王提出的問題。對於少數知道她存在的羅絲信徒來說，凱拉赫克本質上是一個旅遊景點。邪教徒們認為她是羅絲青睞的標誌，儘管她每隔幾天就要吃掉數百磅的肉，而且對建築群沒有其他貢獻。

english: A piece of the Rod of Seven Parts
zh_tw: 七碎片之杖的一部分

english: Standing near Ker-arach is a {@creature yochlol} named Ylellith, which the cultists recently summoned to help with a mission. When the creatures see the characters and realize the characters are enemies, they attack and fight to the death.
zh_tw: 站在凱拉赫克附近的是一個名叫伊勒莉絲的{@creature yochlol||蠟融妖}，邪教徒最近召喚了它來協助執行任務。當這些生物看到角色並意識到角色是敵人時，它們會攻擊並戰鬥至死。

english: Ker-arach's Web
zh_tw: 凱拉赫克的網

english: The web in the center of the cavern is made of ultra-strong, ultra-sticky strands of Ker-arach's silk. Additionally, Ker-arach has spun other, smaller webs throughout the area. The webs are {@book difficult terrain|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}. Any creature that enters the webbing for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or it becomes stuck and has the {@condition restrained} condition. As an action, a creature can try to pull itself or another creature within its reach from the webbing, doing so with a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. A creature freed in this way is no longer restrained by the webbing.
zh_tw: 洞穴中心的蛛網是由凱拉赫克絲的超強、超粘的蛛絲製成的。此外，凱拉赫克絲還在整個區域內編織了其他較小的蛛網。這些蛛網是{@book 困難地形|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}。任何生物在一個回合中首次進入蛛網或在其回合結束時停留在蛛網中，必須成功透過一個{@dc 12}的力量豁免檢定，否則將被困住並處於{@condition restrained||束縛}狀態。作為一個動作，一個生物可以嘗試將自己或另一個在其觸及範圍內的生物從蛛網中拉出，這需要透過一個成功的{@dc 15}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。以這種方式被解救的生物不再受到蛛網的束縛。

english: The webs are flammable. Any 5-foot cube of webs exposed to fire burns away, dealing 5 ({@dice 2d4}) fire damage to any creature in that area.
zh_tw: 這些蛛網是易燃的。任何暴露在火焰下的5尺立方體的蛛網都會燃燒掉，並對那個區域內的任何生物造成5（{@dice 2d4}）點火焰傷害。

english: Retrieving the Rod Piece
zh_tw: 取回權杖部件

english: The {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|first piece} of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} is wrapped tightly in silk at the center of this cavern's web. Characters who have {@sense darkvision} or a light source can see the rod piece from up to 30 feet away. A character within reach of the rod piece can use a sharp tool to cut it free of the web as an action. For more about the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, see this book's {@area introduction|00e|x}.
zh_tw: {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|第一部分}（來自{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}）被緊緊地包裹在絲綢中，位於這個洞穴蛛網的中心。擁有{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}或光源的角色可以在30尺外看到權杖的這部分。一個角色在權杖部分的範圍內可以使用鋒利的工具將其從蛛網中割下，這需要一個動作。有關{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的更多資訊，請參閱本書的{@area 簡介|00e|x}。

english: Next Steps
zh_tw: 下一步

english: The spiderdragon Ker-arach and the yochlol Ylellith use a piece of the Rod of Seven Parts to communicate directly with the demon-god Lolth
zh_tw: 蜘蛛龍凱拉赫克和蠟融妖（一種惡魔形態）伊勒莉絲使用七碎片之杖的一部分與惡魔神羅絲直接溝通。

english: Once the characters have acquired the first piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, they can return to Sigil through the portal that remains open outside Web's Edge. At this point, the characters will likely want to rest, confer with their allies in Sigil, and see where this first rod piece points them to go next.
zh_tw: 一旦角色們獲得了{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第一塊碎片，他們就可以透過蛛網邊緣外保持開啟的傳送門返回法印城。此時，角色們可能想要休息，與法印城的盟友商議，並檢視這第一塊法杖碎片指向他們接下來要去的地方。

english: When the characters return to the sanctum, Malaina is there (see "{@area The Sigil Sanctum|0cb|x}" earlier in this chapter for more details). Malaina offers to help however she can, including seeking information outside of Sigil or retrieving specific magic items the characters might want.
zh_tw: 當角色們返回聖所時，瑪萊娜在那裡（詳見本章前面的'{@area 法印城聖所|0cb|x}'以獲取更多詳情）。瑪萊娜提供幫助，包括在法印城之外尋找資訊或取回角色可能需要的特定魔法物品。

english: Once the characters have concluded their business in the sanctum, they can begin their quest for the location of the second rod piece, as described in the next chapter.
zh_tw: 一旦角色們在聖所完成了他們的事務，他們就可以開始尋找第二章描述的第二根魔杖部件的位置的任務。

english: Chapter 3: The Lambent Zenith's Last Voyage
zh_tw: 第3章：輝耀天頂號的最後航行

english: The spelljamming ship Lambent Zenith was carrying a piece of the rod before the ship crashed in the Astral Sea
zh_tw: 法術船輝耀天頂號在船隻在星界海墜毀之前攜帶著法杖的一部分

english: The hunt for the second piece of the Rod of Seven Parts brings the characters to the starry void of the Astral Plane. Within its silvery depths, alien predators lurk in silence and fallen gods lie in stasis. Adventurers known across the multiverse as spelljammers gallivant through space in ships powered by magic.
zh_tw: 尋找七碎片之杖的第二塊碎片將角色們帶到了星界位面的星空虛空中。在其銀色的深處，外星捕食者在寂靜中潛伏，墮落的神祇處於停滯狀態。被稱為魔法船駕駛員的冒險家們在多元宇宙中穿梭，他們的船隻由魔法驅動。

english: In this chapter, the characters search the Astral Sea for the second rod piece. The characters need to explore the wreckage of a spelljamming ship called the {@i Lambent Zenith}, then retrieve the rod piece from a dragon-like creature that guards it inside the heart of a fallen god.
zh_tw: 在這一章中，角色們在星界海中尋找第二件魔杖部件。角色們需要探索一艘名為{@i 輝耀天頂號}的魔法船的殘骸，然後從一個守衛在隕落神明心臟內的類似龍的生物那裡取回魔杖部件。

english: Running the Adventure
zh_tw: 運作冒險

english: This chapter begins after the characters retrieve the first piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}. A character who holds that piece knows instinctively that the next piece is in the part of the Astral Plane called the Astral Sea. As Mordenkainen previously explained, the portal in the Sigil sanctum leads to the general area of the rod piece the characters seek.
zh_tw: 本章開始於角色們取回第一部分的{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}之後。持有那部分權杖的角色本能地知道下一部分位於稱為星界海的星界部分。正如魔鄧肯之前解釋的，法印城聖所中的傳送門通向角色們尋找的權杖部件的大致區域。

english: Features of the Astral Sea
zh_tw: 星界海的特徵

english: In the Astral Sea, time is meaningless, and creatures can survive there indefinitely without food or drink.
zh_tw: 在星界海中，時間沒有意義，生物可以無限期地在那裡生存，無需食物或飲水。

english: The locations explored within this chapter are a small fraction of what can be found in the Astral Sea. As such, the guidance here focuses on information relevant to the chapter's contents.
zh_tw: 本章探索的地點是星界海中可發現的一小部分。因此，這裡的指導側重於與本章內容相關的資訊。

english: Air
zh_tw: 氣

english: The Astral Plane contains breathable, comfortable air. Unless otherwise stated, creatures can breathe normally.
zh_tw: 星界包含可呼吸的、舒適的空氣。除非另有說明，生物可以正常呼吸。

english: Gravity
zh_tw: 重力

english: The characters are in an area of normal gravity during this chapter.
zh_tw: 在這一章中，角色們處於正常重力的區域。

english: Movement
zh_tw: 移動

english: Though many creatures use spelljamming ships or other vessels to traverse the Astral Sea, a vehicle isn't required. In the Astral Sea, a traveler can propel themself by thought alone. A creature can move in any direction at a flying speed in feet equal to 5 × its Intelligence score.
zh_tw: 儘管許多生物使用法術船或其他船隻穿越星界海，但並不需要交通工具。在星界海中，旅行者可以僅憑思想推動自己前進。一個生物可以在任何方向上以等於其智力得分乘以5的飛行速度移動。

english: Character Advancement
zh_tw: 角色升級

english: The characters should be 12th level when this chapter begins. The characters gain a level after they retrieve the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|second piece} of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} from the hertilod.
zh_tw: 角色在本章開始時應為12級。在角色從赫蒂洛德處獲得{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|第二件部件}（{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的一部分）後，他們將提升一個等級。

english: Power of Secrets
zh_tw: 秘密的力量

english: The characters can learn two secrets in this chapter that are applicable to the rules in "{@area The Power of Secrets|028|x}" section in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}:
zh_tw: 角色們可以在這一章中學到兩個秘密，這兩個秘密適用於本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中的"{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}"部分的規則：

english: Figaro's Secret
zh_tw: 費加羅的秘密

english: Figaro, the tiefling first mate of the Lambent Zenith, knew about the dangers of the portion of the Astral Sea the ship was passing through but deliberately hid this information from the captain. The characters can learn his secret in {@area area Z8|164|x} of the ship's wreckage.
zh_tw: 菲加羅，輝耀天頂號號的提夫林大副，知道船隻正在穿越的星界海部分的危險，但故意向船長隱瞞了這些資訊。角色們可以在船隻殘骸的{@area 區域Z8|164|x}中得知他的秘密。

english: Ikasa's Secret
zh_tw: 伊卡莎的秘密

english: The blink dog Ikasa knows about another survivor of the pirate attack that stranded him and his best friend, the elf Daveras. The characters can learn this secret in {@area area Z12|173|x} of the ship's wreckage.
zh_tw: 眨眼狗伊卡莎知道另一名海盜襲擊的生還者，這次襲擊使他和他的好朋友，精靈達維拉斯被困。角色們可以在船隻殘骸的{@area 區域Z12|173|x}區域瞭解到這個秘密。

english: Second Rod Piece
zh_tw: 第二權杖部件

english: The second piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} is inside the hertilod in {@area area A2|192|x} in the "{@area Heart of Havock|18c|x}" section later in this chapter. For more information about the rod and the spell this piece allows its wielder to cast, see this book's {@area introduction|00e|x}.
zh_tw: {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第二塊碎片位於本章後面"{@area 浩劫之心|18c|x}"部分中{@area 區域A2|192|x}的赫蒂洛德內部。有關該法杖及其碎片允許持有者施放的法術的更多資訊，請參見本書的{@area 簡介|00e|x}。

english: A Doorway to Space
zh_tw: 通往太空的門戶

english: When the characters are ready to continue their adventure, they can step through the portal in the Sigil sanctum and emerge on the Astral Plane in the Astral Sea. Like with the first rod piece, the portal opens near where the second piece is located, but it's up to the characters to find exactly where the piece is ensconced.
zh_tw: 當角色們準備好繼續他們的冒險時，他們可以透過法印城聖所中的傳送門進入星界位面，在星界海中出現。像第一件魔杖部件一樣，傳送門在第二件部件附近開啟，但確切地找到部件所在的位置則取決於角色們。

english: The Astral Plane
zh_tw: 星光位面

english: By researching in the Sigil sanctum or talking with the wizards, the characters can learn the following information about the Astral Plane and the Astral Sea:
zh_tw: 透過在法印城聖所進行研究或與法師交談，角色們可以瞭解到以下關於星界和星界海的資訊：

english: Planar Nature
zh_tw: 位面本質

english: The Astral Sea is in the Astral Plane, which is colloquially known as the realm of thought and dream. Creatures can propel themselves through the plane by merely thinking about moving in a specific direction. Creatures can also traverse the Astral Plane using vessels called spelljamming ships.
zh_tw: 星界海位於星界，俗稱為思想和夢境的領域。生物只需透過思考朝特定方向移動，就能推動自己在該平面上前進。生物還可以使用稱為法術船的船隻穿越星界。

english: Dead Gods
zh_tw: 神屍

english: Scattered throughout the Astral Sea are the remains of dead and dying gods who are here either because they were forgotten by their worshipers or slain at the hands of more powerful entities.
zh_tw: 星界海中散佈著死去和垂死的神的殘骸，他們之所以在這裡，要麼是因為他們被信徒遺忘，要麼是被更強大的實體所殺害。

english: If the characters ask about the location the rod piece points to, Alustriel determines that the dying god Havock is near the piece.
zh_tw: 如果角色們詢問魔杖部件指向的位置，艾拉斯卓確定垂死的神哈沃克（哈沃克）就在部件附近。

english: Havock
zh_tw: 哈沃克

english: Havock's petrified form is hundreds of miles long and weighs thousands of tons. It once had eight legs and two heads that each held a single, unblinking eye, but as Havock lost worshipers and power over millennia, its legs and heads snapped off, destined to drift forever in the Astral Sea.
zh_tw: 哈沃克石化的形態長達數百英里，重達數千噸。它曾經有八條腿和兩個頭，每個頭上都有一隻不眨的眼睛，但隨著哈沃克在數千年中失去了信徒和力量，它的腿和頭斷裂開來，註定要在星界海中永遠漂流。

english: Timelessness
zh_tw: 永恆之境

english: Time has no meaning on the Astral Plane. Creatures on the Astral Plane don't age or experience hunger or thirst.
zh_tw: 在星界層面上，時間沒有意義。星界上的生物不會老化，也不會經歷飢餓或口渴。

english: Into the Astral Sea
zh_tw: 進入星界海

english: The Astral Sea is home to many terrifying predators, including star anglers
zh_tw: 星界海是許多可怕的捕食者的家園，包括星界垂釣者

english: When the characters step through the portal to the Astral Sea to pursue the second rod piece, read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 當角色們透過傳送門進入星界海以追尋第二權杖部件時，請閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: You step through the doorway and enter a silver-clouded void. Lucent wisps of white and gray fog swirl in the distance among pinpricks of starlight. For a split second, you have no sense of direction. Then, you start plummeting. The silver clouds shift, and you see that you're falling toward a colossal, misshapen mass.
zh_tw: 你穿過門道，進入一個銀色雲霧的虛空。明亮的白色和灰色霧氣在遠處的星光中旋渦。一瞬間，你失去了方向感。然後，你開始下墜。銀色的雲彩變換，你看到你正朝著一個巨大的畸形質量墜落。

english: The characters emerge from a free-floating doorway on the Astral Plane. On passing through, the characters are subject to the gravity field that extends from the stony mass they're falling toward: the petrified body of a dying god called Havock. The characters can immediately propel themselves using their thoughts as described in the "{@area Movement|13a|x}" section earlier in this chapter.
zh_tw: 角色們從一個在星界位面上自由漂浮的門道中出現。穿過時，角色們受到來自他們正下落的石質質量體的重力場影響：這是一個被稱為哈沃克的垂死神明的石化身體。角色們可以立即使用他們的思想來推動自己，如本章前面"{@area 移動|13a|x}"部分所描述。

english: The character holding the rod piece divines that the next rod piece is located within the stony mass. The doorway is anchored approximately 1 mile from the mass's surface.
zh_tw: 持有權杖部件的角色透過神諭得知下一個權杖部件位於石質質量內部。傳送門固定在距離該質量表面大約1英里的位置。

english: Stalkers in the Stars
zh_tw: 星際追蹤者

english: As the characters move toward the mass, something follows them. Read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 當角色們向那個質量體移動時，有些東西跟隨著他們。閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: Amid the clouds, two large globes of light bob toward you.
zh_tw: 在雲層中，兩個巨大的光球向你飄來。

english: Characters can make a {@dc 18} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. On a successful check, a character notices a large, anglerfish-shaped outline following each bobbing light—two hungry {@creature Star Angler|VEoR|star anglers} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) are stalking the party. The star anglers attack immediately.
zh_tw: 角色可以進行一次 {@dc 18} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定。檢定成功後，角色會注意到一個巨大的、鮟鱇魚形狀的輪廓跟隨著每一個浮動的燈光——兩隻飢餓的 {@creature Star Angler|VEoR|星辰釣者}（參見 {@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）正在跟蹤隊伍。星鮟鱇立即發起攻擊。

english: Once the star anglers are dispatched, the characters can continue on to the surface of the dying god, where the wreckage of the {@i Lambent Zenith} lies.
zh_tw: 一旦星漁者被消滅，角色們可以繼續前往垂死之神的表面，那裡是{@i 輝耀天頂號}的殘骸所在地。

english: Wreck of the Lambent Zenith
zh_tw: 輝耀天頂號號的殘骸

english: With its navy-blue hull and golden gossamer sails, the spelljamming galleon {@i Lambent Zenith} once cut an elegant silhouette through the Astral Sea's silver clouds. Its captain, the deva {@creature Inda Malayuri|VEoR}, was an arcanist and emissary tasked with guiding the lost and bringing peace to tumultuous worlds. During a voyage, Inda uncovered a piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}.
zh_tw: 這艘擁有海軍藍船體和金色薄紗帆的法驅帆船{@i 輝耀天頂號}曾在星界海的銀色雲層中劃出優雅的剪影。它的船長——天神使徒{@creature Inda Malayuri|VEoR|印達·馬來由}是位奧術師兼密使，肩負著指引失落者併為動盪世界帶來和平的使命。在一次航行中，印達發現了{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的碎片。

english: Using her extensive arcane knowledge, Inda harnessed the magic within the rod piece to augment the {@i Lambent Zenith}, allowing the ship to travel to the farthest corners of the multiverse in the blink of an eye.
zh_tw: 印達利用她豐富的奧術知識，駕馭了法杖部分內的魔法來增強{@i 輝耀天頂號}，使這艘船能夠在瞬間到達多元宇宙最遠的角落。

english: But the {@i Lambent Zenith}'s expedition screeched to a halt when it encountered a dying god of chaos named Havock drifting through the Astral Sea. The latent chaos magic around Havock twisted the ship's capabilities; the {@i Lambent Zenith} was ripped asunder, and its prow plunged into Havock's heart.
zh_tw: 但是當{@i 輝耀天頂號}號探險船遇到一位名為哈沃克的瀕死混沌之神在星界海中漂流時，它的探險戛然而止。哈沃克周圍的潛伏混沌魔法扭曲了這艘船的能力；{@i 輝耀天頂號}號被撕裂，其船首刺入了哈沃克的心臟。

english: When the characters approach Havock and the wreckage (shown on {@adventure map 3.1|VEoR|3|Map 3.1: Lambent Zenith}), read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 當角色們接近哈沃克和殘骸（如{@adventure 地圖 3.1|VEoR|3|Map 3.1: Lambent Zenith}所示）時，請閱讀或改述以下內容：

english: The stony mass isn't a planet or an asteroid, but a colossal creature that appears lifeless. Shattered ribs arch over the creature's mossy spine, and the air crackles with decaying magic.
zh_tw: 這個石質質量體不是行星或小行星，而是一隻看似無生命的龐大生物。破碎的肋骨橫跨在生物長滿苔蘚的脊椎之上，空氣中瀰漫著腐敗的魔法氣息。

english: Among the bones is the shipwreck of a large galleon broken into three large chunks: the sterncastle, nestled in the corpse's hip bones; the starboard section, embedded in the ribcage; and the prow, stabbed into the creature's heart.
zh_tw: 在骨骼之間是一艘大型蓋倫船的殘骸，它被分成了三個大塊：船尾樓，嵌在屍體的髖骨中；右舷部分，嵌入胸腔；以及船頭，刺入生物的心臟。

english: The {@i Lambent Zenith} broke into three distinct pieces: the stern segment, the starboard segment, and the prow segment. On their initial approach, the characters are closest to the stern segment and {@area area Z1|14f|x}, but they can approach the segments in whichever order they like.
zh_tw: {@i 輝耀天頂號}分裂成了三個不同的部分：船尾部分、右舷部分和船首部分。在初次接近時，角色們最接近船尾部分和{@area 區域Z1|14f|x}，但他們可以按任何順序接近這些部分。

english: The character holding the rod piece senses that the next piece is located somewhere in the ship's wreckage.
zh_tw: 持有魔杖部件的角色感覺到下一件部件位於船隻殘骸中的某個地方。

english: Accessing the Rod Piece
zh_tw: 獲取權杖部件

english: The rod piece was stored in a safe room in the {@i Lambent Zenith}'s prow ({@area area Z19|189|x}). When the ship crashed, the safe room's security wards activated, and the room's doors sealed magically. To access the safe room and uncover the rod piece, the characters must first deactivate the security wards.
zh_tw: 法杖的一部分被儲存在{@i 輝耀天頂號}船首的一個安全房間裡（{@area 區域Z19|189|x}）。當船墜毀時，安全房間的防護法術被啟用，房間的門被魔法密封。要進入安全房間並揭開法杖的部分，角色們首先必須停用防護法術。

english: Ward Runes
zh_tw: 防護符文

english: The security wards are powered by two magical runes: one in {@area area Z8|164|x} and one in {@area area Z13|177|x}. The runes are invisible. If a creature can see invisible objects, each rune looks like a stylized carving of a crescent moon pulsing with silver light. Casting {@spell Dispel Magic} ({@dc 17}) on a rune destroys it. A rune can also be deactivated if a creature within 5 feet of it says, "The moon sings a song for the lost."
zh_tw: 安全防護由兩個魔法符文提供能量：一個位於 {@area 區域Z8|164|x}，另一個位於 {@area 區域Z13|177|x}。符文是不可見的。如果一個生物可以看到隱形物體，每個符文看起來都像一個風格化的新月雕刻，脈動著銀色光芒。對符文施放 {@spell Dispel Magic||解除魔法}（{@dc 17}）會摧毀它。如果一個生物在符文5尺範圍內說出"月亮為迷失者唱響一曲。"，符文也會被停用。

english: Both runes must be either rendered inactive or destroyed for the safe room's door to open. This allows access to the heart of Havock, where the rod piece is located.
zh_tw: 兩個符文必須被同時失效或摧毀，這樣安全房間的門才會開啟。這將允許進入哈沃克的心臟區域，權杖部件就位於那裡。

english: Arcane Portals
zh_tw: 奧術傳送門

english: The crew of the {@i Lambent Zenith} used the magic contained within the rod piece to create portals through which the ship could travel across the multiverse with ease. However, when the {@i Lambent Zenith} approached Havock, the rod's magic mixed with the latent power in Havock's dying body and went awry. This volatile combination now causes teleportation spells and effects to function strangely in the segments of the shipwreck.
zh_tw: {@i 輝耀天頂號}的船員利用權杖碎片中的魔法建立了傳送門，使得這艘船能夠輕鬆穿越多元宇宙。然而，當{@i 輝耀天頂號}接近哈沃克時，權杖的魔法與哈沃克垂死身體中的潛在能量混合，併發生了偏差。這種不穩定的組合現在導致傳送法術和效果在沉船殘骸的部分區域中運作異常。

english: When a creature within a wreck segment casts a spell (or uses a similar magical effect) that would teleport it or another creature, instead of the normal effect, a 5-foot-diameter circular portal appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the casting creature. The portal is a glowing ring filled with opaque mist and remains open for 1 minute.
zh_tw: 當一個生物在殘骸段內施放一個法術（或使用類似的魔法效果），其效果本應是傳送它自己或其他生物時，會出現一個5尺直徑的圓形傳送門，位於施法生物30尺範圍內的未被佔據的空間內。傳送門是一個發光的環，裡面充滿了不透明的霧氣，並且保持開啟狀態1分鐘。

english: When a portal appears, roll on the Portal Exit table to determine where the portal leads. If the result is where the characters already are, roll again. Any creature or object that passes through an open portal appears in a random unoccupied space in the exit location.
zh_tw: 當一個傳送門出現時，在傳送門出口表上擲骰以確定傳送門通向何處。如果結果是角色們已經所在的地方，請再次擲骰。任何透過開放傳送門的生物或物體都會出現出口位置的一個隨機空閒空間。

english: Portal Exit
zh_tw: 傳送門出口

english: d6
zh_tw: d6

english: Exit Location
zh_tw: 出口位置

english: Sterncastle deck (stern segment; {@area area Z1a|14f|x})
zh_tw: 船尾甲板（船尾段；{@area 區域Z1a|14f|x}）

english: Companionway (stern segment; {@area area Z5|15c|x})
zh_tw: 同伴通道（船尾部分；{@area 區域Z5|15c|x}）

english: Starboard top deck (starboard segment; {@area area Z10|16d|x})
zh_tw: 右舷上甲板（右舷段；{@area 區域Z10|16d|x}）

english: Grell nest (starboard segment; {@area area Z11|170|x})
zh_tw: 格雷爾巢穴（右舷部分；{@area 區域Z11|170|x}）

english: Study (starboard segment; {@area area Z13|177|x})
zh_tw: 書房（右舷段；{@area 區域Z13|177|x}）

english: Bridge (prow segment; {@area area Z17|184|x})
zh_tw: 艦橋（船首部分；{@area 區域Z17|184|x}）

english: Traversing Wreck Segments
zh_tw: 穿越殘骸區段

english: Characters can forgo the portals and travel between the wreck segments on their own, either by walking or by flying. The segments are 300 feet from each other.
zh_tw: 角色們可以不透過傳送門，自行在殘骸段之間移動，無論是步行還是飛行。這些殘骸段彼此相距300尺。

english: The areas between the segments contain a multitude of hungry astral predators. The creatures trapped in the segments don't traverse the wreck for this reason. When the characters enter one of these areas, roll on the Random Wreck Encounters table to see what confronts the characters.
zh_tw: 各段之間的區域包含了許多飢餓的星界捕食者。被困在各段中的生物因這個原因不會穿越殘骸。當角色們進入這些區域之一時，在隨機殘骸遭遇表上擲骰，看看是什麼在等待著角色們。

english: Random Wreck Encounters
zh_tw: 隨機殘骸遭遇

english: Creature
zh_tw: 生物

english: Two {@creature Night Scavver|BAM|night scavvers} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12})
zh_tw: 兩隻{@creature Night Scavver|BAM|夜色獨眼印魚}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）

english: One {@creature star angler|VEoR} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12})
zh_tw: 一個{@creature star angler|VEoR|星辰釣者}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）

english: One {@creature cloaker}
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature cloaker||斗篷怪}

english: No encounter
zh_tw: 無事發生

english: Stern Segment
zh_tw: 船尾部分

english: The largest piece of the wreck, the stern segment, is nestled in Havock's hip bones. A handful of stranded shipwreck survivors led by the {@i Lambent Zenith}'s first mate, Figaro, are encamped on this segment.
zh_tw: 殘骸中最大的部分，船尾段，位於哈沃克的髖骨之中。一小群被困的船難生還者在{@i 輝耀天頂號}的大副費加羅的帶領下，在這個殘骸段上紮營。

english: A {@creature death slaad} recently infiltrated the camp, sowing chaos and magically manipulating Figaro's mind. This drove Figaro into a paranoid state, causing him to lock himself in his quarters, where one of the safe room's ward runes is located.
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature death slaad||史拉亡蟾}最近潛入了營地，散播混亂並魔法操控了菲加羅的心智。這使菲加羅陷入了偏執狀態，導致他將自己鎖在住所內，而那裡正是安全室的一個防護符文所在之處。

english: Characters approaching this wreck segment can land on either the sterncastle deck ({@area area Z1a|14f|x}) or in the companionway ({@area area Z5|15c|x}).
zh_tw: 接近這個殘骸段的角色可以降落在船尾甲板（{@area 區域Z1a|14f|x}）或者在船員通道（{@area 區域Z5|15c|x}）。

english: Starboard Segment
zh_tw: 右舷部分

english: The starboard piece of the ship crashed into Havock's ribcage. A small lifeboat also crashed into this area, carrying refugees from a space pirate attack: Daveras, his blink dog companion Ikasa, and a treant named Redbud. Daveras escaped the wreckage and joined the survivor camp on the stern segment. Unknown to Daveras, Ikasa and Redbud also survived and are on the starboard segment.
zh_tw: 船的右舷部分墜入了哈沃克的胸腔。一艘小型救生艇也墜入了這個區域，載著來自太空海盜襲擊的難民：達維拉斯、他的眨眼狗夥伴伊卡莎和一個名叫紫荊的樹精。達維拉斯逃離了殘骸，並加入了船尾部分的生還者營地。達維拉斯不知道，伊卡莎和紫荊也倖存了下來，並且目前在右舷部分。

english: Wreckage blocks off this segment's lower decks from the outside. Characters approaching this segment must land on the starboard segment's section of the top deck ({@area area Z10|16d|x}).
zh_tw: 殘骸阻擋了這個段的下層甲板與外界的通道。接近這個段的角色必須降落在右舷段的上甲板部分（{@area 區域Z10|16d|x}）。

english: Prow Segment
zh_tw: 船首段

english: The wreck of the {@i Lambent Zenith}'s prow impaled the dormant god's heart. The ship's captain, Inda, is here, as is the entrance to the safe room.
zh_tw: {@i 輝耀天頂號}的船首刺穿了沉睡之神的心臟。船長印達在此，安全室的入口也在這裡。

english: Characters approaching this segment can land on either the prow segment's top deck ({@area area Z14a|17b|x}) or the lower deck ({@area area Z17|184|x}).
zh_tw: 接近這個部分的角色可以降落在船首部分的上甲板（{@area 區域Z14a|17b|x}）或下層甲板（{@area 區域Z17|184|x}）。

english: General Features
zh_tw: 通用特徵

english: The areas of the {@i Lambent Zenith}'s wreckage have the following features:
zh_tw: {@i 輝耀天頂號}的殘骸區域具有以下特徵：

english: Gravity
zh_tw: 重力

english: The wreck and the areas around it have normal gravity.
zh_tw: 殘骸及其周圍區域具有正常重力。

english: Lighting
zh_tw: 光照

english: Unless otherwise stated, the ambient silvery glow of the Astral Sea fills the wreck, rendering its areas brightly lit.
zh_tw: 除非另有說明，星界海的周圍銀色光芒充滿了這艘船的殘骸，使其區域明亮照明。

english: Walls, Ceilings, and Floors
zh_tw: 牆壁、天花板和地板

english: The floors and walls of the ship are made from faded blue wood. The ceilings of the ship's lower decks are 10 feet high.
zh_tw: 船的地板和牆壁由褪色的藍色木材製成。船的下層甲板的天花板高10尺。

english: Lambent Zenith Locations
zh_tw: 輝耀天頂號號地點

english: The areas of the wreck are keyed to map 3.1.
zh_tw: 殘骸的區域在地圖3.1上有標註。

english: Map 3.1: Lambent Zenith
zh_tw: 地圖 3.1: 輝耀天頂號號

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Z1a–Z1b: Sterncastle Deck and Below
zh_tw: Z1a–Z1b: 船尾樓甲板及以下

english: Scraps of golden sails dangle from the sterncastle's ruined mast. Two armored githyanki patrol the deck and below, silver swords at their hips.
zh_tw: 金色帆布的碎片懸掛在船尾樓破損的桅杆上。兩名身穿盔甲的吉斯洋基巡邏在甲板和下方，銀色的劍掛在他們的腰間。

english: Two lawful neutral {@creature Githyanki Knight||githyanki knights} named Lysan and Zastra, who served as bosuns on the {@i Lambent Zenith}, keep watch here. Characters who want to avoid the githyanki must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check. The knights notice characters who fail the check, beckoning them to approach and state their business.
zh_tw: 兩名守序中立的 {@creature Githyanki Knight||吉斯洋基騎士} 莉珊和扎斯特拉曾是 {@i 輝耀天頂號} 號的水手長，在這裡站崗。想要避開吉斯洋基的角色必須透過一項 {@dc 15} 敏捷 ({@skill Stealth||隱匿}) 檢定。騎士會注意到檢定失敗的角色，並示意他們上前說明來意。

english: Lysan and Zastra are cautious but friendly. They have a sardonic sense of humor developed after being stranded for so long. If the characters express no hostile intent, the bosuns welcome them to the {@i Lambent Zenith} and call for Ilren, who stepped in as the camp's interim leader when the ship's first mate fell ill. The githyanki explain that they haven't heard from the ship's captain, Inda, who Lysan and Zastra assume either died during the crash or is stranded elsewhere in the wreckage. Lysan and Zastra introduce Ilren to the party.
zh_tw: 萊珊和扎斯特拉謹慎但友好。他們在長時間被困後形成了一種諷刺的幽默感。如果角色們沒有表現出敵意，水手長們會歡迎他們登上{@i 輝耀天頂號}，並叫來伊爾倫，後者在大副生病後擔任了營地的臨時領導者。吉斯洋基人解釋說，他們沒有收到船長印達的訊息，萊珊和扎斯特拉認為她要麼在墜毀中死亡，要麼被困在殘骸中的其他地方。萊珊和扎斯特拉向隊伍介紹了伊爾倫。

english: If the characters are hostile, Lysan and Zastra shout for help and attack the characters. After all combatants have taken a turn, all five sailors in the upper crew quarters ({@area area Z2|153|x}) join the fight.
zh_tw: 如果角色們表現出敵意，萊森和扎斯特拉會呼救並攻擊角色們。在所有戰鬥者都進行了一輪後，上層船員艙（{@area 區域Z2|153|x}）中的五名水手會加入戰鬥。

english: Talking with Lysan and Zastra
zh_tw: 與利桑和扎斯特拉對話

english: Lysan and Zastra know the following information:
zh_tw: 萊森和扎斯特拉知道以下資訊：

english: Last Voyage
zh_tw: 最後的航行

english: The Lambent Zenith was a sailing ship that sought to herald hope, community, and order across the multiverse. But this mission came to an end a few months ago when the ship collided with the body of a dying god.
zh_tw: 輝耀天頂號是一艘傳播希望、社群和秩序的帆船，它的宗旨是在多元宇宙中宣揚這些理念。但是這個使命在幾個月前因為船隻與一個垂死神明的身體相撞而終結。

english: Strange Magic
zh_tw: 奇怪的魔法

english: The ship's prow was outfitted with "fancy magic stuff" beyond the githyanki's understanding. This magic malfunctioned when the ship crashed, and now teleportation magic used within the wreck is warped. Instead of teleporting creatures, the magic instead spawns a portal that leads somewhere else in the wreckage.
zh_tw: 船頭裝備了吉斯洋基無法理解的"花哨魔法物品"。當船隻墜毀時，這些魔法出現了故障，現在在殘骸中使用的傳送魔法被扭曲了。魔法不再傳送生物，而是產生了一個通往殘骸其他地方的傳送門。

english: Terrors of Space
zh_tw: 太空的恐怖

english: The areas beyond the wreck are teeming with hungry astral predators. The survivors are too afraid of these predators to risk traveling between the segments. The camp has also been plagued recently by aberrant monsters such as cloakers, though the survivors don't know why.
zh_tw: 殘骸之外的區域充滿了飢餓的星界捕食者。生還者們太害怕這些捕食者，不敢冒險在各個區段之間旅行。最近，營地也一直受到諸如斗篷怪等異常怪物的困擾，儘管生還者們不知道為什麼。

english: Ilren
zh_tw: 伊爾倫

english: If asked for specifics, Lysan and Zastra share a look before directing the characters to speak with the second mate, Kycera, in the galley ({@area area Z3|155|x}). A character who succeeds on a {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check intuits that the two are uneasy about some of their crewmates. If the characters press the issue, the githyanki pull them aside and admit that the camp's interim leader, Ilren, and the {@i Lambent Zenith}'s first mate, Figaro, would have more information. However, Figaro has been acting paranoid of late and refuses to leave his quarters ({@area area Z8|164|x}).
zh_tw: 如果被問及細節，莉珊和扎斯特會交換一個眼神，然後指示角色去廚房與二副凱瑟拉交談（{@area 區域Z3|155|x}）。一個成功透過 {@dc 14} 感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定的人物會直覺地感覺到這兩人對某些船員感到不安。如果角色繼續追問，吉斯洋基人會把他們拉到一旁，承認營地的臨時領導者伊爾倫和{@i 輝耀天頂號}號的大副菲加羅可能會有更多的資訊。然而，菲加羅最近表現得偏執，並拒絕離開他的房間（{@area 區域Z8|164|x}）。

english: Talking with Ilren
zh_tw: 與伊爾倫交談

english: Ilren appears as a boisterous giff—a bulky individual with a head similar to that of a hippopotamus—wearing a sleek red coat. But Ilren is a disguised {@creature death slaad} who can cast the spell {@spell Modify Memory} (spell save {@dc 15}) once per day. Ilren is the reason the camp suffers Aberration attacks; the death slaad sneakily directs monsters toward the wreck's survivors and revels in the victims' suffering. Ilren also magically modified Figaro's memories and usurped power in the camp.
zh_tw: 伊爾倫（伊爾倫）看起來是一個喧鬧的吉弗人——一個體型魁梧，頭部類似河馬的生物——穿著光滑的紅色外套。但伊爾倫實際上是一個偽裝的{@creature death slaad||史拉亡蟾}，每天可以施放一次{@spell Modify Memory||篡改記憶}法術（法術豁免難度{@dc 15}）。營地遭受異怪襲擊的原因正是伊爾倫；這隻死亡史拉蟾暗中引導怪物襲擊殘骸中的生還者，並從受害者的痛苦中獲得快感。伊爾倫還透過魔法修改了費加羅（菲加羅）的記憶，並篡奪了營地的權力。

english: On meeting the characters, Ilren claims to come from a similar background: the giff is an adventurer with heroic dreams who became stranded on this wreck when his skiff crashed into Havock. Ilren claims that nothing of his skiff remains.
zh_tw: 在遇到角色們時，伊爾倫聲稱他來自一個類似的背景：這位吉夫是一個有英雄夢想的冒險家，當他的小船撞上哈沃克時，他被困在了這艘殘骸上。伊爾倫聲稱他的小船沒有留下任何殘骸。

english: Ilren welcomes the characters to explore the {@i Lambent Zenith}'s wreck and make themselves at home, but a character who succeeds on a {@dc 17} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check intuits that Ilren's jolly demeanor belies a suspicious and cold attitude. If asked about Figaro, Ilren breezily explains that Figaro is recovering from an illness but doesn't elaborate. Ilren adds that he is happy to serve as leader while Figaro is indisposed.
zh_tw: 伊爾倫歡迎角色們探索 {@i 輝耀天頂號} 號殘骸並安頓下來，但成功透過 {@dc 17} 感知（ {@skill Insight||洞悉} ）檢定角色直覺到伊爾倫愉快態度下隱藏著懷疑和冷漠。如果問及菲加羅，伊爾倫輕鬆地解釋菲加羅正在養病但並未詳述。伊爾倫補充說，他很樂意在菲加羅無法履行職責時擔任領導。

english: Ilren doesn't reveal its true form unless attacked.
zh_tw: 伊爾倫除非被攻擊，否則不會顯露其真實形態。

english: Lysan and Zastra are wary of strangers but glad for friendly company
zh_tw: 利桑和扎斯特拉對陌生人保持警惕，但對於友好的陪伴感到高興

english: Z2: Upper Crew Quarters
zh_tw: Z2: 上層船員艙

english: This room is plain yet inviting. Five sailors lounge in cramped bunks and colorful hammocks strung from the ceiling.
zh_tw: 這個房間簡單卻很吸引人。五名水手分別懶洋洋地躺在狹小的雙層床和從天花板懸掛下來的彩色吊床上。

english: Five lawful good sailors from the Upper Planes (use the {@creature veteran} stat block, but the sailors are Celestials instead of Humanoids) are lounging here. The sailors are indifferent to the characters but jump into combat to protect themselves and their fellows.
zh_tw: 來自上層位面的五名守序善良水手（使用{@creature veteran||老兵}的統計資料塊，但這些水手是天界生物而非人型生物）在此休息。這些水手對角色們漠不關心，但會為了保護自己和同伴而投入戰鬥。

english: These sailors were lackeys aboard the {@i Lambent Zenith}. Though they can recount the ship's mission and subsequent crash, these sailors know nothing about the rod piece.
zh_tw: 這些水手是{@i 輝耀天頂號}號上的普通水手。儘管他們能敘述船隻的使命和隨後的墜毀，但這些水手對於魔杖部件一無所知。

english: Z3: Galley and Pantry
zh_tw: Z3: 廚房和食品儲藏室

english: The sound of sizzling and the smell of spices emanate from the galley. A tall orc woman in black leather armor works busily at the stove. A gold tattoo of a crescent moon surrounds her left eye.
zh_tw: 嘶嘶聲和香料的氣味從廚房傳來。一位身穿黑色皮甲的高大獸人女性正在爐邊忙碌地工作。她左眼周圍有一個金色的新月紋身。

english: Kycera Duskstride is the {@i Lambent Zenith}'s second mate and is a chaotic good, orc {@creature assassin}. A former pirate, Kycera saw the error of her ways and joined the {@i Lambent Zenith}'s crew to find redemption. Now she spends her time in the wreck's galley. Though the survivors don't require food in the timeless void of the Astral Sea, Kycera finds that cooking and eating bring the restless survivors comfort.
zh_tw: 凱瑟拉·暮步（凱瑟拉·暮行）是{@i 輝耀天頂號}的二副，也是一位混亂善良的獸人{@creature assassin||刺客}。作為前海盜，凱瑟拉意識到了自己的錯誤，並加入{@i 輝耀天頂號}的船員隊伍，尋求救贖。如今她大部分時間都待在沉船的廚房裡。儘管在星海的永恆虛空中，生還者們並不需要食物，但凱瑟拉發現，烹飪和進食能給焦躁不安的生還者們帶來安慰。

english: Kycera Duskstride
zh_tw: 凱瑟拉·暮行

english: Talking with Kycera
zh_tw: 與凱瑟拉交談

english: Kycera gladly discusses the general history of the Lambent Zenith. However, if asked about the rod piece or the security system, Kycera clams up, suspicious of the characters' motives. A character who succeeds on a {@dc 13} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check assures her of their heroic purpose, at which point Kycera reveals the following information:
zh_tw: 凱瑟拉很樂意討論輝耀天頂號的總體歷史。然而，如果被問及權杖碎片或安全系統，凱瑟拉會閉口不談，對角色們的動機表示懷疑。一個成功透過{@dc 13}魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定的角色能夠讓她確信他們的英雄目標，這時凱瑟拉會透露以下資訊：

english: Precious Cargo
zh_tw: 珍貴貨物

english: The Lambent Zenith carried an extremely rare and powerful magic artifact. As a former pirate, Kycera helped Captain Inda design the security system to protect the artifact.
zh_tw: 輝耀天頂號攜帶了一件極為罕見且強大的魔法神器。作為一名前海盜，凱瑟拉幫助印達船長設計了保護這件神器的安全系統。

english: Safe Room
zh_tw: 安全房間

english: The artifact was stored in a safe room at the front of the ship. During the Lambent Zenith's crash, arcane wards should have sealed the safe room's doors. The safe room is inaccessible while the wards are active.
zh_tw: 這個神器被存放在船前部的安全房間裡。在輝耀天頂號號墜毀期間，奧術防護應該已經封閉了安全房間的門。只要防護還在啟用狀態，安全房間就無法進入。

english: Ward Runes
zh_tw: 防護符文

english: Two runes hidden on the ship power the wards. Kycera knows one rune was placed in the ship's stateroom, but she doesn't remember the second rune's location. She believes that magic or a pass phrase can deactivate the runes. She doesn't know the pass phrase, but the captain would know.
zh_tw: 船上隱藏的兩個符文為結界提供動力。凱瑟拉知道一個符文被放置在船的會客室，但她不記得第二個符文的位置。她相信魔法或者一個口令可以停用這些符文。她不知道口令，但船長會知道。

english: If asked about Figaro, Kycera expresses annoyance at his seclusion; her tone belies a sense of parental concern. If the characters help Figaro and defeat Ilren, Kycera is grateful and provides all the information above willingly.
zh_tw: 如果被問及菲加羅，凱瑟拉對他的隱居表示惱火；她的語氣透露出一種家長式的關切。如果角色們幫助菲加羅並擊敗伊爾倫，凱瑟拉會非常感激，並願意提供上述所有資訊。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Within the pantry are {@dice 2d4} unopened casks of aged wine, each worth 500 gp. Kycera happily allows the characters to take them, as she's concerned about the crew getting too drunk to fend off threats.
zh_tw: 儲藏室裡有{@dice 2d4}個未開封的陳年葡萄酒桶，每個價值500金幣。凱瑟拉很高興地允許角色們拿走它們，因為她擔心船員們喝得太多而無法抵禦威脅。

english: Z4: Mess Hall
zh_tw: Z4: 食堂

english: Empty wooden tables and chairs fill the mess hall. In the corner, an elf man plays a game of cards.
zh_tw: 食堂裡擺滿了空蕩蕩的木桌和椅子。在角落裡，一個精靈男子正在玩紙牌遊戲。

english: Daveras
zh_tw: 達維拉斯

english: The elf is Daveras, a neutral {@creature druid}. Daveras joined the camp after his lifeboat crashed into Havock. The remains of his lifeboat rest on the starboard segment.
zh_tw: 這個精靈是達維拉斯，一箇中立的{@creature druid||德魯伊}（德魯伊）。達維拉斯在救生艇撞上哈沃克後加入了營地。他的救生艇殘骸位於右舷段。

english: If the characters haven't met Ilren already, Ilren is here playing cards with Daveras.
zh_tw: 如果角色們尚未遇見伊爾倫，伊爾倫就在這裡和達維拉斯玩紙牌。

english: Talking with Daveras
zh_tw: 與達維拉斯交談

english: Though gruff, Daveras is friendly. He shares the following information:
zh_tw: 儘管達維拉斯說話粗魯，但他很友好。他分享了以下資訊：

english: Missing Camp Member
zh_tw: 失蹤的營地成員

english: Daveras's usual card partner, a halfling woman named Cirit, hasn't shown up for their games lately. Camp members said Cirit left to scout the other wreck segments, but Daveras seems doubtful. Unknown to Daveras, Cirit is actually in the Lambent Zenith's brig ({@area area Z9|16a|x}).
zh_tw: 達維拉斯的常伴牌友，一位名叫西里特的半身人女性最近沒有來參加他們的遊戲。營地成員說西里特離開去偵察其他殘骸部分了，但達維拉斯似乎對此表示懷疑。達維拉斯並不知道，西里特實際上被關在了輝耀天頂號的禁閉室（{@area 區域Z9|16a|x}）。

english: Paranoid Leader
zh_tw: 偏執的領袖

english: Figaro, the camp's first leader, locked himself in his quarters and refuses to communicate. Daveras tried to talk to him, but Figaro used a magical device to erect an impenetrable barrier around the room.
zh_tw: 菲加羅，營地的第一任領袖，將自己鎖在房間裡並拒絕交流。達維拉斯試圖與他交談，但菲加羅使用了一個魔法裝置在房間周圍建立了一個不可穿透的屏障。

english: Personal History
zh_tw: 個人歷史

english: Daveras wasn't part of the Lambent Zenith's crew. When his spelljamming ship, the Verdant Branch, was attacked by space pirates, he escaped on a lifeboat with his best friend, a {@creature blink dog} named Ikasa, as well as a treant named Redbud, who had grown into the lifeboat's hull. The lifeboat crashed into a different segment of the wreck, and Daveras outran the raiders to get to the camp on the stern segment. He believes no one else survived.
zh_tw: 達維拉斯不是輝耀天頂號號的船員。當他的法術船，翠綠枝條號，在太空海盜的攻擊下，他與他最好的朋友，一隻名叫伊卡莎的{@creature blink dog||閃現犬}，以及一個已經長進救生艇船體的樹精紫荊，一起乘坐救生艇逃生。救生艇撞入了殘骸的不同區段，達維拉斯甩掉了襲擊者，跑到了船尾部分的營地。他相信沒有其他人倖存。

english: If Ilren isn't present, Daveras confides that he noticed Figaro's odd paranoia started shortly after Ilren arrived.
zh_tw: 如果伊爾倫不在場，達維拉斯會私下透露他注意到費加羅奇怪的偏執行為是在伊爾倫到達後不久開始的。

english: If Daveras is reunited with Ikasa (found in {@area area Z12|173|x}), he is elated and happily vouches for the characters when talking to Figaro in area Z5.
zh_tw: 如果達維拉斯與伊卡莎（位於{@area 區域Z12|173|x}）重逢，他會非常高興，並在與菲加羅在區域 Z5 交談時欣然為角色們擔保。

english: Z5: Companionway
zh_tw: Z5: 同伴通道

english: The forward end of this hallway is buried in Havock's flesh. The stern end holds two doors and two stairways leading up, and another door on the port side bears a gilded plaque that reads "Stateroom."
zh_tw: 這個走廊的前部被埋在哈沃克的肉體中。船尾端有兩個門和兩個向上的樓梯，而左舷的另一扇門上有一個鍍金的牌子，上面寫著"會客室"。

english: The port door is locked and leads to a guest stateroom that now serves as Figaro's living quarters. Due to his paranoid state, Figaro uses a {@item Cube of Force} to deter any living matter from entering his room.
zh_tw: 左舷門被鎖住了，通向一個客艙，現在被用作菲加羅的生活區。由於他的偏執狀態，菲加羅使用了一個{@item Cube of Force||力場魔方}來阻止任何生物進入他的房間。

english: A character trying to sneak up to Figaro's locked door must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check to avoid being noticed. An unnoticed character can, as an action, use thieves' tools to try to pick the door's lock, doing so with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check.
zh_tw: 一個試圖悄悄接近菲加羅上鎖房門的人物必須透過一個 {@dc 18} 敏捷 ({@skill Stealth||隱匿}) 檢定以避免被發現。一個未被發現的人物可以作為一個動作，使用盜賊工具嘗試撬開房門的鎖，需成功的 {@dc 20} 敏捷 ({@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}) 檢定。

english: Gaining Figaro's Trust
zh_tw: 獲得菲加羅的信任

english: Figaro deactivates the cube's barrier if he feels he can trust the characters. The barrier allows sound to pass through, meaning that the characters can talk with Figaro. A character talking with Figaro can make a {@dc 25} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check. On a successful check, Figaro trusts the characters, unlocks the door, and permits the characters to enter.
zh_tw: 如果菲加羅覺得他可以信任這些角色，他就會解除立方體的屏障。屏障允許聲音透過，這意味著角色們可以和菲加羅交談。與菲加羅交談的角色可以進行一個 {@dc 25} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定。如果檢定成功，菲加羅會信任這些角色，解鎖門並允許他們進入。

english: By helping the people found throughout the wreck, the party can find individuals who will vouch for them. If two or more individuals vouch for the party, Figaro deactivates the barrier without the characters needing to make a check. If only one individual vouches for the party, a character makes the check with advantage.
zh_tw: 透過幫助遍佈殘骸的各個區域的人，隊伍可以找到願意為他們擔保的人。如果有兩個人或更多人為隊伍擔保，菲加羅會在角色們不需要進行檢定的情況下關閉屏障。如果只有一個人為隊伍擔保，一個角色在進行檢定時會有優勢。

english: Z6: Lower Crew Quarters
zh_tw: Z6: 下層船員艙

english: The bunks and hammocks here are empty, and the walls are covered with colorful pieces of wood, each with something written on it.
zh_tw: 這裡的雙層床和吊床都是空的，牆壁上覆蓋著彩色的木片，每片上面都寫著一些東西。

english: The painted pieces of wood are makeshift remembrance markers, honoring those who died in the {@i Lambent Zenith}'s crash. Each piece of wood has a name scribbled on it with smudged graphite. The survivors long ago burned the deceased's bodies on the ship's decks.
zh_tw: 這些塗漆的木片是臨時的紀念標記，用以紀念在{@i 輝耀天頂號}墜毀中喪生的人。每塊木頭上都用塗汙的石墨草草寫上了一個名字。生還者們早已在船的甲板上焚燒了死者的遺體。

english: Z7: Storage
zh_tw: Z7: 儲藏室

english: Unused rigging and dusty old sails fill this old storage closet.
zh_tw: 這個舊儲藏室裡堆滿了未使用的繩索和佈滿灰塵的舊帆。

english: Characters who have a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 15 or higher hear muffled shouting from below.
zh_tw: 擁有15或更高被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）分數的角色能聽到從下方傳來的沉悶喊叫聲。

english: Secret Entrance
zh_tw: 秘密入口

english: Loose floorboards on the room's port side can be pried up, allowing access to the brig ({@area area Z9|16a|x}). Ilren recently used this passage, then attempted to hide the loose floorboards beneath a canvas tarp. A character who searches the floor and succeeds on a {@dc 12} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check notices the edge of the loose floorboards jutting upward beneath the canvas.
zh_tw: 房間左側的鬆脫地板可以被撬開，通往船上的禁閉室（{@area 區域Z9|16a|x}）。伊爾倫最近使用了這條通道，然後試圖用帆布遮蓋鬆脫的地板。一名角色若搜尋地板並透過了 {@dc 12} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，會注意到帆布下鬆脫地板的邊緣向上翹起。

english: Z8: Stateroom
zh_tw: Z8: 客艙

english: The Lambent Zenith's first mate, Figaro, is experiencing the effects of a Modify Memory spell
zh_tw: 輝耀天頂號號的大副菲加羅，正在經歷一個記憶修改法術的效果

english: The stateroom is simple but elegant. The warm light of the wall sconces bathes the mahogany bookshelves and crimson bedsheets. Sitting on the edge of the bed is a purple-skinned tiefling. He stares blankly at the wall, but his posture is as tense as a wound spring.
zh_tw: 這個會客室簡單而優雅。牆壁上的壁燈溫暖地照耀著桃花心木書架和深紅色的床單。床邊坐著一個紫色皮膚的提夫林。他茫然地盯著牆壁，但他的姿態像緊繃的彈簧一樣緊張。

english: The tiefling is Figaro, a lawful good {@creature mage}. If Figaro allowed the characters into his room willingly or if enough individuals vouch for them, Figaro shakily introduces himself and is willing to talk to the characters. Otherwise, he screams and attacks. Figaro surrenders after he is reduced to half of his hit point maximum, but he still refuses to talk with the characters.
zh_tw: 這個提夫林是菲加羅，一個守序善良的{@creature mage||魔法師}。如果菲加羅願意地讓角色們進入他的房間，或者有足夠的人為他們擔保，菲加羅會顫抖著介紹自己並願意與角色們交談。否則，他會尖叫並攻擊。菲加羅在生命值降至最大值的一半後投降，但他仍然拒絕與角色們交談。

english: Talking with Figaro
zh_tw: 與菲加羅交談

english: If the characters gained Figaro's trust, he answers questions about the Lambent Zenith. He knows the following:
zh_tw: 如果角色們獲得了費加羅的信任，他會回答有關輝耀天頂號的問題。他知道以下資訊：

english: Experiments with the Rod
zh_tw: 權杖實驗

english: The Lambent Zenith harnessed the conjuration magic within a piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} to create portals that allow the ship to quickly traverse the multiverse. The rod piece was stored below the bridge on the ship's prow.
zh_tw: 輝耀天頂號利用了{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}一部分中的召喚魔法來建立傳送門，使船能夠快速穿越多元宇宙。法杖的部分被儲存在船首的艦橋下方。

english: Emergency Security Protocol
zh_tw: 緊急安全協議

english: Knowing that the rod piece shouldn't fall into the wrong hands, the Lambent Zenith's captain installed a security protocol that sealed the rod piece's location in the event of an emergency—such as a crash. As far as Figaro knows, the rod remains in the safe room ({@area area Z19|189|x}), though that area is inaccessible due to the activated safety protocol.
zh_tw: 瞭解到權杖部件不應落入錯誤的人手中，輝耀天頂號的船長安裝了一個安全協議，在緊急情況下——例如墜毀——將會封鎖權杖部件的位置。據菲加羅所知，權杖仍然在安全室（{@area 區域Z19|189|x}）內，但由於啟用了安全協議，該區域目前無法進入。

english: Ward Runes
zh_tw: 防護符文

english: The security protocol is fueled by two runes in different locations aboard the ship. Both runes must be dispelled to access the room that holds the rod piece. Figaro knows the runes are invisible. He also knows one rune is located in this stateroom, on the bed's headboard, while the other is in the ship's study ({@area area Z13|177|x}) on the wall above the desk. He suspects casting {@spell Dispel Magic} on a rune would deactivate it, but the caster needs to see the rune. He also suspects the captain knew another way to deactivate it. If she survived on another segment, the characters could try to reach her to ask; if not, it might be recorded it in her notes.
zh_tw: 安全協議由船上不同位置的兩個符文驅動。要進入存放魔杖部件的房間，必須驅散這兩個符文。費加羅知道這些符文是隱形的。他也知道一個符文位於這個會客室的床頭板上，而另一個則在船的書房（{@area 區域Z13|177|x}）的牆上，位於書桌上方。他懷疑對符文施放{@spell Dispel Magic||解除魔法}可以使其失效，但施法者需要能看到符文。他還懷疑船長知道另一種停用符文的方法。如果她倖存下來在另一個殘骸段，角色們可以嘗試找到她詢問；如果沒有，這些資訊可能記錄在她的筆記中。

english: Mending Figaro's Memories
zh_tw: 修復菲加羅的記憶

english: Ilren used repeated {@spell Modify Memory} spells to manipulate Figaro's mind. A character who studies Figaro's symptoms and succeeds on a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check recognizes Figaro's glassy gaze as a telltale sign of memory-tampering magic. Restoring Figaro's true memories causes Figaro to immediately recall Ilren's deception. If the characters haven't confronted Ilren, Figaro rushes off to face the death slaad.
zh_tw: 伊爾倫多次使用了{@spell Modify Memory||篡改記憶}法術來操控費加羅的心智。一個研究費加羅症狀的角色若成功透過{@dc 20}智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定，便能認出費加羅呆滯的目光是記憶篡改魔法的明顯跡象。恢復費加羅的真實記憶會讓他立即記起伊爾倫的欺騙行為。如果角色們尚未與伊爾倫對峙，費加羅會匆忙前去面對死亡史萊姆。

english: Figaro's Secret
zh_tw: 費加羅的秘密

english: After recovering his memories, Figaro remains agitated even if he confronts Ilren. If the characters ask what's bothering him, Figaro admits he knew about the dangers of this stretch of Astral Sea but didn't warn the captain, since this route was economical and Figaro believed it would be easy for the crew to traverse.
zh_tw: 恢復記憶後，菲加羅仍然感到不安，即使他面對伊爾倫也是如此。如果角色們詢問他的煩惱，菲加羅承認他知道這段星界海的危險，但沒有警告船長，因為這條路線經濟而且菲加羅相信船員們能夠輕鬆穿越。

english: Regardless of the characters' reaction to this revelation, learning it counts as a secret for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
zh_tw: 無論角色們對這個揭示有何反應，瞭解它都算作本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則的秘密。

english: Ward Rune
zh_tw: 防護符文

english: The ward rune is located on the bed's headboard.
zh_tw: 防護符文位於床頭板上。

english: Z9: Brig
zh_tw: Z9: 禁閉室

english: Small cells with thin iron bars line both sides of the center hallway. You hear shouts for help from one of the cells.
zh_tw: 中心走廊兩側排列著帶有細鐵柵的小牢房。你聽到其中一個牢房裡傳來呼救聲。

english: The shouting is coming from a {@creature couatl} named Cirit, currently in the form of a halfling {@creature priest}. Cirit was one of the {@i Lambent Zenith}'s crew members and was present when Ilren infiltrated the survivors' camp.
zh_tw: 喊叫聲來自一位名叫奇裡特（西里特）的{@creature couatl||羽蛇}，目前以半身人{@creature priest||祭司}的形態出現。奇裡特曾是{@i 輝耀天頂號}的船員之一，在伊爾倫（伊爾倫）潛入生還者營地時在場。

english: Cirit saw Ilren's true aberrant form. But when Cirit confronted Ilren about the deception, the death slaad overpowered her. Believing Cirit to be an ordinary halfling spellcaster, Ilren hoped to use her to create a {@creature green slaad} and locked her in the brig instead of killing her. Cirit has been trying to escape since.
zh_tw: 西里特看到了伊爾倫真正的畸變體形態。但當西里特就欺騙之事質問伊爾倫時，死亡史拉蟾（史拉亡蟾）制服了她。伊爾倫認為西里特只是一個普通的半身人施法者，希望利用她來創造一個{@creature green slaad||史拉綠蟾}，於是把她關在禁閉室裡，而不是殺了她。從那以後，西里特一直在試圖逃脫。

english: The door to Cirit's cell is locked. A character can pick the lock with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check using thieves' tools, or a character can wrest open the door with a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 西里特的牢房門被鎖上了。一個角色可以使用盜賊工具透過一個成功的 {@dc 15} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定來撬鎖，或者一個角色可以透過一個成功的 {@dc 15} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定強行開啟門。

english: Talking with Cirit
zh_tw: 與西里特交談

english: On seeing the characters, Cirit is relieved and immediately asks for their assistance. She provides the following information:
zh_tw: 看到角色們，西里特鬆了一口氣，並立即請求他們的幫助。她提供了以下資訊：

english: Ilren's Aberrant Nature
zh_tw: 伊爾倫的畸變本質

english: Cirit saw through Ilren's disguise. She identifies Ilren as a {@creature death slaad}, an Aberration that relishes the suffering of others.
zh_tw: 西里特看穿了伊爾倫的偽裝。她確認伊爾倫是一隻{@creature death slaad||史拉亡蟾}，一種喜歡他人痛苦的異怪。

english: What Happened
zh_tw: 發生了什麼

english: Cirit tried to speak with Figaro about Ilren, but Figaro did nothing; Cirit suspects Ilren magically manipulated Figaro's mind. She then confronted Ilren, but the death slaad overpowered her. She doesn't know why Ilren kept her alive, and she's not keen on finding out why.
zh_tw: 西里特試圖與菲加羅談論伊爾倫，但菲加羅沒有采取任何行動；西里特懷疑伊爾倫用魔法操縱了菲加羅的思想。之後她面對伊爾倫，但死亡史拉蟾（史拉亡蟾）佔了上風。她不知道為什麼伊爾倫讓她活著，並且她也不想知道為什麼。

english: Cirit implores the characters to help her thwart Ilren. If the characters defeat Ilren, Cirit vouches for them when talking with Figaro in {@area area Z5|15c|x}.
zh_tw: 西里特懇求角色們幫助她挫敗伊爾倫。如果角色們擊敗了伊爾倫，西里特會在與菲加羅在{@area 區域Z5|15c|x}交談時為他們擔保。

english: Cirit
zh_tw: 西里特

english: Z10: Starboard Top Deck
zh_tw: Z10: 右舷頂層甲板

english: The deck's flooring here is uneven, with roots woven around the planks. Jutting from the segment's fore is the wreckage of a lifeboat. Atop this smaller wreck is a stout tree with vibrant pink and red blossoms.
zh_tw: 這裡的甲板地面不平整，根鬚在木板間交織。從這段船體的前端突出的是一艘救生艇的殘骸。在這個較小的殘骸上方，是一棵長有鮮豔粉紅和紅色花朵的結實樹木。

english: The tree atop the crashed lifeboat is a treant named Redbud (use the {@creature treant} stat block, but Redbud's movement speed is 0 feet) that joined the crew and grew into the lifeboat to strengthen its hull. The treant nearly died when the boat crashed, but Redbud survived by sending roots into the {@i Lambent Zenith}'s wreck to feed off Havock. Redbud's main purpose now is protecting the blink dog Ikasa (found in area Z11), who remains trapped aboard the lifeboat.
zh_tw: 墜毀救生艇頂部的樹是一個名叫紅芽的樹人（使用{@creature treant||樹人}的屬性表，但紅芽的移動速度為0尺），它加入了船員隊伍並長入救生艇以強化船體。船墜毀時樹人幾乎死亡，但紅芽透過將根扎入{@i 輝耀天頂號}的殘骸中以汲取哈沃克的養分而倖存。紅芽現在的主要目的是保護被困在救生艇上的閃電犬伊卡莎（位於區域Z11）。

english: Interacting with Redbud
zh_tw: 與紫荊樹互動

english: Redbud remains silent and motionless until a creature attempts to enter the segment's lower deck (areas Z11–Z13). Initially, Redbud affably discourages characters from proceeding deeper into the wreck; when pressed, Redbud claims this is to protect them from hungry parasites that have nested below. However, a character who makes a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check intuits that while Redbud is telling the truth about monsters below, the treant has ulterior reasons for keeping the characters away from the lower deck.
zh_tw: 紅芽保持沉默和靜止，直到有生物試圖進入船段的底層甲板（區域 Z11 至 Z13）。最初，紅芽友好地勸阻角色們深入沉船；當被逼迫時，紅芽聲稱這是為了保護他們免受在下方築巢的飢餓寄生蟲的傷害。然而，成功透過 {@dc 13} 感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定的角色會直覺到，雖然紅芽關於下方怪物的說法屬實，但樹人另有意圖，希望讓角色們遠離底層甲板。

english: If the characters question the treant's sincerity, Redbud admits to the deception. Redbud explains that a dear friend is trapped below, and the treant's roots are protecting this friend from being eaten by the monsters nesting on the lower deck. Redbud implores the characters to clear out the nest, allowing the characters to proceed further only if they agree.
zh_tw: 如果角色們質疑樹精的真誠，紫荊承認了欺騙。紫荊解釋說，一個親愛的朋友被困在下面，樹精的根正在保護這位朋友不被下層甲板上築巢的怪物吃掉。紫荊懇求角色們清除巢穴，只有在角色們同意的情況下，才允許他們繼續前進。

english: A treant named Redbud lives in a lifeboat that crashed into the Lambent Zenith
zh_tw: 一個名叫紫荊的樹精居住在一艘撞入輝耀天頂號的救生艇中

english: Z11: Grell Nest
zh_tw: Z11: 觸鬚怪巢穴

english: Thick, pale roots here form two dense walls on either side of the room. Six bulbous, brain-shaped creatures with snapping beaks and barbed tentacles bob through the air.
zh_tw: 這裡濃密的、蒼白的根形成了房間兩側的兩堵密集的牆。六個球根狀的、形狀像大腦的生物，有著咬合的喙和帶刺的觸手在空中擺動。

english: Six {@creature Grell||grells} have made their home here, feeding off hapless raiders looking to pillage this wreck segment. The grells are hostile toward all other creatures.
zh_tw: 六隻{@creature Grell||觸鬚怪}在這裡安了家，以那些不幸的襲擊者為食，這些襲擊者想要掠奪這個殘骸段。這些觸鬚怪對所有其他生物都表現出敵意。

english: Redbud's Roots
zh_tw: 紫荊的根

english: The treant's roots have warped and splintered the floorboards, rendering squares with roots {@book difficult terrain|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}.
zh_tw: 樹人的根鬚使地板扭曲、碎裂；有根鬚盤踞的方格視為{@book 困難地形|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}。

english: Redbud's roots also block the entrances to the lifeboat wreck (area Z12) and the study ({@area area Z13|177|x}), the latter of which contains one of the safe room's ward runes. Redbud moves these roots if the characters eradicate the monsters nesting below. The roots also retract if Redbud is killed or forced to relocate.
zh_tw: 紫荊的根也阻擋了救生艇殘骸（區域Z12）和研究室（{@area 區域Z13|177|x}）的入口，後者包含了安全房間的一個保護符文。如果角色們根除了下方築巢的怪物，紫荊會移動這些根。如果紫荊被殺死或被迫遷移，這些根也會縮回。

english: Z12: Lifeboat Wreck
zh_tw: Z12: 生命艇殘骸

english: A cot is shoved against one wall here opposite a desk. Sitting in the room's center is a reddish-brown dog with a leather collar studded with glowing crystals.
zh_tw: 一張簡易床被推到房間的一面牆邊，對面是一張桌子。坐在房間中央的是一隻紅棕色的狗，戴著一個鑲有發光水晶的皮項圈。

english: Ikasa the {@creature blink dog} is outfitted with a magical collar that allows him to speak Common. Afraid to use his teleportation ability due to the wreck's warped magic, Ikasa remained in the lifeboat, protected by Redbud.
zh_tw: 伊卡莎這隻{@creature blink dog||閃現犬}配備了一個允許它說通用語的魔法項圈。由於殘骸的魔法扭曲，伊卡莎害怕使用它的傳送能力，因此它留在了救生艇上，由紫荊保護。

english: On seeing the characters, Ikasa excitedly bounds over and introduces himself. If the characters mention Daveras, Ikasa asks to be reunited with his old companion.
zh_tw: 看到角色們，伊卡莎興奮地跳過來自我介紹。如果角色們提到達維拉斯，伊卡莎請求與他的老夥伴重聚。

english: Ikasa's Secret
zh_tw: 伊卡莎的秘密

english: If the characters speak with Ikasa about Daveras, the blink dog becomes uncharacteristically morose. On further inquiry, Ikasa reveals he saw Daveras's friend, the halfling Palenna Tindertoe, escape the wreckage of the Verdant Branch after pirates attacked it. Palenna floated away from the ship using the power of her mind and likely still floats somewhere in the Astral Sea. Ikasa didn't tell Daveras, who believes he, Redbud, and the blink dog were the only survivors of the attack. Ikasa hasn't had the opportunity to find Palenna due to being trapped on the lifeboat, and he is afraid Daveras will become despondent thinking about his friend trying to survive in the Astral Sea alone.
zh_tw: 如果角色們與伊卡莎談論達維拉斯，這隻瞬移犬會異常地變得憂鬱。在進一步詢問下，伊卡莎透露他看到達維拉斯的朋友，半精靈帕蓮娜·火種趾，在海盜襲擊翠綠枝條號後逃離了殘骸。帕蓮娜利用她的心靈力量使自己漂浮遠離了船隻，很可能還在星界海的某處漂浮。伊卡莎沒有告訴達維拉斯，後者認為他、紫荊和瞬移犬是襲擊中唯一的生還者。由於被困在救生艇上，伊卡莎沒有機會去尋找帕蓮娜，他也擔心達維拉斯會因為想到他的朋友獨自在星界海中掙扎求生而感到絕望。

english: Regardless of what the characters do on learning this, it counts as a secret for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
zh_tw: 無論角色在獲知此事後採取何種行動，根據本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中的{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則，這都算作一個秘密。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The lifeboat's interior contains survival necessities. A character who searches the lifeboat and succeeds on a {@dc 18} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check also finds an emergency fund of 100 gp stashed in one of the desk's drawers.
zh_tw: 救生艇內部裝有生存必需品。一名角色若搜尋救生艇併成功透過{@dc 18}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，還能在桌子的某個抽屜裡找到100金幣的應急資金。

english: Z13: Study
zh_tw: Z13: 書房

english: Books and scrolls concerning arcane subjects pack the bookshelves here. Pressed against the wall is a redwood desk, atop which are clean sheets of parchment and two inkwells.
zh_tw: 這裡書架上擺滿了關於奧術主題的書籍和卷軸。靠牆放著一張紅木書桌，上面有乾淨的羊皮紙和兩個墨水池。

english: Secret Strongbox
zh_tw: 秘密保險箱

english: A character who inspects the bookshelves and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check discovers that one of the books—a volume titled Dissertations on the Abstruse Mind—is a disguised strongbox. The box is locked, but the lock can be picked with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check using thieves' tools or forced open with a successful {@dc 11} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. Inda carries the strongbox's key.
zh_tw: 一名角色若檢查書架並在 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定中成功，將發現其中一本書——書名為《深奧心靈論》——其實是一個偽裝成書本的保險箱。保險箱上了鎖，但可以透過使用盜賊工具成功透過 {@dc 15} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定來撬開，或者透過成功透過 {@dc 11} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定強行開啟。印達持有保險箱的鑰匙。

english: The box is trapped. When a creature attempts to open the box by any means other than the key, poisonous gas puffs out the keyhole. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition poisoned} condition for 1 hour.
zh_tw: 箱子被設下了陷阱。當生物嘗試用除了鑰匙以外的任何方式開啟箱子時，毒氣會從鑰匙孔中噴出。該生物必須成功透過一次 {@dc 20} 的體質豁免檢定，否則將獲得 {@condition poisoned||中毒} 狀態，持續1小時。

english: The box contains a {@item Potion of Mind Reading} and a journal. The journal belongs to Inda and contains writings in Common and Celestial regarding her experiments with the rod piece. A character who spends 10 minutes reading the journal learns the pass phrase needed to deactivate the ward runes protecting the safe room: "The moon sings a song for the lost."
zh_tw: 箱子裡裝有一瓶{@item Potion of Mind Reading||讀心藥水}和一本日記。這本日記屬於印達，內容用通用語和天界語寫成，記錄了她對權杖部件的實驗。如果一個角色花費10分鐘閱讀這本日記，他將瞭解到用於停用保護安全房間的防護符文的口令："月亮為迷失者歌唱。"

english: Ward Rune
zh_tw: 防護符文

english: The ward rune is on the wall above the desk.
zh_tw: 防護符文刻在書桌上方的牆上。

english: Z14a–Z14b: Forecastle and Top Deck
zh_tw: Z14a–Z14b: 前甲板和頂層甲板

english: A colossal heart—part flesh and part stone—looms over this segment's top deck. What remains of the ship's prow is plunged deep into the heart, and the deck rumbles as the heart pulses. Scraps of gossamer sails dangle off the ship's broken-off mast, which is jammed through one of the doors leading into the forecastle.
zh_tw: 一個巨大的心臟——部分是肉體部分是石頭——籠罩在這個區段的頂層甲板上。船頭殘留的部分深深地插入心臟，隨著心臟的跳動，甲板發出隆隆聲。薄紗般的帆布碎片懸掛在船隻斷裂的桅杆上，桅杆卡在通向前甲板的一扇門中。

english: The mast blocks the entrance to the navigation room ({@area area Z16|181|x}). The door to the captain's quarters (area Z15) is unobstructed but locked; the lock can be opened with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check using thieves' tools. As an action, a character can attempt a {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to force the door open. A character who has a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 13 or higher and who is standing within 5 feet of the door hears someone inside.
zh_tw: 桅杆擋住了導航室（{@area 區域Z16|181|x}）的入口。通往船長室（區域 Z15）的門沒有阻礙但已上鎖；可以使用盜賊工具並透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定來開啟鎖。作為一個動作，角色可以嘗試進行一次 {@dc 15} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定來強行開啟門。如果角色的被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）分數達到 13 或更高，並且站在距離門 5 尺範圍內，可以聽到裡面有人。

english: Z15: Captain's Quarters
zh_tw: Z15: 船長的艙室

english: Captain {@creature Inda Malayuri|VEoR} survived the crash of the Lambent Zenith but now must fix her prosthetic wing
zh_tw: 軍士隊長 {@creature Inda Malayuri|VEoR|印達·馬來由} 在輝耀天頂號號的摧毀中倖存，但現在必須修理她的義肢振翅

english: In this cabin, clothes are tossed over chair backs, and open books are strewn across tables. At the back of the room stands a deva. Her right leg below her knee is a wood-and-metal prosthetic, and from her back extends a massive, white-feathered wing.
zh_tw: 在這個小屋裡，衣服隨意地搭在椅子背上，開啟的書散落在桌子上。房間的後面站著一個天神使徒。她膝蓋以下的右腿是一個木製和金屬製成的義肢，從她的背部伸出一個巨大的白色羽毛翅膀。

english: The one-winged woman is the captain of the {@i Lambent Zenith}, {@creature Inda Malayuri|VEoR}. Inda uses the {@creature deva} stat block, except she has a flying speed of 0 feet.
zh_tw: 獨翼女子是{@i 輝耀天頂號}的首領，{@creature Inda Malayuri|VEoR|印達·馬來由}。印達使用{@creature deva||天神使徒}資料卡，只是她的飛行速度為0尺。

english: Inda's right leg and wing were severed in an attack years ago. She now uses prosthetics, but her prosthetic wing was damaged in the crash. She has been trying to repair it in the navigation room ({@area area Z16|181|x}). She is determined to escape the wreck and reunite with whatever remains of her crew, though she worries the rod piece will be stolen by raiders if she leaves.
zh_tw: 印達的右腿和翅膀在幾年前的一次襲擊中被切斷了。她現在使用義肢，但她的義肢翅膀在墜機中受損。她一直在導航室（{@area 區域Z16|181|x}）嘗試修理它。她決心逃離這艘殘骸，並與她的船員團聚，儘管她擔心如果她離開，法杖部件會被襲擊者偷走。

english: Talking with Inda
zh_tw: 與印達交談

english: Having encountered raiders attempting to pillage the wreck, Inda is wary of the characters and pointedly asks about their motives. She is hesitant to provide any information about the Lambent Zenith's cargo—especially the rod piece—and isn't swayed by bribes or threats.
zh_tw: 印達遇到了試圖掠奪殘骸的襲擊者，因此她對角色們保持警惕，並明確詢問他們的動機。她不願意提供有關輝耀天頂號號貨物的任何資訊——特別是法杖部件——並且不會被賄賂或威脅所動搖。

english: A character talking with Inda can make a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check. If a character offers to aid her with repairing her prosthetic wing or to reunite her with her crew in the stern segment, this check is made with advantage. On a successful check, Inda agrees to help the characters. In addition to the general history of the {@i Lambent Zenith}, Inda knows the following points of information:
zh_tw: 一個與印達交談的角色可以進行一次 {@dc 15} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定。如果角色主動提出幫助她修復她的假翼或協助她與船員在船尾區域重聚，此次檢定具有優勢。若檢定成功，印達同意幫助角色們。除了 {@i 輝耀天頂號} 的總體歷史外，印達還知道以下資訊：

english: Location of the Rod Piece
zh_tw: 杆件的位置

english: The rod piece was stored in a safe room directly beneath the ship's bridge. To protect the rod piece from raiders, the safe room was equipped with magical security wards that triggered when the ship crashed.
zh_tw: 杆件被存放在船橋正下方的一個安全房間裡。為了防止杆件被掠奪者竊取，安全房間配備了魔法安全結界，當船隻墜毀時這些結界被觸發。

english: Deactivating the Ward Runes
zh_tw: 停用守衛符文

english: The safe room's wards are powered by two runes. One is located on the headboard of the bed in the ship's stateroom, and the other is in the study, on the wall above the desk. The runes are invisible, and both runes need to be deactivated to access the safe room. Inda knows the pass phrase for deactivating both runes: "The moon sings a song for the lost."
zh_tw: 安全房間的守衛由兩個符文提供動力。一個位於船上客房床頭板上，另一個在書房裡，位於書桌上方的牆上。這些符文是隱形的，要進入安全房間，需要停用兩個符文。印達知道停用這兩個符文的口令：'月亮為迷失者歌唱。'

english: What's in the Heart
zh_tw: 核心裡有什麼

english: Inda has avoided exploring Havock. However, she's seen a serpentine monster emerge from Havock's heart.
zh_tw: 印達避開了探索哈沃克。然而，她看見一個蛇形怪物從哈沃克的核心出現。

english: If the characters have no way to see the invisible ward runes, Inda lends the party a {@item Lantern of Revealing}.
zh_tw: 如果角色沒有辦法看到隱形的守衛符文，印達借給隊伍一個{@item Lantern of Revealing||顯像提燈}。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Inda has a {@item Flame Tongue shortsword} and a {@item Ring of Evasion} on her bedside table next to the {@item Lantern of Revealing}. If asked, Inda is reluctant to give away the shortsword or ring but can be convinced with a successful {@dc 22} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check. Inda has a key to the strongbox in {@area area Z13|177|x} and knows where the secret compartment holding a {@item Spell Scroll} of {@spell Flame Strike} is in {@area area Z17|184|x}; she mentions these to the characters if they help her with her prosthetic wing in area Z16 or help her reach her crew in the stern segment.
zh_tw: 印達的床頭櫃上放著一把{@item Flame Tongue shortsword||焰舌短劍}和一枚{@item Ring of Evasion||反射閃避戒指}，旁邊還有一盞{@item Lantern of Revealing||顯像提燈}。如果被問及，印達不太願意交出短劍或戒指，但如果成功透過{@dc 22}魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，可以說服她。印達有一個鑰匙可以開啟位於{@area 區域Z13|177|x}的保險箱，並且知道在{@area 區域Z17|184|x}中藏有{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}的{@spell Flame Strike||焰擊術}的秘密隔間；如果角色在區域 Z16 幫助她修復假翼或幫助她抵達船尾段的同伴，她會向角色提及這些資訊。

english: As an action, a character who can reach the bedside table can try to steal one of the magic items atop it without being seen by Inda, doing so with a successful {@dc 19} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. On a failed check, Inda sees the attempt and immediately becomes hostile.
zh_tw: 作為一個動作，能夠觸及床頭桌的角色可以嘗試偷取桌上的一個魔法物品而不會被印達發現，這需要透過一個成功的 {@dc 19} 敏捷 ({@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}) 檢定。如果檢定失敗，印達會發現這一企圖並立即變得敵對。

english: Z16: Navigation Room
zh_tw: Z16: 導航室

english: A chunk of mast has pierced the doors to the corridor and fills one corner of the room. A large bronze sphere hovers in the center of the room, spinning idly. Splayed on the table below is a wing-shaped contraption.
zh_tw: 一段桅杆穿透了通往走廊的門，填滿了房間的一個角落。一個巨大的青銅球體在房間中央懸停，無目的地旋轉。在下面的桌子上展開的是一個翅膀形狀的裝置。

english: This room formerly served as the Lambent Zenith's navigation room. It now functions as Inda's workshop.
zh_tw: 這個房間曾是輝耀天頂號的導航室。現在它是印達的工作坊。

english: Inda's Prosthetic Wing
zh_tw: 印達的義肢翅膀

english: Inda's prosthetic wing sits on the center table. Inda has been trying to repair it, but while she excels at theoretical studies, she is inexperienced with practical engineering.
zh_tw: 印達的義肢翅膀放在中心的桌子上。印達一直在嘗試修復它，但她雖然在理論研究方面很出色，但在實際工程方面卻缺乏經驗。

english: Characters can attempt to help Inda repair the prosthetic wing. A character must first succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) or Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check to know which joints must be reconnected. Then, the character must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check to reconnect the joints; a character who has proficiency with tinker's tools makes this check with advantage.
zh_tw: 角色可以嘗試幫助印達修復機械翼。角色首先需要成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）或感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定，以瞭解哪些關節需要重新連線。然後，角色必須成功透過一次 {@dc 17} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定來重新連線關節；擁有修補工具熟練度的角色在進行此檢定時具有優勢。

english: Once a successful Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check has been made, Inda knows she can tinker with the wing enough that it will eventually work.
zh_tw: 一旦成功透過一次敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定，印達就知道她可以對機翼進行足夠的調整，使其最終能夠正常工作。

english: Inda is grateful to the characters for their help fixing the broken wing, even if their efforts are unsuccessful. If the characters escort her to the stern segment of the wreck, she vouches for the characters to Figaro in {@area area Z5|15c|x}.
zh_tw: 印達對角色們幫助修復損壞的翅膀表示感謝，即使他們的努力沒有成功。如果角色們護送她到殘骸的船尾部分，她會在{@area 區域Z5|15c|x}區域為角色們向菲加羅擔保。

english: Z17: Bridge
zh_tw: Z17: 艦橋

english: This room ends in a wall of Havock's flesh, and glass shards from the shattered window litter the floor. An armchair sits on a platform toward the back of the room; below it lies a silver-wrought chair, toppled over and broken in half.
zh_tw: 這個房間以哈沃克的肉體牆結束，破碎窗戶的玻璃碎片散落在地板上。房間後部的平臺上放著一把扶手椅；它下面是一個銀色打造的椅子，翻倒了並且折斷了一半。

english: The armchair served as the captain's chair. The broken chair on the ground was the ship's helm but is now irrevocably destroyed.
zh_tw: 扶手椅曾是船長的座椅。地上破碎的椅子曾是船的舵，但現在已不可挽回地被摧毀了。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A character who examines the captain's chair and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check finds a secret compartment in the right armrest. The compartment holds a bronze tube containing a {@item Spell Scroll} of {@spell Flame Strike}.
zh_tw: 一個角色如果檢查船長的座椅併成功透過一個{@dc 15}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，會在右扶手中發現一個秘密隔間。隔間內有一個青銅管，裡面裝著一張{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}的{@spell Flame Strike||焰擊術}。

english: Z18: Forward Cargo Hold
zh_tw: Z18: 前貨物艙

english: Empty crates and barrels litter this deck, and a double door stands at the fore. The doors' surfaces shimmer as if trapped behind a wall of translucent silver light.
zh_tw: 空箱子和木桶散落在這個甲板上，一扇雙開門位於船首。門的表面閃爍著，彷彿被囚禁在一堵半透明的銀色光牆後面。

english: The door to the safe room is sealed by the ship's emergency security wards (see the "{@area Accessing the Rod Piece|146|x}" section earlier in this chapter). Inspecting the safe room via a {@spell Detect Magic} spell or a similar effect reveals a strong aura of abjuration magic, as well as two tethers stretching toward the stern segment and the starboard segment, respectively. These tethers indicate the links between the wards and the runes in these respective locations.
zh_tw: 安全室的門被船上的緊急安全結界封住了（見本章前面的"{@area 獲取權杖部件|146|x}"部分）。透過{@spell Detect Magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似效果檢查安全室，可以發現一股強烈的防護魔法氣息，以及兩個分別伸向船尾段和右舷段的鏈條。這些鏈條表明了結界與這些相應位置的符文之間的聯絡。

english: Z19: Safe Room
zh_tw: Z19: 保險箱室

english: An overwhelmingly foul stench fills this destroyed and empty room. Where the prow should be is a gaping hole leading into the putrid core of Havock's heart.
zh_tw: 這個被摧毀且空無一物的房間裡充滿了令人難以忍受的惡臭。本應是船頭的位置是一個巨大的洞口，通往哈沃克心臟的腐臭核心。

english: The rod piece was consumed by the {@creature hertilod|VEoR} lurking within the heart.
zh_tw: 杆件被潛伏在核心的{@creature hertilod|VEoR|赫蒂洛德}吞噬了。

english: Heart Entryway
zh_tw: 心臟入口

english: The hole in this area leads into the heart of Havock, as shown on {@adventure map 3.2|VEoR|3|Map 3.2: Heart of Havock} and described in the following section. To retrieve the rod piece, the characters must venture into the heart and confront the monster inside.
zh_tw: 這個區域的洞口通向哈沃克的核心，如{@adventure 地圖 3.2|VEoR|3|Map 3.2: Heart of Havock}所示，並在以下部分描述。要取回杆件，角色們必須冒險進入核心並與裡面的怪物對峙。

english: Heart of Havock
zh_tw: 浩劫之心

english: Though much of Havock is petrified and crumbling, the god's heart still beats. Over time, the heart spawned a parasitic monstrosity known as a hertilod, which feasts on the god's residual divine power and terrorizes hapless astral travelers who stumble on Havock's corpse. When the {@i Lambent Zenith} crashed into Havock, the god's heart began absorbing pieces of the ship's prow, and the hertilod gorged itself on the spelljamming vessel's detritus—including the piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}.
zh_tw: 雖然哈沃克的大部分已經石化並崩解，但這位神祇的心臟仍在跳動。隨著時間的推移，心臟孕育出一種稱為赫爾提洛德的寄生怪物，它吞噬神祇殘餘的神力，並恐嚇那些不幸遭遇哈沃克遺屍的星界旅者。當{@i 輝耀天頂號}撞擊哈沃克時，神祇的心臟開始吸收船首的碎片，而赫爾提洛德則大快朵頤這艘魔法艦船的殘骸——包括那件{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的碎片。

english: General Features
zh_tw: 通用特徵

english: The areas of the heart of Havock have the following notable features:
zh_tw: 哈沃克心臟區域有以下顯著特徵：

english: Foul Air
zh_tw: 汙穢空氣

english: The air throughout the heart is foul. Any creature that breathes the foul air has the {@condition poisoned} condition until it breathes fresh air again.
zh_tw: 心臟中的空氣充滿了惡臭。任何呼吸這種惡臭空氣的生物都會處於{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態，直到再次呼吸到新鮮空氣。

english: Lighting
zh_tw: 光照

english: All areas inside the heart are dimly lit by floating orbs of pinkish bioluminescence.
zh_tw: 心臟內的所有區域都由漂浮的粉紅色生物發光球體微弱地照亮。

english: Walls, Ceiling, and Floor
zh_tw: 牆壁、天花板和地板

english: The walls, ceiling, and floor of the heart are made of purple flesh. Parts of this flesh have been petrified, hardening into gray crystal, while other parts remain soft and spongy. The heart beats erratically, sending a dull pulse echoing through its chambers every few minutes. The ceilings in the heart are all 50 feet high.
zh_tw: 心臟的牆壁、天花板和地板由紫色的肉體構成。這部分肉體有些已經石化，硬化成灰色晶體，而其他部分仍然柔軟且多孔。心臟不規則地跳動，每隔幾分鐘就在其腔室中發出沉悶的脈動。心臟中的天花板高度都是50尺。

english: Areas of the Heart
zh_tw: 心臟區域

english: The areas of the heart are keyed to map 3.2.
zh_tw: 心臟區域與地圖 3.2 對應。

english: Map 3.2: Heart of Havock
zh_tw: 地圖 3.2: 哈沃克之心

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: A1: Entry Atrium
zh_tw: A1: 入口大廳

english: Beyond the shattered safe room is an oval chamber with walls of purple flesh dimly lit by pinkish, bioluminescent orbs. The air reeks of death. An opening in one wall leads to another chamber.
zh_tw: 破碎的安全房間之外是一個橢圓形的房間，牆壁由紫色的肉體構成，被粉紅色的生物發光球體微弱地照亮。空氣中瀰漫著死亡的惡臭。一個牆上的開口通向另一個房間。

english: A character holding the first rod piece divines that the next piece is deeper in the heart.
zh_tw: 持有第一部分杆件的角色透過神諭得知下一部分更深藏在心臟之中。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The heart absorbed detritus from the wreckage of the Lambent Zenith's safe room and bridge. A character who searches through the detritus and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check uncovers a gilded spyglass worth 1,000 gp.
zh_tw: 心臟吸收了輝耀天頂號安全室和艦橋殘骸中的碎屑。一個角色如果搜尋這些碎屑併成功透過一個 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，會發現一個價值1000 gp的鍍金望遠鏡。

english: A2: Ventricle Chamber
zh_tw: A2: 心室室

english: Deep in the heart of Havock lurks a creature called a hertilod, which has swallowed a piece of the Rod of Seven Parts
zh_tw: 在哈沃克心臟深處潛藏著一個叫做赫蒂洛德的生物，它吞下了七碎片之杖的一部分

english: The walls and floor of this massive chamber alternate between gray, petrified stone and flexing muscle and flesh. Clinging to the ceiling is a serpentine monstrosity, like a skinless snake. Its long, draconic snout drips with venom as it slumbers.
zh_tw: 這個巨大房間的牆壁和地板在灰色的石化石頭和伸縮的肌肉與肉體之間交替變換。天花板上附著著一個蛇形的怪物，像一條沒有皮膚的蛇。它長長的、龍一樣的口鼻在沉睡時滴著毒液。
