english: The creature sleeping on the ceiling is the {@creature hertilod|VEoR} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) that swallowed the next rod piece. A character can move through the area without waking the hertilod by succeeding on a {@dc 18} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check. Otherwise, the hertilod wakes when it detects a creature within 30 feet of itself and attacks.
zh_tw: 睡在天花板上的生物是吞噬了下一節杖的 {@creature hertilod|VEoR|赫蒂洛德}（詳見 {@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）。角色可以透過進行一次 {@dc 18} 敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定，在不驚醒赫蒂洛德的情況下透過該區域。否則，當赫蒂洛德探測到 30 尺內有生物時，它會醒來併發起攻擊。

english: Retrieving the Rod Piece
zh_tw: 取回權杖部件

english: The rod piece is deep within the hertilod's gullet. If the hertilod is forced to regurgitate creatures in its gullet, roll a {@dice d6}. On a roll of 4 or higher, the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|rod piece} is also regurgitated and lands in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the hertilod. Alternatively, a creature within the hertilod's gullet can use its action to make a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check, finding the rod piece on a successful check. Once the hertilod is dispatched, a character can easily recover the rod piece from the hertilod's gullet. For more about the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, see this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
zh_tw: 這件權杖碎片深藏在赫提洛德的咽喉內。如果赫提洛德被迫吐出在其咽喉中的生物，擲一個{@dice d6}。擲出4或更高時，{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|杆件}也會被吐出並落在赫提洛德10尺範圍內的一個未被佔據的空間中。或者，赫提洛德咽喉內的生物可以使用其動作進行一次{@dc 15}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，成功檢定時找到權杖碎片。一旦赫提洛德被消滅，角色可以輕易地從赫提洛德的咽喉中取回權杖碎片。有關{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的更多資訊，請參見本書的{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}。

english: Caved-In Artery
zh_tw: 塌陷的動脈

english: A 10-foot-wide petrified artery leads from this chamber. The artery has caved in, blocking that exit from the chamber.
zh_tw: 一條10尺寬的石化動脈從這個房間延伸出去。動脈已經塌陷，堵住了從房間的這個出口。

english: A character who uses an action to dig through the cave-in can make a {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a successful check, the character clears a passage through the cave-in large enough for a Medium creature to squeeze through. Exiting the heart through this passage leads to the area above the {@i Lambent Zenith}'s prow ({@area area Z19|189|x}).
zh_tw: 一個角色若使用動作挖掘塌方區域，可以進行一次 {@dc 15} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。若檢定成功，角色會清理出一條足夠中等體型生物擠過的通道。透過這條通道離開核心區域，可以到達 {@i 輝耀天頂號} 船首上方的區域（{@area 區域Z19|189|x}）。

english: A3: Flooded Atrium
zh_tw: A3: 淹沒的中庭

english: The air here is humid. Pooled on the floor is black sludge that shimmers like an oil slick.
zh_tw: 這裡的空氣潮溼。地板上積聚著像油膜一樣閃爍的黑色汙泥。

english: A character who examines the sludge and succeeds on a {@dc 13} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check identifies it as Havock's blood. A creature that touches the blood immediately takes 10 ({@dice 3d6}) force damage. For each minute a creature spends in contact with the blood, the creature takes this damage again.
zh_tw: 一個角色如果檢查了這團淤泥並透過了一項 {@dc 13} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定，可以識別出這是哈沃克的血。任何生物如果接觸到這團血，會立即受到10（{@dice 3d6}）點力場傷害。每一分鐘持續接觸這團血的生物，將會再次受到這一傷害。

english: Caved-In Artery
zh_tw: 塌陷的動脈

english: A 10-foot-wide petrified artery leads from this chamber. The artery has caved in, blocking that exit from the chamber. Characters can clear that exit as described in area A2.
zh_tw: 一條10尺寬的石化動脈從這個房間延伸出去。動脈已經塌陷，堵住了從房間的這個出口。角色們可以按照A2區域的描述清除那個出口。

english: Next Steps
zh_tw: 下一步

english: Once the characters have successfully retrieved the second piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} from the hertilod, they can return to the portal to Sigil that floats above Havock. After the rod piece is removed from Havock's vicinity, teleportation magic within the wreck segments functions normally.
zh_tw: 一旦角色們成功從赫蒂洛德那裡取回了{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第二件部分，他們就可以返回漂浮在哈沃克上方的通往法印城的傳送門。當杆件從哈沃克附近移除後，殘骸段內的傳送魔法將正常運作。

english: Chapter 4: The Ruined Colossus
zh_tw: 第4章：毀滅的巨像

english: The next piece of the Rod of Seven Parts is inside an enormous war machine
zh_tw: 七碎片之杖的下一部分位於一個巨大的戰爭機器內部

english: Searching for the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|third piece} of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} takes the characters to the continent of Khorvaire on Eberron. The scars of the Last War are still fresh on Khorvaire. Nowhere is this truer than in the Mournland, a once-glorious nation destroyed during the apocalyptic Day of Mourning. Here, the characters must search for the next piece of the rod.
zh_tw: 尋找{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|第三部分}（來自{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}）將角色們帶到了艾伯倫大陸上的科瓦雷。科瓦雷上，終末戰爭的傷痕依然未愈。在悲悼荒原，這種傷痛尤為深刻。悲悼荒原曾是一個輝煌的國度，但在那場末日的悲悼之日中被毀滅。在這裡，角色們必須尋找權杖的下一部分。

english: Curtains of thick, gray mist blanket the Mournland. Sentient constructs, desperate adventurers, and ravenous mutated monsters roam the blasted landscape. The characters must navigate this wasteland in search of the rod piece, ultimately discovering that the piece is located inside the remains of an enormous, highly advanced, bipedal war machine called a colossus.
zh_tw: 厚重的灰色霧氣籠罩著悲悼荒原。有感知的構造物、絕望的冒險家和貪婪的變異怪物在這片荒蕪的土地上徘徊。角色們必須穿越這片荒地尋找杆件，最終發現這部分位於一個巨大、高度先進的雙足戰爭機器的殘骸內，這種機器被稱為巨像。

english: Running This Chapter
zh_tw: 運作本章

english: This chapter begins after the characters retrieve the second piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}. The characters can knit the pieces together or keep them separate, as described in the {@area introduction|00e|x}. Regardless, when a character holds the second piece of the rod, they intuitively know that the next piece is located somewhere on the continent of Khorvaire on the world of Eberron.
zh_tw: 這一章節開始於角色們取回{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第二部分之後。角色們可以將這些部分拼接起來或保持分開，如在{@area 簡介|00e|x}中所述。無論如何，當一個角色持有魔杖的第二部分時，他們會直觀地知道下一部分位於艾伯倫世界科瓦雷大陸的某處。

english: Specifically, the piece lies in the Mournland, on the slopes of Mount Ironrot. If the characters ask the Wizards Three in the Sigil sanctum why it's unclear exactly where the third piece is located, Alustriel shares the information in the "{@area Exploring Mount Ironrot|1a4|x}" section later in this chapter.
zh_tw: 具體來說，那部分位於悲悼荒原，在鐵鏽山的斜坡上。如果角色們詢問法印城聖所中的三巫師為什麼第三部分的確切位置不清楚，艾拉斯卓會在本章後面的"{@area 探索鐵鏽山|1a4|x}"部分分享資訊。

english: This chapter first describes Mount Ironrot, including locations and encounters awaiting the characters. The chapter then details the ruins of a colossus called Landro, whose dangers the characters must survive to claim the third piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}.
zh_tw: 這一章節首先描述了鐵鏽山，包括等待角色們的位置和遭遇。然後詳細描述了一個名為蘭德羅的巨像的廢墟，角色們必須在其中生存下來的危險，以索取{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第三部分。

english: Character Advancement
zh_tw: 角色升級

english: The characters should be 13th level when this chapter begins. The characters gain a level after they retrieve the third piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} from the graymatter engine of Landro.
zh_tw: 當這一章節開始時，角色們應該是13級。角色們在從蘭德羅的灰質引擎中取回{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第三部分後將獲得一個等級。

english: Power of Secrets
zh_tw: 秘密的力量

english: The characters can learn two secrets in this chapter that are applicable to the rules in "{@area The Power of Secrets|028|x}" section in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}:
zh_tw: 角色們可以在這一章中學到兩個秘密，這兩個秘密適用於本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中的"{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}"部分的規則：

english: Mercy's Secret
zh_tw: 仁慈的秘密

english: Mercy is the leader of a band of warforged pilgrims. Mercy was separated from their best friend, the warforged Filch, after the two were separated after the Day of Mourning. They feel guilty that they haven't searched for Filch. Characters can learn Mercy's secret in the "{@area Warforged Pilgrims|1b6|x}" section later in this chapter.
zh_tw: 仁慈是一群戰鑄巡禮者的領袖。在悲悼之日之後，仁慈與他們最好的朋友，戰鑄菲爾奇分開了。他們因為沒有尋找菲爾奇而感到內疚。角色們可以在本章後面的"{@area 戰俑朝聖者|1b6|x}"部分瞭解到仁慈的秘密。

english: Kalyth's Secret
zh_tw: 卡利思的秘密

english: Kalyth, the leader of a band of veterans, lost valuable magic items and money that could have prevented the current financial strain she and her allies are under. Characters can learn Kalyth's secret in the "{@area Veterans' Camp|1ae|x}" section later in this chapter.
zh_tw: 卡利思，一群老兵的領袖，丟失了寶貴的魔法物品和金錢，這本可以避免她和她盟友目前所面臨的財務壓力。角色們可以在本章後面的"{@area 老兵營地|1ae|x}"部分瞭解到卡利思的秘密。

english: Third Rod Piece
zh_tw: 第三根法杖部件

english: The third piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} is found in {@area area L28|20a|x} within Landro. For more information about the rod and the spell this piece allows its wielder to cast, see this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0|Rod Pieces}.
zh_tw: 第三部分的{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}在蘭德羅的{@area 區域L28|20a|x}中找到。關於法杖以及這部分允許其持有者施放的法術的更多資訊，請參見本書的{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0|Rod Pieces}。

english: Doorway to Eberron
zh_tw: 通往艾伯倫的門戶

english: Before seeking the third rod piece, the characters can rest and prepare in the sanctum in Sigil. By doing some research in Sigil or conversing with the Wizards Three, the characters can learn the following about their next destination:
zh_tw: 在尋找第三根法杖碎片之前，角色們可以在法印城的聖所休息和準備。透過在法印城進行一些研究或與三巫師交談，角色們可以瞭解到以下關於他們下一個目的地的資訊：

english: Ruins of War
zh_tw: 戰爭廢墟

english: The Mournland is a ruined wasteland. Before the Last War—a global conflict waged across the continent of Khorvaire for over a century—the Mournland was the nation of Cyre. An apocalyptic event called the Day of Mourning destroyed Cyre and transformed the region. Remnants of the Last War's battlefields, such as the fire-spewing war machines known as colossi, lie strewn about the Mournland, and warforged wander the land.
zh_tw: 悲悼荒原是一片毀壞的荒地。在終末戰爭——席捲科瓦雷大陸、持續一個多世紀的全球衝突——之前，此地是塞爾王國。一場名為悲悼之日的末日災變摧毀了塞爾，改變了整個地區。終末戰爭的戰場殘跡散落於悲悼荒原各處，包括被稱為巨像的噴火戰爭機器；戰俑也在這片土地上徘徊。

english: Warforged
zh_tw: 戰俑

english: Warforged are common on Khorvaire. These Constructs are formed from wood and steel, then magically imbued with life and sentience. Warforged were originally created to fight in the Last War, though many survived that conflict and now try to understand their place in the world.
zh_tw: 戰俑在科瓦雷大陸上很常見。這些構裝生物由木頭和鋼鐵製成，然後被魔法賦予生命和意識。戰俑最初是為了參加終末戰爭而創造的，儘管許多戰俑在那次衝突中倖存下來，現在他們試圖理解自己在世界中的位置。

english: Unreliable Magic
zh_tw: 不穩定的魔法

english: In the Mournland, magic doesn't always function as intended, particularly teleportation and divination magic. See the "{@area Regional Effects|1a5|x}" section later in this chapter for more.
zh_tw: 在悲悼荒原，魔法並不總是按預期那樣發揮作用，特別是傳送和占卜魔法。詳見本章後面的"區域效應{@area 區域效應|1a5|x}"部分以獲取更多資訊。

english: An Important Detail
zh_tw: 一個重要細節

english: The Mount Ironrot region is a wasteland scattered with broken war machines
zh_tw: 鐵鏽山地區是一片佈滿破損戰爭機器的荒地

english: Before the characters leave Sigil for Mount Ironrot, the Wizards Three share their concerns that this rod piece will be particularly challenging to find since the Mournland is difficult to navigate. The wizards suspect that the rod piece is hidden in one of the dozens of ruined colossi scattered across Mount Ironrot (as shown on {@adventure map 4.1|VEoR|4|Map 4.1: Mount Ironrot Outskirts}).
zh_tw: 在角色們離開法印城前往鐵鏽山之前，三巫師分享了他們的擔憂，認為這一節權杖碎片將特別難以找到，因為悲悼荒原難以導航。巫師們懷疑權杖碎片隱藏在散落在鐵鏽山上的數十座廢棄巨像中的其中一座中（如{@adventure 地圖 4.1|VEoR|4|Map 4.1: Mount Ironrot Outskirts}所示）。

english: Instead of searching each colossus individually, the wizards suggest augmenting the rod's divining power with local magic that can penetrate the Mournland's impeded navigation. The characters can do this by tuning their second rod piece to a working {@item Docent|ERLW} from inside one of the fallen colossi. A {@i Docent} is a small, sentient metal sphere that employs its sentience and magic on behalf of an attuned warforged; the full description of a {@i Docent} is found in the "{@area Finding a Docent|1bb|x}" section later in this chapter. The wizards correctly postulate that a {@i Docent}'s magic will stabilize and augment the rod's divining powers so it will directly point the way to the third piece.
zh_tw: 與其逐一搜尋每個巨像，法師們建議透過本地魔法增強法杖的占卜能力，以穿透悲悼荒原的導航障礙。角色們可以透過將他們的第二根法杖碎片調諧到其中一個倒下巨像內部的正常工作的{@item Docent|ERLW|指導附件}來實現這一點。{@i 指導附件}是一種小型、有感知的金屬球體，它利用其感知和魔法為已調諧的戰爭鍛造體服務；{@i 指導附件}的完整描述在本章後面的"{@area 尋找指導附件|1bb|x}"部分中。法師們正確地推測，{@i 指導附件}的魔法將穩定並增強法杖的占卜能力，使其直接指向第三塊碎片的位置。

english: About Docents
zh_tw: 關於指導附件

english: Long ago, colossi were powered and controlled by {@item Docent|ERLW|Docents}. The techniques and tools to create {@i Docents} were lost, but working {@i Docents} can sometimes still be found in colossi. The Wizards Three suggest the characters find a working {@i Docent} and tune it to the rod piece.
zh_tw: 很久以前，巨像是由{@item Docent|ERLW|指導附件}驅動和控制的。創造{@i 指導附件}的技術和工具已經失傳，但在巨像中有時仍然可以找到工作的{@i 指導附件}。三巫師建議角色們找到一個工作的{@i 指導附件}並將其調整到法杖碎片上。

english: Mount Ironrot
zh_tw: 鐵鏽山

english: When the characters are ready, they can step through the doorway in Sigil. They arrive outside a jet-black, glass oval portal near the slopes of Mount Ironrot.
zh_tw: 當角色們準備好後，他們可以穿過法印城的門。他們到達了鐵鏽山斜坡附近的一個漆黑的玻璃橢圓形傳送門外面。

english: Running Mount Ironrot
zh_tw: 穿越鐵鏽山

english: As the characters search for a {@item Docent|ERLW}, they encounter the Mournland denizens described in the subsequent "{@area Mount Ironrot Encounters|1b5|x}" section. Run an encounter each time the characters travel from one location to another. All three encounters should occur before the characters proceed to the "{@area Landro|1c7|x}" section.
zh_tw: 當角色們尋找一個{@item Docent|ERLW|指導附件}時，他們遇到了隨後"{@area 鐵鏽山遭遇戰|1b5|x}"部分中描述的悲悼荒原居民。每次角色們從一個地方移動到另一個地方時，進行一次遭遇。所有三次遭遇都應該在角色們繼續前往"{@area 蘭德羅|1c7|x}"部分之前發生。

english: From their expeditions and these encounters, the characters learn of a working {@i Docent} in a ruined village called Ialos. They also learn that this {@i Docent} is central to a conflict between rival groups of Mournland scavengers: a band of veterans and a community of warforged pilgrims.
zh_tw: 透過他們的探險和這些遭遇，角色們得知在名為伊阿洛斯的廢墟村莊中有一個工作的{@i 指導附件}。他們還瞭解到這個{@i 指導附件}是悲悼荒原的拾荒者之間的衝突的核心：一群老兵和一群戰俑朝聖者。

english: Exploring Mount Ironrot
zh_tw: 探索鐵鏽山

english: Use the following rules when the characters travel around Mount Ironrot.
zh_tw: 當角色們在鐵鏽山周圍旅行時，請使用以下規則。

english: Regional Effects
zh_tw: 區域效應

english: Mount Ironrot is affected by these environmental phenomena:
zh_tw: 鐵鏽山受到以下環境現象的影響：

english: Impeded Navigation
zh_tw: 受阻導航

english: In outdoor areas, creatures have disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks made to navigate.
zh_tw: 在戶外區域，生物在進行導航時的感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定時具有劣勢。

english: Lightly Obscured
zh_tw: 輕度遮蔽

english: Mist perpetually shrouds outdoor areas, rendering them {@book lightly obscured|PHB|8|Vision and Light}.
zh_tw: 迷霧始終籠罩著戶外區域，使其處於{@book 輕度遮蔽|PHB|8|Vision and Light}狀態。

english: Muddled Magic
zh_tw: 混亂魔法

english: Creatures and objects within 1 mile of Mount Ironrot can't be perceived through magical scrying sensors. Spells or magical effects that would reveal a creature's or object's location fail while that creature or object is within 1 mile of the mountain. The third piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} points only to Mount Ironrot without precision.
zh_tw: 鐵鏽山周圍1英里內的生物和物體無法透過魔法偵測感測器被感知。當生物或物體位於鐵鏽山1英里內時，揭示其位置的咒語或魔法效果將失效。{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第三塊只指向鐵鏽山，但無法精確定位。

english: Traveling
zh_tw: 旅行

english: Distances between locations anywhere in the Mournland are indeterminate and ever-changing. Map 4.1 shows the approximate positions of locations around Mount Ironrot relative to one another. The map doesn't include a scale due to this effect.
zh_tw: 在悲悼荒原任何地方之間的距離都是不確定的，並且一直在變化。地圖4.1顯示了鐵鏽山周圍地點相對於彼此的大致位置。由於這種效應，地圖沒有包括比例尺。

english: Whenever the characters travel from one location to another, roll {@dice 2d4} to determine the number of hours it takes the party to reach their destination. Have the players designate one party member to make a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check on behalf of the group each time the characters travel. On a failed check, double the number of hours the party must travel to reach their destination.
zh_tw: 每當角色們從一個地點前往另一個地點時，擲 {@dice 2d4} 來決定隊伍到達目的地所需的小時數。讓玩家指定一名隊員在每次旅行時為隊伍進行 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定。若檢定失敗，隊伍到達目的地所需的小時數翻倍。

english: Dangers
zh_tw: 危險

english: There is no safe food to forage in the Mournland, and monsters are everywhere. If the party lingers too long between locations, introduce random encounters with creatures such as {@creature Blazebear|VEoR|blazebears} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) or blade scouting parties (see the "{@area Blade Scouting Party|1ba|x}" section later in this chapter).
zh_tw: 在悲悼荒原沒有安全的食物可供採集，而且到處都是怪物。如果隊伍在地點之間逗留時間過長，就引入隨機遭遇，遇到諸如{@creature Blazebear|VEoR|焰熊}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）或刀刃偵察隊（詳見本章後面的"{@area 刀刃偵察隊|1ba|x}"部分）這樣的生物。

english: Mount Ironrot Locations
zh_tw: 鐵鏽山地點

english: The following locations are keyed to map 4.1.
zh_tw: 以下地點對應地圖4.1。

english: Map 4.1: Mount Ironrot Outskirts
zh_tw: 地圖 4.1：鐵鏽山外圍

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Oval Portal
zh_tw: 橢圓形傳送門

english: A twenty-foot-tall, vertical, black oval made of glass sits on the muck atop a low hill. The oval reflects the surrounding mist-shrouded landscape with supernatural clarity. The oval looks like a giant mirror, but it functions as a door between here and Sigil.
zh_tw: 一個二十尺高的垂直黑色橢圓形玻璃物體坐落在低矮山丘上的泥濘之上。這個橢圓形以超自然的清晰度反射著周圍被霧氣籠罩的景色。它看起來像一面巨大的鏡子，但實際上是連線這裡和法印城的門。

english: A {@spell Detect Magic} spell reveals an aura of conjuration magic emanating from the oval. This oval served as a conduit for powerful teleportation magic in Cyre, but the Day of Mourning rendered its magic unstable. The oval serves as a portal to Sigil while the characters carry the second piece of the rod.
zh_tw: 一個{@spell Detect Magic||偵測魔法}法術揭示了從橢圓形散發出的召喚魔法的氣息。這個橢圓形在塞爾曾作為強大的傳送魔法的通道，但悲悼之日使其魔法變得不穩定。當角色們攜帶法杖的第二件碎片時，這個橢圓形作為通往法印城的傳送門。

english: If a creature tries to teleport to the Mournland using a {@spell Teleport} spell, a {@spell Plane Shift} spell, or similar magic, the spell's caster must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the spell fails and has no effect. On a successful save, the spell works, but teleported creatures arrive in an empty space near this oval, regardless of their intended destination in the Mournland.
zh_tw: 如果一個生物嘗試使用 {@spell Teleport||傳送術} 法術、{@spell Plane Shift||位面轉移} 法術或類似的魔法傳送到悲悼荒原，法術的施法者必須進行 {@dc 15} 體質豁免檢定。如果檢定失敗，法術失效且沒有任何效果。如果檢定成功，法術生效，但傳送的生物會到達這個橢圓形附近的空地上，無論他們原本打算在悲悼荒原的哪個目的地。

english: A creature that studies the reflection of the Mournland in the oval clearly sees the ruined colossi, the {@area veterans' camp|1ae|x}, and {@area Ialos|1b2|x} (see map 4.1 and the sections below). Otherwise, the view from this hill is limited, offering a glimpse of only the nearest ruined colossus.
zh_tw: 一個仔細觀察橢圓形中悲悼荒原倒影的生物，可以清楚地看到那些破碎的巨像、{@area 老兵營地|1ae|x}以及{@area 伊阿洛斯|1b2|x}（見地圖4.1及以下部分）。除此之外，從這座小山上看到的景色有限，只能瞥見最近的破碎巨像。

english: Ruined Colossi
zh_tw: 廢墟巨像

english: Each time the characters investigate one of the colossi shown on map 4.1, read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 每次角色調查地圖4.1上顯示的巨像之一時，請閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: What was once a massive, bipedal war machine made of stone, metal, and wood now lies in ruin. Fragments of the mechanical titan lie scattered about, each piece as big as a barn.
zh_tw: 曾經由石頭、金屬和木頭製成的龐大雙足戰爭機器現在已成為廢墟。機械巨人的碎片散落四周，每一塊都像穀倉那麼大。

english: These colossi are smaller than Landro and are easily accessible, making the task of searching them relatively quick. For this reason, no maps of these ruined colossi are provided. You can simply narrate the characters' foray into each colossus.
zh_tw: 這些巨像比蘭德羅要小，而且容易接近，這使得搜尋它們的任務相對快速。出於這個原因，沒有提供這些廢墟巨像的地圖。你可以簡單地敘述角色們進入每個巨像的探險。

english: It takes {@dice 1d4} hours for the characters to search a colossus's wreckage for a {@item Docent|ERLW}. At the end of this time, have one character make a {@dc 17} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check for the group. On a failed check, the characters don't find a {@i Docent}, but they can't be sure they didn't simply miss it; the characters can spend another {@dice 1d4} hours to reattempt the check. On a successful check, the characters not only determine that the colossus's {@i Docent} is definitely gone, but also uncover one of the following clues (determined by you):
zh_tw: 角色們需要花費 {@dice 1d4} 小時來搜尋巨像殘骸中的 {@item Docent|ERLW|指導附件}。在這段時間結束時，讓一名角色為團隊進行一個 {@dc 17} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定。如果檢定失敗，角色們沒有找到 {@i 指導附件}，但他們無法確定是否只是錯過了它；角色們可以再花費 {@dice 1d4} 小時重新嘗試檢定。如果檢定成功，角色們不僅確定巨像的 {@i 指導附件} 確實不見了，還能發現以下線索之一（由你決定）：

english: Deep Tracks
zh_tw: 深深的足跡

english: Deep, angular boot prints belonging to unusually heavy, bipedal creatures lead to and from the wreckage. Examining multiple colossi and triangulating the boot prints' directions (no check required) points to the village of {@area Ialos|1b2|x}.
zh_tw: 深而有角度的靴印屬於異常沉重的雙足生物，這些足跡通向殘骸並從殘骸中延伸出來。檢查多個巨像並確定靴印的方向（無需檢定）指向了伊阿洛斯村莊{@area 伊阿洛斯|1b2|x}。

english: Second Party
zh_tw: 第二方

english: Smaller, fresher boot prints made by lighter bipeds meander aimlessly about the wreckage. It's impossible to discern the aim of these lighter bipeds from these tracks alone.
zh_tw: 較小、更新的靴印是由較輕的雙足生物隨意地在廢墟周圍徘徊留下的。僅憑這些足跡，無法確定這些較輕雙足生物的目的。

english: Skilled Extractor
zh_tw: 熟練的提取者

english: The Docent was removed with surgical precision, likely by someone who knew exactly what they were looking for.
zh_tw: 指導附件被以外科手術般的精確度移除，很可能是由一個確切知道自己在尋找什麼的人所為。

english: Landro
zh_tw: 蘭德羅

english: This unusually large colossus contains the third piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}. Landro is described later in this chapter.
zh_tw: 這個異常巨大的巨像包含著{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第三部分。蘭德羅將在本章後面的部分進行描述。

english: Veterans' Camp
zh_tw: 老兵營地

english: A crumbling stone bridge crosses a river of indigo water. Beneath one side of the bridge, soiled leather tents and bedrolls are arranged around a firepit.
zh_tw: 一座破舊的石橋橫跨著一條靛藍色的河流。在橋的一側下方，髒汙的皮革帳篷和睡袋圍繞著一個火坑排列著。

english: This campsite belongs to the ex-soldier Kalyth and her two companions (see the "{@area Cyran Veterans|1b9|x}" section later in this chapter). The veterans rest here between expeditions around Mount Ironrot. If the characters meet the veterans here and aren't hostile toward them, Kalyth offers to share her group's meager food supplies with the party.
zh_tw: 這個營地屬於前士兵卡利思和她兩個同伴（見本章後面的"{@area 塞爾老兵|1b9|x}"部分）。老兵們在鐵鏽山周圍的探險之間在此休息。如果角色們在這裡遇到老兵們，並且對他們沒有敵意，卡利思願意與隊伍分享她團隊的少量食物供應。

english: Kalyth's Secret
zh_tw: 卡利思的秘密

english: If the characters are friendly with Kalyth, she asks to speak with them privately. In a quiet spot, Kalyth admits that in the aftermath of the Day of Mourning, she lost several valuable magic items and a purse full of gold that she could've used to stave off the veterans' current financial plight. The items are long gone, and Kalyth fears that the other veterans would reject her—or worse—if they found out she once had the money they desperately need and lost it.
zh_tw: 如果角色們與卡利思友好，她會請求私下與他們交談。在一個安靜的地方，卡利思承認，在悲悼之日之後，她失去了幾件有價值的魔法物品和一個裝滿金幣的錢袋，她本可以用這些金幣來緩解老兵們目前的經濟困境。這些物品早已不復存在，卡利思擔心如果其他老兵發現她曾經擁有他們急需的錢卻弄丟了，他們會排斥她——或者更糟。

english: Regardless of the characters' reaction to this revelation, learning it counts as a secret for the purposes of {@area the Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
zh_tw: 不論角色們對這個揭示的反應如何，瞭解到這一點在本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則的目的上算作一個秘密。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A character who searches the area and succeeds on a {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check spots a loose brick among the bridge's remains. Behind the brick are a {@item Potion of Greater Healing||Potion of Healing (greater)} and a moldy hunk of bread—part of the veterans' provisions.
zh_tw: 一名角色在搜尋該區域併成功透過一次 {@dc 14} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定時，會注意到橋樑遺蹟中有一塊鬆動的磚塊。磚塊後面是一瓶 {@item Potion of Greater Healing||治療藥水（高等）} 和一塊發黴的麵包——這是老兵們的補給品的一部分。

english: Ialos
zh_tw: 伊阿洛斯

english: A windmill towers above this ruined village. The windmill's sides and blades are reinforced with badly rusted steel plates, and the attached wooden outbuilding is in shambles. Muddy roads separate the mill from the ruined buildings. In the center of a nearby intersection stands an eroded stone statue of a humanoid draped in colorful scraps of cloth.
zh_tw: 一座風車高聳在這個廢墟村莊之上。風車側面和葉片加固著嚴重生鏽的鋼板，而附屬的木製附屬建築已經破敗不堪。泥濘的道路將風車與毀壞的建築物分隔開來。在附近十字路口的中心，矗立著一座風化的石雕，描繪的是一個身披彩色破布的人形生物。

english: Mournland-roaming pilgrims (see the "{@area Warforged Pilgrims|1b6|x}" section later in this chapter) turned this ruined mill into an ossuary for fallen warforged.
zh_tw: 在悲悼荒原漫遊的朝聖者（見本章後面的"{@area 戰俑朝聖者|1b6|x}"部分）將這座廢墟風車改造成了為倒下的戰俑設立的骨灰堂。

english: From this base, pilgrims venture out to find relics or lost warforged. At such times, {@dice 2d4} pilgrims (use the {@creature warforged warrior|VEoR} stat block in {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) remain in Ialos to guard the mill or patrol its surroundings. When no expedition is underway, thirteen pilgrims (including their leader, Mercy, who also uses the {@creature warforged warrior|VEoR} stat block) occupy Ialos. The pilgrims defend their home against attackers, but they flee when they're outmatched.
zh_tw: 從這片基地出發，朝聖者們外出尋找遺物或失落的構裝體。此時，會有{@dice 2d4}名朝聖者（使用{@creature warforged warrior|VEoR|戰鑄戰士}的資料塊，見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）留在伊阿洛斯守護磨坊或巡邏其周圍。在沒有遠徵進行時，十三名朝聖者（包括他們的領袖仁慈，她也使用{@creature warforged warrior|VEoR|戰鑄戰士}的資料塊）佔據伊阿洛斯。朝聖者們會保衛家園免受攻擊，但在力量懸殊時會選擇逃跑。

english: The following locations are keyed to map 4.2:
zh_tw: 以下地點對應於地圖4.2：

english: Map 4.2: Ialos
zh_tw: 地圖 4.2：伊阿洛斯

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Founder's Statue
zh_tw: 創始人雕像

english: Colorful scraps of fabric drape over the shoulders and outstretched arm of this statue. The warforged pilgrims decorated the statue of Ialos's founder as a gesture of respect; they are grateful to the village's original builders for creating this space they can use to mourn.
zh_tw: 這座雕像的肩膀和伸出的手臂上披著彩色的布條。戰俑朝聖者們裝飾了伊阿洛斯創始人的雕像，作為一種尊重的表示；他們感激這個村莊最初的建造者創造了這個他們可以用來哀悼的空間。

english: Mill
zh_tw: 風車

english: The millstones have been removed from this mill, leaving an empty space. Warforged pilgrims use the mill to plan expeditions.
zh_tw: 這座風車的磨石已經被移除，留下了一個空蕩蕩的空間。戰俑朝聖者們使用這座風車來策劃探險。

english: Ossuary
zh_tw: 骨灰堂

english: Bodies of deceased warforged line this cleared-out basement. Each body is carefully secured to the wall in a dignified pose: back straight, arms crossed, and head slightly lowered.
zh_tw: 已故的戰俑的遺體排列在這個清理出來的地下室中。每具遺體都被小心翼翼地固定在牆上，以一種尊嚴的姿態：背部挺直，雙臂交叉，頭部微微下垂。

english: Ruins
zh_tw: 功虧一簣

english: Except for the mill, every building in Ialos was destroyed on the Day of Mourning. Broken stone and rotten timber lie strewn about the village.
zh_tw: 除了風車之外，伊阿洛斯的每棟建築都在悲悼之日被摧毀了。破碎的石頭和腐爛的木材散落在村莊各處。

english: Storeroom
zh_tw: 儲藏室

english: Objects the warforged pilgrims deem sacred line the shelves of this storeroom (see "Treasure" below).
zh_tw: 戰俑朝聖者認為神聖的物品排列在這個儲藏室的貨架上（見下方的"寶藏"）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The storeroom contains curiosities and trinkets salvaged from Mournland ruins. Some of these items had magical properties until the Day of Mourning destroyed their magic. The storeroom's notable treasures include the following:
zh_tw: 儲藏室裡存放著從悲悼荒原廢墟中回收的奇珍異寶。這些物品中的一些在悲悼之日之前具有魔法屬性，但那天的災難摧毀了它們的魔力。儲藏室中值得注意的寶藏包括以下內容：

english: Art Objects
zh_tw: 藝術品

english: Clean tapestries, intact sculptures, and leather-wrapped oil paintings are carefully piled in a corner of the storeroom. Altogether, these relics of old Cyre are worth 2,000 gp.
zh_tw: 乾淨的掛毯、完好無損的雕塑以及用皮革包裹的油畫被精心地堆放在儲藏室的一角。這些塞爾王國的古老遺物總共價值2000金幣。

english: Docents
zh_tw: 指導附件

english: Half a dozen metal orbs line one shelf, but only one is a functional {@item Docent|ERLW} (see the "Docent" section later in this chapter). These items were taken from the area's ruined colossi. A character can touch a piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} to the working Docent to determine the location of the third piece (see the "{@area Finding a Docent|1bb|x}" section later in this chapter).
zh_tw: 半打金屬球排列在一個架子上，但只有一個是有功能的{@item Docent|ERLW|指導附件}（見本章後文的"指導附件"部分）。這些物品取自該區域的廢墟巨像。角色可以將{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的一部分接觸工作的指導附件，以確定第三部分的位置（見本章後文的"{@area 尋找指導附件|1bb|x}"部分）。

english: Magic Ring
zh_tw: 魔法戒指

english: An iron ring etched with angelic feathers hangs from a silver chain on the wall. This is a {@item Ring of Feather Falling}.
zh_tw: 牆上掛著一個鐵環，上面刻有天使羽毛的圖案，鐵環系在一根銀鏈上。這是一個{@item Ring of Feather Falling||羽落戒指}。

english: Mount Ironrot Encounters
zh_tw: 鐵鏽山遭遇戰

english: These encounters should occur, in the order presented, as the characters travel from one location on map 4.1 to another. Each encounter occurs only once.
zh_tw: 這些遭遇應該按照4.1地圖上一個地點到另一個地點的順序發生。每個遭遇只發生一次。

english: Warforged Pilgrims
zh_tw: 戰俑朝聖者

english: The characters spot a band of five bipeds walking single file across a distant ridge. These are warforged pilgrims. Each uses the {@creature warforged warrior|VEoR} stat block (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}).
zh_tw: 角色們發現一隊五個雙足生物正沿著遠處的山脊單行前進。這些是戰俑朝聖者。每個朝聖者都使用{@creature warforged warrior|VEoR|戰鑄戰士}的統計資料塊（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）。

english: The pilgrims are peaceful folk who wander the Mournland in search of friendly travelers and artifacts important to warforged. A purple-hued ex-soldier named Mercy is the group's leader. Mercy is initially indifferent to the characters, but the leader responds positively to any aid the characters offer, such as advice or adventuring supplies.
zh_tw: 這些朝聖者是和平的人民，他們在悲悼荒原徘徊，尋找友好的旅行者和對戰俑重要的神器。一個名叫仁慈的紫色調的前士兵是這個團體的領袖。仁慈最初對角色們漠不關心，但領袖對角色們提供的任何幫助，如建議或冒險用品，都會積極回應。

english: Mercy
zh_tw: 仁慈

english: Pilgrims' Problems
zh_tw: 朝聖者的問題

english: At first, Mercy speaks vaguely about the pilgrims' goals. If the characters offer aid or helpful advice, Mercy talks about the pilgrims' expeditions to ruined colossi. Mercy then tells the characters that the pilgrims have been extracting {@item Docent|ERLW|Docents} from these ruins, and that the pilgrims consider the items sacred. Mercy also talks about the pilgrims' recent run-ins with rival salvagers. Mercy mentions two other groups in particular: a band of Cyran veterans that watches Mercy's group from the shadows, and a gang of openly hostile warforged that the pilgrims avoid at all costs. This latter group, Mercy explains, is loyal to the Lord of Blades, a local warmonger who conscripts warforged to his bloody cause of wiping out anyone who opposes him.
zh_tw: 起初，仁慈對朝聖者的目標說得含糊其辭。如果角色們提供幫助或有益的建議，仁慈就會談論朝聖者對毀滅巨像的探險。然後，仁慈告訴角色們，朝聖者一直在從這些廢墟中提取{@item Docent|ERLW|指導附件}，並且朝聖者認為這些物品是神聖的。仁慈還談到了朝聖者最近與競爭對手的衝突。仁慈特別提到了另外兩個團體：一群從暗處監視仁慈團隊的塞爾老兵，以及一群公開敵對的戰俑，朝聖者不惜一切代價避開這個團體。仁慈解釋說，這個團體效忠於刀鋒領主，一個當地的戰爭販子，他徵召戰俑加入他血腥的事業，消滅所有反對他的人。

english: If the characters offer to help the pilgrims, Mercy suggests they meet at the pilgrims' base in Ialos (see "{@area Ialos|1b2|x}" earlier in this chapter). Mercy and the pilgrims happily travel with the characters, though they hide if violence breaks out, emerging only when it's safe. If the characters wish to attend to other business before meeting the pilgrims at Ialos, Mercy draws a rough map in the mud to show the way. The pilgrims head straight to Ialos and are there when the characters arrive.
zh_tw: 如果角色們提出幫助朝聖者，仁慈建議他們在伊阿洛斯的朝聖者基地會面（見本章前面的"{@area 伊阿洛斯|1b2|x}"）。仁慈和朝聖者們高興地與角色們同行，儘管他們在暴力爆發時會躲藏起來，只有在安全時才會出現。如果角色們希望在前往伊阿洛斯會見朝聖者之前處理其他事務，仁慈會在泥土上畫一個粗略的地圖以指示方向。朝聖者們直接前往伊阿洛斯，並且當角色們到達時，他們已經在那裡。

english: Mercy's Secret
zh_tw: 仁慈的秘密

english: If the characters befriend Mercy, they sense during their conversations with the warforged that something weighs heavily on Mercy. If the characters ask the warforged about their melancholy, Mercy asks to speak with the characters privately. In private, Mercy admits that their best friend has been missing in the Mournland since the Day of Mourning. Weighted with the responsibility of leadership, Mercy has never searched for this friend, a blue-and-red warforged named Filch. If the characters offer to search for Filch, they find the ex-soldier in {@area area L4|1d9|x} of {@area Landro|1c7|x}.
zh_tw: 如果角色們與仁慈成為朋友，他們會在與戰俑的對話中感覺到有些東西重重地壓在仁慈心上。如果角色們詢問戰俑關於他們的憂鬱，仁慈請求私下與角色們交談。在私下裡，仁慈承認他們最好的朋友自悲悼之日以來一直在悲悼荒原失蹤。肩負領導責任的仁慈從未尋找過這位朋友，一個名叫菲爾奇的藍紅相間的戰俑。如果角色們提出尋找菲爾奇，他們會在{@area 蘭德羅|1c7|x}的{@area 區域L4|1d9|x}找到這位前士兵。

english: Regardless of the characters' reaction to this revelation or whether they offer to look for Filch, learning it counts as a secret for the purposes of {@area the Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
zh_tw: 不論角色們對這個啟示的反應如何，或者他們是否提出尋找菲爾奇，瞭解這一點在本書的{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中的{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則下都被視為一個秘密。

english: Cyran Veterans
zh_tw: 塞爾老兵

english: The characters encounter three lawful neutral {@creature Veteran||veterans} wandering through the mist. Once it's clear the characters aren't monsters or violent marauders, the wanderers introduce themselves as the Turquoise Spear, a small platoon of Cyran ex-soldiers that scours the Mournland for relics.
zh_tw: 角色們遇到了三個守序中立的{@creature Veteran||老兵}在霧中徘徊。一旦清楚角色們不是怪物或暴力掠奪者，這些流浪者就自我介紹為綠松石之矛，一個小型的塞爾前士兵小隊，他們在悲悼荒原搜尋遺物。

english: An orc artillerist named Kalyth speaks for her companions, two halfling soldiers named Dortle-Lynn and Grezan. Kalyth explains that the Turquoise Spear recently discovered a stockpile of {@item Docent|ERLW|Docents} taken from colossi. She wants to claim the {@i Docents} to sell in markets outside the Mournland, but she'd happily let the characters borrow a {@i Docent} beforehand. Unfortunately, Kalyth says, the {@i Docent} stockpile is in Ialos, a ruined village currently occupied by "rogue warforged." The Turquoise Spear attempted to infiltrate the ruins, but the warforged made it clear they wouldn't give up their stockpile without a fight.
zh_tw: 一位名為卡利思的獸人炮兵代表她的同伴發言，這兩位半身人士兵分別名為多特爾-琳恩與格雷贊。卡利思解釋說，翡翠之矛最近發現了一批從巨像中取出的{@item Docent|ERLW|指導附件}。她想要將{@i 指導附件}帶到悲悼荒原以外的市場上出售，但她很樂意讓角色們先借用一件{@i 指導附件}。不幸的是，卡利思表示，{@i 指導附件}的庫存位於伊阿洛斯，這是一個目前被"失控的戰爭鑄造體"佔據的廢墟村莊。翡翠之矛曾試圖潛入廢墟，但戰爭鑄造體明確表示，要想獲得這批庫存，必須透過戰鬥。

english: Kalyth doesn't know that the warforged are peaceful pilgrims, nor does she know that the pilgrims regard the {@i Docents} as sacred. Regardless of these facts, the veteran insists that these treasures rightfully belong to "living, breathing Cyrans."
zh_tw: 卡利思不知道這些戰俑是和平的朝聖者，也不知道朝聖者們將這些{@i 指導附件}視為神聖的。不管這些事實如何，這位老兵堅持認為這些寶藏理應屬於"活著、呼吸著的賽爾人"。

english: If the characters agree to help the Turquoise Spear, Kalyth gives the party directions to Ialos (see "{@area Ialos|1b2|x}" earlier in this chapter). She adds that the town's most prominent structure is a large metal windmill that glints faintly in the mist.
zh_tw: 如果角色們同意幫助綠松石之矛，卡利思會給隊伍指明前往伊阿洛斯的方向（見本章前面的"{@area 伊阿洛斯|1b2|x}"）。她補充說，該鎮最顯眼的建築是一座大型金屬風車，在霧中微弱地閃爍。

english: Blade Scouting Party
zh_tw: 刀刃偵察隊

english: As they pass between scorched thickets, the characters are ambushed by violent followers of a bloodthirsty warmonger called the Lord of Blades. These scouts have orders to search the region for a suitable colossus to turn into a new outpost, but they'll happily make time to slay a few people in their way. The scouting party includes two {@creature Blade Scout|VEoR|blade scouts} and one {@creature blade lieutenant|VEoR} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12} for both stat blocks).
zh_tw: 當角色們穿過焦黑的灌木叢時，他們遭到了一個渴望鮮血的戰爭販子——刀刃領主的暴力追隨者的伏擊。這些偵察兵接到命令在該地區尋找一個合適的巨像，將其轉變為一個新的前哨站，但如果路上有人，他們也樂於花時間殺戮。偵察隊包括兩名{@creature Blade Scout|VEoR|刀鋒偵察兵}和一名{@creature blade lieutenant|VEoR|刀刃副官}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}中的兩個統計資料塊）。

english: The blades fight until destroyed. They remain tight-lipped if captured, but if a character demands information and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check, the lieutenant says his party's commander is a powerful warforged headhunter named Glaive. "She'll make mincemeat out of you, interlopers!" the lieutenant scoffs. The blades can point the party to ruined colossi in the area but otherwise have no useful information.
zh_tw: 這些刀鋒戰士會戰鬥至被摧毀。如果被俘虜，他們會保持沉默，但是如果一個角色要求他們提供資訊併成功透過一個{@dc 15}魅力（{@skill Intimidation||威嚇}）檢定，副官會透露他們的指揮官是一個名為格萊夫（長柄刀）的強大構裝體獵頭者。"她會把你們這些闖入者剁成肉醬！"副官嘲笑道。刀鋒戰士可以指引隊伍前往該地區被毀的巨像，除此之外沒有其他有用的資訊。

english: Warforged try to survive in the blasted wilderness around Mount Ironrot
zh_tw: 戰俑試圖在鐵鏽山周圍的荒蕪荒野中生存

english: Finding a Docent
zh_tw: 尋找指導附件

english: The party's first task in the Mournland is to find a working {@item Docent|ERLW} to which they can tune the second piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}. In the course of their exploration, they learn that the only operational {@i Docent} in the region is in a storeroom in Ialos.
zh_tw: 隊伍在悲悼荒原的首要任務是找到一個可以工作的{@item Docent|ERLW|指導附件}，以便調整{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第二件碎片。在他們的探索過程中，他們得知該地區唯一執行中的{@i 指導附件}位於伊阿洛斯的一個儲藏室內。

english: The Dispute
zh_tw: 爭端

english: By the time the characters reach Ialos, they should have met the pilgrims and the Cyran veterans. Both sides might ask the characters to intervene and resolve their dispute. Here is a breakdown of the situation:
zh_tw: 到角色們到達伊阿洛斯的時候，他們應該已經遇到了朝聖者和塞爾老兵。雙方都可能請求角色介入並解決他們的爭端。以下是對情況的分析：

english: What Kalyth Wants
zh_tw: 卡利思想要

english: The Cyran veterans want to sell treasures from their ruined homeland in markets outside the Mournland. With the money, Kalyth says, she and her comrades can fund new, better lives for themselves.
zh_tw: 塞爾老兵想要在悲悼荒原外的市場出售他們毀滅的家園中的寶藏。卡利思說，有了這些錢，她和她的同伴們可以為自己資助新的生活，更好的生活。

english: What Mercy Wants
zh_tw: 仁慈想要

english: Mercy regards Docents (and any other items intended for warforged use) as sacred. The pilgrims believe that such objects belong in the hands of warforged who fought in the Last War.
zh_tw: 仁慈將指導附件（以及任何其他為戰俑使用的物品）視為神聖的。朝聖者們相信，這些物品應該掌握在那些在終末戰爭中戰鬥的戰俑手中。

english: What They'll Settle For
zh_tw: 他們願意接受

english: Ultimately, Kalyth's group wants money, and Mercy's group wants respect. If both parties get what they want, the dispute ends.
zh_tw: 最終，卡利思的團隊想要的是金錢，而仁慈的團隊想要的是尊重。如果雙方都能得到他們想要的，爭端就會結束。

english: Settling the Dispute
zh_tw: 解決爭端

english: Mercy doesn't understand that the Cyran veterans' true motivation is money, nor does Mercy recognize the value of the items in the pilgrims' possession. Though reluctant to bargain with the veterans, whom the pilgrims consider warmongers, Mercy can be persuaded to negotiate if the characters act as intermediaries.
zh_tw: 仁慈並不瞭解塞爾老兵真正的動機是金錢，也不認識朝聖者所擁有的物品的價值。儘管不願意與老兵們討價還價，朝聖者們認為他們是戰爭販子，但如果角色們充當中間人，仁慈可以被說服進行談判。

english: If the characters explain the veterans' financial need and convince Mercy that the veterans mean no harm, Mercy offers to give the characters the art objects kept in the pilgrims' storeroom. If a character succeeds on a {@dc 14} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check during this discussion, Mercy also offers the characters the {@item Ring of Feather Falling} in the storeroom.
zh_tw: 如果角色們解釋了老兵們的財務需求，並說服仁慈（仁慈）相信老兵們並無惡意，仁慈會提出將朝聖者儲藏室中的藝術品贈與角色們。如果在此討論中，某角色成功透過了一次 {@dc 14} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，仁慈還會將儲藏室中的 {@item Ring of Feather Falling||羽落戒指} 贈與角色們。

english: Kalyth doesn't realize that the pilgrims' have valuable art objects or a magic ring. If told about these treasures, Kalyth says the Cyran veterans would gladly take either option instead of the {@item Docent|ERLW|Docents}. If Mercy offers the ring as well, Kalyth insists the characters keep either the art or the ring, whichever they'd prefer, in thanks for brokering a peaceful resolution.
zh_tw: 卡利思沒有意識到朝聖者擁有有價值的藝術品或一枚魔法戒指。如果被告知這些寶藏，卡利思表示塞爾老兵很樂意接受這些選項之一，而不是{@item Docent|ERLW|指導附件}。如果仁慈也提供戒指，卡利思堅持讓角色們保留藝術品或戒指中的任何一個，以他們更喜歡的作為感謝，以換取促成和平解決爭端。

english: Helpful Information
zh_tw: 有用的資訊

english: If the resolution allows the warforged pilgrims to keep their {@i Docents} and no one is harmed in the dispute, once it's clear the characters are looking for a piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, Mercy tells the characters the following about Landro's unique power source:
zh_tw: 如果解決方案允許戰鑄巡禮者保留他們的{@i 指導附件}，並且在爭議中沒有人受到傷害，一旦清楚角色們正在尋找{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的一部分，仁慈會告訴角色們以下關於蘭德羅獨特動力源的資訊：

english: "I've heard tales of an unusual colossus called Landro powered not by a {@i Docent}, but by a device called a graymatter engine that incorporated part of an artifact—perhaps that's what you seek? The graymatter engine was said to generate a magical barrier around Landro, making it impossible to enter Landro except where the barrier has already been broken."
zh_tw: "我聽說過一個不同尋常的巨像，名叫蘭德羅，它不是由一個{@i 指導附件}驅動，而是由一個叫做灰質引擎的裝置驅動，這個裝置包含了部分神器——也許這就是你們所尋找的？據說灰質引擎在蘭德羅周圍產生了一個魔法屏障，使得除了屏障已經被打破的地方之外，進入蘭德羅是不可能的。"

english: If the characters negotiate a deal that the Turquoise Spear finds agreeable, Kalyth tells the party the following about the third rod piece:
zh_tw: 如果角色們協商出一項令綠松石之矛覺得可接受的交易，卡利思會告訴隊伍關於第三根杆件的以下資訊：

english: "Rumor has it there's a colossus powered by part of an artifact. Supposedly, if you remove this piece, the colossus will begin a self-destruct sequence, and there's no way to stop the colossus from detonating in a terrible conflagration."
zh_tw: "有傳言說有一個由神器部分驅動的巨像。據說，如果你移除這部分，巨像將開始自我毀滅程式，沒有辦法阻止巨像在一場可怕的火災中爆炸。"

english: Tuning the Rod
zh_tw: 調整魔杖

english: Regardless of which side, if any, the characters take in this conflict, the characters must pair the second piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} to the working {@item Docent|ERLW} in Ialos to continue the adventure. (A character need not be attuned to the {@i Docent} to pair the {@i Docent} to the rod piece.)
zh_tw: 無論角色在這場衝突中站在哪一方，或者是否選擇站隊，角色們必須將{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第二部分與伊阿洛斯中工作的{@item Docent|ERLW|指導附件}配對，以繼續冒險。（角色無需與{@i 指導附件}協調一致，就可以將{@i 指導附件}與魔杖部分配對。）

english: When a character touches the rod piece to the working {@i Docent}, the piece emits a loud, metallic ping. Thereafter, the piece points in the direction of the third rod piece inside Landro. If the party travels in that direction, the characters eventually reach the ruins of Landro (see the "Landro" section below).
zh_tw: 當角色將該權杖碎片觸碰至運作中的{@i 指導附件}時，碎片會發出響亮的金屬鳴響。此後，碎片將指向位於蘭德羅的第三塊權杖碎片所在方位。若隊伍朝該方向行進，角色們最終將抵達蘭德羅廢墟（詳見下文"蘭德羅"章節）。

english: Docent
zh_tw: 指導附件

english: A Docent
zh_tw: 一個指導附件

english: Landro
zh_tw: 蘭德羅

english: In the Last War's climactic final years, Cyran artificers crafted massive war machines called colossi. One of the nation's greatest specimens was deployed to the battlefield just as the Day of Mourning swept over Cyre and destroyed the nation. Instead of teleporting to the front lines, this colossus, called Landro, appeared miles away, half-buried in the face of a soaring mountain. Landro's crew was killed instantly.
zh_tw: 在最後一戰的高潮最後幾年，塞爾的工匠們製造了被稱為巨像的龐大戰爭機器。這個國家最偉大的樣本之一在悲悼之日席捲塞爾並摧毀這個國家時被部署到戰場。這個被稱為蘭德羅的巨像並沒有被傳送到前線，而是出現在數英里之外，半埋在一座高聳的山面上。蘭德羅的船員瞬間死亡。

english: Landro now looms empty and foreboding over Mount Ironrot's eastern flank. The experimental magic that powers Landro—an eldritch machine called the graymatter engine, fueled by a piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}—continues to function, creating a magical force field around the colossus and altering the gravity within it. In addition to the aberrant monsters and restless Undead that haunt Landro's remains, another faction is determined to plumb the ruins' depths: violent, zealous warriors loyal to the Lord of Blades.
zh_tw: 蘭德羅現在空蕩蕩的，籠罩在鐵鏽山東側的不祥陰影下。驅動蘭德羅的實驗性魔法——一個叫做灰質引擎的古老機器，由{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的一部分驅動——仍在運轉，它在巨像周圍創造了一個魔法力場，並改變了其內部的重力。除了在蘭德羅遺蹟中出沒的異常怪物和不安的不死生物，還有一個派系決心要探索廢墟的深處：對刀鋒領主忠誠的暴力、狂熱的戰士。

english: Lord of Blades' Strike Squad
zh_tw: 刀鋒領主的突擊隊

english: While the characters explore Landro, they're pursued by a warforged named {@creature Glaive|VEoR} (see the accompanying stat block). Glaive is a high-ranking commander loyal to the Lord of Blades. She has orders to find a ruined colossus suitable to transform into an outpost for the blades, and Landro fits this description perfectly. When she becomes aware of the party's presence in Landro, Glaive relishes the opportunity to destroy these "meddlesome interlopers," as she calls them.
zh_tw: 當角色們探索蘭德羅時，他們被一個名叫{@creature Glaive|VEoR|長柄刀}的戰俑追擊（見附帶的統計資料）。長柄刀是刀鋒領主的高階指揮官，她接到命令要找到一個適合改造成刀鋒前哨站的毀滅巨像，而蘭德羅完全符合這個描述。當她意識到隊伍在蘭德羅的存在時，長柄刀渴望抓住機會消滅這些她口中的"煩人的干涉者"。

english: Glaive is accompanied by two {@creature Blade Scout|VEoR|blade scouts} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) named Rack and Crunch. The three blades prefer to split up and sneak around Landro and the adjoining caves. They take turns using hit-and-run tactics to harry the characters, creating a sense that more blades lurk around every corner. As long as Glaive is around, the characters can't finish an uninterrupted long rest inside Landro or in the caves of Mount Ironrot.
zh_tw: 長柄刀由兩個名為架子和壓碎的{@creature Blade Scout|VEoR|刀鋒偵察兵}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）陪同。這三位刀鋒成員更傾向於分散開來，在蘭德羅和相鄰的洞穴中潛行。他們輪流使用打擊和逃跑的戰術來騷擾角色們，製造出每個角落都潛藏著更多刀鋒成員的感覺。只要長柄刀在附近，角色們就不能在蘭德羅或鐵鏽山的洞穴中完成不受幹擾的長休。

english: It's up to you where the characters encounter this strike squad, though Landro's location descriptions provide suggestions. If you don't want to ambush the characters with this encounter, it should occur in {@area area L27|208|x}. Glaive is devoted to her mission and fights the characters until destroyed, but her subordinates are less motivated. If Glaive is defeated, Rack and Crunch flee.
zh_tw: 角色們在哪裡遇到這支突擊隊由你決定，儘管蘭德羅的位置描述提供了一些建議。如果你不想用這次遭遇來伏擊角色們，它應該發生在{@area 區域L27|208|x}。長柄刀對她的任務非常投入，會與角色戰鬥直到被摧毀，但她的下屬們動機較弱。如果長柄刀被擊敗，架子和壓碎會逃跑。

english: Glaive
zh_tw: 長柄刀

english: Since the Mournland's earliest days, Glaive has wielded her namesake weapon in service to the Lord of Blades' bloody conquest of the blighted region. Among the blades, Glaive is best known for her talent at self-modification. "Glaive" is etched onto the back of her neck-plate. It is the only name Glaive has ever known, and fellow blades don't dare call her anything else. Mournland adventurers, however, refer to the terrifying commander by another name: Kill Switch.
zh_tw: 自從悲悼荒原的早期開始，長柄刀就以她的名字命名的武器為刀鋒領主對這片荒蕪地區的血腥征服服務。在刀鋒中，長柄刀最出名的是她的自我改造能力。"長柄刀"被刻在她的頸板背面。這是長柄刀唯一知道的名字，同伴們不敢叫她別的。然而，悲悼荒原的冒險家們用另一個名字稱呼這位可怕的指揮官：致命開關。

english: Entering Landro
zh_tw: 進入蘭德羅

english: The invisible barrier described in the "Landro Features" section below makes it impossible to enter the colossus via typical means. The barrier is damaged in three places, allowing ingress via paths along Mount Ironrot into {@area areas L5|1da|x}, {@area L11|1e7|x}, and {@area L16|1f4|x} of the colossus. {@adventure Map 4.3|VEoR|4|Map 4.3: Landro} includes a side view of Landro and the paths that lead into the colossus's interior.
zh_tw: 在"蘭德羅特點"部分描述的無形屏障使得透過典型手段進入巨像變得不可能。屏障在三個地方受損，允許透過沿著鐵鏽山的路徑進入巨像的{@area 區域L5|1da|x}、{@area L11|1e7|x}和{@area L16|1f4|x}。{@adventure 地圖 4.3|VEoR|4|Map 4.3: Landro}包括了蘭德羅的側檢視以及通往巨像內部的路徑。

english: The easiest way to enter the colossus is through the mountain caves that lead to area L5. The characters can also search higher up the mountain along outdoor paths for the entrances to caverns that lead to areas L11 and L16. Searching for area L11 takes {@dice 2d4} hours, and during the characters' search, a hungry {@creature roc} ambushes them. Searching for area L16 takes {@dice 3d4} hours, and during the characters' search, they stumble on a nest with two {@creature Roc||rocs} and one roc egg the height of a human. The angry roc parents attack the characters, though the rocs don't pursue if the characters flee.
zh_tw: 進入巨像最簡單的方法是透過通往區域L5的山洞。角色們也可以沿著山上的戶外路徑搜尋通往區域L11的洞穴入口。搜尋區域L11需要{@dice 2d4}小時，在角色們的搜尋過程中，一隻飢餓的{@creature roc||鵬鳥}伏擊了他們。搜尋區域L16需要{@dice 3d4}小時，在角色們的搜尋過程中，他們偶然發現了一個巢穴，裡面有兩隻{@creature Roc||鵬鳥}和一隻與人類身高相當的鵬鳥蛋。憤怒的鵬鳥父母攻擊了角色們，儘管如果角色們逃跑，鵬鳥們不會追擊。

english: Landro Features
zh_tw: 蘭德羅特徵

english: The following features are common to all areas of Landro unless otherwise noted.
zh_tw: 除非另有說明，以下特徵適用於蘭德羅的所有區域。

english: Antigravity Magic
zh_tw: 反重力魔法

english: The piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} linked to the graymatter engine creates special gravity-altering effects in parts of Landro. The areas affected by these effects are denoted on {@adventure map 4.3|VEoR|4|Map 4.3: Landro} as the swirled features in {@area areas L5|1da|x}, {@area L6|1dc|x}, {@area L7|1de|x}, {@area L8|1df|x}, and {@area L9|1e1|x}. These have the following effects:
zh_tw: 與灰物質引擎相連的{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的碎片在蘭德羅的部分區域產生了特殊的重力改變效果。這些受影響的區域在{@adventure 地圖 4.3|VEoR|4|Map 4.3: Landro}中標記為{@area 區域L5|1da|x}、{@area L6|1dc|x}、{@area L7|1de|x}、{@area L8|1df|x}和{@area L9|1e1|x}中的漩渦狀特徵。這些區域具有以下效果：

english: Antigravity Wells
zh_tw: 反重力井

english: Landro's ankles, legs, knees, hips, spine, and elbow are filled with magical energy meant to allow the colossus's body to bend and rotate freely. Creatures and objects can enter and exit these permeable "antigravity wells" like any normal space. While inside an antigravity well, a creature is affected by a {@spell Levitate} spell (no saving throw). Regular notches in the walls make it relatively easy for creatures to move up or down a well to reach other areas of the colossus.
zh_tw: 蘭德羅的腳踝、腿部、膝蓋、臀部、脊柱和肘部充滿了魔法能量，旨在允許巨像的身體自由彎曲和旋轉。生物和物體可以像進入任何正常空間一樣進出這些可滲透的"反重力井"。在反重力井內，生物會受到一個{@spell Levitate||浮空術}法術的影響（無需豁免）。牆壁上的常規凹槽使得生物相對容易地沿著井上下移動，以到達巨像的其他區域。

english: Gravity Tiles
zh_tw: 重力瓦片

english: Landro's upper levels are enchanted with gravity magic that keeps passengers safely rooted to the floor. Creatures can move across the floor in {@area areas L20|1fb|x}–{@area L28|20a|x} normally, no matter the orientation of Landro's upper body.
zh_tw: 蘭德羅的上層區域被施加了重力魔法，使乘客安全地固定在地板上。無論蘭德羅的上半身如何朝向，生物都可以在 {@area 區域L20|1fb|x} 至 {@area L28|20a|x} 正常地在地板上移動。

english: The effects of the antigravity wells and the gravity tiles end if Landro's shutdown sequence is activated (see the "{@area Shutdown Sequence|215|x}" section later in this chapter).
zh_tw: 如果蘭德羅的關閉序列被啟用（見本章後面的'{@area 關閉序列|215|x}'部分），反重力井和重力瓦片的效果將結束。

english: Ceilings
zh_tw: 天花板

english: The height of the ceilings varies considerably in Landro; see individual area descriptions for details. In {@area areas L1|1d3|x}–{@area L4|1d9|x} of the cave network, the ceilings are 15 feet high unless otherwise noted.
zh_tw: 蘭德羅的天花板高度變化很大；詳情請參閱各個區域的描述。在洞穴網路的{@area 區域L1|1d3|x}至{@area L4|1d9|x}中，除非另有說明，天花板高度為 15 尺。

english: Graymatter Fluid
zh_tw: 灰質流體

english: A steady stream of thin, oily liquid leaks from the graymatter engine and runs into other parts of Landro and the connected caverns. This graymatter fluid is the engine's sensory appendage. The graymatter engine can't move or control this liquid, but it has {@sense blindsight} within 60 feet of anywhere the graymatter fluid touches.
zh_tw: 一股細薄的油性液體從灰質引擎中不斷滲出，流進蘭德羅的其他部分以及相連的洞穴中。這種灰質流體是引擎的感官延伸。灰質引擎不能移動或控制這種液體，但它在灰質流體接觸的任何地方60尺範圍內具有{@sense blindsight||盲視}。

english: When a creature looks at a puddle of graymatter fluid, the creature sees a twisted, monstrous version of itself with an inscrutable expression rather than its actual reflection. A creature that ingests any amount of graymatter fluid must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or experience the following effects:
zh_tw: 當一個生物看向一灘灰色物質液體時，它會看到一個扭曲、怪異的自己，帶著難以捉摸的表情，而不是它實際的倒影。任何攝入灰色物質液體的生物都必須成功透過一次{@dc 14}體質豁免檢定，否則會經歷以下效果：

english: Altered Speech
zh_tw: 改變的言語

english: The creature gains telepathy to a range of 30 feet but loses the ability to speak. Any attempts to speak generate only incoherent babbling. This effect ends after the creature finishes a long rest.
zh_tw: 生物獲得了30尺範圍內的心靈感應能力，但失去了說話的能力。任何嘗試說話都會產生只是含糊不清的胡言亂語。這種效果在生物完成一次長休息後結束。

english: Psychic Damage
zh_tw: 心靈傷害

english: For each ounce of graymatter fluid consumed, the creature takes 11 ({@dice 2d10}) psychic damage. A creature killed by this damage rises as a {@creature zombie} {@dice 1d4} hours after dying.
zh_tw: 生物每喝下一盎司灰質流體，就受到11（{@dice 2d10}）點心靈傷害。被這種傷害殺死的生物，會在死亡{@dice 1d4}小時後化為{@creature zombie||喪屍}起身。

english: Invisible Barrier
zh_tw: 隱形屏障

english: The graymatter engine creates an invisible barrier around the intact parts of Landro. Nothing can penetrate the barrier, which is similar to the effect of a {@spell Wall of Force} spell, though a {@spell Disintegrate} spell can't destroy it. The barrier is broken in compromised sections of Landro ({@area areas L5|1da|x}, {@area L11|1e7|x}, and {@area L16|1f4|x}).
zh_tw: 灰質引擎在蘭德羅的完好部分周圍創造了一個隱形屏障。任何東西都無法穿透這個屏障，它類似於{@spell Wall of Force||力場牆}法術的效果，儘管{@spell Disintegrate||解離術}無法摧毀它。屏障在蘭德羅受損的部分（{@area 區域L5|1da|x}、{@area L11|1e7|x} 和 {@area L16|1f4|x}）被打破。

english: Lighting
zh_tw: 光照

english: Landro's interior areas and the adjoining caves are dark. Area descriptions assume the characters have a light source or some other means of seeing in the dark. During the day, the parts of Landro exposed to the outdoors are shrouded in the same {@book lightly obscuring|PHB|8|Vision and Light} mist as the rest of Mount Ironrot (see "{@area Exploring Mount Ironrot|1a4|x}" earlier in this chapter).
zh_tw: 蘭德羅的內部區域以及相鄰的洞穴都是黑暗的。區域描述假設角色有光源或其他在黑暗中視物的手段。白天時，蘭德羅暴露在室外的部分與鐵鏽山的其他地方一樣，被{@book 輕微遮蔽|PHB|8|Vision and Light}的霧氣所籠罩（參見本章前面"{@area 探索鐵鏽山|1a4|x}"部分）。

english: Walls
zh_tw: 牆壁

english: As long as the graymatter engine is active, Landro's body—which is made from steel-plated stone blocks—is immune to damage. The adjacent caves are made of naturally formed stone.
zh_tw: 只要灰質引擎處於活躍狀態，由鋼製石板構成的蘭德羅的身體就免疫於傷害。相鄰的洞穴是由天然形成的石頭構成的。

english: Landro Locations
zh_tw: 蘭德羅地點

english: The following locations are keyed to map 4.3.
zh_tw: 以下地點對應地圖4.3。

english: Map 4.3: Landro
zh_tw: 地圖 4.3: 蘭德羅

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: L1: Cave Entrance
zh_tw: L1: 山洞入口

english: The jagged cave entrance in the side of the mountain resembles a yawning maw. Warped stalactites droop at odd angles like monstrous fangs. A shallow stream of thin, gray liquid dribbles from the hole. Inside the cave, darkness awaits.
zh_tw: 山側的鋸齒狀洞穴入口像一個張開的大口。扭曲的鐘乳石以奇怪的角度垂下，像怪物的獠牙。從洞中滴出一條淺淺的灰色液體細流。洞穴內部，黑暗在等待。

english: The shallow stream of graymatter fluid originates from the upper levels of Landro.
zh_tw: 灰質流體的細小溪流源自蘭德羅的上層區域。

english: L2: Cave Graveyard
zh_tw: L2: 洞穴墓地

english: The corpses of recently fallen human soldiers bearing fine weapons and well-oiled armor lie scattered about this musty cavern.
zh_tw: 最近倒下的人類士兵的屍體，攜帶著精良的武器和塗油保養良好的盔甲，散落在這個發黴的洞穴中。

english: A character who examines the area and succeeds on a {@dc 12} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check notices a thick layer of powdery residue has settled across the scene, suggesting the remains have possibly been here for years. Anyone who examined the thin, gray liquid in the cave entrance realizes that the white powder is residue from this liquid.
zh_tw: 一個檢查該區域併成功透過 {@dc 12} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定的角色會注意到現場佈滿了一層厚厚的粉末狀殘留物，這表明這些遺骸可能已經在這裡存在多年。任何檢查洞穴入口處那薄層灰色液體的人都會意識到，這些白色粉末是該液體的殘留物。

english: The corpses are Cyran soldiers who were instantly killed by mysterious magic on the Day of Mourning. The Mournland's magic has preserved their bodies, which a character can determine by examining the corpses and succeeding on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) or Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check.
zh_tw: 這些屍體是塞爾士兵，他們在悲悼之日那天被神秘的魔法瞬間殺死。悲悼荒原的魔法儲存了他們的遺體，角色可以透過檢查屍體併成功透過一個 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）或感知（{@skill Medicine||醫療}）檢定來確定這一點。

english: If a creature picks up the armor or weapons, two {@creature Flying Sword||flying swords} and two suits of {@creature animated armor} rise from the scattered gear to reclaim the stolen treasure. They attack the thief and the thief's allies, but they don't pursue foes outside this area.
zh_tw: 如果生物拿起盔甲或武器，兩把{@creature Flying Sword||凌空劍}和兩套{@creature animated armor||活化盔甲}將從散落的裝備中升起，以奪回被盜的寶藏。它們會攻擊小偷及其盟友，但不會追擊這個區域外的敵人。

english: L3: Cave Shack
zh_tw: L3: 山洞小屋

english: Rickety metal sheets separate the east end of this cave from the rest of the complex. Aggressive growling emanates from behind the sheets.
zh_tw: 搖搖欲墜的金屬板將這個洞穴的東端與綜合體的其餘部分隔開。從板後傳來了攻擊性的咆哮聲。

english: This area is separated from the rest of the caves by rickety metal sheets scavenged from the debris of Landro's right foot ({@area area L5|1da|x}). The area serves as a shelter for three Brelish soldiers who were transformed by the strange magic of the Day of Mourning. Use the {@creature fomorian} stat block for each soldier, except they are Large instead of Huge.
zh_tw: 這個區域透過從蘭德羅右腳的廢墟中撿來的破舊金屬板與洞穴的其餘部分隔開（參見{@area 區域L5|1da|x}）。這個區域是三個布魯蘭士兵的避難所，他們在悲悼之日那天被奇怪的魔法改變了。使用{@creature fomorian||廢陋巨人}的統計資料塊來代表每個士兵，除了他們是大型而不是巨型。

english: The cowardly soldiers make occasional forays into the caves to smash rats or other easy prey. They attack only if they can surprise the characters, perhaps at the narrow tunnel to the north (area L4), or if the characters are already in a fight with Glaive's squad. The soldiers know nothing of Landro other than to avoid drinking the graymatter fluid.
zh_tw: 這些膽小的士兵偶爾會進入洞穴去打砸老鼠或其他容易捕獲的獵物。他們只有在能出其不意地攻擊角色時才會攻擊，或許是在北部的狹窄隧道（區域 L4），或者如果角色們已經在與格萊夫的小隊戰鬥。這些士兵除了知道要避免喝灰質流體之外，對蘭德羅一無所知。

english: L4: Bottleneck
zh_tw: L4: 瓶頸

english: If the characters haven't run into significant challenges yet, Glaive and one of her blade scout companions attack the characters from both ends of this narrow tunnel. After all combatants have taken a turn, the attackers flee into Landro and hide for another surprise attack.
zh_tw: 如果角色們還沒有遇到重大挑戰，格拉伊芙（長柄刀）和她的一名刀鋒偵察兵同伴會從這條狹窄隧道的兩端攻擊角色們。所有戰鬥者都進行了一次行動後，攻擊者會逃入蘭德羅並藏起來，準備再次突襲。

english: Regardless of whether the characters fight the strike squad, if they search this area, they find a comatose {@creature warforged warrior|VEoR} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) in the northeast corner of this area. A character who tries to rouse the warrior and succeeds at a {@dc 18} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check wakes the warrior, who identifies themself as Filch. Filch wandered in here shortly after the Day of Mourning looking for their best friend, the warforged Mercy (see the "{@area Warforged Pilgrims|1b6|x}" section earlier in this chapter). The stress of the situation caused Filch's comatose state. Mercy and Filch would be happy to be reunited.
zh_tw: 無論角色是否與突擊隊戰鬥，如果他們搜尋這個區域，他們會在這個區域的東北角發現一個處於昏迷狀態的{@creature warforged warrior|VEoR|戰鑄戰士}（參見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）。如果一個角色試圖喚醒這個戰士，併成功透過一個{@dc 18}魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，戰士將醒來，並自我介紹為菲爾奇。菲爾奇在悲悼之日之後不久就來到這裡，尋找他最好的朋友，戰鬥構裝戰士仁慈（參見本章前面的"{@area 戰俑朝聖者|1b6|x}"部分）。這種情況的壓力導致了菲爾奇的昏迷狀態。仁慈和菲爾奇會很高興能重逢。

english: Filch
zh_tw: 偷竊

english: L5: Right Foot
zh_tw: L5: 右腳

english: Aside from a narrow passage, the 10-foot-tall toe section of the colossus's foot has collapsed. Oversize, skull-shaped mushrooms pockmark the heap of debris that marks the rough division between the colossus's interior and the adjacent cave. At the chamber's far end, motes of dust and debris float in a cylinder of glowing, green light that stretches from floor to ceiling. The cylinder of light continues upward into Landro's leg.
zh_tw: 除了一條狹窄的通道，巨人腳部的10尺高的腳趾部分已經坍塌。巨大的、頭骨形狀的蘑菇點綴著標誌著巨人內部和相鄰洞穴之間粗糙分界線的碎片堆。在房間的遠端，塵埃和碎片的微粒在一根從地板延伸到天花板的發光的綠色光柱中漂浮。光柱繼續向上延伸進入蘭德羅的腿部。

english: Within the mushroom patch are two {@creature Shrieker||shriekers}. The shriekers' high-pitched screams might attract the Brelish soldiers from area L3 or alert one of Glaive's scouts to the characters' location.
zh_tw: 在蘑菇地裡有兩隻{@creature Shrieker||尖叫菌}。這些尖叫菌的高聲尖叫可能會吸引來自區域L3的布魯蘭士兵，或者提醒長柄刀的一個偵察兵注意到角色們的位置。

english: The 20-foot-diameter cylinder of light extending up at the back of this foot is an antigravity well (see the "{@area Antigravity Wells|1cc|x}" section earlier in this chapter). The well connects to Landro's right hip (see {@area area L8|1df|x}).
zh_tw: 從這隻腳後方向上延伸的直徑20尺的圓柱形光柱是一個反重力井（參見本章前面的"{@area 反重力井|1cc|x}"部分）。這個井與蘭德羅的右臀相連（參見{@area 區域L8|1df|x}）。

english: L6: Left Foot
zh_tw: L6: 左腳

english: The stone door at the toe end of this hollow foot has broken in several parts and is jammed shut. Through the cracks in the door, you can see the solid stone of the surrounding mountain.
zh_tw: 這個空洞的腳趾末端的石門在幾個部分上已經破裂並且卡住了。透過門上的裂縫，你可以看到周圍山脈的堅固石頭。

english: A character who searches the area and succeeds on a {@dc 11} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check spots a dusty, lusterless gemstone lying in a corner. This is an id crystal, which the graymatter engine's consciousness can be transferred into (see the "{@area Crystal Companion|214|x}" section later in this chapter).
zh_tw: 一個搜尋該區域併成功透過{@dc 11}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定的角色會發現角落裡躺著一顆佈滿灰塵、毫無光澤的寶石。這是一顆id水晶，可以將灰質引擎的意識轉移到其中（詳見本章後面的"{@area 水晶夥伴|214|x}"部分）。

english: L7: Leg Shafts
zh_tw: L7: 腿部通道

english: Each of Landro's 130-foot-tall legs contains two 20-foot-diameter, cylindrical antigravity wells, one in its calf and one in its thigh, connected at the knee by a 20-foot-diameter antigravity sphere.
zh_tw: 蘭德羅每條130尺高的腿內含有兩個直徑20尺的圓柱形反重力井，一個在小腿部位，一個在大腿部位，透過一個直徑20尺的反重力球在膝蓋處連線。

english: L8: Armory
zh_tw: L8: 軍械庫

english: The two 20-foot-diameter antigravity spheres in this 30-foot-tall chamber serve as Landro's hip sockets. Gaps in the floor and ceiling of each sphere grant access to the colossus's legs (area L7) and abdomen (areas L9–{@area L11|1e7|x}), respectively. A 10-foot-wide antigravity well cylinder serves as a spine, connecting to area L9.
zh_tw: 這個30尺高的房間內的兩個20尺直徑的反重力球體作為蘭德羅的髖關節。每個球體的地板和天花板上的間隙分別提供了通往巨人腿部（區域L7）和腹部（區域L9-{@area L11|1e7|x}）的通道。一個10尺寬的反重力井柱作為脊柱，連線到區域L9。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A weapon rack on the wall opposite Landro's spine contains two {@item Halberd|PHB|halberds} and one {@item hand crossbow|PHB} with a case of 20 {@item Crossbow Bolts (20)|PHB|bolts}.
zh_tw: 蘭德羅的脊柱對面牆上的武器架上放著兩把{@item Halberd|PHB|長戟}和一把帶有20支{@item Crossbow Bolts (20)|PHB|弩箭}的{@item hand crossbow|PHB|手弩}。

english: L9: Blocked Antigravity Well
zh_tw: L9: 阻塞的反重力井

english: Rubble in area L18 blocks travel through Landro's spinal antigravity well above this floor. Otherwise, this area is empty.
zh_tw: 區域L18中的瓦礫阻擋了透過蘭德羅脊柱反重力井的通行。除此之外，這個區域是空的。

english: L10: Artificer Quarters
zh_tw: L10: 奇械師宿舍

english: Absolute silence fills this tranquil sleeping area. The walls are lined with wooden bunk beds draped in green and purple quilts. Motes of dust drift with a peculiar languidness. A woman sleeps in one of the beds.
zh_tw: 這個寧靜的休息區充滿了絕對的寂靜。牆壁上排列著掛著綠色和紫色被子的木製雙層床。塵埃顆粒以一種奇特的悠閒方式漂浮。一個女人睡在其中的一張床上。

english: This 20-foot-high chamber is affected by a persistent {@spell Silence} spell. A {@spell Dispel Magic} spell ends the effect.
zh_tw: 這個20尺高的房間受到持續的{@spell Silence||沉默術}法術影響。一個{@spell Dispel Magic||解除魔法}法術可以結束這個效果。

english: Aura of Slumber
zh_tw: 沉睡之光

english: Lingering in this chamber causes creatures to feel drowsy. A creature that ends its turn in this chamber must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition unconscious} condition for 1 minute. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is unconscious for 1 hour instead. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature uses an action to wake it.
zh_tw: 在這個房間中停留會使生物感到昏昏欲睡。一個生物如果在這個房間中結束其回合，必須成功透過一次 {@dc 13} 體質豁免檢定，否則將獲得 {@condition unconscious||昏迷} 狀態，持續1分鐘。如果豁免檢定失敗且差值達到5或更多，該生物將昏迷1小時。該生物會在受到傷害或其他生物使用動作喚醒它時醒來。

english: Sleeping Ghost
zh_tw: 沉睡的幽靈

english: The figure dozing in one of the beds is the spirit of Alamar-Vatashi, a soldier who overslept on the Day of Mourning. In life, Alamar-Vatashi was a kalashtar, a Humanoid bound to a dream-spirit called a quori. The Day of Mourning caused her to remain asleep in this chamber. She is a neutral good {@creature ghost} who can speak Common; she can also communicate telepathically within a range of 30 feet.
zh_tw: 在其中一張床上打盹的身影是阿拉瑪－瓦塔希的靈魂，一個在悲悼之日睡過頭的士兵。在生前，阿拉瑪－瓦塔希是一個卡拉斯塔，一個與被稱為庫瑞的夢境精靈繫結的類人生物。悲悼之日使她在這個房間裡一直沉睡。她是中立善良的{@creature ghost||幽魂}，能說通用語；她還能在30尺範圍內進行心靈感應交流。

english: If Alamar-Vatashi awakens and becomes aware of the characters, she telepathically asks why they aren't sleeping and yawns deeply. If questioned, she says she's too tired to talk, but she offers to share her dreams with the characters if they wish. A character who touches Alamar-Vatashi's incorporeal palm experiences a vivid vision of the day Landro came to this mountain on the Day of Mourning. This touch doesn't damage the character. Read or paraphrase the following to describe the vision:
zh_tw: 如果阿拉瑪－瓦塔希甦醒並意識到角色們的存在，她會透過心靈感應詢問為什麼他們不睡覺，並深深地打了個哈欠。如果被問及，她說她太累了不想說話，但如果角色們願意，她願意與他們分享她的夢想。一個觸控到阿拉瑪－瓦塔希無形手掌的角色會經歷一個生動的幻象，那就是蘭德羅在悲悼之日來到這座山上的那一天。這種觸控不會對角色造成傷害。閱讀或意譯以下內容以描述這個幻象：

english: As if through the eyes of a soaring bird, you see a titanic stone statue standing amid a circle of glowing sigils. A dozen robed figures, as small as ants, stand around the circle and murmur arcane words, their heads bowed in concentration. Impossibly, the stone colossus begins to levitate.
zh_tw: 彷彿透過飛翔的鳥的眼睛，你看到一尊巨大的石雕站立在一圈發光的符咒之中。一打穿著長袍的人影，小得像螞蟻，站在圓圈周圍，低聲念著奧術咒語，他們的頭因專注而低垂。難以置信的是，石質巨像開始懸浮。

english: As silvery light swirls around the colossus, the ground quakes, breaking the mages' focus. The colossus is buried in crumbling stone, surrounded by shifting mountains and sickly gray clouds. Years pass in rapid succession while the colossus stands like a stone sentinel, stuck inside the craggy mountainside.
zh_tw: 當銀色光芒在巨人周圍旋轉時，地面震動，打亂了法師們的專注。巨人被埋在破碎的石頭中，周圍是移動的山脈和病態的灰色雲朵。歲月在快速連續中流逝，而巨人像一個石制哨兵一樣站立，被困在崎嶇的山腰中。

english: The vision lasts only a moment but feels like it lasts hours to the creature experiencing the vision. A character who receives this vision gains the benefits of a short rest. No character can receive the vision more than once.
zh_tw: 這個幻象只持續了片刻，但對經歷幻象的生物來說卻感覺像過了幾個小時。接收到這個幻象的角色獲得了短休的好處。沒有角色能接收到這個幻象超過一次。

english: L11: Workshop
zh_tw: L11: 工作室

english: Fine tinkering tools, woodcarving equipment, and metal plates hang from hooks above a stone table and counters in this crowded workshop. In one corner, a faucet juts from a tall steel vat. The opposite corner has collapsed, allowing access to a tunnel beyond. A rivulet of graymatter fluid oozes across the floor and down the tunnel.
zh_tw: 在這個擁擠的工作坊裡，精細的修補工具、木雕裝置和金屬板掛在石頭桌子上方的鉤子上。在一個角落裡，一個水龍頭從一個高大的鋼桶中伸出。對面的角落已經塌陷，可以進入一個隧道。一股灰質液體在地板上滲出，流向隧道。

english: The ceiling here is 20 feet high. Any characters proficient in {@item tinker's tools|PHB} or {@item woodcarver's tools|PHB} can assemble a set of either tools from the items in this room with 1 minute of work.
zh_tw: 這裡的天花板高20尺。任何精通{@item tinker's tools|PHB|修補工具}或{@item woodcarver's tools|PHB|木雕工具}的角色可以在1分鐘內從這個房間裡的物品中組裝一套這些工具。

english: Repair Paste
zh_tw: 修復膏

english: The steel vat contains magical paste specially formulated for strengthening Constructs. Turning the knob on the attached faucet releases a palm-size dose of paste. A creature can take 1 minute to apply a dose of the paste to a Construct to grant it 10 {@book temporary hit points|PHB|9|Temporary Hit Points}. Once dispensed, a dose of paste loses its magic if not applied within 1 minute. The vat contains three doses of paste.
zh_tw: 這個鋼製大桶裝有專為加強構裝生物而特製的魔法膏。轉動附帶水龍頭上的旋鈕會釋放出一份手掌大小的膏體。生物可以在1分鐘內將一份膏體塗抹在構裝生物上，賦予它10點{@book 臨時生命值|PHB|9|Temporary Hit Points}。一旦釋放，如果1分鐘內不塗抹，一份膏體會失去其魔法效力。桶內含有三份膏體。

english: L12: Lost Soldier
zh_tw: L12: 失蹤的士兵

english: The ghostly image of a human Cyran soldier paces nervously at the bottom of this sloping cavern. On seeing you, the figure smiles with relief and waves, shouting, "Please, help me find my comrades!"
zh_tw: 這個斜坡洞穴底部，一個人類塞爾士兵的幽靈形象緊張地踱步。看到你後，這個形象帶著釋然的微笑揮手，大喊："請幫我找到我的同伴！"

english: The lawful good {@creature ghost}, who says its name is Chandry, pleads with the characters to help it reunite with its comrades inside Landro.
zh_tw: 這個守序善良的{@creature ghost||幽魂}，自稱其名字是錢德里，懇求角色們幫助它與在蘭德羅內的同伴團聚。

english: Suddenly, Chandry cries out with joy and sprints toward the colossus. When the ghost comes within arm's reach of Landro, it blinks out of existence. Chandry then reappears at the bottom of the cave with no memory of the last few moments' events and asks the characters for their help again. Every time Chandry approaches Landro, the ghost disappears and reappears in the same way. If the characters tell Chandry about the fallen soldiers in {@area area L2|1d5|x}, the ghost is put to rest and doesn't reappear.
zh_tw: 突然，錢德里歡呼一聲，朝著巨像衝去。當鬼魂來到蘭德羅的觸手可及之處時，它突然消失了。錢德里隨後重新出現在洞穴的底部，對剛才發生的事情毫無記憶，並再次向角色們尋求幫助。每次錢德里接近蘭德羅時，鬼魂都會以相同的方式消失並重現。如果角色們告訴錢德里關於{@area 區域L2|1d5|x}中倒下的士兵們的事，鬼魂就會安息，不再出現。

english: L13: Dragonshard Pool
zh_tw: L13: 龍晶池

english: A strange pool found inside Landro has magical effects on items dipped into it
zh_tw: 在蘭德羅內部發現的一個奇異水池對浸入其中的物品有魔法效果

english: The deep pool of gray liquid in the corner of this chamber glitters oddly. Around the pool, bones and battered armaments litter the cave floor.
zh_tw: 這個房間角落裡的深灰色液體池閃爍著奇異的光芒。在池子周圍，骨頭和破舊的武器散落在洞穴地面上。

english: Pulverized dragonshards—special gemstones native to Khorvaire—mixed with the graymatter fluid here, creating a pool with strange magical properties.
zh_tw: 粉碎的龍鱗石——一種特有於科瓦雷的寶石——與這裡的灰質液體混合，形成了一個具有奇異魔法屬性的池子。

english: Enchanted Pool
zh_tw: 魔法池塘

english: A {@spell Detect Magic} spell reveals an aura of enchantment magic emanating from the pool. Drinking from it exposes a creature to graymatter fluid (see the "{@area Graymatter Fluid|1ce|x}" section earlier in this chapter). When a nonmagical item is dipped into the pool, roll on the Dragonshard Pool Effects table to determine what happens to the item. An item can be affected by the pool only once; subsequent exposures have no effect.
zh_tw: 一個{@spell Detect Magic||偵測魔法}法術會揭示出一個從池中散發出的附魔魔法光暈。飲用它的液體會讓生物接觸到灰質流體（參見本章前面的"{@area 灰質流體|1ce|x}"部分）。當一個非魔法物品被浸入池中時，擲骰子並根據龍晶池效果表來確定該物品會發生什麼變化。一件物品只能被池子影響一次；後續的接觸不會產生任何效果。

english: The pool has 4 charges. It expends 1 charge each time an item is dipped into it. The pool regains all expended charges daily at dawn.
zh_tw: 這個池子有4次充能。每次將物品浸入其中，都會消耗1次充能。每天黎明時，池子會恢復所有消耗的充能。

english: Dragonshard Pool Effects
zh_tw: 龍晶池效應

english: d6
zh_tw: d6

english: Effect
zh_tw: 效應

english: The item is destroyed.
zh_tw: 物品被摧毀了。

english: The item gains a cosmetic defect such as discoloration, mild warping, or mysterious engravings.
zh_tw: 該物品獲得了諸如變色、輕微變形或神秘雕刻等的外觀缺陷。

english: The item craves more graymatter fluid. Every time the item's wielder comes within 30 feet of graymatter fluid, the item emits a high-pitched hum that lasts until the character moves away from the fluid.
zh_tw: 物品渴望更多的灰質液體。每當物品的使用者靠近灰質液體30尺以內時，物品就會發出一種持續的高音訊，直到該角色遠離液體。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A suit of {@item chain mail|PHB}, two {@item Shortsword|PHB|shortswords}, and a {@item mace|PHB} lie on the floor. All are twisted and malformed, as if they were affected by a roll of 3 or 4 on the Dragonshard Pool Effects table.
zh_tw: 一套{@item chain mail|PHB|鍊甲}、兩把{@item Shortsword|PHB|短劍}和一把{@item mace|PHB|硬頭錘}躺在地板上。它們全部扭曲變形，就好像它們受到了龍晶池效應表上3或4的結果影響一樣。

english: L14: Blazebear Den
zh_tw: L14: 焰熊巢穴

english: A pile of leather scraps, broken bones, and sludgy offal fills a corner of this cave. Nesting in this nauseating pile is a monstrous beast that resembles a bear with three long, fleshy tentacles sprouting from its skull. Each tentacle is topped with a glowing, knobby lump of flesh.
zh_tw: 一堆皮料碎片、碎骨和泥濘的內臟填滿了這個洞穴的角落。在這個令人作嘔的堆中築巢的是一隻類似熊的怪獸，它的頭骨上長出了三條長長的肉質觸手，每條觸手頂部都有一個發光的、多節的肉塊。

english: The monster dwelling here is a {@creature blazebear|VEoR} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}). It attacks any creature it sees and fights until destroyed.
zh_tw: 居住在這裡的怪物是一隻{@creature blazebear|VEoR|焰熊}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）。它攻擊任何它看到的生物，並戰鬥直到被摧毀。

english: L15: Overhang
zh_tw: L15: 懸垂部分

english: Two tunnels branch off opposite sides of this thirty-foot-high cavern. The tunnels reconvene at an overhang fifteen feet above the eastern passage.
zh_tw: 兩個隧道從這個三十尺高的洞穴的相對兩側分叉。這些隧道在東部通道上方十五尺的懸垂處重新匯合。

english: Assuming they haven't both been defeated, one of Glaive's {@creature Blade Scout|VEoR|blade scouts} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) hides on the overhang here while the other scout hides down the eastern tunnel, near area L16. When the characters are within range, the scouts fire their crossbows at a random character.
zh_tw: 假設他們兩個都沒有被擊敗，長柄刀的一名{@creature Blade Scout|VEoR|刀鋒偵察兵}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）隱藏在這個突出部分，而另一名偵察兵隱藏在東邊的隧道里，靠近區域L16。當角色們進入射程時，偵察兵們會用他們的弩向一個隨機的角色射擊。

english: Any creature atop the overhang has {@book half cover|PHB|9|Cover} from creatures in the tunnel below.
zh_tw: 任何位於懸垂上方的生物都對下方隧道中的生物有{@book 半身掩護|PHB|9|Cover}。

english: L16: Ruined Chamber
zh_tw: L16: 毀壞的房間

english: This 30-foot-tall chamber is choked with debris and is {@book difficult terrain|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}.
zh_tw: 這個30尺高的房間裡堆滿了碎片，是{@book 困難地形|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}。

english: L17: Bridge
zh_tw: L17: 橋

english: A wood-and-steel captain's chair tops the platform in the center of this room. Slumped in the chair is a skeletal corpse wearing Cyran regalia. The skeleton wears a silver helmet with a sizable dent. A view port made from shimmering crystal overlooks the mists of the Mournland.
zh_tw: 一個木鋼製的船長椅位於這個房間中心平臺的頂部。坐在椅子上的是一個穿著塞爾禮服的骷髏屍體。骷髏戴著一頂有明顯凹痕的銀色頭盔。一個由閃爍水晶製成的觀景窗俯瞰著悲悼荒原的霧氣。

english: As long as Landro's magical barrier is active, the view port's crystal is immune to damage. The ceiling is 30 feet high.
zh_tw: 只要蘭德羅的魔法屏障處於啟用狀態，觀景窗的水晶就免疫於傷害。天花板高度為30尺。

english: Broken Control Helmet
zh_tw: 損壞的控制頭盔

english: The silver helmet once created a magical link between its wearer and the graymatter engine. A creature that puts its ear to the helmet hears a faint, metallic clanking. A creature that dons the helmet must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has the {@condition incapacitated} condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature experiences a vision of what happened to Landro on the Day of Mourning (use the read-aloud text of the vision in {@area area L10|1e2|x}). The helmet loses this effect if removed from this room.
zh_tw: 這頂銀色頭盔曾經在佩戴者與灰質引擎之間建立了魔法聯絡。將耳朵貼近頭盔的生物會聽到微弱的金屬撞擊聲。佩戴頭盔的生物必須進行一次 {@dc 13} 體質豁免。豁免失敗時，該生物將獲得 {@condition incapacitated||無力} 狀態，持續 1 分鐘。豁免成功時，該生物將看到蘭德羅在悲悼之日那天的景象（使用 {@area 區域L10|1e2|x} 中的朗讀文字來描述這一景象）。如果頭盔被移出這個房間，它將失去這一效果。

english: L18: Collapsed Antigravity Well
zh_tw: L18: 塌陷的反重力井

english: Rubble chokes this shaft. A steady trickle of gray liquid burbles through the rubble.
zh_tw: 碎石堵塞了這個通道。灰色的液體緩緩地從碎石中滴落。

english: Damage to Landro's spine has disabled this antigravity well from this point upward. The rubble blocks access to {@area area L9|1e1|x} below, but the path up to area L20 and beyond is clear.
zh_tw: 蘭德羅的脊柱受損，從這一點向上的反重力井已經失效。碎石阻擋了通往下方{@area 區域L9|1e1|x}的通道，但通往L20區域及更遠的道路是暢通的。

english: Without the aid of antigravity magic, a creature can climb the notched walls inside the shaft only by succeeding on a {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. From this area, the shaft stretches up 100 feet before terminating at the roof of Landro's head ({@area area L28|20a|x}).
zh_tw: 在沒有反重力魔法的幫助下，生物只能透過成功進行一個 {@dc 12} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定來攀爬豎井內有凹槽的牆壁。從這個區域開始，豎井向上延伸100尺，最終到達蘭德羅頭部（{@area 區域L28|20a|x}）的頂部。

english: L19: Muster Point
zh_tw: L19: 集結點

english: Three Cyran soldiers in full regalia stand diligently at the arrow slits in this 30-foot-tall gathering hall. When they become aware of the characters, the soldiers turn to the party, revealing ghostly, screaming skulls instead of faces. The soldiers are three hostile {@creature Wight||wights}. Three {@creature Will-o'-Wisp||will-o'-wisps}, previously {@condition invisible}, appear at the start of combat and fight alongside the wights.
zh_tw: 三名身著全套軍服的塞爾士兵，在這座高30尺的集會大廳中守在箭孔旁。察覺角色們後，士兵轉過身來，露出的不是臉孔，而是幽靈般尖叫的骷髏頭。這三名士兵是敵對的{@creature Wight||屍妖}。三隻原本處於{@condition invisible||隱形}狀態的{@creature Will-o'-Wisp||鬼火}會在戰鬥開始時現身，與屍妖並肩作戰。

english: L20: War Room
zh_tw: L20: 戰爭室

english: This thirty-foot-tall chamber centers on a massive, stone table. Dozens of large maps and scroll cases lie scattered across the table.
zh_tw: 這個三十尺高的房間以一張巨大的石桌為中心。數十張大地圖和卷軸盒散落在桌子上。

english: The table is a magically animated servant (use the {@creature stone golem} stat block). It is designed to defend Landro from enemy boarders. As soon as a creature disturbs the table's contents, the table reveals its true nature and attacks.
zh_tw: 這張桌子是一個被魔法啟用的僕人（使用{@creature stone golem||石魔像}的統計資料塊）。它被設計用來防禦蘭德羅免受敵人登船。一旦有生物擾亂了桌子上的物品，桌子就會揭示其真實本質並進行攻擊。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The vellum maps depict regions of Cyre that bear no resemblance to the current topography. Though useless to navigators, the maps are worth 2,500 gp to historians, collectors, or Cyran expatriates.
zh_tw: 這些羊皮紙地圖描繪的是塞爾地區，與當前的地形沒有任何相似之處。儘管對導航者來說毫無用處，但這些地圖對歷史學家、收藏家或塞爾流亡者來說價值2500金幣。

english: L21: Shoulders
zh_tw: L21: 肩膀

english: Ballistae mounted on wheels point out the windows at each of Landro's shoulders. A total of twelve ballista arrows are scattered on the floors in these areas: five in area L21a and seven in L21b. The ceiling in these areas is 40 feet high.
zh_tw: 弩車安裝在輪子上，指向蘭德羅每個肩膀的窗戶。總共有十二支弩箭散落在這些區域的地板上：L21a區域有五支，L21b區域有七支。這些區域的天花板高度為40尺。

english: L22: Walkway
zh_tw: L22: 走道

english: A 3-foot-tall stone battlement wraps around this open-air walkway.
zh_tw: 這個露天走道周圍環繞著一堵3尺高的石制城垛。

english: L23: Holding Cells
zh_tw: L23: 拘留室

english: Iron bars along either side of this hallway form two cells, each with a locked iron door.
zh_tw: 這個走廊兩側的鐵欄杆形成了兩個牢房，每個牢房都有一扇上鎖的鐵門。

english: The forearm and upper arm both house pairs of holding cells. Designed to hold prisoners of war, these empty cells never saw use. The ceiling in each room is 15 feet high.
zh_tw: 前臂和上臂部位都設有成對的拘留室。這些設計用來關押戰俘的空置牢房從未被使用過。每個房間的天花板高度為15尺。

english: L24: Intake Chamber
zh_tw: L24: 進氣室

english: This small, fifteen-foot-tall chamber features a metal hatch in the floor and a lever attached to a nearby wall.
zh_tw: 這個小而高十五尺的房間有一個在地板上的金屬艙口和一個附著在附近牆上的槓桿。

english: When the lever on the wall is flipped, the hatch in the floor opens, and a 10-foot-diameter, 30-foot-deep cylindrical antigravity well emanates from the colossus's palm. Any Large or smaller unattended object that enters this antigravity well slowly floats into this chamber. The antigravity well deactivates and the hatch closes when the lever is returned to its original position.
zh_tw: 當牆上的操縱桿被翻轉時，地板上的艙口開啟，一個直徑10尺、深30尺的圓柱形反重力井從巨像的手掌中散發出來。任何大型或更小的無人看管的物體進入這個反重力井時會慢慢漂浮進這個房間。當操縱桿恢復到原始位置時，反重力井停用，艙口關閉。

english: L25: Vault
zh_tw: L25: 金庫

english: The floor of this ruined, thirty-foot-tall chamber is bare except for a large, wooden chest. The ostentatious chest's dark walnut planks shine, and its iron straps are gilded with a thick sheet of gold leaf. An iron padlock crafted in the shape of a grinning demon hangs from the chest's hasp.
zh_tw: 這個三十尺高的破敗房間的地板上除了一個大木箱外，空無一物。這個顯眼的木箱的深核桃木板光澤照人，其鐵條上鍍有一層厚厚的金箔。一個鐵製掛鎖，形狀像一個咧嘴笑的惡魔，掛在箱子的搭扣上。

english: The chest is a {@creature mimic} in disguise. As soon as a creature touches it, the mimic attacks. Once it has grappled a creature, the mimic attempts to drag its victim outside so it can drop the victim off the edge of the walkway ({@area area L22|1ff|x}). Creatures that fall take 45 ({@dice 13d6}) bludgeoning damage.
zh_tw: 這個箱子是一個偽裝成箱子的{@creature mimic||擬身怪}。一旦有生物觸碰它，模仿怪就會攻擊。一旦它抓住了一個生物，模仿怪會試圖將其拖到外面，以便將其從步道邊緣（{@area 區域L22|1ff|x}）扔下去。掉落的生物會受到45（{@dice 13d6}）點鈍擊傷害。

english: L26: Throat
zh_tw: L26: 咽喉

english: This twenty-foot-tall cylinder is the equivalent of Landro's throat. Above, a tangle of metal dangles like a mechanical uvula.
zh_tw: 這個二十尺高的圓柱體相當於蘭德羅的喉嚨。上方，一團金屬像機械懸雍垂一樣懸掛著。

english: If she still lives, Glaive has set a trap here for the characters. She tore out the weapons system from area L27 and moved it to the edge of that chamber so that it points down Landro's throat.
zh_tw: 如果她還活著，格萊芙在這裡為角色們設下了陷阱。她從L27區域拆下了武器系統，並將其移至那個房間的邊緣，使其指向蘭德羅的喉嚨。

english: As soon as a character is halfway up this area, Glaive activates the weapon, which ejects a jet of water in a 60-foot line. Any creature in this line must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 22 ({@dice 4d10}) bludgeoning damage and fall down to {@area area L18|1f8|x}, landing with the {@condition prone} condition.
zh_tw: 一旦角色到達這個區域的半途，格萊夫便啟用武器，噴射出一道60尺長的水柱。位於此線上的任何生物必須成功透過一個{@dc 15}敏捷豁免，否則將受到22（{@dice 4d10}）點鈍擊傷害並摔落到{@area 區域L18|1f8|x}，落地時處於{@condition prone||伏地}狀態。

english: Glaive compromised the weapons system when she moved it; once fired, it breaks, losing its magic.
zh_tw: 長柄刀在移動武器系統時破壞了它；一旦發射，它就會損壞，失去其魔法。

english: L27: Weapons System
zh_tw: L27: 武器系統

english: Glaive and her subordinates might confront the heroes inside Landro's weapons systems room
zh_tw: 格萊芙和她的下屬可能會在蘭德羅的武器系統室內與英雄們對峙

english: The mechanical guts of what must have been a magical cannon were torn out of the platform in this room. To the south, a three-foot-tall ledge is all that separates this chamber from the open air. If not for the dense mist of the Mournland, this window would afford a spectacular view.
zh_tw: 這個房間裡的平臺上，一定是魔法大炮的機械內部被撕扯出來。向南，一個三尺高的壁架是這個房間與開放空氣之間的唯一隔離。如果不是因為悲悼荒原的濃霧，這個窗戶將提供一個壯觀的景色。
