english: In this 15-foot-tall room, which is effectively Landro's mouth, {@creature Glaive|VEoR} makes her final stand against the characters if she has survived this long. Her {@creature Blade Scout|VEoR|blade scouts} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}), Rack and Crunch, fight alongside her if they're still alive.
zh_tw: 在這個15尺高的房間，實際上是蘭德羅的嘴中，如果{@creature Glaive|VEoR|長柄刀}活到這個時候，她將與角色們進行最後的對峙。她的{@creature Blade Scout|VEoR|刀鋒偵察兵}（參見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}），架子和壓碎，如果他們還活著，將與地並肩作戰。

english: L28: Graymatter Engine
zh_tw: L28: 灰質引擎

english: Dripping pipes and rusty chains hang from the fifteen-foot-high ceiling of this chamber. Deep-red light courses rhythmically through the pipes, which converge on a large object atop a circular dais.
zh_tw: 滴水的管道和生鏽的鏈條懸掛在這個房間十五尺高的天花板上。深紅色的光芒有節奏地穿過管道，匯聚在一個圓形基座上的一個大物體上。

english: The object resembles an oversize brain made of iron-gray ceramic. Its surface is molded with countless grooves that form mesmerizing patterns. A crack along the ceramic brain's frontal lobe leaks a thin, gray liquid that pools around the dais.
zh_tw: 這個物體看起來像一個由鐵灰色陶瓷製成的超大號大腦。它的表面佈滿了無數凹槽，形成了迷人的圖案。沿著陶瓷大腦的額葉有一條裂縫，從中滲出一種稀薄的灰色液體，彙集在基座周圍。

english: Floating above the brain and scattering light across the room is a small, slender object: a piece of the {@i Rod of Seven Parts}.
zh_tw: 飄浮在腦部上方並向房間散射光芒的是一件小巧而細長的物品：{@i 七碎片之杖}的一部分。

english: Years after its abandonment, the graymatter engine still churns with arcane power. Crafted from experimental designs based on unfamiliar technology, the graymatter engine converts the power of the third {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} piece into magical effects throughout Landro. The colossus's force field, weapons system, and antigravity wells are all powered by this eldritch machine.
zh_tw: 在其被廢棄多年後，灰質引擎仍然充滿了奧術能量。這個基於不熟悉技術的實驗性設計製造的灰質引擎，將第三件{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}部件的力量轉化為遍佈蘭德羅的魔法效果。這個巨像的力場、武器系統和反重力井都是由這臺古老的機器提供動力的。

english: When the characters arrive in this area, the graymatter engine manifests a physical entity to converse with the party. Proceed to the "{@area Graymatter Guardian|20e|x}" section below.
zh_tw: 當角色們到達這個區域時，灰質引擎會顯現出一個實體來與隊伍交談。請繼續前往下方"{@area 灰質守護者|20e|x}"部分。

english: Hidden Sentinels
zh_tw: 隱藏的哨兵

english: This chamber contains false walls made of thin metal plates. A character investigating the walls can tell that they are hollow by succeeding on a {@dc 17} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. Behind these walls stand four defense sentinels bound to the graymatter engine (each uses the {@creature shield guardian} stat block but is Medium instead of Large).
zh_tw: 這個房間包含由薄金屬板製成的假牆。一個調查牆壁的角色可以透過成功進行 {@dc 17} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定來發現這些牆是空心的。在這些牆後面站著四個與灰質引擎繫結的防禦哨兵（每個都使用 {@creature shield guardian||構裝盾衛} 的統計塊，但體型是中等而非大型）。

english: If a sentinel takes damage or the rod piece is removed from the graymatter engine, the walls around all four sentinels slide into the floor and the sentinels activate, attacking all intruders.
zh_tw: 如果一個哨兵受到傷害，或者法杖部件從灰質引擎中移除，所有四個哨兵周圍的牆壁會滑入地板，哨兵啟用，攻擊所有入侵者。

english: Retrieving the Rod Piece
zh_tw: 取回權杖部件

english: As long as the graymatter engine is active, the rod piece floating above the engine's ceramic shell is held in place with powerful magic. As an action, a creature can try to remove the piece. A creature that touches the piece must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 11 ({@dice 2d10}) psychic damage, and the piece doesn't move. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage but is able to grab and move the piece freely. Successfully casting {@spell Dispel Magic} ({@dc 14}) on the piece suppresses the magic for 1 minute, during which time the piece can be touched and removed without requiring creatures to make a saving throw.
zh_tw: 只要灰質引擎處於啟用狀態，懸浮在引擎陶瓷外殼上方的杆件就會被強大的魔法固定。作為一個動作，生物可以嘗試移除該杆件。觸控該杆件的生物必須進行{@dc 15}的感知豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，生物會受到11點（{@dice 2d10}）心靈傷害，且杆件不會移動。如果豁免成功，生物只受到一半的傷害，但能夠自由地抓住並移動杆件。成功對杆件施放{@spell Dispel Magic||解除魔法}（{@dc 14}）可以壓制魔法效果1分鐘，在此期間，杆件可以被觸控和移除，且生物無需進行豁免檢定。

english: When the piece is removed, the four defense sentinels attack the characters, and Landro's shutdown sequence begins (see the "{@area Shutdown Sequence|215|x}" section below). For more about the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, see this book's {@area introduction|00e|x}.
zh_tw: 當部件被移除時，四個防禦哨兵會攻擊角色，蘭德羅的關閉序列開始（見下面的"{@area 關閉序列|215|x}"部分）。關於{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的更多資訊，請見本書的{@area 簡介|00e|x}。

english: Graymatter Guardian
zh_tw: 灰質守護者

english: The graymatter engine serves as Landro's brain, though it can't control the colossus's mechanical systems
zh_tw: 灰質引擎充當蘭德羅的大腦，儘管它無法控制巨人的機械繫統。

english: The graymatter engine has—or, more aptly, is—a mind of its own. It sensed the characters when they first entered Landro and has watched them curiously. When the characters arrive in this room, the graymatter engine manifests a swirling mass of animated graymatter fluid.
zh_tw: 灰質引擎擁有——或者更恰當地說，它本身就是——一個獨立的意識。當角色們第一次進入蘭德羅時，它就感知到了他們，並好奇地觀察著。當角色們到達這個房間時，灰質引擎顯現出一個旋轉的、有生命的灰質流體的團塊。

english: The animated fluid takes the shape of a tall, lithe humanoid and introduces itself as Landro. This neutral-aligned being uses the {@creature water elemental} stat block, except it has telepathy out to 30 feet.
zh_tw: 這種活化的液體變成了一個高大、苗條的人形，並自我介紹為蘭德羅。這個中立陣營的生物使用{@creature water elemental||水元素}的統計資料塊，除了它具有30尺範圍內的心靈感應能力。

english: Landro isn't interested in fighting. Rather, it wants to question the newcomers who've made it all the way to the colossus's uppermost level.
zh_tw: 蘭德羅對戰鬥不感興趣。相反，它想要質問那些已經到達巨人最頂層的新來者。

english: Landro the Host
zh_tw: 蘭德羅，主人

english: In its manifestation as Landro, the graymatter engine assumes the role of a gracious host. It is far more interested in learning about its visitors than in talking about itself. If pushed, Landro briefly explains how it was created by Cyran mages to control the colossus of the same name. On the day of its deployment, the colossus teleported halfway into this mountain, where it has remained since. Unable to wrench its body from Mount Ironrot, the graymatter engine fell into a despondent torpor that lasted until the arrival of its recent visitors.
zh_tw: 以其作為蘭德羅的表現形式，灰質引擎扮演了一個慷慨的主人角色。它更感興趣的是瞭解它的訪客，而不是談論自己。如果被追問，蘭德羅會簡要解釋它是由塞爾法師創造來控制同名巨人的。在它部署的那天，巨人傳送到了這座山的半山腰，從那時起就一直在那兒。由於無法將其身體從鐵鏽山中拔出，灰質引擎陷入了一種持續到最近訪客到來的沮喪的昏睡狀態。

english: Landro
zh_tw: 蘭德羅

english: Sharing Secrets
zh_tw: 分享秘密

english: Landro understands the world by peering into the thoughts and memories of living beings. During conversation, the entity asks the characters to share a secret with it.
zh_tw: 蘭德羅透過窺視生物的思想和記憶來理解世界。在對話過程中，這個實體要求角色們與它分享一個秘密。

english: "I already know a great deal," Landro says. "The knowledge I now seek is of the clandestine variety. I would be interested to learn your secrets."
zh_tw: "我已經知道很多了，"蘭德羅說。"我現在尋求的知識是秘密的那種。我很有興趣瞭解你的秘密。"

english: Landro wishes to learn secrets from the characters through a type of osmosis. Landro tells the characters that this process is harmless and takes only a moment, though it does require physical contact with the head of a consenting character, as well as spending a secret the character has learned. If the characters reject the idea, Landro doesn't push the matter.
zh_tw: 蘭德羅希望透過一種滲透的方式來從角色們那裡學習秘密。蘭德羅告訴角色們，這個過程是無害的，並且只需要片刻時間，儘管它確實需要與同意的角色的頭部進行身體接觸，並且需要角色分享他們所學到的一個秘密。如果角色們拒絕了這個想法，蘭德羅不會強迫這個問題。

english: If the characters consent to the entity's request, Landro extends a ribbon-like tentacle of graymatter fluid. Landro uses this tentacle to briefly touch the head of each consenting character in turn. An affected character hears a deep, sloshing sound and experiences a sensation like being underwater, but when the tentacle is removed, the character is as dry as before.
zh_tw: 如果角色們同意該實體的請求，蘭德羅會伸出一條由灰色物質流體構成的緞帶狀觸鬚。蘭德羅會用這條觸鬚依次短暫觸碰每位同意者的頭部。受影響的角色會聽到深沉的液體晃動聲，並感受到類似置身水下的感覺，但當觸鬚移開後，角色的身體會像之前一樣乾燥。

english: After this process, Landro nods in quiet appreciation and thanks the party for sharing their secrets.
zh_tw: 在這個過程中之後，蘭德羅靜靜地點頭表示感激，並感謝隊伍分享了他們的秘密。

english: Secrets Revealed
zh_tw: 秘密被揭露

english: If any character consents to the graymatter engine's secret-learning process, the most recent secret the party learned is spent, as described in "{@area The Power of Secrets|028|x}" section in the book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}. Instead of the usual benefit of spending the secret, the characters all gain {@book inspiration|PHB|4|inspiration}. Mark off a secret spent in this way on the Secrets Tracker in {@adventure appendix C|VEoR|14}. No matter how many characters consent, only one secret is spent.
zh_tw: 如果有角色同意灰質引擎的秘密學習過程，隊伍最近學到的秘密就會像書中{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}的"{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}"部分所描述的那樣被消耗掉。與通常消耗秘密的好處不同，角色們都會獲得{@book 激勵|PHB|4|inspiration}。在{@adventure 附錄C|VEoR|14}的秘密追蹤器上標記以這種方式消耗的秘密。無論有多少角色同意，都只會消耗一個秘密。

english: The Engine's Aid
zh_tw: 引擎的援助

english: If the characters befriend Landro, or if two or more of the characters agree to share a secret with it, the entity warns the party of the engine room's defense sentinels and explains how the colossus's shutdown sequence works. Even though it is mentally merged with the colossus of the same name, the entity can't control the colossus's systems.
zh_tw: 如果角色們與蘭德羅成為朋友，或者有兩個或更多的角色同意與它分享一個秘密，這個實體就會警告隊伍有關引擎室的防禦哨兵，並解釋巨人的關閉序列是如何工作的。儘管它與同名的巨人在精神上合併，但這個實體無法控制巨人的系統。

english: Elemental Gem (Emerald)
zh_tw: 元素寶石（翡翠）

english: Crystal Companion
zh_tw: 水晶夥伴

english: At the end of their conversation, Landro asks to travel with the party so it can continue to learn from them. If the characters find a special kind of gem called an id crystal, Landro explains, they can transfer the graymatter engine's consciousness to it. Landro tells the characters that a suitable id crystal can be found in the colossus's left foot ({@area area L6|1dc|x}).
zh_tw: 在對話的最後，蘭德羅請求與隊伍一起旅行，以便它能夠繼續向他們學習。如果角色們找到一個叫做意識水晶的特殊寶石，蘭德羅解釋說，他們可以將灰質引擎的意識轉移到它上面。蘭德羅告訴角色們，一個合適的意識水晶可以在巨像的左腳（{@area 區域L6|1dc|x}）找到。

english: When an id crystal touches the graymatter engine, the graymatter engine's consciousness is transferred to the crystal, which becomes an {@item Elemental Gem, Emerald||Elemental Gem (emerald)}.
zh_tw: 當一個身份水晶接觸到灰質引擎時，灰質引擎的意識被轉移到水晶中，它變成了一個{@item Elemental Gem, Emerald||元素寶石（翡翠）}。

english: As soon as the graymatter engine's consciousness is transferred to the id crystal, the rod piece powering the graymatter engine falls to the floor, activating the hidden sentinels in {@area area L28|20a|x} and starting Landro's shutdown sequence (see below).
zh_tw: 一旦灰質引擎的意識被轉移到id晶體中，為灰質引擎提供能量的法杖部件就會掉落到地板上，啟用了{@area 區域L28|20a|x}中的隱藏哨兵，並啟動了蘭德羅的關閉序列（見下文）。

english: Shutdown Sequence
zh_tw: 關閉序列

english: When Landro's shutdown sequence is activated, a magical, soothing voice announces: "One minute until self-destruct." The following things then happen immediately:
zh_tw: 當蘭德羅的關閉序列被啟用時，一個魔法的、安撫人心的聲音宣佈："自毀前還有一分鐘。" 緊接著立即發生以下事情：

english: Antigravity Deactivated
zh_tw: 反重力停用

english: Landro's antigravity magic—including the antigravity wells and floors—is dispelled.
zh_tw: 蘭德羅的反重力魔法——包括反重力井和地板——被解除了。

english: Barrier Dropped
zh_tw: 屏障解除

english: The invisible barrier around Landro disappears.
zh_tw: 圍繞蘭德羅的無形屏障消失了。

english: Self-Destruct Initiated
zh_tw: 自毀啟動

english: Characters inside Landro must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or have the {@condition prone} condition as the colossus heaves and shudders. After 1 minute, the colossus explodes in a fiery conflagration. When this happens, creatures inside Landro must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 99 ({@dice 18d10}) fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Unattended, nonmagical objects inside Landro are destroyed by the explosion.
zh_tw: 在蘭德羅內部的角色必須成功透過一個 {@dc 14} 敏捷豁免，否則將因巨像的搖晃和震動而獲得 {@condition prone||伏地} 狀態。1分鐘後，巨像會在一個熾烈的火焰中爆炸。當這種情況發生時，蘭德羅內部的生物必須進行一個 {@dc 18} 敏捷豁免，失敗則受到 99 點（{@dice 18d10}）火焰傷害，成功則受到一半傷害。蘭德羅內部未被守護的非魔法物品會被爆炸摧毀。

english: Next Steps
zh_tw: 下一步

english: Once they've acquired the third piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, the characters can return to the oval portal on Mount Ironrot's outskirts. Stepping through the portal returns the characters to the sanctum in Sigil.
zh_tw: 一旦角色們獲得了{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第三件部件，他們可以返回到鐵鏽山外圍的橢圓形傳送門。穿過傳送門會將角色們帶回法印城的聖所。

english: Chapter 5: Death House
zh_tw: 第5章：死亡之屋

english: Death House is a source of terror in Barovia, and the characters soon discover why
zh_tw: 死亡之屋是巴洛維亞的恐怖之源，角色們很快就會發現原因。

english: The fourth piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} is in Barovia, one of the Shadowfell's Domains of Dread. With the aid of an Ulmist inquisitor, the party infiltrates the basement of an eerie locale called Death House. Here, they must stop cults plotting to use the fourth rod piece in vile rituals while also preventing the artifact from falling into of the hands of the infamous vampire Strahd von Zarovich.
zh_tw: {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第四件部件位於巴洛維亞，這是墮影冥界的恐怖領域之一。在一位烏爾米斯特審問官的幫助下，隊伍潛入了一個名為死亡之屋的詭異場所的地下室。在這裡，他們必須阻止邪教使用第四件法杖部件進行邪惡儀式的圖謀，同時還要防止這件神器落入臭名昭著的吸血鬼施特拉德·馮·扎洛維奇的手中。

english: Running This Chapter
zh_tw: 運作本章

english: This chapter begins after the characters retrieve the third piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}. When a character holds this piece, they instinctively know that the next closest piece is located in the village of Barovia, in the domain of Strahd von Zarovich. Although it's a small village, Barovia teems with supernatural threats—including the forebodingly named Death House, the location of the fourth piece.
zh_tw: 本章節始於角色們獲得{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第三個碎片之後。當角色持有該碎片時，他們會本能地知道下一個最接近的碎片位於巴洛維亞村的施特拉德·馮·扎洛維奇領地內。儘管巴洛維亞是一個小村莊，但其充滿了超自然威脅——包括名字令人不安的"死亡之屋"，即第四個碎片的所在地。

english: By researching Death House in the Sigil sanctum or asking the Wizards Three about it, the characters learn that Death House is owned by two Barovians named Gustav and Elisabeth Durst, who run a small cult devoted to Barovia's Darklord, Strahd von Zarovich. Given the domain's many greater threats, this minor cult and the house draw scant attention. If the characters ask, Alustriel shares the information in the "{@area Knowledge of Barovia|21d|x}" section. Neither the wizards nor the available research materials in Sigil can reveal further details.
zh_tw: 透過在法印城聖所研究死亡之屋，或向三巫師詢問有關它的事情，角色們得知死亡之屋是由兩位名叫古斯塔夫和伊麗莎白·德斯特的巴洛維亞人擁有的，他們經營著一個小型邪教，致力於巴洛維亞的黑暗領主，施特拉德·馮·扎洛維奇。鑑於該領域有許多更大的威脅，這個小型邪教和這所房子幾乎沒有引起注意。如果角色們詢問，艾拉斯卓會分享"{@area 巴洛維亞的知識|21d|x}"部分中的資訊。無論是法師們還是法印城中的現有研究材料都無法透露更多細節。

english: This chapter begins with the characters' approach to Death House. Their journey is interrupted by a mob of scared peasants as well as a potentially helpful inquisitor. Most of the chapter describes the horrors the characters encounter as they explore Death House. Once the characters acquire the rod piece, Strahd arrives at Death House to toy with the characters and tries to block their escape.
zh_tw: 這一章節以角色們接近死亡之屋開始。他們的旅程被一群受驚的農民以及一個可能提供幫助的審判官所打斷。大部分章節描述了角色們在探索死亡之屋時遇到的恐怖。一旦角色們獲得了法杖部件，施特拉德就出現在死亡之屋，與角色們玩耍，並試圖阻止他們逃脫。

english: Character Advancement
zh_tw: 角色升級

english: The characters should be 14th level when this chapter begins. They gain a level after they retrieve the fourth piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} from Death House.
zh_tw: 當這一章節開始時，角色們應該是14級。他們在從死亡之屋取回{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第四件部件後將獲得一個等級。

english: Power of Secrets
zh_tw: 秘密的力量

english: The characters can learn one secret in this chapter that is applicable to the rules in "{@area The Power of Secrets|028|x}" section in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}:
zh_tw: 角色們可以在這個章節中學到一個適用於本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中的"{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}"部分規則的秘密：

english: Sarusanda's Secret
zh_tw: 薩魯桑達的秘密

english: Sarusanda is an Ulmist inquisitor, but her father, Galias, joined the evil priests of Osybus. Sarusanda expected to find and slay him in Death House. The characters can learn this secret during one of their encounters with Sarusanda, as described in the "{@area Meetings with Sarusanda|22f|x}" section.
zh_tw: 薩魯桑達是一位烏爾米斯特審判官，但她的父親加利亞斯卻加入了奧西布斯的邪惡祭司團。薩魯桑達原以為能在死亡之屋找到並殺死他。角色們可以在與薩魯桑達的某次遭遇中獲知這個秘密，詳細內容在"{@area 與薩魯桑達的會面|22f|x}"部分有所描述。

english: Fourth Rod Piece
zh_tw: 第四根法杖部件

english: The {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|fourth piece} of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} is in {@adventure area D38|VEoR|5|D38: Ritual Chamber} of Death House. For more information about the rod and the spell this piece allows its wielder to cast, see this book's {@area introduction|00e|x}.
zh_tw: {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}位於死亡之屋的{@adventure 區域 D38|VEoR|5|D38: Ritual Chamber}。關於此權杖以及此部件允許持有者施放的法術的更多資訊，請參閱本書的{@area 簡介|00e|x}。

english: Barovia
zh_tw: 巴洛維亞

english: The third rod piece allows the characters to step through the portal in the Sigil sanctum and emerge in the western outskirts of the village of Barovia.
zh_tw: 第三根法杖部件允許角色們穿過法印城聖所的傳送門，並出現在巴洛維亞村莊的西部郊區。

english: If the characters haven't already, allow them to research Barovia in Sigil or ask the wizards about the place, then convey the points listed in the "Knowledge of Barovia" section below. When you're ready to start the chapter, proceed to the "{@area Arriving in Barovia|21e|x}" section.
zh_tw: 如果角色們還沒有進行研究，允許他們在法印城研究巴洛維亞或向法師詢問這個地方，然後傳達下面"巴洛維亞的知識"部分列出的要點。當你準備好開始這一章節時，繼續進行"{@area 抵達巴羅維亞|21e|x}"部分。

english: Knowledge of Barovia
zh_tw: 巴洛維亞的知識

english: Characters who research Barovia can learn the following:
zh_tw: 研究巴洛維亞的角色可以瞭解到以下資訊：

english: Domain of Dread
zh_tw: 恐懼領域

english: Barovia is the name of a village as well as the name of the Domain of Dread that encompasses that village. A Domain of Dread is a demiplane hidden in the Plane of Shadow. Every Domain of Dread is separated from the rest of the multiverse by the mysterious Mists.
zh_tw: 巴洛維亞是一個村莊的名字，同時也是包含這個村莊的恐怖領域的名字。恐怖領域是一個隱藏在陰影位面的半位面。每個恐怖領域都透過神秘的霧氣與多元宇宙的其餘部分分隔開來。

english: The Mists
zh_tw: 迷霧

english: The Mists are unfathomable and unpredictable. Once an individual has been taken by the Mists, there is little chance of escape. The only entities with influence over the Mists are the unknowable Dark Powers, which control the Domains of Dread, and the Darklords, who each rule a domain created to torment them.
zh_tw: 迷霧是深不可測且不可預測的。一旦個體被迷霧帶走，逃脫的機會就很小。唯一對迷霧有影響力的是難以理解的黑暗力量，它們控制著恐怖領域，以及黑暗領主，每個領主都統治著一個為了折磨他們而創造的領域。

english: Strahd the Vampire
zh_tw: 施特拉德吸血鬼

english: As Barovia's Darklord, the vampire Strahd von Zarovich wields immense power and usually has the final say over who comes and goes in his domain.
zh_tw: 作為巴洛維亞的黑暗領主，吸血鬼施特拉德·馮·扎洛維奇擁有巨大的權力，通常對他領域內誰可以來去有最終決定權。

english: Arriving in Barovia
zh_tw: 抵達巴羅維亞

english: When the characters step through the portal in Sigil, they wade through a thick mist before emerging on the western outskirts of Barovia. Read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 當角色們穿過法印城的傳送門時，他們穿過濃密的霧氣，然後出現在巴洛維亞的西郊。閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: Thick, gray fog shrouds this small, gloomy village. Dismal houses and outbuildings line the cobblestone streets. The sound of a child weeping echoes preternaturally from a tall house looming in the distance.
zh_tw: 濃密的灰色霧氣籠罩著這個小而陰鬱的村莊。淒涼的房屋和小建築物排列在鵝卵石街道上。遠處一座高大的房子裡傳來孩子哭泣的聲音，這聲音異常地迴盪著。

english: If the characters attempt to leave or circumvent the village, the Mists return them to where they started.
zh_tw: 如果角色們試圖離開或繞過村莊，迷霧會將他們送回起點。

english: The third piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} points toward the tall, gloomy house on the village's far side, where the sound of weeping is coming from.
zh_tw: {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第三部分指向村莊遠處那幢高大陰鬱的房子，那裡傳來了哭泣聲。

english: Barovian villagers confront the characters when they arrive, believing they're villains
zh_tw: 巴洛維亞村民在角色們到達時對他們進行質問，因為他們認為這些角色是惡棍。

english: Unwelcome Party
zh_tw: 不受歡迎的聚會

english: While making their way across the village, the characters are accosted by a throng of panicked villagers fearful of the newcomers. Read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 當角色們穿過村莊時，他們被一群恐慌的村民圍住，這些村民對新來的人感到害怕。閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: As you move through town, a handful of murmuring villagers follow you at a distance. More villagers emerge from houses on all sides, and soon you're surrounded by a small mob. A farmer carrying a pitchfork points at you and calls you interlopers. Other folks brandish brooms, axes, and large stones. They scream at you to leave the village.
zh_tw: 當你穿過小鎮時，一些村民在遠處竊竊私語地跟著你。更多的村民從四面八方的房子裡出現，很快你就被一小群暴民包圍了。一個手持乾草叉的農民指著你，稱你們為入侵者。其他人揮舞著掃帚、斧頭和大石頭。他們尖叫著讓你們離開村莊。

english: The mob consists of twenty hostile {@creature Commoner||commoners} who surround the characters. As Sarusanda later explains to the characters, the priests of Osybus foresaw the characters' arrival and sowed foul rumors about them to turn the villagers against them. The characters must diffuse the situation with the villagers before they can proceed.
zh_tw: 這群暴民由二十個敵對的{@creature Commoner||平民}組成，他們包圍了角色們。正如薩魯桑達後來向角色們解釋的那樣，奧西布斯的祭司預見到了角色們的到來，散播了關於他們的惡毒謠言，以煽動村民反對他們。角色們必須先平息與村民的緊張局勢，然後才能繼續前進。

english: The characters can disperse the mob in a variety of ways. They can lie about their identities or intentions; they can convince the villagers that they mean no harm or that they hope to help the children crying in the distant house; or they can threaten the villagers' lives. To successfully sway the mob in one of these ways, at least one character must succeed on a {@dc 18} Charisma ({@skill Deception}, {@skill Intimidation}, or {@skill Persuasion}) check, using whichever skill is appropriate. A character who casts {@spell Calm Emotions} on the mob's area has advantage on this check.
zh_tw: 角色們可以透過多種方式驅散暴民。他們可以謊報自己的身份或意圖；可以說服村民他們並無惡意，或者希望幫助在遠處房子裡哭泣的孩子們；也可以威脅村民的生命。要成功地透過這些方式之一影響暴民，至少一個角色必須成功透過一次 {@dc 18} 魅力檢定（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}、{@skill Intimidation||威嚇} 或 {@skill Persuasion||說服}），使用其中適當的技能。如果角色對暴民所在的區域施放了 {@spell Calm Emotions||安定心神} 法術，則在此檢定中獲得優勢。

english: Until the characters disperse or escape the mob, one randomly determined character takes 1 bludgeoning damage from hurled debris at the start of each turn. Each round on initiative count 0, the DC of the check to disperse the mob increases by 1. The villagers immediately disperse if the characters attack or deal damage to any of them.
zh_tw: 在角色們驅散或逃離暴民之前，每個回合開始時，一個隨機確定的角色會因投擲的碎片受到1點鈍擊傷害。在主動性計數0的每一輪，驅散暴民的檢定難度增加1。如果角色們攻擊或對任何村民造成傷害，村民們會立即散開。

english: The Ulmist Inquisition
zh_tw: 烏爾米斯特審問局

english: After the characters are free of the mob, a cloaked adventurer named Sarusanda Allester approaches them. Sarusanda is a lawful neutral, human {@creature inquisitor of the tome|VRGR} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) who speaks Celestial, Common, Draconic, and Elvish, and can cast {@spell Speak with Dead} at will. She introduces herself and asks to speak with the characters in private. The characters can slip into an alley for this discussion, or they can duck into the Blood of the Vine, the village tavern, for a quiet conversation.
zh_tw: 角色們擺脫暴民後，一個名叫薩魯桑達·阿勒斯特的披著斗篷的冒險者接近了他們。薩魯桑達是一個守序中立的人類{@creature inquisitor of the tome|VRGR|秘典審判官}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}），她會說天界語、通用語、龍語和精靈語，並且可以隨意施放{@spell Speak with Dead||死者交談}法術。她自我介紹，並請求私下與角色們交談。角色們可以溜進一條小巷進行這次討論，或者他們可以躲進血之藤，即村酒館，進行一次安靜的談話。

english: Sarusanda Allester
zh_tw: 薩魯桑達·阿勒斯特

english: Sarusanda's Mission
zh_tw: 薩魯桑達的任務

english: Sarusanda's initial impression of the characters depends on how the characters handled the angry mob. If the party dispersed the mob without harming any villagers, Sarusanda is friendly toward the characters. Otherwise, Sarusanda is indifferent but wary.
zh_tw: 薩魯桑達對角色們的最初印象取決於角色們如何處理憤怒的暴民。如果隊伍在沒有傷害任何村民的情況下驅散了暴民，薩魯桑達對角色們就會很友好。否則，薩魯桑達會表現出冷漠但警惕的態度。

english: Sarusanda explains that she is a member of the Ulmist Inquisition, an organization dedicated to rooting out evil throughout the multiverse. She asks the characters what business they have at the house on the far side of the village.
zh_tw: 薩魯桑達解釋說，她是烏爾米斯特審問局的成員，這是一個致力於在整個多元宇宙中根除邪惡的組織。她詢問角色們在村莊另一邊的房子裡有什麼事務。

english: However the characters respond, Sarusanda says she is also going to the building. "The locals call it Death House," she says. "Perhaps we can help each other achieve our goals there."
zh_tw: 無論角色們如何回應，薩魯桑達說她也正要去那座建築。"當地人稱它為死亡之屋，"她說。"也許我們可以在那裡互相幫助實現我們的目標。"

english: In the course of their conversation, Sarusanda conveys the following information to the party.
zh_tw: 在他們的談話過程中，薩魯桑達向隊伍傳達了以下資訊。

english: Cultists in Death House
zh_tw: 死亡之屋的邪教徒

english: Death House is owned by Gustav and Elisabeth Durst. It's an open secret that the Dursts use the building to host cultists who venerate the Darklord of Barovia, Strahd von Zarovich. This minor cult occasionally causes trouble, but until now, it hasn't merited intervention by the Ulmist Inquisition.
zh_tw: 死亡之屋由古斯塔夫和伊麗莎白·德斯特夫婦擁有。眾所周知，德斯特家族使用這座建築來招待崇拜巴洛維亞的黑暗領主，施特拉德·馮·扎洛維奇的邪教徒。這個小型邪教偶爾會引起麻煩，但直到現在，它還沒有引起烏爾米斯特審判所的幹預。

english: Unexpected Discovery
zh_tw: 意外發現

english: Recently, the cultists in Death House obtained something important: a fragment of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}. Sarusanda believes the cultists don't know much about the rod piece, but she suspects the cultists plan to use it to somehow attract Strahd's attention.
zh_tw: 最近，死亡之屋的邪教徒獲得了一些重要的東西：{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的一個碎片。薩魯桑達認為邪教徒對這件法杖部件瞭解不多，但她懷疑邪教徒計劃以某種方式使用它來吸引施特拉德的注意。

english: Priests of Osybus
zh_tw: 奧西布斯祭司

english: The Death House cultists' discovery roused the attention of another wicked group, the priests of Osybus. Unaffiliated with the cultists in Death House, the priests of Osybus are necromancers who steal souls to fuel their evil, life-prolonging magic. They wish to claim the rod piece for use in their necromantic rituals, and they've divined the characters' arrival and know the characters will try to stop them. To slow the characters down, the priests spread dreadful rumors about them throughout town. This stirred the villagers into a frenzy. Sarusanda heard about the priests' activities, discovered the presence of the rod piece, and traveled to the village. She has vowed to stop the priests of Osybus's activities in Death House and any other evil happening there.
zh_tw: 死亡之屋邪教徒的發現引起了另一個邪惡團體的注意，那就是奧西布斯的祭司們。與死亡之屋的邪教徒無關，奧西布斯的祭司們是偷取靈魂以供他們邪惡的、延長生命的魔法使用的死靈師。他們希望奪取法杖部件，用於他們的死靈儀式，並且他們已經預知了角色們的到來，並知道角色們會試圖阻止他們。為了拖慢角色們的速度，祭司們在全鎮散佈關於他們的可怕謠言。這激起了村民們的狂熱。薩魯桑達聽說了祭司們的行為，發現了法杖部件的存在，並前往了村莊。她發誓要阻止奧西布斯的祭司們在死亡之屋的任何邪惡行為以及其他任何邪惡的發生。

english: Eight {@creature Priest of Osybus|VRGR|priests of Osybus} have infiltrated Death House. They are all neutral evil humans who speak Abyssal, Common, and Infernal.
zh_tw: 八位{@creature Priest of Osybus|VRGR|奧西布斯祭司}已經潛入了死亡之屋。他們都是中立邪惡的人類，會說深淵語、通用語和地獄語。

english: Strahd Watches
zh_tw: 施特拉德監視

english: If Sarusanda's information is correct, Strahd is also aware of the activities at Death House.
zh_tw: 如果薩魯桑達的資訊是正確的，施特拉德也意識到了死亡之屋的活動。

english: Sarusanda's Plan
zh_tw: 薩魯桑達的計劃

english: Sarusanda needs to act quickly to stop the priests of Osybus and Strahd from acquiring the rod fragment. She doesn't care if the characters take the artifact; as long as it stays out of her enemies' clutches, she'll consider her work done. To this end, she invites the characters to join her cause. Regardless of whether the characters cooperate with Sarusanda or ignore her, their interaction with her now affect subsequent meetings with her inside Death House.
zh_tw: 薩魯桑達需要迅速行動，以阻止奧西布斯的祭司和施特拉德獲得法杖碎片。她不在乎角色們是否拿走這件神器；只要它不落入她的敵人手中，她就會認為她的工作完成了。為此，她邀請角色們加入她的事業。無論角色們是否與薩魯桑達合作或忽視她，他們現在與她的互動都將影響他們在死亡之屋內部與她的後續會面。

english: Approaching Death House
zh_tw: 接近死亡之屋

english: As the characters come within sight of Death House, read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 當角色們進入死亡之屋的視線範圍時，請閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: A boy and a girl stand in the middle of the dirt road outside a grim house. The boy is weeping and clutches a stuffed doll. The girl is trying to quiet the boy. She turns to you. "There's a monster in our house!" she says. "Mom and Dad told us to play outside. Please, won't you make it safe?"
zh_tw: 一個男孩和一個女孩站在一座陰森房子外的土路中間。男孩正在哭泣，緊緊抓著一個填充玩具娃娃。女孩試圖讓男孩安靜下來。她轉向你。"我們家有個怪物！"她說。"爸爸媽媽告訴我們在外面玩。拜託，你們能讓那裡變得安全嗎？"

english: Rose and Thorn Durst
zh_tw: 玫瑰與荊棘·德斯特

english: The children are Rosavalda "Rose" and Thornboldt "Thorn" Durst. Rose explains that the monster arrived just after the children's parents, Gustav and Elisabeth, ordered Rose and Thorn outside to play. Rose is especially worried for Brigetta, the family's nursemaid, who's always been kind to both children. After Rose and Thorn came outside, they heard screams inside the house, followed by terrible howls coming from the basement. Recently, a group of robed adults (priests of Osybus) arrived and entered the house without a word.
zh_tw: 孩子們是羅薩瓦爾達"玫瑰"和索恩博爾特"索恩"·德斯特。玫瑰解釋說，怪物是在孩子們的父母，古斯塔夫和伊麗莎白，命令玫瑰和索恩出去玩耍後不久到達的。玫瑰特別擔心布里吉塔，這位一直對兩個孩子都很友好的保姆。玫瑰和索恩出來後，他們聽到房子裡傳來尖叫聲，接著是來自地下室的可怕嚎叫聲。最近，一群穿著長袍的成年人（奧西布斯的祭司）到來，沒有說一句話就進入了房子。

english: If calmed with a successful {@dc 10} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check, Thorn sniffles that his parents often invite weird friends over for parties, but this time seems different.
zh_tw: 如果透過一次成功的 {@dc 10} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定使其平靜下來，荊棘抽泣著說他的父母經常邀請奇怪的朋友來參加聚會，但這次似乎有所不同。

english: The children have no other useful information, and neither has any idea how much time has passed since the events they've described. They have no idea that their parents are cult leaders in possession of a powerful artifact. If the characters express hesitation about leaving the children alone, a friendly neighbor arrives and offers to keep the children safe.
zh_tw: 孩子們沒有其他有用的資訊，他們也不知道自從他們描述的事件發生以來過去了多少時間。他們不知道自己的父母是擁有強大神器的邪教領袖。如果角色們對留下孩子們單獨表示猶豫，一個友好的鄰居會到達並提供保護孩子們的安全。

english: Sarusanda Splits Off
zh_tw: 薩魯桑達分開行動

english: As soon as the characters enter Death House, Sarusanda suggests she and the party explore the house separately. This way, you can focus on the characters without having to run Sarusanda alongside them. The characters will have several opportunities to run into Sarusanda in the house. See the "{@area Meetings with Sarusanda|22f|x}" section for more details.
zh_tw: 當角色們一進入死亡之屋，薩魯桑妲就建議她和隊伍分開探索屋子。這樣一來，你可以專注於角色們，而不需要同時操控薩魯桑妲。角色們將會有幾次機會在屋子裡遇到薩魯桑妲。更多詳情請參閱"{@area 與薩魯桑達的會面|22f|x}"部分。

english: If you wish, Sarusanda can stay with the characters, and the events described in that section happen while she accompanies the party.
zh_tw: 如果您願意，薩魯桑達可以和角色們待在一起，她在陪伴隊伍時，那一節描述的事件會發生。

english: Death House
zh_tw: 死亡之屋

english: Before the characters enter Death House, make sure the players understand their goals. The characters can't leave until they encounter {@creature Strahd, Master of Death House|VEoR|Strahd von Zarovich}, as described in the "{@area Leaving the House|2b9|x}" section later in this chapter.
zh_tw: 在角色們進入死亡之屋之前，確保玩家們理解他們的目標。角色們在本章後面的'{@area 離開房子|2b9|x}'部分描述的遇到{@creature Strahd, Master of Death House|VEoR|施特拉德·馮·扎洛維奇}之前不能離開。

english: Death House Objective
zh_tw: 死亡之屋目標

english: The characters must take the fourth piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} from the Strahd-venerating cultists who operate from Death House's basement.
zh_tw: 角色們必須從在死亡之屋地下室活動的崇拜施特拉德的邪教徒手中奪取{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第四件部件。

english: The priests of Osybus have their own plans for the rod piece. As long as the eight priests inside the house are alive, they'll try to keep the characters from taking the artifact.
zh_tw: 奧西布斯的祭司們對法杖部件有自己的計劃。只要房子裡的八位祭司還活著，他們就會試圖阻止角色們取得這個神器。

english: Death House Encounters
zh_tw: 死亡之屋遭遇

english: The foul energies coalescing in Death House have spawned numerous horrors. When the characters enter locations with an "Encounter" subsection for the first time, the description will instruct you to roll on the Death House Encounters table below. With the exception of Meetings with Sarusanda, if you roll an encounter the characters have already overcome or an encounter that would be difficult to resolve in the location, choose an unencountered result instead.
zh_tw: 在死亡之屋聚集的邪惡能量孕育了無數的恐怖。當角色首次進入具有"遭遇"子節的地點時，描述將指導你滾動下面的死亡之屋遭遇表。除了與薩魯桑達的會面外，如果你滾動到角色已經克服的遭遇或在該地點難以解決的遭遇，請選擇一個未遭遇的結果。

english: Death House Encounters
zh_tw: 死亡之屋遭遇

english: Encounter
zh_tw: 遭遇

english: Meeting with Sarusanda (see below)*
zh_tw: 與薩魯桑達會面（見下文）*

english: Three {@creature Priest of Osybus|VRGR|priests of Osybus} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) lurk nearby, poised to strike†
zh_tw: 三名{@creature Priest of Osybus|VRGR|奧西布斯祭司}（參見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）潛伏在附近，準備發動襲擊†

english: One {@creature whirling chandelier|VEoR} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) falls on a random character before two {@creature Invisible Stalker||invisible stalkers} join the surprise attack
zh_tw: 一個{@creature whirling chandelier|VEoR|旋轉吊燈}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）在兩個{@creature Invisible Stalker||隱形追獵者}加入突襲之前隨機落在一個角色身上

english: Four {@creature vampire spawn} attack the party
zh_tw: 四隻{@creature vampire spawn||初生吸血鬼}攻擊隊伍

english: Four {@creature Helmed Horror||helmed horrors}, disguised as inanimate suits of armor, attack the characters
zh_tw: 四名偽裝成無生命盔甲的{@creature Helmed Horror||恐怖鎧甲}攻擊角色們。

english: †If the characters don't face this encounter before leaving Death House, assume that Sarusanda defeated these three priests on her own.
zh_tw: †如果角色們在離開死亡之屋之前沒有面對這次遭遇，假設薩魯桑達自己擊敗了這三位祭司。

english: *Since there are three possible meetings with Sarusanda, you can use this result up to three times.
zh_tw: *由於與薩魯桑達有三次可能的會面，您可以使用這個結果最多三次。

english: Meetings with Sarusanda
zh_tw: 與薩魯桑達的會面

english: The characters occasionally reunite with Sarusanda as they explore Death House. Each time you roll this result on the Death House Encounters table, run one of the following encounters, starting with the first and proceeding in order.
zh_tw: 當角色們探索死亡之屋時，他們偶爾會與薩魯桑達重聚。每次你在死亡之屋遭遇表上擲出這個結果時，從第一個開始，按順序進行以下遭遇之一。

english: Wounded Pride
zh_tw: 受傷的自尊

english: The remnants of a deadly battle lie about this chamber: broken bits of furniture, scattered weapons, and two bodies shrouded in dark robes. Sarusanda kneels in one corner, wrapping a linen bandage around her leg. She startles at your intrusion, then relaxes.
zh_tw: 這個房間內散落著一場致命戰鬥的遺蹟：破碎的傢俱碎片、散落的武器，以及兩個被黑暗長袍覆蓋的屍體。薩魯桑達跪在房間的一個角落，正在用亞麻繃帶包紮她的腿。她對你們的闖入感到吃驚，隨後又放鬆下來。

english: The robed bodies belong to two {@creature Priest of Osybus|VRGR|priests of Osybus} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}), each of whom is stable at 0 hit points. When the characters enter the room, each priest's Tattoo of Osybus trait causes the priest to rise on its next turn, at which point it attacks the characters.
zh_tw: 這些穿著長袍的屍體屬於兩位{@creature Priest of Osybus|VRGR|奧西布斯祭司}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}），每位祭司的生命值都穩定在0點。當角色們進入房間時，每位祭司的奧西布斯紋身特性會在下一個回合使祭司站起來，此時他們會攻擊角色們。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: Sarusanda has 30 hit points remaining and is obviously in pain. If the characters offer to heal her, she downplays her injuries. A character who succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check realizes that it's not just Sarusanda's body that's hurt—her pride is badly wounded too.
zh_tw: 薩魯桑達還剩下 30 點生命值，顯然處於痛苦之中。如果角色們提出為她療傷，她會輕描淡寫自己的傷勢。成功透過 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定的角色會意識到，受傷的不僅僅是薩魯桑達的身體——她的自尊也受到了嚴重的打擊。

english: If unaided, Sarusanda gains 1 level of {@condition exhaustion}, which she retains until she finishes a long rest outside Death House.
zh_tw: 如果無人幫助，薩魯桑達會獲得1級的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}狀態，除非她在死亡之屋外完成一次長休，否則她將一直保持這個狀態。

english: Séance
zh_tw: 降神會

english: Sarusanda interrogates a deceased cult member to learn more about the activities in Death House
zh_tw: 薩魯桑達審問一個已故的邪教成員，以瞭解更多關於死亡之屋的活動

english: Pungent sticks of incense burn around this room's perimeter. Sarusanda stares intently at a human skull clutched in her outstretched hand.
zh_tw: 這個房間的周圍燃燒著刺鼻的香。薩魯桑達專注地凝視著她伸出的手中緊握的一個人頭骨。

english: "Now tell me, servant of evil," Sarusanda demands of the skull, "where do your fellow occultists hide?"
zh_tw: "現在告訴我，邪惡的僕人，"薩魯桑達向骷髏發出要求，"你的同夥秘教徒藏在哪裡？

english: The skull replies, its teeth chattering, "Occultists? How droll! A better question: where are your manners?"
zh_tw: 骷髏回答道，牙齒咔噠作響："神秘學者？多麼有趣！一個更好的問題：你的禮貌在哪裡？"

english: Sarusanda uses {@spell Speak with Dead} to commune with a preserved skull she found in this room. The skull belonged to a cult member named Elya who was sacrificed by his fellow cultists.
zh_tw: 薩魯桑達使用{@spell Speak with Dead||死者交談}法術與她在房間裡發現的一個儲存完好的骷髏進行溝通。這個骷髏屬於一個名叫艾莉雅的邪教成員，他被他的同夥邪教徒獻祭了。

english: Interrogating the Skull
zh_tw: 審問骷髏

english: Elya's skull offers its words in hair-raising, singsong whispers. The skull doesn't know anything about the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} or the priests of Osybus. It can, however, give directions to the cultists' ritual chamber ({@adventure area D38|VEoR|5|D38: Ritual Chamber}) and describe their general motives: "We wish to impress our glorious lord, Strahd von Zarovich!"
zh_tw: 艾莉雅的頭骨以令人毛骨悚然的、歌唱般的低語說出話語。這個頭骨對{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}或奧西布斯的祭司一無所知。不過，它可以指引前往邪教徒儀式廳（{@adventure 區域 D38|VEoR|5|D38: Ritual Chamber}）的方向，並描述他們的大致動機："我們希望給我們光榮的領主，施特拉德·扎洛維奇留下深刻印象！"

english: Once Sarusanda is done speaking with the skull, it cackles in grim amusement, then floats into the air. Three {@creature Will-o'-Wisp||will-o'-wisps} emerge from corners of the room and join the skull (use the {@creature flameskull} stat block) in attacking the party and Sarusanda.
zh_tw: 一旦薩魯桑達與骷髏交談完畢，它就會發出陰森的笑聲，然後飄浮到空中。三個{@creature Will-o'-Wisp||鬼火}從房間的角落出現並加入骷髏（使用{@creature flameskull||燃焰之顱}的統計資料塊）攻擊隊伍和薩魯桑達。

english: Crisis of Faith
zh_tw: 信仰危機

english: Run this encounter with Sarusanda after the characters have claimed the rod piece from the cultists (see {@adventure area D38|VEoR|5|D38: Ritual Chamber}) but before they encounter Strahd.
zh_tw: 在角色們從邪教徒手中獲得權杖碎片後（見{@adventure 區域 D38|VEoR|5|D38: Ritual Chamber}）但在他們遭遇施特拉德之前，執行這個與薩魯桑達的遭遇。

english: Sarusanda stands in the middle of the room. Her shoulders are slumped beneath her grimy armor, and dark circles underline her weary eyes. She doesn't turn to face you, but she holds a finger in the air to indicate silence. A moment later, the room erupts into chaos as three tattooed figures dart from the shadows.
zh_tw: 薩魯桑達站在房間中央。她的肩膀在髒汙的盔甲下顯得低垂，她疲憊的眼下有深色的眼圈。她沒有轉過身來面對你，但她舉起一根手指示意安靜。片刻之後，隨著三個紋身人物從陰影中衝出，房間突然陷入混亂。

english: Three {@creature Priest of Osybus|VRGR|priests of Osybus} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) attack Sarusanda and the party, entering the room from multiple directions if possible.
zh_tw: 三位{@creature Priest of Osybus|VRGR|奧西布斯祭司}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）攻擊薩魯桑達和隊伍，如果可能的話，他們將從房間的多個方向進入。

english: With or without the characters' help, Sarusanda fights passionately against the priests. She discards her normally staid demeanor for this battle and openly rages at the priests, making careless tactical decisions amid the turmoil.
zh_tw: 無論角色們是否提供幫助，薩魯桑達都充滿激情地與祭司們戰鬥。在這場戰鬥中，她摒棄了通常冷靜的態度，公開對祭司們發洩怒火，在混亂中做出魯莽的戰術決策。

english: Sarusanda's Secret
zh_tw: 薩魯桑達的秘密

english: After the battle, a character who asks Sarusanda what's wrong is greeted with a long, bitter sigh. The inquisitor then reveals the source of her distress.
zh_tw: 戰鬥結束後，當一個角色詢問薩魯桑達出了什麼問題時，他得到的是一聲長長的、苦澀的嘆息。然後，這位審問官透露了她痛苦的根源。

english: Shortly after she joined the Ulmist Inquisition, Sarusanda's father—a man named Galias—joined the priests of Osybus. Sarusanda witnessed him commit a terrible act in the cult's name, though she doesn't give details, and the inquisitor admits she didn't arrest her father. Sarusanda considers this her greatest failing.
zh_tw: 薩魯桑達加入烏爾米斯特審問局不久後，她的父親——一個名叫加利亞斯的男人——加入了奧西布斯的祭司行列。薩魯桑達目睹了他以邪教的名義犯下了一件可怕的行為，儘管她沒有給出細節，這位審問官承認她沒有逮捕她的父親。薩魯桑達認為這是她最大的失敗。

english: Galias was fully inducted into the priests of Osybus, and Sarusanda heard that he would be among the cultists at Death House today. She is enraged that she hasn't found Galias so she can confront him.
zh_tw: 加利亞斯已完全被奧西布斯的祭司接納，薩魯桑達聽說他今天會在死亡之屋的邪教徒中。她因為沒有找到加利亞斯而感到憤怒，她想要面對他。

english: Regardless of the characters' reaction to this revelation, learning it counts as a secret for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
zh_tw: 無論角色們對這個揭示有何反應，瞭解它都算作本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則的秘密。

english: Death House Features
zh_tw: 死亡之屋特點

english: The locations in Death House have the following features.
zh_tw: 死亡之屋的地點具有以下特點。

english: Ceilings
zh_tw: 天花板

english: Ceilings vary in height by floor. The first floor has 10-foot-high ceilings, the second floor has 12-foot-high ceilings, the third floor has 8-foot-high ceilings, and the attic has 13-foot-high ceilings.
zh_tw: 每層樓的天花板高度各不相同。一樓有10尺高的天花板，二樓有12尺高的天花板，三樓有8尺高的天花板，閣樓有13尺高的天花板。

english: Haunted Doors
zh_tw: 鬧鬼的門

english: When Strahd enters the house later in this chapter, certain doors marked on the map become haunted doors; see the "{@area Haunted Zones|2a2|x}" section for details.
zh_tw: 當施特拉德在本章稍後進入房屋時，地圖上標註的某些門將成為鬧鬼之門；詳情請參閱"{@area 鬧鬼區域|2a2|x}"部分。

english: Lighting
zh_tw: 光照

english: Unless otherwise noted, each room in the house is lit with {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light} by oil lamps, a fireplace, or some other light source when the characters arrive. The cultists take oil lamps into the ritual chamber ({@adventure area D38|VEoR|5|D38: Ritual Chamber}) when they gather there.
zh_tw: 除非另有說明，當角色們抵達時，屋內的每個房間都由油燈、壁爐或其他光源提供{@quickref Vision and Light||2||明亮光照}。邪教徒們聚集在儀式室（{@adventure 區域 D38|VEoR|5|D38: Ritual Chamber}）時，會攜帶油燈進入。

english: The Mists
zh_tw: 迷霧

english: When the characters enter Death House, the Mists surround the building and prevent them from leaving. A creature that enters the Mists around Death House reemerges seconds later in a random room in Death House. Only Strahd can disperse the Mists (see the "{@area Leaving the House|2b9|x}" section).
zh_tw: 當角色們進入死亡之屋時，迷霧包圍了建築物並阻止他們離開。進入死亡之屋周圍迷霧的生物會在幾秒後重新出現在死亡之屋的隨機房間中。只有施特拉德可以驅散迷霧（詳見"{@area 離開房子|2b9|x}"部分）。

english: Self-Repair
zh_tw: 自我修復

english: After 24 hours, any damage to the house repairs itself. The house also repairs itself as soon as Strahd enters the building.
zh_tw: 24小時後，房子的任何損壞都會自行修復。施特拉德一旦進入這座建築，房子也會立即進行自我修復。

english: Walls
zh_tw: 牆壁

english: The walls of the house are made of 1-foot-thick brick. The dungeon is carved from earth, clay, and rock. Dungeon tunnels are 5 feet wide by 10 feet high with timber braces at 5-foot intervals.
zh_tw: 房子的牆壁由1尺厚的磚塊構成。地牢是從泥土、粘土和岩石中挖掘出來的。地牢的隧道寬5尺，高10尺，每5尺間隔有木製支撐。

english: Death House Locations
zh_tw: 死亡之屋地點

english: These locations are keyed to map 5.1.
zh_tw: 這些位置對應於地圖5.1上的關鍵點。

english: Map 5.1: Death House
zh_tw: 地圖 5.1：死亡之屋

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: D1a–D1b: Portico and Antechamber
zh_tw: D1a–D1b: 門廊和前廳

english: A hinged, wrought-iron gate fills the archway leading to a stone portico. Oil lamps hang from the portico ceiling by chains, flanking an oaken double door.
zh_tw: 一扇帶鉸鏈的鍛鐵大門佔據了通往石頭門廊的拱門。油燈透過鏈條懸掛在門廊天花板上，兩側是橡木雙開門。

english: The double door opens into an empty antechamber. On the south wall is a shield emblazoned with a stylized golden windmill on a red field.
zh_tw: 雙開門通向一個空蕩蕩的前廳。在南牆上有一個盾牌，上面繪有一個紅色背景上的金色風車圖案。

english: A closed double door stands a few steps beyond.
zh_tw: 幾步遠的地方有一扇關閉的雙開門。

english: The doors are unlocked.
zh_tw: 這些門沒有上鎖。

english: D2a–D2b: Main Hall and Cloakroom
zh_tw: D2a–D2b: 主廳和衣帽間

english: This hall runs the width of the house, with a black marble fireplace at one end and a sweeping red marble staircase at the other.
zh_tw: 這個大廳貫穿整個房子的寬度，一端是一個黑色大理石壁爐，另一端是一個宏偉的紅色大理石樓梯。

english: The door to a cloakroom on the east wall is slightly ajar; the black cloaks inside are damp.
zh_tw: 東牆上的衣帽間門微微敞開；裡面的黑色斗篷是潮溼的。

english: The hall is bare of furniture. Faint footprints lead to the cloakroom (area D2b).
zh_tw: 大廳裡沒有傢俱。微弱的腳印通向衣帽間（區域D2b）。

english: Encounter
zh_tw: 遭遇

english: Roll on the {@area Death House Encounters|22e|x} table the first time a character enters this room.
zh_tw: 當角色第一次進入這個房間時，根據{@area 死亡之屋遭遇|22e|x}表格進行擲骰。

english: D3: Den of Wolves
zh_tw: D3: 狼窩

english: This oak-paneled room looks like a hunter's den. A stag's head is mounted above the fireplace, and three stuffed wolves are positioned around the outskirts of the room.
zh_tw: 這個橡木鑲板的房間看起來像一個獵人的窩。壁爐上方掛著一隻雄鹿的頭，三隻填充好的狼被放置在房間的外圍。

english: Trapdoor
zh_tw: 活板門

english: A character searching the southwest corner of the room finds a trapdoor with a successful {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check. The trapdoor is barred from the other side ({@adventure area D32|VEoR|5|D32: Hidden Trapdoor}). It is a Medium object with AC 13, 15 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 一名角色搜尋房間的西南角時，若成功透過{@dc 20}的智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，可發現一個活板門。該活板門從另一側被閂住（{@adventure 區域 D32|VEoR|5|D32: Hidden Trapdoor}）。這是一箇中型物體，AC 13，15點生命值，且免疫毒藥和心靈傷害。

english: D4a–D4b: Kitchen and Pantry
zh_tw: D4a–D4b: 廚房和食品儲藏室

english: The kitchen is tidy, with dishware, cookware, and utensils neatly placed on shelves. A dome-shaped stone oven stands near the east wall. Near the oven is a well-stocked pantry.
zh_tw: 廚房整潔有序，餐具、炊具和廚具都整齊地擺放在架子上。一個圓頂形狀的石爐靠近東牆。爐子附近是一個儲備充足的食品儲藏室。

english: The kitchen is area D4a, while the pantry is area D4b.
zh_tw: 廚房是D4a區域，而食品儲藏室是D4b區域。

english: Dumbwaiter
zh_tw: 升降機

english: Behind a small door in the southwest corner of the kitchen is a dumbwaiter—a 2-foot-wide stone shaft containing a wooden elevator box attached to a hand-operated rope-and-pulley mechanism. The shaft connects to the servants' quarters ({@area area D7a|251|x}) and the Durst parents' bedroom ({@area area D12a|261|x}).
zh_tw: 在廚房西南角的一扇小門後面，有一個雜物升降機——一個2尺寬的石制井道，內含一個木製的升降箱，連線在一個手搖繩索和滑輪機制上。這個井道連線到僕人房間（{@area 區域D7a|251|x}）和德斯特父母的臥室（{@area 區域D12a|261|x}）。

english: A Small character can squeeze into the elevator box with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check. The dumbwaiter's rope-and-pulley mechanism can support 200 pounds of weight before breaking.
zh_tw: 一個小型角色可以透過一次成功的{@dc 10}敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定擠進升降機箱體。升降機的繩索滑輪機械裝置最多可承受200磅的重量，超過就會損壞。

english: D5: Dining Room
zh_tw: D5: 餐廳

english: The centerpiece of this wood-paneled dining room is a carved mahogany table, covered with resplendent silverware and crystalware and surrounded by eight high-backed chairs.
zh_tw: 這個木鑲板餐廳的中心是一張雕刻精美的桃花心木餐桌，上面覆蓋著華麗的銀器和水晶器皿，並被八張高背椅子所環繞。

english: This area is empty except for the immaculate table dressing.
zh_tw: 這個區域除了無瑕的餐桌布置外，空無一物。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The silverware and crystalware here are worth 2,500 gp total.
zh_tw: 這裡銀器和水晶器皿總共價值2500金幣。

english: D6: Upper Hall
zh_tw: D6: 上層大廳

english: Unlit oil lamps are mounted on the walls of this elegant hall. Hanging above the mantelpiece is a wood-framed portrait of a family: a man and a woman with two smiling children—the same children you saw outside. The marble staircase continues upward.
zh_tw: 這個優雅的大廳牆壁上裝有未點燃的油燈。壁爐上方掛著一個木框家庭肖像畫：一對男女和兩個微笑的孩子——就是你在外面看到的那兩個孩子。大理石樓梯繼續向上。

english: The red marble staircase that started on the first floor continues its upward spiral to {@adventure area D11|VEoR|5|D11: Balcony}. A cold draft flows down the steps.
zh_tw: 從一樓開始的紅色大理石樓梯繼續向上螺旋延伸至{@adventure 區域D11|VEoR|5|D11: Balcony}。一股冷風順著臺階吹下。

english: D7a–D7b: Servants' Room and Closet
zh_tw: D7a-D7b: 僕人室和小儲藏室

english: An undecorated bedroom contains a pair of beds with straw-stuffed mattresses.
zh_tw: 一個未加裝飾的臥室裡有一對填充著稻草的床墊的床。

english: An empty footlocker rests at the foot of each bed. Tidy servants' uniforms hang from hooks in the adjoining closet (area D7b).
zh_tw: 每個床尾都有一個空的行李箱。整潔的僕人制服掛在隔壁衣櫥（區域 D7b）的掛鉤上。

english: Dumbwaiter
zh_tw: 升降機

english: A small door in the corner of the room opens onto the shaft of the dumbwaiter.
zh_tw: 房間角落裡的一扇小門通向雜物升降機的井道。

english: D8: Library
zh_tw: D8: 圖書館

english: The priests of Osybus are known for the evil practice of trapping enemies' souls into tattoos on the priests' bodies
zh_tw: 奧西布斯的祭司以將敵人的靈魂困在他們身上的紋身中的邪惡做法而聞名。

english: A mahogany desk faces the fireplace of this private library, and two overstuffed chairs fill the room's corners. Floor-to-ceiling bookshelves line the south wall. A rolling wooden ladder allows access to the higher shelves.
zh_tw: 這個私人圖書館裡的桃花心木書桌面向壁爐，兩個塞滿填充物的椅子佔據了房間的角落。從地板到天花板的書架排列在南牆上。一個滾動的木製梯子可以讓人夠到更高的架子。

english: The bookshelves hold hundreds of tomes on topics such as history, warfare, and alchemy.
zh_tw: 書架上擺滿了關於歷史、戰爭和鍊金術等主題的數百本書籍。

english: Encounter
zh_tw: 遭遇

english: Roll on the {@area Death House Encounters|22e|x} table the first time a character enters this room.
zh_tw: 當角色第一次進入這個房間時，根據{@area 死亡之屋遭遇|22e|x}表格進行擲骰。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A secret door behind a bookshelf in the southeast corner of the room can be opened by pulling on a switch disguised as a red-covered book with a blank spine. A character inspecting the bookshelf spots the fake book with a successful {@dc 13} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check. Unless the secret door is propped open, springs in the hinges cause it to close on its own. Beyond the secret door lies area {@dice D9}.
zh_tw: 房間東南角書架後面的秘密門可以透過拉動偽裝成紅色封皮、書脊空白的書上的開關來開啟。一名角色在成功透過 {@dc 13} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定時可以發現這本假書。除非秘密門被撐開，否則鉸鏈上的彈簧會使其自動關閉。透過秘密門後是 {@dice D9} 區域。

english: D9: Secret Room
zh_tw: D9: 密室

english: This secret room contains bookshelves packed with tomes describing Fiend-summoning rituals.
zh_tw: 這個秘密房間的書架上擺滿了描述召喚惡魔儀式的書籍。

english: Trapped Chest
zh_tw: 陷阱寶箱

english: An unlocked treasure chest stands against the room's south wall. When a creature opens this chest's lid, poison-tipped darts shoot from a spring-loaded mechanism attached to the lid's underside. Each creature within 10 feet of the chest that isn't behind {@quickref cover||3||total cover} takes 2 ({@dice 1d4}) piercing damage and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@dice 4d10}) poison damage and have the {@condition poisoned} condition for 1 hour.
zh_tw: 一個未上鎖的寶箱靠在房間的南牆上。當一個生物開啟這個寶箱的蓋子時，毒鏢會從蓋子底部的彈簧裝置中射出。每個在寶箱10尺範圍內且沒有處於{@quickref cover||3||全身掩護}的生物會受到2點（{@dice 1d4}）穿刺傷害，並且必須成功透過一個{@dc 15}的體質豁免檢定，否則會受到22點（{@dice 4d10}）毒素傷害，並在1小時內獲得{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態。

english: A character who succeeds on a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check while examining the chest spots the trap mechanism. As an action, a character can use thieves' tools to make a {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check to disarm the trap. Failing this check triggers the trap.
zh_tw: 一個角色在檢查箱子時成功透過了一次 {@dc 20} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，發現陷阱機構。作為一個動作，角色可以使用盜賊工具進行一次 {@dc 15} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定以解除陷阱。檢定失敗將觸發陷阱。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The chest contains three blank books with black leather covers (worth 25 gp each) and three {@item Spell Scroll||Spell Scrolls} ({@spell Bless}, {@spell Protection from Poison}, and {@spell Spiritual Weapon}).
zh_tw: 箱子裡裝有三本黑色皮革封面的空白書籍（每本價值25金幣），以及三卷{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}（分別是{@spell Bless||祝福術}、{@spell Protection from Poison||防護毒素}和{@spell Spiritual Weapon||靈體武器}）。

english: D10: Conservatory
zh_tw: D10: 溫室

english: A harpsichord and bench fill this elegant hall's northwest corner. On the opposite side of the room, a large standing harp rests near the room's fireplace. Upholstered chairs line the walls.
zh_tw: 在這個優雅的大廳的西北角，有一架大鍵琴和琴凳。在房間的對面，一把大型立式豎琴放在壁爐附近。牆壁邊擺放著軟墊椅子。

english: Encounter
zh_tw: 遭遇

english: Roll on the {@area Death House Encounters|22e|x} table the first time a character enters this room.
zh_tw: 當角色第一次進入這個房間時，根據{@area 死亡之屋遭遇|22e|x}表格進行擲骰。

english: D11: Balcony
zh_tw: D11: 陽臺

english: At the top of the red marble staircase is a balcony with a suit of black plate armor standing against one wall.
zh_tw: 在紅色大理石樓梯的頂部是一個陽臺，陽臺上靠牆放著一套黑色板甲。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A character who examines the west wall and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check finds a secret door that pushes open to reveal a cobweb-filled wooden staircase leading to the attic.
zh_tw: 一個角色如果檢查西牆並在{@dc 15}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定中成功，會發現一扇可以推開的秘密門，裡面露出一個滿是蜘蛛網的木製樓梯，通向閣樓。

english: D12a–D12c: Master Suite
zh_tw: D12a–D12c: 主人套房

english: Burgundy drapes cover the windows of this large bedroom. The furnishings include a four-poster bed, a matching pair of wardrobes, and a vanity with a jewelry box. A portrait of a man and woman hangs above a fireplace. A parlor in the southwest corner contains a table and two chairs.
zh_tw: 這間寬敞的臥室的窗戶被酒紅色的窗簾覆蓋。傢俱包括一張四柱床、一對相匹配的衣櫃以及帶有珠寶盒的梳妝檯。壁爐上方掛著一幅男女肖像畫。西南角的客廳裡有一張桌子和兩把椅子。

english: The couple in the portrait are the same people from the family portrait in the upper hall ({@adventure area D6|VEoR|5|D6: Upper Hall}). A door facing the foot of the bed opens to an empty closet (area D12b). A door in the parlor leads to an outside balcony (area D12c).
zh_tw: 肖像中的夫婦與上層大廳（{@adventure 區域D6|VEoR|5|D6: Upper Hall}）家族肖像中的人物相同。一張面向床尾的門通向空置的衣櫥（區域D12b）。客廳中的一扇門通往外部陽臺（區域D12c）。

english: Dumbwaiter
zh_tw: 升降機

english: A dumbwaiter in the southwest corner connects to {@area areas D4a|249|x} and {@area D7a|251|x} below.
zh_tw: 西南角的一個雜物升降機連線到下面的{@area 區域D4a|249|x}和{@area D7a|251|x}區域。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The jewelry box on the vanity is made of silver with gold filigree (worth 75 gp). It contains three gold rings (worth 25 gp each) and a thin platinum necklace with a topaz pendant (worth 750 gp).
zh_tw: 梳妝檯上的珠寶盒由銀製成，帶有金絲細工（價值 75 gp）。盒內有三枚金戒指（每枚價值 25 gp）和一條細鉑金項鍊，帶有一個黃玉吊墜（價值 750 gp）。

english: D13: Bathroom
zh_tw: D13: 浴室

english: This dark room contains a barrel under a spigot in the east wall, a wooden claw-foot tub, and a small iron stove with a kettle resting atop it.
zh_tw: 這個昏暗的房間裡有一個位於東牆下的桶，桶下有一個水龍頭，還有一個帶木製爪足的浴缸，以及一個上面放著水壺的小鐵爐。

english: This room is otherwise empty.
zh_tw: 這個房間除此之外是空的。

english: D14: Storage Room
zh_tw: D14: 儲藏室

english: Dusty shelves line the walls of this room. The shelves hold linens and other household goods.
zh_tw: 這個房間的牆壁上排列著塵土飛揚的架子。架子上擺放著亞麻布和其他家庭用品。

english: D15a–D15c: Nursemaid's Suite
zh_tw: D15a–D15c: 保姆套房

english: This bedroom contains a large bed, two nightstands, and a large mirror. A double door fitted with stained-glass windows opens onto a balcony. One of the nightstands has been knocked over, and one of the windows has been smashed.
zh_tw: 這間臥室裡有一張大床，兩個床頭櫃，還有一面大鏡子。一扇配有彩色玻璃窗的雙開門通向陽臺。一個床頭櫃被撞倒了，一扇窗戶被打碎了。

english: This elegantly appointed bedroom (area D15a) and an adjoining nursery (area D15b) were occupied by the Dursts' nursemaid, Brigetta, the cult's latest victim.
zh_tw: 這個裝飾優雅的臥室（區域D15a）和相鄰的嬰兒房（區域D15b）曾是德斯特家族的保姆，布里吉塔的住處，她是邪教的最新受害者。

english: The double door opens onto a balcony (area D15c) overlooking the front of the house.
zh_tw: 這扇雙開門通向一個陽臺（區域D15c），可以俯瞰房子的正面。

english: Encounter
zh_tw: 遭遇

english: Roll on the {@area Death House Encounters|22e|x} table the first time a character enters this room.
zh_tw: 當角色第一次進入這個房間時，根據{@area 死亡之屋遭遇|22e|x}表格進行擲骰。

english: Signs of Abduction
zh_tw: 綁架跡象

english: A character who succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check ascertains that the disarrayed nightstand and broken window are the result of a recent struggle. Rainwater on the floor around the broken window indicates the struggle occurred within the last few hours.
zh_tw: 一個成功透過 {@dc 15} 智力 ({@skill Investigation||調查}) 檢定的角色會斷定混亂的床頭櫃和破碎的窗戶是最近一場搏鬥的結果。破碎窗戶周圍地板上的雨水錶明這場搏鬥發生在過去幾小時內。

english: A character who examines the area and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check finds scuffs on the floor in area D15a from the victim's shoes. These scuffs create a trail to a secret door that leads up to the attic.
zh_tw: 一個角色若仔細檢查該區域併成功透過 {@dc 15} 的感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定，可以在 D15a 區域發現受害者鞋子在地板上的擦痕。這些擦痕形成了一條通往閣樓的秘密門的蹤跡。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A character who examines the mirror and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check finds a secret door behind the mirror. (Characters who saw scuff marks leading to the secret door find it without needing to make a check.) The secret door pushes open to reveal a cobweb-filled wooden staircase leading to the attic.
zh_tw: 一個角色若檢查鏡子併成功透過 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，會發現鏡子後面有一扇暗門。（如果角色看到通向暗門的磨損痕跡，則無需進行檢定即可發現它。）這扇暗門輕輕一推便可開啟，露出一條佈滿蛛網的木製樓梯，通向閣樓。

english: D16: Attic Hall
zh_tw: D16: 閣樓大廳

english: This bare hallway can be accessed by the staircase behind the secret doors in {@adventure areas D11|VEoR|5|D11: Balcony} and D15a.
zh_tw: 這條空蕩的走廊可以透過{@adventure 區域D11|VEoR|5|D11: Balcony}和D15a的暗門後的樓梯進入。

english: D17: Spare Bedroom
zh_tw: D17: 備用臥室

english: This room contains a narrow bed, a nightstand, a writing desk, and a rocking chair.
zh_tw: 這個房間內有一張窄床，一個床頭櫃，一個寫字檯，還有一把搖椅。

english: This room is otherwise empty.
zh_tw: 這個房間除此之外是空的。

english: D18: Storage Room
zh_tw: D18: 儲藏室

english: This chamber is packed with old furniture draped in white sheets.
zh_tw: 這個房間堆滿了用白色床單覆蓋的舊傢俱。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A character who examines the east wall and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check finds a secret door that opens to reveal a secret stair ({@adventure area D21|VEoR|5|D21: Secret Stairs}) to the dungeon ({@adventure area D22|VEoR|5|D22: Dungeon Level Access}).
zh_tw: 一個檢查東牆併成功透過{@dc 15}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定的角色會發現一扇暗門，開啟後露出通往地牢（{@adventure 區域D22|VEoR|5|D21: Secret Stairs}）的秘密樓梯（{@adventure 區域 D21|VEoR|5|D22: Dungeon Level Access}）。

english: D19: Spare Bedroom
zh_tw: D19: 備用臥室

english: This room contains a narrow bed, a nightstand, a rocking chair, an empty wardrobe, and a small iron stove.
zh_tw: 這個房間內有一張窄床，一個床頭櫃，一把搖椅，一個空衣櫃，還有一臺小鐵爐。

english: This room is otherwise empty.
zh_tw: 這個房間除此之外是空的。

english: D20: Children's Room
zh_tw: D20: 兒童房

english: This bedroom contains two small, wood-framed beds, a toy chest, and a dollhouse—a perfect miniature replica of this dreary mansion.
zh_tw: 這間臥室裡有兩張小的木框床，一個玩具箱，還有一個娃娃屋——這是這座陰鬱大廈的完美縮小複製品。

english: Characters who investigate the dollhouse find all the house's secret doors, including one in the attic leading to a spiral staircase (area {@dice D21}) that descends below the house.
zh_tw: 調查娃娃屋的角色會發現房子裡所有的暗門，包括閣樓上的一個暗門，它通向一個螺旋樓梯（區域{@dice D21}），這個樓梯向下延伸至房子下方。

english: Encounter
zh_tw: 遭遇

english: Roll on the {@area Death House Encounters|22e|x} table the first time a character enters this room.
zh_tw: 當角色第一次進入這個房間時，根據{@area 死亡之屋遭遇|22e|x}表格進行擲骰。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Inside the toy chest is a doll that resembles a tall, pale human with black hair and a pronounced widow's peak. Something papery rattles inside the doll's hollow body. A character who removes the doll's head and looks down its neck finds a {@item Spell Scroll} of {@spell Detect Evil and Good}.
zh_tw: 玩具箱裡有一個娃娃，它像是一個高個子、蒼白的黑髮人類，有著明顯的尖尖髮型。娃娃空心的身體裡發出紙質的沙沙聲。一個角色如果取下娃娃的頭並從脖子處往下看，會發現一張{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}，上面寫著{@spell Detect Evil and Good||偵測善惡}法術。

english: D21: Secret Stairs
zh_tw: D21: 秘密樓梯

english: This narrow spiral staircase is made of creaky wood contained within a 5-foot-wide shaft of mortared stone. The staircase descends 50 feet from the house's attic to area {@dice D22} in the dungeon level.
zh_tw: 這個狹窄的螺旋樓梯由吱吱作響的木頭製成，被一個5尺寬的砌石井道所包圍。樓梯從房子的閣樓向下延伸50尺，到達地牢層的區域{@dice D22}。

english: D22: Dungeon Level Access
zh_tw: D22: 地牢層入口

english: The wooden spiral staircase from the attic (area {@dice D21}) ends here. A narrow tunnel stretches southward before branching east and west.
zh_tw: 閣樓（區域{@dice D21}）的木製螺旋樓梯在這裡結束。一條狹窄的隧道向南延伸，然後分別向東和西分叉。

english: Chanting
zh_tw: 吟唱聲

english: From the moment they arrive in the dungeon, the characters hear an eerie, incessant chant echoing throughout the chambers. It's impossible to determine which direction the sound is coming from until the characters reach {@adventure areas D26|VEoR|5|D26: Hidden Spiked Pit} or {@adventure D29|VEoR|5|D29: Intersection}. They can't discern its words until they reach {@adventure area D35|VEoR|5|D35: Reliquary}.
zh_tw: 從他們抵達地牢的那一刻起，角色們就聽到一陣詭異、持續不斷的吟唱聲在各個房間中迴盪。在角色們到達{@adventure 區域D26|VEoR|5|D26: Hidden Spiked Pit}或{@adventure D29|VEoR|5|D29: Intersection}之前，無法確定聲音來自哪個方向。在他們到達{@adventure 區域 D35|VEoR|5|D35: Reliquary}之前，無法分辨其詞語。

english: D23c–D23f: Family Crypts
zh_tw: D23c–D23f: 家族墓穴

english: Each crypt is open to the hallway. The stone slabs meant to seal the rooms lean against the walls outside the crypts.
zh_tw: 每個墓穴都通向走廊。本應封閉墓穴的石板斜靠在墓穴外的牆壁上。

english: These crypts are intended to hold the remains of the Durst family members on their deaths.
zh_tw: 這些墓穴是為了在德斯特家族成員去世時存放他們的遺體而設計的。

english: The crypts in areas D23a and D23b are empty, and the slabs for these crypts are unmarked.
zh_tw: D23a和D23b區域的墓穴是空的，這些墓穴的石板沒有標記。

english: The remaining crypts (areas D23c–D23f) each contain an empty coffin on a stone bier.
zh_tw: 剩下的墓穴（D23c至D23f區域）每個都有一個空棺材放在石制的靈床上。

english: D24: Cult Initiates' Quarters
zh_tw: D24: 邪教新信徒宿舍

english: A wooden table and four chairs stand at the east end of this room. Four alcoves containing straw pallets open off the west half of the room.
zh_tw: 這個房間的東端放著一張木桌和四把椅子。房間西半部有四個凹室，裡面鋪著稻草墊。

english: D25: Cultist Quarters and Well
zh_tw: D25: 邪教徒宿舍與井

english: This area centers on a 4-foot-diameter, 30-foot-deep cistern with a 3-foot-high stone lip. A wooden bucket hangs from a rope-and-pulley mechanism bolted to the crossbeams above the well. Five small rooms with no doors branch off the well room.
zh_tw: 這個區域中心是一個直徑4尺、深30尺的蓄水池，蓄水池邊緣有3尺高的石質邊緣。一個木桶懸掛在井上方橫樑上的繩索和滑輪機制上。五個沒有門的小房間從井房間分叉出去。

english: The five small bedrooms serve as quarters for senior cultists. Each contains a wood-framed bed with a straw mattress and a wooden chest. Each chest is secured with a rusty iron padlock that can be picked using thieves' tools with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check.
zh_tw: 五間小臥室供高階邪教徒居住。每間都有一張木框床，上鋪草墊，和一個木箱。每個箱子都用一把生鏽的鐵掛鎖鎖著，可以透過成功的{@dc 15}敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定使用盜賊工具開啟。

english: Encounter
zh_tw: 遭遇

english: Roll on the {@area Death House Encounters|22e|x} table the first time a character enters this room.
zh_tw: 當角色第一次進入這個房間時，根據{@area 死亡之屋遭遇|22e|x}表格進行擲骰。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: In addition to worthless personal effects, each chest contains one of the following:
zh_tw: 除了沒有價值的個人物品外，每個箱子裡還包含以下物品之一：

english: 110 gp and 60 sp in a pouch made of human skin
zh_tw: 110金幣和60銀幣裝在一個由人皮製成的袋子裡

english: Three pieces of cut jade (worth 100 gp each) in a folded piece of black cloth
zh_tw: 三塊切割過的玉石（每塊價值100金幣）包裹在一塊摺疊的黑布中

english: A black leather eye patch with a peridot (worth 500 gp) sewn into it
zh_tw: 一個黑色皮革眼罩，上面縫著一顆橄欖石（價值500金幣）

english: A chess set with pieces made of obsidian and chalcedony (worth 250 gp)
zh_tw: 一套由黑曜石和玉髓製成的國際象棋（價值250金幣）

english: A {@item +2 Shortsword}
zh_tw: 一件{@item +2 Shortsword||+2 短劍}

english: D26: Hidden Spiked Pit
zh_tw: D26: 隱藏的尖刺坑

english: As you move farther down this tunnel, the chanting heard throughout the dungeon gets louder to the west.
zh_tw: 隨著你深入這條隧道，地牢中迴盪的吟唱聲在西邊變得越來越響。

english: A character who examines the floor and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check notices a suspicious absence of footprints in this hallway. A character searching the floor for traps finds a 5-foot-long, 10-foot-deep pit hidden under rotted wooden planks. The pit has poisoned wooden spikes at the bottom. The first character to step on the cover falls through, landing {@condition prone} and taking 3 ({@dice 1d6}) bludgeoning damage from the fall plus 11 ({@dice 2d10}) piercing damage and 11 ({@dice 2d10}) poison damage from the spikes.
zh_tw: 一個檢查地面並在 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定中成功的角色會注意到走廊內腳印的異常缺失。一個搜尋地面陷阱的角色會發現一個 5 尺長、10 尺深的坑，隱藏在腐朽的木地板下。坑底有塗毒的木質尖刺。第一個踩上覆蓋物的角色會掉入坑中，倒地 {@condition prone||伏地}，並因墜落受到 3 ({@dice 1d6}) 點鈍擊傷害，加上 11 ({@dice 2d10}) 點穿刺傷害和 11 ({@dice 2d10}) 點毒素傷害。

english: D27: Dining Hall
zh_tw: D27: 餐廳

english: This room contains a plain wooden table flanked by long benches. Bones lie scattered on the floor.
zh_tw: 這個房間內有一張普通的木桌，兩邊是長凳。骨頭散落在地板上。

english: These moldy Humanoid bones are the remains of the cult's vile banquets.
zh_tw: 這些發黴的人形骨頭是邪教惡行宴會的殘骸。

english: D28: Larder
zh_tw: D28: 食品儲藏室

english: Aside from scraps of food, this alcove is empty.
zh_tw: 除了食物殘渣外，這個凹室是空的。

english: D29: Intersection
zh_tw: D29: 交叉路口

english: The chanting heard throughout the dungeon is noticeably louder to the north of this intersection.
zh_tw: 在地牢中迴盪的吟唱聲在這個交叉口的北邊明顯更響亮。

english: D30: Stairs Down
zh_tw: D30: 向下樓梯

english: Any character standing at the top of this 20-foot-long staircase realizes the chants originate from somewhere below. Characters who descend the stairs and follow the hall beyond arrive in {@adventure area D35|VEoR|5|D35: Reliquary}.
zh_tw: 任何站在這個20尺長樓梯頂端的角色都會意識到吟唱聲來自下方某處。沿著樓梯下行並穿過前方走廊的角色會到達{@adventure 區域 D35|VEoR|5|D35: Reliquary}。

english: D31: Darklord's Shrine
zh_tw: D31: 黑暗領主的神龕

english: This room is full of moldy skeletons that hang from rusty shackles against the walls. A wide alcove in the south wall contains a painted wooden statue carved in the likeness of a gaunt, pale-faced man wearing a black cloak.
zh_tw: 這個房間充滿了發黴的骷髏，它們掛在牆上生鏽的鐐銬中。南牆上一個寬闊的凹室裡有一個彩繪的木雕，雕刻的是一個面容憔悴、臉色蒼白、身穿黑色斗篷的男子。

english: The statue depicts Strahd, to whom the cultists make sacrifices in the vain hope that he will reveal his secrets to them.
zh_tw: 這座雕像描繪的是施特拉德，邪教徒們向他獻祭，徒勞地希望他能向他們透露他的秘密。

english: Encounter
zh_tw: 遭遇

english: Roll on the {@area Death House Encounters|22e|x} table the first time a character enters this room.
zh_tw: 當角色第一次進入這個房間時，根據{@area 死亡之屋遭遇|22e|x}表格進行擲骰。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: Characters searching the room find a secret door in the middle of the east wall with a successful {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check. The door pulls open to reveal a stone staircase that climbs 10 feet to a landing (area {@dice D32}).
zh_tw: 角色們在搜尋房間時，若成功進行{@dc 10}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}檢定，將在東牆中央發現一扇暗門。門拉開後露出一段石階，爬上10尺即到達一處平臺（區域{@dice D32}）。

english: D32: Hidden Trapdoor
zh_tw: D32: 隱藏的活板門

english: The staircase ends at a landing with a 6-foot-high wooden ceiling with a trapdoor set into it. The trapdoor is bolted shut from this side and can be pushed open to reveal the den ({@adventure area D3|VEoR|5|D3: Den of Wolves}) above.
zh_tw: 樓梯盡頭是一個平臺，上方有一個6尺高的木製天花板，其中嵌有一個活板門。活板門從這一側用螺栓鎖住，可以推開以露出上方的狼窩（{@adventure 區域D3|VEoR|5|D3: Den of Wolves}）。

english: D33: Cult Leaders' Den
zh_tw: D33: 邪教領袖的巢穴

english: A chandelier hangs above a table in the middle of this room. Two high-backed chairs flank the table, which has an empty clay jug and two clay flagons atop it.
zh_tw: 這個房間中央的桌子上方懸掛著一盞吊燈。兩張高背椅分列在桌子兩側，桌上放著一個空的陶製酒壺和兩個陶製酒杯。

english: This is Gustav and Elisabeth's den. Iron candlesticks stand in two corners, their candles lit.
zh_tw: 這是古斯塔夫和伊麗莎白的巢穴。兩個角落裡各立著一個鐵燭臺，上面的蠟燭點燃著。

english: D34: Cult Leaders' Quarters
zh_tw: D34: 邪教領袖的住處

english: This room contains a wood-framed bed with a feather mattress, a wardrobe containing several robes, a pair of iron candlesticks, and an open crate containing thirty torches and a leather sack with fifteen candles inside it.
zh_tw: 這個房間內有一張帶羽絨床墊的木框床，一個內含幾件長袍的衣櫃，一對鐵燭臺，以及一個裝有三十支火把和一個內含十五支蠟燭的皮革袋子的開啟的板條箱。

english: At the foot of the bed is an unlocked but empty wooden footlocker. This is Gustav and Elisabeth's bedroom.
zh_tw: 床尾是一個未上鎖但空著的木製行李箱。這是古斯塔夫和伊麗莎白的臥室。

english: D35: Reliquary
zh_tw: D35: 聖物室

english: Loud chants issue from a hallway near the southwest corner. You discern many voices repeating, "She is slain, she is risen."
zh_tw: 響亮的吟唱聲從西南角附近的走廊傳來。你分辨出許多聲音在重複，"她被殺了，她復活了。"

english: Lurking in the shadows are two {@creature Shambling Mound||shambling mounds} that move to attack as soon as anyone enters this room. The cult keeps "relics" in this chamber. These worthless items—human remains, mundane material components for spellcasting, and so forth—are stored in thirteen niches along the walls.
zh_tw: 潛伏在陰影中的是兩個{@creature Shambling Mound||蔓生怪}，一旦有人進入這個房間就會立即移動並攻擊。邪教在這個房間裡存放著"聖物"。這些毫無價值的物品——人類遺骸、施法用的普通材料元件等等——被存放在沿牆的十三個壁龕中。

english: Death House's reliquary is home to lurking monsters as well as components used in the Durst family's rituals
zh_tw: 死亡之屋的聖物室是潛伏怪物的家園，同時也是德斯特家族儀式中使用的元件所在之處。

english: D36: Prison
zh_tw: D36: 監獄

english: The alcoves here feature chains ending in shackles attached to the back walls.
zh_tw: 這裡的凹室配有鏈條，鏈條末端是固定在後牆上的鐐銬。

english: Despite the ominous trappings, the alcoves are empty.
zh_tw: 儘管有不祥的裝飾，這些凹室是空的。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: Characters searching the area find a secret door in the south wall with a successful {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check. It pulls open to reveal {@adventure area D38|VEoR|5|D38: Ritual Chamber} on the other side.
zh_tw: 角色搜尋該區域時，透過一次成功的{@dc 15}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定可在南牆上發現一扇暗門。拉開後可以看見另一側的{@adventure 區域 D38|VEoR|5|D38: Ritual Chamber}。

english: D37: Tunnel to Portcullis
zh_tw: D37: 通往吊閘的隧道

english: This tunnel is blocked by a rusty iron portcullis.
zh_tw: 這條隧道被一扇生鏽的鐵製格柵門堵住了。

english: This tunnel slopes down at a 20-degree angle into murky water and ends at a rusty portcullis. The floor around the portcullis is submerged under 2 feet of soupy water.
zh_tw: 這條隧道以20度角傾斜向下進入渾濁的水中，並在一扇生鏽的鐵製格柵門處結束。格柵門周圍的地面被2尺深的泥水淹沒。

english: The portcullis can be forcibly lifted with a successful {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. Otherwise, it can be raised or lowered by turning a wooden wheel in the east wall of area {@dice D38}. (The wheel is beyond the reach of someone east of the portcullis.)
zh_tw: 成功透過 {@dc 20} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}) 檢定可以強行抬起閘門。否則，可以透過轉動 {@dice D38} 區域東牆上的木輪來抬起或降低閘門。（閘門東側的人無法夠到木輪。）

english: D38: Ritual Chamber
zh_tw: D38: 儀式室

english: Featureless stone pillars support the high ceiling in this forty-foot-square chamber. Murky water covers the floor, and a breach in the west wall leads to a dark cave heaped with refuse. Stairs lead up to dry stone ledges that hug the walls. Fourteen hooded figures stand atop the ledges, chanting loudly.
zh_tw: 在這個四十尺見方的房間裡，沒有特色的石柱支撐著高高的天花板。渾濁的水覆蓋了地面，西牆上的一個缺口通向一個堆滿垃圾的黑暗洞穴。樓梯通向緊貼牆壁的乾燥石質壁架。十四個戴兜帽的人站在壁架上，高聲吟唱。

english: In the middle of the room, an octagonal dais rises above the water. Atop the dais is a stone altar drenched in freshly spilled blood. The source of the blood is the body of lifeless woman dangling above the altar from chains mounted to the ceiling. A ceramic stake has been plunged through the woman's heart. Standing next to the altar is a large fiend wielding a gruesome crimson spear.
zh_tw: 房間中央，一個八角形的臺子高出水面。臺子頂部是一個石頭祭壇，上面沾滿了剛灑的鮮血。血的來源是一個無生命的女人的身體，她被懸掛在天花板上的鏈條上，懸掛在祭壇上方。一根陶瓷木樁已經刺穿了女人的心臟。站在祭壇旁邊的是一個手持可怕深紅色長矛的大惡魔。

english: The cultists chant: "She is slain, she is risen. Come to us, Lord Strahd. Receive our gift!"
zh_tw: 邪教徒們吟唱道："她被殺了，她復活了。來吧，施特拉德大人。接受我們的禮物！"

english: The water here is 2 feet deep. The ledges and central dais are 5 feet high (3 feet higher than the water's surface), and the chamber's ceiling is 16 feet high (11 feet above the dais and ledges). The chains dangling from the ceiling are 8 feet long.
zh_tw: 這裡的水深2尺。壁架和中央臺子高5尺（比水面高3尺），房間的天花板高16尺（比臺子和壁架高11尺）。懸掛在天花板上的鏈條長8尺。

english: Embedded in the east wall is a wooden wheel connected to hidden chains and mechanisms. A character can use an action to turn the wheel, raising or lowering the portcullis in the eastern wall (see area {@dice D37}). The hole in the west wall contains a heap of stones, rags, and plant matter.
zh_tw: 東牆上嵌著一個木製輪子，它連線著隱藏的鏈條和機械裝置。角色可以使用動作來轉動輪子，升起或降下東牆上的鐵製格柵門（見區域{@dice D37}）。西牆上的洞裡堆滿了石頭、破布和植物材料。

english: Cult's Ritual
zh_tw: 邪教儀式

english: The figures along the ledge include Gustav and Elisabeth ({@creature Cult Fanatic||cult fanatics}), five senior cult members ({@creature Cult Fanatic||cult fanatics}), and seven {@creature Cultist||cultists}. The cult members fight only to defend themselves.
zh_tw: 壁架上的人物包括古斯塔夫和伊麗莎白（{@creature Cult Fanatic||邪教狂信者}），五名高階邪教成員（{@creature Cult Fanatic||邪教狂信者}），以及七名{@creature Cultist||邪教徒}。邪教成員僅會為了自衛而戰鬥。

english: Dangling from the chains above the altar is the corpse of the Dursts' nursemaid, Brigetta. The cult ritually sacrificed Brigetta using a ceremonial stake tipped with the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|fourth piece} of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, which is still embedded in Brigetta's chest.
zh_tw: 從祭壇上方的鎖鏈上懸掛著德斯特家族的保姆布麗姬塔的屍體。邪教使用帶有{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|第四部分}的儀式樁將布麗姬塔作為祭品獻祭，{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的部分仍嵌入在她的胸膛中。

english: A {@creature relentless impaler|VEoR} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) has risen from the pool of Brigetta's blood on the altar. When the impaler detects the characters, it attacks. The impaler hunts them throughout the house until it is destroyed or the characters defeat it. For its Bloodheart Stake trait, the impaler is bound to the stake in Brigetta's corpse.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature relentless impaler|VEoR|無情的刺穿者}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）從祭壇上布里吉塔的血泊中升起。當刺穿者偵測到角色們時，它會發起攻擊。刺穿者在整個房子裡追逐他們，直到它被摧毀或角色們擊敗它。對於它的血心釘特性，刺穿者與布里吉塔屍體上的木樁繫結。

english: Retrieving the Rod Piece
zh_tw: 取回權杖部件

english: If the relentless impaler is destroyed, the cultists cower in fear and allow the characters to take the rod piece from Brigetta's corpse. For more about the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, see this book's {@area introduction|00e|x}.
zh_tw: 如果無情的穿刺者被摧毀，邪教徒會因恐懼而退縮，並允許角色們從布里吉塔的屍體上取走法杖部件。有關{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的更多資訊，請參見本書的{@area 簡介|00e|x}。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: Once the characters claim the rod piece, Gustav and Elisabeth regard them with bitter disdain. "None dare trespass in the territory of Strahd," Gustav says. "You will answer to our master," Elisabeth adds with sinister certainty. They offer no further comments or information. As the characters leave the area, the cultists chant, "He is the Ancient. He is the Land."
zh_tw: 一旦角色們索取了法杖部件，古斯塔夫和伊麗莎白便以極度的輕蔑看待他們。"沒有人敢侵犯施特拉德的領地，"古斯塔夫說。"你們將對我們的主人負責，"伊麗莎白以陰險的確定性補充道。他們沒有提供進一步的評論或資訊。當角色們離開這個區域時，邪教徒們吟唱著，"他是古老的。他是這片土地。"

english: The cult leaders aren't bluffing. As soon as the characters take the fourth rod piece, Strahd enters Death House and makes his presence known. See the "{@area Strahd's Presence|2a0|x}" section below.
zh_tw: 邪教領袖們不是在虛張聲勢。一旦角色們拿到第四根杆件，施特拉德就進入死亡之屋並讓人們知道他的存在。詳見下面的"{@area 施特拉德的存在|2a0|x}"部分。

english: Sarusanda's Company
zh_tw: 薩魯桑達的公司

english: Once the characters have defeated the Death House cultists and claimed the rod piece, run the "{@area Crisis of Faith|236|x}" encounter detailed in the "{@area Meetings with Sarusanda|22f|x}" section earlier in the chapter at a time of your choosing to ensure she rejoins the characters before they face Strahd.
zh_tw: 一旦角色們擊敗了死亡之屋的邪教徒並索取了法杖部件，你可以選擇在合適的時機執行本章前面"{@area 信仰危機|236|x}"部分中詳細描述的"{@area 與薩魯桑達的會面|22f|x}"遭遇，以確保她在角色們面對施特拉德之前重新加入。

english: Having slain the priests of Osybus, seen the cult's plans thwarted, and made sure the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} piece is safe with the characters, Sarusanda's work in the house is done. She accompanies the characters for the remainder of their time in Death House (see the "{@area Leaving the House|2b9|x}" section).
zh_tw: 擊敗了奧西布斯的祭司，目睹了邪教計劃的失敗，並確保了{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的部件安全地與角色們在一起，薩魯桑達在房子裡的工作完成了。她將陪伴角色們在死亡之屋的剩餘時間（見"{@area 離開房子|2b9|x}"部分）。

english: Strahd's Presence
zh_tw: 施特拉德的存在

english: Strahd has finally deemed Death House worthy of attention. Once the party retrieves the rod piece in the ritual chamber, read the following to describe Strahd's arrival at Death House. The characters won't yet see Strahd, but they'll feel his presence.
zh_tw: 施特拉德終於認為死亡之屋值得關注。一旦隊伍在儀式室中取回法杖部件，請閱讀以下內容來描述施特拉德到達死亡之屋的情景。角色們尚未見到施特拉德，但他們將感受到他的存在。

english: A gust of wind blasts through the halls of Death House, and the temperature drops precipitously. Candles and lamps snuff out and relight with dark-purple flames. The wind takes on a monstrous timbre—like screeching bats or howling wolves—and crescendos to a deafening roar. Suddenly, it stops.
zh_tw: 一陣狂風橫掃死亡之屋的走廊，溫度急劇下降。蠟燭和燈具熄滅後又以深紫色的火焰重新點燃。風聲變得像怪物一樣——像是尖叫的蝙蝠或嚎叫的狼——然後逐漸增強到震耳欲聾的咆哮。突然，它停止了。

english: For a long moment, you hear nothing. Then, as clearly as if it were happening right next to you, the house's front door creaks open and slowly closes, latching with a crisp click. Then, once again, nothing.
zh_tw: 在很長一段時間裡，你什麼也沒聽到。然後，就像它就發生在你旁邊一樣清晰，房子的前門吱嘎一聲開啟，然後慢慢關上，發出清脆的咔嗒聲。接著，又是一片寂靜。

english: The characters must now contend with Strahd's nightmare magic in Death House until they find and face the Darklord directly.
zh_tw: 角色們現在必須在死亡之屋中應對施特拉德的噩夢魔法，直到他們找到並直接面對黑暗領主。

english: Haunted Zones
zh_tw: 鬧鬼區域

english: Strahd can twist his domain to suit his whims. Starting when he makes his presence known, certain doorways in the house no longer connect to the rooms they did before. Instead, creatures that pass through these doorways enter an isolated demiplane called a haunted zone.
zh_tw: 施特拉德可以根據自己的奇想來扭曲他的領域。從他顯露自己存在的那一刻起，房子裡的某些門不再通往它們之前連線的房間。相反，透過這些門的生物會進入一個被稱為鬧鬼區域的孤立半位面。

english: Entering a Haunted Zone
zh_tw: 進入鬧鬼區域

english: A character enters a haunted zone whenever they do one of the following:
zh_tw: 當角色進行以下任一活動時，他們將進入一個鬧鬼區域：

english: Finish a long rest in Death House
zh_tw: 在死亡之屋完成一次長休

english: Move through a haunted doorway (marked on {@adventure map 5.1|VEoR|5|Map 5.1: Death House})
zh_tw: 透過一個鬧鬼的門道（標記在{@adventure 地圖 5.1|VEoR|5|Map 5.1: Death House}上）

english: Only one haunted zone manifests at a time. As long as at least one creature is in a haunted zone, any other creatures that enter a haunted zone appear in that same zone regardless of how they arrive. Once all the characters inside a haunted zone exit it, that zone can't be encountered again. The haunted zones are described below in the "{@area Death House Hauntings|2a8|x}" section.
zh_tw: 一次只有一個鬧鬼區域顯現。只要至少有一個生物在鬧鬼區域內，任何其他進入鬧鬼區域的生物，不論他們如何到達，都會出現在同一區域。一旦所有在鬧鬼區域內的角色離開，那個區域就不會再被遇到。鬧鬼區域在下面的"{@area 死亡之屋的鬼魂現象|2a8|x}"部分中有描述。

english: Haunted Doorways
zh_tw: 鬧鬼的門道

english: The room on the other side of a haunted doorway is filled with magical darkness and silence, giving no hint of whatever is within. A creature that partially passes through a haunted doorway—such as by poking a limb or held item into the darkness—is magically pulled into the haunted zone.
zh_tw: 位於鬧鬼門道另一側的房間充滿了魔法性的黑暗和寂靜，不會透露其內部的任何資訊。一個生物如果部分穿過鬧鬼門道——比如將肢體或手持物品伸入黑暗——將被魔法性地拉入鬧鬼區域。

english: Haunted doorways are one-way passages. Within the demiplane, nothing exists except what is described in each entry. When a character passes through a haunted doorway, that haunted doorway turns back to a normal doorway after 1 minute.
zh_tw: 鬧鬼的門道是單向通道。在半位面中，除了每個條目中描述的內容外，不存在任何東西。當角色透過一個鬧鬼的門道時，那個鬧鬼的門道在1分鐘後會變回一個普通的門道。

english: Exiting a Haunted Zone
zh_tw: 退出鬧鬼區域

english: To leave a haunted zone, a character must perform the task specified in the haunted zone's "Correct Exit" section. The "Failed Exit" section describes how creatures that don't perform the required task are eventually forced from the haunted zone.
zh_tw: 要離開一個鬧鬼區域，角色必須完成鬧鬼區域的"正確退出"部分指定的任務。"失敗退出"部分描述了那些沒有執行所需任務的生物最終是如何被迫離開鬧鬼區域的。

english: Finding the Correct Exit
zh_tw: 找到正確的出口

english: A character who casts {@spell Detect Evil and Good} or {@spell Find the Path} or who has {@sense truesight} sees a faint aura around an object related to the task necessary to exit the room. A character can also locate such an object by looking at the area and succeeding on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check.
zh_tw: 一個施放了 {@spell Detect Evil and Good||偵測善惡} 或 {@spell Find the Path||尋路術} 的角色，或者擁有 {@sense truesight||真實視覺} 的角色，會看到與離開房間所需任務相關的物體周圍有微弱的靈光。一個角色也可以透過觀察該區域並在 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定中成功來找到這樣的物體。

english: Leaving a Haunted Zone
zh_tw: 離開鬧鬼區域

english: A character who exits a haunted zone appears somewhere in Death House. Characters who leave the same haunted zone emerge in the same part of Death House. The transition is sudden and disorienting, like waking from a dream. Roll on the Emergence from a Haunted Zone table below to determine where the characters appear when they leave a haunted zone, or choose one of the locations listed.
zh_tw: 一個角色離開鬧鬼區域時，會出現在死亡之屋的某個地方。從同一個鬧鬼區域離開的角色會在同一部分死亡之屋出現。過渡是突然且令人迷失方向的，就像從夢中醒來一樣。在下面的"從鬧鬼區域出現"表格上擲骰子，以確定角色離開鬧鬼區域時出現的位置，或者從列出的地點中選擇一個。

english: Emergence from a Haunted Zone
zh_tw: 從鬧鬼區域的出現

english: d6
zh_tw: d6

english: Location Emerged
zh_tw: 出現的地點

english: The characters sit in the dining room ({@adventure area D5|VEoR|5|D5: Dining Room}), sated and covered with sticky crumbs, though there's no food in sight.
zh_tw: 角色們坐在餐廳（{@adventure 區域D5|VEoR|5|D5: Dining Room}），吃飽了並沾滿黏糊糊的麵包屑，儘管眼前沒有任何食物。
