english: The characters stand in the storage room ({@adventure area D18|VEoR|5|D18: Storage Room}), draped in sheets.
zh_tw: 角色們站在儲藏室（{@adventure 區域D18|VEoR|5|D18: Storage Room}），身上蓋著床單。

english: The characters kneel at the side of the cultists' well ({@adventure area D25|VEoR|5|D25: Cultist Quarters and Well}), desperately parched.
zh_tw: 角色們跪在邪教徒的水井旁（{@adventure 區域D25|VEoR|5|D25: Cultist Quarters and Well}），極度口渴。

english: The characters are slumped over the furniture in the storage room ({@adventure area D18|VEoR|5|D18: Storage Room}).
zh_tw: 角色們癱倒在儲藏室（{@adventure 區域D18|VEoR|5|D18: Storage Room}）的傢俱上。

english: The characters lean against the railing of the nursemaid's balcony ({@area area D15c|268|x}).
zh_tw: 角色們靠在保姆的陽臺欄杆上（{@area 區域D15c|268|x}）。

english: The characters are shackled to the wall in the prison ({@adventure area D36|VEoR|5|D36: Prison}), each character in a different alcove. The characters can easily break their bonds.
zh_tw: 角色們被銬在監獄（{@adventure 區域 D36|VEoR|5|D36: Prison}）的牆上，每個角色在不同的壁龕中。角色們可以輕易掙脫束縛。

english: Once the characters have encountered all four haunted zones, they don't encounter any more. Long rests function as normal, and the haunted doorways become normal doorways.
zh_tw: 一旦角色們遇到了所有四個鬧鬼區域，他們就不會再遇到了。長休將正常進行，鬧鬼的門道也變成了普通的門道。

english: Death House Hauntings
zh_tw: 死亡之屋的鬼魂現象

english: If the characters fall in Death House, Strahd will happily claim the piece of the Rod of Seven Parts therein
zh_tw: 如果角色們在死亡之屋中倒下，施特拉德將高興地索取那裡的七碎片之杖部件。

english: The characters enter the following haunted zones in the order presented.
zh_tw: 角色們按照呈現的順序進入以下鬧鬼區域。

english: Castle Dining Hall
zh_tw: 城堡餐廳

english: You stand at one end of an impossibly long wooden dining table in the hall of a stone keep. Gilded plates, cutlery, and goblets of blood-red wine are set for each member of your party.
zh_tw: 你站在一座石制堡壘大廳裡一張不可能長的木製餐桌的一端。為你們隊伍的每個成員都擺放著鍍金的盤子、餐具和盛滿血紅色葡萄酒的高腳杯。

english: At the other end of the table stands a tall, pale man. He wears regal, red garb, and his raven hair comes to a prominent widow's peak. He smiles menacingly at you as he raises his goblet in a toast. "Welcome, my guests. May you find the eternal hospitality of Strahd von Zarovich to your liking. Should at any point you wish to leave, simply find me and ask."
zh_tw: 在桌子的另一端站著一個高大、蒼白的男人。他穿著華貴的紅色服裝，他的黑髮在額頭上形成了一個突出的美人尖。他帶著威脅性的微笑向你們舉起酒杯致意。"歡迎，我的客人們。願你們喜歡施特拉德·馮·扎洛維奇的永恆款待。如果你們在任何時候想要離開，只需找到我並提出請求。"

english: The "Strahd" in this haunted zone is an illusion. The illusion stands still in anticipation of the characters returning its toast, at which point the illusion quaffs its drink; it doesn't respond to anything else. If the illusion is struck with an attack, it dissolves into a cloud of bats (see "Failed Exit" below).
zh_tw: 這個鬧鬼區域中的"施特拉德"是一種幻象。幻象靜止不動，期待著角色們回應它的敬酒，屆時幻象將一飲而盡；它不會對其他任何事情作出反應。如果幻象被攻擊擊中，它會化為一群蝙蝠消散（見下面的"失敗退出"）。

english: The chamber distorts and elongates as a character attempts to move throughout it. No matter how fast or far a character moves, that character winds up a step or two away from the end of the table where they started.
zh_tw: 當角色試圖穿過這個房間時，房間扭曲並延伸。無論角色移動得多快或多遠，他們最終都會發現自己離他們開始時桌子的盡頭只有一步或兩步之遙。

english: Correct Exit
zh_tw: 正確的出口

english: To escape the dining hall, each character trapped in it must drink from one of the chalices on the table. The wine is thick and metallic tasting. When the character drinks it, the character's vision slowly turns red before returning to normal when the character exits the haunted zone. The only thing the character can hear during this time is the sound of Strahd's deep, spooky laughter.
zh_tw: 要逃離餐廳，每個被困在裡面的角色都必須從桌上的聖盃中喝一杯酒。這酒口感濃稠，帶有金屬味。當角色喝下它時，他們的視野會慢慢變紅，然後在角色離開鬧鬼區域時恢復正常。在這段時間裡，角色唯一能聽到的是施特拉德深沉、令人毛骨悚然的笑聲。

english: Failed Exit
zh_tw: 錯誤的出口

english: If after 1 minute no one has drunk from a chalice, Strahd's illusion dissolves into a cloud of bats that quickly fills the chamber. At the start of each turn, the bats deal 7 ({@dice 2d6}) piercing damage to each creature in the haunted zone. After 5 turns, the bats completely obscure the characters' vision, and the characters exit the haunted zone.
zh_tw: 如果在1分鐘內沒有人從聖盃中飲水，施特拉德的幻象就會溶解成一群迅速填滿房間的蝙蝠雲。在每個回合的開始，蝙蝠對鬧鬼區域內的每個生物造成7（{@dice 2d6}）點穿刺傷害。5回合後，蝙蝠完全遮蔽了角色們的視線，角色們退出了鬧鬼區域。

english: Endless Graveyard
zh_tw: 無盡墓地

english: Countless headstones dot this barren landscape as far as you can see. A pale full moon looms over the horizon.
zh_tw: 無數的墓碑點綴著這片貧瘠的景觀，一直延伸到你能看到的地方。一輪蒼白的滿月懸掛在地平線上。

english: The headstones continue in every direction no matter how far a character travels. Each headstone is inscribed with the name of a different individual who died within Strahd's domain (the names eventually repeat). Buried beneath each tombstone is a coffin that either is empty or contains an illusion of Strahd's corpse.
zh_tw: 無論角色走多遠，墓碑在每個方向上都持續延伸。每個墓碑上都刻著在施特拉德領地內死去的不同個人的名字（這些名字最終會重複）。每個墓碑下埋葬的棺材要麼是空的，要麼包含施特拉德屍體的幻象。

english: Correct Exit
zh_tw: 正確的出口

english: A character who reads the headstones finds one bearing their own name. A character can exit this haunted zone by disinterring the empty coffin buried beneath a headstone bearing the character's name, opening the coffin, and lying in it.
zh_tw: 一個閱讀墓碑的角色會發現一個刻有自己名字的墓碑。角色可以透過挖掘刻有自己名字的墓碑下的空棺材，開啟棺材並躺在裡面來退出這個鬧鬼區域。

english: Failed Exit
zh_tw: 錯誤的出口

english: If a character fails to leave the graveyard, that character must eventually make camp. When a character finishes a long rest in this haunted zone, the character gains 1 level of {@condition exhaustion}, doesn't gain the benefits of the long rest, and exits the haunted zone.
zh_tw: 如果一個角色未能離開墓地，那個角色最終必須紮營。當角色在這個鬧鬼區域完成一次長休時，該角色獲得1級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}狀態，不會獲得長休的益處，並退出鬧鬼區域。

english: Ghostly Recital
zh_tw: 幽靈般的朗誦

english: You're seated in an ornate chair on the edge of a dimly lit parlor. Eight ghostly figures sit in identical chairs to either side of you. At the parlor's far end, a pale man at a harpsichord slowly plinks out a haunting elegy. The ghostly figures listen to the song with rapt attention.
zh_tw: 你坐在一個裝飾華麗的椅子上，位於一個昏暗的客廳邊緣。你兩側有八個幽靈般的人物坐在相同的椅子上。在客廳的遠端，一個面色蒼白的男人在大鍵琴上慢慢地彈出一首令人難忘的輓歌。這些幽靈般的人物全神貫注地聆聽著這首歌。

english: This zone resembles Death House's conservatory ({@adventure area D10|VEoR|5|D10: Conservatory}), except the room's doors and windows overlook a black, featureless void.
zh_tw: 該區域類似於死亡之屋的溫室（{@adventure 區域D10|VEoR|5|D10: Conservatory}），只是房間的門窗俯瞰著一片漆黑、毫無特徵的虛空。

english: If a character makes any noise or otherwise disrupts the performance, the musician—yet another illusion of Strahd—ceases playing, scowls at the character, and disappears. Eight {@creature Specter||specters} fly out of the harpsichord and attack the characters in anger.
zh_tw: 如果角色發出任何噪音或以其他方式幹擾了表演，這位音樂家——施特拉德的另一個幻象——會停止演奏，對角色皺眉，然後消失。八個{@creature Specter||惡靈}從大鍵琴中飛出，憤怒地攻擊角色們。

english: Correct Exit
zh_tw: 正確的出口

english: A character at the harpsichord can make a {@dc 14} Charisma ({@skill Performance}) check to play the rest of the interrupted melody. On a successful check, the ghostly figures sigh with contentment, and the characters exit the haunted zone.
zh_tw: 彈奏大鍵琴的角色可以進行一次 {@dc 14} 魅力 ({@skill Performance||表演}) 檢定，以演奏完被打斷的旋律。若檢定成功，幽靈般的身影會心滿意足地嘆息，角色們則離開鬧鬼的區域。

english: Failed Exit
zh_tw: 錯誤的出口

english: If after 1 minute no one has successfully played the rest of the song, the illusion of Strahd reappears at the harpsichord and hammers out a series of chords. Each character takes 11 ({@dice 2d10}) thunder damage and exits the haunted zone.
zh_tw: 如果在1分鐘內沒有人成功演奏完剩餘的歌曲，施特拉德的幻象會重新出現在大鍵琴旁，並敲擊出一系列和絃。每個角色受到11（{@dice 2d10}）點雷鳴傷害，並退出鬧鬼區域。

english: The Crying Room
zh_tw: 哭泣之室

english: The floor of this bedroom is littered with creepy dolls, monstrous stuffed animals, and misshapen toys. The two children you saw outside the house stand in the middle of the doorless, windowless room, weeping uncontrollably. Large tears run down their faces, pooling in impossible quantities on the floorboards.
zh_tw: 這個臥室的地板上散落著令人毛骨悚然的洋娃娃、怪物填充動物和奇形怪狀的玩具。你在房子外面看到的兩個孩子站在沒有門和窗戶的房間中央，無法控制地哭泣。大滴的淚水順著他們的臉頰流下，在地板上匯聚成不可能的數量。

english: The children are illusions of Rose and Thorn. They are inconsolable; any attempt to interact with the children reveals their illusory nature. Every minute, the water covering the floor of the 10-foot-high bedroom rises an additional 1 foot.
zh_tw: 這些孩子們是羅絲和索恩的幻象。他們無法被安慰；任何試圖與孩子們互動的嘗試都會揭示出他們的虛幻本質。每過一分鐘，覆蓋在這個10尺高的臥室地板上的水就會上升額外的1尺。

english: A character who inspects the items in the room discovers that the dolls look like cartoonish versions of the characters, Sarusanda, and Strahd.
zh_tw: 一個檢查房間裡物品的角色發現，這些洋娃娃看起來像是角色們、薩魯桑達和施特拉德的卡通版本。

english: Correct Exit
zh_tw: 正確的出口

english: To exit the haunted zone, a character must pull the head off the Strahd doll. If the characters struggle to figure this out, allow them to examine the doll and attempt a {@dc 13} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check to realize the truth. The doll's neck reveals itself to be a drain hole, and the head is a plug. All the water in the room spirals into the drain, pulling the characters with it and causing them to exit the zone.
zh_tw: 要離開鬧鬼區域，角色必須將施特拉德玩偶的頭拔掉。如果角色們難以理解這一點，允許他們檢查玩偶並進行一次 {@dc 13} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定以發現真相。玩偶的頸部顯現為一個排水孔，而頭部是一個塞子。房間內的所有水都會旋入排水孔，將角色們捲入其中並使他們離開該區域。

english: Failed Exit
zh_tw: 錯誤的出口

english: If the characters are still in this haunted zone after 10 minutes, the water level reaches the room's ceiling, and each character in this haunted zone gains 1 level of {@condition exhaustion} and exits the zone.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在10分鐘後仍然在這個鬧鬼區域，水位將達到房間的天花板，並且這個鬧鬼區域內的每個角色都會獲得1級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}效果並退出該區域。

english: Leaving the House
zh_tw: 離開房子

english: The characters can attempt to leave Death House at any time. If the characters haven't yet faced Strahd, the Mists invariably return them to a random room. Teleportation spells likewise fail.
zh_tw: 角色們可以隨時嘗試離開死亡之屋。如果角色們還沒有面對施特拉德，迷霧總是會將他們送回到一個隨機的房間。同樣，傳送法術也會失敗。

english: To leave Death House, the characters must first face Strahd.
zh_tw: 要離開死亡之屋，角色們首先必須面對施特拉德。

english: Reuniting with Sarusanda
zh_tw: 與薩魯桑達重聚

english: If Sarusanda hasn't yet rejoined the characters, run the "{@area Crisis of Faith|236|x}" encounter detailed in "{@area Meetings with Sarusanda|22f|x}"; she then rejoins the party and is with them when they face Strahd.
zh_tw: 如果薩魯桑達還沒有重新加入角色們，就執行在"{@area 與薩魯桑達的會面|22f|x}"中詳細描述的"{@area 信仰危機|236|x}"遭遇；然後她將重新加入隊伍，並在角色們面對施特拉德時與他們在一起。

english: Facing Strahd
zh_tw: 面對施特拉德

english: After he arrives at Death House, {@creature Strahd, Master of Death House|VEoR} (see {@area appendix B|566|x}) waits for the characters in the house's main hall ({@area area D2a|243|x}). He is accompanied by two {@creature vampire spawn}.
zh_tw: 到達死亡之屋後，{@creature Strahd, Master of Death House|VEoR|施特拉德，死亡之主}（見{@area 附錄 B|566|x}）在房子的主廳（{@area 區域D2a|243|x}）等待角色們。他由兩個{@creature vampire spawn||初生吸血鬼}陪同。

english: If the characters don't intend to return to the main hall, Strahd and his minions wait for the characters in another room of the house, such as the dining room ({@adventure area D5|VEoR|5|D5: Dining Room}) or the den of wolves ({@adventure area D3|VEoR|5|D3: Den of Wolves}).
zh_tw: 如果角色們不打算返回主廳，施特拉德和他的僕從會在房子的另一個房間等待角色們，例如餐廳（{@adventure 區域D5|VEoR|5|D5: Dining Room}）或狼窩（{@adventure 區域D3|VEoR|5|D3: Den of Wolves}）。

english: When Strahd encounters the characters, read the following:
zh_tw: 當施特拉德遇到角色們時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: "So, intruders into my realm, we finally meet. From the way the villagers spoke about you, I expected you to be more impressive. Ah, well. I am forever disappointed with the insects that think themselves worthy of meeting me. I suppose I could entertain myself with destroying you."
zh_tw: "那麼，闖入我的領域的入侵者們，我們終於見面了。從村民對你們的描述來看，我本以為你們會更加令人印象深刻。啊，好吧。我永遠對那些自以為是、值得與我見面的蟲子感到失望。我想我可以以摧毀你們來娛樂自己。"

english: Sarusanda's Influence
zh_tw: 薩魯桑達的影響

english: If Sarusanda is with the party, Strahd regards the Ulmist inquisitor with grave respect and allows her to leave the house. "I will permit you to flee this place," he intones. "But only if you do so immediately, and you never return."
zh_tw: 如果薩魯桑達與隊伍在一起，施特拉德會以極大的尊重對待這位烏爾米斯特審問官，並允許她離開房子。"我將允許你逃離這個地方，"他宣告。"但只有在你立即這麼做，並且永不回來的情況下。"

english: He glances at the characters, then asks Sarusanda, "Do you know them?"
zh_tw: 他掃視了角色們一眼，然後問薩魯桑達："你認識他們嗎？"

english: Sarusanda's Answer
zh_tw: 薩魯桑達的回答

english: If Sarusanda is indifferent to the characters, she denies any affiliation with them and takes her leave. Strahd applauds the characters for surviving so long in his realm, then attacks them.
zh_tw: 如果薩魯桑達對角色們漠不關心，她會否認與他們有任何關聯並離開。施特拉德為角色們在他的領地記憶體活了這麼長時間而鼓掌，然後攻擊他們。

english: If Sarusanda is friendly with the characters, she says that they are also members of the Ulmist Inquisition. Strahd asks the characters if this is true. A character can then make a {@dc 20} Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check to convince Strahd they are members or otherwise important to the group. On a successful check, Strahd allows the party to leave Death House with Sarusanda. On a failure, Strahd sees through the ruse and dismisses Sarusanda before challenging the characters to combat.
zh_tw: 如果薩魯桑達對角色們友好，她會說他們也是烏爾米斯特審判庭的成員。施特拉德會詢問角色們這是否屬實。隨後，角色可以進行一次 {@dc 20} 魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}）檢定，以說服施特拉德他們是該組織的成員或對團隊有重要意義。如果檢定成功，施特拉德允許隊伍與薩魯桑達一同離開死亡之屋。如果檢定失敗，施特拉德識破詭計並遣散薩魯桑達，隨後向角色們發起戰鬥挑戰。

english: Next Steps
zh_tw: 下一步

english: Once the characters have acquired the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|fourth piece} of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} and escaped Death House, they can travel to the western outskirts of Barovia without trouble. The characters easily find the portal to Sigil in the mist.
zh_tw: 一旦角色獲得了{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|第四部分}的{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}並逃離了死亡之屋，他們便可以無礙地前往巴洛維亞的西部邊緣。角色們很容易在迷霧中找到通往法印城的傳送門。

english: Chapter 6: Night of Blue Fire
zh_tw: 第6章：藍色火焰之夜

english: To retrieve the fifth rod piece, the characters must infiltrate Three Moons Vault, a complex teeming with allies of the evil Lord Soth
zh_tw: 為了取回第五根杆件，角色們必須潛入三月亮金庫，這是一個充滿了邪惡領主索思盟友的複雜設施。

english: To find the next piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, the characters must travel to the world of Krynn where the Blue Fire Wardens, a coalition of benevolent lycanthropes, have clashed with the death knight {@creature Lord Soth|DSotDQ} and his minions. By infiltrating a heavily fortified keep, rescuing the Blue Fire Wardens' leader, and unraveling the schemes of the evil mage Teremini Nightsedge, the characters can claim the fifth rod piece.
zh_tw: 為了找到{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的下一部分，角色們必須前往克萊恩世界，在那裡善良的獸化人聯盟——藍火守衛與死亡騎士{@creature Lord Soth|DSotDQ|索思爵士}及其手下發生了衝突。透過潛入一個重兵把守的要塞，營救藍火守衛的領袖，並揭穿邪惡法師特雷米尼·夜刃的陰謀，角色們可以獲得第五根杆件。

english: Running This Chapter
zh_tw: 運作本章

english: This chapter begins after the characters retrieve the fourth piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}. When a character holds this piece, they instinctively know that the fifth piece is located somewhere on the war-torn world of Krynn. That character senses that the fifth piece is located near a massive, magical tree, in a region called the Northern Dargaard Mountains, but this indication seems inexact. The fifth piece's location is unclear to the characters.
zh_tw: 這一章節開始於角色們取回{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第四部分之後。當一個角色持有這部分時，他們本能地知道第五部分位於飽受戰爭摧殘的克萊恩世界某處。那個角色感覺到第五部分位於一棵巨大的魔法樹附近，在被稱為北達爾加德山脈的地區，但這個指示似乎不夠精確。第五部分的確切位置對角色們來說並不清楚。

english: Neither the characters nor the Wizards Three know why the location of the fifth piece is ambiguous. In truth, the fifth piece was housed in the tree until recently, when it was taken to a nearby castle called Three Moons Vault. The crimson moonlight that now surrounds the castle warps the rod's magical properties. To retrieve the fifth rod piece, the characters must dispel the magical moonlight by disrupting a wicked ritual in the vault.
zh_tw: 角色們和三巫師都不知道為什麼第五部分的位置如此模糊。實際上，第五部分一直被安放在那棵樹中，直到最近才被帶到一個叫做三月亮金庫的附近城堡。現在環繞城堡的深紅色月光扭曲了這根杆的魔法屬性。為了取回第五根杆件，角色們必須透過破壞金庫中的一個邪惡儀式來驅散魔法月光。

english: This chapter starts when the characters step through the portal in Sigil, emerge on Krynn, and begin their search for the magical tree. Though initially fruitless, the characters' search puts them in contact with benevolent lycanthropes who know where to find the fifth piece. The characters must then infiltrate the Three Moons Vault. There, the characters must secure the fifth rod piece from Teremini Nightsedge, an ally of Lord Soth.
zh_tw: 這一章節從角色們穿過法印城的傳送門，出現在克萊恩，並開始尋找魔法樹開始。儘管最初的搜尋毫無結果，但角色們的搜尋讓他們接觸到了知道第五部分位置的善良的獸化人。然後，角色們必須潛入三月亮金庫。在那裡，角色們必須從特雷米尼·夜刃手中確保第五根杆件的安全，特雷米尼是領主索思的盟友。

english: Character Advancement
zh_tw: 角色升級

english: The characters should be 15th level when this chapter begins. The characters gain a level after they retrieve the fifth piece of {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} from the upper level of Three Moons Vault.
zh_tw: 當這一章節開始時，角色們應該是15級。在他們從三月亮金庫的上層取回{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第五部分後，角色們將獲得一個等級的提升。

english: Power of Secrets
zh_tw: 秘密的力量

english: The characters can learn two secrets in this chapter that are applicable to the rules in "{@area The Power of Secrets|028|x}" section in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}:
zh_tw: 角色們可以在這一章中學到兩個秘密，這兩個秘密適用於本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中的"{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}"部分的規則：

english: Gazaia's Secret
zh_tw: 加扎雅的秘密

english: The {@creature Deadbark Dryad|VEoR|dryad} Gazaia hid and watched while soldiers attacked the peylon tree where she lived and looted the fifth piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, which was sustaining the tree. Gazaia now hides in the grotto ({@area area P4|2d6|x}) described in the "{@area Peylon Tree Locations|2cc|x}" section later in this chapter.
zh_tw: {@creature Deadbark Dryad|VEoR|樹精} 藏起來並觀察著士兵們攻擊她居住的佩隆樹，並掠奪了維持樹木生命的{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第五部分。現在，加扎雅藏在本章節後面"{@area 佩隆樹位置|2cc|x}"部分描述的洞穴（{@area 區域P4|2d6|x}）中。

english: Valendar's Secret
zh_tw: 瓦倫達爾的秘密

english: The {@creature werewolf} Valendar led an assault against his enemies without properly planning the mission. Valendar is the leader of the Blue Fire Wardens and is held captive in {@area area V7|30b|x} of the {@area Three Moons Vault|2eb|x}.
zh_tw: {@creature werewolf||狼人} 瓦倫達爾在沒有妥善規劃任務的情況下，領導了一次對他的敵人的攻擊。瓦倫達爾是藍火守衛的領袖，目前被囚禁在{@area 三月亮金庫|2eb|x}的{@area 區域V7|30b|x}。

english: Fifth Rod Piece
zh_tw: 第五根杆件

english: The fifth piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} is in {@area area U5|368|x} in the upper level of the Three Moons Vault. For more information about the rod and the spell this piece allows its wielder to cast, see this book's {@area introduction|00e|x}.
zh_tw: {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第五部分位於三月亮金庫上層的{@area 區域U5|368|x}。關於這根杖以及這部分允許持有者施放的法術的更多資訊，請參見本書的{@area 簡介|00e|x}。

english: Krynn
zh_tw: 克萊恩

english: Once the characters decide to seek the fifth piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, the portal in the Sigil sanctum takes them to the world of Krynn, where evil plots complicate the party's search.
zh_tw: 一旦角色們決定尋找{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第五部分，法印城聖所的傳送門將帶他們前往克萊恩世界，在那裡邪惡的陰謀將使隊伍的搜尋變得複雜。

english: Knowledge of Krynn
zh_tw: 克萊恩的知識

english: The libraries in Sigil contain the following useful information about Krynn:
zh_tw: 法印城的圖書館包含了以下關於克萊恩的有用資訊：

english: Dragons of Krynn
zh_tw: 克萊恩的龍

english: Dragons have a strong presence on Krynn. Chromatic dragons swear allegiance to the expansionistic Dragon Armies of Queen Takhisis. Unusual dragons such as sapphire dragons and lunar dragons pursue hidden agendas.
zh_tw: 龍在克萊恩有著強烈的存在感。色彩龍向擴張主義的龍之軍隊女王塔克西斯宣誓效忠。像藍寶石龍和月亮龍這樣的不尋常的龍追求隱藏的議程。

english: Ruins of the Cataclysm
zh_tw: 災變廢墟

english: A world-shattering event called the Cataclysm swept across Krynn centuries ago. The apocalypse destroyed nations, unleashed monsters, and cast Krynn into a dark age.
zh_tw: 幾個世紀前，一場名為災變的翻天覆地的事件席捲了克萊恩。這場天啟毀滅了國家，釋放了怪物，並將克萊恩投入了黑暗時代。

english: War Torn
zh_tw: 飽受戰爭蹂躪

english: Recently, war has spread across Krynn. Infamous warlords such as the elf mage Feal-Thas and the death knight {@creature Lord Soth|DSotDQ} (see {@area appendix B|560|x}) have taken up arms in their bids for greater power.
zh_tw: 最近，戰爭已經蔓延到克萊恩。像精靈法師費爾-薩斯和死亡騎士{@creature Lord Soth|DSotDQ|索思爵士}（見{@area 附錄 B|560|x}）這樣的著名軍閥為了爭奪更大的權力而拿起了武器。

english: Arriving on Krynn
zh_tw: 抵達克萊恩

english: When the party steps through the Sigil portal and arrives on Krynn, they arrive through a doorway in a massive tree. Read the following:
zh_tw: 當隊伍穿過法印城的傳送門併到達克萊恩時，他們透過一扇位於一棵巨大樹木中的門出現。請閱讀以下內容：

english: The rising sun limns the rolling hills around you. In the purple sky hang three moons—a red moon, a white moon, and a black moon discernible only because of the stars it blots out. Behind you stands a tall fruit tree in early bloom, its bright-orange buds still flowering. The doorway through which you've just emerged is a deep, dark furrow in the tree's bark.
zh_tw: 升起的太陽勾勒出你周圍的連綿丘陵。在紫色的天空中掛著三個月亮——一個紅月亮，一個白月亮，還有一個只有在它遮擋住星星時才能辨認出的黑月亮。你身後矗立著一棵高大的果樹，正值初綻，其鮮橙色的花蕾仍在盛開。你剛剛穿過的那扇門是樹幹上一道深暗的溝槽。

english: The fourth piece of the {@i Rod of Seven Parts} points to another tree on a nearby hill. That massive tree's ashen bark and leafless branches suggest it is dying.
zh_tw: {@i 七碎片之杖}的第四部分指向附近山上的另一棵樹。那棵巨大的樹的灰白色樹皮和光禿禿的枝條表明它正在死去。

english: The fourth rod piece points its wielder to a dying peylon tree. This peylon tree grew to a titanic height thanks to the magic of the rod piece that was previously embedded in its trunk. The rod piece was recently removed, resulting in the tree's current state of decay.
zh_tw: 第四根杆件指向一棵垂死的佩倫樹。這棵佩倫樹因為之前嵌入其樹幹中的杆件的魔力而長到了巨大的高度。最近杆件被移除，導致這棵樹現在處於衰敗狀態。

english: The tree still bears traces of the rod's magic. The fourth piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} points here due to those traces, and the crimson moonlight and latent magic from the Three Moons Vault warps the artifact's divinatory properties. The characters must investigate the tree and talk to its occupants to learn the fifth rod piece's true whereabouts.
zh_tw: 這棵樹仍然帶有那根法杖魔法的痕跡。由於這些痕跡，{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第四部分指向這裡，而來自三月亮金庫的深紅色月光和潛在魔法扭曲了這件神器的占卜屬性。角色們必須調查這棵樹，並與其居住者交談，以瞭解第五根杆件的真正位置。

english: The Peylon Tree
zh_tw: 佩隆樹

english: An enormous, magical tree seems to be the location of the next rod piece, though the characters soon learn the piece is elsewhere
zh_tw: 一棵巨大的魔法樹似乎是下一個杆件的位置，儘管角色們很快得知杆件在別處。

english: The characters begin their exploration of the peylon tree at {@area area P1|2cd|x}. When they arrive at the tree, read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 角色們從{@area 區域P1|2cd|x}開始探索佩隆樹。當他們到達樹旁時，請閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: This tree is hundreds of feet tall. The tree's leafless branches and bark are pale and soft-looking, and the hill is covered in the decomposing remains of sticky, gray fruits that hum with swarms of flies. Deep holes in the tree's trunk—like rents in a rusted suit of armor—provide glimpses inside the tree's rotten, hollow interior.
zh_tw: 這棵樹高數百尺。樹的無葉枝條和樹皮呈淡色，看起來柔軟，而小山覆蓋著粘膩的灰色果實的分解殘骸，這些果實嗡嗡作響，圍繞著成群的蒼蠅。樹幹上的深洞——就像生鏽盔甲上的裂縫——讓人窺見樹內腐爛、空洞的內部。

english: Tree Features
zh_tw: 樹的特徵

english: The peylon tree has the following features:
zh_tw: 佩隆樹具有以下特徵：

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: During the day, the peylon tree's interior is dimly lit by light filtering in from outside.
zh_tw: 在白天，佩隆樹的內部被從外部過濾進來的光線微弱地照亮。

english: Trunk
zh_tw: 象鼻

english: The tree's rotten bark is soft and easy to climb both inside and out.
zh_tw: 這棵樹的腐爛樹皮內外都很軟，容易攀爬。

english: Peylon Tree Locations
zh_tw: 佩隆樹位置

english: The following locations are keyed to map 6.1.
zh_tw: 以下地點對應於地圖 6.1。

english: Map 6.1: Peylon Tree
zh_tw: 地圖 6.1: 佩隆樹

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: P1: Rotted Roots
zh_tw: P1: 腐爛的根

english: Thick, gnarled roots spread in all directions. A gaping fissure at the base of the tree forms a rough, arched entrance into the trunk.
zh_tw: 粗厚、扭曲的樹根向四面八方延伸。樹幹底部的一個巨大裂縫形成了一個粗糙的拱形入口。

english: A character who examines the ground around the tree can make a {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) or Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check. On a successful check, the character spots vague humanoid footprints in the soft dirt. The tracks lead into area P2.
zh_tw: 一個檢查樹周圍地面的角色可以進行一次 {@dc 14} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）或感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定。如果檢定成功，角色會注意到鬆軟泥土中模糊的人形足跡。這些足跡通向區域 P2。

english: Alternative Entrance
zh_tw: 替代入口

english: A character who scales the roots that form a mound along the east side of the tree can enter through the east side of {@area area P3|2d3|x}, 60 feet up.
zh_tw: 一個角色如果攀爬沿著樹東側形成的土堆的樹根，可以透過位於{@area 區域P3|2d3|x}東側的入口進入，該入口位於60尺高的地方。

english: P2: Hollow
zh_tw: P2: 空洞

english: A ledge of interwoven roots and packed dirt hangs sixty feet above the hollow's eastern half, and a boulder leans against the hollow's northern wall.
zh_tw: 一個由交織的樹根和壓實的泥土構成的巖架懸掛在空洞東側的上方六十尺處，一塊巨石靠在空洞北側的牆壁上。

english: The fourth piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} points its wielder to the boulder along the tree's interior northwest curve.
zh_tw: {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第四部分指向沿著樹內部西北彎曲處的巨石。

english: If the characters enter this area from area P1, they attract the attention of the treant and spiders dwelling on the ledge above (see area P3).
zh_tw: 如果角色從P1區域進入這個區域，他們會吸引到居住在上方巖架上的樹精和蜘蛛的注意（見P3區域）。

english: Grotto Entrance
zh_tw: 洞穴入口

english: Inspecting the boulder reveals a hole dug into the loamy soil beneath it. The hole connects to a small grotto beneath the tree ({@area area P4|2d6|x}). With the boulder atop it, the hole is big enough for a Small or smaller creature to fit through.
zh_tw: 檢查巨石會發現在其下的肥沃土壤中挖有一個洞。這個洞連線到樹下的一個小洞穴（{@area 區域P4|2d6|x}）。巨石在上面時，這個洞足夠一個小型或更小的生物穿過。

english: A creature can spend 1 minute digging to widen the hole so Medium creatures can fit through. Alternatively, the boulder can be pushed aside by any number of creatures with a combined Strength score of 30 or more.
zh_tw: 一個生物可以花費1分鐘挖掘以擴大洞口，以便中型生物也能透過。或者，任何擁有總計30點或更多力量值的生物可以透過合力將巨石推到一邊。

english: P3: Ledge
zh_tw: P3: 巖架

english: This thick, tangled mat of roots overlooks a broad hollow within the peylon tree's trunk.
zh_tw: 這片茂密、糾結的樹根網俯瞰著佩隆樹樹幹內的一個寬闊空洞。

english: Rosintar, a neutral evil {@creature treant} who hates intruders, hides on this ledge above area P2. Two {@creature Giant Spider||giant spiders} lurk in the ledge's corner and follow Rosintar's commands.
zh_tw: 羅辛塔爾，一箇中立邪惡的{@creature treant||樹人}，討厭入侵者，隱藏在P2區域上方的這個巖架上。兩隻{@creature Giant Spider||巨蜘蛛}潛伏在巖架的角落，遵循羅辛塔爾的命令。

english: While motionless, Rosintar is indistinguishable from the rest of the peylon tree. A character looking out for trouble notices the two giant spiders with a successful {@dc 17} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. Shortly after the characters arrive in area P2, Rosintar silently signals for the spiders to sneak up on the party. Any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 15 or higher notices the spiders readying to attack. As soon as the spiders attack, Rosintar hurls a rock at a random character, then fights viciously to drive the intruders away.
zh_tw: 在靜止不動時，羅辛塔爾與皮隆樹的其餘部分難以區分。一個尋找麻煩的角色需要透過一次成功的 {@dc 17} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定才能注意到那兩隻巨型蜘蛛。在角色到達區域 P2 後不久，羅辛塔爾悄無聲息地示意蜘蛛偷偷接近隊伍。任何被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）分數為 15 或更高的角色會注意到蜘蛛準備發動攻擊。一旦蜘蛛發動攻擊，羅辛塔爾會向隨機的角色投擲一塊石頭，然後兇狠地戰鬥以驅趕入侵者。

english: If the treant notices characters arriving on the ledge via the alternative entrance (see {@area area P1|2cd|x}), it screeches in surprise and attacks the intruders.
zh_tw: 如果樹精注意到角色透過替代入口（見{@area 區域P1|2cd|x}）到達巖架，它會驚訝地尖叫並攻擊入侵者。

english: Rosintar fights until reduced to 30 or fewer hit points. At that point, Rosintar surrenders.
zh_tw: 羅辛塔爾戰鬥直到生命值降至30點或以下。到那時，羅辛塔爾投降。

english: What the Treant Knows
zh_tw: 樹精所知

english: If the characters allow Rosintar to surrender, the treant tells the party that a cruel dryad named Gazaia dwells in the grotto beneath the tree, accessible via a hole under the boulder (see area P4). The treant bemoans that it didn't notice "the previous intruder"—a small person in a dark-blue cloak—until the intruder had already squeezed into the hole under the boulder. Rosintar doesn't go near the hole, both because the treant wouldn't fit and because it is afraid of Gazaia. Of the blue-cloaked intruder's fate, Rosintar says flatly and with certainty: "The blue-cloaked gnat must be dead."
zh_tw: 如果角色允許羅辛塔爾投降，樹精會告訴隊伍，一個名叫加扎雅的殘忍仙女居住在樹下面的洞穴裡，可以透過石頭下的洞口進入（見區域P4）。樹精哀嘆它沒有注意到"之前的入侵者"——一個穿著深藍色斗篷的小人——直到入侵者已經擠進了石頭下的洞裡。羅辛塔爾不去靠近洞口，一方面是因為樹精進不去，另一方面是因為它害怕加扎雅。關於穿著藍色斗篷的入侵者的命運，羅辛塔爾肯定而直截了當地說："那個穿藍色斗篷的小蟲肯定已經死了。"

english: P4: Grotto
zh_tw: P4: 巖洞

english: It's a 50-foot drop from the hole in {@area area P2|2d0|x} to the floor of this underground chamber. Even during the day, the fetid grotto is dark.
zh_tw: 從{@area 區域P2|2d0|x}的洞口到這個地下洞室的地面是50尺的垂直下降。即使在白天，這個惡臭的巖洞也很黑暗。

english: Tangled roots anchor the dirt walls of this damp, subterranean chamber. The rinds of large, rotten fruits litter the floor. A thick taproot hangs from the ceiling. In one corner of the grotto, a kender wearing a blue cloak rummages in the dirt on hands and knees.
zh_tw: 糾結的樹根固定著這個潮溼的地下洞室的土牆。大而腐爛的水果皮散落在地面上。一根粗大的主根從天花板垂下。在巖洞的一個角落裡，一個穿著藍色斗篷的侏儒正跪在地上挖掘。

english: The rummaging figure is a kender named Riffel who also happens to be a werewolf (use the {@creature werewolf} stat block, except Riffel's size is Small and his alignment is neutral good). When Riffel realizes he has company, he jumps to his feet and draws his spear, but he doesn't fight unless attacked. He is initially wary of the characters but is willing to hear them out. If a character mentions the rod piece, or if a character tries to befriend Riffel and succeeds on a {@dc 13} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check, Riffel relaxes and puts away his weapon.
zh_tw: 翻找的身影是一個名叫裡弗爾的坎德人，他同時也是一名狼人（使用 {@creature werewolf||狼人} 的資料塊，不過裡弗爾的體型是小型且他的陣營是中立善良）。當裡弗爾意識到有人在場時，他會立刻跳起來並拔出長矛，但他不會主動攻擊，除非受到攻擊。他起初對角色們保持警惕，但願意聽他們解釋。如果有角色提到權杖碎片，或者有角色嘗試與裡弗爾交好並透過了 {@dc 13} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，裡弗爾會放鬆下來並收起武器。

english: Riffel's Quest
zh_tw: 裡費爾的任務

english: Riffel says he is searching this grotto for a fresh peylon fruit. He explains that he is a member of a group called the Blue Fire Wardens: naturalists who oppose the death knight Lord Soth. The wardens recently attempted to besiege a group of Soth's followers in a keep called the Three Moons Vault, but the attack failed. Riffel and his fellow survivors fled to the nearby wetlands, but then were attacked by a violent monster.
zh_tw: 裡費爾說他正在這個巖洞裡尋找新鮮的佩隆果。他解釋說，他是被稱為藍火守衛者的一個團體的成員：反對死亡騎士索思的自然主義者。守衛者最近試圖圍攻索思的追隨者們在名為三月亮金庫的堡壘，但攻擊失敗了。裡費爾和他的同伴生還者逃到了附近的溼地，但隨後被一個暴力怪物襲擊。

english: If the characters mention the rod piece, Riffel says:
zh_tw: 如果角色們提到了法杖碎片，裡費爾說：

english: "The artifact was taken to the Three Moons Vault, but you'd be foolish to simply walk in and try to take it. I can sneak you into the vault—but first, I need your help."
zh_tw: "那個神器被帶到三月亮金庫了，但你若想直接走進去並試圖拿走它，那將是愚蠢的。我可以偷偷帶你進金庫——但首先，我需要你們的幫助。"

english: Riffel explains that he needs the peylon fruit to distract a {@creature borthak|VEoR}—a bog monster that attacked the Blue Fire Wardens and trapped Riffel's allies.
zh_tw: 裡費爾解釋說他需要佩隆果來分散一個{@creature borthak|VEoR|博薩克}的注意力——一個攻擊了藍火守衛者並困住了裡費爾的盟友的沼澤怪物。

english: Riffel continues his explanation:
zh_tw: 裡費爾繼續他的解釋：

english: "Borthaks love peylon fruit. When we were attacked, I ran here to find a peylon fruit so I could return and distract the borthak so the others can escape. It's not fruit season, but this tree used to be magical, so I thought it might still have fruit. Anyway, if you help me find some, I'll help you find your artifact."
zh_tw: "博薩克喜歡佩隆果。當我們被攻擊時，我跑到這裡來找佩隆果，這樣我就可以回去分散博薩克的注意力，讓其他人逃跑。現在不是果實的季節，但這棵樹以前是魔法的，所以我想它可能還有果實。無論如何，如果你們幫我找到一些，我會幫助你們找到你們的神器。"

english: The Deadbark Dryad
zh_tw: 枯皮樹精

english: As Riffel and the characters talk, the peylon tree's guardian emerges from the grotto's wall and stands before her uninvited guests. This is Gazaia, a {@creature deadbark dryad|VEoR} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}). Annoyed at the disturbance, Gazaia tells the party and Riffel to state their business or leave her sanctum at once.
zh_tw: 當裡費爾和角色們交談時，佩隆樹的守護者從巖洞的牆壁中出現，站在她不請自來的客人面前。這是加扎雅，一個枯皮樹精（使用{@creature deadbark dryad|VEoR|枯皮樹精}，見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）。加扎雅對打擾感到惱火，告訴隊伍和裡費爾立即說明他們的來意或離開她的聖地。

english: The Last Peylon Fruit
zh_tw: 最後的佩隆果

english: Gazaia says that there is one ripe peylon fruit left in this tree, and she's willing to give it to the party—for a price. Gazaia requests any magic item in exchange for the fruit and will take no other payment.
zh_tw: 加扎雅說這棵樹上還剩下一顆成熟的佩隆果，她願意將它交給隊伍——但需要一個代價。加扎雅請求用任何魔法物品來交換這個果實，並且不接受其他任何形式的支付。

english: Kender
zh_tw: 坎德人

english: The NPC Riffel is a {@race kender|DSotDQ} {@creature werewolf}. On the world of Krynn, kender are a race of Humanoid creatures with pointed ears. They are similar to halflings on other worlds and about the same size. For more information about kender, see {@adventure Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen|DSotDQ}.
zh_tw: NPC 裡費爾是一個{@race kender|DSotDQ|坎德人} {@creature werewolf||狼人}。在克萊恩世界，侏儒是一種擁有尖耳朵的人形生物種族。它們與其他世界的半身人相似，大小也差不多。關於侏儒的更多資訊，請參閱{@adventure 龍槍:龍後之影|DSotDQ}。

english: Bargaining with Gazaia
zh_tw: 與加扎雅討價還價

english: Gazaia can convey the following points to the party:
zh_tw: 加扎雅可以向隊伍傳達以下幾點：

english: Corruption of Soth
zh_tw: 索思的墮落

english: Not long ago, Gazaia and her tree were verdant and thriving. A powerful artifact buried in this hill—the rod piece—infused the peylon tree with its magic and enticed Gazaia to become the tree's guardian. When Lord Soth's soldiers recently stole the artifact, Gazaia failed to defend her charge. The tree turned fetid without the artifact, and Gazaia became angry, vengeful, and grief-stricken.
zh_tw: 不久前，加扎雅和她守護的樹還是鬱鬱蔥蔥、生機勃勃的。這座山中埋藏的一個強大的神器——法杖碎片——賦予了佩隆樹魔法，並吸引了加扎雅成為這棵樹的守護者。當索思勳爵的士兵最近偷走了神器後，加扎雅未能保護好她的守護物件。沒有了神器，樹變得惡臭，加扎雅變得憤怒、復仇心切和悲痛欲絕。

english: Gazaia's Anger
zh_tw: 加扎雅的憤怒

english: If the characters refuse Gazaia's offer and fail to promptly leave, or if Gazaia catches a character attempting to take the peylon fruit by stealth or force, she attacks the party viciously and fights until destroyed.
zh_tw: 如果角色們拒絕加扎雅的提議並且沒有及時離開，或者如果加扎雅發現有角色試圖透過潛行或武力拿走佩隆果，她會殘忍地攻擊隊伍，並戰鬥到被摧毀為止。

english: Gazaia's Secret
zh_tw: 加扎雅的秘密

english: The {@creature deadbark dryad|VEoR} bitterly recounts the tale of Lord Soth's soldiers assaulting the tree. If a character tries to comfort Gazaia, she confesses that she hid while the soldiers were around the tree. Gazaia feels extremely guilty that she didn't defend her charge. Regardless of the characters' reaction to this revelation, learning it counts as a secret for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
zh_tw: {@creature deadbark dryad|VEoR|枯皮樹精}苦澀地講述了索思勳爵的士兵襲擊樹木的故事。如果一個角色試圖安慰加扎雅，她會承認自己在士兵們圍在樹邊時躲了起來。加扎雅對自己沒有保護好自己負責的樹感到極度內疚。無論角色們對這一揭露有何反應，瞭解到這一點都算作一個秘密，符合本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則的目的。

english: Gazaia's Death
zh_tw: 加扎雅之死

english: If Gazaia dies before she shares information with the party, the characters find the ripe peylon fruit in her possession.
zh_tw: 如果加扎雅在與隊伍分享資訊之前死亡，角色們會在她的遺物中找到成熟的佩隆果。

english: Leaving the Peylon Tree
zh_tw: 離開佩隆樹

english: Once the party has the peylon fruit, they can leave the peylon tree with Riffel and continue the adventure.
zh_tw: 一旦隊伍有了佩隆果，他們就可以和裡費爾一起離開佩隆樹，繼續他們的冒險。

english: Bittergrass Fen
zh_tw: 苦草沼澤

english: To help Riffel save his fellow wardens, the characters must follow the kender {@creature werewolf} to a marshy lowland called Bittergrass Fen.
zh_tw: 為了幫助裡弗爾拯救他的同伴守衛，角色們必須跟隨這名坎德人 {@creature werewolf||狼人}前往一片名為苦草叢的沼澤低地。

english: Journey to Bittergrass Fen
zh_tw: 前往苦草沼澤的旅程

english: By foot, the trek to Bittergrass Fen takes an hour. Along the way, Riffel conveys the following:
zh_tw: 步行前往苦草沼澤需要一個小時。沿途，裡費爾傳達了以下幾點：

english: Teremini's Vault
zh_tw: 特雷米尼的金庫

english: The Three Moons Vault is a heavily fortified keep in the nearby mountains. It's overseen by the {@creature archmage} Teremini Nightsedge, who serves the dreaded Lord Soth.
zh_tw: 三月亮金庫是附近山脈中一個重兵把守的堡壘。它由服務於令人畏懼的索思勳爵的{@creature archmage||大法師}特雷米尼·奈特斯吉德監督。

english: The Stolen Shard
zh_tw: 被盜的碎片

english: Teremini's soldiers stole a magical shard at the heart of the peylon tree. The tree and its dryad became corrupted shortly thereafter. (The characters are certain this is the fifth piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}.)
zh_tw: 特雷米尼的士兵從佩隆樹的中心偷走了一塊魔法碎片。不久之後，這棵樹和它的樹精就墮落了。（角色們確信這是{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第五部分。）

english: The Blue Fire Wardens
zh_tw: 藍火守衛者

english: Riffel is a member of the Blue Fire Wardens: benevolent lycanthropes and trackers who oppose Lord Soth and worship the nature god Habbakuk. The wardens' attack on the Three Moons Vault was a catastrophic failure that resulted in the capture of the group's leader, Valendar. Valendar knows more about the vault and the stolen rod piece than any of the other wardens.
zh_tw: 裡費爾是藍火守衛者的一員：這些善良的獸化人和追蹤者反對索思勳爵，並崇拜自然之神哈巴庫克。守衛者對三月亮金庫的攻擊是一個災難性的失敗，導致該組織的領袖瓦倫達爾被捕。瓦倫達爾對金庫和被盜的法杖碎片的瞭解超過了其他所有守衛者。

english: Approaching the Fen
zh_tw: 接近沼澤

english: Once the party arrives at Bittergrass Fen, show your players map 6.2. Read the following to describe the scene:
zh_tw: 一旦隊伍到達苦草沼澤，請向玩家展示地圖6.2。閱讀以下內容以描述場景：

english: Map 6.2: Bittergrass Fen
zh_tw: 地圖6.2: 苦草沼澤

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Rising from the fen are two rows of standing stones, each one a rough-carved pillar twenty feet high and ten feet thick. Floating inches above each standing stone is a ten-foot-diameter boulder. West of the fen is a swiftly flowing creek with muddy banks. Slopes to the north and east meet to form a rocky bluff.
zh_tw: 從沼澤中升起的是兩排立石，每塊都是二十尺高、十尺厚的粗糙雕刻石柱。每塊立石上方几吋處懸浮著一個直徑十尺的巨石。沼澤西邊是一條泥濘河岸的急流小溪。北面和東面的斜坡相遇形成了一個岩石峭壁。

english: An enormous, slavering monster attacks the bluff face, where a stone arch marks the entrance to an underground temple. A crumbling stone door separates the monster from the temple's interior.
zh_tw: 一個巨大的、流著口水的怪物正在攻擊峭壁表面，那裡有一個石拱門標誌著通往地下神廟的入口。一扇破敗的石門將怪物與神廟內部隔開。

english: The Blue Fire Wardens are trapped inside their own temple. If the characters don't intervene, the {@creature borthak|VEoR} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) will soon break through the temple door.
zh_tw: 藍火守衛者被困在自己神廟內。如果角色們不進行幹預，{@creature borthak|VEoR|博薩克}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）很快將會破門而入。

english: The {@creature borthak|VEoR} is too large to fit through the stone door and into the temple, though smaller creatures can slip through with some effort. Left alone, the borthak uses its action on each of its turns to attack the temple door. The door has AC 20, 225 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. If the borthak succeeds in breaking down the door, it enters the temple and attacks the seven wardens (use the {@creature werewolf} stat block, except their alignments are neutral good) who are trapped inside.
zh_tw: {@creature borthak|VEoR|博薩克}的體型太大，無法穿過石門進入神廟，儘管較小的生物可以透過一些努力擠過去。如果無人幹預，博薩克會在每個回合使用它的行動來攻擊神廟的門。門的AC為20，有225點生命值，並且對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。如果博薩克成功破門而入，它會進入神廟並攻擊被困在內的七名守衛者（使用{@creature werewolf||狼人}的統計資料塊，除了他們的陣營是中立善良）。

english: The underground temple isn't shown on map 6.2. Hewn out of the rock and earth, it has a central gathering area and six adjoining cells, where the wardens sleep and pray behind thin wooden doors. The temple contains supplies but nothing of value.
zh_tw: 地下神廟在地圖6.2上沒有顯示。它是從岩石和土壤中開鑿出來的，有一箇中心聚會區和六個相鄰的小屋，守衛者們在薄木門後面睡覺和祈禱。神廟內有補給品，但沒有價值的東西。

english: Distracting the Borthak
zh_tw: 分散博薩克的注意力

english: If one or more characters attack the borthak, it stops attacking the temple long enough to defend itself.
zh_tw: 如果一個或多個角色攻擊博薩克，它會停止攻擊神廟，轉而進行自衛。

english: As an action, a character can use a ripe peylon fruit to distract the borthak. If the fruit is hurled toward the borthak, the monster moves toward the fruit on its next turn and uses its action to devour it. If a character holding the fruit moves within 20 feet of the borthak, the borthak pursues and attacks that character, eager to obtain the fruit.
zh_tw: 作為一個行動，角色可以使用成熟的佩隆果來分散博薩克的注意力。如果將果實投向博薩克，怪物將在下一個回合向果實移動，並使用它的行動來吞食它。如果持有果實的角色移動到博薩克20尺範圍內，博薩克會追逐並攻擊那個角色，渴望得到果實。

english: While characters contend with the {@creature borthak|VEoR}, Riffel moves quickly toward the temple door and crawls through a narrow gap underneath it. The gap is just big enough for a Small character to squeeze through. Once inside, Riffel urges the other wardens to evacuate the temple while the borthak is distracted. On Riffel's next turn, he and the wardens push open the temple door so everyone can escape. Once outside, they skirt along the bluff, heading north. If one or more characters assist with the evacuation, they can keep an eye on the borthak and distract it if necessary while Riffel helps the wardens get to safety.
zh_tw: 當角色們與{@creature borthak|VEoR|博薩克}交戰時，裡費爾迅速朝神廟門移動，並從門下的狹窄縫隙中爬過去。這個縫隙剛好夠一個小型角色擠過去。一旦進入，裡費爾就催促其他守衛者在博薩克分心時撤離神廟。在裡費爾的下一個回合，他和其他守衛者推開神廟門，這樣每個人都可以逃出去。一旦到了外面，他們沿著峭壁邊緣向北前進。如果有一或多個角色協助撤離，他們可以留意博薩克，並在必要時分散它的注意力，同時裡費爾幫助守衛者安全撤離。

english: Bittergrass Fen Features
zh_tw: 苦草沼澤特徵

english: The fen has features the characters can use to their advantage in a confrontation with the {@creature borthak|VEoR}:
zh_tw: 沼澤有一些特徵，角色們可以在與{@creature borthak|VEoR|博薩克}的對抗中利用這些特徵來獲得優勢：

english: Floating Boulders
zh_tw: 漂浮巨石

english: The boulders floating above the stone pillars are held aloft by ancient druidic magic. Casting {@spell Dispel Magic} on a boulder causes it to fall and tumble to the ground. As an action, a character within reach of a floating boulder can try to push it, doing so with a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. Pushing the boulder ends the magic on it and causes it to fall in whichever direction the character prefers. Any creature in the path of a falling boulder must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw to avoid it, taking 11 ({@dice 2d10}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save.
zh_tw: 漂浮在石柱上方的巨石被古老的德魯伊魔法所支撐。對一塊巨石施放 {@spell Dispel Magic||解除魔法} 會導致其墜落並翻滾到地面。作為一個動作，一個處於懸浮巨石範圍內的角色可以嘗試推動它，需透過一次 {@dc 15} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定來成功推動。推動巨石會結束其上的魔法，並使其朝角色偏好的方向墜落。任何處於墜落巨石路徑中的生物必須透過一次 {@dc 15} 敏捷豁免來避免被擊中，豁免失敗則受到 11（{@dice 2d10}）點鈍擊傷害。

english: Muddy Bank
zh_tw: 泥濘的河岸

english: The ground within 20 feet of the creek's eastern shore has turned to sticky mud and is {@book difficult terrain|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}.
zh_tw: 小溪東岸20尺範圍內的地面已經變成了粘性泥土，屬於{@book 困難地形|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}（困難地形）。

english: Escaping the Fen
zh_tw: 逃離沼澤

english: Once all the wardens escape the temple, each warden transforms into a wolf and flees from the borthak. End the characters' encounter with the borthak when they defeat it or after they and all the wardens have escaped, whichever happens first.
zh_tw: 一旦所有的守衛者逃離了神廟，每個守衛者都會變身成狼並從博薩克那裡逃跑。當角色們擊敗博薩克，或者他們和所有守衛者都已逃離時，先發生的情況將結束與博薩克的遭遇。

english: A terrifying monster called a borthak has trapped several Blue Fire Wardens in Bittergrass Fen
zh_tw: 一個名為博薩克的可怕怪物困住了幾名藍火守衛者在苦草沼澤中

english: The Blue Fire Wardens
zh_tw: 藍火守衛者

english: Once the wardens are safe, a human werewolf named Argentia Skywright (use the {@creature werewolf} stat block, except her alignment is neutral good) thanks the characters on behalf of her group. She expands on what Riffel told the party earlier about the Three Moons Vault, conveying the following points:
zh_tw: 一旦守衛者們安全了，一個名叫阿金提亞·斯凱賴特（阿金提亞·斯凱賴特）的人類狼人（使用{@creature werewolf||狼人}的統計資料塊，除了她的陣營是中立善良）代表她的團隊感謝角色們。她補充了裡費爾之前告訴隊伍的關於三月亮金庫的資訊，傳達了以下幾點：

english: Argentira Skywright
zh_tw: 阿金蒂亞·斯凱賴特

english: Blue Fire Attack
zh_tw: 藍火攻擊

english: Shortly after Teremini Nightsedge's soldiers seized the rod fragment from the peylon tree, the Blue Fire Wardens assaulted the Three Moons Vault. They refer to their attack as the Night of Blue Fire. Teremini, a renegade from the Mages of High Sorcery's Order of the Red Robes, foresaw the attack and used powerful lunar magic to create a shroud of transformative red moonlight around the vault. {@creature Werewolf||Werewolves} that step into this moonlight lose control of their powers and succumb to raw, animalistic instinct, making it easier for Teremini to manipulate or trap them.
zh_tw: 特雷米尼·奈特斯吉德的士兵從佩隆樹奪取了法杖碎片後不久，藍火守衛者就襲擊了三月亮金庫。他們將他們的攻擊稱為藍火之夜。特雷米尼是高法術師的紅袍秩序的叛逆者，他預見到了這次攻擊並使用強大的月之魔法在金庫周圍創造了一層變化性的紅月光幕。走進這月光中的{@creature Werewolf||狼人}將失去對自己力量的控制，屈服於原始的、動物的本能，這使得特雷米尼更容易操縱或困住他們。

english: Mage's Ritual
zh_tw: 法師的儀式

english: Teremini learned her red moonlight magic from a lunar dragon named Orinix. Orinix also taught Teremini a ritual to make the wall of transformative moonlight permanent and tasked her with completing this lengthy, taxing ritual. While she focuses on the ritual, powerful magical barriers surround Teremini and her ritual components, which include the fifth rod piece.
zh_tw: 特雷米尼從一個名為奧里尼克斯（奧里尼克斯）的月亮龍那裡學到了她的紅月光魔法。奧里尼克斯還教給了特雷米尼一個儀式，使變化性的月光牆永久化，並指派她完成這個漫長而繁重的儀式。當她專注於儀式時，強大的魔法屏障圍繞著特雷米尼和她包括第五部分法杖在內的儀式元件。

english: Stopping the Ritual
zh_tw: 停止儀式

english: Argentia insists there must be a way to disrupt Teremini's ritual so the characters can seize the rod piece. She encourages the characters to find and rescue Valendar, the wardens' imprisoned leader, who might know how to stop Teremini's ritual.
zh_tw: 阿金提亞堅持認為一定有辦法打斷特雷米尼的儀式，以便角色們能夠奪取法杖碎片。她鼓勵角色們找到並救出被囚禁的守衛者領袖瓦倫達爾，他可能知道如何停止特雷米尼的儀式。

english: Wardens' Aid
zh_tw: 守衛者的幫助

english: Argentia gives the characters a {@item Spell Scroll} of {@spell Moonbeam}. She also explains that if Valendar is stuck in his wolf or hybrid form, they must bring Valendar close to death before he'll return to his true form, which is a human.
zh_tw: 阿金提亞給了角色一張{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}，上面寫著{@spell Moonbeam||月華之光}。她還解釋說，如果瓦倫達爾被困在狼形態或混合形態中，他們必須在瓦倫達爾瀕臨死亡時，他才會恢復到真身，也就是人類形態。

english: Riffel agrees to take the characters to the Three Moons Vault's secret entrance. Before the party leaves, Argentia leads a quick rite to cast a protective ward over Riffel. For the next 12 hours, Riffel and allies within 10 feet of him are immune to the Forced Transformation effect of Teremini's curtain of red moonlight (see the "{@area Environmental Effects|2f1|x}" subsection of the "{@area Three Moons Vault|2eb|x}" section). The wardens have enough power to cast this ritual only once, so it's imperative Riffel return to Bittergrass Fen with Valendar as soon as possible.
zh_tw: 裡費爾同意帶角色們去三月亮金庫的秘密入口。在隊伍離開之前，阿金提亞主持了一個快速儀式，為裡費爾施加了保護性結界。在接下來的12小時內，裡費爾和他周圍10尺內的盟友對特雷米尼的紅月光下的強制變形效果免疫（見"{@area 環境效應|2f1|x}"子節下的"{@area 三月亮金庫|2eb|x}"部分）。守護者們只有足夠的力量進行一次這種儀式，所以裡費爾必須儘快帶著瓦倫達爾返回苦草沼澤。

english: Three Moons Vault
zh_tw: 三月亮金庫

english: The Three Moons Vault is a remote dungeon complex in the mountainous outskirts of Lord Soth's domain.
zh_tw: 三月亮金庫是位於索思勳爵領地山區邊緣的一個偏遠地牢建築群。

english: Millennia ago, a chunk of the red moon Lunitari sheared off, broke into meteorites, and rained down on Krynn. The meteorites' impact formed craters throughout the Northern Dargaard Mountains. Ancient, moon-venerating wardens chose one of these craters as the site for a shrine where they could revere Krynn's moons. The wardens built three magical towers: a spacious white tower for Solinari, a handsome red tower for Lunitari, and a solemn black tower for Nuitari.
zh_tw: 數千年前，紅月露尼塔的一部分脫落，分裂成隕石雨，降落在克萊恩。隕石的撞擊在北達爾加德山脈形成了許多坑洞。古代崇拜月亮的守護者選擇了其中一個坑洞作為神殿的地點，以便他們可以崇拜克萊恩的月亮。守護者們建造了三座魔法塔：一座寬敞的白色塔獻給索利納裡，一座英俊的紅色塔獻給露尼塔裡，以及一座莊重的黑色塔獻給努伊塔裡。

english: The Cataclysm destroyed the white tower, disrupting the balance of magic between the three towers. Lord Soth's forces from nearby Dargaard Keep assumed control of the ruins. They built fortified walls around the site and carved out a subterranean vault to contain prisoners and treasure. The vault is now under the purview of a servant of Lord Soth and operates as a prison for the overlord's enemies and a safe house for his underlings.
zh_tw: 大災變摧毀了白塔，打破了三塔之間的魔法平衡。來自附近達爾加德堡的索思勳爵的部隊接管了廢墟。他們在遺址周圍建造了加固的牆壁，並開鑿了一個地下金庫來關押囚犯和寶藏。這個金庫現在由索思勳爵的一個僕人負責，作為對領主敵人的監獄以及他手下的安全屋。

english: Teremini Nightsedge
zh_tw: 特雷米尼·奈特斯吉德

english: A lawful evil, elf {@creature archmage} named Teremini Nightsedge oversees the Three Moons Vault. Though a loyal servant of Lord Soth, Teremini has her own agenda for the ancient moon towers. When she was young, Teremini tried to join the wardens but was rejected after her reverence of Lord Soth became clear. Now, she hopes to complete her revenge by permanently shrouding the vault in crimson moonlight, kidnapping the Blue Fire Wardens she hates so deeply, and bringing them here to be slain, thereby completing her revenge. Thanks to her recent acquisition of a piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, Teremini has commenced her plan.
zh_tw: 一個名為特雷米尼·奈特斯吉德的守序邪惡精靈{@creature archmage||大法師}負責監管三月亮金庫。儘管是索思勳爵的忠實僕人，特雷米尼對古老的月塔有自己的計劃。在她年輕時，特雷米尼試圖加入守衛者，但在她對索思勳爵的崇拜變得明顯後被拒絕了。現在，她希望透過永久地將金庫籠罩在深紅色月光中，綁架她深深憎恨的藍火守衛者，並將他們帶到這裡被殺害來完成她的復仇。得益於她最近獲得的{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的一部分，特雷米尼已經開始了她的計劃。

english: Teremini Nightsedge
zh_tw: 特雷米尼·奈特斯吉德

english: The Characters' Goals
zh_tw: 角色們的目標

english: The characters have three goals while inside the Three Moons Vault. As the characters explore the vault, NPCs such as Valendar ({@area area V7|30b|x}) and Casivus ({@area area V15|321|x}) can help devise plans for achieving these goals.
zh_tw: 角色們在三月亮金庫內有三大目標。當角色們探索金庫時，像瓦倫達爾（{@area 區域V7|30b|x}）和卡西沃斯（{@area 區域V15|321|x}）這樣的NPC可以幫助制定實現這些目標的計劃。

english: Rescue Valendar
zh_tw: 救援瓦倫達爾

english: Valendar, the leader of the Blue Fire Wardens, is trapped in the vault and might be stuck in his wolf or hybrid form. The characters need to find him, disrupt the magic forcing him to remain transformed, and restore him to his human form.
zh_tw: 瓦倫達爾，藍火守衛者的領袖，被困在金庫中，可能被困在他的狼形或混合形態中。角色們需要找到他，擾亂迫使他保持變形的魔法，並將他恢復到人類形態。

english: Stop Teremini's Ritual
zh_tw: 停止特雷米尼的儀式

english: If the characters rescue Valendar, he tells them that Teremini needs three special crystals in specific places to complete her ritual. If the characters find and sabotage the special crystals, they'll disrupt Teremini's ritual.
zh_tw: 如果角色們救出了瓦倫達爾，他會告訴他們特雷米尼需要在特定的位置放置三顆特殊的水晶才能完成她的儀式。如果角色們找到並破壞了這些特殊的水晶，他們就會擾亂特雷米尼的儀式。

english: Get the Rod Piece
zh_tw: 獲取法杖碎片

english: Teremini is using a piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} as part of a ritual that would permanently shroud the vault and a 1-mile radius around it in magical crimson moonlight. The characters need to disrupt Teremini's ritual before they can retrieve the rod piece. They can then return to Sigil.
zh_tw: 特雷米尼正在使用{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的一部分作為儀式的一部分，該儀式將永久性地將金庫及其周圍1英里範圍內籠罩在魔法的深紅色月光中。角色們需要在他們能夠取回法杖碎片之前打斷特雷米尼的儀式。之後，他們可以返回至法印城（法印城）。

english: Environmental Effects
zh_tw: 環境效應

english: The magical red moonlight that surrounds the Three Moons Vault is temporary, although Teremini is working to make the effect permanent. The moonlight creates the following effects in a 1-mile radius around the Three Moons Vault. These effects are suppressed in the vault's locations.
zh_tw: 圍繞三月亮金庫的魔法紅月光是暫時的，儘管特雷米尼正在努力使這種效果永久化。月光在三月亮金庫周圍1英里範圍內創造了以下效果。這些效果在金庫的地點被抑制。

english: Forced Transformation
zh_tw: 強制變形

english: A {@creature werewolf} that enters the red moonlight changes into its wolf or hybrid form, and it has the {@condition poisoned} condition as long as it is within 1 mile of Three Moons Vault. As long as it remains in this area, the creature can't willingly change shape unless it is reduced to 10 hit points or fewer; a {@spell Remove Curse} spell suppresses Forced Transformation for 1 hour.
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature werewolf||狼人}進入紅月之光後，會變形成狼或混合形態，只要位於三月亮窟的1英里範圍內，它就會處於{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態。只要它繼續停留在這一區域，該生物便無法自願改變形態，除非其生命值降至10或更低；{@spell Remove Curse||移除詛咒}法術會抑制強制變形1小時。

english: Reduced Gravity
zh_tw: 低重力

english: Objects and creatures take half as much damage from falls. Creatures can jump twice as far as normal.
zh_tw: 物體和生物從高處落下受到的傷害減半。生物跳躍的距離是正常情況下的兩倍。

english: Entering the Vault
zh_tw: 進入儲藏室

english: The Three Moons Vault is built amid rocky crags in the Northern Dargaard Mountains. Its main entrance is in plain sight and heavily guarded, but Riffel knows the way to a second, less-protected passage at the end of an old goat path. He takes the characters to this entrance, then he waits there so he can escort Valendar to Bittergrass Fen. It takes about one hour to traverse the distance between the fen and the vault.
zh_tw: 三月亮金庫建在北達爾加德山脈的岩石峭壁之間。它的主要入口清晰可見且重兵把守，但裡費爾知道一條老山羊小路盡頭的第二條保護較少的通道。他帶角色們來到這個入口，然後他在那裡等待，以便護送瓦倫達爾回到苦草沼澤。穿越沼澤和金庫之間的距離大約需要一個小時。

english: The characters begin their exploration of the vault at {@area area V1|2fb|x}.
zh_tw: 角色們從{@area 區域V1|2fb|x}開始探索金庫。

english: Vault Features
zh_tw: 寶庫特點

english: Maps 6.3 and 6.4 depict the Three Moons Vault. The vault is a complex, castle-like structure with a dungeon level, several towers, a secret entrance through the cliffs, and a drawbridge over a moat. Unless the text says otherwise, areas in and around the Three Moons Vault share a number of features.
zh_tw: 地圖6.3和6.4描繪了三月亮金庫。金庫是一個複雜的城堡式結構，包括一個地牢層、幾座塔樓、穿過懸崖的秘密入口，以及跨越護城河的吊橋。除非文字另有說明，三月亮金庫內外的區域共享許多特徵。

english: Ceilings
zh_tw: 天花板

english: The vault's ceilings are 10 feet high.
zh_tw: 金庫的天花板高度為10尺。

english: Doors
zh_tw: 門

english: The vault's doors are stone slabs set on brass hinges. Unless otherwise noted, each door is unlocked.
zh_tw: 金庫的門是設定在黃銅鉸鏈上的石板。除非另有說明，每扇門都是未上鎖的。

english: Lighting
zh_tw: 光照

english: Unless otherwise noted, interior areas are dark. Area descriptions assume the characters have a light source or some other means of seeing in the dark.
zh_tw: 除非另有說明，室內區域都是黑暗的。區域描述假定角色們有光源或者有其他在黑暗中看見事物的手段。

english: Moonlight Mirrors
zh_tw: 月光鏡

english: Several areas in the vault contain objects known as moonlight mirrors, which each reflect a powerful beam of light from one of Krynn's moons. Moonlight mirrors can be used to disrupt Teremini's ritual, as described later in this chapter.
zh_tw: 金庫中的幾個區域包含被稱為月光鏡的物件，每個都能反射來自克萊恩的月亮之一的強大光束。月光鏡可以用來擾亂特雷米尼的儀式，本章後文將對此進行描述。

english: A moonlight mirror is a Medium object with AC 13; 5 hit points; and immunity to poison, psychic, and radiant damage. A {@spell Detect Magic} spell reveals an aura of evocation magic emanating from the mirror. Unless covered, the reflective side of a moonlight mirror casts {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light} in a 20-foot hemisphere, in the color of the moon the mirror reflects. The text notes which ability checks, if any, are required to remove a moonlight mirror from where it is found.
zh_tw: 一面月光鏡是一個AC 13的中型物體；擁有5點生命值；並且免疫毒素、心靈和光耀傷害。一個{@spell Detect Magic||偵測魔法}法術會揭示出從鏡子散發出的塑能系魔法靈光。除非被覆蓋，月光鏡的反射面會在一個20尺半球範圍內投射出{@quickref Vision and Light||2||明亮光照}，其顏色與鏡子所反射的月亮顏色一致。文字備註了需要哪些屬性檢定（如果有的話）才能將月光鏡從其被發現的位置移除。

english: Vault Locations
zh_tw: 金庫位置

english: The following locations are keyed to map 6.3.
zh_tw: 以下地點在6.3號地圖上有標記。

english: Map 6.3: Three Moons Vault
zh_tw: 地圖6.3: 三月亮金庫

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: V1: Entrance
zh_tw: V1: 入口

english: Around the corner from where Riffel leaves the party is the vault's entrance. Read the following:
zh_tw: 在裡費爾離開隊伍的轉角處是金庫的入口。閱讀以下內容：

english: The goat path dead-ends at the convergence of three steep cliff walls. Two austere pillars flank a stone double door set into the wall. Next to each pillar stands a silver statue of a tall, mostly human-shaped individual.
zh_tw: 山羊小徑在三面陡峭的懸崖牆的交匯處走到了盡頭。兩座莊嚴肅穆的柱子分別位於牆內的一扇石制雙門兩側。每個柱子旁邊都立著一個高大的、大致人形的銀色雕像。

english: Two {@creature Moonlight Guardian|VEoR|moonlight guardians} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) guard this secret entrance. They attack any intruders on sight and fight until destroyed.
zh_tw: 兩個{@creature Moonlight Guardian|VEoR|月光守護者}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）守衛著這個秘密入口。它們會攻擊任何進入視線的入侵者，並戰鬥到被摧毀為止。

english: Trapped Doorway
zh_tw: 陷阱門道

english: A {@spell Detect Magic} spell reveals an aura of evocation magic radiating from the doorway. If a creature pulls on either of the doors' crescent-shaped handles, the doorway emits a 30-foot cone of silvery light for 1 minute, centered on the middle of the double door. A creature that enters that area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 27 ({@dice 5d10}) radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature not in its true form has disadvantage on this save; if it fails its save, the creature instantly reverts to its true form and can't assume a different form until it leaves the light.
zh_tw: 一個{@spell Detect Magic||偵測魔法}法術會從門口處偵測到塑能魔法的靈光。如果生物拉動門上的任何一個月牙形把手，門口會發出一道30尺的銀色光錐，持續1分鐘，光錐的中心位於雙門的中間。在一個回合中首次進入該區域或在該區域開始其回合的生物必須進行一個{@dc 17}體質豁免檢定，若豁免失敗則受到27（{@dice 5d10})點光耀傷害，若豁免成功則受到一半傷害。不在其真實形態下的生物在此檢定中有劣勢；如果其豁免失敗，該生物會立即恢復其真實形態，並且在離開光錐之前無法改變形態。

english: Once this trap is triggered, it can't be triggered again.
zh_tw: 一旦這個陷阱被觸發，它就無法再次觸發。

english: V2: Anteroom
zh_tw: V2: 前廳

english: A stone statue of an elegant elf in flowing robes watches over this chamber.
zh_tw: 一個穿著流動長袍的優雅精靈的石像守護著這個房間。

english: An inscription at the base of the statue reads, in Elvish: "It is not surrender. Live to fight again another day."
zh_tw: 雕像底部的銘文用精靈語寫著："這不是投降。活著，為了另一天再戰。"

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A weapon rack in the room holds a black steel {@item +1 Longsword} and a steel shield bearing the stylized floral emblem of the Order of the Rose. An armor stand bears a black breastplate. A small, unlocked chest holds a {@item Potion of Vitality}.
zh_tw: 房間裡的武器架上放著一把黑色的鋼製{@item +1 Longsword||+1 長劍}和一個帶有玫瑰騎士團風格化花卉徽章的鋼盾。一個盔甲架上掛著一件黑色胸甲。一個小的、未上鎖的箱子裡裝著一瓶{@item Potion of Vitality||活力藥水}。

english: V3: Escape Tunnel
zh_tw: V3: 逃生隧道

english: This tunnel stretches one hundred feet before ending at a flat wall.
zh_tw: 這條隧道延伸一百尺，最後以一堵平牆結束。

english: The secret door in the wall is obvious: emblazoned on the masonry is a wide circle of dimly glowing runes. A character who examines the secret door immediately realizes they can trace the runes to cause that circular section of wall to disappear, revealing the remainder of the tunnel on the other side. The wall re-forms a few seconds after it disappears.
zh_tw: 牆上的秘密門非常明顯：在石工上刻著一個寬寬的、微微發光的符文圈。檢查秘密門的角色立刻意識到他們可以追蹤這些符文，使那圓形的牆段消失，露出另一邊的隧道的其餘部分。牆在消失後幾秒鐘內重新形成。

english: The secret door can be activated from either side of the wall, but the runes are visible only when viewed from the north. From the southern side of the door, a creature that searches the wall and succeeds on a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check can see the faintest traces of the runes' light through the wall's brickwork. The creature can trace those runes to activate the door.
zh_tw: 這個秘門可以從牆的任意一側啟用，但符文只有從北面看時才可見。在門的南側，如果一個生物搜尋牆壁並在{@dc 20}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定中成功，可以看到透過牆磚透出的符文光芒的微弱痕跡。該生物可以追蹤這些符文來啟用門。

english: V4: Halls
zh_tw: V4: 廳堂

english: Four ghostly soldiers patrol these hallways. Their eyes are red, and each wears spectral, ridged armor and carries a hollowed-out goat horn.
zh_tw: 四名幽靈士兵在這些走廊中巡邏。他們的眼睛是紅色的，每個都穿著幽靈般的、帶脊的盔甲，手持一個挖空的山羊角。

english: The creatures are four {@creature Wraith||wraiths}. When Akaazi (see {@area area V34|350|x}) isn't present, these wraiths lead the small army of Undead soldiers stationed in the underground garrison ({@area area V8|311|x}). A wraith named Guerthel is Akaazi's favorite; he carries an iron key that unlocks the doors to {@area areas V7|30b|x} and {@area V10|314|x}.
zh_tw: 這些生物是四個{@creature Wraith||邪靈}。當阿卡茲（見{@area 區域V34|350|x}）不在場時，這些邪靈帶領著駐紮在地下軍營（{@area 區域V8|311|x}）的一小支不死軍團。一個名叫格爾瑟爾的邪靈是阿卡茲的最愛；他攜帶著一把鐵鑰匙，可以開啟{@area 區域V7|30b|x}和{@area V10|314|x}的門。

english: Raising the Alarm
zh_tw: 拉響警報

english: If a wraith spots an intruder or is attacked, it uses its action to blow its horn. Creatures within 100 feet of that wraith can hear the horn, prompting the wraith's allies in area V8 to join the fight. A horn blown in the dungeon level can't be heard from the keep above and vice versa.
zh_tw: 如果邪靈發現入侵者或遭到攻擊，它會使用其行動來吹響號角。在該邪靈100尺範圍內的生物可以聽到號角聲，這會促使區域 V8 中的邪靈盟友加入戰鬥。在地牢層吹響的號角聲無法從上面的城堡聽到，反之亦然。

english: V5: Scrying Chamber
zh_tw: V5: 窺視室

english: A fifteen-foot-diameter sphere made of shimmering silver floats above a hexagonal dais on the west side of this thirty-foot-high chamber. The sphere is as reflective as a mirror, and it appears smooth and sleek.
zh_tw: 一個直徑十五尺的由閃爍的銀色製成的球體漂浮在這個三十尺高的房間西邊的六角形基座上方。這個球體像鏡子一樣反射光線，看起來平滑而光滑。

english: Scrying Sphere
zh_tw: 水晶球

english: The silver sphere is a scrying device that allows Teremini to remotely communicate with Lord Soth, who has a similar sphere in his home, Dargaard Keep.
zh_tw: 這個銀色的球體是一個占卜裝置，它允許特雷米尼遠端與擁有類似球體的索思爵士溝通，索思爵士的球體位於他的家中，達爾加德城堡。

english: A creature that touches the seemingly solid sphere discovers that it is made from harmless, viscous silver liquid that is cool to the touch. Each time the sphere is touched, Lord Soth hears a faint pinging noise. Soth can respond by standing before his sphere and speaking. When he does, his helmeted face manifests, but it's composed of the sphere's silvery goo. (For more about {@creature Lord Soth|DSotDQ}, see {@area appendix B|560|x}.)
zh_tw: 一個生物如果觸控到看似堅固的球體，會發現它是由無害的、粘稠的銀色液體製成，觸控起來很涼爽。每次球體被觸控，索思爵士就會聽到微弱的叮噹聲。索思可以透過站在他的球體前並說話來回應。當他這樣做時，他戴著頭盔的臉會顯現出來，但它是由球體的銀色粘液組成的。（關於{@creature Lord Soth|DSotDQ|索思爵士}的更多資訊，見{@area 附錄 B|560|x}。）

english: Unknown to Teremini, Lord Soth can send a weaker facsimile of himself through this scrying sphere. If the characters respond to Lord Soth's manifested face with anything other than deference, a {@creature death knight} made from the sphere's silvery metal emerges from the sphere. The death knight inflicts punishment in Soth's stead, following his directives but requiring no action on Soth's part. If the death knight is destroyed, the sphere is also destroyed and disappears.
zh_tw: 特雷米尼並不知道，索思爵士可以透過這個占卜球傳送一個較弱的自己的複製體。如果角色們對索思爵士顯現的臉做出的回應不是恭敬的，一個由球體銀色金屬製成的{@creature death knight||死亡騎士}將從球體中出現。死亡騎士代表索思施加懲罰，遵循他的指示，但不需要索思採取任何行動。如果死亡騎士被摧毀，球體也會被摧毀並消失。

english: V6: Empty Cells
zh_tw: V6: 空牢房

english: Iron bars form three empty cells along the walls of this room. A nondescript stone door to the east indicates the room's exit. Lupine howls of pain sound from beyond the iron door to the west.
zh_tw: 鐵欄杆形成了這個房間牆壁上的三個空牢房。東邊的一扇不起眼的石門指示著房間的出口。西邊的鐵門後面傳來狼嚎般的痛苦聲。

english: The howls can be clearly heard coming from the other side of the locked iron door (area V7). The door can be unlocked with Guerthel's key (see {@area area V4|303|x}), or a character using thieves' tools can use an action to try to pick the lock, doing so with a successful {@dc 16} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check.
zh_tw: 嚎叫聲可以從被鎖住的鐵門（區域V7）的另一邊清晰地聽到。這扇門可以用格爾瑟爾的鑰匙開啟（參見{@area 區域V4|303|x}），或者一個使用盜賊工具的角色可以使用一個動作嘗試撬鎖，成功透過一個{@dc 16}敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定即可開啟。

english: V7: Valendar's Cell
zh_tw: V7: 瓦倫達爾的牢房

english: When the characters enter this room, read the following:
zh_tw: 當角色們進入這個房間時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: Bright-red light fills this twenty-foot-tall oval chamber. The light emanates from a large circular mirror set into a specially made groove on the ceiling. Kneeling on the floor of the chamber is a werewolf. It howls terribly, clutching and clawing at its body in fury. At the sight of the cell door opening, the werewolf leaps up and sprints toward you, claws extended!
zh_tw: 明亮的紅色光線充滿了這個二十尺高的橢圓形房間。光線來自天花板上一個特別製作的凹槽中的大圓形鏡子。一個狼人跪在房間的地板上。它在憤怒中痛苦地嚎叫，抓撓著自己的身體。看到牢房門開啟，狼人跳起來，向你衝過來，爪子伸展開來！

english: The red moonlight from the magical mirror forced Valendar (use the {@creature werewolf} stat block, except his alignment is chaotic good) to transform into his hybrid form. Valendar's imprisonment, anger, and fear make it difficult for him to think clearly. He attacks the characters, thinking they are his tormentors.
zh_tw: 來自魔法鏡子的紅色月光迫使瓦倫達爾（使用{@creature werewolf||狼人}的統計資料塊，除了他的陣營是混亂善良）變成了他的混合形態。瓦倫達爾的囚禁、憤怒和恐懼使他難以清晰地思考。他認為角色們是他的折磨者，於是攻擊他們。

english: Red Moonlight Mirror
zh_tw: 紅月光鏡

english: The mirror in the ceiling sheds bright-red light in the whole room. Removing the mirror from the ceiling requires no special effort.
zh_tw: 天花板上的鏡子在房間內散發出明亮的紅光。從天花板上移除鏡子不需要任何特殊努力。

english: Saving Valendar
zh_tw: 拯救瓦倫達爾

english: Valendar can't transform into his true form as long as he is in the area of moonlight emanating from the mirror. Valendar reverts to his true form if he is reduced to 10 hit points or fewer.
zh_tw: 只要瓦倫達爾處於鏡子發出的月光區域，他就不能變成他的真身。如果瓦倫達爾的生命值降至10點或更少，他將恢復到他的真身形態。

english: What Valendar Knows
zh_tw: 瓦倫達爾所知道的

english: If the characters help Valendar transform back into his true form, he thanks them wholeheartedly and shares everything he knows about the Three Moons Vault. He conveys the following points:
zh_tw: 如果角色們幫助瓦倫達爾變回他的真身，他會衷心地感謝他們，並分享他所知道關於三月亮金庫的一切。他傳達了以下要點：

english: Valendar
zh_tw: 瓦倫達爾

english: General Layout
zh_tw: 通常佈局

english: Valendar describes the general layout of the Three Moons Vault. He also explains that each of the vault's three towers is topped with a special room called a lunarium, which is an observatory containing a model.
zh_tw: 瓦倫達爾描述了三月亮金庫的總體佈局。他還解釋說，金庫的每個三座塔樓頂部都有一個特殊的房間，稱為月房，這是一個包含模型的天文臺。

english: Lunariums and Crystals
zh_tw: 月石和水晶

english: Within each lunarium is a "lunar crystal" infused with the moonlight of one of Krynn's three moons. These crystals are essential to Teremini's ritual and are protected by the ritual's magic.
zh_tw: 每個月房內都有一個注入了克萊恩三顆月亮之一月光的"月晶石"。這些晶石對特雷米尼的儀式至關重要，並且受到儀式魔法的保護。

english: Magic Balance
zh_tw: 魔法平衡

english: Krynn's moons represent a delicate balance of magical power, and Teremini's ritual relies on this balance. If the lunar crystals' magic is unbalanced, the ritual will be stopped.
zh_tw: 克萊恩的月亮代表了魔法力量的微妙平衡，而特雷米尼的儀式依賴於這種平衡。如果月晶石的魔法失去平衡，儀式將會停止。

english: Moonlight Mirrors
zh_tw: 月光鏡

english: The vault contains several other mirrors like the one in Valendar's cell. Valendar suggests the characters find three moonlight mirrors, one for each moon, then shine their light onto different lunar crystals to unbalance the crystals' magic.
zh_tw: 金庫中包含幾個像瓦倫達爾牢房中那樣的其他鏡子。瓦倫達爾建議角色們找到三個月光鏡，每個月亮一個，然後將它們的光線照射到不同的月晶石上，以破壞晶石的魔法平衡。

english: Valendar needs to return to his fellow wardens. After he's spoken to the characters, he departs, sneaking through the vault's secret escape tunnel to meet Riffel outside.
zh_tw: 瓦倫達爾需要回到他的守衛同伴那裡。在與角色們交談後，他離開了，透過金庫的秘密逃生通道潛行到外面與裡費爾會合。

english: Valendar's Secret
zh_tw: 瓦倫達爾的秘密

english: As the characters talk with Valendar, the leader adopts a sheepish demeanor, especially when talking about his capture. If the characters ask why, Valendar admits that he didn't properly scout the Three Moons Vault before the wardens' attack on the castle. Valendar underestimated Teremini, assuming she was a powerless lackey of Lord Soth. Valendar believes the wardens' defeat was his fault, and he's glad that no one else was captured in the assault.
zh_tw: 當角色們與瓦倫達爾交談時，這位領袖表現出一種羞怯的態度，特別是當談到他被捕時。如果角色們詢問原因，瓦倫達爾承認他在守衛者攻擊城堡之前沒有正確地偵查三月亮金庫。瓦倫達爾低估了特雷米尼，以為她只是索思爵士的一個無權的助手。瓦倫達爾認為守衛者的失敗是他的錯，他很高興在突襲中沒有其他人被捕。

english: Regardless of the characters' reaction to this revelation, learning it counts as a secret for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
zh_tw: 無論角色們對這個揭示有何反應，瞭解它都算作本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則的秘密。

english: V8: Garrison
zh_tw: V8: 衛戍區

english: All manner of undead creatures—mostly skeletons and zombies—impatiently mill around this area. They look ready for a fight.
zh_tw: 各種不死生物——主要是骷髏和殭屍——不耐煩地在這個區域徘徊。它們看起來準備好了戰鬥。

english: The vault's Undead soldiers occupy this grim chamber, ready for deployment at a moment's notice. Unless the soldiers have been called elsewhere to defend the vault or perform drudge work, the garrison contains sixteen {@creature Skeleton||skeletons}, nine {@creature Zombie||zombies}, and two {@creature Ogre Zombie||ogre zombies}.
zh_tw: 金庫的不死士兵佔據了這個陰沉的房間，隨時準備被部署。除非士兵們被叫到其他地方去保衛金庫或做苦工，這個守備隊包含十六個{@creature Skeleton||骷髏}，九個{@creature Zombie||喪屍}，和兩個{@creature Ogre Zombie||食人魔殭屍}。

english: V9: Winding Staircase
zh_tw: V9: 螺旋樓梯

english: A spiral staircase occupies most of this small chamber. Short hallways lead east and west from the staircase, which ascends 50 feet before connecting to {@area area V32|34d|x}.
zh_tw: 一個螺旋樓梯佔據了這個小房間的大部分。短走廊從樓梯向東和西延伸，樓梯上升50尺後連線到{@area 區域V32|34d|x}。

english: V10: Trapped Black Rose Bearer
zh_tw: V10: 被困的黑玫瑰使者

english: Both doors to this room are locked. A character can take the key from Guerthel (see {@area area V4|303|x}), or as an action, a character can use thieves' tools to try to pick the lock, doing so with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. If the characters enter this room, read the following:
zh_tw: 這個房間的兩扇門都鎖著。角色可以從格爾瑟爾那裡取得鑰匙（參見{@area 區域V4|303|x}），或者使用盜賊工具嘗試撬鎖，透過一個成功的{@dc 10}敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定即可成功。如果角色進入這個房間，請閱讀以下內容：

english: Though this tiered chamber was once elegantly appointed, its brass candelabras, velvet runners, and red tapestries were destroyed—likely by the room's occupant, a desiccated Undead currently tearing at the walls. A single doorway is set into the short north wall of the room.
zh_tw: 儘管這個分層的房間曾經裝飾得很優雅，它的黃銅燭臺、天鵝絨地毯和紅色掛幔都被摧毀了——很可能是房間的居住者，一個正在撕扯牆壁的乾枯不死生物所為。房間的北面短牆上有一扇單獨的門。

english: The {@creature black rose bearer|VEoR} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) trapped here is raging at everything in sight. Akaazi (see {@area area V34|350|x}) locked the bearer in here to prevent it from wreaking havoc throughout the dungeon. The black rose bearer attacks anyone who enters and fights until destroyed.
zh_tw: 被困在這裡的{@creature black rose bearer|VEoR|黑玫瑰使者}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）對視線中的一切狂暴不已。阿卡茲（見{@area 區域V34|350|x}）將這個使者鎖在這裡，以防止它在地牢中肆虐。黑玫瑰使者會攻擊任何進入的人，並戰鬥到被摧毀為止。

english: The doorway in the north wall opens to a stairway ascending to {@area area V35|353|x}.
zh_tw: 北牆上的門通向一個樓梯，通往{@area 區域V35|353|x}。

english: V11: Vault Access
zh_tw: V11: 金庫入口

english: Two minotaur skeletons guard this curved hallway. Beyond them, heavy, round metal doors seal five doorways. A brown stain covers the ground in front of the northernmost door.
zh_tw: 兩個牛頭人骷髏守衛著這個彎曲的走廊。在它們後面，五扇沉重的圓形金屬門封閉了五個門道。北邊最遠的門前的地面上覆蓋著棕色的汙漬。

english: The two {@creature Minotaur Skeleton||minotaur skeletons} attack intruders on sight and fight until destroyed.
zh_tw: 兩隻{@creature Minotaur Skeleton||骷髏牛頭人}一看到入侵者就會攻擊，並戰鬥到被摧毀為止。

english: V12: Treasure Vaults
zh_tw: V12: 寶藏庫

english: Each of these vault rooms is sealed behind a locked iron door. As an action, a character can use thieves' tools to try to unlock a door, doing so with a successful {@dc 18} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check, or force open a locked door, which requires a successful {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 每一間金庫房間都被鎖著的鐵門封住。作為一個動作，角色可以使用盜賊工具嘗試解鎖一扇門，成功透過一個 {@dc 18} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定即可，或者強行開啟一扇鎖住的門，這需要成功透過一個 {@dc 18} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。

english: V12a: Treasures
zh_tw: V12a: 寶藏

english: The door to this vault is trapped with a magical glyph. A character who examines the door can find the glyph by succeeding on a {@dc 17} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check, and any character can disable the glyph by succeeding on a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check. When a creature other than Teremini opens the door, a 20-foot-radius sphere of fire explodes from the glyph. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@dice 5d8}) fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Once this trap is triggered, it can't be triggered again.
zh_tw: 這座金庫的門被一個魔法符文所陷阱。一個角色透過成功進行一個 {@dc 17} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定可以檢查出這個符文，任何角色都可以透過成功進行一個 {@dc 20} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定來解除這個符文。當一個非特雷米尼的生物開啟這扇門時，符文會爆發出一個20尺半徑的火球。在該區域內的每個生物必須進行一次 {@dc 17} 敏捷豁免檢定，未透過則受到22（{@dice 5d8}）點火焰傷害，成功則僅受到一半傷害。一旦這個陷阱被觸發，它將無法再次觸發。

english: This vault contains 1,900 gp, ten gems worth 100 gp each, and six paintings worth 250 gp each.
zh_tw: 這個金庫包含1,900金幣，十顆每顆價值100金幣的寶石，以及六幅每幅價值250金幣的畫作。

english: V12b: Guardian Chamber
zh_tw: V12b: 守衛室

english: A {@creature beholder zombie} waits inside this vault. Akaazi keeps this zombie apart from the other Undead and reserves it for special tasks. It has orders to attack non-Undead creatures other than Akaazi and Teremini.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature beholder zombie||眼魔喪屍}在這座金庫內等待著。阿卡茲將這個殭屍與其他不死生物隔離開來，併為特殊任務保留它。它接到命令，攻擊除了阿卡茲和特雷米尼之外的非不死生物。

english: V12c: Empty Vault
zh_tw: V12c: 空金庫

english: This vault is empty.
zh_tw: 這個金庫是空的。

english: V12d: Leader's Gear
zh_tw: V12d: 領袖裝備

english: Heaped on this vault's floor are Valendar's belongings, including his leather armor, a {@item Potion of Greater Healing||Potion of Healing (greater)}, a {@item Spell Scroll} of {@spell Stoneskin}, and a brilliant-blue cloak emblazoned with the holy symbol of Habbakuk.
zh_tw: 這個金庫的地板上堆滿了瓦倫達爾的個人物品，包括他的皮甲、一瓶{@item Potion of Greater Healing||治療藥水（高等）}、一張{@spell Stoneskin||石膚術}的{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}，以及一件飾有哈巴庫克聖徽的鮮藍色斗篷。

english: V13: Ruined Vault
zh_tw: V13: 毀壞的金庫

english: Fuzzy brown mold covers this area like carpeting. A pile of rubble slopes upward to form a rough stairway.
zh_tw: 這個區域被毛茸茸的棕色黴菌覆蓋，就像地毯一樣。一堆瓦礫向上傾斜形成了一個粗糙的樓梯。

english: In addition to brown mold's usual effects, the areas of brown mold in this chamber are {@book difficult terrain|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}. A slope made of rubble connects this room to the white tower's basement (area V14) 20 feet above.
zh_tw: 除了棕色黴菌的通常效果外，這個房間裡的棕色黴菌區域是{@book 困難地形|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}。由瓦礫構成的斜坡將這個房間與上方20尺處的白塔地下室（區域 V14）連線起來。

english: V14: Flooded Basement
zh_tw: V14: 水淹地下室

english: Several inches of standing water cover the floor of these ruined rooms. Rubble in the northeast corner slopes downward to form a rough stairway.
zh_tw: 這些破敗的房間的地板上覆蓋著幾吋深的積水。東北角的瓦礫向下傾斜形成了一個粗糙的樓梯。

english: Stone walls once separated this basement level into four rooms, but the Cataclysm destroyed the north and west chambers. The standing water makes the floor {@quickref difficult terrain||3} in this area. The sloping rubble descends to area V13.
zh_tw: 岩石牆壁曾將這個地下室樓層分隔為四個房間，但大災變摧毀了北側和西側的密閣。積水使得該區域的地板成為{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。傾斜的瓦礫向下延伸至區域V13。

english: V15: Lunar Shrine
zh_tw: V15: 月神殿

english: A larger-than-life alabaster statue of a humanoid in flowing robes watches over this shrine. The figure bears a moon-like sphere instead of a face. The sphere is illuminated by white light shining from a silver mirror in the crook of the statue's left arm. Coiled around the plinth is an enormous, green, snakelike creature with a human face. It stares shrewdly at you as you enter.
zh_tw: 一尊比真人還大的雪花石膏雕像屹立在神龕之上，人形身軀穿著飄逸長袍。雕像沒有面孔，取而代之的是一個月球般的球體。一道從雕像左臂彎處的銀鏡發出的白光正照亮著這個球體。基座周圍盤繞著一條巨大的綠色蛇形生物，長著人臉。當你進入時，它正狡黠地盯著你。

english: The statue is a depiction of Solinari, the god of Krynn's white moon and good magic.
zh_tw: 這座雕像是克萊恩的白月亮和善良魔法之神索拉里（索林那瑞）的描繪。

english: White Moonlight Mirror
zh_tw: 白月光鏡

english: The mirror in the statue's arm is a white moonlight mirror. Removing the mirror from the statue requires no special effort.
zh_tw: 雕像手臂中的鏡子是一面白月光鏡。從雕像上取下鏡子不需要任何特殊努力。

english: Shrine's Guardian
zh_tw: 神殿的守衛

english: Wrapped around the statue is a {@creature guardian naga} named Casivus. Casivus has guarded this shrine since long before Lord Soth's forces arrived, and it chafes at the evil doings of Teremini and her minions.
zh_tw: 纏繞在雕像周圍的是一條名為卡西沃斯的{@creature guardian naga||守秘納迦}。自從索思爵士的軍隊到來之前，卡西沃斯就已經守護著這座神殿，它對特雷米尼及其手下的邪惡行為感到憤怒。

english: The naga is initially indifferent to the characters. If a character mentions that the party opposes Teremini's plans or engages the naga in polite conversation and succeeds on a {@dc 14} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check, Casivus becomes friendly toward the group. In this case, the naga permits the characters to take the mirror from the statue. Casivus also imparts two useful points of information:
zh_tw: 納迦最初對角色們漠不關心。如果某個角色提到隊伍反對特雷米尼的計劃，或者與納迦進行禮貌的交談併成功透過一個 {@dc 14} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，卡西沃斯會對團隊變得友好。在這種情況下，納迦允許角色從雕像上取走鏡子。卡西沃斯還會透露兩個有用的資訊：

english: Position of the Moons
zh_tw: 月亮的位置

english: To disrupt Teremini's ritual, the characters must shine different colors of moonlight onto the lunariums' crystals in a specific combination. This combination depends on the current phases and positions of Krynn's moons. Teremini has a magical orrery in the red tower that shows the moons' positions. A character can study this orrery to determine the moonlight-crystal combinations necessary to disrupt the ritual.
zh_tw: 要幹擾特雷米尼的儀式，角色們必須將不同顏色的月光照射到月晶石上，以特定的組合。這個組合取決於克萊恩的月亮當前的階段和位置。特雷米尼在紅塔中有一個魔法天球儀，顯示了月亮的位置。角色可以研究這個天球儀來確定幹擾儀式所需的月光-水晶組合。

english: Stairwell Passphrase
zh_tw: 樓梯井口令

english: Casivus tells the characters the passphrase to open the locked door inside the chamber northeast of here (area V16). The passphrase is "buried is best."
zh_tw: 卡西沃斯告訴角色們開啟這裡東北方的房間（區域 V16）內上鎖門的口令。口令是"埋葬是最好的"。

english: Casivus has no wish to leave this shrine or accompany the characters, but the naga would be pleased to see Teremini and her followers gone.
zh_tw: 卡西沃斯並不想離開這座神殿，也不想陪伴角色們，但這條納迦會很高興看到特雷米尼和她的追隨者消失。

english: V16: Locked Stairwell
zh_tw: V16: 鎖住的樓梯間

english: An enclosure with a shuttered door stands in the southernmost part of this otherwise empty room.
zh_tw: 在這個本應空無一物的房間的最南端，有一個帶有百葉門的圍欄。

english: The door to this stairwell is locked with an {@spell Arcane Lock} spell. Teremini, Akaazi, and Casivus know the door's passphrase ("buried is best"). As an action, a character can try to force open the door, doing so with a successful {@dc 24} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 通往樓梯間的門被一個{@spell Arcane Lock||秘法鎖}法術鎖住了。特雷米尼、阿卡茲和卡西沃斯知道門的密碼（"埋葬是最好的"）。作為一個動作，一個角色可以嘗試強行開啟門，成功的{@dc 24}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定即可實現。

english: The circular staircase connects to area V17, which is 30 feet above.
zh_tw: 這個圓形樓梯連線到V17區域，該區域在上方30尺處。

english: V17: White Tower Ruins
zh_tw: V17: 白塔遺蹟

english: The walls and floor here are crumbling. A wooden ladder leans against the edge of the ceiling above.
zh_tw: 這裡的牆壁和地板都在崩解。一把木梯斜靠在上方天花板的邊緣。

english: The white tower's ground floor lies in ruin. A ladder connects this floor to {@area area V19|32b|x}.
zh_tw: 白塔的底層已成廢墟。一架梯子連線著這個樓層和{@area 區域V19|32b|x}。

english: V18: Veteran Camp
zh_tw: V18: 老兵營地

english: A sloping mound of rubble creates a rough bridge over the moat west of the white tower. Six humans in dented armor pace atop the slope.
zh_tw: 一堆傾斜的瓦礫堆在白塔西側的護城河上形成了一座粗糙的橋樑。六名穿著凹陷盔甲的人類在斜坡上踱步。

english: The slope immediately leading into this area is guarded by six {@creature Veteran||veterans} (lawful evil humans). A seventh veteran is resting in the tent to the north and rushes to help their allies when a fight breaks out. The veterans defend the keep with their lives, knowing that to do otherwise would invite Teremini's wrath.
zh_tw: 通往這個區域的斜坡由六名{@creature Veteran||老兵}（守序邪惡的人類）守衛。第七名老兵在北方的帳篷裡休息，一旦發生戰鬥就會衝出來幫助他們的同伴。老兵們以生命捍衛要塞，因為他們知道不這樣做會招致特雷米尼的憤怒。

english: V19: White Tower Lookout
zh_tw: V19: 白塔瞭望臺

english: A single human lookout in dented armor stands watch in the southern portion of this area.
zh_tw: 一個穿著凹陷盔甲的人類哨兵站在這個區域的南部進行守望。

english: The guard is a lawful evil, human {@creature veteran}. The veteran carries a hollow goat's horn in addition to her usual gear. If she expects attackers, she pulls up the ladder that connects to {@area area V17|327|x} and blows her horn to raise the alarm.
zh_tw: 這名守衛是一名守序邪惡的人類{@creature veteran||老兵}。除了她通常的裝備外，這位老兵還攜帶著一個挖空的山羊角。如果她預期會有攻擊者，她會拉起連線到{@area 區域V17|327|x}的梯子，並吹響她的號角以發出警報。

english: A spiral staircase ascends to area V20.
zh_tw: 一座螺旋樓梯通往V20區域。

english: V20: Ruined Shrine
zh_tw: V20: 廢墟神龕

english: Ornate pillars bearing countless impressions of celestial bodies encircle this ruined chamber. The floor tiles are cracked and loose, and part of the wall has caved in.
zh_tw: 裝飾華麗的柱子上印有無數的天體印記，環繞著這個破敗的房間。地板磚塊裂縫累累，鬆動不堪，部分牆壁已經坍塌。

english: A staircase in the southern part of the room ascends to the white tower's lunarium ({@area area U1|361|x}).
zh_tw: 房間南部的樓梯通往白塔的月晶石室（{@area 區域U1|361|x}）。

english: White Moonlight Mirror
zh_tw: 白月光鏡

english: Hidden in a cavity beneath the flagstone tiles is a white moonlight mirror wrapped in old oilcloth. A character can find the mirror by searching the floor and succeeding on a {@dc 12} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check. Removing the mirror from the cavity requires no special effort.
zh_tw: 隱藏在石板地磚下的空洞中是一面用舊油布包裹的白色月光鏡。角色可以透過搜尋地板併成功透過一個 {@dc 12} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定來找到這面鏡子。從空洞中取出鏡子不需要特別的努力。

english: V21: Drawbridge
zh_tw: V21: 吊橋
