english: The castle's drawbridge is lowered over the murky moat.
zh_tw: 城堡的吊橋已經放下，橫跨在昏暗的護城河上。

english: Soth's rank-and-file soldiers use this gate to enter the keep.
zh_tw: 索思的普通士兵使用這個大門進入城堡。

english: Drawbridge
zh_tw: 吊橋

english: To raise or lower the wooden drawbridge, both levers inside the keep must be pulled at the same time. An automatic mechanism then raises or lowers the bridge over the course of 1 minute.
zh_tw: 要升起或降下木製吊橋，城堡內的兩個槓桿必須同時拉動。然後，一個自動機制會在1分鐘的過程中升起或降下橋樑。

english: Moat
zh_tw: 護城河

english: The moat surrounding the Three Moons Vault is 50 feet deep. A nearby stream keeps the moat filled with ice-cold snowmelt from the mountains.
zh_tw: 環繞三月亮金庫的護城河深達50尺。附近的溪流不斷將來自山中的冰冷空氣注入護城河，使其保持充盈。

english: V22: Lookout Turret
zh_tw: V22: 瞭望塔

english: A ladder allows access from the courtyard to this fortified platform. Two guards in dented armor, each carrying hollowed-out goat's horns, keep watch here.
zh_tw: 一把梯子允許從庭院進入這個加固的平臺。兩名穿著凹陷盔甲的守衛，每個人都攜帶著挖空的山羊角，在這裡保持警戒。

english: Two {@creature Veteran||veterans} (lawful evil humans) keep watch atop the turret. If they see or hear the characters approach, they sound their horns, and allies from {@area area V18|329|x} arrive in 5 minutes.
zh_tw: 兩名{@creature Veteran||老兵}（守序邪惡的人類）在塔樓上保持警戒。如果他們看到或聽到角色們接近，他們會吹響他們的號角，來自{@area 區域V18|329|x}的盟友將在5分鐘內到達。

english: V23: Wall Walk
zh_tw: V23: 牆道

english: The stone walkway atop the keep's curtain wall passes through the second floor of each moon tower, allowing access. The walkway can be reached via staircases in the courtyard ({@area area V25|339|x}).
zh_tw: 位於要塞幕牆頂部的石制步道穿過每個月亮塔的第二層，允許通行。透過庭院中的樓梯可以到達步道（{@area 區域V25|339|x}）。

english: V24: Rookery
zh_tw: V24: 鳥巢

english: Two enormous, skeletal, birdlike creatures perch atop the wooden platform here.
zh_tw: 兩隻巨大的、骨骼般的、類似鳥類的生物棲息在這個木製平臺上。

english: These two {@creature Bone Roc|VEoR|bone rocs} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) are trained to ferry passengers to and from a similar rookery near the bottom of the mountain.
zh_tw: 這兩個{@creature Bone Roc|VEoR|骨骸巨鳥}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）被訓練用來在山腳下類似的棲息地之間運送乘客。

english: A bone roc attacks only if threatened or harmed.
zh_tw: 骨鴞只有在受到威脅或傷害時才會攻擊。

english: V25: Courtyard
zh_tw: V25: 庭院

english: The center of the keep features an open-air plaza paved with moon rock tiles.
zh_tw: 城堡的中心是一個露天廣場，用月亮石鋪成。

english: From this courtyard, individuals can access the ground floors of the three moon towers, most of the keep's other buildings, and staircases to the curtain wall walkways. A hundred feet above looms the moondisk ({@area area U5|368|x}).
zh_tw: 從這個庭院，人們可以進入三座月亮塔的底層，要塞其他大部分建築，以及通往幕牆步道的樓梯。一百尺上方懸掛著月亮盤（{@area 區域U5|368|x}）。

english: V26: Barrack
zh_tw: V26: 兵營

english: This sparsely furnished area includes simple beds and empty wash tubs.
zh_tw: 這個傢俱簡陋的區域包括簡單的床鋪和空的洗衣盆。

english: When non-Undead individuals stay at the Three Moons Vault, they reside here.
zh_tw: 當非不死生物個體停留在三月亮金庫時，他們居住在這裡。

english: V27: Armory
zh_tw: V27: 軍械庫

english: Weapon racks and armor stands line the walls of this cramped storage room.
zh_tw: 這個狹小的儲藏室的牆壁上擺滿了武器架和盔甲架。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The equipment here includes the following:
zh_tw: 這裡的裝備包括以下內容：

english: Three {@item Longsword|PHB|longswords}
zh_tw: 三把{@item Longsword|PHB|長劍}

english: Two {@item Halberd|PHB|halberds}
zh_tw: 兩把{@item Halberd|PHB|長戟}

english: Two {@item Crossbow Bolt Case|PHB|crossbow bolt cases}, each containing 20 {@item Crossbow Bolts (20)|PHB|bolts}
zh_tw: 兩個{@item Crossbow Bolt Case|PHB|弩矢匣}，每個包含20{@item Crossbow Bolts (20)|PHB|弩箭}

english: Two {@item Shield|PHB|shields}
zh_tw: 兩個{@item Shield|PHB|盾牌}

english: A suit of {@item Splint Armor|PHB|splint} mail
zh_tw: 一套{@item Splint Armor|PHB|板條甲}

english: A bottle of {@item Oil of Sharpness}
zh_tw: 一瓶{@item Oil of Sharpness||銳鋒之油}

english: V28: Royal Quarters
zh_tw: V28: 皇家住所

english: A grim iron throne and an iron statue of an intimidating knight stand in the middle of this room. Both look out a window at the courtyard to the southeast. Fastened to the throne's headrest is a mirror that seems to draw light in rather than reflect it.
zh_tw: 這個房間中央有一張陰森的鐵製寶座和一尊威武騎士的鐵雕像。兩者都面向東南方向的庭院的窗戶望去。寶座的頭枕上固定著一面鏡子，這面鏡子似乎在吸收光線而不是反射它。

english: On the rare occasions when Lord Soth visits the Three Moons Vault, this chamber is set aside for him to glower over his subjects.
zh_tw: 在索思爵士偶爾訪問三月亮金庫的時候，這個房間被特別留出來供他居高臨下地審視他的臣民。

english: Black Moonlight Mirror
zh_tw: 黑月光鏡

english: The mirror affixed to the throne is a black moonlight mirror. Removing the mirror from the throne requires no special effort.
zh_tw: 固定在寶座上的鏡子是一面黑月光鏡。從寶座上取下鏡子不需要特別的努力。

english: V29: Orrery
zh_tw: V29: 天文儀

english: A large model of a planet and three moons hangs in the center of this high-ceilinged chamber. The celestial bodies are affixed to bronze rings via delicate rods that move slowly under their own momentum. The device is illuminated by a beam of red moonlight that emanates from a mirror mounted twenty feet up the southwest wall. Twin staircases ascend to a railed walkway overlooking the orrery.
zh_tw: 一個大型的行星和三個月亮的模型懸掛在這個高天花板房間的中心。這些天體透過精緻的杆子固定在青銅環上，這些杆子在自己的動量下緩慢移動。這個裝置由一束從掛在西南牆二十尺高的鏡子發出的紅色月光照亮。一對樓梯通向一個有欄杆的走道，可以俯瞰這個天文模型。

english: This enchanted orrery accurately depicts the current positions of Krynn's three moons—Solinari, Lunitari, and Nuitari—relative to Krynn. If the moonlight mirror in area V30 is removed, the orrery stops moving.
zh_tw: 這個附魔的天球儀準確地描繪了克萊恩的三顆月亮——索拉里、露尼塔裡和努伊塔裡——相對於克萊恩的當前位置。如果V30區域的月光鏡被移除，天球儀就會停止移動。

english: Staircases on either side of the orrery lead to area V30 above.
zh_tw: 位於天文模型兩側的樓梯通往上方的區域 V30。

english: Deciphering the Orrery
zh_tw: 解讀天球儀

english: A character can study the orrery to deduce the relative positions of Krynn's moons. The character gleans that, currently, Lunitari prevails over Solinari, Solinari prevails over Nuitari, and Nuitari prevails over Lunitari.
zh_tw: 一個角色可以研究這個天文模型來推斷克萊恩的月亮們的相對位置。角色瞭解到，目前，盧尼塔裡（努林塔瑞）勝過索拉里（索林那瑞），索拉里勝過努塔裡（努塔瑞），而努塔裡勝過盧尼塔裡。

english: Based on this deduction, the character understands that Teremini's ritual can be disrupted by shining red moonlight on the white crystal, white moonlight on the black crystal, and black moonlight on the red crystal.
zh_tw: 根據這個推斷，角色理解到特雷米尼的儀式可以透過將紅月光照射在白水晶上、白月光照射在黑水晶上、以及黑月光照射在紅水晶上來中斷。

english: V30: Red Mirror Stairwell
zh_tw: V30: 紅鏡樓梯間

english: A stone guardrail protects anyone standing on this elevated walkway from falling to the floor below. One wall of the walkway bears a shiny red mirror. Stairs in the center of the space ascend to another chamber.
zh_tw: 一個石制的護欄保護站在這條高架走道上的任何人不會掉到下面的地面。走道的一面牆上裝有一面閃亮的紅色鏡子。空間中心的樓梯通往另一個房間。

english: Red Moonlight Mirror
zh_tw: 紅月光鏡

english: The mirror affixed to the wall is a red moonlight mirror. Removing the mirror from the wall requires no special effort.
zh_tw: 固定在牆上的鏡子是一面紅月光鏡。從牆上取下鏡子不需要任何特殊努力。

english: V31: Teremini's Quarters
zh_tw: V31: 特雷米尼的住處

english: This bedroom includes a four-poster bed, a writing desk, several bookshelves, and a footlocker.
zh_tw: 這間臥室包括一張四柱床、一張寫字檯、幾個書架和一個行李箱。

english: Teremini dwells in this finely decorated bedroom.
zh_tw: 特雷米尼居住在這個裝飾精美的臥室中。

english: Mimic
zh_tw: 擬身怪

english: The footlocker is a {@creature mimic}. Teremini trained the mimic to attack anyone who snoops around her room.
zh_tw: 這個行李箱是一個{@creature mimic||擬身怪}。特雷米尼訓練這個擬身怪攻擊任何在她房間裡窺探的人。

english: Logbook
zh_tw: 航海日誌

english: On the desk is a log of all the treasures and prisoners transported to and from the Three Moons Vault. Of interest to the characters are the first and last pages of the log.
zh_tw: 桌子上有一本記錄了所有運往三月亮金庫的寶藏和囚犯的日誌。對角色們感興趣的是日誌的首頁和尾頁。

english: The first page describes the six moonlight mirrors found in the original moon towers during the vault's construction. The log notes the present location of these mirrors:
zh_tw: 第一頁描述了在金庫建造期間在原始月亮塔中發現的六面月光鏡。日誌記錄了這些鏡子的當前位置：

english: {@b White Mirrors}: The lunar shrine ({@area area V15|321|x}) and the ruined shrine ({@area area V20|32d|x})
zh_tw: {@b 白鏡子}：月亮神殿（{@area 區域V15|321|x}）和廢墟神殿（{@area 區域V20|32d|x}）

english: {@b Red Mirrors}: Valendar's cell ({@area area V7|30b|x}) and the red mirror stairwell ({@area area V30|346|x})
zh_tw: {@b 紅鏡子}：瓦倫達爾的牢房（{@area 區域V7|30b|x}）和紅色鏡子樓梯井（{@area 區域V30|346|x}）

english: {@b Black Mirrors}: Royal quarters ({@area area V28|340|x}) and Akaazi's quarters ({@area area V36|357|x})
zh_tw: {@b 黑色鏡子}：王室居所（{@area 區域V28|340|x}）與阿卡茲的居所（{@area 區域V36|357|x}）

english: The log's last pages mention "a piece of the legendary {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, seized from an ungrateful dryad" as well as "three lunar crystals, procured from a powerful dragon." The logbook doesn't specify where the rod piece or the crystals are currently stored.
zh_tw: 日誌的最後幾頁提到了"來自一個忘恩負義的樹精的傳說中的{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的一部分"，以及"從一隻強大的龍那裡獲得的三個月光水晶"。日誌本並沒有指明現在這些部件或水晶被存放在哪裡。

english: A staircase at the northern end of the room ascends to the red tower's lunarium ({@area area U2|363|x}).
zh_tw: 房間北端的樓梯通往紅塔的月晶石室（{@area 區域U2|363|x}）。

english: V32: Stairwell
zh_tw: V32: 樓梯井

english: This stairwell connects to {@area area V9|313|x} below.
zh_tw: 這個樓梯井連線到下方的{@area 區域V9|313|x}。

english: V33: Muster Yard
zh_tw: V33: 集結場

english: This empty yard has a floor of thick mud.
zh_tw: 這個空蕩蕩的院子地面覆蓋著厚厚的泥漿。

english: Teremini's soldiers conduct training drills in this muddy yard. When the keep's alarm is raised, they rally here and prepare to defend the keep. The mud is {@book difficult terrain|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}.
zh_tw: 特雷米尼的士兵在這個泥濘的院子裡進行訓練演習。當城堡的警報響起時，他們在這裡集結並準備保衛城堡。泥地是{@book 困難地形|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}。

english: Two {@creature Earth Elemental||earth elementals}, summoned and bound by Teremini, dwell beneath the mud. If they detect intruders with their {@sense tremorsense|MM}, the elementals rise from the mud and attack.
zh_tw: 兩個由特雷米尼召喚並束縛的{@creature Earth Elemental||土元素}，居住在泥漿之下。如果它們透過它們的{@sense tremorsense|MM|震顫感知}察覺到入侵者，這些元素就會從泥漿中升起並發動攻擊。

english: V34. Circle of Undeath
zh_tw: V34: 不死之環

english: An interior circular stone wall creates a ringed hallway inside this tower. Archways in the wall are covered in black curtains. The outer hallway is eerily empty, but you can hear chanting coming from beyond the archways.
zh_tw: 一個內部的圓形石牆在這個塔內形成了一個環形的走廊。牆上的拱門被黑色簾子覆蓋。外部走廊異常空曠，但你可以聽到從拱門另一邊傳來的吟唱聲。

english: Three archways, each shrouded by a black curtain, connect the two spaces in this area. Once the characters walk through a curtain into the inner space, read the following:
zh_tw: 三個拱門，每個都被黑色簾子覆蓋，連線了這個區域的兩個空間。一旦角色們穿過簾子進入內部空間，請閱讀以下內容：

english: Black candles cast {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} throughout this inner room, revealing a circle of unholy runes drawn in chalk on the floor. A black-robed figure crouches, examining the runes, while a zombie-like creature holding a black rose in a glass jar stands nearby.
zh_tw: 黑色蠟燭在整個內室中投下{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}，顯露出地板上用粉筆繪製的褻瀆符文之環。一個黑袍身影蹲伏著，檢查著符文，而一個手持裝有黑玫瑰玻璃罐的喪屍狀生物則站在附近。

english: A neutral evil human {@creature necromancer wizard|MPMM} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) named Akaazi uses this chamber to conduct necromantic rituals and create Undead soldiers for Lord Soth's army. Akaazi is accompanied by a {@creature black rose bearer|VEoR} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}).
zh_tw: 一箇中立邪惡的人類{@creature necromancer wizard|MPMM|死靈師}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）名叫阿卡茲，他使用這個房間進行死靈儀式，為索思領主的軍隊創造不死士兵。阿卡茲由一位{@creature black rose bearer|VEoR|黑玫瑰使者}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）陪同。

english: As soon as she's aware of intruders, Akaazi commands the bearer to attack and fights to the death in the name of Lord Soth.
zh_tw: 一旦察覺到有入侵者，阿卡茲命令攜帶者發動攻擊，並以索思領主的名義戰鬥至死。

english: If the characters look up, they can see a black moonlight mirror hanging in {@area area V36|357|x}.
zh_tw: 如果角色們向上看，他們可以看到一面黑月光鏡懸掛在{@area 區域V36|357|x}。

english: V35: Temple
zh_tw: V35: 神廟

english: A stone altar at the back of this temple is its only notable fixture. Dusty windows set in iron frames overlook the courtyard.
zh_tw: 這座神廟後部的石制祭壇是其唯一值得注意的設施。佈滿灰塵的窗戶裝在鐵架上，俯瞰著庭院。

english: Akaazi's eerie black tower leads into this temple, so the chamber is rarely used. The north staircase descends 30 feet to {@area area V10|314|x}.
zh_tw: 阿卡茲詭異的黑色高塔通向這座神廟，因此這個房間很少使用。北邊的樓梯向下延伸30尺至{@area 區域V10|314|x}。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A section of this chamber's western wall is hollow and set onto hinges that allow it to swing out toward the courtyard. The secret door can be detected with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.
zh_tw: 這間房間的西牆有一部分是空心的，安裝在鉸鏈上，可以朝庭院方向開啟。成功的 {@dc 13} 感知 ({@skill Perception||感知}) 檢定可以發現這個秘密門。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The back of the altar is hollow and bears a single shelf, on which sits a {@item Wand of Enemy Detection}.
zh_tw: 祭壇的背面是空心的，並且有一個架子，上面放著一根{@item Wand of Enemy Detection||搜敵魔杖}。

english: V36: Akaazi's Quarters
zh_tw: V36: 阿卡茲宿舍

english: This room contains a simple sleeping mat and a bookcase full of grim tomes of little value. Two doors exit the tower and connect to the wall walk outside.
zh_tw: 這間房間內有一張簡單的睡墊和擺滿了價值不高的陰沉書籍的書架。兩扇門通出塔樓，連線到外面的城牆步道。

english: Black Moonlight Mirror
zh_tw: 黑月光鏡

english: A circular opening in the floor allows a creature to view the chamber below ({@area area V34|350|x}). A black moonlight mirror is suspended from three iron chains connected to the sides of the opening. The mirror can be safely detached from one iron chain with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. If a character fails this check by 5 or more, the mirror comes loose from the chains and falls to the floor 20 feet below.
zh_tw: 地板上的一個圓形開口允許生物檢視下面的房間 ({@area 區域V34|350|x})。一面黑色的月光鏡子懸掛在連線開口側面的三條鐵鏈上。透過一個成功的 {@dc 15} 敏捷 ({@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}) 檢定，可以安全地從一條鐵鏈上取下鏡子。如果一個角色在此檢定中失敗且差值超過5，鏡子會從鐵鏈上脫落，掉到下方20尺的地板上。

english: V37: Aviary
zh_tw: V37: 鳥舍

english: Black corvids fill the small cages in this bleak, windowless aviary. The birds squawk loudly whenever anyone enters.
zh_tw: 這個陰鬱、沒有窗戶的鳥舍裡，小籠子裡充滿了黑色的烏鴉。每當有人進入時，這些鳥兒就會大聲叫喊。

english: Twenty {@creature Raven||ravens} used to deliver messages occupy the flimsy wooden cages.
zh_tw: 二十隻用於傳遞資訊的{@creature Raven||渡鴉}佔據了這些脆弱的木籠。

english: A staircase on the eastern wall ascends to the black tower's lunarium ({@area area U3|365|x}).
zh_tw: 東牆上的樓梯通往黑塔的月晶石室（{@area 區域U3|365|x}）。

english: Upper-Level Features
zh_tw: 高層特徵

english: In addition to the features of the Three Moons Vault listed earlier in this chapter, the vault's upper level has a number of important features.
zh_tw: 除了本章前面列出的三月亮金庫的特徵外，金庫的上層還有一些重要的特徵。

english: If the characters don't know how to stop Teremini's ritual yet, one of them realizes that the answer must have to do with Krynn's moons, and that they should examine the orrery in {@area area V29|343|x}.
zh_tw: 如果角色們還不知道如何停止特雷米尼的儀式，他們中的一個意識到答案肯定與克萊恩的月亮有關，並且他們應該檢查{@area 區域V29|343|x}中的天球儀。

english: Colored Glass
zh_tw: 彩色玻璃

english: Each lunarium ({@area areas U1|361|x}, {@area U2|363|x}, and {@area U3|365|x}) is surrounded by six columns that support a hemispherical rooftop made of enameled glass. Panes of enameled glass are set between each column. Each 10-foot square of glass is a Large object with AC 10, 10 hit points, vulnerability to bludgeoning and thunder damage, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 每個月晶石室（{@area 區域U1|361|x}、{@area U2|363|x} 和 {@area U3|365|x}）周圍有六根柱子，支撐著一個由琺琅玻璃製成的半球形屋頂。每根柱子之間都鑲嵌著琺琅玻璃。每塊10尺見方的玻璃是一個大型物體，具有10的護甲等級（AC），10點生命值，對鈍擊和雷鳴傷害易損，對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。

english: The glass is enchanted so that only one color of moonlight shines through it:
zh_tw: 這些玻璃被施了魔法，只能透過一種顏色的月光：

english: Solinari's white light shines into the white tower's lunarium ({@area area U1|361|x}).
zh_tw: 索拉里斯的白光照射進白塔的月晶石室（{@area 區域U1|361|x}）。

english: Lunitari's red light shines into the red tower's lunarium ({@area area U2|363|x}).
zh_tw: 露尼塔裡的紅光照射進紅塔的月晶石室（{@area 區域U2|363|x}）。

english: Nuitari's black light shines into the black tower's lunarium ({@area area U3|365|x}).
zh_tw: 努伊塔裡的黑光照射進黑塔的月晶石室（{@area 區域U3|365|x}）。

english: Lunar Crystals
zh_tw: 月晶石

english: Shallow steps ascend to a dais at the center of each lunarium. A specially carved pillar atop the dais bears a lunar crystal. These lunar crystals were specially created by the lunar dragon Orinix.
zh_tw: 淺淺的臺階通往每個月晶石室中心的高臺。高臺上特別雕刻的柱子上承載著一個月晶石。這些月晶石是由月龍奧里尼克斯特別創造的。

english: These crystals are components for Teremini's ritual, but they have no value or special properties. When the characters arrive, these daises are surrounded by barriers of solid moonlight (see below). The crystals can't be smashed while Teremini concentrates on her ritual.
zh_tw: 這些晶石是特雷米尼儀式的組成部分，但它們沒有價值或特殊屬性。當角色們到達時，這些高臺被堅固的月光屏障所環繞（見下文）。在特雷米尼專注於她的儀式時，晶石無法被破壞。

english: Solid Moonlight
zh_tw: 堅固月光

english: The moonbridges and moondisk ({@area areas U4|367|x} and {@area U5|368|x}) are made of solid moonlight that shimmers like opalescent glass. If a creature not in its true form starts its turn touching solid moonlight, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition poisoned} condition until the start of its next turn.
zh_tw: 月橋與月盤（{@area 區域U4|367|x} 和 {@area U5|368|x}）由堅實的月光製成，閃爍著如蛋白石玻璃般的光芒。如果一個沒有處於真實形態的生物在其回合開始時觸碰到堅實的月光，該生物必須成功透過一個 {@dc 15} 體質豁免檢定，否則將擁有 {@condition poisoned||中毒} 狀態，直到其下一個回合開始。

english: While Teremini concentrates on her ritual, spherical barriers of solid moonlight also surround each lunar crystal dais.
zh_tw: 當特雷米尼專注於她的儀式時，每個月晶石高臺也被球形的堅固月光屏障所環繞。

english: Nothing can physically pass through solid moonlight or teleport through it. It is immune to all damage and can't be dispelled by the {@spell Dispel Magic} spell. Any solid moonlight caught in the area of a {@spell Sunburst} spell is dispelled for 10 minutes. Solid moonlight also extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking ethereal travel through it. The ritual is powered by the rod piece and is therefore unaffected by the {@spell Antimagic Field} spell.
zh_tw: 沒有任何物質可以物理穿過堅固月光，也無法透過它進行傳送。它對所有傷害免疫，且不能被{@spell Dispel Magic||解除魔法}法術解除。任何位於{@spell Sunburst||陽炎爆}法術範圍內的堅固月光將被解除10分鐘。堅固月光也延伸到靈界，阻止透過靈界的靈界旅行。儀式由法杖部件驅動，因此不受{@spell Antimagic Field||反魔法場}法術的影響。

english: Upper-Level Locations
zh_tw: 上層地點

english: The following locations are keyed to map 6.4.
zh_tw: 以下地點對應於地圖6.4。

english: Map 6.4: Three Moons Vault—Upper Level
zh_tw: 地圖 6.4：三月亮金庫—上層

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: U1: White Lunarium
zh_tw: U1: 白色月晶石

english: White moonlight glows around this smooth dais.
zh_tw: 白色的月光在這個光滑的高臺上閃耀。

english: The moonlight barrier around this lunarium's dais is trapped. When the barrier is touched, it emits a blinding flash of white light in a 30-foot radius centered on the dais. Any creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition blinded} condition for 24 hours.
zh_tw: 這個月神殿祭壇周圍的月光屏障設有陷阱。當屏障被觸碰時，它會以祭壇為中心，在30尺半徑範圍內發出一道耀眼的白色閃光。該區域內的任何生物必須成功透過一次 {@dc 17} 的體質豁免檢定，否則將獲得 {@condition blinded||目盲} 狀態，持續24小時。

english: U2: Red Lunarium
zh_tw: U2: 紅色月石

english: A shadowy, skeletal wolf walking upright like a human stalks the area here.
zh_tw: 一隻陰影般的、骨骼的狼像人類一樣直立行走，在這附近徘徊。

english: The skeletal wolf is a {@creature deathwolf|VEoR} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) created from the body of a slain Blue Fire Warden. Akaazi ordered the deathwolf to attack any intruders during Teremini's ritual. If it sees the characters, the deathwolf attacks viciously and stops at nothing to destroy its opponents.
zh_tw: 這隻骨骼狼是一隻{@creature deathwolf|VEoR|死亡狼}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}），由一隻被殺死的藍火守衛的身體創造而來。阿卡茲命令死亡狼在特雷米尼的儀式期間攻擊任何入侵者。如果它看到角色們，死亡狼會兇猛地攻擊，並且不擇手段地摧毀它的對手。

english: U3: Black Lunarium
zh_tw: U3: 黑色月長石

english: Two desiccated, undead creatures, each holding a bell jar containing a black rose, stand guard here.
zh_tw: 兩個乾枯的不死生物，每個都手持一個裝有黑玫瑰的鐘形罩，在此守衛。

english: Two {@creature Black Rose Bearer|VEoR|black rose bearers} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) have been ordered to defend this lunarium against intruders.
zh_tw: 兩個{@creature Black Rose Bearer|VEoR|黑玫瑰使者}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）被命令保衛這個月晶石室，抵禦入侵者。

english: U4: Moonbridges
zh_tw: U4: 月橋

english: Three bridges of solid moonlight span the gaps between the lunariums and the moondisk.
zh_tw: 三座由堅固月光構成的橋樑橫跨月晶石室與月亮盤之間的空隙。

english: U5: Moondisk
zh_tw: U5: 月盤

english: A robed, hooded woman stands at the center of a circular platform, her arms stretched wide and her eyes closed. A rod piece floats between her outstretched hands.
zh_tw: 一位穿著長袍、戴著兜帽的女人站在一個圓形平臺的中心，她的雙臂伸展開來，眼睛緊閉。一個法杖部件在她伸出的雙手之間浮動。

english: Teremini (lawful evil, elf {@creature archmage}) performs her ritual here. The {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|fifth piece} of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} floats between Teremini's outstretched hands.
zh_tw: 特雷米尼（守序邪惡，精靈{@creature archmage||大法師}）在這裡進行她的儀式。{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|第五部件}（來自{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}）懸浮在特雷米尼伸出的雙手之間。

english: When Teremini notices the characters approaching, she shouts, "Death to all who oppose Lord Soth! And death to those pitiful wardens! You'll never stop me!"
zh_tw: 當特雷米尼注意到角色們接近時，她大喊：'所有反對索思領主的人都得死！還有那些可憐的守衛者也得死！你們永遠阻止不了我！'

english: If the characters disrupt Teremini's ritual, she screams in rage and attacks them. Teremini pockets the rod piece and fights to the death. For more about the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, see this book's {@area introduction|00e|x}.
zh_tw: 如果角色們打斷了特雷米尼的儀式，她會憤怒地尖叫並攻擊他們。特雷米尼將法杖部件收入口袋，並戰鬥至死。有關{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的更多資訊，請見本書的{@area 簡介|00e|x}。

english: Disrupting the Ritual
zh_tw: 擾亂儀式

english: To retrieve the fifth rod piece, the characters must stop Teremini Nightsedge's ritual to enshroud the Three Moons Vault in magical red moonlight
zh_tw: 為了取回第五個法杖部件，角色們必須阻止特雷米尼·夜刃的儀式，該儀式旨在用魔法紅月光覆蓋三月亮金庫

english: Teremini's ritual is disrupted if either of the following occurs:
zh_tw: 如果出現以下任一情況，特雷米尼的儀式將被打斷：

english: Red moonlight shines on the white crystal, white moonlight shines on the black crystal, and black moonlight shines on the red crystal.
zh_tw: 紅月光照射在白水晶上，白月光照射在黑水晶上，黑月光照射在紅水晶上。

english: A lunar crystal is removed from its pillar. The ensuing chaos after the ritual is disrupted is an ideal time for the characters to seize the rod piece from Teremini, who is distracted as she rallies the vault's forces to fend off the dragon Orinix. If the characters fail to thwart Teremini's ritual, they should fight her elsewhere in the vault so they can retrieve the rod piece.
zh_tw: 如果從柱子上移除一個月晶石。儀式被打斷後的混亂是角色們從分心的特雷米尼手中奪取法杖部件的理想時機，因為她正在召集金庫的力量來抵禦龍奧里尼克斯。如果角色們未能挫敗特雷米尼的儀式，他們應該在金庫的其他地方與她戰鬥，以便取回法杖部件。

english: Ritual Duration
zh_tw: 儀式持續時間

english: The text is intentionally vague about how much time it takes Teremini to complete her ritual. The players should feel that time is of the essence, but not so much that their characters can't afford to retreat and take a long rest if truly necessary.
zh_tw: 文字故意含糊其辭，沒有明確特雷米尼完成儀式需要多少時間。玩家們應該感覺到時間緊迫，但不至於讓他們的角色覺得連撤退並進行長休都不可能，如果真的必要的話。

english: Moonlight Shifts
zh_tw: 月光變化

english: The curtain of crimson moonlight surrounding the Three Moons Vault disappears. Areas of solid moonlight—including the moondisk, moonbridges, and barriers around the lunarium daises—instantly dissolve. Any creature standing on one of these surfaces falls to the courtyard 100 feet below.
zh_tw: 圍繞三月亮金庫的深紅色月光幕簾消失了。所有堅固月光區域——包括月亮盤、月亮橋和月晶石室高臺周圍的屏障——立即溶解。任何站在這些表面上的生物都會墜落到下方100尺的庭院中。

english: Orinix Arrives
zh_tw: 奧里尼克斯到達

english: A portal to Lunitari opens where the moondisk once hovered. Orinix, an {@creature adult lunar dragon|BAM} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) flies from this portal and looms over the courtyard. Displeased at Teremini's failure, the dragon attacks everyone in sight, focusing foremost on Teremini.
zh_tw: 一個月亮盤曾懸停的地方開啟了一扇通往露妮塔瑞的門戶。一隻{@creature adult lunar dragon|BAM|成年月亮龍}（參見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）奧里尼克斯從這扇門戶中飛出，並盤旋在庭院上空。由於對特雷米尼的失敗感到不滿，這隻龍攻擊了視野內的所有人，並首先集中攻擊特雷米尼。

english: Orinix
zh_tw: 奧里尼克斯

english: Next Steps
zh_tw: 下一步

english: Once the characters have the fifth piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, they can return to Sigil via the doorway in the tree through which they arrived on Krynn.
zh_tw: 當角色獲得了{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}後，他們可以透過他們來到克萊恩時穿過的樹中的門戶返回法印城。

english: An enormous, magical tree seems to be the location of the next rod piece, though the characters soon learn the piece is elsewhere.
zh_tw: 一棵巨大的魔法樹似乎是下一個法杖部件的所在地，儘管角色們很快得知部件其實在別處。

english: Chapter 7: Tomb of Wayward Souls
zh_tw: 第7章：迷失靈魂之墓

english: The next rod piece lurks deep in the deadly Tomb of Wayward Souls
zh_tw: 下一個法杖部件隱藏在致命的迷失靈魂墓穴深處

english: Retrieving the sixth piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} leads the characters to a chain of tropical islands on the world of Oerth. There, the party must plumb the depths of a deadly complex called the Tomb of Wayward Souls, which was built to lure in and slay treasure-seekers. This labyrinthine maze of deadly traps was crafted by the diabolical archlich Acererak, who takes perverse pleasure in littering his dungeons with the bones of defeated adventurers.
zh_tw: 獲取第六件{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的碎片將引導角色們前往位於奧斯世界的熱帶島嶼鏈。在那裡，冒險隊伍必須深入名為"迷失靈魂之墓"的致命建築群，這座建築被設計用來引誘並殺死尋寶者。這個充滿致命陷阱的迷宮是由邪惡的巫妖之王阿瑟瑞克打造的，他以此為樂，在迷宮中佈滿了被擊敗的冒險者的遺骸。

english: Running This Chapter
zh_tw: 運作本章

english: This chapter begins after the characters retrieve the fifth piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}. A character who holds that piece instinctively knows that the sixth piece is located on the Isle of Serpents on Oerth, a world known for its legendary dungeons and magical treasures.
zh_tw: 本章開始於角色們獲得{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第五個部分後。持有該部分的角色會本能地知道第六個部分位於奧斯的蛇島，這是一個以其傳奇地下城和魔法寶藏而聞名的世界。

english: The characters arrive on the island in time to witness a battle between a {@creature kraken} and a crew of archaeologists. The archaeologists are in dire straits, and it's up to the characters to decide whether to help. Eventually, the characters realize that the sixth piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} is located in the complex the archaeologists were exploring: the Tomb of Wayward Souls.
zh_tw: 角色們及時抵達島嶼，目睹了一場{@creature kraken||克拉肯}與一隊考古學家之間的戰鬥。考古學家們處境危急，角色們需要決定是否出手相助。最終，角色們意識到，{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第六件碎片正位於考古學家們探索的遺蹟中：迷途靈魂之墓。

english: The archaeologists haven't explored far into the deadly complex, so the characters must face its challenges without much information. The search for the rod piece culminates in a showdown with Rerak, an empowered simulacrum of Acererak.
zh_tw: 考古學家們還沒有深入探索這個致命的建築群，因此角色們必須在資訊不足的情況下面對其挑戰。尋找法杖部件的行動最終以與瑞拉克的對決達到高潮，瑞拉克是阿瑟瑞克的一個增強型幻影。

english: Character Advancement
zh_tw: 角色升級

english: The characters should be 16th level when this chapter begins. The characters gain a level after they retrieve the sixth rod piece from the Tomb of Wayward Souls.
zh_tw: 當這一章節開始時，角色們應該是16級。角色們從迷失靈魂之墓中取回第六根杆件後，將獲得一級。

english: Power of Secrets
zh_tw: 秘密的力量

english: The characters can learn two secrets in this chapter that are applicable to the rules in "{@area The Power of Secrets|028|x}" section in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}:
zh_tw: 角色們可以在這一章中學到兩個秘密，這兩個秘密適用於本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中的"{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}"部分的規則：

english: Marian's Secret
zh_tw: 瑪莉安的秘密

english: Marian Xavere, one of the archaeologists, holds a lifelong fascination with Acererak and the archlich's evil magic, and she was previously tempted to study necromancy. See the "{@area Archaeologist Camp|37b|x}" section later in this chapter for more information.
zh_tw: 考古學家之一瑪莉安·夏維爾（瑪莉安·澤維爾）對阿瑟瑞克（阿瑟瑞克）及這位大巫妖的邪惡魔法終生著迷，她曾一度被誘惑去研究死靈法術。更多資訊請參閱本章稍後的"{@area 考古學家營地|37b|x}"部分。

english: Rerak's Secret
zh_tw: 瑞拉克的秘密

english: The false lich resents his imprisonment in the Tomb of Wayward Souls and never wanted to enact Acererak's will. Rerak is the guardian of the rod piece the characters seek and waits in {@area area T26|3e4|x} of the complex.
zh_tw: 這個假巫妖對他的囚禁在迷途者之墓中感到怨恨，並且從未想要執行阿瑟瑞克的意志。瑞拉克是角色們尋找的法杖部件的守護者，並在建築群的{@area 區域T26|3e4|x}區域等待。

english: Sixth Rod Piece
zh_tw: 第六塊法杖部件

english: The {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|sixth piece} of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} is in {@area area T27|3ea|x} of the Tomb of Wayward Souls. For more information about the rod and the spell this rod piece allows its wielder to cast, see this book's {@area introduction|00e|x}.
zh_tw: {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|第六塊部件}（參見{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}）位於迷途之魂之墓的{@area 區域T27|3ea|x}。有關此杖及此杖節允許持有者施展的法術的更多資訊，請參閱本書的{@area 簡介|00e|x}。

english: Oerth
zh_tw: 奧斯

english: This chapter takes place on Oerth, in the Greyhawk campaign setting. The world is rife with elaborate dungeons, magical treasures, and other fantastical hallmarks of sword and sorcery.
zh_tw: 本章節發生在奧斯，在灰鷹戰役設定中。這個世界充滿了精心設計的地下城、魔法寶藏以及其他劍與魔法的奇幻標誌。

english: Isle of Serpents
zh_tw: 蛇島

english: Characters who research the Isle of Serpents in Sigil can learn the following:
zh_tw: 在法印城研究蛇島的角色可以瞭解到以下資訊：

english: Acererak's Machinations
zh_tw: 阿瑟瑞克的陰謀

english: Long ago, the archlich Acererak visited the Isle of Serpents in his search for precious artifacts. Acererak demolished settlements across the island, stealing treasures and killing indiscriminately. He then built one of his infamous tombs near the coast. The descendants of those who survived Acererak's onslaught remain on the island and are still working to rebuild. Many seek to reclaim the treasures that were stolen from them.
zh_tw: 很久以前，巫妖阿瑟瑞克在尋找珍貴文物的過程中訪問了蛇島。阿瑟瑞克摧毀了島上的定居點，偷竊財寶，並且濫殺無辜。然後他在海岸附近建造了他那臭名昭著的墳墓之一。那些在阿瑟瑞克的襲擊中倖存下來的人的後代仍然在島上，並且仍在努力重建。許多人尋求奪回被從他們那裡偷走的寶藏。

english: Geography
zh_tw: 地理位置

english: The Isle of Serpents is a part of an archipelago known as the Asperdi-Duxchan Chain. The island's temperate climate creates a haven for venomous snakes and poisonous fauna, and its craggy cliffs contain treacherous coastal cave systems.
zh_tw: 蛇島是被稱為阿斯佩爾迪-杜克山群島的一部分。島上的溫帶氣候為有毒蛇類和有毒動物創造了一個避難所，其崎嶇的懸崖包含了危險的沿海洞穴系統。

english: Inhabitants
zh_tw: 居民

english: Popular accounts of the island describe it as unlucky, leading outsiders to avoid it. (The island's inhabitants know this rumor is false, though likely tied to Acererak's long-ago activities, and most families have been here for many generations. The characters learn this when they visit the island.)
zh_tw: 關於這個島的流行說法描述它是不吉利的，導致外來者避開它。（島上的居民知道這個謠言是假的，儘管可能與很久以前的阿瑟瑞克的活動有關，而且大多數家庭已經在這裡生活了許多代。當角色們訪問島嶼時，他們瞭解到這一點。）

english: Legends
zh_tw: 傳說

english: Legends speak of Acererak's infamous Tomb of Horrors, a deadly labyrinth filled with monsters and puzzles. Stories state that the archlich created similar tombs to guard precious magical artifacts. One such tomb is located on the isle.
zh_tw: 傳說中提到阿瑟瑞克臭名昭著的恐怖之墓，這是一個充滿了怪物和謎題的致命迷宮。故事中說，這位巫妖創造了類似的墳墓來守護珍貴的魔法神器。其中一座墳墓就位於這個島上。

english: Down to Oerth
zh_tw: 下降到奧斯

english: When the party steps through the Sigil portal to the Isle of Serpents, they emerge through a ground-level opening in a cliff. The opening overlooks a lagoon, as shown on map 7.1.
zh_tw: 當隊伍透過法印城的傳送門來到蛇島時，他們從懸崖上的一個地面開口出現。這個開口俯瞰著一個瀉湖，如地圖7.1所示。

english: Map 7.1: Isle of Serpents Lagoon
zh_tw: 地圖7.1：蛇島瀉湖

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Kraken Attack!
zh_tw: 克拉肯怪攻擊！

english: The characters arrive in the midst of chaos on the lagoon's beach. Read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 角色們在瀉湖海灘上的混亂中到達。閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: You feel warm sea air as you gaze upon the craggy shore of an island lagoon. Rising from the lagoon's depths are tentacles that lash toward the beach at a group of panicked people dressed in hiking gear.
zh_tw: 當你凝視著島嶼瀉湖崎嶇的海岸時，你感受到了溫暖的海風。從瀉湖深處升起的觸手正向一群穿著徒步裝備、驚慌失措的人群抽打。

english: The tentacles belong to a {@creature kraken} that took damage in an altercation with a hunting boat earlier and has been reduced to 250 hit points. It was lurking off the lagoon's coast when a group of archaeologists stopped here to fish. Hungry and irate, the kraken ambushed the people, who are desperately trying to escape. The kraken is positioned along the easternmost portion of the 100-foot-deep water shown on map 7.1. The archaeologists are scattered throughout the 2-foot-deep water and along the beach.
zh_tw: 這些觸手屬於一隻{@creature kraken||克拉肯}，在早些時候與一艘狩獵船的衝突中受到了傷害，並且生命值減少到了250點。當一群考古學家在這裡停下來釣魚時，它正潛伏在瀉湖海岸附近。飢餓和憤怒的克拉肯怪伏擊了這些人，他們正在拼命試圖逃脫。克拉肯怪位於地圖7.1上顯示的100尺深水域的最東端。考古學家分散在2尺深的水域和海灘上。

english: There are fifteen human and elf archaeologists on the beach. With the exception of Laysa Matulin, Talo Yieria, Vogren Starcloak, and Marian Xavere (who are described in the following sections), the archaeologists use the {@creature commoner} stat block.
zh_tw: 海灘上有十五名人類和精靈考古學家。除了萊莎·馬圖林、塔洛·伊耶里亞、沃格倫·星袍和瑪莉安·澤維爾（他們在以下部分有描述）之外，其他考古學家使用{@creature commoner||平民}的統計資料塊。

english: If the characters join the battle, the {@creature kraken} focuses on them while the archaeologists retreat. If the characters don't join the battle, the kraken gobbles up eight of the archaeologists before sinking into the lagoon, satisfied. Laysa, Talo, Vogren, and Marian are among the survivors.
zh_tw: 如果角色們加入戰鬥，{@creature kraken||克拉肯}會專注於他們，而考古學家則會撤退。如果角色們不加入戰鬥，克拉肯怪會在沉入瀉湖之前吞掉八名考古學家，感到滿足。萊莎、塔洛、沃格倫和瑪莉安是生還者之一。

english: Meeting Laysa Matulin
zh_tw: 遇見萊莎·馬圖林

english: When the kraken is no longer a threat, the leader of the archaeologists approaches the characters.
zh_tw: 當克拉肯怪不再構成威脅時，考古學家的領隊走向角色們。

english: A stout human woman with bronze skin and curly dark hair held back with a colorful scarf runs toward you. Her expression is a mixture of relief and excitement.
zh_tw: 一位身材魁梧的人類女性，擁有青銅色的皮膚和被一條彩色圍巾束起的捲曲黑髮，向你跑來。她的表情是鬆了一口氣和興奮的混合體。

english: Laysa is a chaotic good, human, pirate-turned-archaeologist (use the {@creature assassin} stat block). Descended from the island's original inhabitants, Laysa seeks to reclaim the treasures stolen from her ancestors. She recruited a crew to help her explore the complex where she believes the treasures are held.
zh_tw: 萊莎是一個混亂善良，人類，從海盜轉為考古學家（使用{@creature assassin||刺客}統計資料塊）。作為島上原住民的後代，萊莎尋求奪回從她祖先那裡被偷走的寶藏。她招募了一隊人馬幫助她探索她相信藏有寶藏的複雜區域。

english: Laysa invites the characters to the archaeologists' camp to rest and chat.
zh_tw: 萊莎邀請角色們到考古學家的營地休息和聊天。

english: A kraken attacks people on the Isle of Serpents
zh_tw: 一隻克拉肯怪在蛇島上攻擊人們

english: Archaeologist Camp
zh_tw: 考古學家營地

english: The archaeologists set their camp on the beach to the lagoon's south, where the cliff gives way and allows passage inland. Describe the camp as follows:
zh_tw: 考古學家們在瀉湖南側的海灘上設立了營地，那裡的懸崖退讓，允許通往內陸。按照以下方式描述營地：

english: The tents here sit between the shore and the jungle. Armor and digging equipment lie scattered across the sand. To one side, two men—an elf and an orc—tend to wounded colleagues. They each have a symbol of an arc of seven stars hanging from their necks, and their hands glow with divine magic. On the opposite side of camp, a human woman pores over a spellbook.
zh_tw: 這裡的帳篷位於海岸和叢林之間。盔甲和挖掘裝置散落在沙子上。在一邊，兩個男人——一個精靈和一個獸人——正在照顧受傷的同事。他們每個人的脖子上都掛著一個由七顆星星組成的弧狀符號，他們的手散發著神聖的魔法光芒。在營地的另一邊，一個人類女性正在研究一本咒語書。

english: The archaeologists are investigating the ancient complex in which a piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} waits. The characters can chat with the archaeologists to learn about the complex and ask to borrow magic items to aid their quest.
zh_tw: 考古學家們正在調查一個古老的建築群，其中等待著{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的一部分。角色們可以與考古學家們交談，瞭解建築群的情況，並請求借用魔法物品來幫助他們的任務。

english: Laysa's Goals
zh_tw: 萊莎的目標

english: At camp, Laysa is happy to share what she knows. She volunteers the following information:
zh_tw: 在營地，萊莎很樂意分享她所知道的。她自願提供了以下資訊：

english: Foreign Complex
zh_tw: 外國建築群

english: The complex's architectural style is different than local traditions, so the complex must have been built by an outsider. Based on the complex's defenses, Laysa believes something valuable is held within.
zh_tw: 這個建築群的建築風格與當地的傳統不同，因此它一定是由外來者建造的。根據建築群的防禦措施，萊莎相信裡面藏有寶貴的東西。

english: Laysa Matulin
zh_tw: 萊莎·馬圖林

english: Some Progress
zh_tw: 一些進展

english: Laysa's crew uncovered the complex's entrance, as well as two false entrances laden with traps. The archaeologists haven't been able to explore much more, but they think they've identified how to delve farther into the complex.
zh_tw: 萊莎的團隊發現了建築群的入口，以及兩個佈滿陷阱的假入口。考古學家們還沒有能夠進一步探索，但他們認為他們已經知道如何深入建築群。

english: Stolen Treasures
zh_tw: 被盜的寶藏

english: Long ago, an evil mage with a skeletal appearance demolished Laysa's ancestral village on this island. The mage absconded with several treasures and was never seen again.
zh_tw: 很久以前，一個外表骷髏的邪惡法師摧毀了萊莎在這個島上的祖村。這位法師帶著幾件寶藏逃走了，從此再也沒有人見過他。

english: Laysa is unfamiliar with the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, but she agrees that such a powerful magic item could be found within the complex. She isn't aware of any other location where the rod piece might be.
zh_tw: 萊莎對{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}不太熟悉，但她同意這樣一件強大的魔法物品可能在建築群內被發現。她不知道還有其他任何地方可能藏有法杖的部件。

english: Laysa provides the characters with a rough map of the complex ({@adventure map 7.2|VEoR|7|Map 7.2: Tomb Complex}) and can lead the party to its entrance when they're ready.
zh_tw: 萊莎為角色們提供了一張建築群的粗略地圖（{@adventure 地圖7.2|VEoR|7|Map 7.2: Tomb Complex}），並且當他們準備好時，她可以帶領隊伍到達入口。

english: Stolen Treasures
zh_tw: 被盜的寶藏

english: Laysa hopes to recover six ancestral treasures stolen from her people. Some of these treasures are magic items, although Laysa describes them only as detailed below. The items (and their locations on {@adventure map 7.3|VEoR|7|Map 7.3: Tomb of Wayward Souls}) are as follows:
zh_tw: 萊莎希望找回從她的人民那裡被盜走的六件祖傳寶藏。其中一些寶藏是魔法物品，儘管萊莎只是按照下面的方式描述它們。這些物品（以及它們在{@adventure 地圖 7.3|VEoR|7|Map 7.3: Tomb of Wayward Souls}上的位置）如下：

english: Ebony wand decorated with bones and feathers ({@area area T9|3a7|x})
zh_tw: 裝飾有骨頭和羽毛的烏木魔杖（{@area 區域T9|3a7|x}）

english: Ring of golden stars ({@area area T13|3b5|x})
zh_tw: 金色星星戒指（{@area 區域T13|3b5|x}）

english: Sacred scimitar dedicated to serpent spirits ({@area area T17|3c3|x})
zh_tw: 獻給蛇靈的神聖彎刀（{@area 區域T17|3c3|x}）

english: Set of copper tablets engraved with incantations ({@area area T19|3cc|x})
zh_tw: 刻有咒語的銅板套裝（{@area 區域T19|3cc|x}）

english: Crystal orb used in rituals ({@area area T23|3da|x})
zh_tw: 用於儀式的水晶球（{@area 區域T23|3da|x}）

english: Blue silk sash used in ceremonies ({@area area T27|3ea|x})
zh_tw: 用於儀式的藍色絲質腰帶（{@area 區域T27|3ea|x}）

english: If the characters uncover any of these items from the complex and return them to Laysa, she is ecstatic. For each item returned, Laysa pays the characters five gemstones worth 500 gp apiece. She keeps the gemstones in a pouch that hangs from her belt.
zh_tw: 如果角色們從這個建築群中找到這些物品並將它們帶回給萊莎，她會非常高興。對於每個帶回的物品，萊莎會支付給角色們五顆寶石，每顆價值500金幣。她將寶石放在掛在腰帶上的一個小袋裡。

english: Talo Yieria and Vogren Starcloak, Priests and Healers
zh_tw: 塔洛·伊耶里亞和沃格倫·星袍，牧師和治療者

english: The elf man is Talo Yieria, and the orc man is Vogren Starcloak. Both are neutral good {@creature Priest||priests} of Celestian, the enigmatic deity of stars and wanderers on Oerth. Though apprehensive about exploring the complex, the couple are dear friends to Laysa and support her efforts.
zh_tw: 這位精靈男子是塔洛·伊耶里亞，而這位獸人男子是沃格倫·星袍。兩位都是塞萊斯汀的中立善良{@creature Priest||祭司}，塞萊斯汀是奧斯上的星星和流浪者的神秘神祇。儘管對探索這個建築群感到憂慮，但這對夫婦是萊莎的親密朋友，並支援她的努力。

english: Talo and Vogren are well versed in the religious history of the island. If asked, they provide the following advice:
zh_tw: 塔洛和沃格倫對島上的宗教歷史非常熟悉。如果被問及，他們提供了以下建議：

english: Reciprocity
zh_tw: 互惠

english: Powerful nature spirits reside on the island and don't take kindly to those who would exploit it. No one should take anything without leaving something in return.
zh_tw: 島上居住著強大的自然精靈，它們不喜歡那些想要利用島嶼的人。沒有人應該在不留下任何東西作為回報的情況下拿走任何東西。

english: Respect
zh_tw: 尊重

english: Offerings of money, food, or crafted items show respect to the island's spirits. Acts of kindness can also gain the spirits' favor.
zh_tw: 向島上的精靈提供金錢、食物或手工藝品作為祭品，表示尊重。善行同樣可以獲得精靈的青睞。

english: Should the characters return to the camp partway through exploring the complex, Talo and Vogren offer to use magic to heal them.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在探索建築群的過程中中途返回營地，塔洛和沃格倫願意使用魔法為他們治療。

english: Marian Xavere, Resident Mage
zh_tw: 瑪莉安·澤維爾，常駐法師

english: The human woman poring over a spellbook is the camp's resident arcana expert, Marian Xavere (neutral {@creature mage}). Hailing from the mainland, Marian joined Laysa's crew because of her intense fascination with magical traps and artifacts.
zh_tw: 那位專注研究魔法書的人類女性是營地的常駐奧術專家，瑪莉安·澤維爾（中立{@creature mage||魔法師}）。來自大陸的瑪莉安因為對魔法陷阱和神器的濃厚興趣而加入了萊莎的隊伍。

english: Marian's arcane research led her to study Acererak, and she can tell the characters about the archlich. The characters learn the information about Acererak presented in this chapter and in Acererak's entry in {@area appendix B|555|x}. Marian doesn't realize exactly how dangerous the complex here is.
zh_tw: 瑪莉安的奧術研究引導她研究了阿瑟瑞克，她可以告訴角色們關於這位巫妖的資訊。角色們瞭解到本章以及{@area 附錄 B|555|x}中阿瑟瑞克條目所呈現的關於阿瑟瑞克的資訊。瑪莉安並沒有意識到這裡的建築群有多危險。

english: Magic Items
zh_tw: 魔法物品

english: Marian has a {@item Lantern of Revealing} sitting near her and a {@item Gem of Seeing} strapped to her belt. If asked, she lends the characters the lantern but is hesitant to lend the gem. A character can convince her to lend them the {@item Gem of Seeing} by succeeding on a {@dc 18} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check.
zh_tw: 瑪莉安身邊放著一盞{@item Lantern of Revealing||顯像提燈}，腰間掛著一顆{@item Gem of Seeing||真視寶石}。如果被請求，她會借給角色們那盞燈，但對於借出寶石則猶豫不決。角色可以透過一次{@dc 18}魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定成功說服她借出{@item Gem of Seeing||真視寶石}。

english: Marian's Secret
zh_tw: 瑪莉安的秘密

english: When the characters speak at length with Marian, they notice the mage speaks enthusiastically, but somewhat guiltily, about Acererak. If the characters remark on or ask about this, Marian admits that she once admired the archlich and even considered studying necromancy. When Marian realized the great evil involved, though, she eschewed this grim path.
zh_tw: 當角色們與瑪莉安長時間交談時，他們注意到這位法師在談論阿瑟瑞克時表現得非常熱情，但有些內疚。如果角色們評論或詢問這一點，瑪莉安承認她曾經欽佩這位巫妖，甚至考慮過學習死靈術。然而，當瑪莉安意識到其中涉及的巨大邪惡時，她放棄了這條黑暗的道路。

english: Regardless of the characters' reaction to this revelation, learning it counts as a secret for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
zh_tw: 無論角色們對這個揭示有何反應，瞭解它都算作本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則的秘密。

english: Map 7.2: Tomb Complex
zh_tw: 地圖7.2：墓穴建築群

english: Into the Tomb
zh_tw: 進入墓穴

english: After devastating the island's native villages, Acererak constructed one of his tombs here. Though outsiders rarely visited the Isle of Serpents, whispers of an island complex laden with treasures spread across Oerth. Over time, this complex became known as the Tomb of Wayward Souls, since explorers would venture inside only to die.
zh_tw: 在摧毀了島嶼上的原住民村莊後，阿瑟瑞克在這裡建造了他的一個墳墓。儘管外來者很少訪問蛇島，但關於一個充滿寶藏的島嶼建築群的傳言在奧斯上傳播開來。隨著時間的推移，這個建築群被稱為迷路者之墓，因為探險者們進入後只有死路一條。

english: Laysa and her crew made some progress exploring the complex, demarking the false entrances and traps. The complex's entrance is about 1 mile from the archaeologists' camp.
zh_tw: 萊莎和她的團隊在探索建築群方面取得了一些進展，標記了假入口和陷阱。建築群的入口距離考古學家的營地大約1英里。

english: Features of the Tomb
zh_tw: 墳墓的特徵

english: Unless otherwise stated, the areas of the complex have the following features.
zh_tw: 除非另有說明，建築群的區域具有以下特點。

english: Ceilings, Doors, Floors, and Walls
zh_tw: 天花板、門、地板和牆壁

english: The ceilings, floors, and walls of the complex are constructed from limestone. Chamber ceilings are 20 feet high, while hallway ceilings are 10 feet high. Doors are wooden and unlocked unless otherwise specified; some must be opened by special means. The complex's walls are immune to any spell or magical effect that would change their shape, such as a {@spell Passwall} or {@spell Stone Shape} spell.
zh_tw: 建築群的天花板、地板和牆壁都是由石灰石建造的。房間的天花板高20尺，而走廊的天花板高10尺。門是木製的，除非另有說明，否則都是未上鎖的；有些門需要透過特殊方式開啟。建築群的牆壁對任何會改變其形狀的法術或魔法效果免疫，例如{@spell Passwall||穿牆術}或{@spell Stone Shape||塑石術}法術。

english: Hidden Doors
zh_tw: 隱藏門

english: Illusion magic conceals many of the complex's doors, making them look like solid walls. These hidden doors are detectable by touch, and creatures with {@sense truesight} see the doors as if they weren't hidden. Casting {@spell Dispel Magic} on a hidden door permanently removes the magic concealing it. A hidden door is otherwise identical to other doors in the complex. Locations of hidden doors are marked on {@adventure map 7.3|VEoR|7|Map 7.3: Tomb of Wayward Souls}.
zh_tw: 幻象魔法隱藏了建築群中的許多門，使它們看起來像是實心牆。這些隱藏門可以透過觸控來探測，擁有{@sense truesight||真實視覺}能力的生物可以看到門，就好像它們沒有被隱藏一樣。對隱藏門施放{@spell Dispel Magic||解除魔法}法術可以永久移除隱藏它的魔法。除此之外，隱藏門與建築群中的其他門沒有區別。隱藏門的位置在{@adventure 地圖 7.3|VEoR|7|Map 7.3: Tomb of Wayward Souls}上標記。

english: Lighting
zh_tw: 光照

english: The interior of the complex is brightly lit by crystal sconces holding eerie green flames. The flames can't be extinguished by any means.
zh_tw: 建築群的內部由水晶壁燈照亮，壁燈中持有一種怪異的綠色火焰。這些火焰無法透過任何方式熄滅。

english: Planar Trammels
zh_tw: 位面牽引

english: When a creature within the complex casts a spell or uses an effect that would transport itself or another creature to a different plane (such as casting {@spell Astral Projection}, {@spell Banishment}, {@spell Etherealness}, or {@spell Plane Shift}), the spell slot and components, item charges, or other resources are expended as normal, but nothing happens.
zh_tw: 當建築群內的生物施放法術或使用效果，以將自己或另一個生物傳送到另一個位面時（例如施放{@spell Astral Projection||星界投影}、{@spell Banishment||放逐術}、{@spell Etherealness||以太化}或{@spell Plane Shift||位面轉移}），法術位和材料、物品充能或其他資源會正常消耗，但什麼都不會發生。

english: The Rod Piece and Its Guardian
zh_tw: 法杖碎片及其守護者

english: The sixth piece of the rod can be found in {@area area T27|3ea|x}. The piece is guarded by Rerak, an empowered simulacrum of Acererak designed to harvest souls for the archlich. When an adventurer dies in the complex, Rerak traps their soul using foul magic and shunts it to the gems embedded in the false lich's eyes. The souls remain in the false lich's eyes for 24 hours, after which the souls are transferred to Acererak and are trapped forever. Rerak also resets traps that adventurers have triggered in the complex.
zh_tw: 法杖的第六部分可以在{@area 區域T27|3ea|x}找到。這部分由瑞拉克守護，瑞拉克是為阿瑟瑞克設計的強化模擬像，旨在為這位大巫妖收集靈魂。當冒險者在建築群中死亡時，瑞拉克使用邪惡的魔法捕捉他們的靈魂，並將它們轉移到假巫妖眼睛中嵌入的寶石裡。靈魂在假巫妖的眼睛中保持24小時，之後靈魂被轉移到阿瑟瑞克那裡，並永遠被困住。瑞拉克還會重置冒險者在建築群中觸發的陷阱。

english: A long time has passed since the archlich created Rerak. The simulacrum is torn between dutifully fulfilling Acererak's will and resenting the archlich for imprisoning him within this complex. Retrieving the rod piece requires confronting Rerak in his crypt, though the characters can recover the piece without fighting the simulacrum. For more information about confronting Rerak, see {@area area T26|3e4|x}.
zh_tw: 自從巫妖創造了瑞拉克以來，已經過去了很長時間。這個模擬像在忠誠地完成阿瑟瑞克的意志和因被囚禁在這個建築群中而怨恨巫妖之間掙扎。取回法杖部件需要在它的墓穴中面對瑞拉克，儘管角色們可以在不與模擬像戰鬥的情況下恢復部件。有關面對瑞拉克的更多資訊，請參見{@area 區域T26|3e4|x}。

english: Corrupted Mirages
zh_tw: 腐化的幻象

english: Rerak's resentment, intermingled with the magic of the rod piece, causes strange mirages to appear throughout the complex. These mirages are described where they're encountered (see {@area areas T9|3a7|x}, {@area T13|3b5|x}, {@area T21|3d3|x}, and {@area T24|3de|x}).
zh_tw: 瑞拉克的怨恨與法杖部分的魔法交織在一起，導致整個建築群中出現了奇怪的幻象。這些幻象在遇到的地方有描述（見{@area 區域T9|3a7|x}, {@area T13|3b5|x}, {@area T21|3d3|x}, 和 {@area T24|3de|x}）。

english: Tomb Locations
zh_tw: 墳墓位置

english: The areas of the tomb are keyed to map 7.3.
zh_tw: 墓穴的區域對應於地圖7.3。

english: Map 7.3: Tomb of Wayward Souls
zh_tw: 地圖 7.3: 迷路者之墓

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: T1: False Entrance
zh_tw: T1: 假入口

english: This wide corridor ends at two stone doors with metal handles. At the entrance, the archaeologists posted symbols for "danger" and "fire."
zh_tw: 這條寬闊的走廊在兩扇帶有金屬把手的石門前結束。在入口處，考古學家貼上了"危險"和"火"的標記。

english: The doors at the end of the corridor are fake and can't be opened. Behind them is a solid wall.
zh_tw: 走廊盡頭的門是假門，無法開啟。門後面是一堵實牆。

english: Explosion Trap
zh_tw: 爆炸陷阱

english: A creature that steps inside the corridor triggers a trap. When the creature touches the corridor floor, the floor tiles depress, and a slab of stone lodged in the ceiling lowers to the ground, sealing the corridor before flooding it with magical fire. Each creature inside the closed-off corridor must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 ({@dice 8d6}) fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 當一個生物踏入走廊時會觸發陷阱。當該生物接觸到走廊地板時，地板磚會下陷，天花板上的一塊石頭會降落到地面，封鎖走廊並隨後用魔法火焰將其淹沒。每個被困在封閉走廊內的生物都必須進行一次 {@dc 20} 敏捷豁免檢定，豁免失敗則會受到28點（{@dice 8d6}）火焰傷害，成功則只受到一半傷害。

english: The stone slab seals off the corridor until the next dawn, when the slab rises into its ceiling cavity and the trap resets. In the meantime, a creature can use an action to try to lift the slab, creating a passable opening with a successful {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 石板將走廊封鎖，直到下一個黎明，此時石板會升起至天花板凹槽中，陷阱重置。在此期間，生物可以使用一個動作嘗試抬起石板，成功透過 {@dc 18} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定即可創造一個可透過的開口。

english: T2: False Entrance
zh_tw: T2: 假入口

english: Strange pockmarks line the walls of this corridor, at the end of which is a set of dark wooden doors.
zh_tw: 這條走廊的牆壁上佈滿了奇怪的凹坑，走廊的盡頭是一扇深色木門。

english: Arrow Trap
zh_tw: 箭矢陷阱

english: Spring-loaded arrows are hidden in the pockmarked walls. A creature that enters the trapped area marked on map 7.3 for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there triggers a fusillade of arrows and must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 ({@dice 6d8}) piercing damage from the arrows on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The 5-foot-wide area along the east wall is outside the trap's area and safe to stand in.
zh_tw: 彈簧箭隱藏在佈滿凹坑的牆壁中。當生物在一個回合中首次進入地圖7.3上標記的陷阱區域或在該區域結束其回合時，將觸發一陣箭雨，並且必須進行一次{@dc 20}敏捷豁免，如果豁免失敗，將受到27點（{@dice 6d8}）穿刺傷害，如果豁免成功，則只受到一半傷害。東牆沿線的5尺寬區域在陷阱範圍之外，站在那裡是安全的。

english: Doors' Secret
zh_tw: 門的秘密

english: The doors at the end of the hallway are fake and can't be opened. Tiny text is scrawled on the doors' front:
zh_tw: 走廊盡頭的門是假門，無法開啟。門的正面潦草地寫著微小的文字：

english: "Acererak commends you! Alas, these doors lead nowhere, but your skill shall not go unrewarded. Should you wish to plumb the depths of my tomb, heed these words: the blue one craves your magic."
zh_tw: "阿瑟瑞克讚賞你！唉，這些門通向無處，但你的技能不會白費。如果你想探索我的墳墓深處，請聽這些話：藍色那個渴望你的魔法。"

english: This is a clue for opening the door in {@area area T4|396|x}.
zh_tw: 這是開啟{@area 區域T4|396|x}中門的線索。

english: T3: Tomb Entrance
zh_tw: T3: 墓穴入口

english: This hallway has been partially excavated. Lifted stone lids reveal a ten-foot-deep pit filled with spikes in the center of the corridor. A thin plank of wood is laid over the pit to allow for safe crossing.
zh_tw: 這條走廊已經被部分挖掘出來。提起的石蓋板露出了走廊中心一個十尺深、裡面佈滿尖刺的坑。一根細木板搭在坑上，以便於安全透過。

english: Characters can use the wooden plank to cross the pit safely. A creature that falls into the pit takes 5 ({@dice 1d10}) piercing damage from the spikes, which turn the floor of the pit into {@book difficult terrain|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}.
zh_tw: 角色可以使用木板安全地穿過深坑。任何掉入深坑的生物會受到5（{@dice 1d10}）點穿刺傷害，因為深坑底部佈滿了尖刺，使得深坑的底部變成了{@book 困難地形|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}。

english: At the bottom of the pit, situated in the middle of its northeast wall, is a hidden door that leads to {@area area T5|39a|x}.
zh_tw: 在坑的底部，位於其東北牆的中間，有一個隱藏的門，通向{@area 區域T5|39a|x}。

english: T4: Face of the Great Blue Devil
zh_tw: T4: 巨大藍魔的面孔

english: A relief of a scowling, fiendish face made of azure mosaic tiles spans the hallway's back wall. The face's mouth is open, revealing a black maw, and its eyes are carved from clouded white crystal. To the right of the mosaic is a closed door.
zh_tw: 一幅由天藍色馬賽克瓷磚製成的怒目惡魔面孔的浮雕橫跨走廊的後牆。這張臉的嘴巴張開，露出一個黑色的咽喉，眼睛由帶雲紋的白色水晶雕刻而成。馬賽克的右側是一扇關閉的門。

english: A character who examines the relief with a {@spell Detect Magic} spell or similar magic finds that the relief's mouth radiates conjuration magic and its eyes radiate abjuration magic.
zh_tw: 使用{@spell Detect Magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似魔法檢查浮雕的角色會發現，浮雕的嘴巴散發出召喚魔法，而它的眼睛散發出防護魔法。

english: Mouth Portal
zh_tw: 口部傳送門

english: The relief's mouth is 10 feet wide and several feet tall. Objects and creatures that enter the relief's mouth are teleported to {@area area T14|3ba|x}.
zh_tw: 浮雕的嘴巴寬10尺，高數尺。進入浮雕嘴巴的物體和生物會被傳送到{@area 區域T14|3ba|x}。

english: Opening the Devil's Door
zh_tw: 開啟惡魔之門

english: The relief is the key to opening the door to {@area area T6|39e|x}. The door can be opened in no other way.
zh_tw: 浮雕是開啟通向{@area 區域T6|39e|x}的門的關鍵。除此之外，門無法以其他方式開啟。

english: When a creature standing within 5 feet of the relief casts a spell using a spell slot, the spell slot is expended as normal, but the spell has no effect. Instead, the magic is absorbed by the relief, filling it with a number of charges equal to the level of spell slot expended and causing the relief's eyes to glow green. Once the relief has absorbed 6 or more charges, the door opens. The door closes on its own after 10 minutes unless it is held or wedged open. When the door closes, the relief's eyes stop glowing, and opening the door again from this area requires the expenditure of more spell slots. The door can be opened from the east side like any normal door.
zh_tw: 當一個生物站在浮雕5尺範圍內使用法術位施法時，法術位會正常消耗，但法術沒有效果。相反，魔法被浮雕吸收，根據消耗的法術位等級，為浮雕填充相應數量的電荷，並使浮雕的眼睛發出綠色光芒。一旦浮雕吸收了6個或更多的電荷，門就會開啟。除非被固定或楔住，否則門會在10分鐘後自動關閉。當門關閉時，浮雕的眼睛停止發光，並且從這個區域再次開啟門需要消耗更多的法術位。門可以從東側像任何普通門一樣開啟。

english: T5: Cave of Seven Casks
zh_tw: T5: 七個桶的洞穴

english: A cryptic message written in Celestial provides clues about how to use the seven casks in a nearby cave
zh_tw: 一條用天界語寫的神秘資訊提供了關於如何在附近洞穴中使用七個酒桶的線索

english: Crooked wooden planks line the floor of this cave. Seven casks are embedded along one wall. Each cask has a different symbol painted on it, with a spigot beneath it. Cups and tankards line shelves on the opposite wall.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴的地板上鋪著彎曲的木板。七隻桶沿著一面牆嵌入。每個桶上都畫著不同的符號，下面有一個龍頭。杯子和酒壺排列在對面的架子上。

english: A character who studies the shelves notices a repeating message carved in Celestial along the shelves' edges:
zh_tw: 一個研究書架的角色注意到在書架邊緣用天界語雕刻著一條重複的資訊：

english: "A septet of libations I present to you,
zh_tw: "我向你們呈現七種飲料，"

english: But only one will help you escape this tomb.
zh_tw: 但只有一個能幫助你逃離這座墳墓。

english: Six drinks are magic; one is mundane.
zh_tw: 六種飲料是魔法的；一種是普通的。

english: Those marked with stars are vitality's bane.
zh_tw: 那些帶有星星標記的是生命力的禍根。

english: Blue is neither blessing nor curse.
zh_tw: 藍色既不是祝福也不是詛咒。

english: Moon cleanses you of illness or worse.
zh_tw: 月亮淨化你，驅除疾病或更糟糕的狀況。

english: Green's neighbor is never boring—
zh_tw: 格林的鄰居從不無聊—

english: Drink deep; pass through the flooring."
zh_tw: 深飲之；穿過地板。

english: The message gives clues as to the casks' contents.
zh_tw: 這條資訊提供了關於酒桶內容物的線索。

english: Each cask contains 20 pints of liquor. In order from left to right, the casks are marked with the following symbols:
zh_tw: 每個木桶裝有20品脫的酒。從左到右，木桶上標記有以下符號：

english: Green Star
zh_tw: 綠星

english: The liquor in this cask is infused with necromantic magic. A creature that drinks any amount of the liquor must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw, taking 22 ({@dice 5d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 這桶酒中注入了死靈魔法。任何飲用了這酒的生命體都必須進行一次 {@dc 20} 的體質豁免，若豁免失敗會受到 22 ({@dice 5d8}) 點死靈傷害，若豁免成功則傷害減半。

english: Blue Square
zh_tw: 藍色方塊

english: A creature that drinks a pint or more of the liquor in this cask gains the benefit of a {@item Potion of Diminution}. A character reduced to Tiny size by the liquor can't fit through the narrow gaps between the floorboards (see the "Tunnel to Area T8" section for more information).
zh_tw: 生物如果飲用了這個木桶中的酒一品脫或更多，將獲得{@item Potion of Diminution||縮小藥水}的效果。被酒縮小到微型尺寸的角色無法透過地板縫隙的狹窄間隙（詳見"通往區域T8的隧道"部分以獲取更多資訊）。

english: Green Crescent Moon
zh_tw: 綠月牙

english: A creature that drinks a pint or more of the liquor in this cask gains the benefit of an {@item Elixir of Health}.
zh_tw: 喝下這個酒桶中酒液一品脫或更多的生物將獲得{@item Elixir of Health||健康靈藥}的效果。

english: Red Square
zh_tw: 紅色方塊

english: A creature that drinks a pint or more of the liquor in this cask gains the benefit of a {@item Potion of Gaseous Form}. A character in gaseous form can easily pass through the narrow gaps between the floorboards (see "Tunnel to Area T8" below).
zh_tw: 喝下這個桶裡一品脫或更多酒精飲料的生物將獲得{@item Potion of Gaseous Form||氣化形體藥水}的效果。處於氣態形態的角色可以輕鬆地透過地板縫隙中的狹窄間隙（見下文的"通往區域T8的隧道"）。

english: Blue Circle
zh_tw: 藍色圓圈

english: A creature that drinks a pint or more of the liquor in this cask gains the benefit of a {@item Potion of Growth}.
zh_tw: 喝下這桶酒中一品脫或更多量的生物將獲得{@item Potion of Growth||成長藥水}的效果。

english: Green Circle
zh_tw: 綠色圓圈

english: The liquor is this cask is not magical, but it is toxic. A creature that drinks any amount of the liquor must succeed on a {@dc 25} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition poisoned} condition for 1 hour.
zh_tw: 這個木桶中的酒並非魔法酒，而是有毒的。任何生物只要飲用了這種酒，必須成功透過一次 {@dc 25} 的體質豁免檢定，否則將獲得 {@condition poisoned||中毒} 狀態，持續1小時。

english: Red Star
zh_tw: 紅色星星

english: The liquor in this cask acts as a magical paralytic. Upon drinking any amount from this cask, a creature must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition paralyzed} condition for 1 hour.
zh_tw: 這個酒桶中的酒具有魔法麻痺效果。當一個生物飲下這個酒桶中的任何量後，它必須成功透過一個 {@dc 20} 體質豁免檢定，否則將獲得 {@condition paralyzed||麻痺} 狀態，持續1小時。

english: Liquor removed from this cave immediately loses its magical properties. Removing a cask from this room causes the liquor within the cask to evaporate.
zh_tw: 從這個洞穴中移走的酒立即失去其魔法屬性。從這個房間中移走酒桶會導致桶內的酒蒸發。

english: Tunnel to Area T8
zh_tw: 通往區域 T8 的隧道

english: Characters who examine the floor can see an empty basement through the 1-inch cracks between the floorboards. The basement has a tunnel exiting to the east, toward {@area area T8|3a4|x}. The easiest way to reach this tunnel is to drink from the cask marked with the red square to adopt a cloudlike form. The floorboards are otherwise immovable and immune to all damage.
zh_tw: 角色如果檢查地板，可以透過地板板之間1吋的裂縫看到一個空的地下室。地下室有一條向東通往{@area 區域T8|3a4|x}的隧道。到達這條隧道最簡便的方法是飲用標有紅色方塊的木桶中的酒，以採取雲霧形態。否則，地板板是不可移動的，並且對所有傷害免疫。

english: If the characters have trouble solving the puzzle, any character who walks across the floorboards realizes that the only way past this room is through the thin gaps between the floorboards. If the characters still struggle, allow them to make a {@dc 12} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check to determine that the magical liquor in one or more of the casks might facilitate travel through the cracks between the floorboards.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在解謎時遇到困難，任何走過地板的角色都會意識到，穿過這個房間的唯一方法是透過地板之間的狹窄縫隙。如果角色們仍然難以解決，允許他們進行一次 {@dc 12} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定，以確定一個或多個酒桶中的魔法酒可能有助於透過地板之間的裂縫進行移動。

english: T6: Hall of Gemstones
zh_tw: T6: 寶石大廳

english: Rows of colorful jewels line this corridor's walls. At the east end stands an emerald-colored statue of a crashing wave, the words "This wave is green" carved into its base. A door is set in the corridor's south wall.
zh_tw: 這條走廊的牆壁上排列著一排彩色寶石。在東端，矗立著一座翡翠色的雕像，雕刻著一個破碎的波浪，其底座上刻有"這個波浪是綠色的"字樣。走廊的南牆上有一扇門。

english: Close inspection of the statue uncovers a divot in the statue's base big enough to hold one jewel.
zh_tw: 仔細檢查雕像會發現雕像底座上有一個凹槽，大小足以容納一顆寶石。

english: Gemstone Puzzle
zh_tw: 寶石謎題

english: All the jewels embedded in the walls are made of worthless crystal except for one: an emerald worth 1,000 gp. A character who spends at least 1 minute examining the jewels spots the emerald with a successful {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check. Prying the emerald from its wall socket is easily done. Placing the emerald in the statue opens the door sealing off the passage to {@area area T16|3c0|x}. The door resists all other attempts to open it. Once opened, however, it ceases to be locked and can thereafter be opened and closed without the emerald.
zh_tw: 除了一個價值1000金幣的祖母綠外，牆上鑲嵌的所有寶石都是由無價值的水晶製成的。一名角色如果至少花費1分鐘時間檢查這些寶石，並透過一次成功的{@dc 20}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，就能發現這顆祖母綠。將祖母綠從牆上的插座中撬出來是很容易的。將祖母綠放入雕像中會開啟通往{@area 區域T16|3c0|x}的通道的密封門。這扇門抵抗所有其他開啟它的嘗試。然而，一旦開啟，它將不再鎖上，此後無需祖母綠即可開啟和關閉。

english: A character who succeeds on a {@dc 16} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check recalls that emeralds are used to contain water elementals.
zh_tw: 一個角色如果成功透過 {@dc 16} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定，會回憶起翡翠被用來封印水元素。

english: Whenever a creature touches one of the other jewels embedded in the walls, the statue glows and launches a blast of freezing magic down the hallway in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 33 ({@dice 6d10}) cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 每當一個生物觸碰到嵌在牆上的其他寶石之一時，雕像就會發光，並沿著走廊發射一道30尺長、5尺寬的冷凍魔法。在該區域內的每個生物必須進行一次{@dc 20}敏捷豁免，豁免失敗則受到33（{@dice 6d10}）點寒冷傷害，豁免成功則只受到一半傷害。

english: T7: Skeleton Closet
zh_tw: T7: 骷髏壁櫥

english: A moldering skeleton draped in cobwebs sits in one corner of this small room. A gold choker set with a large black stone hangs around the skeleton's neck.
zh_tw: 這個小房間的一個角落裡，有一具被蛛網覆蓋的腐爛骷髏。骷髏的脖子上掛著一條鑲有一塊大黑寶石的金項鍊。

english: If examined with a {@spell Detect Magic} spell or similar effect, the necklace radiates an aura of necromancy magic.
zh_tw: 如果使用{@spell Detect Magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似效果進行檢測，這個項鍊散發出死靈魔法的氣息。

english: Necklace Trap
zh_tw: 項鍊陷阱

english: The first time a creature touches the necklace, it releases a burst of deathly energy in a 5-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw, taking 36 ({@dice 8d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 當一個生物第一次觸控這條項鍊時，它會在5尺半徑的球形範圍內釋放出一股死亡能量。該區域內的每個生物都必須進行一次{@dc 22}體質豁免檢定，失敗則受到36（{@dice 8d8}）點暗影傷害，成功則受到一半的傷害。

english: Once the trap has been triggered, the necklace becomes a mundane choker worth 1,200 gp.
zh_tw: 一旦陷阱被觸發，這條項鍊就變成了一條普通的項圈，價值1200金幣。

english: T8: Room of Myriad Archways
zh_tw: T8: 千門之室

english: Each wall of this octagonal room contains a stone archway. A veil of white fog fills the room.
zh_tw: 這個八邊形房間的每一面牆上都有一個石拱門。一層白色的霧氣瀰漫在房間內。

english: The fog is magical and can't be cleared or dispelled.
zh_tw: 霧是魔法造成的，無法清除或驅散。

english: Archways
zh_tw: 拱道

english: The archways lead to the following destinations:
zh_tw: 這些拱門通向以下目的地：

english: North Archway
zh_tw: 北拱門

english: Any creature or object that enters this one-way portal is teleported to {@area area T3|394|x}, appearing at the southwest end of the corridor or the nearest unoccupied space.
zh_tw: 任何生物或物體進入這個單向傳送門都會被傳送到{@area 區域T3|394|x}，在走廊的西南端或最近的未被佔據的空間出現。

english: Northeast Archway
zh_tw: 東北拱道

english: This archway connects to {@area area T11|3af|x}. The tunnel leading there is made of smooth, gray stone.
zh_tw: 這個拱門連線到{@area 區域T11|3af|x}。通往那裡的隧道由光滑的灰色石頭製成。

english: East Archway
zh_tw: 東拱門

english: Any creature or object that enters this one-way portal is teleported to an unoccupied space in {@area area T20a|3d0|x}. If there's not enough space in that location for the creature or object, it is unable to pass through the portal and is rebuffed instead.
zh_tw: 任何生物或物體進入這個單向傳送門都會被傳送到{@area 區域T20a|3d0|x}的一個未被佔據的空間。如果那個位置沒有足夠的空間容納該生物或物體，它將無法透過傳送門，而是會被彈回。

english: Southeast Archway
zh_tw: 東南拱門

english: This archway connects to area T7 via a hidden doorway. The tunnel beyond the archway is made of obsidian and covered in cobwebs.
zh_tw: 這個拱門透過一個隱藏的門道連線到區域T7。拱門後面的隧道由黑曜石製成，覆蓋著蜘蛛網。

english: South Archway
zh_tw: 南拱道

english: Any creature or object that enters this one-way portal is teleported to a random unoccupied space in {@area area T14|3ba|x}.
zh_tw: 任何生物或物體進入這個單向傳送門，都會被傳送到{@area 區域T14|3ba|x}中的一個隨機空閒空間。

english: Southwest Archway
zh_tw: 西南拱門

english: This archway connects to a basement under the floorboards of {@area area T5|39a|x} via a dirt tunnel.
zh_tw: 這個拱門透過一個土隧道連線到{@area 區域T5|39a|x}地板下的地下室。

english: West Archway
zh_tw: 西拱道

english: Any creature or object that enters this one-way portal is teleported to an unoccupied space in {@area area T20b|3d0|x}. If there's not enough space in that location for the creature or object, it is unable to pass through the portal and is rebuffed instead.
zh_tw: 任何生物或物體進入這個單向傳送門，都會被傳送到{@area 區域T20b|3d0|x}中的一個空閒空間。如果那個位置的空間不足以容納該生物或物體，它將無法透過傳送門，而是會被推回。

english: Northwest Archway
zh_tw: 西北拱門

english: This archway connects to area T9. The tunnel leading there is covered with moss.
zh_tw: 這個拱道連線到區域 T9。通往那裡的隧道覆蓋著苔蘚。

english: T9: Forest of Spirits Mirage
zh_tw: T9: 靈魂森林的幻象

english: You arrive at an expansive glade of trees. Bobbing lights flit between the branches, and at the center of the glade stands a towering banyan tree wrapped in sickly looking vines. A path winds through the glade but disappears when you try to focus closely on it.
zh_tw: 你來到了一片廣闊的樹林空地。搖曳的燈光在樹枝間穿梭，空地中心矗立著一棵高聳的榕樹，被病態的藤蔓纏繞。一條小徑蜿蜒穿過空地，但當你試圖仔細觀察時，它就消失了。

english: The banyan tree is a neutral {@creature treant} named Abalahin. Abalahin is real, while the rest of the forest is a mirage. The mirage is tactile, so creatures can interact with it.
zh_tw: 榕樹是一棵中立的{@creature treant||樹人}，名叫阿巴拉欣。阿巴拉欣是真實的，而其餘的森林則是幻象。這個幻象是有觸感的，所以生物可以與之互動。

english: Piercing the Illusion
zh_tw: 穿透幻象

english: The mirage is linked to Abalahin's existence. If Abalahin is killed, the mirage ends, revealing the room to be a stone chamber containing Abalahin's remains.
zh_tw: 這個海市蜃樓與阿巴拉欣的存在相關聯。如果阿巴拉欣被殺死，海市蜃樓就會結束，揭示這個房間實際上是一個包含阿巴拉欣遺骸的石室。

english: Befriending Abalahin
zh_tw: 與阿巴拉欣結友

english: Abalahin is covered with strangling vines that render the treant sluggish and distant. A {@spell Remove Curse} spell or similar effect causes the blighted vines around Abalahin to dissolve. Once the vines are gone, Abalahin is grateful to the characters and, in return, suppresses the mirage, revealing the room's exits.
zh_tw: 阿巴拉欣被扼殺藤蔓覆蓋，這使得樹精行動遲緩，反應遲鈍。使用一個{@spell Remove Curse||移除詛咒}法術或類似的效果可以使圍繞阿巴拉欣的枯萎藤蔓溶解。一旦藤蔓消失，阿巴拉欣對角色們表示感激，作為回報，它壓制了幻象，揭示了房間的出口。

english: Bobbing Spirit Lights
zh_tw: 飄動的靈光

english: There are {@dice 1d8} bobbing spirit lights (each uses the {@creature will-o'-wisp} stat block and speaks Common and Sylvan) that fill the illusory glade at any given time. The spirit lights are part of the mirage, are indifferent to the characters' presence, and disappear if attacked. Any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 17 or higher discerns the spirit lights whispering and overhears one of the following remarks:
zh_tw: 在任何給定時間，有{@dice 1d8}個浮動的靈光（每個使用{@creature will-o'-wisp||鬼火}的統計資料塊，並且會說通用語和森林語）充滿了這個虛幻的空地。這些靈光是海市蜃樓的一部分，對角色們的存在漠不關心，如果被攻擊就會消失。任何被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分為17或更高的角色能夠辨別出靈光在低語，並無意中聽到以下評論之一：

english: +3 Wand of the War Mage
zh_tw: +3 戰法師魔杖

english: "The next challenge is crushing—move fast!"
zh_tw: "下一個挑戰是壓碎——動作要快！"

english: "The master of this tomb longs to be free. Wouldn't you, if you were he?"
zh_tw: "這座墳墓的主人渴望自由。如果你是他，你不會嗎？"

english: "Steal not from the library, for it holds trouble."
zh_tw: "不要從圖書館偷竊，因為它藏有麻煩。"

english: "Illusions are we, born from a mix of wanderlust and corrupted magic. Many more can you find in this forgotten place."
zh_tw: "我們是幻象，源於漫遊欲和腐敗魔法的混合。在這個被遺忘的地方，你可以找到更多。"

english: "The jade serpents crave offerings."
zh_tw: "玉蛇渴望祭品。"

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Close inspection of Abalahin's roots reveals an ebony wand decorated with bones and feathers (a {@item +3 Wand of the War Mage}). A character who succeeds on a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check can convince Abalahin to relinquish the wand voluntarily. The wand can also be removed without attracting Abalahin's notice by a character who succeeds on a {@dc 25} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. The wand is one of the treasures Laysa mentioned earlier in this chapter.
zh_tw: 仔細檢查阿巴拉欣的根部，會發現一根裝飾著骨頭和羽毛的黑檀木魔杖（一個 {@item +3 Wand of the War Mage||+3 戰法師魔杖}）。一個在 {@dc 15} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定中成功的角色可以說服阿巴拉欣自願交出魔杖。魔杖也可以由在 {@dc 25} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定中成功的角色在不引起阿巴拉欣注意的情況下取走。這根魔杖是萊莎在本章早些時候提到的寶藏之一。

english: Abalahin is hostile toward creatures it catches trying to steal the wand. Once the treant has been defeated, the wand can easily be retrieved.
zh_tw: 阿巴拉欣對試圖偷走魔杖的生物表現出敵意。一旦這棵樹精被擊敗，魔杖就可以輕易地被取回。

english: T10: Crushing Room Trap
zh_tw: T10: 壓碎房間陷阱

english: This room appears to be empty. When one or more characters enter the room, read the following:
zh_tw: 這個房間看起來是空的。當一個或多個角色進入房間時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: A click sounds from above. The room's ceiling begins descending rapidly.
zh_tw: 上方傳來一聲點選聲。房間的天花板開始迅速下降。

english: The 20-foot-high ceiling drops suddenly, stopping 6 inches above the floor before rising just as quickly and plummeting again. This rapid, piston-like movement lasts for 1 minute, after which the ceiling returns to its original height and locks in place until the trap is triggered again.
zh_tw: 這個20尺高的天花板突然下降，停在離地面6吋的地方，然後同樣迅速地升起，再次猛然下降。這種快速的活塞式運動持續1分鐘，之後天花板恢復到原始高度並固定在那裡，直到陷阱再次被觸發。

english: Each time the trap triggers, have the characters roll initiative. The ceiling drops to its lowest point on initiative count 20 of each round, losing initiative ties, until the trap resets.
zh_tw: 每次陷阱觸發時，讓角色們擲先攻骰。在每一輪的第20個先攻計數時，天花板下降到最低點，如果出現平手則失去先攻，直到陷阱重置。

english: Any creature in the room when the ceiling drops must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 55 ({@dice 10d10}) bludgeoning damage and has the {@condition prone} condition. On a successful save, the creature can rush from the room, taking no damage, or remain in the room and take half as much damage only. A creature that can fit in spaces as narrow as 6 inches has advantage on the save thanks to the narrow gap that remains between the ceiling and floor when the ceiling is at its lowest level.
zh_tw: 當天花板掉落時，房間內的任何生物都必須進行一次 {@dc 20} 敏捷豁免。豁免失敗時，該生物受到 55 ({@dice 10d10}) 點鈍擊傷害，並處於 {@condition prone||伏地} 狀態。豁免成功時，該生物可以衝出房間，不受傷害，或者留在房間內，僅受到一半的傷害。能夠適應狹窄至 6 吋空間的生物在豁免上有優勢，因為在天花板降到最低位置時，天花板與地板之間仍有一個狹窄的縫隙。

english: A Small or larger creature subjected to the trap can choose to make a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw instead of a Dexterity saving throw, provided the creature doesn't have the {@condition prone} condition, with the aim of slowing the ceiling's descent for the betterment of others. The creature making the Strength saving throw takes 55 ({@dice 10d10}) bludgeoning damage regardless of whether its save succeeds or fails. If the save succeeds, however, the trap's damage to other creatures is reduced to 0 until initiative count 20 of the next round (losing initiative ties).
zh_tw: 一個體型為小型或更大的生物在被陷阱作用時，可以選擇進行{@dc 20}力量豁免而不是敏捷豁免，前提是該生物沒有處於{@condition prone||伏地}狀態，目的是減緩天花板的下落以幫助他人。無論該生物的力量豁免是否成功，它都會受到55點（{@dice 10d10}）鈍擊傷害。然而，如果豁免成功，陷阱對其他生物的傷害將減少到0，直到下一輪的第20個先攻計數（在先攻平局時失去優勢）。

english: The ceiling is too heavy to be stopped by any braces, but an {@item Immovable Rod} or similar item can prevent it from dropping so far as to crush anyone.
zh_tw: 天花板太重，無法被任何支撐物阻止下降，但是一個{@item Immovable Rod||不動權杖}或者類似的物品可以防止它下降到足以壓碎任何人的程度。

english: T11: Strange Altar
zh_tw: T11: 奇異祭壇

english: A dark, triangular altar stands in the center of this chamber. Carved into each side of the altar is a niche containing a chest. One chest is plated with gold, one is plated with silver, and the last is plated with lead.
zh_tw: 這個房間中心矗立著一個黑色的三角形祭壇。祭壇的每一面都雕刻有一個壁龕，壁龕內各放著一個箱子。其中一個箱子鍍金，一個箱子鍍銀，最後一個箱子鍍鉛。

english: The chests are unlocked, and their contents are as follows:
zh_tw: 箱子是未上鎖的，它們的內容如下：

english: Gold Chest
zh_tw: 黃金寶箱

english: This {@item chest|PHB} is worth 100 gp on its own and contains 100 gp.
zh_tw: 這個{@item chest|PHB|箱子}本身價值100金幣，並且裡面裝有100金幣。

english: Silver Chest
zh_tw: 銀色箱子

english: This {@item chest|PHB} is worth 50 gp on its own and contains a ceremonial {@item dagger|PHB} plated with electrum with an amethyst set in its pommel (worth 750 gp).
zh_tw: 這個{@item chest|PHB|箱子}本身價值50金幣，裡面裝有一把儀式用的{@item dagger|PHB|匕首}，匕首上鍍有電氣石，其柄頭上鑲嵌著紫水晶（價值750金幣）。

english: Lead Chest
zh_tw: 鉛製箱子

english: This worthless {@item chest|PHB} contains a {@item Spell Scroll} of {@spell Knock}, which the altar trap values at 200 gp (see below).
zh_tw: 這個無價值的{@item chest|PHB|箱子}裡裝有一個{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}，上面寫著{@spell Knock||敲擊術}法術，祭壇陷阱將其估價為200金幣（見下文）。

english: Altar Trap
zh_tw: 祭壇陷阱

english: Removing a chest or its contents from a niche causes the altar's carvings to glow with pale light. Creatures in the room have 1 minute to either return the chest and its contents to the niche or place one or more items of equal or greater value into the niche. Otherwise, one of the following effects occurs when the time expires, depending on the chest involved:
zh_tw: 從壁龕中移除箱子或其內容物會導致祭壇的雕刻發出蒼白的光芒。房間中的生物有1分鐘時間將箱子及其內容物放回壁龕，或者將等值或更高價值的物品放入壁龕。否則，時間到期時，根據涉及的箱子，將發生以下效果之一：

english: Gold Chest
zh_tw: 黃金寶箱

english: Six {@creature Swarm of Poisonous Snakes||swarms of poisonous snakes} teleport into the room. The snakes are hostile.
zh_tw: 六個{@creature Swarm of Poisonous Snakes||毒蛇群}傳送進房間。這些蛇具有敵意。

english: Silver Chest
zh_tw: 銀色箱子

english: A burst of desiccating energy radiates from the altar in a 15-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@dice 4d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 一股枯竭的能量以祭壇為中心向四周輻射，形成一個15尺半徑的球體。區域內的每個生物必須進行一次{@dc 17}體質豁免檢定，豁免失敗將受到18（{@dice 4d8}）點暗蝕傷害，豁免成功則只受一半傷害。

english: Lead Chest
zh_tw: 鉛製箱子

english: A {@creature death knight} teleports into the room, appearing in a random unoccupied space within 15 feet of the altar. The knight is hostile.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature death knight||死亡騎士}傳送進房間，出現在祭壇周圍15尺範圍內的一個隨機未被佔據的空間內。這位騎士具有敵意。

english: T12: Room of Respite
zh_tw: T12: 休息室

english: A marble gazebo with a fountain at its center is surrounded by flowering bushes.
zh_tw: 一箇中心有噴泉的大理石涼亭被開花的灌木叢所環繞。

english: This room is safe.
zh_tw: 這個房間是安全的。

english: Fountain
zh_tw: 噴泉

english: The fountain's waters have healing properties. A creature that drinks from the fountain regains 21 ({@dice 6d6}) hit points. Once a creature has benefited from the fountain's magic, it can't do so again until the next dawn.
zh_tw: 這個噴泉的水源具有治療特性。飲用噴泉水的生物恢復21（{@dice 6d6}）點生命值。一旦一個生物受益於這個噴泉的魔法，直到下一個黎明之前它不能再受益。

english: T13: Celestial Sky Mirage
zh_tw: T13: 天界天空的幻象

english: A hidden door conceals this room. Creatures that step through the doorway are seemingly transported to a location outdoors, thanks to illusion magic:
zh_tw: 一扇隱藏門隱藏了這個房間。穿過門道的生物似乎被傳送到了戶外的一個地方，這要歸功於幻象魔法：

english: You're transported to a grassy field with a starry night sky above you.
zh_tw: 你被傳送到一個草地上，頭頂是繁星點點的夜空。

english: The grassy field and night sky are illusions concealing a bare, rectangular room. Characters can move only as far as the room's walls and ceiling allow, for though these surfaces are hidden to normal eyes, they can be felt. Creatures with {@sense truesight} recognize the illusions as mirages and can see the room as it actually is; they can also see an engraved black box resting on a black dais in the middle of the room. Characters who can't see the box and dais can locate them by touch after a careful search of the area.
zh_tw: 草地和夜空是幻象，掩蓋了一個光禿禿的矩形房間。角色只能移動到房間的牆壁和天花板允許的範圍，因為儘管這些表面對普通眼睛是隱藏的，但它們可以被感覺到。具有{@sense truesight||真實視覺}的生物能識別這些幻象為海市蜃樓，並能看到房間的真實樣子；它們也能看到房間中央黑色基座上休息的雕刻黑色盒子。看不到盒子和基座的角色在仔細搜尋該區域後可以透過觸控找到它們。

english: Observing the Night Sky
zh_tw: 觀察夜空

english: A character observing the mirage of the night sky can make a {@dc 14} Intelligence ({@skill Nature}) check. On a success, a character realizes that, while beautiful, the night sky is wholly inaccurate, as if created by someone who has never seen the sky before. Succeeding on this check also allows the character to see through the room's illusions, revealing not only the walls and ceiling but also the box and the dais on which it sits.
zh_tw: 一個觀察到夜空中海市蜃樓的角色可以進行一次 {@dc 14} 智力（{@skill Nature||自然}）檢定。若成功，角色會意識到，雖然夜空美麗，但它完全不準確，彷彿是某個從未見過天空的人所創造。成功透過這次檢定還允許角色看穿房間的幻象，揭示出不僅牆壁和天花板，還有盒子和它所放置的平臺。

english: Box Trap
zh_tw: 盒子陷阱

english: The engraved box can't be forced open, but a character can try to unlock it using thieves' tools, doing so with a successful a {@dc 20} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. A {@spell Knock} spell or similar magic also unlocks the box.
zh_tw: 雕刻的盒子無法強行開啟，但角色可以嘗試使用盜賊工具解鎖它，成功進行一個 {@dc 20} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定即可。 {@spell Knock||敲擊術} 法術或類似的魔法也可以解鎖這個盒子。

english: A character who inspects the box before opening it can make a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check. On a successful check, the character notices a spring-loaded compartment beneath the box's lid. A character can use thieves' tools to try to dismantle this compartment and disable the trap, doing so with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. If the trap isn't deactivated, poisoned darts burst from the box when it's opened. Each creature within 10 feet of the box when the trap is sprung must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@dice 4d4}) piercing damage and have the {@condition poisoned} condition for 1 hour.
zh_tw: 一名角色在開啟盒子前檢查它可以進行一個 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定。如果檢定成功，角色會注意到盒子蓋下有一個彈簧夾層。角色可以使用盜賊工具嘗試拆解這個夾層並解除陷阱，這需要一個成功的 {@dc 15} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定。如果陷阱未被解除，當盒子開啟時，毒鏢會從中射出。當陷阱觸發時，每個在盒子 10 尺範圍內的生物必須成功透過一個 {@dc 20} 敏捷豁免，否則將受到 10（{@dice 4d4}）點穿刺傷害並陷入 {@condition poisoned||中毒} 狀態 1 小時。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Contained within the box is a delicate gold ring engraved with geometric star designs. This ring isn't magical or of any significant monetary value, but Laysa's ancestors once used it in traditional storytelling ceremonies involving astrology. This is one of the treasures Laysa mentioned earlier in this chapter.
zh_tw: 盒子內裝有一個精緻的金戒指，上面刻有幾何星形圖案。這枚戒指沒有魔法效果，也沒有顯著的貨幣價值，但萊莎的祖先曾在涉及占星術的傳統講故事儀式中使用過它。這是萊莎在本章早些時候提到的寶藏之一。

english: T14: Juggernaut Arena
zh_tw: T14: 巨型戰車競技場

english: Anyone who wanders into the tomb's arena must contend with granite juggernauts
zh_tw: 任何走進墳墓競技場的人都必須與花崗巖巨人作戰

english: Thin, obsidian pillars are spaced throughout this musty room, the ceiling of which is only ten feet high. In the flickering light, you see two massive, rolling constructs roving the space.
zh_tw: 在這個發黴的房間裡，分佈著一些細長的黑曜石柱子，房間的天花板只有十尺高。在閃爍的光線中，你看到兩個巨大的滾動構造在空間中巡邏。

english: The room's ceiling is 10 feet high—barely large enough to accommodate the two {@creature Granite Juggernaut|VEoR|granite juggernauts} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) that trundle between the room's pillars. The juggernauts attack any intruders they notice, but they won't strike pillars.
zh_tw: 房間的天花板高10尺——勉強足夠容納兩個{@creature Granite Juggernaut|VEoR|花崗岩戰車}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）在房間的柱子間滾動。花崗巖巨人會攻擊他們注意到的任何入侵者，但它們不會撞擊柱子。

english: The juggernauts fight until they are destroyed or until a creature destroys the triangular stone in the control room (area T15).
zh_tw: 巨型機器人會戰鬥直到它們被摧毀，或者直到一個生物摧毀了控制室（區域T15）中的三角形石頭。

english: T15: Juggernaut Control Room
zh_tw: T15: 巨型戰車控制室

english: A hidden door conceals this room.
zh_tw: 一扇隱藏的門隱藏了這個房間。

english: A five-foot-tall, triangular stone covered in runes stands in this bare room's center. At the top of the stone, a plum-sized diamond pulses with red light.
zh_tw: 在這個空蕩的房間中央，立著一塊五尺高、三角形的石頭，上面刻滿了符文。在石頭的頂部，一顆李子大小的鑽石發出紅色的光脈衝。

english: The triangular stone is immovable and powers the {@creature Granite Juggernaut|VEoR|juggernauts} in area T14. A character who examines the triangular stone and succeeds on a {@dc 17} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check can decipher its runes and discern its purpose.
zh_tw: 這塊三角石無法移動，併為區域 T14 中的{@creature Granite Juggernaut|VEoR|巨型機器人}提供能量。一個角色如果檢查這塊三角石，併成功透過{@dc 17}智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定，就能夠破譯其符文並瞭解其用途。

english: Destroying the Stone
zh_tw: 摧毀此石

english: The triangular stone has AC 20; 100 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage; and immunity to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. When the stone is destroyed, the juggernauts in area T14 stop moving and become inanimate objects.
zh_tw: 這個三角形石頭具有AC 20；100生命值；對毒素和心靈傷害免疫；並且對來自非魔法攻擊的鈍擊、穿刺和揮砍傷害免疫。當石頭被摧毀時，區域T14中的巨型機械停止移動並變成無生命的物體。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Once the stone has been destroyed or both juggernauts have been defeated, characters can take the diamond, which is worth 5,000 gp. The diamond stops glowing when it leaves the room.
zh_tw: 一旦石頭被摧毀或兩個巨型機器人都被擊敗，角色們就可以拿走鑽石，它價值5000金幣。當鑽石離開房間時，它停止發光。

english: T16: Acid Pit Crossing
zh_tw: T16: 酸性坑道穿越
