english: Filling most of this chamber is a ten-foot-deep pit of green acid, over which stretches a three-foot-wide stone bridge. Nozzles embedded in the north and south walls shoot blasts of air across the bridge.
zh_tw: 這個房間大部分被一個十尺深的綠色酸液坑佔據，上面橫跨著一座三尺寬的石橋。嵌入在北牆和南牆上的噴嘴會向橋上噴射氣流。

english: A creature that falls into the acid takes 21 ({@dice 6d6}) acid damage. Any creature that starts its turn in the acid also takes this damage.
zh_tw: 掉入酸液中的生物會受到21（{@dice 6d6}）的強酸傷害。任何在其回合開始時處於酸液中的生物也會受到此傷害。

english: Gust Nozzles
zh_tw: 噴射口

english: Air blasts from nozzles in the walls north and south of the bridge with such force that they can't be easily stoppered. When a creature moves onto the bridge for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, or when a flying creature enters a space above the bridge or the acid pit for the first time on a turn, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is pushed by the gusts 5 feet north or south (determined randomly) and has the {@condition prone} condition; if the space isn't on a surface that can support the creature, the creature falls as normal.
zh_tw: 從橋的南北牆上噴出的氣流如此猛烈，以至於無法輕易堵住。當一個生物在回合中首次移動到橋上或在其回合開始時位於橋上，或者當飛行生物首次在回合中進入橋或酸液坑上方空間時，該生物必須透過一次 {@dc 20} 敏捷豁免檢定。豁免失敗時，該生物會被氣流推動 5 尺向北方或南方（隨機決定），並獲得 {@condition prone||伏地} 狀態；如果落點不在可以支撐該生物的表面上，則該生物按正常情況墜落。

english: T17: Jade Serpent Guardians' Chamber
zh_tw: T17: 翡翠蛇守衛室

english: A jade statue stands between this room's two exits. The statue depicts an armored, feminine figure from the waist up, with six arms and a gleaming curved sword in each hand; from the waist down, the statue's body is serpentine. Two statues depicting large cobras with jade scales sit in alcoves to the east.
zh_tw: 一尊玉雕像立於這個房間的兩個出口之間。雕像刻畫了一個上半身穿著盔甲的女性形象，擁有六臂，每隻手中都握著一把閃閃發光的彎劍；從腰部以下，雕像的身體是蛇形的。兩尊描繪有玉鱗的大眼鏡蛇的雕像坐落在東側的壁龕中。

english: If one or more characters enter the room, read the following:
zh_tw: 如果一個或多個角色進入房間，請閱讀以下內容：

english: The center statue's eyes glow with white light, and the cobra statues begin writhing toward you.
zh_tw: 中心雕像的眼睛發出白光，眼鏡蛇雕像開始向你扭動。

english: The central statue uses the {@creature marilith} stat block but is a Construct. This central statue controls the two cobra statues; each cobra statue uses the {@creature spirit naga} stat block but is a Construct. The statues speak Common. The statues are hostile toward any creature that enters the chamber.
zh_tw: 中央雕像使用{@creature marilith||六臂蛇魔}的統計資料塊，但屬於構裝生物。這尊中央雕像控制著兩尊眼鏡蛇雕像；每尊眼鏡蛇雕像使用{@creature spirit naga||陰魂納迦}的統計資料塊，但也是構裝生物。雕像們講通用語。雕像對任何進入房間的生物都表現出敵意。

english: Sword of Sharpness (scimitar) with a snake-shaped pommel
zh_tw: 鋒利之劍（彎刀）帶有蛇形劍柄

english: Appeasing the Statues
zh_tw: 安撫雕像

english: A character can use an action to try to appease the statues with a {@dc 20} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check; if the character makes an offering of food or treasure worth 50 gp or more, this check is made with advantage. On a successful check, the statues become friendly toward the characters and cease attacking.
zh_tw: 角色可以使用一個動作，嘗試透過一次 {@dc 20} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定來安撫雕像；如果角色提供了價值 50 gp 或更多的食物或寶藏，該檢定具有優勢。檢定成功後，雕像會對角色變得友好並停止攻擊。

english: The statues served as island guardians for centuries before Acererak abducted them. If informed about Laysa, the statues are thrilled to learn about her efforts.
zh_tw: 這些雕像在阿瑟瑞克綁架它們之前，作為島嶼的守護者已經服務了幾個世紀。如果告知它們關於萊莎的情況，雕像們會非常高興地瞭解到她的努力。

english: Acererak's magic confines the statues to this room, but previous adventurers have told them about surrounding areas. The statues can share details about what's in areas T16 and T18.
zh_tw: 阿瑟瑞克的魔法將雕像限制在這個房間內，但之前的冒險者已經告訴了它們周圍區域的情況。雕像可以分享關於區域T16和T18的詳細資訊。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: One of the central statue's swords functions as a {@item Scimitar of Sharpness||Sword of Sharpness (scimitar)} in the hands of a Humanoid. The scimitar is one of the treasures Laysa mentioned earlier in this chapter. If told about Laysa, the central statue willingly gives the sword; otherwise, the sword can be retrieved when all the statues have been defeated.
zh_tw: 中央雕像之一的劍在類人生物手中可以作為一把{@item Scimitar of Sharpness||銳鋒之劍（彎刀）}使用。這把彎刀是萊莎在本章前面提到的寶藏之一。如果告訴雕像關於萊莎的事情，中央雕像會自願贈送這把劍；否則，只有當所有雕像都被擊敗時，才能取得這把劍。

english: T18: Hall of Discordance
zh_tw: T18: 不和大廳

english: Eight niches are built into these walls. Each niche contains a musical instrument: a lute, a lyre, a viol, a flute, a drum, a dulcimer, a shawm, and a horn. At the end of the hallway is a double door emblazoned with two theater masks—one elated and one despairing.
zh_tw: 這兩面牆壁上建有八個壁龕。每個壁龕裡都放著一種樂器：琵琶、豎琴、中提琴、長笛、鼓、揚琴、肖姆管和號角。走廊的盡頭是一扇雙門，上面裝飾著兩個戲劇面具——一個興高采烈，一個絕望。

english: When a creature comes within 5 feet of any of the instruments, they all glow with a purple light and begin playing on their own, filling the hall with an awful din. Each creature in the hall must make a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw, taking 16 ({@dice 3d10}) psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. After the damage is dealt, the instruments cease to play or glow, becoming normal items of their kind.
zh_tw: 當一個生物接近任何一件樂器5尺範圍內時，所有樂器都會發出紫色的光芒並自動開始演奏，大廳中充滿了可怕的噪音。大廳中的每個生物必須進行一次{@dc 20}感知豁免檢定，若失敗則受到16（{@dice 3d10}）點心靈傷害，若成功則只受到一半的傷害。傷害被處理後，樂器將停止演奏和發光，恢復為普通的物品。

english: Mask Door
zh_tw: 面具門

english: Upon closer inspection, the mouths of both masks are open slots, each large enough to fit a Medium or Small Humanoid's arm. The doors are locked.
zh_tw: 仔細檢查後，你會發現兩個面具的嘴巴都是開口的插槽，每個都足夠一箇中型或小型類人生物的手臂伸入。門是鎖著的。

english: Thin script engraved above the pair of masks reads as follows:
zh_tw: 在這對面具上方雕刻的細薄文字如下：

english: "Pay the toll, in blood or in song."
zh_tw: "付出通行費，以血或以歌。"

english: There are two ways to open the doors. A character can play one of the hallway's instruments and make a {@dc 20} Charisma ({@skill Performance}) check; if the character doesn't have proficiency with the chosen instrument, this check is made with disadvantage. On a successful check, the doors open. On a failed check, the character takes 16 ({@dice 3d10}) psychic damage, and the doors remain locked.
zh_tw: 有兩種方法可以開啟這些門。一個角色可以演奏走廊中的一種樂器，並進行一次 {@dc 20} 魅力（{@skill Performance||表演}）檢定；如果該角色不擅長所選的樂器，這次檢定將帶有劣勢。如果檢定成功，門將開啟。如果檢定失敗，該角色將受到 16 點（{@dice 3d10}）精神傷害，並且門保持鎖定狀態。

english: Alternatively, a character can place one of their arms into a mask's open mouth. When each mouth has an arm in it, the mouths clamp down. If both arms belong to the same character, that character takes 28 ({@dice 8d6}) piercing damage; if the arms belong to different characters, each character takes 14 ({@dice 4d6}) piercing damage. The mouths then unclamp, and the doors unlock.
zh_tw: 另外，一個角色可以將他們的一隻手臂放入面具張開的口中。當每個口都放入一隻手臂後，面具會咬合。如果兩隻手臂屬於同一個角色，那麼這個角色會受到28（{@dice 8d6}）點穿刺傷害；如果手臂屬於不同的角色，每個角色會受到14（{@dice 4d6}）點穿刺傷害。之後，面具會鬆開，門會解鎖。

english: T19: Library
zh_tw: T19: 圖書館

english: Shelves filled with tomes and scrolls line the walls of this expansive chamber. Five stone statues depicting skeletal warriors stand sentinel throughout the room.
zh_tw: 書架上擺滿了書籍和卷軸，排列在這個寬敞的房間的牆壁上。五尊石雕，描繪著骷髏戰士，守衛在房間各處。

english: A Manual of Bodily Healthy written on engraved copper sheets
zh_tw: 一本刻在銅片上的《身體健康手冊》

english: Guardians
zh_tw: 守衛

english: Whenever an item is removed from this room's shelves, one of the five skeletal statues here springs to life. The statue uses the {@creature stone golem} stat block but is Medium and hostile, attacking whichever creature took the item. The statue remains active until the triggering item is returned or until the statue is destroyed. Multiple statues can be active at once.
zh_tw: 每當有物品從這個房間的架子上被拿走時，這裡的五座骷髏雕像中的一座就會活過來。這座雕像使用{@creature stone golem||石魔像}的統計資料塊，但是是中等大小且具有敵意，攻擊拿走物品的生物。雕像在觸發物品被歸還或雕像被摧毀之前一直保持活躍狀態。一次可以有多座雕像同時活躍。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A thorough search of the shelves' contents takes 10 minutes and yields the following items:
zh_tw: 徹底搜尋書架上的內容需要10分鐘，並發現了以下物品：

english: {@item Spell Scroll} of {@spell Greater Restoration}
zh_tw: {@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸} of {@spell Greater Restoration||高等復原術}

english: Set of engraved copper sheets that functions as a {@item Manual of Bodily Health} (one of the treasures Laysa mentioned earlier in this chapter)
zh_tw: 一套雕刻的銅板，作為{@item Manual of Bodily Health||強身手冊}使用（萊莎在本章早些時候提到的寶藏之一）

english: Thin, leather-bound journal written in Common that explains that the combination for the crypt doors ({@area area T25|3e1|x}) is the word "die" in Draconic
zh_tw: 一本薄薄的皮革裝訂日記，以通用語寫成，記載墓室大門（{@area 區域T25|3e1|x}）的密碼是龍語的「die」（死）一詞

english: T20a–T20b: Void Closets
zh_tw: T20a–T20b: 虛空壁櫥

english: These two storage closets are identical. The door to each room is locked. As an action, a character can use thieves' tools to try to unlock either door, doing so with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. Each door can also be forced open from either side with a successful {@dc 11} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, or with a {@spell Knock} spell or similar magic.
zh_tw: 這兩個儲藏室完全相同。每個房間的門都是鎖著的。作為一個動作，角色可以使用盜賊工具嘗試解鎖任一扇門，成功進行 {@dc 15} 敏捷 ({@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}) 檢定即可解鎖。每扇門也可以從任一側透過成功的 {@dc 11} 力量 ({@skill Athletics||運動}) 檢定，或使用 {@spell Knock||敲擊術} 法術或類似魔法強行開啟。

english: This room is pitch dark.
zh_tw: 這個房間漆黑一片。

english: The interior of each closet is filled with magical darkness that can't be dispelled.
zh_tw: 每個壁櫥的內部都充滿了無法驅散的魔法黑暗。

english: Spheres of Annihilation
zh_tw: 湮滅法球

english: In the center of each room is an uncontrolled {@item Sphere of Annihilation}. The magical darkness obscures the sphere; only creatures with {@sense truesight} can detect its presence.
zh_tw: 每個房間的中心都有一個不受控制的{@item Sphere of Annihilation||湮滅法球}。魔法黑暗掩蓋了這個球體；只有具有{@sense truesight||真實視覺}能力的生物才能探測到它的存在。

english: T21: Phantasmal Mirage
zh_tw: T21: 幻象幻境

english: Eerie sounds echo in this pitch-dark room.
zh_tw: 在這個漆黑的房間裡，迴響著詭異的聲音。

english: This room is filled with magical darkness, and neither the darkness nor the eerie sounds can be dispelled. Any creature that enters this room for the first time must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition frightened} condition, as the darkness and eerie sounds conjure up the creature's deepest fears. The {@condition frightened} condition ends on the creature when it leaves the room.
zh_tw: 這個房間充滿了魔法黑暗，黑暗和詭異的聲音都無法被驅散。任何首次進入這個房間的生物必須成功透過一次 {@dc 18} 感知豁免檢定，否則會陷入 {@condition frightened||恐懼} 狀態，因為黑暗和詭異的聲音會喚起該生物內心最深處的恐懼。當該生物離開房間時，{@condition frightened||恐懼} 狀態結束。

english: While {@condition frightened} in this way, a creature takes 11 ({@dice 2d10}) psychic damage for every 5 feet it moves. After taking this damage, the creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the frightened condition on a itself on a success.
zh_tw: 當{@condition frightened||恐懼}時，生物每移動5尺將受到11（{@dice 2d10}）點心靈傷害。受到此傷害後，該生物可以重複進行豁免檢定，若成功則解除自身的恐懼狀態。

english: Piercing the Illusion
zh_tw: 穿透幻象

english: Creatures with {@sense truesight} see the room for what it is: an abandoned study. A dusty desk and empty bookcase line the east wall.
zh_tw: 具有{@sense truesight||真實視覺}的生物可以看到房間的真相：一個廢棄的書房。一個佈滿灰塵的桌子和空書架排列在東牆。

english: T22: Vortex Bridge
zh_tw: T22: 漩渦橋

english: A dull roar fills this hexagonal chamber. A bridge consisting of engraved, colored limestone tiles stretches between two ledges. A pitch-black vortex of energy churns beneath the bridge.
zh_tw: 這個六邊形的房間充滿了低沉的轟鳴聲。一座由雕刻著彩色石灰石瓦片組成的橋橫跨在兩個懸崖之間。橋下翻騰著一個漆黑的能量漩渦。

english: The tiled bridge stretches over a gravity vortex 60 feet below. The force of the vortex reduces the flying speed of any creature within the room to 0 feet.
zh_tw: 瓦片橋橫跨在下方60尺處的重力漩渦之上。漩渦的力量將房間內任何生物的飛行速度降低至0尺。

english: Map 7.4: Vortex Bridge Puzzle
zh_tw: 地圖 7.4：漩渦橋謎題

english: Bridge Puzzle
zh_tw: 橋謎題

english: Close inspection of the bridge's tiles reveals that each one bears an engraved symbol representing one of the eight schools of magic. A {@spell See Invisibility} spell or similar effect uncovers concealed writing on the ledge before the bridge, which reads as follows:
zh_tw: 仔細檢查橋上的瓦片可以發現，每塊瓦片上都刻有一個代表八大魔法學派之一的符號。使用{@spell See Invisibility||識破隱形}法術或類似效果可以揭示橋前懸崖上的隱藏文字，內容如下：

english: "The vortex eats all magic, save for that from which it was born."
zh_tw: "漩渦吞噬所有魔法，除了它誕生之源的魔法。"

english: To cross the bridge safely, creatures must step on the tiles bearing the symbol for evocation magic, which are red, or the tiles bearing the symbol for transmutation magic, which are orange. The tiles are shown on map 7.4.
zh_tw: 為了安全地穿過橋，生物必須踩在帶有召喚魔法符號的紅色瓦片上，或者是帶有變化魔法符號的橙色瓦片上。這些瓦片在地圖7.4上顯示。

english: When observed within the range of a {@spell Detect Magic} spell or similar magic, the vortex radiates an aura of evocation and transmutation magic. A character who observes the vortex or witnesses the flight-inhibiting effect of the room's gravity well can make a {@dc 16} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check, recalling the following facts on a success:
zh_tw: 當在 {@spell Detect Magic||偵測魔法} 法術或類似魔法的範圍內觀察時，漩渦散發出咒法和變化魔法的靈光。觀察到漩渦或見證房間重力井抑制飛行效果的角色可以進行 {@dc 16} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定，成功時回憶起以下事實：

english: The spell {@spell Reverse Gravity} is a transmutation spell.
zh_tw: 法術{@spell Reverse Gravity||反轉重力}是一種變化系法術。

english: The school of transmutation magic deals with manipulating energy and matter.
zh_tw: 變化魔法學派涉及能量和物質的操控。

english: Evocation spells create powerful elemental effects.
zh_tw: 咒法系法術創造出強大的元素效果。

english: If the players have trouble with this puzzle, reveal that the characters must step on only evocation or transmutation tiles, and tell them which colors these tiles are. When a creature steps on an incorrect tile, the tile breaks away, and both the tile and the creature are sucked into the vortex below. The creature takes 36 ({@dice 8d8}) force damage and is teleported to a safe, unoccupied space at the south end of the room or in the tunnel leading to {@area area T19|3cc|x}.
zh_tw: 如果玩家在這個謎題上遇到麻煩，揭示角色必須只踩在召喚或變化魔法的瓦片上，並告訴他們這些瓦片的顏色。當生物踩在錯誤的瓦片上時，瓦片會斷裂，瓦片和生物都會被吸入下面的漩渦。生物受到36（{@dice 8d8}）點力場傷害，並被傳送到房間南端或通往{@area 區域T19|3cc|x}的隧道中的一個安全且未被佔據的空間。

english: T23: Arcane Laboratory
zh_tw: T23: 奧術實驗室

english: Three tall, glass cylinders line the back wall of this dimly lit chamber. Each cylinder contains a decaying corpse, half-buried in snow topped with red powder. Against the north wall stands a bare wooden desk.
zh_tw: 三個高大的玻璃圓柱體排列在這個昏暗房間的後牆。每個圓柱體都裝有一個腐爛的屍體，半埋在覆蓋著紅色粉末的雪中。北牆邊立著一張光禿禿的木桌。

english: This chamber bears the remnants of Acererak's endeavors to create empowered simulacra to guard his many tombs. A character who examines the cylinders and succeeds on a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check recognizes the snow and powdered ruby in each glass cylinder as components for creating a simulacrum.
zh_tw: 這個房間裡留有阿塞拉克為了創造強化的幻象來守護他的眾多陵墓而進行的努力的遺蹟。一個角色如果檢查這些玻璃圓筒併成功透過一個 {@dc 20} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定，就會認出每個玻璃圓筒中的雪和紅寶石粉末是創造幻象所需的材料。

english: Secret Desk Compartment
zh_tw: 秘密書桌隔間

english: A character who searches the desk and succeeds on a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check discovers that one of its drawers contains a locked false bottom. Rerak (see {@area area T26|3e4|x}) carries the key to this compartment, but a character with thieves' tools can use them to try to unlock the compartment, doing so with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. A {@spell Knock} spell or similar magic also unlocks the compartment.
zh_tw: 一個角色如果搜查這張書桌並且在智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定中成功透過 {@dc 20}，會發現其中一個抽屜有一個上鎖的假底。雷拉克（參見 {@area 區域T26|3e4|x}）攜帶這個隔間的鑰匙，但一個擁有盜賊工具的角色可以使用它們來嘗試解鎖這個隔間，透過成功的 {@dc 20} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定即可完成。一個 {@spell Knock||敲擊術} 法術或類似的魔法也能解鎖這個隔間。

english: The secret compartment bears a magical trap. If the compartment is opened by any means other than using the key found on Rerak in {@area area T26|3e4|x}, magical lightning shoots from the drawer. Each creature in the room must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 26 ({@dice 4d12}) lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A {@spell Detect Magic} spell or similar effect unveils the source of this trap: a tiny rune inscribed in the drawer. The trap can be disarmed by dispelling the rune with a {@spell Dispel Magic} spell ({@dc 17}).
zh_tw: 秘密隔間帶有一個魔法陷阱。如果隔間並非使用在 {@area 區域T26|3e4|x} 拉拉克身上找到的鑰匙開啟，魔法閃電就會從抽屜中射出。房間內的每個生物都必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 敏捷豁免，失敗則受到 26 ({@dice 4d12}) 點閃電傷害，成功則只受到一半傷害。透過 {@spell Detect Magic||偵測魔法} 法術或類似效果，可以揭示陷阱的來源：抽屜內刻著的一個微小符文。陷阱可以透過使用 {@spell Dispel Magic||解除魔法} 法術 ({@dc 17}) 驅散符文來解除。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Within the hidden desk compartment is a rose quartz {@item Crystal Ball} and a stack of notes written in Common. The Crystal Ball is one of the treasures Laysa mentioned earlier in this chapter.
zh_tw: 隱藏在桌子隔層裡的是一顆玫瑰石英的{@item Crystal Ball||水晶球}和一疊用通用語寫的筆記。水晶球是萊莎在本章早些時候提到的寶藏之一。

english: A character who spends 10 minutes studying the notes learns about Acererak's endeavors to create empowered simulacra of himself to guard his tombs. Acererak speaks of his simulacra with disdain, viewing them as tools. He finds the fact that his simulacra can develop sentience a sadistic joke.
zh_tw: 如果一個角色花費10分鐘研究這些筆記，他會瞭解到阿瑟瑞克試圖創造強化模擬像來守衛他的墳墓。阿瑟瑞克對自己的模擬像持有輕蔑態度，將它們視為工具。他認為他的模擬像能夠發展出意識是一個施虐的笑話。

english: The notes also explain that the combination for the crypt doors ({@area area T25|3e1|x}) is the word "die" in Draconic.
zh_tw: 筆記也說明，墓室大門（{@area 區域T25|3e1|x}）的密碼是龍語的「die」（死）一詞。

english: T24: Underwater Trench Mirage
zh_tw: T24: 水下溝渠幻象

english: Characters standing outside this room can see that it is empty, but a {@spell Detect Magic} spell reveals the presence of illusion magic throughout. When one or more characters enter the room, read the following:
zh_tw: 站在房間外的角色可以看到房間是空的，但{@spell Detect Magic||偵測魔法}法術揭示了整個房間中存在的幻象魔法。當一個或多個角色進入房間時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: The walls, floor, and ceiling of the chamber vanish, replaced with a dark ocean in which you are submerged. There is no visible surface. Beneath you swims a large, finned shadow.
zh_tw: 房間的牆壁、地板和天花板消失了，取而代之的是一個你被浸沒其中的黑暗海洋。看不見表面。在你下方遊動著一個有著大鰭的陰影。

english: This chamber contains a mirage of a deep, underwater trench. Though illusory, the seawater is tactile, and creatures unable to breathe underwater suffocate while in this chamber.
zh_tw: 這個房間包含一個深海溝壑的幻象。雖然海水是幻覺，但觸感卻是真實的，無法在水下呼吸的生物在這個房間裡會窒息。

english: A hostile {@creature giant shark} swims beneath the characters. The shark is part of the mirage, though it can harm characters who don't pierce the illusion. The shark can't harm anyone outside the room.
zh_tw: 一隻敵對的{@creature giant shark||巨鯊}在角色下方遊動。這隻鯊魚是海市蜃樓的一部分，儘管它可以傷害那些沒有看穿幻象的角色。鯊魚不能傷害房間外的任何人。

english: Piercing the Illusion
zh_tw: 穿透幻象

english: A creature that succeeds on a {@dc 18} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check can see through the illusion, perceiving the empty room and its exits. A creature with {@sense truesight} can also see through the illusion.
zh_tw: 一個在 {@dc 18} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定中成功的生物可以看穿這個幻象，感知到空無一物的房間及其出口。一個具有 {@sense truesight||真實視覺} 的生物也可以看穿這個幻象。

english: Upon realizing the illusion, a creature can breathe the water as easily as it breathes air. However, the creature continues to interact with the water as if it were tactile, such as swimming through it.
zh_tw: 一旦意識到這是幻覺，生物可以像呼吸空氣一樣輕鬆地呼吸水。然而，生物繼續像水有觸感一樣與之互動，例如在其中游泳。

english: T25: Crypt Doors
zh_tw: T25: 墓穴之門

english: This corridor ends at a massive double door with a carved relief depicting a river of screaming souls flowing through a ravaged landscape. Instead of handles, the doors bear a trio of concentric, rune-carved platinum circles that can be rotated. At the circles' center is an engraving of a leering skull.
zh_tw: 這條走廊以一扇巨大的雙開門結束，門上雕刻著一幅浮雕，描繪了一條尖叫的靈魂河流流經一個荒蕪的景象。門上沒有把手，而是有三個同心的、刻有符文的鉑金圓圈，可以旋轉。在圓圈的中心是一幅嘲笑的骷髏雕刻。

english: The platinum circles are the locking mechanisms for the crypt doors. A character who can read Draconic sees the letters {@i a} through {@i z} in Draconic on each circle.
zh_tw: 鉑金圓圈是墓穴門的鎖定機制。能夠讀懂龍語的角色可以在每個圓圈上看到龍語的字母表從{@i a}到{@i z}。

english: When the three concentric rings are aligned so they spell the word "die" in Draconic, the crypt doors unlock. This combination can be found in {@area areas T19|3cc|x} and {@area T23|3da|x}. Alternatively, a character using thieves' tools can spend 1 minute trying to unlock the doors, doing so with a successful {@dc 25} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. A {@spell Knock} spell or similar magic also unlocks the doors.
zh_tw: 當三個同心環對齊時，它們會在龍語中拼寫出單詞"死亡"，墓室的門就會解鎖。這個組合可以在 {@area 區域T19|3cc|x} 和 {@area T23|3da|x} 中找到。另外，使用盜賊工具的角色可以花費 1 分鐘嘗試解鎖門，成功透過 {@dc 25} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定即可。使用 {@spell Knock||敲擊術} 或類似魔法也可以解鎖門。

english: Knockout-Gas Trap
zh_tw: 昏迷氣體陷阱

english: If the double door is opened via any other means besides the correct combination, a cloud of sweet-smelling gas is released from the skull engraving. The gas fills the widened area immediately south of the double door. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition unconscious} condition for {@dice 2d4 + 10} minutes. An {@condition unconscious} creature can repeat this saving throw each time it takes damage, ending the effect on itself on a successful save.
zh_tw: 如果雙門透過除正確組合之外的任何其他方式被開啟，會從頭骨雕刻中釋放出一團香甜的氣體。這團氣體會立即充滿雙門正南方向的擴寬區域。該區域的每個生物必須成功透過一次 {@dc 20} 體質豁免檢定，否則將獲得 {@condition unconscious||昏迷} 狀態，持續 {@dice 2d4 + 10} 分鐘。一個 {@condition unconscious||昏迷} 的生物每次受到傷害時都可以重複進行這項豁免檢定，成功透過檢定將結束自身的效果。

english: T26: Crypt
zh_tw: T26: 墓穴

english: Six stone pedestals stand near the walls of this expansive room. From left to right, they bear a blue scarf, a golden ring, a glittering scimitar, an ebony wand wrapped with feathers and bone, a set of engraved copper sheets, and a crystal ball made of rose quartz.
zh_tw: 六座石制基座位於這個寬敞房間的牆壁附近。從左到右，它們分別放置著一條藍色的圍巾、一枚金色的戒指、一把閃閃發光的彎刀、一根纏繞著羽毛和骨頭的烏木魔杖、一套雕刻的銅板，以及一個由玫瑰石英制成的水晶球。

english: At the room's center looms a black throne, upon which sits a skeleton dressed in luxurious robes and headdress. A platinum door stands behind the throne.
zh_tw: 房間中央聳立著一個黑色的寶座，上面坐著一個穿著奢華長袍和頭飾的骷髏。寶座後面有一扇鉑金門。

english: The figure sitting on the throne is Rerak, a {@creature false lich|VEoR} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}). Although alert, Rerak remains motionless until he takes damage or a creature moves within 15 feet of him, at which point he becomes hostile and attacks.
zh_tw: 坐在寶座上的人物是瑞拉克，一個{@creature false lich|VEoR|假巫妖}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）。雖然警覺，但瑞拉克一直保持靜止，直到他受到傷害或有生物移動到他15尺範圍內，此時他會變得敵對並進行攻擊。

english: Appeasing Rerak
zh_tw: 安撫雷拉克

english: Upon creation, Rerak was magically bound to Acererak's piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}; as long as the rod piece remains within the tomb, so must Rerak. Rerak resents his creator for leaving him to languish within this tomb, and though he remains loyal to Acererak, he longs to experience the world beyond the tomb's walls.
zh_tw: 瑞拉克在被創造時就被魔法束縛在阿瑟瑞克的七分之一的{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}上；只要法杖部分留在墳墓內，瑞拉克也必須如此。瑞拉克對他的創造者因將他留在墳墓中而感到怨恨，儘管他仍然忠於阿瑟瑞克，但他渴望體驗墳墓牆壁之外的世界。

english: Throughout the fight, Rerak commands the characters to flee. Each time Rerak does this, each character can make a {@dc 19} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check without taking an action. On a successful check, the character discerns a melancholy tone to Rerak's words, as if he loathed that he must kill them.
zh_tw: 在整個戰鬥中，雷拉克命令角色們逃跑。每次雷拉克這樣做時，每個角色都可以在不採取行動的情況下進行一次 {@dc 19} 感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定。如果檢定成功，角色會察覺到雷拉克話語中的憂鬱語氣，彷彿他厭惡必須殺死他們。

english: During combat, a character can use an action to try to convince Rerak to turn against his creator. Have that character make a {@dc 23} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check. If the character mentions the mirages or Acererak's disdain toward his creations (found in the notes in {@area area T23|3da|x}), this check is made with advantage. On a successful check, Rerak's loyalty to Acererak is shaken. After three successful checks, Rerak halts the battle and crushes his eye sockets' gems, severing his connection to Acererak and releasing any souls trapped within.
zh_tw: 在戰鬥中，角色可以使用一個動作嘗試說服雷拉克背叛他的創造者。讓該角色進行一次 {@dc 23} 魅力 ({@skill Persuasion||說服}) 檢定。如果角色提到幻象或阿塞拉克對他造物的蔑視（可在 {@area 區域T23|3da|x} 的筆記中找到），該檢定帶有優勢。檢定成功時，雷拉克對阿塞拉克的忠誠動搖。三次成功的檢定時，雷拉克停止戰鬥並粉碎自己眼窩中的寶石，切斷與阿塞拉克的聯絡並釋放其中被困的靈魂。

english: Rerak's Secret
zh_tw: 瑞拉克的秘密

english: If the characters convince Rerak to turn against Acererak and talk with the false lich about his imprisonment in the tomb or his mistreatment at the archlich's hands, Rerak reveals how unhappy and lonely he has been for centuries. Rerak also reveals that as far back as his earliest memory, the false lich never truly wanted to fulfill Acererak's will.
zh_tw: 如果角色們說服瑞拉克反抗阿瑟瑞克，並與假巫妖談論他在墳墓中的囚禁或在大巫妖手中受到的虐待，瑞拉克透露了他幾個世紀以來是多麼的不快樂和孤獨。瑞拉克還透露，據他最早的記憶所知，假巫妖從未真正想要實現阿瑟瑞克的意志。

english: Regardless of the characters' reaction to this revelation, learning it counts as a secret for the purposes of the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
zh_tw: 無論角色們對這個揭示有何反應，瞭解它都算作本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則的秘密。

english: False Treasures
zh_tw: 假寶藏

english: The items on the pedestals are false re-creations of treasures that can be found throughout the complex. A creature that touches one of these false treasures must immediately succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@dice 3d6}) necrotic damage and have the {@condition stunned} condition until the start of its next turn.
zh_tw: 基座上的物品是整個建築群中可找到寶物的偽造品。接觸這些偽造寶物的生物必須立即進行一次 {@dc 15} 體質豁免，若失敗則受到 10 ({@dice 3d6}) 點暗蝕傷害，並在其下個回合開始前陷入 {@condition stunned||震懾} 狀態。

english: Keys
zh_tw: 鑰匙

english: Rerak carries two keys: a platinum key shaped like a skeleton that unlocks the door to the crypt's vault (area T27) and a plain iron key that unlocks the secret compartment in {@area area T23|3da|x}. Characters who defeat Rerak find the keys amid his dusty remains.
zh_tw: 瑞拉克攜帶著兩把鑰匙：一把形狀像骷髏的鉑金鑰匙，可以開啟墓穴金庫（區域T27）的門；另一把普通的鐵鑰匙，可以開啟在{@area 區域T23|3da|x}的秘密隔間。擊敗瑞拉克的角色可以在他塵土飛揚的遺物中找到這些鑰匙。

english: If the characters convinced Rerak to turn against his creator, Rerak provides the keys willingly.
zh_tw: 如果角色們說服瑞拉克反抗他的創造者，瑞拉克會自願提供鑰匙。

english: The false lich Rerak is a terrifying sight to behold
zh_tw: 假巫妖瑞拉克是一個令人恐懼的景象

english: T27: Crypt Vault
zh_tw: T27: 墓穴金庫

english: The door to the crypt vault is locked and protected by magical wards. It can be unlocked only with the platinum skeleton key in Rerak's possession. A creature that attempts to open the vault by any other means must make a {@dc 25} Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 ({@dice 8d6}) force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 通往墓穴寶庫的門被鎖住並受到魔法結界的保護。只有雷拉克所擁有的鉑金骷髏鑰匙才能開啟它。任何試圖透過其他方式開啟寶庫的生物都必須進行一次 {@dc 25} 敏捷豁免檢定，豁免失敗則受到 28（{@dice 8d6}）點力場傷害，豁免成功則只受到一半的傷害。

english: The {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|sixth piece} of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} rests on the pedestal.
zh_tw: {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|第六塊部件}的{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}放置在基座上。

english: Coins and precious stones are strewn across this vault's floor. A rod piece rests atop a pedestal draped with a blue silk sash embroidered with gold thread.
zh_tw: 硬幣和寶石散落在這個金庫的地板上。一個法杖的部分放在一個披著藍色絲綢腰帶的基座上，腰帶上繡有金線。

english: For more about the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, see this book's {@area introduction|00e|x}.
zh_tw: 關於{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的更多資訊，請參見本書的{@area 簡介|00e|x}。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: If a character shows the silk sash to Laysa, she identifies it as a garment given to her people that functions as a {@item Robe of Stars}. The robe is one of the treasures Laysa mentioned earlier in this chapter.
zh_tw: 如果一個角色將絲綢腰帶展示給萊莎，她會認出這是給她的人民的一件衣服，作為{@item Robe of Stars||星辰法袍}使用。這件長袍是萊莎在本章早些時候提到的寶藏之一。

english: The mundane treasure within the vault includes the following:
zh_tw: 金庫中普通的寶藏包括以下內容：

english: 479 sp, 342 gp, and 179 pp
zh_tw: 479個銀幣，342個金幣和179個鉑金幣

english: Jade game board with platinum playing pieces, worth 7,500 gp in total
zh_tw: 翡翠遊戲棋盤，配有白金棋子，總價值7500金幣

english: Set of ruby earrings worth 500 gp
zh_tw: 一套價值500 gp的紅寶石耳環

english: Three fire opals worth 1,000 gp each
zh_tw: 三顆火蛋白石，每顆價值1000金幣

english: Exit
zh_tw: 出口

english: The door in the middle of the north wall is locked and can be unlocked only by using Rerak's platinum skeleton key. The door opens into a cave tunnel that leads to the beach, about 1 mile south of the archaeologists' camp.
zh_tw: 北牆中間的門被鎖住了，只能使用瑞拉克的鉑金骷髏鑰匙才能開啟。門開啟後通向一個洞穴隧道，該隧道通往海灘，大約位於考古學家營地以南1英里處。

english: Next Steps
zh_tw: 下一步

english: Once they've left the Tomb of Wayward Souls, the characters can return to the archaeologists' camp without incident. Laysa celebrates the characters' safe return; if the characters brought back any of the ancestral treasures she's been searching for, Laysa pays them as promised.
zh_tw: 一旦他們離開了迷失靈魂之墓，角色們可以平安無事地返回考古學家的營地。萊莎慶祝角色們安全歸來；如果角色們帶回了她一直在尋找的任何祖傳寶藏，萊莎會如約支付他們報酬。

english: If Rerak is with the party, he volunteers to lend his knowledge of the tomb to help the archaeologists in their excavation. The archaeologists are apprehensive but nonetheless accept his aid.
zh_tw: 如果瑞拉克與隊伍在一起，他主動提供自己對墳墓的知識，幫助考古學家進行挖掘。考古學家雖然有所顧慮，但仍然接受了他的幫助。

english: While Rerak aids the archaeologists, he doesn't hurt them. Rerak won't return to Sigil with the characters; the simulacrum worries that the magic that sustains him might extinguish if he leaves Oerth. Rerak hopes to make a home on the Isle of Serpents with anyone who welcomes him.
zh_tw: 當雷拉克幫助考古學家時，他不會傷害他們。雷拉克不會與角色們一起返回法印城。這個模擬生物擔心，如果他離開奧斯特，維持他存在的魔法可能會熄滅。雷拉克希望在蛇島上與任何歡迎他的人一起安家。

english: The characters can return to Sigil through the doorway near the lagoon at their leisure.
zh_tw: 角色們可以隨意透過位於瀉湖附近的門返回法印城。

english: Chapter 8: The Dragon Queen's Pride
zh_tw: 第8章：龍后之傲

english: The heroes' quest for the final rod piece takes them into a casino in the heart of Avernus
zh_tw: 英雄們尋找最後一塊法杖碎片的探險將他們帶到了阿弗納斯的中心地帶的賭場

english: The adventurers discover that the final piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} is in the heart of Avernus, the first layer of the Nine Hells. The characters must infiltrate a diabolical casino dedicated to Tiamat, Queen of Evil Dragons, whose lair is nearby.
zh_tw: 冒險家們發現{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的最後部分位於阿弗納斯的核心，這是九層地獄的第一層。角色們必須潛入一個專門供奉邪惡龍後提亞馬特的惡魔賭場，她的巢穴就在附近。

english: Running This Chapter
zh_tw: 運作本章

english: This chapter begins after the characters retrieve the sixth piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}. A character who holds this piece knows instinctively that the seventh piece is located somewhere inside a casino called the Red Belvedere in Avernus. The Wizards Three warn the characters that finding this location might be difficult since the Nine Hells are impossible to map and difficult to traverse.
zh_tw: 這一章開始於角色們取回{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第六部分之後。持有這部分的角色本能地知道第七部分位於阿弗納斯一個名為紅亭臺的賭場內。三巫師警告角色們，找到這個位置可能很困難，因為九層地獄無法繪製地圖，且難以穿越。

english: Once the characters enter Avernus, they must hitch a ride on an infernal war machine and traverse the hellish landscape to reach the Red Belvedere. The characters must manipulate the Fiends in the casino's highest ranks to enter the exclusive Ruby Sanctum, then fight Tiamat's champion—or convince Tiamat to give up the final rod piece.
zh_tw: 一旦角色們進入阿弗納斯，他們必須搭乘一臺地獄戰爭機器，穿越地獄般的景觀，以到達紅亭臺。角色們必須操縱賭場中最高等級的惡魔，以進入獨家的紅寶石聖所，然後與提亞馬特的冠軍戰鬥——或者說服提亞馬特放棄最後一塊法杖碎片。

english: Character Advancement
zh_tw: 角色升級

english: The characters should be 17th level when this chapter begins. They gain a level once they retrieve the seventh and final piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} from the casino's Ruby Sanctum.
zh_tw: 當這一章節開始時，角色們應該是17級。一旦他們從賭場的紅寶石聖所中取回{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的第七個也是最後一塊碎片，他們就會升一級。

english: Power of Secrets
zh_tw: 秘密的力量

english: The individuals the characters meet in Avernus are primarily Fiends and other unpleasant beings. As a rule, these creatures lack the remorse, guilt, and shame that would give their secrets power if revealed to the characters. The characters don't learn any secrets applicable to the rules in "{@area The Power of Secrets|028|x}" section found in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}, though they can spend secrets during this chapter normally.
zh_tw: 角色們在阿弗納斯遇到的個體主要是惡魔和其他不愉快的生物。通常，這些生物缺乏悔恨、內疚和羞恥感，如果這些秘密被揭露給角色們，它們將具有力量。角色們在這個章節中不會學到適用於本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中"{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}"部分規則的任何秘密，儘管他們可以像平常一樣在這一章中使用秘密。

english: Seventh Rod Piece
zh_tw: 第七部分法杖

english: The final piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} is in {@area area N5|45b|x} in the Ruby Sanctum, located in the Dragon's Pride area of the Red Belvedere casino. For more information about the rod and the spell this rod piece allows its wielder to cast, see this book's {@area introduction|00e|x}.
zh_tw: {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的最後部分位於紅寶石聖所的{@area 區域N5|45b|x}，該聖所在紅亭臺賭場的龍后之傲區域。有關該法杖及其允許持有者施放的法術的更多資訊，請參見本書的{@area 簡介|00e|x}。

english: Avernus
zh_tw: 阿弗納斯

english: This chapter takes place in Avernus, the first layer of the Nine Hells of Baator.
zh_tw: 這一章發生在阿弗納斯，巴託九層地獄的第一層。

english: Knowledge of Avernus
zh_tw: 阿弗納斯的知識

english: Characters who research Avernus in Sigil can learn the following:
zh_tw: 在法印城研究阿弗納斯的角色可以瞭解到以下資訊：

english: Blood War
zh_tw: 血戰

english: Avernus is a major battlefield for the Blood War, the raging conflict between demons and devils. It would be fruitless to fight every Fiend the characters come across in Avernus, since conflicts invariably escalate as infernal combatants join in against interlopers in the Nine Hells. To accomplish their goals, the characters might need to work with Fiends.
zh_tw: 阿弗納斯是血戰的主要戰場，這是惡魔和魔鬼之間激烈的衝突。在阿弗納斯遇到的每一個惡魔都與之戰鬥是沒有意義的，因為隨著地獄戰士加入對抗九層地獄的入侵者，衝突不斷升級。為了實現他們的目標，角色們可能需要與惡魔合作。

english: Environment
zh_tw: 環境

english: Avernus is a hellscape in the most literal sense: a ravaged battlefield littered with decaying carcasses and wrecked war machines. A foul haze perpetually shrouds the skies. Ambient light swells above the horizon in a grim mockery of a sunset, but the sky is bereft of celestial bodies. Searing gusts of wind blast across the landscape, reeking of ash and brimstone. Due to this perpetual smoky twilight, there are no real days or nights in Avernus. Time passes as usual, though, and can be tracked in hour increments.
zh_tw: 阿弗納斯在最字面的意義上是地獄般的景象：一片被蹂躪的戰場，到處都是腐爛的屍體和被摧毀的戰爭機器。一股惡臭的霧霾永久地籠罩著天空。地平線上的背景光膨脹，形成了對日落的陰森嘲弄，但天空中沒有天體。灼熱的風帶著灰燼和硫磺的惡臭橫掃整個景觀。由於這種永恆的煙霧暮光，阿弗納斯沒有真正的白天或夜晚。然而，時間仍然像往常一樣流逝，並且可以按小時遞增來追蹤。

english: History
zh_tw: 歷史

english: Long ago, Avernus was a tantalizing paradise created by the archdevil Asmodeus to tempt mortals. However, the incursion of the River Styx and hordes of demons ruined that paradise, leaving behind gore and destruction.
zh_tw: 很久以前，阿弗納斯是由大惡魔阿斯蒙蒂斯創造的一個誘人的天堂，用來誘惑凡人。然而，冥河斯蒂克斯的入侵和成群的惡魔破壞了那個天堂，留下了血腥和毀滅。

english: Queen of Dragons
zh_tw: 龍之女王

english: Tiamat is the five-headed progenitor of the chromatic dragons in some realms and embodies the vices of evil dragonkind. Her lair is located in Avernus, connected to numerous monuments and temples scattered across the hellscape.
zh_tw: 提亞馬特是某些領域中色彩龍的五頭始祖，體現了邪惡龍族的惡行。她的巢穴位於阿弗納斯，與遍佈地獄景觀的眾多紀念碑和寺廟相連。

english: Spell Modifications
zh_tw: 法術修改

english: Drenched in the eldritch energy of the Nine Hells, Avernus warps magic used within its borders. At your discretion, a spell can be cosmetically modified to demonstrate the corruption of Avernus; these modifications don't change the spell's mechanical effects. The following are some examples:
zh_tw: 阿弗納斯沉浸在九層地獄的古老能量中，扭曲了在其邊界內使用的魔法。根據您的判斷，一個法術可以被外觀上修改，以展示阿弗納斯的腐敗；這些修改不會改變法術的機械效果。以下是一些例子：

english: {@spell Hunter's Mark}. A spectral crown of spiked iron encircles the target's head.
zh_tw: {@spell Hunter's Mark||獵人印記}。一個帶有尖刺的鐵製幽靈皇冠環繞在目標的頭部。

english: {@spell Mage Hand}. The conjured hand takes the shape of a taloned claw.
zh_tw: {@spell Mage Hand||法師之手}。召喚出的手呈現出爪形。

english: {@spell Magic Missile}. The missiles emit a haunting wail when fired.
zh_tw: {@spell Magic Missile||魔法飛彈}。當發射時，飛彈會發出令人毛骨悚然的哀嚎聲。

english: Traversing Avernus
zh_tw: 穿越阿弗納斯

english: Avernus warps the senses, making distance impossible to gauge. The Wizards Three can't be sure where the characters will emerge in Avernus from the portal in Sigil, so they'll have to find their way to their destination. Residents of Avernus use vehicles known as infernal war machines to make trips more manageable. The Wizards Three suggest that the characters might be able to reach the Red Belvedere by using or commandeering one of these vehicles.
zh_tw: 阿弗納斯扭曲了感知，使得距離變得難以估量。三巫師無法確定角色們將從法印城的傳送門出現在阿弗納斯的哪個位置，所以他們必須找到通往目的地的路。阿弗納斯的居民使用被稱為地獄戰爭機器的車輛來使旅行更加容易。三巫師建議角色們可能可以透過使用或奪取這些車輛之一來到達紅亭臺。

english: Descending into Avernus
zh_tw: 降臨阿弗納斯

english: When the characters step through the portal in Sigil, they emerge along a shelf in a mountainside cliff. Read or paraphrase the following to set the scene:
zh_tw: 當角色們穿過位於法印城的傳送門時，他們出現在山腰的一個巖架上。請閱讀或轉述以下內容以設定場景：

english: Shrieking gusts of hot air assault your senses as you step into Avernus. Miasmic clouds roil over a ravaged landscape of broken rocks, bleached bones, and jagged metal. The dusty atmosphere reeks of sulfur and tar.
zh_tw: 當你踏入阿弗納斯時，尖叫的熱風衝擊著你的感官。瘴氣雲層在破碎的岩石、漂白的骨頭和鋸齒狀的金屬構成的荒蕪景象上翻滾。多塵的大氣散發著硫磺和焦油的惡臭。

english: The characters know they need to travel to the Red Belvedere, but they don't know where the casino is located. The warped nature of the Nine Hells defies all mapping attempts, so the characters must figure out how to get to their destination.
zh_tw: 角色們知道他們需要前往紅亭臺，但他們不知道賭場位於何處。九層地獄的扭曲本質使所有制圖嘗試都變得無效，因此角色們必須弄清楚如何到達他們的目的地。

english: If consulted, the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} points away from the mountains and down the cliff, where a rough path skirts the cliff's base.
zh_tw: 如果被諮詢，{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}指向遠離山脈的方向，沿著懸崖而下，那裡有一條崎嶇的小路沿著懸崖底部延伸。

english: Hell of a Ride
zh_tw: 地獄之旅

english: The erinyes roam the blasted landscape in a vehicle called the Venatrix
zh_tw: 罪魔在荒蕪的景觀中漫遊，乘坐一種名為捕食者的車輛

english: The characters can descend the cliff without trouble. Once they do, they catch the attention of a crew of scavengers. Read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 角色們可以毫無困難地下降懸崖。一旦他們這麼做，就會吸引一群拾荒者的注意。請閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: Out of the red dust clouds barrels an angular metal vehicle, ten feet tall, with spiked tires and hellfire roaring in its engine. Tortured screams issue from its furnace. The vehicle slows to a halt, and a winged silhouette jumps out and waves at you.
zh_tw: 從紅色的塵埃雲中衝出一輛稜角分明的金屬車輛，高十尺，帶有帶刺的輪胎，引擎中咆哮著地獄之火。痛苦的尖叫聲從它的爐子裡發出。車輛減速停下，一個帶翅膀的輪廓跳出並向你揮手。

english: The infernal war machine {@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR} has room for four Medium or smaller creatures to ride inside the vehicle, including its driver, and for four Medium or smaller creatures to ride in its upper, open-air area. Three {@creature erinyes} crew the {@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR}: Nykaia, who leaps out to greet the characters, and Kypris and Mykale, who are inside.
zh_tw: 該地獄戰爭機器{@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR|捕食者}內部有足夠空間供四隻中等大小或更小的生物乘坐，包括其駕駛員，並且在其上部開放式區域還可以供四隻中等大小或更小的生物乘坐。三名{@creature erinyes||罪魔}組成了{@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR|捕食者}的船員：妮凱雅，她跳出車外向角色們打招呼，而凱普莉絲和米凱爾則在車內。

english: Nykaia is the group's glib and calculating leader, Kypris is their unflappable engineer and driver, and Mykale is their overeager weapons specialist. The three devils travel the wasteland of Avernus harvesting scrap metal and other valuable materials. The group is searching for additional crew members to aid them in their latest score.
zh_tw: 妮凱雅是這個團隊機智而又精明的領袖，凱普莉絲是他們沉著冷靜的工程師兼駕駛員，米凱爾則是他們過於急切的武器專家。這三個惡魔在阿弗納斯的荒原上游蕩，收集廢金屬和其他有價值的材料。這個團隊正在尋找額外的船員來幫助他們完成他們最新的計劃。

english: Seeing that the characters lack a vehicle, Nykaia offers them a deal: if the characters help her with a job, she and her crew will give them a ride to wherever they'd like. If the characters refuse, skip to the "{@area Stop for Directions|406|x}" section.
zh_tw: 妮凱雅注意到角色們沒有交通工具，於是提出一個交易：如果角色們幫她完成一項工作，她和她的船員將帶他們去任何他們想去的地方。如果角色們拒絕，跳轉到"{@area 停下來問路|406|x}"部分。

english: The three erinyes are hoping to take down a {@creature goristro}: a minotaur-like demon that carries demonic legions and rare treasures through the battlefields of the Blood War. They need someone to focus on the goristro while they take out the soldiers on its back.
zh_tw: 這三位罪魔希望擊敗一隻{@creature goristro||巨牛魔}：一種類似牛頭人的惡魔，它在血戰的戰場上攜帶著惡魔軍團和稀有寶藏。她們需要有人專注於對付巨牛魔，而她們則負責消滅它背上的士兵。

english: Nykaia knows about the Red Belvedere but refuses to provide any more information until the characters help with the goristro. If the characters agree to her deal, she welcomes them aboard the {@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR}. Nykaia isn't hostile toward the characters and won't attack them unless the characters threaten her or start a fight.
zh_tw: 妮凱雅知道紅亭臺的情況，但在角色們幫助處理巨牛魔之前，她拒絕提供更多資訊。如果角色們同意她的交易，她歡迎他們登上{@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR|捕食者}。妮凱雅對角色們沒有敵意，除非角色們威脅她或開始戰鬥，否則她不會攻擊他們。

english: If the characters attack Nykaia or attempt to take the {@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR} by force, Kypris and Mykale emerge from the war machine and join the fight. If the erinyes are in danger of losing the fight, they surrender and beg the characters to spare them, offering to drive the characters to the Red Belvedere in exchange.
zh_tw: 如果角色們攻擊妮凱雅或試圖強行奪取{@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR|捕食者}，凱普莉絲和米凱爾會從戰爭機器中出現並加入戰鬥。如果罪魔處於輸掉戰鬥的危險中，她們會投降並懇求角色們饒恕她們，提出作為交換條件，駕駛角色們前往紅色貝爾維德爾。

english: Driving the Venatrix
zh_tw: 駕駛捕食者

english: The following rules are an adjusted, condensed version of the {@adventure infernal war machine rules|BGDIA|11|Rules} found in {@adventure Baldur's Gate: Descent into Avernus|BGDIA}.
zh_tw: 以下規則是{@adventure 地獄戰爭機器規則|BGDIA|11|Rules}的調整和簡化版本，可在{@adventure 博德之門：墜入阿弗納斯|BGDIA}中找到。

english: Driving
zh_tw: 駕駛

english: The helm of an infernal war machine is a chair with a wheel, levers, pedals, and other controls. The helm requires a driver to operate.
zh_tw: 地獄戰爭機器的駕駛艙是一把帶有輪子、操縱桿、踏板和其他控制裝置的椅子。駕駛艙需要一名駕駛員來操作。

english: While the {@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR}'s engine is on, the driver can use an action to propel the vehicle up to its speed (see the "Vehicle Statistics" section below) or bring the vehicle to a dead stop. While the vehicle is moving, the driver can steer it along any course.
zh_tw: 當{@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR|捕食者}的引擎開啟時，駕駛員可以使用動作將車輛推進至其速度（見下文的"車輛統計"部分），或者使車輛完全停止。在車輛移動時，駕駛員可以沿著任何路線駕駛它。

english: If the driver has the {@condition incapacitated} condition, leaves the helm, or does nothing to alter the {@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR}'s course and speed, the vehicle moves in the same direction and at the same speed it did during the driver's last turn until it hits an obstacle big enough to stop it.
zh_tw: 如果駕駛員處於{@condition incapacitated||無力}狀態，離開駕駛艙，或者沒有采取任何措施改變{@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR|捕食者}的路線和速度，車輛將以駕駛員上次回合時相同的方向和速度繼續移動，直到它撞到足夠大的障礙物為止。

english: As a bonus action, the driver can do one of the following:
zh_tw: 駕駛員可以用一個附贈動作做出如下行為之一：

english: Start the {@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR}'s engine or shut it off.
zh_tw: 啟動{@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR|捕食者}的引擎或將其關閉。

english: Cause the {@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR} to take the {@action Dash} or {@action Disengage} action while the vehicle's engine is running
zh_tw: 在車輛引擎執行時，使{@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR|捕食者}執行{@action Dash||疾走}或{@action Disengage||撤離}動作

english: Insert a {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA} into the engine's furnace
zh_tw: 將一個{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}插入引擎的爐膛中

english: Soul Fuel
zh_tw: 靈魂燃料

english: The Venatrix's engine has a furnace fueled by {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|Soul Coins} (described later in this chapter). Among the vehicle's helm controls is a narrow slot into which Soul Coins can be fed. The vehicle's furnace consumes a Soul Coin instantly, expending all the coin's remaining charges at once and destroying the coin in the process. The soul trapped in the coin becomes trapped in the furnace instead, giving the vehicle 24 hours of fuel for each charge the Soul Coin had when it was consumed (maximum 72 hours). The furnace can hold any number of souls, their screams of anguish audible out to a range of 60 feet.
zh_tw: 捕食者的引擎有一個由{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}（本章後文描述）驅動的熔爐。載具的舵板控制裝置中有一個狹窄的插槽，可以將靈魂幣投入其中。載具的熔爐會立即消耗一枚靈魂幣，一次性耗盡硬幣的所有剩餘充能並在過程中摧毀硬幣。被困在硬幣中的靈魂轉而被困在熔爐中，為載具提供每枚靈魂幣被消耗時所擁有的充能對應的24小時燃料（最多72小時）。熔爐可以容納任意數量的靈魂，它們的痛苦尖叫聲可在60尺範圍內聽到。

english: The {@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR} currently has enough soul fuel to run for 60 hours.
zh_tw: {@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR|捕食者}目前擁有足夠的靈魂燃料可以執行60小時。

english: Vehicle Statistics
zh_tw: 車輛具體數值

english: The Venatrix is a Gargantuan vehicle that can hold eight Medium creatures and carry up to 1 ton of cargo. It has a speed of 100 feet; AC 19; a damage threshold of 10; 200 hit points; immunity to fire, poison, and psychic damage; and a {@d20 4} bonus to Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
zh_tw: 捕食者是一種超巨型載具，可以容納八名中等體型生物並載重最多1噸貨物。它具有100尺的速度；AC 19；傷害閾值為10；200點生命值；對火焰、毒素和心靈傷害免疫；並且在力量和敏捷豁免檢定上具有{@d20 4}的加值。

english: Weapon Stations
zh_tw: 武器操作檯

english: The Venatrix is equipped with two harpoon guns and an infernal screamer, which is a writhing humanoid torso made of melting wax with a barbed hand crank between its shoulder blades. The weapons are mounted to the vehicle's exterior, so any creature riding on the outside of the vehicle can operate a weapon. Each weapon station requires one creature to operate it.
zh_tw: 捕食者配備了兩門魚叉槍和一種地獄尖叫者，後者是一個由熔化的蠟製成的扭曲人形軀幹，在它的肩胛骨之間有一個帶刺的手搖曲柄。這些武器安裝在車輛的外部，因此任何騎在車輛外部的生物都可以操作一種武器。每個武器站需要一個生物來操作。

english: A creature operating a harpoon gun can use an action to make a ranged weapon attack with it ({@hit 6} to hit, range 120 ft., one target). On a hit, the harpoon deals 10 ({@dice 2d8 + 1}) piercing damage.
zh_tw: 一個操作魚叉槍的生物可以使用一個動作用它進行一次遠端武器攻擊（{@hit 6}命中，範圍120尺，單一目標）。命中時，魚叉造成10（{@dice 2d8 + 1}）穿刺傷害。

english: A creature operating the infernal screamer can use an action to turn its crank, unleashing a telepathic shriek of agony at one target the creature can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw, taking 26 ({@dice 4d12}) psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 操控地獄尖嘯者的生物可以使用一個動作來轉動其曲柄，向一個它可以看到且在其120尺內的目標釋放一聲心靈痛苦的尖叫。目標必須進行一次{@dc 15}感知豁免，豁免失敗將受到26({@dice 4d12})點心靈傷害，豁免成功則只受一半傷害。

english: Goristro Raid
zh_tw: 巨牛魔突襲

english: This encounter occurs only if the characters teamed up with the {@creature erinyes} in the previous encounter. If the characters instead defeated the erinyes and claimed the {@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR} for themselves or bypassed the erinyes entirely, skip to the "{@area Stop for Directions|406|x}" section.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在之前的遭遇中與{@creature erinyes||罪魔}聯手，才會發生這次遭遇。如果角色們擊敗了罪魔併為自己奪取了{@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR|捕食者}，或者完全繞過了罪魔，那麼請跳至"{@area 停下來問路|406|x}"部分。

english: It takes about an hour for the {@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR} to travel to the goristro's location. As the {@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR} approaches the goristro, read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 到達巨牛魔所在位置大約需要{@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR|捕食者}行駛一個小時。當{@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR|捕食者}接近巨牛魔時，請閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: Thunderous footsteps shake the ground as you approach a horned, red-furred demon over twenty feet tall. Two winged shapes flank its towering form. On its back is a tented palanquin occupied by demonic soldiers swarming like insects.
zh_tw: 當你接近一個身高超過二十尺、長著角和紅色皮毛的惡魔時，雷鳴般的腳步震撼著大地。兩個有翼的身影圍繞著它高聳的形態。它的背上是一個帳篷式的轎子，裡面擠滿了像昆蟲一樣成群的惡魔士兵。

english: The hulking {@creature goristro} is flanked by two {@creature Vrock||vrocks}. Inside the goristro's palanquin are two {@creature Hezrou||hezrous} and five {@creature Quasit||quasits}, as well as the "treasure" that the {@creature erinyes} are after: a {@creature unicorn} named Sterling in an iron cage.
zh_tw: 這個龐大的{@creature goristro||巨牛魔}兩側各有一個{@creature Vrock||鷲魔}。在巨牛魔的轎子裡有兩隻{@creature Hezrou||狂蟾魔}和五隻{@creature Quasit||小惡魔}，還有{@creature erinyes||罪魔}所追求的"寶藏"：一個名叫斯特林的被關在鐵籠中的{@creature unicorn||獨角獸}。

english: Nykaia explains that Kypris will drive the war machine close to the goristro. The three erinyes will then fly to the palanquin to defeat the demons within while the characters slay the goristro.
zh_tw: 妮凱雅解釋說，凱普莉絲將駕駛戰爭機器靠近巨牛魔。然後，三個罪魔將飛到轎子那裡，擊敗裡面的惡魔，而角色們則殺死巨牛魔。

english: The goristro defends itself. If the vrocks see that the goristro is losing, they join the fight. The three erinyes easily dispatch the demons in the palanquin.
zh_tw: 巨牛魔自衛。如果鷲魔s看到巨牛魔正在失利，它們會加入戰鬥。三個罪魔輕鬆擊敗轎子裡的惡魔。

english: True Treasure Revealed
zh_tw: 真寶藏揭示

english: Once combat finishes, the three erinyes carry down their claimed treasure:
zh_tw: 戰鬥結束後，三名罪魔攜帶著她們所宣稱的寶藏：

english: A large cage lands with a thud before the vehicle. Through the iron bars, you see the white fur and gilded mane of a unicorn as it nickers in fear.
zh_tw: 一個巨大的籠子在車輛前重重地落下。透過鐵欄杆，你看到一隻獨角獸的白色皮毛和金色的鬃毛，它在恐懼中嘶鳴。

english: Mykale excitedly explains that a unicorn's horn is a highly valuable ritual ingredient that will ingratiate the erinyes with powerful infernal war leaders. The unicorn desperately wishes to be freed and says as much in Celestial and Elvish.
zh_tw: 米凱爾興奮地解釋說，獨角獸的角是一種非常有價值的儀式材料，它將使罪魔得到強大的地獄戰爭領袖的青睞。獨角獸絕望地希望被釋放，並用天界語和精靈語表達了這一點。

english: Characters who try to convince the erinyes to release the unicorn must make a {@dc 30} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check. If the characters offer a rare or rarer magic item in exchange for Sterling's freedom, this check is made with advantage. On a successful check, the erinyes give the characters custody of Sterling. If the characters attempt to take Sterling by force, the erinyes become hostile and attack.
zh_tw: 試圖說服復仇女神釋放獨角獸的角色必須進行一次 {@dc 30} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定。如果角色提供了一件稀有或更稀有的魔法物品作為交換斯特林自由的代價，此檢定將獲得優勢。檢定成功時，復仇女神會將斯特林的監護權交給角色。如果角色試圖強行帶走斯特林，復仇女神將變得敵對並發動攻擊。

english: With Sterling (or a traded magic item) now in their possession, the three erinyes uphold their end of the deal and take the characters to the Red Belvedere. If the characters slay two of the erinyes, the third erinyes surrenders and offers to drive the characters to the Red Belvedere in exchange for her life.
zh_tw: 擁有斯特林（或交換的魔法物品）後，三名罪魔履行了她們的交易承諾，帶領角色們前往紅亭臺。如果角色們殺死了兩名罪魔，第三名罪魔會投降，並提出以她的生命為代價，駕駛角色們前往紅亭臺。

english: Stop for Directions
zh_tw: 停下來問路

english: If the characters are forced to search the plains and battlefields of Avernus for the Red Belvedere because they have no one to lead them there, have the party's navigator make a {@dc 20} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check at the end of every hour of travel. After each successful check, the characters find something to steer them in the right direction; determine the source of this help by rolling on the Stop for Directions table. After four successful checks, the characters locate the Red Belvedere.
zh_tw: 如果角色們因為沒有人帶領而被迫在阿弗納斯的平原和戰場上搜尋紅色觀景臺，讓隊伍的導航員在每小時的旅行結束時進行一次 {@dc 20} 感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定。每次成功檢定後，角色們會找到一些指引他們正確方向的東西；透過擲停靠方向表來確定這種幫助的來源。在四次成功檢定後，角色們會找到紅色觀景臺。

english: Stop for Directions
zh_tw: 停下來問路

english: d6
zh_tw: d6

english: Source of Help
zh_tw: 幫助的來源

english: An iron signpost in the middle of nowhere points in the direction of the Red Belvedere.
zh_tw: 在荒涼之地中間的一個鐵製路標指向紅亭臺的方向。

english: A friendly {@creature imp} knows the way to the Red Belvedere. After tagging along for an hour and giving directions, the imp turns {@condition invisible} and leaves.
zh_tw: 一個友好的{@creature imp||小魔鬼}知道通往紅亭臺的路。跟隨並指引方向一個小時後，這個小惡魔變得{@condition invisible||隱形}並離開了。

english: A {@creature ghost} doomed to wander the battlefields of Avernus points the way to the Red Belvedere.
zh_tw: 一個註定在阿弗納斯戰場上徘徊的{@creature ghost||幽魂}指引著通往紅亭臺的路。

english: An indifferent {@creature bearded devil} hitchhiker offers directions, preferably in exchange for food, drink, or a free ride.
zh_tw: 一個漠不關心的{@creature bearded devil||須魔}搭便車者提供方向指引，最好用食物、飲料或免費搭車作為交換。

english: The Red Belvedere
zh_tw: 紅亭臺

english: Eventually, the characters reach the Red Belvedere. The casino is a remnant of Avernus's original existence: a bucolic paradise designed to tempt mortal souls. Its edifice was destroyed in the carnage of the Blood War, but a champion of Tiamat named {@creature Windfall|VEoR} rebuilt the casino and rededicated it to the Dragon Queen as a celebration of her god's greed and vanity.
zh_tw: 最終，角色們到達了紅亭臺。這個賭場是阿弗納斯最初存在的遺蹟：一個設計來誘惑凡人靈魂的田園詩般的天堂。它的建築在血戰的屠殺中被摧毀，但提亞馬特的一名冠軍，名為{@creature Windfall|VEoR|意外之財}，重建了賭場，並將其重新奉獻給龍後，作為對她神的貪婪和虛榮的慶祝。

english: The Red Belvedere is more than a monument to the Dragon Queen. The casino is connected via a tunnel to Tiamat's lair, and Tiamat can hear every prayer and proclamation of her power uttered within the buildings' walls.
zh_tw: 紅亭臺不僅僅是龍後的紀念碑。這個賭場透過一條隧道與提亞馬特的巢穴相連，提亞馬特能聽到在這些建築牆內發出的每一個祈禱和對她力量的宣稱。

english: As the characters approach the Red Belvedere, read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 當角色們接近紅亭臺時，請閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: Jagged mountains give way to an unexpectedly beautiful sight: a sprawling, palatial complex glittering with silver and gold. Light dances through the front rotunda's red stained-glass dome, reflecting off the overcast sky to shower the buildings with a rosy glow. A carved stone sign at the front of the complex reads in numerous languages, "The Red Belvedere."
zh_tw: 參差不齊的山脈讓位給一個出人意料的美景：一個蔓延開來的宮殿式建築群，閃爍著銀光和金光。光線穿過前廳的紅色彩繪玻璃圓頂，反射在陰沉的天空上，給建築物披上了一層玫瑰色的光輝。建築群前面的一個雕刻石碑用多種語言寫著"紅亭臺"。

english: If the crew of the {@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR} is with the party, the erinyes bid the characters goodbye at the front of the casino.
zh_tw: 如果{@vehicle Venatrix|VEoR|捕食者}的船員與隊伍在一起，罪魔在賭場前向角色們告別。

english: Casino Lobby
zh_tw: 賭場大堂

english: The Red Belvedere's layout is shown on map 8.1.
zh_tw: 紅亭臺的佈局在地圖8.1上顯示。

english: Map 8.1: The Red Belvedere
zh_tw: 地圖 8.1：紅亭閣

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: When the characters first enter the casino's rotunda lobby, read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 當角色們首次進入賭場的圓頂大堂時，請閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: Sweet perfume and glittering lights chase away all evidence of the war-torn landscape outside. A gilded statue of a roaring dragon presides over the casino's lobby. Distantly, you hear clattering coins and patrons laughing in preternaturally deep voices.
zh_tw: 甜美的香水和閃爍的燈光碟機散了外面飽受戰爭蹂躪的景象。一尊鍍金的咆哮龍雕像主宰著賭場的大堂。遠處，你聽到硬幣的叮噹聲和顧客們以異常低沉的聲音笑著。

english: A winged tiefling soars above the spectacle. Patches of multicolored scales freckle her skin, and her prim tailcoat shimmers with every hue.
zh_tw: 一個長著翅膀的提夫林在壯觀的景象上方翱翔。她的皮膚上點綴著多彩的鱗片，她的正式燕尾服隨著每一個色彩閃爍。

english: The winged tiefling is {@creature Windfall|VEoR}, a champion of Tiamat and the proprietor of the Red Belvedere (see the accompanying stat block). A performer at heart, Windfall is ostentatious and charismatic, making small talk with regular patrons and jovially welcoming new faces to the casino.
zh_tw: 這個長著翅膀的提夫林是{@creature Windfall|VEoR|意外之財}，提亞馬特的冠軍以及紅亭臺的所有者（見隨附的統計資料塊）。作為一個天生的表演者，意外之財表現得非常炫耀和有魅力，與常客閒聊，並且熱情地歡迎新面孔來到賭場。

english: Meeting Windfall
zh_tw: 遇見意外之財

english: As a dedicated champion of Tiamat, {@creature Windfall|VEoR} has been granted phenomenal power by her master. Her skin glitters with patches of multicolored scales, and in combat, her blade sings with all five of the chromatic dragons' elements. Windfall's enchanted tailcoat shimmers with the colors of the Dragon Queen, and she uses this coat to dazzle patrons and enemies alike.
zh_tw: 作為提亞馬特的忠實冠軍，{@creature Windfall|VEoR|意外之財}被她的主人賦予了驚人的力量。她的皮膚閃爍著多彩鱗片的斑點，在戰鬥中，她的劍與五種色彩龍的元素一起歌唱。意外之財的魔法燕尾服閃爍著龍後的顏色，她用這件外套來迷惑顧客和敵人。

english: When the characters arrive at the Red Belvedere, Windfall introduces herself and answers any questions the characters have about the Red Belvedere. She provides the following information:
zh_tw: 當角色們到達紅亭臺時，意外之財向他們介紹自己，並回答角色們關於紅亭臺的任何問題。她提供了以下資訊：

english: Casino
zh_tw: 賭場

english: The Red Belvedere is a decadent respite from the Blood War's horrors. Here, adventurers and devils alike can indulge in their vices in five different rooms, each with its own theme.
zh_tw: 紅亭臺是血戰恐怖的一個墮落的避難所。在這裡，冒險家和惡魔都可以在五個不同主題的房間裡放縱他們的惡習。

english: Currency
zh_tw: 貨幣

english: The Red Belvedere has its own in-house currency (see the "{@area Casino Currency|40d|x}" section). Both gold and {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|Soul Coins} can be traded for in-house currency at the exchange desk in the lobby.
zh_tw: 紅亭臺有自己的內部貨幣（見"{@area 賭場貨幣|40d|x}"部分）。金幣和{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}都可以在大堂的兌換臺兌換成內部貨幣。

english: Dragon Queen Dedication
zh_tw: 龍後奉獻

english: The casino is dedicated to Tiamat to celebrate the Dragon Queen's avarice and pride. Those who don't worship Tiamat are also welcome to partake in the casino's offerings.
zh_tw: 這個賭場是為了奉獻給提亞馬特，慶祝龍後的貪婪和驕傲。不崇拜提亞馬特的人也歡迎參與賭場提供的活動。

english: Rod Piece
zh_tw: 杆件

english: If the characters mention the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, Windfall artfully dodges the topic. She claims that while the casino has been visited by several high-profile adventurers and scholars, she hasn't seen anything matching the rod piece's description. In truth, Windfall knows exactly where the final piece of the rod is: her private sanctum, adjacent to Tiamat's lair. A character who succeeds on a {@dc 32} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check discerns only that Windfall is concealing information.
zh_tw: 如果角色們提到了 {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}，意外之財會巧妙地迴避這個話題。她聲稱雖然賭場曾有幾位著名冒險者和學者造訪，但她並未見過與杖節描述相符的物品。事實上，意外之財非常清楚杖的最後一節在哪裡：她的私人密室，毗鄰提亞馬特的巢穴。成功透過 {@dc 32} 感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定的角色只能察覺到意外之財在隱瞞資訊。

english: Where's the Rod Piece?
zh_tw: 權杖部件在哪裡？

english: While inside the Red Belvedere, the character holding the sixth rod piece can determine that the seventh piece is located on the casino's premises one floor down.
zh_tw: 在紅亭臺內部，持有第六個權杖部件的角色可以確定第七個部件位於賭場一樓的場所。

english: The final piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} is held in Windfall's sanctum within the casino's exclusive club, Dragon's Pride. Only those personally invited by Windfall or one of the casino's pit masters are allowed inside Dragon's Pride.
zh_tw: {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的最後部分被儲存在意外之財的聖所內，位於賭場獨傢俱樂部龍后之傲中。只有被意外之財或賭場的任何一個賭檯主管親自邀請的人才能進入龍后之傲。

english: If the characters ask her for permission to enter Dragon's Pride, Windfall scoffs and says they'll need to ingratiate themselves to a pit master to gain access to the exclusive area. It amuses the tiefling to watch the characters try to gain favor with at least one of the casino's pit masters (see the "{@area Casino Pit Masters|415|x}" section). Windfall is certain the characters will never convince the pit masters to let them into Dragon's Pride.
zh_tw: 如果角色們請求她允許進入龍后之傲，意外之財嗤之以鼻，並說他們需要向賭檯主管討好才能獲得進入這個專屬區域的許可權。這個提夫林覺得看著角色們試圖至少贏得賭場的一個賭檯主管的青睞很有趣（見"{@area 賭場賭檯主管|415|x}"部分）。意外之財確信角色們永遠不會說服賭檯主管讓他們進入龍后之傲。

english: Casino Currency
zh_tw: 賭場貨幣

english: The Red Belvedere uses a special type of in-house currency known as a talon. An exchange desk in the casino's lobby allows patrons to trade in coins for talons and vice versa. One talon is worth 10 gp.
zh_tw: 紅亭臺使用一種特殊的內部貨幣，稱為爪幣。賭場大堂的兌換臺允許顧客用硬幣兌換爪幣，反之亦然。一個爪幣的價值是10金幣。

english: A talon looks like an iridescent metal coin stamped with the silhouette of a dragon's claw on both sides. Since the Red Belvedere is dedicated to Tiamat, each talon is imbued with a mote of the Dragon Queen's power. Carrying and exchanging talons bear unpleasant consequences:
zh_tw: 爪幣看起來像一枚彩虹色的金屬硬幣，兩面都印有龍爪的剪影。由於紅亭臺是奉獻給提亞馬特的，每個爪幣都被賦予了龍後力量的一小部分。攜帶和兌換爪幣會帶來不愉快的後果：

english: Curse
zh_tw: 詛咒

english: A creature that carries any number of talons is cursed. While cursed in this way, the creature has disadvantage on Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws as its mind is clouded by jealous and selfish thoughts. The curse ends on an affected creature only when the creature no longer holds any talons. A {@spell Remove Curse} spell or similar magic suppresses the curse's effects for 1 hour. When the curse ends on a creature, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or gain 1 level of {@condition exhaustion}, as the rampant avarice takes a physical toll.
zh_tw: 任何攜帶爪牙的生物都會受到詛咒。被如此詛咒時，該生物因被嫉妒和自私的想法所困擾，在智力和感知豁免檢定上處於劣勢。只有當該生物不再持有任何爪牙時，詛咒才會結束。{@spell Remove Curse||移除詛咒}法術或類似的魔法可以壓制詛咒的效果，持續1小時。當詛咒在生物身上結束時，該生物必須成功透過一次{@dc 18}體質豁免檢定，否則獲得1級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}，因為過度的貪婪對肉體造成了損害。

english: Soul Coins
zh_tw: 靈魂幣

english: The devils of the Nine Hells also use a type of currency called {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|Soul Coins}. Soul Coins are used among the infernal hierarchy to purchase favors, bribe the unwilling, and reward the faithful for services rendered. A single Soul Coin can be exchanged at the casino for 300 talons and vice versa.
zh_tw: 九層地獄的惡魔也使用一種稱為{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}的貨幣。靈魂硬幣在地獄的等級制度中用來購買恩惠、賄賂不情願者以及獎勵為提供服務而忠誠的人。一枚靈魂硬幣可以在賭場兌換成300個爪幣，反之亦然。

english: Soul Coin
zh_tw: 靈魂幣

english: A Soul Coin
zh_tw: 靈魂硬幣

english: Casino Security
zh_tw: 賭場安保

english: Each room of the casino is supervised by a trio of {@creature Pit Fiend||pit fiends}. They are silent observers and intervene only if a patron starts a fight or is caught cheating (see the "{@adventure Cheating in the Red Belvedere|VEoR|8|Cheating in the Red Belvedere}" sidebar).
zh_tw: 賭場的每個房間都由三個{@creature Pit Fiend||深獄煉魔}監督。他們是沉默的觀察者，只有在顧客開始打架或被抓住作弊時才會介入（見"{@adventure 在紅亭臺作弊|VEoR|8|Cheating in the Red Belvedere}"側邊欄）。

english: On approaching a troublesome patron, the pit fiends confiscate the patron's talons and escort the patron from the casino. The patron is then barred from the casino for 24 hours. A barred patron can attempt to reenter by succeeding on either a {@dc 20} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check to avoid the pit fiends' notice or a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check to convince the pit fiends to overlook the patron's past transgressions and allow reentry. Patrons barred more than once might be unable to reenter the casino for longer than 24 hours, at your discretion.
zh_tw: 當接近一個惹麻煩的顧客時，坑魔會沒收該顧客的爪子並將其護送出賭場。隨後，該顧客將被禁止進入賭場24小時。被禁止的顧客可以嘗試透過一個 {@dc 20} 敏捷 ({@skill Stealth||隱匿}) 檢定來避開坑魔的注意，或者透過一個 {@dc 15} 魅力 ({@skill Persuasion||說服}) 檢定來說服坑魔忽略該顧客過去的違規行為並允許其重新進入。被禁止多次的顧客可能會被禁止進入賭場超過24小時，具體時間由你決定。

english: The pit fiends have no qualms about killing a patron who attacks them.
zh_tw: 深獄煉魔對於殺死攻擊他們的顧客沒有任何顧慮。

english: Casino Pit Masters
zh_tw: 賭場賭檯主管

english: A pit master presides over each room of the Red Belvedere. (The rooms of the casino are displayed on map 8.1.) The characters must gain favor with at least one pit master to access Dragon's Pride. If the characters ask the patrons milling around the casino lobby, they can learn the information presented below about each pit master.
zh_tw: 紅亭臺的每個房間都有一位賭檯主管負責。（賭場的房間在地圖8.1上顯示。）角色們必須至少獲得一位賭檯主管的青睞，才能進入龍后之傲。如果角色們詢問在賭場大堂閒逛的顧客，他們可以瞭解到以下關於每位賭檯主管的資訊。

english: Kaylan Renaudon
zh_tw: 凱蘭·雷諾頓

english: {@i Master of the Stygian Maze}
zh_tw: {@i 冥界迷宮的主宰}

english: Kaylan is a devious {@creature vampire} who arrived in Avernus after dodging a group of vampire hunters on the Material Plane. When Windfall refurbished the Red Belvedere, the tiefling employed Kaylan to design the ever-shifting halls of the casino's Stygian Maze. Kaylan now presides over the maze, gleefully watching patrons wander the confounding passages in search of riches.
zh_tw: 凱蘭是一個狡猾的{@creature vampire||吸血鬼}，在物質界躲避了一群吸血鬼獵人後抵達了阿弗納斯。當意外之財翻新紅亭臺時，這位提夫林僱傭了凱蘭來設計賭場冥界迷宮中不斷變化的走廊。凱蘭現在主宰著這個迷宮，愉快地看著顧客在尋找財富的過程中徘徊在令人困惑的通道里。

english: Kaylan has a special {@item Sword of Life Stealing} that, in addition to its usual properties, allows the vampire to draw sustenance from a soul trapped within a {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA}. Feeding off a {@i Soul Coin} in this way irrevocably destroys both the coin and the soul within, which has left Kaylan perpetually hungry for more.
zh_tw: 凱蘭擁有一把特殊的{@item Sword of Life Stealing||竊命劍}，除了它的一般屬性外，還允許這個吸血鬼從被困在{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}中的靈魂中吸取養分。以這種方式吸取{@i 靈魂幣}會導致硬幣和其中的靈魂都被不可逆轉地摧毀，這使得凱蘭永遠渴望更多。

english: Gaining Kaylan's Favor
zh_tw: 贏得凱蘭的青睞

english: Kaylan desires to feed off as many Soul Coins as he can. The characters can give Kaylan three Soul Coins in exchange for access to Dragon's Pride.
zh_tw: 凱蘭渴望儘可能多地吸收靈魂硬幣。角色們可以給凱蘭三個靈魂硬幣，以換取進入龍后之傲的許可權。

english: Cheating in the Red Belvedere
zh_tw: 在紅亭臺作弊

english: Cheating by magical means is nearly impossible within the casino. Magical effects that enhance personal skill, such as Bardic Inspiration or the {@spell Enhance Ability} spell, don't directly tamper with the game and aren't considered cheating; however, casting an illusion on your hand of cards or invisibly moving dice draws the {@creature Pit Fiend||pit fiends}' attention.
zh_tw: 在賭場內透過魔法手段作弊幾乎是不可能的。增強個人技能的魔法效果，如詩人的靈感或{@spell Enhance Ability||強化屬性}法術，並不直接篡改遊戲，因此不被視為作弊；然而，在手牌上施展幻象或無形地移動骰子會吸引{@creature Pit Fiend||深獄煉魔}的注意。

english: Physical methods of deceit (hidden cards, weighted dice, and so on) are more likely to pass unnoticed. A character attempting to cheat in this way must make a {@dc 30} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check; if the character is proficient with the gaming set of the game being played, the character can make this check with advantage. On a successful check, the character bends the game to their will. Encourage the player to describe how the character successfully cheats. On a failed check, the pit fiends notice the character's attempt, confiscate the character's talons, and escort the character from the casino. A {@creature pit fiend} can be placated with a minimum bribe of 250 talons or 2,500 gp.
zh_tw: 物理欺騙手段（如隱藏的卡片、加重骰子等）更有可能不被察覺。一個試圖以這種方式作弊的角色必須進行一個 {@dc 30} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定；如果該角色在所使用的遊戲道具套裝上有熟練，該角色可以在此檢定中獲得優勢。如果檢定成功，角色將遊戲按照自己的意願操控。鼓勵玩家描述角色是如何成功作弊的。如果檢定失敗，煉獄魔鬼會注意到角色的企圖，沒收角色的爪子，並將角色從賭場中驅逐。一個 {@creature pit fiend||深獄煉魔} 可以透過最少 250 個爪子或 2,500 gp 的賄賂來安撫。

english: Khai Kiroth
zh_tw: 凱基羅特

english: {@i Master of the Scarlet Coliseum}
zh_tw: {@i 猩紅競技場之主}

english: Khai is a boisterous {@creature red abishai|MPMM} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) and the master of the casino's fighting pit. He relishes bloodshed, and his laughter booms over the gore-stained arena. Khai fancies himself the strongest of the pit masters, and he chafes under Windfall's leadership. Khai dedicates every death in the coliseum to Tiamat.
zh_tw: 凱是一個喧鬧的{@creature red abishai|MPMM|亞比莎紅龍魔}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}），並且是賭場戰鬥坑的主宰。他喜歡流血衝突，他的笑聲在血跡斑斑的競技場上空迴盪。凱自認為是賭檯主管中最強的，他對意外之財的領導感到不滿。凱將鬥獸場中的每一次死亡都獻給了提亞馬特。

english: Gaining Khai's Favor
zh_tw: 贏得凱的青睞

english: Khai prizes battle prowess above all else. Should the characters win three matches in the coliseum, Khai challenges them to combat; if the characters reduce Khai to 50 hit points or fewer without killing him, the abishai rewards them with access to Dragon's Pride. See the "{@area Scarlet Coliseum|435|x}" section later in this chapter for more information about this option.
zh_tw: 凱最看重的是戰鬥能力。如果角色們在鬥獸場贏得三場比賽，凱會向他們挑戰戰鬥；如果角色們在不殺死凱的情況下將他的生命值減少到50點或更少，這位阿比沙伊會獎勵他們進入龍后之傲的許可權。關於這個選項的更多資訊，請參見本章後面的"{@area 猩紅鬥獸場|435|x}"部分。

english: Rezran "Snake Eyes" Agrodro, Khai Kiroth, and Nyssa Otellion
zh_tw: 雷茲蘭 "蛇眼" 阿格羅卓, 凱基羅特, 妮莎·歐泰利昂

english: Nyssa Otellion
zh_tw: 妮莎·歐泰利昂

english: {@i Master of the Cerulean Hall}
zh_tw: {@i 蔚藍大廳的主宰}

english: A stoic and haughty {@creature blue abishai|MPMM} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}), Nyssa serves as the master of the casino's games of strategy and intellect. Nyssa prides herself on being an unbeatable foe in battles of wit. However, Nyssa doesn't hesitate to resort to underhanded methods to achieve victory, citing her opponent's inability to notice her cheating as a failure of intellect.
zh_tw: 妮莎·歐泰利昂是一位冷漠而傲慢的{@creature blue abishai|MPMM|亞比莎藍龍魔}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}），她作為賭場策略和智力遊戲的主宰。妮莎自豪地認為自己在智慧之戰中是一個不可戰勝的對手。然而，妮莎毫不猶豫地訴諸不正當手段來取得勝利，她將自己的作弊行為歸咎於對手未能察覺，認為這是智力上的失敗。

english: Gaining Nyssa's Favor
zh_tw: 贏得妮莎的青睞

english: Nyssa admires those who are extremely clever and observant. See the "{@area Cerulean Hall|42e|x}" section later in this chapter for more information about gaining favor with her.
zh_tw: 妮莎非常欽佩那些極其聰明和觀察入微的人。關於如何贏得她的青睞，請參閱本章後面的"{@area 蔚藍大廳|42e|x}"部分以獲取更多資訊。

english: Rezran "Snake Eyes" Agrodro
zh_tw: 雷茲蘭「蛇眼」阿格羅卓

english: {@i Master of the Viridian Den}
zh_tw: {@i 翠綠巢穴的主宰}

english: Rezran, a greedy {@creature green abishai|MPMM} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}), is the master of the casino's games of chance. His nickname "Snake Eyes" comes from his penchant for rolling ones in Triple Hydra (see the "{@area Viridian Den|43f|x}" section for an explanation of the game's rules). Rezran is an opportunist to his core, always chasing after riches. He is a devoted follower of Tiamat and covets the Dragon Queen's amassed wealth.
zh_tw: 雷茲蘭是一個貪婪的{@creature green abishai|MPMM|亞比莎綠龍魔}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}），是賭場機會遊戲的主宰。他的綽號"蛇眼"來源於他在三頭蛇遊戲中經常擲出一對麼點（見"{@area 翠綠巢穴|43f|x}"部分，瞭解遊戲規則的解釋）。雷茲蘭是一個徹頭徹尾的機會主義者，總是追逐財富。他是提亞馬特的忠實追隨者，並且渴望龍後的積累財富。

english: Gaining Rezran's Favor
zh_tw: 贏得雷茲蘭的青睞

english: Rezran observes the characters as they partake in the Viridian Den's games. If the characters amass a total of 1,000 talons or more while in the den, Rezran is impressed with their luck and grants the characters access to Dragon's Pride.
zh_tw: 雷茲蘭觀察角色們參與翠綠巢穴的遊戲。如果角色們在巢穴中積累了1000個爪幣或更多，雷茲蘭會對他們的運氣印象深刻，並授予角色們進入龍后之傲的許可權。

english: Uvashar
zh_tw: 烏瓦沙爾

english: {@i Master of the Alabaster Racetrack}
zh_tw: {@i 烏瓦沙爾}

english: Uvashar is a suave, white-furred {@creature rakshasa} and the master of the casino's nightmare racing circuit. Uvashar can often be found indulging in fine food and music in a private viewing box.
zh_tw: 烏瓦沙爾是一個風度翩翩、白毛皮的{@creature rakshasa||羅剎}，是賭場噩夢賽跑賽道的主宰。烏瓦沙爾經常可以在一個私人包廂裡享受美食和音樂。

english: Duplicitous and manipulative, Uvashar likes to assume the guise of a casino patron and sow discord among the racetrack's audience members. The rakshasa rigs races to add excitement to an event. Uvashar doesn't worship Tiamat like many of the casino's pit masters and patrons, but the rakshasa nonetheless maintains a grudging allegiance to the Dragon Queen.
zh_tw: 烏瓦沙爾狡詐且善於操縱，他喜歡偽裝成賭場顧客，在賽馬場的觀眾中播撒不和。這位羅剎操縱比賽以增加活動的興奮感。與賭場的許多賭檯主管和顧客不同，烏瓦沙爾並不崇拜提亞馬特，但這位羅剎仍然對龍後保持勉強的忠誠。

english: Gaining Uvashar's Favor
zh_tw: 贏得烏瓦沙爾的青睞

english: Uvashar holds great esteem for those who keep their promises and uphold their end of a deal—especially when it requires a fair amount of skill to successfully pull off. One potential encounter to gain Uvashar's favor is presented later in the "{@area Alabaster Racetrack|422|x}" section later in the chapter.
zh_tw: 烏瓦沙爾非常尊敬那些信守承諾並履行交易的人——特別是當這需要相當數量的技巧才能成功完成時。在本章後面的"{@area 雪花石膏賽車場|422|x}"部分中，提出了一個可能的遭遇，以贏得烏瓦沙爾的青睞。

english: Kaylan Renaudon and Uvashar
zh_tw: 凱蘭·雷諾頓和烏瓦沙爾

english: Casino Rooms
zh_tw: 賭場房間

english: The casino's rooms are described in the following sections.
zh_tw: 賭場的房間在以下各節中進行了描述。

english: Alabaster Racetrack
zh_tw: 雪花石膏賽車場

english: Sleek white pillars surround what looks like a racetrack. The stands bustle with patrons, all eager to bet on the impending race.
zh_tw: 光滑的白色柱子圍繞著一個看起來像賽馬跑道的地方。看臺上擠滿了急切下注即將到來比賽的顧客。

english: This arena hosts nightmare racing. Audience members can place bets, earning a payout depending on which steeds place in the top two of a given race. Up to six {@creature Nightmare||nightmares} race at any given time; those who bet on the first-place steed receive triple their initial bet, and those who bet on the second-place steed receive double their initial bet.
zh_tw: 這個競技場舉辦噩夢賽跑。觀眾可以下注，在給定的比賽中，根據哪些駿馬排在前兩名來獲得賠付。任何時候最多有六匹{@creature Nightmare||夢魘}參加比賽；那些押注第一名駿馬的人將獲得三倍於他們最初賭注的獎金，而那些押注第二名駿馬的人將獲得兩倍於他們最初賭注的獎金。

english: To simulate a race, have each participating character place a bet on a single number from 1 to 6—each number represents a nightmare. Roll a {@dice d6} twice to determine which nightmares win first and second place, respectively. If both rolls are the same number, reroll one die to determine which nightmare wins second place.
zh_tw: 為了模擬一場比賽，讓每個參與的角色對一個1到6的數字下注——每個數字代表一個噩夢。擲兩個{@dice d6}骰子來確定哪些噩夢分別贏得第一名和第二名。如果兩個骰子的點數相同，請重新擲一個骰子來確定哪個噩夢贏得第二名。

english: To Cheat or Not to Cheat
zh_tw: 作弊還是不作弊

english: A few moments after the characters enter the racetrack's area for the first time, an elf in a stylish white suit approaches them and offers them a deal. Read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 當角色們第一次進入賽馬跑道區域的幾分鐘後，一個穿著時尚白色西裝的精靈接近他們並提出一個交易。閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: "Looking to make some coin, eh? So am I. I've got a little trick planned that'll cinch the race in my favor, winning me a thousand talons at least. You want in? I'll give you a cut of the winnings, and if it all goes swimmingly, I'll take you to the elite floor."
zh_tw: "想賺些錢，是嗎？我也是。我有個小技巧，可以確保我在比賽中獲勝，至少能贏一千爪幣。你想加入嗎？我會分給你一部分贏利，如果一切順利，我還會帶你去精英樓層。"

english: The elf is the racetrack's pit master Uvashar (see the "{@area Casino Pit Masters|415|x}" section earlier in the chapter), concealed with an illusory disguise. A character who succeeds on a {@dc 18} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check pierces the illusion and sees the rakshasa's true appearance.
zh_tw: 精靈是賽道的維修站主管烏瓦沙爾（參見本章前面的"{@area 賭場賭檯主管|415|x}"一節），他用一種幻術偽裝隱藏了自己的真實身份。一個角色如果成功透過一個 {@dc 18} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，就能看穿幻象，看到拉克沙薩的真實樣貌。

english: Uvashar profits regardless of which nightmare wins the race; the rakshasa merely enjoys tempting mortals with offers to cheat and observing their reactions. If the characters accept Uvashar's deal, Uvashar gives the characters a {@item Potion of Speed} and instructs them to slip the potion into the feed of the nightmare named Sunshroud. Uvashar then points the characters in the direction of the stables.
zh_tw: 無論哪個噩夢贏得比賽，烏瓦沙爾都能獲得利潤；這位羅剎只是喜歡用作弊的誘惑來試探凡人，並觀察他們的反應。如果角色們接受了烏瓦沙爾的交易，烏瓦沙爾會給他們一瓶{@item Potion of Speed||加速藥水}，並指示他們將藥水摻入名為日幕的噩夢的食物中。然後烏瓦沙爾會指向馬廄的方向。

english: Uvashar Unmasked
zh_tw: 揭開烏瓦沙爾的真面目

english: If any character confronts Uvashar about their disguise, Uvashar rescinds the deal, bitterly commenting that the character has ruined the fun. The rakshasa nonetheless commends the character's observation skills before leaving to find another group to toy with. The characters must find another way to gain Uvashar's favor or ingratiate themselves to another pit master.
zh_tw: 如果任何角色揭穿烏瓦沙爾的偽裝，烏瓦沙爾將撤銷交易，並痛苦地評論說這個角色破壞了樂趣。儘管如此，這個羅剎還是讚揚了角色的觀察力，然後離開去尋找另一個群體來戲弄。角色們必須找到另一種方式來贏得烏瓦沙爾的青睞或討好另一個競技場主宰。

english: Stables
zh_tw: 馬廄

english: The racetrack's stables are depicted on map 8.2. If the characters enter the stable area, read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 賽車場的馬廄在地圖8.2上有所描繪。如果角色們進入馬廄區域，請閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: Six nightmares snort and paw at the ground in their respective stalls, their flaming manes dancing as devil jockeys attend to the steeds. The reeking stench of offal rises from the feed buckets. In one corner stands a bored-looking pit fiend.
zh_tw: 六匹夢魘在各自的馬廄裡噴著鼻息，用蹄子刨地，它們燃燒的鬃毛隨著惡魔騎手照料這些坐騎而舞動。來自飼料桶的內臟臭味瀰漫開來。在一個角落裡，站著一個看起來無聊的深獄煉魔。

english: Map 8.2: Alabaster Racetrack Stables
zh_tw: 地圖 8.2：雪花石膏賽車場馬廄

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: One {@creature pit fiend} serves as security for the area. The six {@creature Nightmare||nightmares} (named Chicanery, Far Gambit, Blinx, Cursed Cavalry, Sunshroud, and Retribution) stamp impatiently in their stalls, and a {@creature barbed devil} jockey attends to each one.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature pit fiend||深獄煉魔}擔任該區域的保安。六隻{@creature Nightmare||夢魘}（分別命名為詭計, 遠謀, 布林克斯, 詛咒騎兵, 日幕, 和復仇）在它們的馬廄裡不耐煩地跺腳，每個夢魘都有一個{@creature barbed devil||蝟魔}騎手照料。

english: Characters must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check each time they enter or exit the stables to avoid being noticed and attacked by the pit fiend.
zh_tw: 角色每次進入或離開馬廄時都必須成功透過一次{@dc 22}敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定，以避免被注意到並遭到深獄煉魔的攻擊。

english: Rigging the Race
zh_tw: 操縱比賽

english: Successfully slipping the {@item Potion of Speed} into Sunshroud's feed bucket requires multiple steps:
zh_tw: 成功地將{@item Potion of Speed||加速藥水}倒入日幕的飼料桶需要多個步驟：

english: Step 1
zh_tw: 第一步

english: One or more characters must successfully sneak into the stables.
zh_tw: 一個或多個角色必須成功潛入馬廄。

english: Step 2
zh_tw: 第二步

english: After locating Sunshroud's stall, a character must succeed on a {@dc 25} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check to pour the potion into the feed bucket. On a failed check, Sunshroud and its jockey notice the character and make a ruckus, attracting the attention of the pit fiend.
zh_tw: 在找到日幕的攤位後，角色必須成功透過一次{@dc 25}敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定，才能將藥水倒入飼料桶。如果檢定失敗，日幕及其騎師會注意到角色並製造騷亂，引起深獄煉魔的注意。

english: Step 3
zh_tw: 第三步

english: The potion reacts with the offal in the nightmare's feed bucket, causing a cloud of toxic gas to erupt. Characters within 5 feet of the feed bucket must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition poisoned} condition for 1 hour. On a failed saving throw, the character's coughing also alerts the pit fiend.
zh_tw: 藥水與噩夢飼料桶中的內臟發生反應，導致一團有毒氣體爆發出來。距離飼料桶 5 尺內的角色必須成功透過一次 {@dc 20} 體質豁免檢定，否則將獲得 {@condition poisoned||中毒} 狀態，持續 1 小時。如果豁免失敗，角色的咳嗽聲還會驚動深淵煉魔。

english: Step 4
zh_tw: 第四步

english: The characters must successfully sneak out of the stables.
zh_tw: 角色們必須成功地從馬廄中潛行出去。

english: If a character executes all four steps without attracting the attention of the pit fiend, Sunshroud consumes the {@item Potion of Speed} and wins handily.
zh_tw: 如果一個角色在不吸引深獄煉魔注意的情況下成功執行了所有四個步驟，日幕將消耗{@item Potion of Speed||加速藥水}並輕鬆獲勝。

english: Pit Master's Confrontation
zh_tw: 坑主的對峙

english: If the characters successfully rig the race in Sunshroud's favor, a pit fiend approaches the party after the race. The pit fiend explains that the racetrack's pit master wants to meet with the characters, and it escorts the party to Uvashar's private viewing box. Read or paraphrase the following if the characters accompany the pit fiend to the viewing box:
zh_tw: 如果角色們成功地操縱比賽，使日幕處於有利地位，賽後一個深獄煉魔會接近隊伍。深獄煉魔解釋說，賽道的坑主想要見見角色們，並護送隊伍到烏瓦沙爾的私人觀賽包廂。如果角色們跟隨深獄煉魔到觀賽包廂，閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: This box overlooks the racetrack, far from the crowds in the stands. Charcuterie plates line the tables. Reclining in a chair is a bipedal fiend with fur like a white tiger, dressed in a sharp suit and watching you slyly.
zh_tw: 這個包廂俯瞰著賽道，遠離看臺上的人群。桌子上擺滿了各種熟食拼盤。一個像白虎一樣長著皮毛的雙足惡魔，穿著一身利落的西裝，斜靠在椅子上，狡猾地觀察著你們。

english: Uvashar cuts straight to the point and asks the characters if they tampered with the race.
zh_tw: 烏瓦沙爾直截了當地問角色們是否操縱了比賽。

english: Telling the Truth
zh_tw: 說出真相

english: If the characters tell the truth, Uvashar tsks before magically appearing as the suited elf from earlier. The rakshasa admonishes the characters and dismisses them without reward. The characters must find an alternate way into Dragon's Pride.
zh_tw: 如果角色們說出真相，烏瓦沙爾會發出嘖嘖聲，然後使用魔法變身為之前那個穿西裝的精靈。這個羅剎責備角色們，沒有給予獎勵就讓他們離開。角色們必須找到另一種方式進入龍后之傲。

english: Lying
zh_tw: 撒謊

english: A character who attempts to lie about the party's involvement must make a {@dc 18} Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check. On a successful check, Uvashar is impressed. On a failed check, Uvashar critiques the character's skill before laughing and commending the party's commitment. In either case, Uvashar honors the deal, offering the party access into Dragon's Pride (see the "{@area Dragon's Pride|446|x}" section later in this chapter).
zh_tw: 一個試圖撒謊隱瞞團隊參與的角色必須進行一次 {@dc 18} 魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}）檢定。如果檢定成功，烏瓦沙爾會感到印象深刻。如果檢定失敗，烏瓦沙爾會在笑出聲並讚揚團隊的決心之前，批評該角色的技能。無論哪種情況，烏瓦沙爾都會兌現承諾，允許團隊進入"龍后之傲"（{@area 龍后之傲|446|x}，詳見本章後面的部分）。

english: Cerulean Hall
zh_tw: 蔚藍大廳

english: Blue crystal pillars reach toward this gaming hall's ceiling. All is quiet except for the clinking of coins and shuffling of cards. Walking between tables is a lean, blue-scaled devil with dragon wings.
zh_tw: 藍色的水晶柱子伸向這個遊戲大廳的天花板。除了硬幣的叮噹聲和紙牌的洗牌聲外，一切都很安靜。在桌子間行走的是一個瘦削、藍鱗的惡魔，長有龍翼。

english: The blue devil is the room's pit master, Nyssa Otellion (see the "{@area Casino Pit Masters|415|x}" section). Nyssa stoically moves between game tables, searching for a worthy opponent.
zh_tw: 這個房間裡的坑主是藍色惡魔妮莎·歐泰利昂（見"{@area 賭場賭檯主管|415|x}"部分）。妮莎冷靜地在遊戲桌之間移動，尋找一個值得的對手。

english: Games in the Cerulean Hall
zh_tw: 天藍大廳的遊戲

english: The Cerulean Hall is home to games of strategy and intellect, such as dragonchess and three-dragon ante. The room is divided into three sections based on skill: an amateur players' section, an intermediate players' section, and an expert players' section.
zh_tw: 天藍大廳是策略和智力遊戲的場所，比如龍棋和三龍撲克。房間根據技能水平分為三個部分：業餘玩家區、中級玩家區和專家玩家區。

english: The minimum bet to participate in a game is 15 talons, regardless of section. At the start of a game, all participants place their starting bets in a central pot; games like dragonchess are typically limited to two participants, but other games can have five or more participants.
