For each turn of the game, all participants make Intelligence checks using the relevant gaming set (a dragonchess set, a playing card set, or another suitable set). The participant with the highest total roll wins the turn. In the event of a tie, no one wins the turn. The first participant who wins three turns wins the game and collects the pot.
zh_tw: 參與遊戲的最低下注是15個爪幣，不論哪個區域。在遊戲開始時，所有參與者將起始下注放入中央獎池；像龍棋這樣的遊戲通常限於兩名參與者，但其他遊戲可以有五名或更多的參與者。對於遊戲的每個回合，所有參與者使用相關的遊戲套裝（一個龍棋套裝、一副撲克牌套裝或另一個合適的套裝）進行智力檢定。總點數最高的參與者贏得該回合。如果出現平局，則該回合無人獲勝。首位贏得三個回合的參與者贏得遊戲並收集獎池。

english: For NPC participants, the following table shows the average bet and skill modifier to use depending on the section the NPC is playing in.
zh_tw: 對於NPC參與者，下表顯示了根據NPC所玩遊戲區域的平均下注和技能調整值。

english: Cerulean Hall Betting
zh_tw: 天藍大廳下注

english: Section Level
zh_tw: 區域等級

english: Average Bet
zh_tw: 平均下注

english: Modifier
zh_tw: 調整值

english: Amateur
zh_tw: 業餘

english: 17 ({@dice 1d4 + 15}) talons
Intermediate
zh_tw: 中級

english: 20 ({@dice 2d4 + 15}) talons
Expert
zh_tw: 專家

english: 25 ({@dice 4d4 + 15}) talons
A Contest of Wits
zh_tw: 智慧的較量

english: Any character who wins a game in the experts' section gains Nyssa's attention. The pit master approaches the character after the game and offers a challenge of wits. Read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 在專家區贏得遊戲的任何角色都會吸引妮莎的注意。坑主在遊戲結束後接近角色，並提出智力挑戰。閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: "Not bad. You are clever—I acknowledge that much. But I wonder how you would fare against the master of this chamber. I hereby challenge you to a dragonchess match: winner takes all."
zh_tw: "不錯。你很聰明——我承認這一點。但我好奇你與這個大廳的主人對抗會如何。我在此向你挑戰一場龍棋比賽：勝者通吃。"

english: If the character accepts her challenge, Nyssa insists on playing the match immediately. Nyssa wagers 50 talons on this match of dragonchess, and her modifier is +12.
zh_tw: 如果角色接受了她的挑戰，妮莎堅持立即進行比賽。妮莎在這場龍棋比賽中下注50爪幣，她的調整值是+12。

english: Nyssa's Cheating
zh_tw: 妮莎的作弊

english: Nyssa is wearing a {@item Medallion of Thoughts}, which she uses to scan her opponent's surface thoughts and stay one step ahead in the match. Nyssa uses a {@spell Disguise Self} spell to hide the medallion from view. As long as Nyssa's opponent can be affected by divination magic, the medallion allows Nyssa to treat any roll of a 9 or below as a 10 when she makes Intelligence checks using a dragonchess set.
zh_tw: 妮莎佩戴著一個{@item Medallion of Thoughts||讀心勳章}，她用它來掃描對手的表面思想，在比賽裡始終保持領先一步。妮莎使用了一個{@spell Disguise Self||易容術}法術來隱藏這個護符，使其不被人看見。只要妮莎的對手能被占卜魔法影響，這個護符就允許妮莎在用龍棋套裝進行智力檢定時，將任何9或以下的擲骰結果視為10。

english: A character that succeeds on a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check can pierce the illusion and see the medallion, which can be identified by any character who succeeds on a {@dc 17} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check. A character that casts {@spell Detect Magic} or similar magic notices the aura of illusion magic concealing Nyssa and the medallion.
zh_tw: 一個成功透過 {@dc 20} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定的人物可以看穿幻象並看到徽章，任何成功透過 {@dc 17} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定的人物都可以識別它。施展 {@spell Detect Magic||偵測魔法} 或類似魔法的角色會注意到隱藏妮莎和徽章的幻象魔法靈光。

english: If a character accuses Nyssa of cheating, she asks the character for proof. If the character correctly identifies the medallion, Nyssa smiles widely and commends the character's ability to see through her ruse. She then concedes the match.
zh_tw: 如果一個角色指控妮莎作弊，她要求角色提供證據。如果角色正確識別出護符，妮莎會露出寬慰的微笑，並稱贊角色看穿她詭計的能力。然後她就會承認比賽失敗。

english: End of the Match
zh_tw: 比賽結束

english: If the character wins the dragonchess match or Nyssa concedes, Nyssa compliments the character's intellect and thanks the character for the most thrilling match she's had in a while. She then offers the character and their companions access to Dragon's Pride (see the "{@area Dragon's Pride|446|x}" section).
zh_tw: 如果角色贏得了龍棋比賽或者妮莎承認失敗，妮莎會稱讚角色的智慧，並感謝角色為她帶來了一段時間以來最激動人心的比賽。然後她提供給角色及其同伴進入龍后之傲的通道（見本章後面的"{@area 龍后之傲|446|x}"部分）。

english: If Nyssa wins, she scoffs at the character and haughtily collects her winnings.
zh_tw: 如果妮莎贏了，她會嘲笑角色，並傲慢地收取她的賭金。

english: Scarlet Coliseum
zh_tw: 猩紅鬥獸場

english: Jeers and shouts rise from this open-air coliseum made of deep-red stone. Over the sound of roars and clattering metal, a booming voice excitedly commentates on the fight.
zh_tw: 這個由深紅色石頭建造的露天競技場中，嘲笑聲和呼喊聲此起彼伏。在咆哮聲和金屬碰撞聲之上，一個激動人心的聲音在興奮地評論著戰鬥。

english: The booming voice is the magically amplified voice of Khai Kiroth, the coliseum's pit master and commentator (see the "{@area Casino Pit Masters|415|x}" section earlier in this chapter).
zh_tw: 這個激動人心的聲音是凱基羅特透過魔法放大的聲音，他是競技場的坑主和評論員（見本章前面的"{@area 賭場賭檯主管|415|x}"部分）。

english: Watching a coliseum match is free. Matches pit two teams against each other: one consisting of creatures enlisted by the casino, the other consisting of casino patrons looking to prove their mettle in combat. Before each match, audience members can bet on which team will emerge victorious. At the conclusion of a match, audience members who bet on the winning team receive twice their initial bet.
zh_tw: 觀看競技場比賽是免費的。比賽將兩個隊伍相互對抗：一個由賭場徵召的生物組成，另一個由想要在戰鬥中證明自己實力的賭場顧客組成。在每場比賽之前，觀眾可以下注哪個隊伍會獲勝。比賽結束時，下注在獲勝隊伍的觀眾將獲得他們最初下注的兩倍。

english: Entering the Coliseum
zh_tw: 進入競技場

english: It costs 15 talons to enter the coliseum as a combatant. A maximum of three combatants are allowed on the patrons' team. If all three combatant slots aren't filled by characters, the remaining slots are filled by {@creature Veteran||veterans}.
zh_tw: 作為戰鬥者進入競技場需要花費15爪幣。顧客的隊伍最多允許有三名戰鬥者。如果所有三個戰鬥者名額沒有被角色填滿，剩餘的名額將由{@creature Veteran||老兵}填補。

english: The arena matches are divided into three tiers, with victory in a tier granting access to the next one. Victory in a match goes to the side that reduces all combatants on the other side to 0 hit points. If the patrons' team wins a match, each combatant on the team receives 100 talons. The matches have one-hour breaks between them, allowing participants to take a short rest in the coliseum's wings.
zh_tw: 競技場比賽分為三個等級，在一個等級中獲勝可以進入下一個等級。比賽的勝利方是將對方所有戰鬥者的生命值降至0點的一方。如果顧客的隊伍贏得比賽，隊伍中的每個戰鬥者將獲得100爪幣。比賽之間有一小時的休息時間，允許參與者在競技場的休息區進行短休。

english: Map 8.3 depicts the coliseum's arena. The three tiers of matches are as follows:
zh_tw: 地圖8.3描繪了競技場的場地。三個等級的比賽如下：

english: Map 8.3: Scarlet Coliseum
zh_tw: 地圖8.3：赤紅競技場

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Tier 1
zh_tw: 第一階段(T1)

english: {@creature Barlgura||Barlguras} are released into the arena—one for each member of the opposing team.
zh_tw: {@creature Barlgura||惡猿魔}被釋放到競技場中——每個對手隊伍的成員對應一個。

english: Tier 2
zh_tw: 第二階段(T2)

english: A {@creature purple worm} erupts through the floor of the arena.
zh_tw: 一條{@creature purple worm||紫蟲}從競技場的地板下爆發出來。

english: Tier 3
zh_tw: 第三階段(T3)

english: Two iron statues built to resemble pit fiends lumber into the arena. They use the {@creature iron golem} stat block but have iron wings that give them a flying speed of 30 feet.
zh_tw: 兩個鐵製雕像，建造得像深獄煉魔，笨重地走進競技場。它們使用{@creature iron golem||鐵魔像}的統計塊，但擁有鐵翅膀，使它們具有30尺的飛行速度。

english: If a participant wins a match but doesn't wish to continue to the next tier, the participant can pay an exit fee of 15 talons and swap with another willing participant. A participant's companions can join them in the coliseum's wings between matches.
zh_tw: 如果一個參與者贏得了比賽但不想繼續到下一個等級，參與者可以支付15爪幣的退出費用並與另一個願意的參與者交換。參與者的同伴可以在比賽之間加入他們在競技場的休息區。

english: Pit Master's Challenge
zh_tw: 坑主的挑戰

english: Characters who win three matches gain Khai's attention. Khai meets them in the coliseum's wings after the match and speaks with them. Read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 贏得三場比賽的角色會吸引凱的注意。凱在比賽結束後在競技場的休息區與他們會面並和他們交談。閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: "This arena hasn't seen warriors like you for quite some time. Would you indulge in one final bout—against me? Truly, a special event! And, of course, I offer splendid payment for your victory. How does one thousand talons sound, along with access to our casino's exclusive club floor, Dragon's Pride?"
zh_tw: "這個競技場已經有一段時間沒有見到像你們這樣的戰士了。你們願意再進行一場最終的比賽——對抗我嗎？確實，這是一個特別的事件！當然，如果你們勝利，我會提供豐厚的報酬。一千爪幣聽起來怎麼樣，還有進入我們賭場獨傢俱樂部樓層，龍后之傲的許可權？

english: Khai challenges the characters to one final arena match—against him. Since this is a special match, he allows all the characters to fight. If the characters agree, Khai declares that they shall meet in the arena in one hour.
zh_tw: 凱向角色們挑戰最後的一場競技場比賽——與他對抗。由於這是一場特殊比賽，他允許所有角色參戰。如果角色們同意，凱宣佈他們將在一小時後在競技場會面。

english: Final Showdown
zh_tw: 最終決戰

english: An excited crowd has gathered in the coliseum. Khai has two {@creature Horned Devil||horned devils} on his team. Khai fights ruthlessly but offers cheerful commentary during the combat, lauding the characters for their skill and mocking their failings.
zh_tw: 一群興奮的觀眾聚集在競技場。凱的隊伍中有兩隻{@creature Horned Devil||角魔}。凱戰鬥時毫不留情，但在戰鬥中提供愉快的評論，讚揚角色們的技巧並嘲笑他們的失敗。

english: On being reduced to fewer than 25 hit points, Khai concedes the match, declaring the characters the victors. As promised, Khai hands the characters 1,000 talons and offers them access to Dragon's Pride (see the "{@area Dragon's Pride|446|x}" section).
zh_tw: 當生命值降至25點以下時，凱承認比賽失敗，宣佈角色們為勝利者。如他所承諾的，凱遞給角色們1000爪幣，並提供給他們進入龍后之傲的許可權（見本章後面的"{@area 龍后之傲|446|x}"部分）。

english: Combatants in the Scarlet Coliseum might face an irate purple worm
zh_tw: 在赤紅競技場中戰鬥的參賽者可能會面對一個憤怒的紫色蠕蟲

english: Stygian Maze
zh_tw: 冥河迷宮

english: This area's foyer is carved from glistening obsidian. An austere, fanged man in a high-collared cloak sits at an intricately carved desk, next to which is a simple stone doorway. Behind the desk, a floor-to-ceiling window overlooks a stone maze shrouded in fog.
zh_tw: 這個區域的門廳是用閃閃發光的黑曜石雕刻而成的。一個嚴肅、有獠牙的男人穿著高領斗篷坐在一張雕刻精細的桌子旁，旁邊是一個簡單的石門。桌子後面，一扇從地板到天花板的窗戶俯瞰著一個被霧氣籠罩的石質迷宮。

english: The man behind the desk is the maze's pit master, the vampire Kaylan Renaudon (see the "{@area Casino Pit Masters|415|x}" section earlier in this chapter). Kaylan provides the following information:
zh_tw: 坐在桌子後面的男人是迷宮的坑主，吸血鬼凱蘭·雷諾頓（見本章前面的"{@area 賭場賭檯主管|415|x}"部分）。凱蘭提供了以下資訊：

english: Maze
zh_tw: 迷宮術

english: The maze challenges participants' navigational skills and adventuring prowess. Participants traverse magically shifting hallways in search of treasure, avoiding perils along the way.
zh_tw: 迷宮挑戰參與者的導航技能和冒險能力。參與者穿越魔法變化的走廊尋找寶藏，同時避免沿途的危險。

english: Participation
zh_tw: 參與

english: Entering the maze costs 20 talons per participant. Participants can explore the maze alone or in groups.
zh_tw: 進入迷宮每位參與者需花費20爪幣。參與者可以單獨或組隊探索迷宮。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Treasure stashes found throughout the maze typically contain talons, though some also include {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|Soul Coins}.
zh_tw: 迷宮中發現的寶藏堆通常包含爪幣，儘管有些還包括{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}。

english: A character who succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check notices a flicker of hunger appear in Kaylan's eyes when he mentions {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|Soul Coins}. If pressed, Kaylan admits that he feeds off {@i Soul Coins} using a special {@item Sword of Life Stealing}, which he always keeps with him. If the characters bring him {@i Soul Coins}, he'll give the characters 500 talons for each coin.
zh_tw: 一個成功透過 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定的角色會注意到，當凱蘭提到 {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣} 時，他的眼中閃過一抹飢渴。如果被追問，凱蘭會承認他使用一把特殊的 {@item Sword of Life Stealing||竊命劍} 來吸食 {@i 靈魂幣}，他一直隨身攜帶著這把劍。如果角色們給他帶來 {@i 靈魂幣}，他會為每個錢幣支付 500 塔隆。

english: Bringing three or more {@i Soul Coins} to Kaylan earns his admiration, and he offers the characters access to Dragon's Pride in return (see the "{@area Dragon's Pride|446|x}" section).
zh_tw: 給凱蘭帶去三枚或更多的{@i 靈魂幣}會贏得他的讚賞，作為回報，他提供給角色們進入龍后之傲的許可權（見本章後面的"{@area 龍后之傲|446|x}"部分）。

english: Maze Features
zh_tw: 迷宮特性

english: The maze's passageways constantly move, making the maze impossible to map. All areas of the maze have the following features:
zh_tw: 迷宮的通道不斷移動，使得迷宮無法被繪製地圖。迷宮的所有區域都有以下特性：

english: Ceilings
zh_tw: 天花板

english: Ceilings are solid but appear to be made of thick fog. Ceilings are 15 feet high in rooms and 10 feet high in passageways.
zh_tw: 天花板是實心的，但看起來像是由濃霧構成。房間中的天花板高度為15尺，在通道中的天花板高度為10尺。

english: Floor and Walls
zh_tw: 地板和牆壁

english: The floor and walls are constructed of smooth black stone.
zh_tw: 地板和牆壁由光滑的黑色石頭構成。

english: Lighting
zh_tw: 光照

english: The maze is dimly lit by hovering globes of magical light.
zh_tw: 迷宮由懸浮的魔法光球昏暗地照亮。

english: Room Size
zh_tw: 房間尺寸

english: Unless otherwise stated, all chambers within the maze are circular rooms 30 feet in diameter.
zh_tw: 除非另有說明，迷宮內所有的房間都是直徑30尺的圓形房間。

english: Navigating the Maze
zh_tw: 穿越迷宮

english: Before the characters explore the maze, have them designate a leader. If a character is exploring the maze alone, that character is the leader. The leader then ventures through the maze, making a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) or Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check to discern the best pathway. On a successful check, the leader correctly navigates to a treasure chamber; roll randomly or choose an option from the Treasure Chambers table to determine what room is encountered. On a failed check, the leader stumbles into a challenge chamber; roll randomly or choose an option from the Challenge Chambers table to determine which room is encountered. Each room should be encountered only once. If you roll a result the characters have already encountered, or if the characters would leave the maze before finding a chest with one or more {@i Soul Coins}, reroll or choose another option.
zh_tw: 在角色們探索迷宮之前，讓他們指定一個領導者。如果角色獨自探索迷宮，那麼該角色就是領導者。領導者隨後冒險穿越迷宮，進行一次{@dc 20}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）或感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定，以辨別最佳路徑。如果檢定成功，領導者會正確導航到一個寶藏室；隨機擲骰或從寶藏室表格中選擇一個選項來確定遇到哪個房間。如果檢定失敗，領導者會誤入一個挑戰室；隨機擲骰或從挑戰室表格中選擇一個選項來確定遇到哪個房間。每個房間只應被遇到一次。如果擲出的結果是角色們已經遇到過的，或者如果角色們在找到一個裝有一個或多個{@i 靈魂幣}的寶箱之前離開迷宮，則重新擲骰或選擇另一個選項。

english: Treasure Chambers
zh_tw: 寶藏房間

english: Chamber
zh_tw: 密閣

english: A simple table sits at the center of this chamber. On the table are two {@item Potion of Greater Healing||Potions of Healing (greater)} and a bag of 30 talons.
zh_tw: 這個房間的中央放置著一張簡單的桌子。桌子上有兩瓶{@item Potion of Greater Healing||高等治療藥水}和一袋30爪幣。

english: This chamber contains a gurgling pool of turquoise water. A creature that spends 1 minute bathing in the pool gains {@dice 2d10} temporary hit points.
zh_tw: 這個房間內有一個汩汩作響的綠松石色水池。生物在水池中沐浴1分鐘可以獲得{@dice 2d10}點臨時生命值。

english: Planters filled with sweet-smelling flowers line this room. At the center of the room is an unlocked wooden chest containing 75 talons.
zh_tw: 這個房間的四周擺放著充滿甜美香氣的花盆。房間中央是一個未上鎖的木製箱子，裡面裝有75爪幣。

english: This chamber contains a locked iron chest. A character can open the chest with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check using thieves' tools, or it can be forced open with a successful {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. A {@spell Knock} spell or similar magic also opens the chest. Inside the chest are 100 talons and three {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|Soul Coins}.
zh_tw: 這個房間內有一個上鎖的鐵箱。角色可以透過使用盜賊工具成功進行{@dc 15}敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定來開啟箱子，或者透過成功進行{@dc 17}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定來強行開啟。使用{@spell Knock||敲擊術}或類似的魔法也可以開啟箱子。箱子裡有100個塔倫和三個{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}。

english: One of this room's walls has a simple stone doorway, which leads out of the maze and returns the characters to the maze lobby.
zh_tw: 這個房間的一面牆上有一個簡單的石制門道，它通向迷宮外，並將角色們帶回迷宮大廳。

english: Challenge Chambers
zh_tw: 挑戰房間

english: Chamber
zh_tw: 密閣

english: Five {@creature Mimic||mimics}, all disguised as treasure chests, occupy this room. Disturbing one mimic causes them all to attack.
zh_tw: 這個房間裡有五個{@creature Mimic||擬身怪}，它們都偽裝成寶箱的樣子。打擾其中一個擬身怪會引來它們的全部攻擊。

english: This room is filled with 1-foot-deep water. A thin wooden plank spans the water, connecting the room's entrance and exit. A creature crossing the plank must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check or fall into the water. The first time a creature touches the water, three {@creature Water Elemental||water elementals} appear and attack.
zh_tw: 這個房間內充滿了1尺深的水。一塊薄木板橫跨水面，連線著房間的入口和出口。生物在透過木板時必須成功透過一次 {@dc 17} 敏捷 ({@skill Acrobatics||體操}) 檢定，否則會掉入水中。當生物首次接觸水面時，三隻 {@creature Water Elemental||水元素} 會出現並發動攻擊。

english: A hostile but sleeping {@creature behir} lies curled around a chest. A creature that approaches the behir must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check to avoid being noticed. The chest is unlocked and contains 50 talons and one {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA}.
zh_tw: 一隻敵對但正在睡眠的{@creature behir||青足龍蛇}蜷縮在一個箱子周圍。任何接近貝希爾的生物必須成功透過一個{@dc 16}敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定，以避免被注意到。箱子沒有上鎖，裡面裝有50枚塔隆和一枚{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}。

english: A large vase filled with 100 talons sits in the center of the room. The vase is guarded by three {@creature Invisible Stalker||invisible stalkers}, which attack any creature that touches the vessel.
zh_tw: 一個裝有100爪幣的大花瓶放在房間中央。這個花瓶由三個{@creature Invisible Stalker||隱形追獵者}守護，它們會攻擊任何觸碰容器的生物。

english: A hostile {@creature iron golem} patrols this room and immediately attacks intruders. If the golem is destroyed, a character who searches the golem's remains finds three {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|Soul Coins}.
zh_tw: 一個敵對的{@creature iron golem||鐵魔像}在房間裡巡邏，並立即攻擊入侵者。如果魔像被摧毀，搜尋魔像殘骸的角色會發現三枚{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}。

english: Viridian Den
zh_tw: 翠綠巢穴

english: The walls and ceilings of this cozy den are made of luminescent jade. Rowdy patrons gather around game tables, scowling at dice and cards as they test their luck. A green-scaled draconic devil moves between games, idly chatting with players.
zh_tw: 這個舒適的小窩的牆壁和天花板由發光的翡翠製成。喧鬧的顧客聚集在遊戲桌旁，皺眉看著骰子和卡牌，測試他們的運氣。一個綠鱗的龍形惡魔在遊戲間穿梭，隨意地與玩家聊天。

english: The green devil is the room's pit master, Rezran Agrodro (see the "{@area Casino Pit Masters|415|x}" section). Rezran observes the room, occasionally swooping in to speak with a patron who's on a winning streak.
zh_tw: 這個綠惡魔是房間的坑主，雷茲蘭·阿格羅卓（見本章前面的"{@area 賭場賭檯主管|415|x}"部分）。雷茲蘭觀察著房間，偶爾俯衝下來與一位連勝的顧客交談。

english: Pit Master's Favor
zh_tw: 坑主的青睞

english: If the characters have 1,000 talons or more and are in the Viridian Den, Rezran is impressed and invites them to Dragon's Pride.
zh_tw: 如果角色們擁有1000爪幣或更多，並且位於翠綠色小窩，雷茲蘭會印象深刻並邀請他們到龍后之傲。

english: Games in the Viridian Den
zh_tw: 翠綠色小窩的遊戲

english: The characters can partake in two games while visiting the Viridian Den.
zh_tw: 角色們在訪問翠綠色小窩時可以參與兩種遊戲。

english: Drake's Auction
zh_tw: 幼龍的拍賣

english: This card game has a minimum bet of 20 talons, which goes into a pot at the center of the table. The goal of the game is to amass the highest-ranking hand of cards.
zh_tw: 這種紙牌遊戲的最低下注是20爪幣，這些下注會放入桌子中央的獎池中。遊戲的目標是積累最高等級的一手牌。

english: At the start of the game, the croupier deals each participant a pair of cards. The croupier draws three cards to lay face up next to the pot; these cards are up for auction. Participants bid on the auction cards, and the participant with the highest bid wins the card and adds their bid to the pot. Once all three auction cards have been sold, all participants reveal their hands, and the highest-ranking hand wins the whole pot.
zh_tw: 遊戲開始時，莊家給每位參與者發一對牌。莊家抽取三張牌放在獎池旁邊，面朝上；這些牌將被拍賣。參與者對拍賣牌進行競標，出價最高的參與者贏得那張牌，並將他們的出價加到獎池中。一旦所有三張拍賣牌都售出，所有參與者展示他們的手牌，最高等級的手牌贏得整個獎池。

english: To simulate play of this game, have each participant roll {@dice 2d12} in secret. Then, roll {@dice 3d12} and show the numbers rolled—these represent the auction cards. On winning a bid, the participant can add the number rolled on the die won to their total roll. At the end of the game, the participant with the highest total wins. If the highest totals are tied, no one wins.
zh_tw: 為了模擬這個遊戲的玩法，讓每位參與者秘密擲骰{@dice 2d12}。然後，擲骰{@dice 3d12}並展示擲出的數字——這些代表拍賣牌。贏得競標時，參與者可以將贏得的骰子上擲出的數字加到他們的總點數上。遊戲結束時，總點數最高的參與者獲勝。如果最高總點數出現平局，則無人獲勝。

english: Triple Hydra
zh_tw: 三頭蛇

english: The minimum bet for this game is 25 talons. In this dice game, each participant rolls {@dice 3d6}. If the participant rolls none of the same number, the participant wins nothing. If the participant rolls two of the same number, the participant wins an amount equal to twice their starting bet. If the participant rolls three of the same number, the participant wins an amount equal to triple their starting bet.
zh_tw: 這種遊戲的最低下注是25爪幣。在這個骰子游戲中，每位參與者擲骰{@dice 3d6}。如果參與者沒有擲出相同的數字，則一無所獲。如果參與者擲出兩個相同的數字，則贏得的金額是他們起始下注的兩倍。如果參與者擲出三個相同的數字，則贏得的金額是他們起始下注的三倍。

english: If a participant rolls two or more 1s, this roll is called snake eyes. In addition to the normal payout, a participant who rolls snake eyes also gets an additional payout equal to their starting bet.
zh_tw: 如果一個參與者擲出兩個或更多的1點，這種擲骰被稱為蛇眼。除了正常的賠付外，擲出蛇眼的參與者還會額外獲得等於他們起始下注的賠付。

english: Dragon's Pride
zh_tw: 龍后之傲

english: Occupying the lower floor of the Red Belvedere, Dragon's Pride is an exclusive club reserved for the casino's most valued patrons. Here, club members can spend talons on opulent jewelry, refreshing cocktails, and rejuvenating spa treatments.
zh_tw: 龍后之傲佔據了紅亭的底層，是一個專為賭場最尊貴的顧客保留的獨傢俱樂部。在這裡，俱樂部會員可以用爪幣購買奢華的珠寶、清爽的雞尾酒和恢復活力的水療護理。

english: This floor is also home to the casino proprietor's office, which connects to a hidden sanctum used to communicate directly with Tiamat. Within this sanctum, Windfall keeps the final piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, hoping to amplify the rod's ability to cast {@spell Simulacrum} with Tiamat's power and re-create her master's beloved lost creation: Sardior, the ruby dragon.
zh_tw: 這一層也是賭場老闆辦公室的所在地，它連線到一個隱藏的聖所，用於直接與提亞馬特溝通。在這個聖所內，意外之財保管著{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的最後部分，希望利用提亞馬特的力量增強魔杖施放{@spell Simulacrum||擬像術}的能力，並重新創造她主人心愛的失物：薩迪歐，紅寶石龍。

english: Entering Dragon's Pride
zh_tw: 進入龍后之傲

english: Dragon's Pride occupies the lower floor of the casino and is accessed via an elevator. This elevator is magically concealed within the back of the large dragon statue in the casino's lobby. To view the elevator's entrance and pass through, a creature must bear the club's mark: an enchanted tattoo of a dragon claw. Only Windfall and the casino's pit masters can bestow or remove this tattoo. As soon as the tiefling or a pit master grants permission to enter Dragon's Pride, the mark magically appears on a creature's hand. To creatures lacking the mark, the club's elevator is undetectable and impassable by any other means.
zh_tw: 龍后之傲位於賭場下層，須搭乘升降梯進入。升降梯以魔法隱藏在賭場大廳的大型龍雕像背面。生物必須帶有俱樂部的標記——附有魔法的龍爪刺青——才能看見並穿過升降梯入口。只有意外之財和賭場主管能賦予或移除這道刺青。這名提夫林或任何一位賭場主管一旦準許某個生物進入龍后之傲，標記就會魔法般地出現在該生物的手上。沒有標記的生物無法偵知升降梯，也無法用任何其他方式透過入口。

english: Once the characters have gained favor with at least one of the casino's pit masters, that pit master marks each of the characters with the club's tattoo and instructs the characters to head through the back of the lobby's statue. Now bearing the club's mark, the characters can see the entrance to Dragon's Pride:
zh_tw: 一旦角色們至少贏得了賭場的一個坑主的青睞，那個坑主就會給每個角色打上俱樂部的紋身，並指示角色們穿過大廳雕像的背面。現在帶著俱樂部的標誌，角色們可以看到龍后之傲的入口：

english: What was once a solid statue now appears translucent. Within, a stone platform slowly levitates between this floor and the one below.
zh_tw: 原本是實心的雕像現在看起來變得透明。裡面，一個石臺在這個樓層和下面的樓層之間緩緩上升。

english: As long as they bear the mark, the characters can enter and exit Dragon's Pride at their leisure.
zh_tw: 只要他們攜帶著標誌，角色們可以隨意進出龍后之傲。

english: Features of Dragon's Pride
zh_tw: 龍后之傲的特點

english: Unless otherwise stated, the areas of Dragon's Pride have the following features.
zh_tw: 除非另有說明，龍后之傲的區域具有以下特點。

english: Ceilings, Floors, and Walls
zh_tw: 天花板、地板和牆壁

english: The ceilings, floors, and walls are carved from smooth red stone that's slightly warm to the touch. The ceilings are 15 feet high unless otherwise noted.
zh_tw: 天花板、地板和牆壁都是由觸感微暖的光滑紅石雕刻而成。除非另有說明，天花板高度為15尺。

english: Lighting
zh_tw: 光照

english: Rooms are brightly lit by multicolored magical sconces. Tapping a sconce turns it off.
zh_tw: 房間由多彩的魔法壁燈照亮。輕敲壁燈可以將其關閉。

english: Security
zh_tw: 安全

english: A {@creature pit fiend} stands guard in each room. The pit fiends are silent observers who intervene if a fight breaks out.
zh_tw: 每個房間都有一位{@creature pit fiend||深獄煉魔}守衛。深獄煉魔是沉默的觀察者，如果發生戰鬥，他們會介入。

english: Wards
zh_tw: 大區

english: Magical wards surround Dragon's Pride. If a creature without the club's mark attempts to teleport into Dragon's Pride, the creature takes 33 ({@dice 6d10}) psychic damage, and the attempt fails.
zh_tw: 魔法結界環繞著龍后之傲。如果一個沒有俱樂部標誌的生物試圖透過傳送進入龍后之傲，該生物將受到33點（{@dice 6d10}）心靈傷害，並且傳送嘗試失敗。

english: Dragon's Pride Locations
zh_tw: 龍后之傲的地點

english: The areas of Dragon's Pride are keyed to map 8.4.
zh_tw: 龍后之傲的區域對應於地圖8.4。

english: Map 8.4: Dragon's Pride
zh_tw: 地圖8.4：龍后之傲

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: N1: Wyrmsong Cantina
zh_tw: N1: 龍吟酒館

english: Lavish couches surround low tables in this dimly lit lounge. At the center of the room is a circular bar. Liquor bottles on shelves flash colors in time with faintly playing jazz, while a frost-blue devil pours drinks behind the bar.
zh_tw: 在這個昏暗的休息室中，豪華的沙發圍繞著低矮的桌子。房間中央是一個圓形的吧檯。架子上的酒瓶隨著微弱播放的爵士樂閃爍著色彩，而一個冰藍色的惡魔在吧檯後面倒酒。

english: The bartender is an {@creature ice devil} named Oganath, who uses its frigid claws to instantly chill the drinks it serves. At any given time, {@dice 2d4} {@creature Horned Devil||horned devils} relax in the lounge.
zh_tw: 酒保是一位名叫奧加納斯的{@creature ice devil||冰魔}，它用自己冰冷的爪子瞬間冷卻它所服務的飲料。在任何時候，都有{@dice 2d4}只{@creature Horned Devil||角魔}在休息室裡放鬆。

english: Oganath's Cocktails
zh_tw: 奧加納斯的雞尾酒

english: An expert in arcane mixology, Oganath serves a myriad of magic drinks at the bar:
zh_tw: 奧加納斯是位精通奧術調酒的專家，在吧檯提供多種魔法飲料：

english: Blazing Bloody Jack (Costs 100 Talons)
zh_tw: 熾熱血腥傑克（花費100爪幣）

english: Motes of coagulated, red juice are suspended throughout this amber-colored cocktail, which tastes both sweet and spicy. When consumed, this drink functions as a {@item Potion of Heroism}.
zh_tw: 這個琥珀色的雞尾酒中懸浮著凝固的紅色汁液，味道既甜又辣。飲用後，這種飲料具有{@item Potion of Heroism||英勇藥水}的效果。

english: Joker's Sky (Costs 125 Talons)
zh_tw: 小丑的天空（花費125爪幣）

english: This lustrous blue drink is topped with fluffy, white cream. When consumed, this drink functions as a {@item Potion of Flying}.
zh_tw: 這款光澤的藍色飲料頂部覆蓋著蓬鬆的白色奶油。飲用後，這種飲料具有{@item Potion of Flying||飛行藥水}的效果。

english: Salubra Slinger (Costs 50 Talons)
zh_tw: 健康射手（花費50爪幣）

english: This fizzy, berry-flavored drink causes the imbiber's mouth to feel slightly numb. When consumed, this drink functions as an {@item Elixir of Health}.
zh_tw: 這款帶有氣泡的漿果味飲料會讓飲用者的口腔感到輕微的麻木。飲用後，這種飲料具有{@item Elixir of Health||健康靈藥}的效果。

english: A drink loses its magic if it is removed from the Red Belvedere. Oganath also offers a variety of mundane cocktails, which cost 3 talons each.
zh_tw: 如果飲料從紅亭臺移走，它將失去魔法效果。奧加納斯還提供各種普通的雞尾酒，每款價格為3爪幣。

english: N2: Enchanting Arcana
zh_tw: N2: 迷人奧秘

english: A sleek rakshasa in shimmering teal robes runs this arcane jewelry store. Elegant, bejeweled accessories are displayed for sale on the counter.
zh_tw: 一位穿著閃亮藍綠色長袍的光滑拉克莎斯經營著這家奧術珠寶店。櫃檯上陳列著出售的優雅、鑲有寶石的飾品。

english: The store is run by a vainglorious {@creature rakshasa} lapidary named Krysocol, who has several pieces for sale:
zh_tw: 這家店由一位虛榮的{@creature rakshasa||羅剎}寶石匠克里索科爾經營，他有幾件商品出售：

english: Two black jade pendants (each an {@item Amulet of Proof against Detection and Location}) for 300 talons each
zh_tw: 兩個黑色玉墜（每個都是{@item Amulet of Proof against Detection and Location||反偵護符})，每個300爪幣

english: A brass necklace hung with citrine spheres (a {@item Necklace of Fireballs} with five beads) for 1,250 talons
zh_tw: 一條掛著黃色水晶球的黃銅項鍊（一個帶有五個珠子的{@item Necklace of Fireballs||火球項鍊})，價格為1250爪幣

english: A purple ring with white diamond stars (a {@item Ring of Shooting Stars}) for 2,000 talons
zh_tw: 一枚帶有白色鑽石星星的紫色戒指（一個{@item Ring of Shooting Stars||流星戒指})，價格為2000爪幣

english: Forged in Hell
zh_tw: 地獄鍛造

english: Any magic item created by Krysocol bears the following additional effect, which the rakshasa is loath to disclose:
zh_tw: 克里索科爾製造的任何魔法物品都具有以下額外效果，這位拉克莎斯不願透露：

english: Curse
zh_tw: 詛咒

english: As long as you wear this item, you are cursed. The item can't be removed until you are targeted by a {@spell Remove Curse} spell or similar magic. While cursed in this way, every time you finish a long rest, you must make a {@dc 10} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, you immediately drop everything you are carrying or wearing and are transformed into a {@creature lemure}. Only a {@spell Wish} spell can reverse this transformation.
zh_tw: 只要你佩戴這件物品，你就會被詛咒。在你被 {@spell Remove Curse||移除詛咒} 法術或類似魔法命中之前，這件物品無法被移除。當以此方式被詛咒時，每當你完成一次長休，你必須進行一次 {@dc 10} 魅力豁免。若豁免失敗，你立刻掉落攜帶或穿戴的所有物品，並轉變為一隻 {@creature lemure||劣魔}。只有 {@spell Wish||祈願術} 可以逆轉這一轉變。

english: N3: Virtuous Vices
zh_tw: N3: 美德的惡習

english: Fluffy clouds of steam billow from this spa, redolent of ginger and citrus. Two erinyes—one in a white robe, one in black—stand behind the counter. Behind them are several hot springs and massage stations.
zh_tw: 這家水療中心冒出的蒸汽像蓬鬆的雲朵，散發著姜和柑橘的香氣。兩個罪魔——一個穿著白色長袍，一個穿著黑色——站在櫃檯後面。他們身後是幾個溫泉和按摩站。

english: The spa is run by two {@creature erinyes} named Vitia and Vertu. They offer two services:
zh_tw: 這家水療中心由兩位名叫維提亞和維爾圖的{@creature erinyes||罪魔}經營。她們提供兩項服務：

english: Brimstone Springs (Costs 100 Talons)
zh_tw: 硫磺泉（花費100爪幣）

english: This service takes 1 hour and includes a relaxing hot spring bath and massage. A creature who partakes in this service gains {@dice 4d10 + 4} {@book temporary hit points|PHB|9|Temporary Hit Points} in addition to the benefits of a short rest.
zh_tw: 這項服務耗時1小時，包括一個放鬆的溫泉浴和按摩。享受這項服務的生物除了短休的好處外，還將獲得{@dice 4d10 + 4}點{@book 臨時生命值|PHB|9|Temporary Hit Points}。

english: Luxe Reawakening (Costs 450 Talons)
zh_tw: 豪華覺醒（花費450爪幣）

english: This rejuvenating service takes 3 hours. A creature who partakes in this service gains {@dice 6d10 + 6} {@book temporary hit points|PHB|9|Temporary Hit Points} in addition to the benefits of a long rest.
zh_tw: 這項恢復活力的服務需要3小時。享受這項服務的生物除了長休的好處外，還將獲得{@dice 6d10 + 6}點{@book 臨時生命值|PHB|9|Temporary Hit Points}。

english: N4: Windfall's Office
zh_tw: N4: 意外之財的辦公室

english: The door to the office is locked and guarded by two {@creature Pit Fiend||pit fiends}. Each pit fiend standing guard also carries a key to the office door for emergency purposes. Opening the door without the proper key requires thieves' tools and a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check, or a {@spell Knock} spell or similar magic.
zh_tw: 辦公室的門被鎖上了，並由兩隻{@creature Pit Fiend||深獄煉魔}守護著。每隻站崗的坑魔都攜帶著辦公室門的鑰匙，以備緊急情況使用。沒有合適的鑰匙開啟門需要盜賊工具併成功透過{@dc 20}敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定，或者使用{@spell Knock||敲擊術}或類似的魔法。

english: If the office door is opened by any means other than the key, its trap activates, spraying colorless poisonous gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or take 18 ({@dice 4d8}) poison damage. This trap can't be disarmed.
zh_tw: 如果辦公室的門以任何非鑰匙的方式被開啟，其陷阱將啟用，向15尺的錐形範圍內噴射無色的有毒氣體。區域內的每個生物必須成功透過一次{@dc 20}的體質豁免檢定，否則將受到18點（{@dice 4d8}）毒素傷害。此陷阱無法解除。

english: The office's interior is devoid of occupants. When the characters venture inside, read the following:
zh_tw: 辦公室內部沒有人員。當角色們進入裡面時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: Bookshelves line the walls of this room. A bed draped in plush linens is built into an alcove, across from which is a simple work desk covered in papers and books. Mounted on the back wall is the sculpted bust of a smiling red dragon.
zh_tw: 這個房間的牆壁上排列著書架。一個被豪華亞麻布覆蓋的床嵌入在一個凹室裡，對面是一個簡單的工作桌，桌子上堆滿了紙張和書籍。後牆上掛著一個微笑的紅龍的雕塑半身像。

english: The desk is covered with notes about magical constructs, as well as religious and historical texts written in Draconic. A character who spends 10 minutes studying these items learns the following:
zh_tw: 桌子上覆蓋著關於魔法構造的筆記，以及用龍語寫成的宗教和歷史文字。如果一個角色花費10分鐘研究這些物品，他將瞭解到以下內容：

english: The First World
zh_tw: 第一世界

english: Tiamat worked alongside the platinum dragon Bahamut to shape the Material Plane in the form of a single First World. An unknown cataclysm sundered this First World, resulting in the numerous universes now occupying the Material Plane.
zh_tw: 提亞馬特與白金龍巴哈姆特並肩工作，塑造了以單一的第一世界形式存在的物質位面。一個未知的大災變分裂了這個第一世界，導致現在佔據物質位面的眾多宇宙。

english: The Ruby Dragon
zh_tw: 紅寶石龍

english: While creating the First World, Bahamut and Tiamat also created Sardior, a dragon with ruby scales. Sardior was destroyed in the sundering of the First World.
zh_tw: 在創造第一世界的過程中，巴哈姆特和提亞馬特還創造了薩迪歐，一隻擁有紅寶石鱗片的龍。薩迪歐在第一世界的分裂中被毀滅。

english: The Simulacrum Project
zh_tw: 模擬像計劃

english: Windfall acquired the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|seventh piece} of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} some time ago. She used it to create an image of Sardior, who she believes resembled a red dragon. Windfall hopes to find a way to use the rod piece to bring the image to life.
zh_tw: 意外之財不久前獲得了{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|第七部分}（來自{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}）。她用其創造了薩迪歐的影像，她認為薩迪歐與紅龍相似。意外之財希望找到一種方法，利用杖的部分讓影像煥發生機。

english: Secret Entrance
zh_tw: 秘密入口

english: The bust on the wall projects an illusion that conceals the entrance to the Ruby Sanctum (area N5). A {@spell See Invisibility} spell or similar magic reveals the entryway's outline in the wall. A character searching the room for secret doors finds this hidden entrance with a successful {@dc 18} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check.
zh_tw: 牆上的雕像投射出一層幻象，掩蓋了紅玉聖殿（區域 N5）的入口。使用{@spell See Invisibility||識破隱形}法術或類似魔法可以揭示牆上門戶的輪廓。角色在房間內搜尋密門時，成功透過 {@dc 18} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定即可發現這個隱藏的入口。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Most of the items in Windfall's office are lavish but mundane and too big to transport. However, a character who searches the room finds a {@item Tome of Leadership and Influence} tucked into a bookcase.
zh_tw: 意外之財辦公室裡的大部分物品都很豪華，但都是普通且體積太大而難以搬運的。然而，一個在房間裡搜尋的角色會發現一本藏在書架裡的{@item Tome of Leadership and Influence||統御卷冊}。

english: N5: Ruby Sanctum
zh_tw: N5: 紅寶石聖所

english: A holographic red dragon sleeps next to the final rod piece
zh_tw: 一隻全息紅龍睡在最後的法杖碎片旁邊

english: The walls of this cavernous space are made of faceted, ruby-red crystal. A thin tunnel juts from the back of the cavern and leads into darkness.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴般的空間的牆壁由多面的紅寶石色水晶構成。一條狹窄的隧道從洞穴的後部突出，通向黑暗。

english: A stalagmite rises from the floor in the center of the room. A similarly sized stalactite hangs from the ceiling directly above it. The space between the two is occupied by a crystalline rod piece pulsing with energy. The piece projects the holographic image of a sleeping red dragon. Windfall stands near the projection, watching it intently.
zh_tw: 從房間中央的地面上升起一根石筍。同樣大小的石鐘乳懸掛在天花板上，正對著它。兩者之間的空間被一根充滿能量的水晶法杖碎片佔據。這件碎片投射出一個沉睡紅龍的全息影象。意外之財站在投影旁邊，專注地觀察著它。

english: The ceilings in this chamber are 45 feet high. {@creature Windfall|VEoR} is hostile to trespassers in the sanctum.
zh_tw: 這個房間的天花板高45尺。{@creature Windfall|VEoR|意外之財}對聖所中的入侵者持有敵意。

english: The crystalline object floating between the stalagmite and stalactite is the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|final piece} of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}. Attempting to remove the rod piece from its position immediately causes the image of the dragon to disappear, prompting Windfall to attack.
zh_tw: 懸浮在石筍和石鐘乳之間的水晶物體是{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|最後一片}的{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}。試圖從其位置移除法杖碎片會立即導致龍的影象消失，這將促使意外之財發起攻擊。

english: Draconic Intervention
zh_tw: 龍族幹預

english: When Windfall is first reduced to 0 hit points, multicolored light surrounds her as five hissing voices echo throughout the chamber:
zh_tw: 當意外之財第一次降至0生命值時，五彩光芒環繞著她，同時五個嘶嘶作響的聲音在房間中迴盪：

english: "Upstart insects! Who dares make a racket outside my lair? Who dares interrupt the musings of the Dragon Queen?"
zh_tw: "無禮的蟲子！誰敢在我的巢穴外製造噪音？誰敢打擾龍後的思維？"

english: The facets of the sanctum's walls reflect images of Tiamat's eyes as she talks. Windfall regains 300 hit points but has the {@condition paralyzed} condition due to Tiamat's magic as the Dragon Queen speaks to the characters directly.
zh_tw: 聖所牆壁的各個切面反射出提亞馬特的眼睛的影像，隨著她說話而閃爍。意外之財恢復了300點生命值，但由於提亞馬特的魔法，她現在處於{@condition paralyzed||麻痺}狀態，龍後直接對角色們說話。

english: Retrieving the Rod Piece
zh_tw: 取回權杖部件

english: If the characters inform Tiamat of Vecna's plot, Tiamat growls in disdain before grudgingly allowing the characters to leave with the final piece of the rod. She explains that the Material Plane is partly her creation—and she refuses to let an overzealous archlich unmake it. The Dragon Queen then commands the characters to leave the casino at once.
zh_tw: 如果角色們向提亞馬特透露了維克那的陰謀，提亞馬特會輕蔑地咆哮，然後不情願地允許角色們帶著法杖的最後一片離開。她解釋說物質位面部分是她的創造——她拒絕讓一個過於狂熱的大巫妖毀掉它。然後龍後命令角色們立即離開賭場。

english: Otherwise, Tiamat releases Windfall from her magical restraints, instructs the tiefling to eradicate the party, and leaves to commune with her other champions. Only after Windfall is defeated can the characters acquire the final piece of the rod. For more about the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, see this book's {@area introduction|00e|x}.
zh_tw: 否則，提亞馬特解除了對意外之財的魔法束縛，指示這位提夫林消滅隊伍，並離開去與其他冠軍溝通。只有在意外之財被擊敗後，角色們才能獲得法杖的最後一片。有關{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的更多資訊，請參見本書的{@area 簡介|00e|x}。

english: To Tiamat's Lair
zh_tw: 前往提亞馬特的巢穴

english: The narrow tunnel to the south eventually leads to Tiamat's lair. This entrance is currently guarded by Drekarvynix, an {@creature ancient red dragon}, who demands the characters leave unless they can prove their legitimate business in Tiamat's lair. Unless the characters provide a compelling reason to enter, Drekarvynix attacks them. The red dragon doesn't pursue the characters back through the tunnel to Dragon's Pride.
zh_tw: 向南的狹窄隧道最終通往提亞馬特的巢穴。這個入口目前由德雷卡維尼克斯，一頭{@creature ancient red dragon||遠古紅龍}守衛著，它要求角色們離開，除非他們能證明自己來提亞馬特巢穴的正當理由。除非角色們提供充分的進入理由，否則德雷卡維尼克斯會攻擊他們。這頭紅龍不會沿著隧道追擊角色們回到龍后之傲。

english: Next Steps
zh_tw: 下一步

english: Once the characters have retrieved the last piece of the rod, they can go back to the doorway through the mountainside cliff in Avernus and return to Sigil without further complications.
zh_tw: 一旦角色們取回了法杖的最後一片，他們就可以返回到阿弗納斯山崖的門口，然後返回法印城，不會再有進一步的麻煩。

english: Chapter 9: The Betrayer Revealed
zh_tw: 第9章：背叛者揭露

english: Once Alustriel and Tasha realize Mordenkainen is a fraud, an epic battle ensues in Sigil
zh_tw: 一旦艾拉斯卓和塔莎意識到魔鄧肯是個騙子，一場史詩般的戰鬥就在法印城爆發了

english: Once the characters have all of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, all eyes turn to {@creature Alustriel Silverhand|VEoR|Alustriel}, {@creature Tasha the Witch|VEoR|Tasha}, and the impostor Mordenkainen. The plan was for the characters to work with the Wizards Three to pin down Vecna's location and stop the archlich's Ritual of Remaking. However, this chapter reveals that the characters—as well as Alustriel and Tasha—have been deceived.
zh_tw: 一旦角色們集齊了所有的{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}，所有人的目光都轉向了{@creature Alustriel Silverhand|VEoR|艾拉斯卓}、{@creature Tasha the Witch|VEoR|塔莎}和冒牌的魔鄧肯。原計劃是讓角色們與三巫師合作，確定維克那的位置並阻止這位大巫妖的重塑儀式。然而，這一章揭示了角色們——以及艾拉斯卓和塔莎——都受到了欺騙。

english: The fake Mordenkainen reveals himself to be {@creature Kas the Betrayer|VEoR}, Vecna's former ally and current archenemy. The characters must chase Kas across the multiverse to Pandesmos, the first layer of the plane of Pandemonium, where the vampire plans to co-opt Vecna's ritual and become the most powerful being in existence.
zh_tw: 冒充魔鄧肯的人揭露自己其實是{@creature Kas the Betrayer|VEoR|背叛者凱斯}，他曾是維克那的盟友，如今卻是維克那的死敵。角色們必須跨越多元宇宙追趕凱斯，前往喧癲空隧位面的第一層——潘德斯莫斯。這名吸血鬼計劃在那裡篡奪維克那的儀式，成為一切存在之中最強大的個體。

english: Running This Chapter
zh_tw: 運作本章

english: This chapter begins after the characters retrieve the final piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} from Avernus. Whether the characters are carrying the previous six rod pieces or those pieces remained in Sigil, the rod knits itself into one artifact when all the pieces are within a few inches of each other.
zh_tw: 這一章節開始於角色們從阿弗納斯取回了{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的最後一片。無論角色們是否攜帶著前六片法杖，或者那些碎片留在了法印城，當所有碎片彼此靠近幾吋之內時，法杖就會自行組合成一個完整的神器。

english: The rod becomes complete, but no character is likely yet attuned to it, and the Wizards Three in Sigil asked the characters to return to the sanctum once all the rod pieces were found. If the characters hesitate after retrieving the final rod piece, encourage them to quickly return to their allies at the sanctum in Sigil. The characters' return to the sanctum triggers the next part of the story.
zh_tw: 法杖變得完整，但目前可能還沒有角色與之共鳴，並且法印城的三巫師要求角色們一旦找到了所有法杖碎片就返回聖所。如果角色們在找到最後一片法杖碎片後猶豫不決，鼓勵他們迅速返回法印城的盟友聖所。角色們返回聖所將觸發故事的下一部分。

english: This chapter's early scenes include the chaos caused when Kas steals the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} and gravely wounds Alustriel and Tasha. The chapter progresses to Pandesmos, where the characters find a war erupting between Kas's and Vecna's demonic forces. The characters must stay on Kas's trail if they hope to find Vecna, potentially neutralize Kas, and end the threat to the multiverse.
zh_tw: 這一章的早期場景包括凱斯偷走了{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}並嚴重傷害了艾拉斯卓和塔莎時引起的混亂。隨著章節的推進，角色們來到了潘德斯莫斯，在那裡他們發現凱斯和維克那的惡魔力量之間爆發了戰爭。如果角色們希望找到維克那，可能中和凱斯，並結束對多元宇宙的威脅，他們必須繼續追蹤凱斯。

english: Character Advancement
zh_tw: 角色升級

english: The characters should be 18th level when this chapter begins. The characters gain a level after they navigate Pandesmos Outlook and arrive at Carapace Ridge, where the war between the forces of Kas and Vecna rages.
zh_tw: 當這一章節開始時，角色們應該是18級。在角色們穿越潘德斯莫斯前哨站並抵達卡帕斯山脊，那裡凱斯和維克那的勢力之間的戰爭正在激烈進行之後，角色們將獲得一個等級的提升。

english: Power of Secrets
zh_tw: 秘密的力量

english: The characters can learn one secret in this chapter that is applicable to the rules in "{@area The Power of Secrets|028|x}" section in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}:
zh_tw: 角色們可以在這個章節中學到一個適用於本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中的"{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}"部分規則的秘密：

english: Malaina's Secret
zh_tw: 瑪萊娜的秘密

english: Alustriel's wife was suspicious of Mordenkainen since he arrived in the sanctum, but she said nothing to Alustriel, Tasha, or the characters. The characters can learn this secret in the "{@area Malaina's Mistrust|473|x}" section later in this chapter.
zh_tw: 艾拉斯卓的妻子自從魔鄧肯來到聖所以來就對他起了疑心，但她沒有對艾拉斯卓、塔莎或角色們說任何話。角色們可以在本章稍後"{@area 瑪萊娜的不信任|473|x}"部分瞭解到這個秘密。

english: Returning from Avernus
zh_tw: 從阿弗納斯返回

english: When the characters return from Avernus with the final piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, {@creature Kas the Betrayer|VEoR|Kas}—disguised as Mordenkainen—greets them inside the sanctum. He appears giddy yet terrified, unable to hide his honest emotions.
zh_tw: 當角色們帶著最後一塊{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}從阿弗納斯返回時，偽裝成魔鄧肯的{@creature Kas the Betrayer|VEoR|凱斯}在聖所內迎接他們。他看起來既興奮又恐懼，無法隱藏他真實的情緒。

english: As soon as the disguised Kas sees the characters step through the doorway with the final rod piece, he exclaims the following:
zh_tw: 當偽裝的凱斯看到角色們帶著最後一片法杖穿過門口時，他立刻大聲說道：

english: "My friends! Have you got it? The final piece? I can tell from the spring in your step that you do! How exciting!
zh_tw: "我的朋友們！你們拿到了嗎？最後一件？我能從你們的步伐中看出你們拿到了！多麼令人興奮啊！

english: "While you've been away, we've deduced that Vecna needs to conduct his ritual in a place of great import where he can generate power from the secrets his cult has stolen.
zh_tw: "在你們離開的期間，我們推斷出維克那需要在一個重要的地方進行他的儀式，他可以從他的邪教偷來的秘密中產生力量。"

english: "It's likely to be a far-flung location, and on a plane we'd not expect. I'd say it's like finding a needle in a haystack, but I have colleagues who might help us determine the location. I'll speak with them today, and hopefully we'll have our answer.
zh_tw: "這很可能是一個遙遠的地方，在一個我們意想不到的位面上。我想說這就像是在乾草堆裡找針，但我有同事可能會幫助我們確定位置。我今天會和他們談談，希望我們能找到答案。"

english: "You've all been through a lot. You should rest in your quarters. In the meantime, I'll make sure the rod is properly reassembled and working to its full potential. You're going to need your energy for when we face Vecna!"
zh_tw: "你們都經歷了很多。你們應該在自己的房間裡休息。與此同時，我會確保法杖被正確地重新組裝併發揮其全部潛力。當我們面對維克那時，你們將需要你們的能量！

english: Kas strongly encourages the characters to rest now and leave the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} in the wizards' care. Kas wants to keep the characters away from the rod and the wizards for the next few hours. Ever the villain, Kas plans to take Alustriel and Tasha by surprise, steal the rod, and flee to Pandemonium to free {@creature Miska the Wolf-Spider|VEoR} before confronting {@creature Vecna the Archlich|VEoR|Vecna}. Even if a character is already attuned to the rod, Kas plans to steal it.
zh_tw: 凱斯強烈建議角色們現在休息，並將{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}交給巫師們保管。凱斯希望在接下來的幾個小時內讓角色們遠離權杖和巫師們。作為一貫的惡棍，凱斯計劃出其不意地抓住艾拉斯卓和塔莎，偷走權杖，逃往喧癲空隧，在對抗{@creature Vecna the Archlich|VEoR|維克那}之前釋放{@creature Miska the Wolf-Spider|VEoR|米斯卡，狼蛛}。即使某個角色已經與權杖建立了共鳴，凱斯仍計劃將其偷走。

english: Despite what he has said while posing as Mordenkainen, Kas knows Vecna is conducting his Ritual of Remaking on the plane of Pandemonium. After receiving a message in a dream from the Dark Powers, Kas realized that the magic inherent in his {@item Crown of Lies|VEoR} would transport him through Alustriel's portal to roughly the location of Vecna's ritual. Now that the characters have retrieved the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, the characters are mere inconveniences to Kas, but he doesn't want to fight them, as the fight might significantly weaken him, if not worse.
zh_tw: 儘管他冒充魔鄧肯時所說的話，凱斯知道維克那正在喧癲空隧位面進行他的重塑儀式。在從黑暗力量那裡收到夢中的資訊後，凱斯意識到他的{@item Crown of Lies|VEoR|謊言之冠}中固有的魔法可以將他透過艾拉斯卓的傳送門大致傳送到維克那儀式的位置。現在角色們已經取回了{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}，對於凱斯來說，角色們只是小小的不便，但他不想與他們戰鬥，因為戰鬥可能會大大削弱他，甚至更糟。

english: If the Characters Decline
zh_tw: 如果角色拒絕

english: If the characters are suspicious, or if they are being particularly cautious, they might not want to hand over the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} or rest in their quarters. Below are options for handling characters who don't take Kas's suggestions.
zh_tw: 如果角色們心生疑慮，或者特別謹慎，他們可能不願意交出{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}或在自己的房間裡休息。以下是處理那些不接受凱斯建議的角色的選項。

english: The Other Wizards
zh_tw: 其他法師

english: Kas told Alustriel and Tasha that he wishes to tinker with the complete {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}. He has convinced the others that he can fortify the artifact to prevent it from shattering again when the characters use it to stop Vecna's ritual. If the characters insist on keeping the rod, Alustriel and Tasha approach them and explain this. They ask the characters to relinquish the rod, acknowledging that Mordenkainen might be a bit eccentric, but his magical theories are sound. Alustriel and Tasha extol the virtues of ensuring that the rod won't sunder again.
zh_tw: 凱斯告訴艾拉斯卓和塔莎，他希望對完整的{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}進行一些調整。他說服其他人，他可以加固這個神器，以防止當角色們使用它來阻止維克那的儀式時再次破碎。如果角色們堅持要保留法杖，艾拉斯卓和塔莎會接近他們並解釋這一點。他們請求角色們放棄法杖，承認魔鄧肯可能有點古怪，但他的魔法理論是正確的。艾拉斯卓和塔莎讚揚確保法杖不會再斷裂的好處。

english: Missing Malaina
zh_tw: 失蹤的瑪萊娜

english: If the characters resist resting in their quarters, Alustriel approaches them privately. She's concerned that her wife, Malaina, left the sanctum several hours ago and hasn't returned. The lengthy absence isn't like Malaina, Alustriel explains, and the wizard is worried for her wife's safety. Malaina is resisting any magical attempts to contact her, Alustriel tells the characters.
zh_tw: 如果角色們拒絕在他們的住處休息，艾拉斯卓私下接近他們。她擔心她的妻子瑪萊娜幾個小時前離開了聖所，並且沒有回來。長時間的缺席不像是瑪萊娜的風格，艾拉斯卓解釋說，這位法師擔心她妻子的安全。瑪萊娜正在抵抗任何魔法聯絡的嘗試，艾拉斯卓告訴角色們。

english: When she left, Malaina told Alustriel that she was going to a shop called Velgar's Vittles in Sigil's Market Ward. The Wizards Three were busy, so Alustriel didn't ask for more information. Now, Alustriel expects to imminently be occupied helping Mordenkainen and Tasha locate Vecna. Alustriel can't leave the sanctum, so she asks the characters to find her wife before the group leaves to confront the archlich. Alustriel provides directions to Velgar's Vittles.
zh_tw: 當她離開時，瑪萊娜告訴艾拉斯卓她要去法印城市場區的一家叫做維爾加餐館的商店。三巫師當時很忙，所以艾拉斯卓沒有詢問更多資訊。現在，艾拉斯卓預計很快就會忙於幫助魔鄧肯和塔莎定位維克那。艾拉斯卓不能離開聖所，所以她請求角色們在團隊離開去面對大巫妖之前找到她的妻子。艾拉斯卓提供了前往維爾加餐館的路線。

english: In reality, Malaina was suspicious of Mordenkainen, but she didn't want to make accusations without proof. Malaina was seeking a scholar named Velgar Vera (neutral good, orc {@creature mage}). Velgar is a friend to Mordenkainen and has visited Mordenkainen's home in Avernus. Velgar wasn't in his shop earlier today, so Malaina lingered in the Market Ward, waiting for the orc to return.
zh_tw: 實際上，瑪萊娜對魔鄧肯有所懷疑，但她不想在沒有證據的情況下提出指控。瑪萊娜正在尋找一位名叫維爾加·維拉的學者（中立善良，獸人{@creature mage||魔法師}）。維爾加是魔鄧肯的朋友，曾訪問過魔鄧肯在阿弗納斯的家。維爾加今天早些時候不在他的商店裡，所以瑪萊娜在市場區逗留，等待這位獸人回來。

english: Following the Lead
zh_tw: 跟隨線索

english: If the characters go to Velgar's Vittles, Velgar reports that Malaina met with him briefly a few hours ago to ask about Mordenkainen. Velgar tells the characters the same thing he told Malaina: the shopkeeper spoke with Mordenkainen last week, and the famous wizard mentioned nothing about Alustriel, Tasha, or Vecna, or anything about recently being in Sigil.
zh_tw: 如果角色們去了維爾加餐館，維爾加會報告說瑪萊娜幾小時前短暫地與他見面，詢問有關魔鄧肯的事情。維爾加告訴角色們他告訴瑪萊娜的同樣的事情：店主上週與魔鄧肯交談過，那位著名的法師沒有提到任何關於艾拉斯卓、塔莎或維克那的事情，也沒有提到最近在法印城的事情。

english: By the time the characters return to the sanctum, it's too late to stop Kas. Proceed to the "{@area Kas Reveals Himself|46d|x}" section.
zh_tw: 當角色們返回聖所時，已經來不及阻止凱斯了。請繼續閱讀"{@area 凱斯顯露真身|46d|x}"部分。

english: Fighting Kas
zh_tw: 對抗凱斯

english: It's unlikely, but one or more characters might be present when Kas reveals his true identity. In this case, use the stat block presented in the "{@creature Kas the Betrayer|VEoR}" section in {@area appendix B|55b|x}. Kas focuses on stealing the rod and using the portal to travel to Pandesmos. If the characters defeat Kas, he reveals the location of Vecna's ritual: the Cave of Shattered Reflection in Pandesmos on the plane of Pandemonium. Kas also reveals he planned to use the rod to free {@creature Miska the Wolf-Spider|VEoR} and ally with the demon lord to overtake Vecna.
zh_tw: 可能性不大，但當凱斯揭露他的真實身份時，可能會有一或多個角色在場。在這種情況下，請使用《{@creature Kas the Betrayer|VEoR|背叛者凱斯}》部分在《{@area 附錄 B|55b|x}》中提供的統計塊。凱斯專注於偷走法杖並使用傳送門前往潘德斯莫斯。如果角色們擊敗了凱斯，他會透露維克那儀式的位置：喧癲空隧的破碎倒影洞，在喧癲空隧的平面上。凱斯還透露他計劃使用法杖釋放{@creature Miska the Wolf-Spider|VEoR|米斯卡，狼蛛}並與惡魔領主結盟，以推翻維克那。

english: It's up to the characters what happens to Kas next. Alustriel and Tasha are likely injured in the fight and therefore disinclined to join the characters in their pursuit of Vecna. However, Alustriel and Tasha urge the characters to take the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} to aid their fight against the lich-god. At your discretion, Alustriel and Tasha might join the characters on the journey to Pandesmos, but they focus on neutralizing Kas's powerful remaining forces instead of joining the fight against Vecna. Alustriel or Tasha might join particularly persuasive characters in their pursuit of Vecna, but this will require significant effort on your part and might make the ensuing chapters significantly easier for the characters.
zh_tw: 接下來凱斯的命運取決於角色們的選擇。艾拉斯卓和塔莎在戰鬥中可能受傷，因此不太願意加入角色們追捕維克那的行動。然而，艾拉斯卓和塔莎強烈建議角色們帶上{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}以幫助他們對抗巫妖之神。根據您的判斷，艾拉斯卓和塔莎可能會加入角色們前往潘德斯莫斯的旅程，但他們專注於中和凱斯剩餘的強大力量，而不是加入對抗維克那的戰鬥。如果角色們特別有說服力，艾拉斯卓或塔莎可能會加入他們追捕維克那的行動，但這將需要您付出巨大的努力，並可能使後續章節對角色們來說變得更容易。

english: When the characters are ready, Alustriel can direct them to a portal in Sigil that leads to Pandesmos. It's up to you whether the door opens to Pandesmos Outlook (shown on {@adventure map 9.1|VEoR|9|Map 9.1: Pandesmos Outlook}) or directly at the cave entrance. In the former case, Alustriel can provide directions to the cave from the outlook. If this happens, skip parts of the next chapter as appropriate. In the latter case, the characters gain an additional level and skip to {@adventure chapter 11|VEoR|11}.
zh_tw: 當角色們準備好了，艾拉斯卓可以指引他們前往法印城的一個傳送門，這個傳送門通往潘德斯莫斯。由你決定這扇門是通往潘德斯莫斯前哨站（如{@adventure 地圖 9.1|VEoR|9|Map 9.1: Pandesmos Outlook}所示）還是直接到達洞穴入口。如果是前者，艾拉斯卓可以從前哨站提供前往洞穴的路線。如果發生這種情況，請適當跳過下一章的某些部分。如果是後者，角色們將獲得額外的一個等級，並跳至{@adventure 第十一章|VEoR|11}。

english: Kas Reveals Himself
zh_tw: 凱斯顯露真身

english: Kas deals catastrophic damage to Alustriel's sanctum
zh_tw: 凱斯對艾拉斯卓的聖所造成了災難性的破壞

english: If the characters return to their quarters to rest, Kas spends the next hour going through the motions of pretending to examine the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} with Alustriel and Tasha. In reality, Kas is waiting for the characters to fall asleep or become distracted in their quarters. Once he assumes the characters are sleeping or oblivious, he reveals his true form.
zh_tw: 如果角色們返回他們的房間休息，凱斯將在接下來的一個小時裡假裝檢查與艾拉斯卓和塔莎一起的{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}。實際上，凱斯正在等待角色們入睡或在他們的房間裡分心。一旦他認為角色們已經睡著或毫無察覺，他就露出了他的真實形態。

english: Kas takes Alustriel and Tasha by surprise, severely wounding them, then steals the rod and steps through the sanctum's portal to Pandemonium, where the characters face him in the next chapter.
zh_tw: 凱斯出其不意地攻擊了艾拉斯卓和塔莎，嚴重傷害了他們，然後偷走了法杖，穿過聖所的傳送門逃往喧癲空隧，在下一章中角色們將在那裡面對他。

english: Once Kas escapes the sanctum, Malaina returns to find the immediate aftermath of Kas's betrayal. She rushes to alert the characters.
zh_tw: 一旦凱斯逃離聖所，瑪萊娜回來發現了凱斯背叛的直接後果。她急忙去警告角色們。

english: Reality Dawns
zh_tw: 真相大白

english: When Kas reveals himself, a cacophony erupts downstairs. Sleeping characters are awakened, and otherwise occupied characters hear the following:
zh_tw: 當凱斯揭露自己時，樓下爆發出一片混亂。睡著的角色被喚醒，而其他忙碌的角色聽到了以下內容：

english: Violent slamming and terrible crashes tear through the silence. Something is happening downstairs. Deep, wicked-sounding laughter echoes through the sanctum, along with familiar voices shouting, "You monster!" and "We trusted you!"
zh_tw: 猛烈的撞擊聲和可怕的碰撞聲打破了寂靜。樓下發生了一些事情。深沉而邪惡的笑聲在聖所中迴盪，伴隨著熟悉的聲音呼喊，"你這個怪物！"和"我們信任你！"

english: When the characters open their door, they see Malaina in a panic. She shouts for the characters to come downstairs. Read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 當角色們開啟門時，他們看到瑪萊娜處於恐慌之中。她大聲呼喊角色們下樓。閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: The sanctum looks like it was hit by a tornado: there are toppled bookshelves, overturned pieces of furniture, and books and papers strewn everywhere. Scorch marks mar the once-gleaming wood and plush carpets. Only a single sofa in the sanctum's center is upright, and on it sit Alustriel and Tasha. Both are sipping potions and look dazed.
zh_tw: 聖所看起來像是被龍捲風襲擊過：有倒塌的書架、翻倒的傢俱，書籍和檔案到處都是。曾經閃亮的木頭和豪華地毯上留下了燒焦的痕跡。只有聖所中心的一張沙發是直立的，艾拉斯卓和塔莎坐在上面。兩人都在喝藥水，看起來有些茫然。

english: Alustriel and Tasha are in a state of shock, both because the Mordenkainen they were working with is actually the evil vampire Kas, and because they didn't catch on to his plan. Alustriel and Tasha answer questions confusedly and in short phrases.
zh_tw: 艾拉斯卓和塔莎處於震驚狀態，一方面是因為他們一直與之合作的魔鄧肯實際上是邪惡的吸血鬼凱斯，另一方面是因為他們沒有識破他的計劃。艾拉斯卓和塔莎回答問題時顯得困惑，並且回答簡短。

english: After a few minutes, the wizards regain their poise and tell the characters all the information in the beginning of this section. Alustriel and Tasha are willing to submit to magical means of determining the truth. They never deceived the characters, and they never wanted anything more than to stop Vecna's ritual.
zh_tw: 幾分鐘後，兩位法師恢復鎮定，將本節開頭的所有資訊告訴角色們。艾拉斯卓和塔莎願意接受魔法檢驗，以證明所言屬實。她們從未欺騙角色們，始終只想阻止維克那的儀式。

english: Chasing Kas
zh_tw: 追逐凱斯

english: Before Kas fled the sanctum, he muttered a phrase both Alustriel and Tasha overheard: "Finally, it ends in Pandesmos." The women repeat the phrase to the characters. Further, Alustriel has examined the sanctum's portal and knows Kas fled to the plane of Pandemonium. They surmise, correctly, that Vecna is weaving his ritual in Pandesmos, the first layer of Pandemonium.
zh_tw: 在凱斯逃離聖所之前，他喃喃自語了一個艾拉斯卓和塔莎都聽到的短語："最終，在潘德斯莫斯結束。"這兩位女士將這個短語重複給角色們。此外，艾拉斯卓檢查了聖所的傳送門，知道凱斯逃往了喧癲空隧位面。他們正確推斷，維克那正在潘德斯莫斯進行他的儀式，那是喧癲空隧的第一層。

english: Neither Alustriel nor Tasha had previously met Kas, but the stories about his and Vecna's hatred for each other are well known, as is Kas's hunger for power. Alustriel correctly supposes that Kas plans to find Vecna and co-opt the lich-god's ritual to become the most powerful being in existence. This outcome is as bad as Vecna ruling the multiverse, as far as Alustriel and Tasha are concerned, since Kas is just as evil as Vecna.
zh_tw: 艾拉斯卓和塔莎之前都未曾見過凱斯，但他和維克那之間相互憎恨的故事廣為人知，正如凱斯對權力的渴望一樣。艾拉斯卓正確地推測凱斯計劃找到維克那並奪取巫妖之神的儀式，成為存在中最強大的生物。對艾拉斯卓和塔莎來說，這個結果和維克那統治多元宇宙一樣糟糕，因為凱斯和維克那一樣邪惡。

english: Because Kas took such pains to manipulate the characters into finding the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}, Alustriel realizes the awful truth and shares it with the characters: Kas plans to use the rod to free {@creature Miska the Wolf-Spider|VEoR}, a powerful demon lord who was trapped in Pandesmos eons ago using the rod. Kas and Miska would then march against {@creature Vecna the Archlich|VEoR|Vecna}, co-opting the lich-god's ritual to begin their reign of terror across the multiverse.
zh_tw: 因為凱斯如此煞費苦心地操縱角色們去尋找{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}，艾拉斯卓意識到了可怕的真相併將其告訴了角色們：凱斯計劃用這根杖釋放{@creature Miska the Wolf-Spider|VEoR|米斯卡，狼蛛}，一個在很久以前被用這根杖困在潘德斯莫斯的強大惡魔領主。凱斯和米斯卡隨後將進軍對抗{@creature Vecna the Archlich|VEoR|維克那}，並利用這位巫妖之神的儀式開始他們在多元宇宙中的恐怖統治。

english: The Way Forward
zh_tw: 前進的道路

english: Alustriel and Tasha don't know the exact location of Vecna's ritual. The characters must travel to Pandesmos and confront Kas to learn the location so they can stop the Ritual of Remaking.
zh_tw: 艾拉斯卓和塔莎不知道維克那儀式的確切位置。角色們必須前往潘德斯莫斯並面對凱斯，以瞭解位置，這樣他們才能阻止重塑儀式。

english: During their confrontation with Kas, Alustriel and Tasha were injured. Healing supplies in the sanctum ensure the wizards aren't in real danger. They insist the characters chase after Kas immediately to prevent him from freeing Miska. Alustriel and Tasha promise to help the characters however they can.
zh_tw: 在與凱斯的對峙中，艾拉斯卓和塔莎受傷了。聖所中的治療用品確保了法師們沒有真正的危險。他們堅持要求角色們立即追趕凱斯，以防止他釋放米斯卡。艾拉斯卓和塔莎承諾會盡他們所能來幫助角色們。

english: Alustriel and Tasha correctly suspect that Vecna will have woven abjurations to protect himself from any who would stop him. Vecna's Links are the magical tie the characters need to stop the lich-god. In fact, thanks to the links tying them to Vecna, the characters are the only ones in existence who can do so. They are the multiverse's only hope.
zh_tw: 艾拉斯卓和塔莎正確懷疑維克那會編織防護咒語來保護自己不受任何試圖阻止他的人的傷害。維克那的連結是角色們需要的魔法紐帶，以阻止這位巫妖之神。事實上，由於這些將他們與維克那聯絡起來的連結，角色們是存在中唯一能夠做到這一點的人。他們是多元宇宙唯一的希望。

english: Before the characters leave the sanctum, Alustriel suggests the characters use the {@item Chime of Exile|VEoR} to return Kas to Tovag, his Domain of Dread. Alustriel notes that the characters need to significantly weaken Kas before the magic item will work on the vampire.
zh_tw: 在角色們離開聖所之前，艾拉斯卓建議他們使用{@item Chime of Exile|VEoR|放逐鐘琴}將凱斯送回他的恐懼領域託瓦格。艾拉斯卓指出，角色們需要在魔法物品對吸血鬼生效之前大幅削弱凱斯。

english: Malaina's Mistrust
zh_tw: 瑪萊娜的不信任

english: Once the characters learn what has happened, they notice that Malaina remains particularly solemn.
zh_tw: 一旦角色們瞭解了發生的事情，他們注意到瑪萊娜仍然特別嚴肅。

english: Malaina's Secret
zh_tw: 瑪萊娜的秘密

english: If the characters ask Malaina what's wrong, she admits she began suspecting something wasn't right shortly after Mordenkainen arrived in the sanctum. Malaina noticed that Mordenkainen muttered to himself in an unexpectedly cruel tone when he thought no one was around. He was also angrily defensive anytime Malaina casually asked how the mage fared. Malaina assumed Mordenkainen was merely stressed, so she didn't act on her suspicions until it was too late.
zh_tw: 如果角色們詢問瑪萊娜出了什麼問題，她承認在魔鄧肯到達聖所後不久，她就開始懷疑有些不對勁。瑪萊娜注意到，當魔鄧肯認為周圍沒有人時，他會以一種出乎意料的殘酷語調自言自語。此外，每當瑪萊娜隨意詢問這位法師的狀況時，他都會憤怒地辯解。瑪萊娜以為魔鄧肯只是壓力大，所以她沒有根據自己的懷疑採取行動，直到為時已晚。

english: Regardless of the characters' reaction to this revelation, learning it counts as a secret for the purposes of the rules in the "{@area Power of Secrets|028|x}" section in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}.
zh_tw: 無論角色對這一真相作何反應，根據本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中"{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}"部分的規則，瞭解到這一點都將被視為一個秘密。

english: Pandesmos Outlook
zh_tw: 潘德斯莫斯瞭望臺

english: If the characters decide to chase after Kas, they can step through the portal whenever they choose. They emerge in Pandesmos Outlook, entering through the door shown on map 9.1.
zh_tw: 如果角色們決定追趕凱斯，他們可以隨時穿過傳送門。他們會從地圖9.1上顯示的門進入潘德斯莫斯瞭望臺。

english: Map 9.1: Pandesmos Outlook
zh_tw: 地圖9.1：潘德斯莫斯瞭望點

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Pandemonium
zh_tw: 喧癲空隧

english: The rest of this chapter and the following two chapters take place on the plane of Pandemonium.
zh_tw: 本章以及接下來的兩章發生在喧癲空隧的平面上。

english: Pandemonium is an infinite plane of overwhelming chaos, a great mass of rock riddled with tunnels and vast caverns carved by howling winds. It is cold, noisy, and mostly dark.
zh_tw: 喧癲空隧是一個無限的混沌位面，一個佈滿隧道和由呼嘯的風雕刻出的廣闊洞穴的巨大岩石。這裡寒冷、嘈雜且大部分時間都是黑暗的。

english: Wind quickly extinguishes nonmagical open flames, such as torches and campfires. Spoken conversation is possible only by yelling, and then only to a maximum distance of 10 feet.
zh_tw: 風迅速熄滅了非魔法的明火，比如火把和篝火。只有透過大喊，才能進行口頭對話，而且最大距離只有10尺。

english: General Features
zh_tw: 通用特徵

english: The features of Pandesmos Outlook are described in the following sections.
zh_tw: 潘德斯莫斯瞭望點的特徵在以下各節中進行了描述。

english: Demons
zh_tw: 惡魔

english: The chaos and violence brewing in the area attracts demons. Within 10 feet of the bottom of the cliff's lowest shelf are two {@creature Degloth|VEoR|degloths} and two {@creature Vlazok|VEoR|vlazoks} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12} for stat blocks for both). The exact placement of the demons is at your discretion. If they notice the characters, the demons attack. A demon that sees a fight break out rushes to join in the combat, hoping to make an easy kill.
zh_tw: 該地區醞釀的混亂和暴力吸引了惡魔。在懸崖最低層底部10尺範圍內有兩隻{@creature Degloth|VEoR|德格洛斯}和兩隻{@creature Vlazok|VEoR|弗拉佐克}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}，瞭解兩者的統計資料）。惡魔的確切位置由您決定。如果它們注意到角色們，惡魔會發動攻擊。如果惡魔看到戰鬥爆發，會衝過來加入戰鬥，希望輕鬆擊殺。

english: Demons reduced to 20 hit points or fewer might divulge key information in exchange for mercy. See the "{@area Tracking Kas|47d|x}" section for how these demons might help the characters locate Kas.
zh_tw: 降至20點生命值或更少的惡魔可能會為了求饒而透露關鍵資訊。請參閱"{@area 追蹤凱斯|47d|x}"部分，瞭解這些惡魔如何幫助角色找到凱斯。

english: Doorway
zh_tw: 門口

english: The doorway to Sigil remains open through the end of this adventure. The characters can come and go as they wish. On the Pandesmos side, the doorway is invisible in the cliff.
zh_tw: 直到這次冒險的結束，通往法印城的門都保持開啟。角色們可以隨意進出。在潘德斯莫斯一側，門在懸崖中是不可見的。

english: Elevation
zh_tw: 海拔

english: The characters emerge on a shelf of a massive cliff. This shelf is 150 feet above ground level. The shelf drops 50 feet to another shelf, which is 100 feet above ground level. The entire cliff is 180 feet tall.
zh_tw: 角色們出現在一個巨大的懸崖的平臺上。這個平臺距離地面150尺。平臺向下50尺是另一個平臺，距離地面100尺。整個懸崖高180尺。

english: Geysers
zh_tw: 間歇泉

english: In the north section of Pandesmos Outlook are five geysers that periodically spew boiling water tainted with the plane's inherent chaos.
zh_tw: 在潘德斯莫斯前哨站的北部區域有五個間歇泉，它們會定期噴發帶有該位面固有混沌特性的沸水。

english: If the characters haven't already rolled initiative, have them roll initiative when a character first moves within 30 feet of a geyser. On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), one of the five geysers erupts; you choose which geyser. When a geyser erupts, all creatures within 5 feet of the geyser must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 44 ({@dice 8d10}) force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 如果角色們尚未進行先攻檢定，當角色首次移動至距間歇泉30尺範圍內時，讓他們進行先攻檢定。在先攻點數20（先攻平局時後手）時，五個間歇泉中的一個會爆發；你選擇哪個間歇泉。當間歇泉爆發時，所有位於間歇泉5尺範圍內的生物必須進行一個{@dc 18}敏捷豁免檢定，失敗則受到44（{@dice 8d10}）點力場傷害，成功則受到一半傷害。

english: Lighting
zh_tw: 光照

english: Strange multicolored lights flit through the caverns of Pandesmos, casting the area in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} at all hours.
zh_tw: 奇異的多彩光芒穿梭於潘德斯莫斯觀景臺的洞窟中，使該區域在所有時段都處於{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}。

english: Tracking Kas
zh_tw: 追蹤凱斯

english: Kas fled toward Carapace Ridge, where Miska is imprisoned in the nearby Ruinous Citadel and where Kas has a stronghold in a cliffside redoubt. The vampire plans to marshal his forces before marching on the Cave of Shattered Reflection and confronting Vecna.
zh_tw: 凱斯逃往甲殼嶺，米斯卡被囚禁在附近的毀滅堡壘，而凱斯在懸崖上的要塞有一個據點。吸血鬼計劃集結他的力量，然後前往破碎倒影洞，面對維克那。

english: The characters need to travel northwest from Pandesmos Outlook to reach Carapace Ridge. There are several ways the characters might learn which direction to head. If the characters have trouble determining where to go, a character who succeeds on a {@dc 20} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check can hear, amid the howling wind, sounds of battle coming from the northwest.
zh_tw: 角色們需要從潘德斯莫斯瞭望臺向西北方向前往卡拉斯峰脊。角色們有幾種方式可以瞭解到前往的方向。如果角色們難以確定前往何處，一個成功透過 {@dc 20} 感知 ({@skill Perception||感知}) 檢定的角色可以在呼嘯的風聲中聽到來自西北方向的戰鬥聲。

english: Interrogating Demons
zh_tw: 審問惡魔

english: If the characters defeat and interrogate the demons in this area, they learn that a powerful vampire made haste recently toward the northwest. The demons stayed out of the vampire's way when they saw the vampire dispatch several {@creature Glabrezu||glabrezus}.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在這個區域擊敗並審問惡魔，他們會得知最近有一個強大的吸血鬼匆忙向西北方向前進。當惡魔們看到這位吸血鬼迅速擊敗了幾個{@creature Glabrezu||迷誘魔}時，他們選擇避開了這位吸血鬼的路線。

english: Investigating the Battlefield
zh_tw: 調查戰場

english: A character who investigates the battlefield and succeeds on a {@dc 16} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check spots a trail of bootprints that leads to the northwest. This is Kas's path toward Carapace Ridge.
zh_tw: 一名角色若調查戰場併成功透過一個 {@dc 16} 感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定，會發現一串朝西北方向延伸的靴印。這是凱斯前往甲殼嶺的路徑。

english: Characters who succeed on a {@dc 14} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check find the mangled bodies of three {@creature Glabrezu||glabrezus}. The bodies and a blood trail lead northwest. Kas cut these creatures down on his way to Carapace Ridge.
zh_tw: 成功透過一個 {@dc 14} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定的角色會發現三隻 {@creature Glabrezu||迷誘魔} 的殘破屍體。屍體和一條血痕指向西北方向。凱斯在前往龜背嶺的路上擊倒了這些生物。

english: Next Steps
zh_tw: 下一步

english: The characters arrive at Carapace Ridge toward the end of a battle between the demonic forces of Kas and those of the demon-god Lolth, who supports Vecna's cause. The characters must decide how best to navigate the battlefield and determine where Vecna is conducting his Ritual of Remaking in the next chapter.
zh_tw: 角色們到達卡帕斯山脊時，正值凱斯的惡魔勢力與支援維克那事業的惡魔神羅絲的勢力之間的戰鬥接近尾聲。角色們必須決定如何最好地穿越戰場，並在下一章中確定維克那正在進行他的重塑儀式的地點。

english: Chapter 10: The War of Pandesmos
zh_tw: 第10章：潘德斯莫斯之戰

english: Kas has fled Sigil, intent on using the Rod of Seven Parts to free Miska, his ally against Vecna
zh_tw: 凱斯逃離了法印城，決心使用七碎片之杖釋放米斯卡，他的盟友，對抗維克那。

english: The characters tracked Kas to Carapace Ridge on the first layer of Pandemonium. In this chapter, the characters must find Kas and learn where Vecna is weaving his Ritual of Remaking. Along the way, the characters might become embroiled in a war raging between Kas's allies and the forces of Lolth, the Spider Queen, who is allied with Vecna.
zh_tw: 角色們追蹤凱斯到達了喧癲空隧第一層的甲殼嶺。在這一章中，角色們必須找到凱斯並瞭解維克那在哪裡進行他的重塑儀式。在此過程中，角色們可能會捲入凱斯的盟友和羅絲，蜘蛛女王的軍隊之間的激烈戰爭，羅絲與維克那結盟。

english: Running This Chapter
zh_tw: 運作本章

english: This chapter begins where the previous chapter ended, after the characters followed Kas's trail to Carapace Ridge, a low dip in a cliff that provides access to a beach below. The characters' search for Kas takes them to several locations, from the Ruinous Citadel, where {@creature Miska the Wolf-Spider|VEoR} is in the process of breaking free from his prison; to the Hurricane Tower, where the forces of Lolth marshal; and to the cliffside redoubt, where Kas retreated to plan. Along the way, they encounter Vaeve, a {@creature drow mage} who is loyal to neither Lolth nor Kas, and who offers the characters useful information.
zh_tw: 這一章節從上一章節結束的地方開始，角色們跟隨凱斯的蹤跡來到卡帕斯山脊，這是一個低窪的懸崖，可以通往下面的海灘。角色們在尋找凱斯的過程中會去到幾個地點，從毀滅堡壘——那裡的{@creature Miska the Wolf-Spider|VEoR|米斯卡，狼蛛}正在努力從他的監獄中逃脫；到颶風塔，羅絲的勢力正在那裡集結；再到懸崖邊的要塞，凱斯撤退到那裡進行計劃。沿途，他們遇到了薇芙，一位{@creature drow mage||卓爾魔法師}，她既不忠誠於羅絲也不忠誠於凱斯，她向角色們提供了有用的資訊。

english: The characters' choices affect where they ultimately face Kas, but regardless, the characters must weaken the vampire enough to banish him with their {@item Chime of Exile|VEoR}. While doing so, they discover Vecna's location in the Cave of Shattered Reflection.
zh_tw: 角色的選擇將影響他們最終面對凱斯的地點，但無論如何，角色必須削弱吸血鬼足夠多，才能使用他們的{@item Chime of Exile|VEoR|放逐鐘琴}將他驅逐。在此過程中，他們發現了維克那在破碎倒影洞中的位置。

english: Character Advancement
zh_tw: 角色升級

english: The characters should be 19th level when this chapter begins. The characters gain a level after they learn the location of Vecna's Ritual of Remaking.
zh_tw: 當這一章開始時，角色們應該是19級。在他們得知維克那重塑儀式的位置後，角色們將獲得一個等級的提升。

english: Power of Secrets
zh_tw: 秘密的力量

english: The characters can learn two secrets in this chapter applicable to the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules found in this book's {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}:
zh_tw: 角色們可以在此章節中學習兩個與本書{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}中提到的{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則相關的秘密：

english: Naxa's Secret
zh_tw: 納克薩的秘密

english: The {@creature drow mage} Naxa and her sister came to retrieve a cloak. It isn't simply a fancy magic item—it's a key piece in an important ritual they're planning. The characters can learn this secret later in the chapter in the vault of the Ruinous Citadel ({@area area Y4|4af|x}).
zh_tw: {@creature drow mage||卓爾魔法師}納克薩和她的姐妹前來取回一件斗篷。這不僅僅是一件炫目的魔法物品——它是她們計劃中的一個重要儀式的關鍵部分。角色們可以在本章稍後的毀滅堡壘金庫（{@area 區域Y4|4af|x}）中瞭解到這個秘密。

english: Kas's Secret
zh_tw: 凱斯的秘密

english: Vecna is weaving his Ritual of Remaking deep underground in the Cave of Shattered Reflection. The characters learn this secret when they confront Kas later in this chapter.
zh_tw: 維克那正在破碎倒影洞的地下深處進行他的重塑儀式。角色們在本章晚些時候面對凱斯時得知這個秘密。

english: Chaos Incarnate
zh_tw: 混沌化身

english: When Kas arrived in Pandesmos, he used the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} to force a hole in the sealed portal that blocks Miska from exiting the demiplane where he is trapped. The hole isn't wide enough, so Miska is expanding it so he can break free.
zh_tw: 當凱斯到達潘德斯莫斯時，他使用了{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}在封閉的傳送門上強行開啟了一個洞，這個傳送門阻擋了米斯卡從他被困的半位面中逃脫。這個洞不夠寬，所以米斯卡正在擴大它，以便他能夠突破束縛。

english: As Miska attempts to emerge, Fiends loyal to the demon lord have flocked to the area. They've been met by the forces of Lolth, Vecna's ally in his bid to remake the multiverse. In exchange for the protection supplied by her troops while Vecna weaves his ritual, the lich-god promised the Spider Queen a place at his side when he remakes the multiverse.
zh_tw: 當米斯卡試圖出現時，忠於這位惡魔領主的惡魔已經聚集到這個地區。他們遇到了羅絲的軍隊，羅絲是維克那在重塑多元宇宙的嘗試中的盟友。作為對她的部隊在維克那編織儀式期間提供保護的交換，巫妖神承諾蜘蛛女王在他重塑多元宇宙時將站在他身邊。

english: When the characters arrive in Pandesmos, they see a battle unfolding on Carapace Ridge. The forces loyal to Miska and Kas are fighting those loyal to Lolth and Vecna. The battle is at a stalemate and Kas cannot yet confront Vecna and co-opt the ritual. The characters have three options to stop Vecna and Kas: confront Kas in his cliffside redoubt, stop Miska from breaking free of his prison, or face Lolth's commander at Hurricane Tower.
zh_tw: 當角色們到達潘德斯莫斯時，他們看到卡帕斯山脊上正在進行一場戰鬥。忠於米斯卡和凱斯的勢力正在與忠於羅絲和維克那的勢力作戰。戰鬥處於僵局，凱斯還無法面對維克那並奪取儀式。角色們有三個選項來阻止維克那和凱斯：在懸崖要塞中面對凱斯，阻止米斯卡從他的監獄中逃脫，或者在颶風塔面對羅絲的指揮官。

english: Carapace Ridge
zh_tw: 甲殼脊

english: This battlefield, including the ridge where the characters arrive, is presented on map 10.1. Distance is difficult to judge on Pandemonium; the physical distance between the locations on map 10.1 is flexible but shouldn't be more than a mile or two.
zh_tw: 這個戰場，包括角色們到達的山脊，在地圖10.1上展示。在喧癲空隧，距離很難判斷；地圖10.1上各個地點之間的實際距離是靈活的，但不應超過一兩英里。

english: Map 10.1: Pandesmos Battlefield
zh_tw: 地圖10.1：潘德斯莫斯戰場

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Read the following to present the scene:
zh_tw: 閱讀以下內容以呈現場景：

english: You arrive on a clifftop towering hundreds of feet over a beach, beyond which boils a sea of kaleidoscopic clouds. On the beach, an ancient stone redoubt sits half-consumed by the sea. A tower juts from atop the cliff. Both fortifications are within sight, but screaming winds carry fog that makes judging distances difficult.
zh_tw: 你們到達了一個高聳於海灘之上數百尺的懸崖頂端，懸崖之外是一片萬花筒般的雲海。在海灘上，一座古老的石頭堡壘半浸在海中。一座塔從懸崖頂部突出。這兩座防禦工事都在視線範圍內，但是呼嘯的風攜帶著霧氣，使得判斷距離變得困難。

english: Corpses of many-legged horrors lie around you. The largest corpse is a massive spider with ichor oozing from holes in its carapace.
zh_tw: 許多長著多條腿的恐怖生物的屍體躺在你周圍。最大的屍體是一隻巨大的蜘蛛，其甲殼上的洞裡滲出了膿液。

english: A war between thousands of demonic combatants rages throughout the ridge. The forces organized around the tower include driders and monstrous spiders, which bear banners featuring a spider with a woman's head. The forces surging from the redoubt are enormous spiders with the heads of wolves. The spider-wolves carry banners with snarling wolf heads.
zh_tw: 一場涉及數千惡魔戰士的戰爭在山脊上激烈進行。圍繞塔樓組織的部隊包括蛛化卓爾和怪物蜘蛛，它們攜帶著以女性頭部的蜘蛛為標誌的旗幟。從要塞湧出的部隊是頭部為狼的巨大蜘蛛。這些蜘蛛狼攜帶著帶有咆哮狼頭的旗幟。

english: Four spyder-fiend combatants of the battle linger near the characters: a {@creature quavilithku spyder-fiend|VEoR} and three {@creature Kakkuu Spyder-Fiend|VEoR|kakkuu spyder-fiends} (stat blocks for both appear in {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}). They're busily hollowing out the corpse of a massive {@creature citadel spider|VEoR} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) as a bunker for use if the battle shifts back this way. If they spot the characters, the spyder-fiends scuttle out of the citadel spider and skitter around its corpse to attack. The spyder-fiends retreat to the carapace if they start to lose the fight.
zh_tw: 四隻戰鬥中的蜘蛛惡魔在角色們附近徘徊：一隻{@creature quavilithku spyder-fiend|VEoR|誇維爾斯庫蜘蛛惡魔}和三隻{@creature Kakkuu Spyder-Fiend|VEoR|卡庫蜘蛛惡魔}（兩者的統計資料塊出現在《{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}》中）。它們正忙於挖掘一隻巨大的{@creature citadel spider|VEoR|城堡蜘蛛}（見《{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}》）的屍體，作為戰鬥再次轉向這個方向時使用的掩體。如果它們發現了角色們，蜘蛛惡魔會從城堡蜘蛛的屍體中爬出來，並在其屍體周圍快速移動以進行攻擊。如果開始輸掉戰鬥，蜘蛛惡魔會撤退到甲殼上。

english: Both sides of the battle use banners to identify units and send messages. The forces of {@creature Camlash|VEoR}, Lolth's balor general, use a stylized symbol of Lolth on their banners, while Miska's forces use banners featuring wolf heads. The troops are so numerous and powerful on both sides that even 19th-level characters can't materially affect the war by joining in the fighting.
zh_tw: 戰鬥的雙方使用旗幟來識別部隊和傳遞資訊。羅絲的巴洛炎魔將軍{@creature Camlash|VEoR|卡姆拉什}的部隊在他們的旗幟上使用羅絲的風格化符號，而米斯卡的部隊則使用帶有狼頭的旗幟。雙方的軍隊數量眾多且強大，即使是19級的角色也無法透過加入戰鬥來實質性地影響戰爭。

english: Vaeve's Offer
zh_tw: 薇芙的提議

english: A neutral {@creature drow mage} named Vaeve is lurking around the battlefield, initially out of sight. Vaeve spots the fighting and realizes that the characters are her best hope for allies. She reveals herself as the battle winds down, perhaps joining the fight against the kakkuus once the characters defeat the dangerous quavilithku.
zh_tw: 一位中立的{@creature drow mage||卓爾魔法師}名叫薇芙，在戰場周圍潛伏，起初是看不見的。薇芙注意到了戰鬥，並意識到角色們是她最好的盟友希望。隨著戰鬥逐漸平息，她顯露自己，或許在角色們擊敗危險的誇維利特庫之後，加入對抗卡庫斯的戰鬥。

english: Talking with Vaeve
zh_tw: 與薇芙對話

english: Vaeve hopes the characters might help her, so she is eager to talk. She identifies both sides in the fight but insists she's not loyal to either side. Vaeve shares the following key points in her conversation with the characters:
zh_tw: 薇芙希望角色們或許能幫助她，所以她急於交談。她識別了戰鬥中的雙方，但堅稱她不忠於任何一方。薇芙在與角色們的對話中分享了以下關鍵點：

english: Vaeve
zh_tw: 薇芙

english: An Explanation
zh_tw: 一個解釋

english: The battle rages between forces loyal to Lolth, who is working with Vecna, and forces loyal to Miska, who is in the process of breaking free from his prison and is allied with a vampire. Vaeve and her identical twin sister, Naxa, are adventurers from Neverwinter who came here to retrieve potent magical components for their arcane rituals. They were using the chaos of battle to steal back a magic cloak—a family heirloom, Vaeve says—recently taken to Miska's treasure vault somewhere in the stone citadel on the beach below. But Vaeve and Naxa became separated in the fighting, and Vaeve worries that Naxa is brazen enough to attempt the retrieval on her own.
zh_tw: 戰鬥在忠於羅絲的勢力和忠於米斯卡的勢力之間激烈進行，羅絲正在與維克那合作，而米斯卡正在努力從他的監獄中逃脫，並且與一個吸血鬼結盟。薇芙和她的同卵雙胞胎姐妹納克薩是來自無冬城的冒險家，她們來到這裡是為了獲取強大的魔法元件來進行她們的奧術儀式。她們利用戰鬥的混亂來偷回一件魔法斗篷——薇芙說這是一件家族傳家寶——最近被帶到米斯卡在下面的海灘上的石頭城堡的某個地方的寶庫中。但是薇芙和納克薩在戰鬥中失散了，薇芙擔心納克薩會大膽到獨自嘗試取回。

english: Assistance Needed
zh_tw: 需要幫助

english: Vaeve doesn't know why the characters are here, but she assumes they're planning to cross the battlefield for some reason. Vaeve asks the characters to escort Naxa from the citadel back to Carapace Ridge. There's significant treasure in the citadel, Vaeve says, and Vaeve would be grateful if the characters helped her sister.
zh_tw: 薇芙不知道角色們為何在此，但她假設他們出於某種原因計劃穿越戰場。薇芙請求角色們護送納克薩從城堡回到甲殼嶺。薇芙說，城堡裡有大量財寶，如果角色們能幫助她的妹妹，薇芙將會非常感激。

english: General's Presence
zh_tw: 將軍的威嚴

english: Lolth's general, a demon named {@creature Camlash|VEoR}, directs troops from the tottering tower. Lolth's forces include {@creature Giant Spider||giant spiders} and {@creature Drider||driders}. The tower looks ready to tip over because it is; only the webbing inside the tower's base keeps it from falling over.
zh_tw: 羅絲的將軍，一個名叫{@creature Camlash|VEoR|卡姆拉什}的惡魔，從搖搖欲墜的塔樓指揮著部隊。羅絲的軍隊包括{@creature Giant Spider||巨蜘蛛}和{@creature Drider||蛛化卓爾}。這座塔看起來隨時都會倒塌；只有塔基內的蛛網才讓它沒有倒下。

english: Miska's Location
zh_tw: 米斯卡的位置

english: Miska is down in the citadel by the weird ocean of churning energy. Miska was recently freed from imprisonment, but he hasn't left the citadel yet—Vaeve doesn't know why. Miska's forces are varied spyder-fiends as well as flying demons that drip deadly blood.
zh_tw: 米斯卡位於那座城堡旁，旁邊是翻騰能量的奇異海洋。米斯卡最近才從囚禁中被釋放，但他還沒有離開城堡——薇芙不知道為什麼。米斯卡的部隊由各種間諜惡魔和滴落致命血液的飛行惡魔組成。

english: Vampire's Presence
zh_tw: 吸血鬼的存在

english: Miska is following the commands of a vampire who occasionally appears on the battlefield to turn the tide of important fights against Lolth's forces. (Vaeve doesn't know the vampire's name, but her description should make it clear to the characters that this is Kas.)
zh_tw: 米斯卡正在遵循一個偶爾出現在戰場上，對抗羅絲軍隊的吸血鬼的命令。（薇芙不知道吸血鬼的名字，但她的描述應該足以讓角色們明白這是凱斯。）

english: Vampire's Home
zh_tw: 吸血鬼之家

english: The vampire inhabits a chamber in the cliff, another mile past the tower. The upper entrance is under siege by Camlash's forces, and the lower entrance is guarded by spyder-fiends. Vaeve points out both entrances to the cliffside redoubt, two miles distant and barely visible through the blowing fog.
zh_tw: 吸血鬼居住在懸崖上的一個房間裡，位於塔樓再過去一英里的地方。上面的入口正受到卡姆拉什的部隊圍攻，而下面的入口則由間諜惡魔守衛。薇芙指出了懸崖堡壘的兩個入口，它們在兩英里之外，幾乎被吹拂的霧氣遮擋得看不見。

english: If the characters express interest in confronting Kas, Vaeve suggests first facing one or both generals. Defeating Camlash might compel Kas to emerge to seize a final victory over Lolth's forces. Defeating Miska might bring Kas out in a rage. Doing both, Vaeve suggests, could be most effective.
zh_tw: 如果角色們表示有興趣面對凱斯，薇芙建議首先面對一個或兩個將軍。擊敗卡姆拉什可能會迫使凱斯出現，以奪取對羅絲軍隊的最終勝利。擊敗米斯卡可能會使凱斯憤怒地出現。薇芙建議，兩者都做可能是最有效的。

english: Before the characters leave, Vaeve reiterates her wish that the characters help Naxa. Vaeve insists that it's the least the characters can do in exchange for the useful information Vaeve shared. She refuses to go with them into the conflict.
zh_tw: 在角色們離開之前，薇芙重申了她希望角色們能幫助納克薩的願望。薇芙堅持認為，這是角色們在換取薇芙分享的有用資訊後至少可以做到的事情。她拒絕與他們一起進入衝突。

english: Avoiding the War
zh_tw: 避免戰爭

english: Descriptions for the Ruinous Sea, Hurricane Tower, and the Ruinous Citadel are below—but you might not need them. High-level characters have options for travel to Kas's redoubt without wading through an active battlefield. However, no options are free of danger.
zh_tw: 關於毀滅之海、颶風塔和毀滅堡壘的描述如下——但你可能不需要它們。高等級角色有不透過穿越活躍戰場就能到達凱斯堡壘的旅行選項。然而，沒有選擇是完全沒有危險的。

english: Teleportation
zh_tw: 傳送

english: The characters can teleport directly to the redoubt's upper or lower entrances. The characters can't teleport into the redoubt directly, since it's warded with a {@spell Forbiddance} spell.
zh_tw: 角色們可以直接傳送到要塞的上部或下部入口。角色們不能直接傳送進入要塞，因為它被施加了一道{@spell Forbiddance||禁制術}法術的保護。

english: Flight
zh_tw: 飛翔

english: Camlash's {@creature Citadel Spider|VEoR|citadel spiders} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) function as artillery, but the skies are predominantly under Miska's control thanks to powerful flying demons pledged to his service. If the characters fly around or above the battle, three {@creature Hazvongel|VEoR|hazvongels} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) soar down from the wispy cloud cover to attack. The hazvongels fight to the death. If the characters don't fly directly toward the cliffside redoubt after this fight, another trio of hazvongels attacks from a different direction. After this second attack, the demons steer clear of the flying characters.
