zh_tw: 這個凱斯不知道自己不是真實的，也無法理解這個概念，但他明白維克那將他註定了這個監獄。他沒有意識到這座破碎的要塞曾經是他位於奧斯的家。和真正的凱斯一樣，這個凱斯對維克那懷有強烈的仇恨，儘管以這種形態，他對這個大巫妖無能為力。

english: Manifested Secret
zh_tw: 顯現的秘密

english: In Vecna's twisted unreality, Kas is shackled with his legendary sword, but he is forever unable to use it. The {@item Sword of Kas} is this unreality's manifested secret.
zh_tw: 在維克那扭曲的非現實性中，凱斯被他的傳奇劍束縛，但他永遠無法使用它。{@item Sword of Kas||凱斯之劍}是非現實性的顯現秘密。

english: Kas willingly lets a character take the {@item Sword of Kas} if convinced the characters can destroy Vecna, better yet, if convinced that relinquishing his weapon will enable him to destroy Vecna someday. A character can make a {@dc 25} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check to try to convince Kas using either line of reasoning. If the characters fail to persuade him to relinquish the sword, Kas snarls and insults them, but he won't fight. If a character tells Kas that his prison is actually a shattered version of his home in Keoland, Kas howls in fury and gives over his sword immediately, asking the characters to take down Vecna.
zh_tw: 如果凱斯相信角色們能夠摧毀維克那，他願意讓角色們拿走{@item Sword of Kas||凱斯之劍}，更甚者，如果凱斯相信放棄他的武器將使他有一天能夠摧毀維克那，他也會這麼做。角色可以進行一次{@dc 25}魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，嘗試用任何一種理由說服凱斯。如果角色們未能說服他放棄劍，凱斯會咆哮並侮辱他們，但他不會戰鬥。如果有個角色告訴凱斯他的監獄實際上是他在基奧蘭德家園的破碎版本，凱斯會憤怒地嚎叫並立即交出他的劍，請求角色們擊敗維克那。

english: The characters can dismantle this unreality by touching the sword and performing one of the actions detailed in the "{@area Dismantling an Unreality|4e1|x}" section earlier in this chapter.
zh_tw: 角色們可以透過觸控劍並執行本章前面"{@area 拆除一個非現實性|4e1|x}"部分詳細說明的動作來拆除這個非現實性。

english: Neverwinter's New King
zh_tw: 無冬城的新國王

english: Vecna plans to turn Lord Neverember into a death knight who will subjugate the city's population
zh_tw: 維克那計劃將無燼領主變成一個死亡騎士，以征服這座城市的居民。

english: When the characters cross the threshold in {@area area E2b|4ea|x}, they appear in an unreality where Vecna commands control over the city of Neverwinter in Faerûn.
zh_tw: 當角色們穿過{@area 區域E2b|4ea|x}的門檻時，他們出現在一個非現實中，在那裡維克那控制著費倫的無冬城。

english: In this unreality, Vecna turned Lord Neverember into a loyal death knight and iron-fisted tyrant. Neverember has turned his servants into {@creature Wight||wights} and his opponents into dust.
zh_tw: 在這個非現實中，維克那將無燼領主變成了一個忠誠的死亡騎士和鐵腕暴君。無燼將他的僕人變成了{@creature Wight||屍妖}，將他的對手變成了塵埃。

english: Read the following when the characters arrive in the Neverwinter unreality:
zh_tw: 當角色們到達無冬城非現實性時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: A regal figure clad in menacing spiked armor stands on the balcony of a castle ten feet above the city square. Four sets of gallows are lined up in the center of the square. The armored figure's features are shrouded in black shadow. Fitted on the figure's head is a striking golden crown, the front of which is emblazoned with a glowing symbol of Vecna.
zh_tw: 一個身穿威脅性尖刺盔甲的高貴身影站在城堡的陽臺上，城堡高出市中心廣場十尺。廣場中央排列著四組絞刑架。盔甲人物的面容被黑色陰影籠罩。人物頭上戴著一頂醒目的金色王冠，王冠正面刻有一個發光的維克那標誌。

english: Throughout the square, terrified citizens gawk at the king with tearful, disbelieving eyes. Beneath the balcony, twelve armored, desiccated figures stand guard and keep the crowd from advancing any closer.
zh_tw: 廣場上，驚恐的市民用含淚、難以置信的眼神凝視著國王。陽臺下方，十二個穿著盔甲、乾枯的身影守衛著，阻止人群靠近。

english: Map 11.3 depicts this location.
zh_tw: 地圖 11.3 描述了這個地點。

english: Map 11.3: Neverwinter Square
zh_tw: 地圖 11.3: 無冬城廣場

english: If the characters make their presence known, Lord Neverember orders the twelve {@creature Wight||wights} below the balcony to apprehend the characters and place them in the gallows. Lord Neverember doesn't join the fight unless the wights are destroyed or the characters attack him.
zh_tw: 如果角色們暴露了自己的行蹤，無燼領主會命令陽臺下的十二個{@creature Wight||屍妖}逮捕角色們並將他們關進絞刑架。除非屍妖被摧毀或者角色們攻擊他，否則無燼領主不會加入戰鬥。

english: If a character tells the awestruck crowd that Lord Neverember is not the rightful ruler of Neverwinter and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check, the mob breaks into a violent frenzy. In this case, the mob distracts the wights so the characters can focus their attention on Lord Neverember.
zh_tw: 如果某個角色向震驚的群眾聲稱無燼領主並非無冬城的合法統治者，並且成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 的魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，人群將陷入狂暴。在這種情況下，人群會分散亡靈戰士的注意力，使得角色們可以將注意力集中在無燼領主身上。

english: Lord Neverember (use the {@creature death knight} stat block) is unwilling to part with his crown; he fights the characters to withhold the symbol of his rulership.
zh_tw: 無燼領主（使用{@creature death knight||死亡騎士}的統計資料塊）不願意放棄他的王冠；他與角色們戰鬥，以保留他統治地位的象徵。

english: Manifested Secret
zh_tw: 顯現的秘密

english: The secret that Lord Neverember is not the rightful ruler of Neverwinter is represented by Vecna's symbol emblazoned on Neverember's crown. The characters can dismantle this unreality by touching the crown and performing one of the actions detailed in the "{@area Dismantling an Unreality|4e1|x}" section earlier in this chapter. A character can touch the crown only while Lord Neverember has the {@condition incapacitated} condition or after he has been destroyed. Magic can't lift the crown from Lord Neverember's head while he has at least 1 hit point.
zh_tw: 無燼領主不是無冬城合法統治者的秘密由維克那的標誌在無燼的王冠上所代表。角色們可以透過觸控王冠並執行本章前面"{@area 拆除一個非現實性|4e1|x}"部分中詳細說明的動作之一來解散這個非現實。只有在無燼領主處於{@condition incapacitated||無力}狀態或被摧毀後，角色才能觸控王冠。在他至少有1點生命值時，魔法無法從無燼領主的頭上取下王冠。

english: Dead Gods
zh_tw: 神屍

english: An astral dreadnought consumes a dead god in Vecna's new reality
zh_tw: 在維克那的新現實中，一艘星界無畏艦吞噬了一個死去的神。

english: When the characters cross the threshold in {@area area E2c|4ea|x}, they appear in an unreality where Vecna has usurped the power of every other god in the multiverse and scattered the dead gods' bones across the Astral Sea.
zh_tw: 當角色們穿過{@area 區域E2c|4ea|x}的門檻時，他們出現在一個非現實中，在那裡維克那篡奪了多元宇宙中所有其他神祇的力量，並將死去的神祇的骨頭散落在星界海中。

english: Read aloud the following when the characters arrive:
zh_tw: 當角色們到達時，請大聲朗讀以下內容：

english: You float amid a vast void speckled with distant silvery lights. All around you are the floating remains of enormous stone corpses. Nearby, a monstrous behemoth resembling a horned, serpentine lobster drifts slowly through a patch of debris. The creature groans in agony, its one eye darting around in confusion. Vecna's unholy symbol glows faintly from within the behemoth's immense torso. Six spherical pests—each with a single eye and gaping maw—gnash at the behemoth's flanks.
zh_tw: 你漂浮在一個點綴著遙遠銀色光芒的浩瀚虛空中。周圍是巨大石質屍體的殘骸在漂浮。附近，一個類似有角的蛇形龍蝦的怪物巨獸在一片殘骸中慢慢漂移。這個生物在痛苦中呻吟，它的獨眼困惑地四處張望。維克那的邪惡符號在巨獸巨大的身軀內發出微弱的光芒。六個球形害蟲——每個都有一個獨眼和張開的大嘴——在巨獸的側腹撕咬。

english: The behemoth is a dying {@creature astral dreadnought|MPMM} that's being preyed on by six {@creature Eye Monger|BAM|eye mongers} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12} for both stat blocks). The dreadnought has only 150 hit points remaining, it has no remaining uses of its Legendary Resistance trait, and its flying speed is reduced to 20 feet until its hit points are fully restored. The eye mongers focus their attacks on the astral dreadnought unless the characters stop them.
zh_tw: 這個巨獸是一隻瀕臨死亡的{@creature astral dreadnought|MPMM|星界鉅艦獸}，正被六個{@creature Eye Monger|BAM|大眼遊星}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}中的統計資料塊）捕食。鉅艦只剩下150點生命值，它的傳奇抗性特性已無剩餘使用次數，並且在其生命值完全恢復之前，其飛行速度降低到20尺。除非角色們阻止它們，否則眼魔怪會集中攻擊星界鉅艦。

english: The astral dreadnought is called Arekanz. Arekanz has been consuming dead gods, but in this unreality, Vecna spitefully cursed the gods' remains to contaminate the dreadnought and induce its certain death. Arekanz is suffering the effects of the curse. It is so wracked with pain that it doesn't defend itself except to use its Donjon Visit legendary action.
zh_tw: 這艘星界無畏艦被稱為阿雷坎茲。阿雷坎茲一直在吞噬死去的神，但在這個非現實性中，維克那惡意地詛咒了神的殘骸，以汙染無畏艦並引發它的必然死亡。阿雷坎茲正在遭受詛咒的影響。它痛苦不堪，以至於除了使用其城堡訪問傳奇行動外，它不進行自我防禦。

english: A character who succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check recognizes Arekanz as an {@creature astral dreadnought|MPMM}, a creature that has a demiplane where its stomach should be. Everything the dreadnought swallows ends up there. The character also knows that if the dreadnought dies, the demiplane inside it will be destroyed, leaving everything in it to float aimlessly in the Astral Sea.
zh_tw: 一名透過 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定的角色會認出阿雷坎茲是一個 {@creature astral dreadnought|MPMM|星界鉅艦獸}，這是一種體記憶體在半位面的生物，它的胃部被半位面取代。恐獸吞下的所有東西都會進入這個半位面。該角色還知道，如果恐獸死亡，它體內的半位面將會被摧毀，裡面的所有東西都將無目的地漂浮在星界海中。

english: Blue Feather of Habbakuk
zh_tw: 哈巴庫克的藍色羽毛

english: Within Arekanz's demiplanar donjon is a blue phoenix feather marked with the symbol of Vecna unreality's manifested secret. In this unreality, this single feather is all that remains of Habbakuk, a god on the world of Krynn and one of the many gods Vecna intends to destroy as part of his ritual. Any character with proficiency in the {@skill Religion} skill recognizes the feather as the remains of Habbakuk. The characters must retrieve the blue phoenix feather so they can use it to dismantle this unreality.
zh_tw: 在阿雷坎茲的半位面地牢內，有一根藍色的鳳凰羽毛，上面標有維克那非現實的顯現秘密的象徵。在這個非現實中，這根羽毛是哈巴庫克的殘餘物，哈巴庫克是克萊恩世界的一個神，也是維克那打算作為其儀式一部分摧毀的眾多神之一。任何精通{@skill Religion||宗教}技能的角色都能認出這根羽毛是哈巴庫克的遺物。角色們必須取回藍色鳳凰羽毛，以便他們可以使用它來解散這個非現實。

english: Arekanz's Donjon Locations
zh_tw: 阿雷坎茲的城堡地點

english: In this unreality, before Vecna slew his rival deities and fed their remains to Arekanz, the archlich turned each rival to stone. From where creatures first appear in Arekanz's demiplanar donjon, the shattered remains of these deities stand between the party and the unreality's manifested secret to the east.
zh_tw: 在這個非現實中，在維克那殺死他的對手神祇並將他們的遺骸餵給阿雷坎茲之前，這位死靈大法師將每個對手都變成了石頭。從生物首次出現在阿雷坎茲的半位面地牢的地方開始，這些神祇的破碎遺骸就矗立在隊伍和東邊非現實顯現的秘密之間。

english: The following locations are keyed to map 11.4.
zh_tw: 以下地點對應地圖11.4。

english: Map 11.4: Arekanz's Donjon
zh_tw: 地圖 11.4: 阿雷坎茲的地牢

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: G1: Crumbling Mound
zh_tw: G1: 崩塌的土堆

english: Characters who end up in Arekanz's demiplanar donjon arrive here.
zh_tw: 角色們如果最終到達阿雷坎茲的半位面地牢，就會來到這裡。

english: You stand among hills made from the half-digested bodies of countless deities. A deep valley separates two of these hills and stretches as far as can be seen in either direction. Under your feet, the ground shifts as mounds of scree continuously collapse into the valley.
zh_tw: 你站在由無數神祇半消化的屍體構成的山丘之間。一個深邃的山谷將其中兩個山丘分隔開來，並且無論朝哪個方向看都看不到盡頭。在你的腳下，地面隨著無數碎石堆不斷崩塌進山谷而發生移動。

english: The area of the hazardous scree is marked with dotted lines on the map. When any creature takes a step on the scree, the scree collapses. That creature and any other creatures within the marked area must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or fall down the cliff and onto the floor of the valley 100 feet below, taking 35 ({@dice 10d6}) bludgeoning damage.
zh_tw: 地圖上用虛線標記了危險碎石區域的邊界。當任何生物踏足碎石時，碎石會坍塌。該生物以及標記區域內的其他生物必須成功透過一次 {@dc 13} 敏捷豁免檢定，否則會從懸崖上跌落，墜落到下方100尺的山谷底部，受到35（{@dice 10d6}）點鈍擊傷害。

english: G2: Sword Bridge
zh_tw: G2: 劍橋

english: The colossal, iron longsword of some legendary being was cast unceremoniously onto the ground here, creating an improvised crossing over the valley.
zh_tw: 某個傳說中的巨大鐵製長劍被隨意地扔在這裡的地上，形成了一個即興的山谷過道。

english: Three {@creature Eye Monger|BAM|eye mongers} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) swallowed by Arekanz lurk below the sword. They attack any characters who cross the sword bridge.
zh_tw: 三隻被阿雷坎茲吞噬的{@creature Eye Monger|BAM|大眼遊星}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）潛伏在劍橋下方。它們會攻擊任何穿過劍橋的角色。

english: G3: Horror's Fissure
zh_tw: G3: 恐怖之裂隙

english: An wide fissure runs east to west between the sword bridge and a tall shrine.
zh_tw: 一道寬闊的裂縫從劍橋和一座高聳的神祠之間東西向延伸。

english: The fissure is 30 feet deep. As the characters approach, it shudders as a {@creature cosmic horror|BAM} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) slithers out of it from the east to feast on the characters' minds and bodies.
zh_tw: 裂縫深30尺。當角色們接近時，它因為一隻從東邊爬出來的{@creature cosmic horror|BAM|宇宙恐怪}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）而顫抖，它來吞噬角色們的思想和身體。

english: G4: Shrine of Habbakuk
zh_tw: G4: 哈巴庫克神祠

english: The tall stone statue at the center of this shrine depicts a cobalt-blue biped with a humanlike body, avian features, and vestments decorated with phoenix iconography. Embedded in the statue's sternum is a blue phoenix feather emblazoned with the glowing symbol of Vecna.
zh_tw: 這座位於神祠中心的高大石雕描繪了一個蔚藍色雙足生物，它有著類似人類的身軀、鳥類的特徵，以及裝飾有鳳凰圖案的服飾。在雕像的胸骨上鑲嵌著一根藍色鳳凰羽毛，上面印有維克那發光的標誌。

english: The statue reflects Habbakuk, a god of animals and druids revered widely on the world of Krynn.
zh_tw: 這座雕像反映了哈巴庫克，一位在克萊恩世界廣泛受到尊崇的動物和德魯伊的神。

english: Manifested Secret
zh_tw: 顯現的秘密

english: The characters can dismantle this unreality by touching the feather and performing one of the actions detailed in the "{@area Dismantling an Unreality|4e1|x}" section earlier in this chapter.
zh_tw: 角色們可以透過觸控羽毛並執行本章前面"{@area 拆除一個非現實性|4e1|x}"部分中詳細說明的動作之一來解散這個非現實。

english: If the astral dreadnought dies while the characters are searching its demiplanar donjon for the manifested secret, the demiplane ceases to exist, and everything inside it appears around the dreadnought's corpse, including the characters and the feather. A character who spends 1 hour sifting through the ejected detritus finds the feather.
zh_tw: 如果星界無畏艦在角色們在其半位面城堡中尋找顯現秘密時死去，該半位面將不復存在，其內部的一切將出現在無畏艦屍體周圍，包括角色們和那根羽毛。一個角色如果花費1小時在被丟擲的廢棄物中搜尋，將找到那根羽毛。

english: Cave of Shattered Reflection
zh_tw: 破碎倒影洞

english: Once the characters have dismantled all three demiplanes connected to Vecna's Grasp, the large crystals in {@area area E1|4e8|x} shatter to dust, opening the way to Vecna's ritual chamber: a mythic cavern called the Cave of Shattered Reflection. In existence since the earliest days of the multiverse, the cavern has the ability to harness beings' life force and reveal fundamental truths to those inside. Here, Vecna twists the powers of the cave to fuel his ritual to unravel the multiverse and remake it to his specifications.
zh_tw: 一旦角色們解散了與維克那之握相連的三個半位面，{@area 區域E1|4e8|x}中的大水晶就會碎成塵埃，為通往維克那的儀式室——一個名為破碎倒影洞的神話洞穴——開啟了道路。這個洞穴自多元宇宙的最初日子以來就存在，它有能力利用生物的生命力量，並向洞內的人揭示基本的真理。在這裡，維克那扭曲了洞穴的力量，以推動他的儀式，解開多元宇宙並按照他的規格重新制造它。

english: Cave Features
zh_tw: 洞穴特徵

english: The Cave of Shattered Reflection has the following features, as shown on {@adventure map 11.5|VEoR|11|Map 11.5: Cave of Shattered Reflection}.
zh_tw: 碎裂之鏡洞穴具有以下特徵，如{@adventure 地圖 11.5|VEoR|11|Map 11.5: Cave of Shattered Reflection}所示。

english: Crystal Walls
zh_tw: 水晶牆壁

english: Most of the walls are made of a translucent, purple crystal that is immune to all damage. Creatures on opposite sides of a crystal wall can see each other vaguely, provided they are both within 5 feet of the wall. Sound, including the sound made by the {@item Chime of Exile|VEoR}, can't pass through crystal walls.
zh_tw: 大部分牆壁由一種半透明的紫色水晶構成，這種水晶對所有傷害免疫。在水晶牆對面的生物，只要它們都距離牆壁5尺以內，就可以模糊地看到彼此。聲音，包括{@item Chime of Exile|VEoR|放逐鐘琴}發出的聲音，無法穿過水晶牆。

english: Diamond Doors
zh_tw: 鑽石門

english: Portals made of translucent, solid diamond are set into the crystal walls. Creatures on opposite sides of a diamond door can see each other vaguely, provided they are both within 5 feet of the door.
zh_tw: 由半透明實心鑽石製成的傳送門嵌入水晶牆中。在鑽石門對面的生物，只要它們都距離門5尺以內，就可以模糊地看到彼此。

english: The Cave of Shattered Reflection is dotted with diamond doors
zh_tw: 破碎倒影洞散佈著鑽石門

english: With the exception of the door in {@area area R2|517|x}, each side of each diamond door is set with a large ruby, the other with a large sapphire. (These are depicted on the map in red and blue, respectively.) Each side of the door is also etched with a sigil. This sigil matches the sigil on another door in the Cave of Shattered Reflection. {@adventure Map 11.5|VEoR|11|Map 11.5: Cave of Shattered Reflection} shows five pairs of identical sigils, labeled A1 and A2, B1 and B2, C1 and C2, {@dice D1} and {@dice D2}, and E1 and E2.
zh_tw: 除了{@area 區域R2|517|x}中的門之外，每扇鑽石門的每一側都鑲嵌著一顆大紅寶石，另一側則是一顆大藍寶石。（這些在地圖上分別用紅色和藍色表示。）每扇門的一側還刻有一個符號。這個符號與破碎倒影洞中另一扇門上的符號相匹配。{@adventure 地圖 11.5|VEoR|11|Map 11.5: Cave of Shattered Reflection}顯示了五對相同的符號，分別標記為A1和A2，B1和B2，C1和C2，{@dice D1}和{@dice D2}，以及E1和E2。

english: {@b Teleporting between Sigils}. When Vecna or a creature carrying Vecna's Link touches a diamond door's gemstone, the doorway teleports the creature to the nearest unoccupied space next to the other door with a matching secret sigil.
zh_tw: {@b 在符號之間傳送}。當維克那或攜帶維克那的連結的生物觸碰鑽石門上的寶石時，門道會將生物傳送到帶有匹配秘密法印城的另一扇門最近的未被佔據的空間旁邊。

english: The side of the destination doorway on which the creature appears depends on which gemstone the creature touched to teleport. If the touched gemstone was a ruby, the creature appears on the side of the destination doorway set with a ruby. If the touched gemstone was a sapphire, the creature appears on the side of the destination doorway set with a sapphire.
zh_tw: 生物出現在目標門道的一側取決於它觸碰了哪個寶石來傳送。如果觸碰的寶石是紅寶石，生物將出現在目標門道上設有紅寶石的一側。如果觸碰的寶石是藍寶石，生物將出現在目標門道上設有藍寶石的一側。

english: Lighting
zh_tw: 光照

english: The cave is bathed in eerie purple light, providing {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light}.
zh_tw: 洞穴沐浴在詭異的紫色光芒中，提供{@quickref Vision and Light||2||明亮光照}。

english: Limited Teleportation
zh_tw: 有限傳送

english: As long as Vecna is conducting his ritual, diamond doors are the only form of teleportation magic besides Vecna's Fell Rebuke reaction that functions in this place. The cave's crystal walls don't restrict where Vecna can teleport using Fell Rebuke, although he still must be able to see his destination.
zh_tw: 只要維克那在進行他的儀式，鑽石門是除了維克那的墮落斥責反應之外唯一能在此地運作的傳送魔法形式。洞穴的水晶牆壁並不限制維克那使用墮落斥責傳送的位置，儘管他仍然必須能夠看到他的目的地。

english: Empowered by Secrets
zh_tw: 被秘密增強

english: In the Cave of Shattered Reflection, secrets are power. Depending on how many secrets the characters kept throughout this campaign, they might be more powerful in this cave than they would otherwise be.
zh_tw: 在破碎倒影洞中，秘密就是力量。根據角色們在這場戰役中保守的秘密數量，他們在這個洞穴中可能比在其他地方更為強大。

english: Before running this part of the adventure, refer to the tracking sheet in {@adventure appendix C|VEoR|14}. Tally the number of secrets the party has learned, and write the sum in the Total Secrets Learned box. Then add the number of secrets the characters traded for benefits, and write the sum in the Total Secrets Revealed box. Subtract the Total Secrets Revealed from Total Secrets Learned and write the result in the Secrets Kept Box. Consult the Power of Secrets table to determine what additional powers, if any, the characters have in the Cave of Shattered Reflection.
zh_tw: 在執行這一部分冒險之前，請參考{@adventure 附錄C|VEoR|14}中的追蹤表。統計隊伍已發現的秘密數量，並將總數寫在"已發現秘密總數"框中。然後加上角色們因獲得好處而透露的秘密數量，並將總數寫在"已透露秘密總數"框中。從"已發現秘密總數"中減去"已透露秘密總數"，並將結果寫在"保留秘密數"框中。查閱"秘密之力"表，以確定角色們在"破碎倒影洞窟"中是否擁有額外的能力。

english: These powers are cumulative. For example, if the characters kept seven secrets, they start the encounter with {@book inspiration|PHB|4|inspiration} and also can see clearly through the cave's crystal walls.
zh_tw: 這些力量是累積的。例如，如果角色們保守了七個秘密，他們在遭遇戰開始時就會獲得{@book 激勵|PHB|4|inspiration}，並且也能清晰地看穿洞穴的水晶牆。

english: Power of Secrets
zh_tw: 秘密的力量

english: Secrets Kept
zh_tw: 保守的秘密

english: Additional Power
zh_tw: 額外的力量

english: Each character starts the encounter with inspiration.
zh_tw: 每個角色在遭遇戰開始時都擁有靈感。

english: Characters can see clearly through the cave's crystal walls.
zh_tw: 角色可以清晰地看穿洞穴的水晶牆。

english: The first time each character enters the Cave of Shattered Reflection, the character benefits from the effects of the {@spell Haste} spell for 1 minute. The characters don't suffer from lethargy after the spell ends.
zh_tw: 每個角色第一次進入破碎倒影洞時，該角色會從{@spell Haste||加速術}法術的效果中受益，持續時間為1分鐘。法術結束後，角色們不會感到昏睡。

english: Characters have advantage on any Constitution saving throws made in the cave.
zh_tw: 角色在洞穴中進行的所有體質豁免檢定中具有優勢。

english: Cave Locations
zh_tw: 洞穴的地點

english: These locations are keyed to map 11.5.
zh_tw: 這些地點對應於地圖 11.5。

english: Map 11.5: Cave of Shattered Reflection
zh_tw: 地圖 11.5: 破碎倒影洞

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: R1: Shattered Grotto
zh_tw: R1: 破碎的洞穴

english: When the crystal mass in {@area area E1|4e8|x} of Vecna's Grasp shatters in front the characters, read the following:
zh_tw: 當維克那之握的{@area 區域E1|4e8|x}中的晶體在角色面前碎裂時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: The cave trembles as deep rents appear in the mass of purple crystals in the center of the room. With a tremendous crack, the crystals shatter, sending shards flying. The destruction of the crystals reveals a deep pit. Screaming winds and ghastly ethereal wisps of neon-green light rise from the pit.
zh_tw: 洞穴在房間中心的紫色水晶塊中出現了深深的裂縫時顫抖。隨著一聲巨大的破裂聲，水晶破碎，碎片四濺。水晶的破壞揭示了一個深坑。尖叫的風聲和令人恐懼的幽靈般的霓虹綠光從坑中升起。

english: The pit is 500 feet deep. Its sides are composed of obsidian near the top and purple crystal closer to the bottom. The howling winds and lights are expressions of Vecna's hoarded secrets. The pit is filled with wind strong enough to blow out torches. Attack rolls in the pit have disadvantage due to the wind.
zh_tw: 這個坑深達500尺。它的兩側由頂部附近的黑曜石和接近底部的紫色水晶組成。呼嘯的風和光線是維克那囤積的秘密的表現。坑裡充滿了足以吹滅火把的強風。由於風力影響，在坑中的攻擊檢定處於不利狀態。

english: Climbing down the pit's smooth walls without climbing gear or magic is perilous. A creature must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to do so, falling to the bottom of the pit on a failed check.
zh_tw: 在沒有攀爬裝備或魔法的情況下，從坑洞光滑的牆壁上攀爬下來是非常危險的。生物必須成功透過一個 {@dc 20} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定才能做到，如果檢定失敗，則會摔落到坑洞底部。

english: The bottom of the pit is a flat, cylindrical chamber of smooth crystal. When the characters reach the bottom of the pit, two Undead monsters emerge from the pit's walls and attack the party. The monsters use the {@creature death knight} stat block and represent potent secrets Vecna has hoarded.
zh_tw: 坑底是一個平坦的、光滑水晶製成的圓柱形房間。當角色們到達坑底時，兩個不死怪物從坑壁中出現並向隊伍發起攻擊。這些怪物使用{@creature death knight||死亡騎士}的統計資料塊，代表著維克那囤積的強大秘密。

english: One monster's hands and arms drip with blood, representing a king who secretly murdered his sibling. The other monster has no facial features, representing a famed individual who lied about their identity.
zh_tw: 一個怪物的雙手和手臂滴著血，代表著一個秘密殺害自己兄弟姐妹的國王。另一個怪物沒有面部特徵，代表著一個謊報自己身份的著名人物。

english: An opening on the east side of this area connects to area R2.
zh_tw: 這個區域東邊的一個開口連線到R2區域。

english: R2: Threshold
zh_tw: R2: 門檻

english: A wall of translucent, purple crystal divides this obsidian cavern in two, blocking the way toward the tunnel on the other side. You feel a faint but deeply unpleasant hum coming from the tunnel.
zh_tw: 一面半透明的紫色水晶牆將這個黑曜石洞穴一分為二，阻擋了通往另一邊隧道的道路。你感覺到從隧道傳來微弱但極其不愉快的嗡嗡聲。

english: Set in the middle of the crystal wall is a large, circular slab of lustrous white diamond. A glowing ruby is set into the diamond's center. It looks uncannily like an eyeball with a bloodred iris. An identical ruby is set into the opposite side of the diamond slab.
zh_tw: 鑲嵌在水晶牆中間的是一個大型的圓形光澤白色鑽石板。一塊發光的紅寶石嵌入鑽石的中心。它看起來詭異地像一個有著血紅色虹膜的眼睛。一個相同的紅寶石嵌入在鑽石板的對面。

english: The first time a character comes within 5 feet of the crystal wall, a peculiar reflection of that character appears in the crystal. The reflection mirrors the character's appearance except for their face, which wears a twisted sneer. This is a {@creature mirror shade|VEoR} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}). It attacks the character once, then flees to area R3.
zh_tw: 當角色首次接近水晶牆5尺以內時，該角色的一個奇特倒影出現在水晶中。這個倒影除了臉部扭曲成嘲諷的笑容外，反映了角色的外觀。這是一個{@creature mirror shade|VEoR|鏡影}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）。它攻擊角色一次，然後逃向R3區域。

english: Psychic Hum
zh_tw: 心靈嗡鳴

english: The tunnel east of the door emanates an unpleasant humming sensation into creatures' minds. Though painful, the hum doesn't deal damage. Once a character crosses the threshold to area R3, the hum intensifies in volume and begins to deal damage (see the "Amplified Hum" section of area R3 below).
zh_tw: 門東側的隧道向生物的大腦發出一種不愉快的嗡嗡感覺。雖然痛苦，但這種嗡嗡聲並不造成傷害。一旦角色穿過通往R3區域的閾值，嗡嗡聲的音量會增強，並開始造成傷害（見下文R3區域的"增強嗡鳴"部分）。

english: Diamond Door
zh_tw: 鑽石門

english: The diamond door in this hall connects the two halves of this room. Vecna or a character carrying Vecna's Link can teleport to the opposite side of the door simply by touching the ruby set into the door's diamond surface.
zh_tw: 這個大廳中的鑽石門連線了這個房間的兩半。維克那或者攜帶維克那的連結的角色可以透過觸控門上鑲嵌的紅寶石，簡單地傳送到門的對面。

english: R3: Ritual Chamber
zh_tw: R3: 儀式室

english: Floor-to-ceiling walls of purple crystal divide this broad cavern and cast thousands of disorienting reflections throughout it. Large doors made of solid diamond are set into various walls. Each door has a large ruby or sapphire embedded in it.
zh_tw: 從地板到天花板的紫色水晶牆壁將這個寬敞的洞穴分隔開來，在其中投射出成千上萬令人迷失方向的反射。由純鑽石製成的大型門嵌入在不同的牆壁上。每扇門上都嵌有一塊大紅寶石或藍寶石。

english: As you enter the cave, the psychic hum intensifies, shaking you to the core. The hum is coming from somewhere in the crystal maze.
zh_tw: 當你們進入洞穴時，心靈嗡鳴聲變得更加強烈，震撼著你們的心靈深處。這種嗡鳴聲來自水晶迷宮的某個地方。

english: Four {@creature Mirror Shade|VEoR|mirror shades} (see {@adventure appendix A|VEoR|12}) lurk within the crystal walls. (If the characters already destroyed the one in {@area area R2|517|x}, there are three mirror shades in this chamber instead of four.) The mirror shades are servants of Vecna tasked with slaying intruders. The mirror shades use their Mirror Movement trait to move through the crystal walls.
zh_tw: 四個{@creature Mirror Shade|VEoR|鏡影}（見{@adventure 附錄A|VEoR|12}）潛伏在水晶牆內。（如果角色們已經摧毀了在{@area 區域R2|517|x}的那一個，那麼在這個房間裡的鏡影數量會從四個減少到三個。）這些鏡影是維克那的僕從，任務是殺死入侵者。鏡影利用它們的映象移動特性穿過水晶牆移動。

english: Amplified Hum
zh_tw: 增強嗡鳴

english: Any creature other than Vecna and his mirror shades that starts its turn here must succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or take 5 ({@dice 1d10}) psychic damage.
zh_tw: 任何在此處開始回合的除維克那和他的映象分身之外的生物必須成功透過一次 {@dc 20} 的感知豁免，否則受到 5 ({@dice 1d10}) 點心靈傷害。

english: Door Maze
zh_tw: 門迷宮

english: The crystal walls divide the area into discrete chambers. To reach Vecna, the characters must use the diamond doors and figure out how to reach the central chamber (labeled "Vecna" on {@adventure map 11.5|VEoR|11|Map 11.5: Cave of Shattered Reflection}).
zh_tw: 水晶牆將該區域分隔成獨立的密室。角色們必須利用鑽石門並找出通往中央密室（在{@adventure 地圖 11.5|VEoR|11|Map 11.5: Cave of Shattered Reflection}中標記為"維克那"）的路線。

english: Ten diamond doors are set into the crystal walls. Each door has a ruby on one side and a sapphire on the other, and each door is etched with a sigil, as described earlier in the "{@area Diamond Doors|510|x}" section. The doors, their gemstones, and the etched sigils—represented with labels—are marked on map 11.5.
zh_tw: 十扇鑽石門嵌入在水晶牆中。每扇門的一側鑲有紅寶石，另一側鑲有藍寶石，每扇門上都刻有一個符號，如"{@area 鑽石門|510|x}"部分前文所述。這些門、它們的寶石以及刻有的符號——帶有標籤——在地圖11.5上有所標記。

english: Characters can teleport to Vecna's central chamber by touching the ruby gemstone on one of the following doors: A2, B1, C1, {@dice D1}. The characters might need to use some trial and error to figure out which doors lead where. If the characters struggle, allow any character proficient in the {@skill Arcana} or {@skill Investigation} skill to figure out which doors lead to where the characters want to go.
zh_tw: 角色們可以透過觸控以下門之一上的紅寶石來傳送到維克那的中央房間：A2、B1、C1、{@dice D1}。角色們可能需要透過一些嘗試和錯誤來弄清楚哪些門通向哪裡。如果角色們遇到困難，允許任何擅長{@skill Arcana||奧秘}或{@skill Investigation||調查}技能的角色來弄清楚哪些門通向角色們想去的地方。

english: Confronting Vecna
zh_tw: 面對維克那

english: Read the following when the characters enter the central chamber where Vecna weaves his ritual:
zh_tw: 當角色們進入維克那編織他的儀式的中央房間時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: Levitating in the center of this crystal chamber is a skeletal person wearing kingly vestments: Vecna the Archlich. Vecna's desiccated head is thrown back in concentration. His wrinkled eyelids are closed, with one drooping over its empty socket. His shriveled lips are pulled back to reveal rotted teeth. Vecna spreads his arms, one with a missing hand, and murmurs in a profane-sounding gibberish while a lightless orb swirls in front of his chest. It grows bigger by the moment.
zh_tw: 在這個水晶房間的中心懸浮著一個穿著王者服飾的骷髏人：維克那，大巫妖。維克那的乾枯頭部向後仰著，專注地集中精神。他那佈滿皺紋的眼皮閉著，其中一個垂在空洞的眼窩上。他那枯萎的嘴唇向後拉，露出腐爛的牙齒。維克那張開雙臂，其中一隻沒有手，一邊用聽起來褻瀆的胡言亂語低語，一邊在他的胸前有一個無光的球體旋轉。它每時每刻都在變大。

english: {@creature Vecna the Archlich|VEoR} (see {@area appendix B|56d|x}) is weaving his Ritual of Remaking. He is too focused to pay the characters any mind unless they confront him directly. Vecna is funneling energy into the ritual in addition to the power of the secrets his cult gathered, so the lich is considerably less powerful than he normally is. Unlike the characters, Vecna can move through this area as if its doors were normal.
zh_tw: {@creature Vecna the Archlich|VEoR|維克那，大巫妖}（見{@area 附錄 B|56d|x}）正在編織他的重塑儀式。他太專注於此，除非角色們直接面對他，否則他不會注意到角色們。維克那除了他的邪教收集的秘密力量之外，還在將能量注入儀式中，所以這個巫妖比他通常的狀態要弱得多。與角色們不同，維克那可以像穿過普通門一樣穿過這個區域。

english: To achieve victory, the characters must reduce {@creature Vecna the Archlich|VEoR|Vecna} to 50 hit points or fewer. A character then must use the {@item Chime of Exile|VEoR} to target Vecna, which requires a clear line of sight to him. If a character wields the complete {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} in this encounter, that character feels the artifact's yearning to preserve the order of the multiverse and stop Vecna's ritual. Each time a character strikes Vecna with the rod, Vecna takes an extra 35 ({@dice 10d6}) psychic damage.
zh_tw: 為了取得勝利，角色們必須將{@creature Vecna the Archlich|VEoR|維克那}的生命值降至50點或更少。然後，角色必須使用{@item Chime of Exile|VEoR|放逐鐘琴}來針對維克那，這需要對他有清晰的視線。如果角色在這一戰中揮舞完整的{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}，那個角色就會感受到這件神器渴望維護多元宇宙的秩序並阻止維克那的儀式。每次角色用這根法杖擊中維克那時，維克那會額外承受35（{@dice 10d6}）點心靈傷害。

english: When the characters do this, read the following:
zh_tw: 當角色們這樣做時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: The chime echoes off the crystal walls, drowning out the ambient psychic hum. Vecna, his ritual interrupted, clutches his head and screams in agony. Something in him snaps, and he falls limply to the ground. The cave becomes deathly silent. Time seems to stand still.
zh_tw: 鈴聲在水晶牆上回響，淹沒了周圍的心靈嗡鳴聲。維克那的儀式被打斷，他抓住頭部，痛苦地尖叫。他體內的某物斷裂了，他無力地倒在地上。洞穴變得死一般的寂靜。時間似乎靜止了。

english: Then the crystal cavern shatters, overwhelming your senses. Vecna's body tumbles into an unfathomable inky void just before you also plunge into the black expanse. When you come to, you find yourself drifting among a sea of stars.
zh_tw: 然後水晶洞穴破碎了，壓倒了你的感官。維克那的身體在你也要陷入那深不可測的墨色虛空之前翻滾進去。當你恢復意識時，你發現自己漂浮在一片星空之中。

english: The {@item Chime of Exile|VEoR} sends Vecna hurtling toward his home world of Oerth. Moreover, the sudden cessation of Vecna's ritual causes a chain reaction that destroys the Cave of Shattered Reflection and Vecna's Grasp. Everything except Vecna is sucked through a portal to the Astral Sea, which is where the characters find themselves afterward. As if to punctuate the end of their quest, each character's Vecna's Link vanishes as their connection to the lich is severed.
zh_tw: {@item Chime of Exile|VEoR|放逐鐘琴}將維克那推向他的家鄉奧斯。此外，維克那儀式的突然停止引發了一連串的反應，摧毀了破碎倒影洞和維克那之握。除了維克那之外的所有東西都被吸入了一個通往星界海的傳送門，這也是角色們之後發現自己所在的地方。彷彿是為了標誌著他們任務的結束，每個角色的維克那的連結隨著他們與巫妖的聯絡被切斷而消失了。

english: Conclusion
zh_tw: 結局

english: With Vecna banished to Oerth and his ritual foiled, the characters have saved the multiverse from ruin. (If the characters fail, the multiverse becomes a terrible place indeed!)
zh_tw: 隨著維克那被放逐到奧斯，他的儀式被挫敗，角色們已經從毀滅中拯救了多元宇宙。（如果角色們失敗，多元宇宙確實會變成一個可怕的地方！）

english: Characters who return to the sanctum in Sigil are greeted by Alustriel and Tasha, who immediately begin planning a magnificent celebration in honor of the characters' heroics.
zh_tw: 返回至法印城的聖所的角色們受到了艾拉斯卓和塔莎的熱烈歡迎，他們立即開始計劃一場盛大的慶典，以表彰角色們的英雄壯舉。

english: Though stymied, Vecna is far from undone. He might stubbornly attempt to destroy and re-create the multiverse again, or he might formulate a new scheme to bend the cosmos to his will. Either way, it will be some time before a new band of adventurers must rise to defeat the archlich once again.
zh_tw: 儘管受挫，維克那遠未被徹底擊敗。他可能會頑固地再次嘗試毀滅並重新創造多元宇宙，或者他可能會制定一個新的計劃來使宇宙屈服於他的意志。無論哪種方式，都將有一段時間直到新的一群冒險者必須再次崛起以擊敗這位大巫妖。

english: Acererak
zh_tw: 阿瑟瑞克

english: Also known as the Devourer, Acererak is a powerful archlich feared across many worlds. He takes sadistic pleasure in killing adventurers by luring them into his trap-riddled tombs with the promise of powerful artifacts. Then he feeds on their souls to sustain his escapades across the multiverse.
zh_tw: 阿瑟瑞克，也被稱為吞噬者，是一個在許多世界中令人恐懼的強大死靈大法師。他以殘忍的快感誘使冒險者進入佈滿陷阱的墳墓，承諾給予強大的神器。然後，他吞噬他們的靈魂，以維持他在多元宇宙中的冒險。

english: History
zh_tw: 歷史

english: Hundreds of years ago, Acererak was a mortal mage from Oerth devoted to the pursuit of power and immortality. Some say that Acererak was a pupil of Vecna, from whom he learned undeath's secrets.
zh_tw: 數百年前，阿瑟瑞克是來自奧斯的一個凡人法師，致力於追求力量和不朽。有人說阿瑟瑞克是維克那的學生，他從維克那那裡學到了不死的秘密。

english: Acererak travels the planes in search of powerful artifacts. When the archlich finds a particularly intriguing one, he seals it in one of his infamous tombs to tempt treasure hunters into the dungeon's depths. Acererak has filled these tombs with deadly traps, fearsome monsters, and twisted puzzles meant to torment and eventually slay would-be thieves, whose souls he then consumes.
zh_tw: 阿瑟瑞克穿越各個位面尋找強大的神器。當這位死靈大法師發現特別有趣的物品時，他會將其封印在他臭名昭著的墳墓之一中，以此誘惑尋寶者深入地牢的深處。阿瑟瑞克在這些墳墓中佈滿了致命的陷阱、可怕的怪物和扭曲的謎題，旨在折磨並最終殺死那些潛在的盜賊，然後他將他們的靈魂消耗掉。

english: The most famous of Acererak's tombs is the Tomb of Horrors, which has claimed many adventurers throughout its history. Another infamous tomb is the Tomb of the Nine Gods, in which Acererak sealed nine false gods he had slain there. He has additional tombs on Oerth, in Faerûn, and beyond.
zh_tw: 阿瑟瑞克最著名的墳墓是恐怖之墓，它在歷史上奪去了許多冒險家的生命。另一個臭名昭著的墳墓是九神之墓，在其中阿瑟瑞克封印了他所殺死的九個假神。他在奧斯、費倫以及更遠的地方還有其他的墳墓。

english: Unlike many archliches, Acererak doesn't desire godhood. Nevertheless, his nefarious deeds have garnered him a substantial following. One such group of these followers founded the Bleak Academy, an institution of arcane and religious learning that extols Acererak's power.
zh_tw: 與許多死靈大法師不同，阿瑟瑞克並不渴望成為神。儘管如此，他的惡行還是為他贏得了相當多的追隨者。這些追隨者中的一個團體創立了荒涼學院，這是一個讚頌阿瑟瑞克力量的奧術和宗教學問的機構。

english: Personality
zh_tw: 個性

english: Acererak delights in watching others perish. He regards himself as superior in all aspects, treating others as one would annoying insects. He views even the creatures he creates as mere tools to serve his whims. This hubris has often led him to disaster, but as a lich, Acererak continually returns to unlife.
zh_tw: 阿瑟瑞克喜歡看著其他人死去。他自認為在各方面都是優越的，將其他人視為討厭的昆蟲。他甚至將自己創造的生物視為僅僅用來滿足自己奇想的工具。這種傲慢經常導致他遭遇災難，但作為一個巫妖，阿瑟瑞克不斷地以不死之身迴歸。

english: Alustriel Silverhand
zh_tw: 艾拉斯卓·銀手

english: Lady {@creature Alustriel Silverhand|VEoR}, called the Shining Lady, has been an influential wizard and proponent of good across Toril for centuries. Alustriel is one of the Seven Sisters—immortal daughters of Mystra, a god of magic. The divine energy Mystra passed to Alustriel grants Alustriel incredible power over arcane magic.
zh_tw: 被稱為光輝女士的{@creature Alustriel Silverhand|VEoR|艾拉斯卓·銀手}，幾個世紀以來一直是託瑞爾大陸上一位有影響力的法師和善良事業的支持者。艾拉斯卓是七姐妹之一——神秘女神密斯特拉的不朽女兒，密斯特拉是魔法之神。密斯特拉傳遞給艾拉斯卓的神聖能量賦予了她對奧術魔法難以置信的掌控力。

english: Alustriel's youthful appearance as a human woman with silver hair gives no hint of her supernaturally extended life span. She typically wears long robes and wields a unicorn-headed staff, her {@i Staff of Silverymoon}.
zh_tw: 艾拉斯卓作為一位擁有銀色頭髮的人類女性的年輕外表，沒有透露出她超自然延長的壽命。她通常穿著長袍，手持一個以獨角獸為頭的法杖，即她的{@i 銀月法杖}。

english: Personality
zh_tw: 個性

english: Alustriel's primary concerns are to spread kindness, reward virtue, and promote a culture of compassion throughout the multiverse. She is good at building alliances and quick to intervene when she senses a threat to the forces of good. She has traveled far and established safe houses across the planes—such as her sanctum in the city of Sigil. Alustriel doesn't seek personal glory or wealth; her style of influencing the cosmos is quiet yet steady.
zh_tw: 艾拉斯卓的主要關注點是傳播善意、獎勵美德，並在整個多元宇宙中推廣一種富有同情心的文化。她擅長建立聯盟，並且在感知到對善良勢力的威脅時會迅速介入。她已經走過了很遠的路，在各個位面上建立了安全屋——比如她在法印城之城的聖所。艾拉斯卓不追求個人的榮耀或財富；她影響宇宙的方式是悄然而穩定的。

english: History
zh_tw: 歷史

english: Like other Chosen of Mystra, Alustriel is concerned with preserving the Weave, the primary incarnation of magic that permeates Toril. She believes that the Weave favors those who act with mercy and compassion, seeks to deliver lives of security for all, and bolsters people's efforts when they seek to right wrongs and combat evil.
zh_tw: 像密斯特拉的其他選民一樣，艾拉斯卓致力於維護魔網，這是滲透託瑞爾的魔法的主要化身。她相信魔網偏愛那些以仁慈和同情行事的人，致力於為所有人提供安全的生活，並在人們尋求糾正錯誤和對抗邪惡時增強人們的努力。

english: Nowhere are Alustriel and her deeds better known than in the Silver Marches and its capital, Silverymoon. Alustriel ruled Silverymoon for centuries, once disguised as a wizard named Elué Dualen and then later in her true form. She helped create Silverymoon's famous Moonbridge and co-founded the Lady's College, the first school in Faerûn for mages as students rather than as apprentices in service.
zh_tw: 沒有任何地方比銀色聯邦及其首都銀月城更熟悉艾拉斯卓和她的事蹟。艾拉斯卓統治銀月城數個世紀，起初化名為法師艾露耶·杜阿倫，後來才恢復真實身分。她協助建造了銀月城著名的月橋，也共同創立了女士學院；這是費倫第一所以法師為正式學生，而非服侍導師的學徒，來提供教育的學院。

english: Alustriel stepped down as Silverymoon's high mage more than a century ago. Her son, Methrammar Aerasumé, now leads the city and works to uphold his mother's legacy.
zh_tw: 艾拉斯卓在一個多世紀前就不再擔任銀月城的高階法師。她的兒子，梅特拉瑪·阿拉斯梅，現在領導著這座城市，並致力於維護他母親的遺產。

english: Alustriel has partaken in countless adventures before and after her tenure as Silverymoon's high mage. She has befriended famous adventurers such as Drizzt Do'Urden, worked with prominent organizations like the Harpers, and helped prevent or undo many kinds of evil.
zh_tw: 在擔任銀月城高等法師期間及其後，艾拉斯卓參與了無數的冒險。她與像崔斯特·杜堊登這樣的著名冒險家成為朋友，與諸如豎琴手聯盟這樣的傑出組織合作，並幫助預防或消除了各種邪惡。

english: Kas the Betrayer
zh_tw: 背叛者凱斯

english: The Betrayer, the Bloody Handed, the Destroyer—{@creature Kas the Betrayer|VEoR|Kas} has earned many epithets during his long existence. He is a vampire, legendary sword-fighter, and ruthless warlord, and he is driven primarily by one thing: his hatred for Vecna.
zh_tw: 背叛者、血手、毀滅者——{@creature Kas the Betrayer|VEoR|凱斯}在他漫長的存在中贏得了許多稱號。他是一名吸血鬼、傳奇劍客和無情的軍閥，驅使他前進的主要只有一件事：他對維克那的仇恨。

english: Kas resembles a well-muscled, raven-haired, human man in his thirties, though he is far older. His fangs reveal his vampiric nature.
zh_tw: 凱斯看起來像一個肌肉發達、黑髮的三十多歲人類男性，儘管他的實際年齡要大得多。他的獠牙揭示了他的吸血鬼本性。

english: Personality
zh_tw: 個性

english: Kas is cruel, spiteful, and unrelenting in his pursuit of vengeance against Vecna. He readily lies, breaks promises, betrays allies, and taunts those who fall for his ruses. Kas has little use for those who won't validate his superiority or help advance his goals.
zh_tw: 凱斯性格殘忍、懷恨在心，對維克那的復仇追求毫不留情。他毫不猶豫地撒謊、違背承諾、背叛盟友，並嘲笑那些落入他陷阱的人。對於那些不願證實他的優越性或幫助實現他目標的人，凱斯幾乎不把他們放在眼裡。

english: In this adventure, Kas fools Tasha and Alustriel, two incredibly powerful wizards. In addition to defeating Vecna, Kas desperately wants the wizards to witness and acknowledge his strength.
zh_tw: 在這次冒險中，凱斯愚弄了塔莎和艾拉斯卓這兩位極其強大的法師。除了擊敗維克那，凱斯迫切希望法師們目睹並承認他的力量。

english: Lolth the Spider Queen
zh_tw: 羅絲，蜘蛛女王

english: Lolth—the demon-god of deceit, shadows, and spiders—gains power by deceiving allies and enemies alike. Worshipers of the Spider Queen believe she can see through the eyes of all spiders and insist she is all-knowing.
zh_tw: 羅絲——欺詐、陰影和蜘蛛的惡魔神——透過欺騙盟友和敵人來獲得力量。蜘蛛女王的信徒認為她可以透過所有蜘蛛的眼睛看到一切，並堅稱她無所不知。

english: History
zh_tw: 歷史

english: In eons past, Lolth regularly plotted against her family of elven gods, seeking to kill those deities and subjugate their followers. Though her attempts mostly failed, she learned from them and grew mightier.
zh_tw: 在遠古時代，羅絲定期密謀對抗她的精靈神族家族，試圖殺害這些神祇並征服他們的信徒。儘管她的企圖大多失敗了，但她從中學到了東西並變得更強大。

english: Her failed attempt on the life of the powerful elven god Corellon Larethian resulted in Lolth's banishment to the Abyss. There she conquered a layer known as the Demonweb, where she now makes her home. Lolth embraces her surroundings and takes the form of a demon, regularly appearing as a beautiful elven woman with the lower body of an enormous, monstrous spider. Lolth relishes her title of the Spider Queen and attempts to annihilate any who doubt her power.
zh_tw: 羅絲試圖暗殺強大的精靈神科瑞隆·拉瑞斯安失敗後，導致她被流放到無底深淵。在那裡，她征服了一個叫做魔網深坑的層面，現在那裡成了她的家。羅絲擁抱她的環境並以惡魔的形式出現，經常出現為一個下半身是巨大、怪物般蜘蛛的美麗的精靈女性。羅絲喜歡她作為蜘蛛女王的稱號，並試圖消滅任何懷疑她力量的人。

english: Lolth became the patron god of evil monsters that dwell in Faerûn's Underdark. Some Humanoids also choose to worship her. Lolth conveys her favor in monstrous ways. One of the most accursed of the Spider Queen's gifts is transformation into a drider.
zh_tw: 羅絲成為了居住在費倫地底黑暗中的邪惡怪物的守護神。一些類人生物也選擇崇拜她。羅絲以怪物的方式表達她的青睞。蜘蛛女王最被詛咒的禮物之一是變成一個蛛化卓爾（蛛化卓爾）。

english: Followers of Lolth seek to foment chaos everywhere in the Spider Queen's name. The more ruthless and fanatically devoted to Lolth a worshiper is, the higher that worshiper ranks in Lolth's favor.
zh_tw: 羅絲的追隨者以蜘蛛女王的名義到處煽動混亂。一個信徒越是無情和狂熱地奉獻給羅絲，那個信徒在羅絲的寵愛中的地位就越高。

english: Personality
zh_tw: 個性

english: Lolth is a cruel god. She loves chaos and hurting the innocent, especially those who oppose her power-hungry ideals. The suffering of others delights her, and if that pain benefits her plans, all the better.
zh_tw: 羅絲是一個殘忍的神。她喜歡混亂和傷害無辜，特別是那些反對她渴望權力的理想的人。他人的痛苦使她感到高興，如果這種痛苦對她的計劃有利，那就更好了。

english: The Spider Queen employs duplicity and sadism against her enemies, but she also enjoys bedeviling those who claim to love her. She promises great rewards to those who follow her without question; whether she delivers on her vows depends on her whims.
zh_tw: 蜘蛛女王對敵人使用欺騙和虐待，但她也喜歡困擾那些聲稱愛她的人。她向那些無條件跟隨她的承諾給予巨大的回報；她是否履行她的誓言取決於她的心血來潮。

english: The Spider Queen often allies with other gods or powerful demon lords, though she does so only for personal gain. At the first sign of any inconvenience, Lolth abandons her allies. Despite that fact, some believe her patronage is valuable.
zh_tw: 蜘蛛女王經常與其他神祇或強大的惡魔領主結盟，儘管她這麼做只是為了個人利益。在遇到任何不便的第一個跡象時，羅絲就會拋棄她的盟友。儘管如此，一些人認為她的庇護是有價值的。

english: Most recently, Lolth allied with Vecna. The archlich promised Lolth a place at his side as the second-most powerful being in existence if she aids his efforts to use the Ritual of Remaking to re-form the multiverse. Lolth has deployed armies to protect Vecna on Pandemonium, though if the tide turns against the archlich, Lolth plans to strand her forces.
zh_tw: 最近，羅絲與維克那結盟。這位死靈大法師向羅絲承諾，如果她幫助他利用重塑儀式重新塑造多元宇宙，她將成為存在的第二強大的存在，站在他身邊。羅絲已經部署了軍隊在喧癲空隧上保護維克那，儘管如果形勢對死靈大法師不利，羅絲計劃拋棄她的軍隊。

english: Lord Soth
zh_tw: 索思爵士

english: {@creature Lord Soth|DSotDQ} is the most powerful death knight on Krynn. Once a Solamnic Knight of the Order of the Rose, Soth was a paragon of virtue and justice who allowed his pride to lead him down an evil path. Soth perished during Krynn's Cataclysm, then rose from the ashes as a death knight. Soth lives in his cursed castle, Dargaard Keep.
zh_tw: {@creature Lord Soth|DSotDQ|索思爵士}是克萊恩上最強大的死亡騎士。曾經是玫瑰騎士團的索拉姆尼克騎士，索思是一個美德和正義的典範，但他的驕傲讓他走上了邪惡的道路。索思在克萊恩的大災變中死去，然後作為死亡騎士從灰燼中崛起。索思居住在他被詛咒的城堡，達爾加德要塞。

english: Miska the Wolf-Spider
zh_tw: 米斯卡，狼蛛

english: Miska the Wolf-Spider is a legendary demon lord and master of battlefield strategy. He has the lower body of a massive armored spider, four arms, and two enormous wolf heads that drip poison. Yet Miska's greatest strength is his cunning mind.
zh_tw: 米斯卡，狼蛛是一個傳說中的惡魔領主，也是戰場策略的大師。他有著巨大裝甲蜘蛛的下半身、四隻手臂和兩個滴著毒液的巨大狼頭。然而，米斯卡最大的力量是他狡猾的頭腦。

english: History
zh_tw: 歷史

english: Ages ago, {@creature Miska the Wolf-Spider|VEoR|Miska} led the hordes of Chaos against the forces of Law at the behest of his patron, the enigmatic Queen of Chaos. It seemed Miska's domination couldn't be stopped.
zh_tw: 數個時代以前，{@creature Miska the Wolf-Spider|VEoR|米斯卡}在他的庇護者——神秘的混沌女王的指示下，領導混沌的軍團對抗秩序的力量。似乎米斯卡的統治無人能擋。

english: In desperation, Miska's opponents crafted an artifact to bind him in an extraplanar prison. This rod broke apart after sealing him in Pandemonium, scattering across the planes and becoming known as the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR}. The rod is the key to releasing Miska from his long imprisonment.
zh_tw: 在絕望中，米斯卡的對手製造了一個神器將他束縛在異界監獄中。這個法杖在將他封印在喧癲空隧之後破碎了，碎片散落在各個位面，被稱為{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}。這個法杖是釋放米斯卡脫離長期監禁的關鍵。

english: Mordenkainen
zh_tw: 魔鄧肯

english: Mordenkainen is a human wizard from Oerth whose wanderlust and hunger for new magic take him across the multiverse. Mordenkainen is calculating and mysterious, but he isn't cruel.
zh_tw: 魔鄧肯是一位來自奧斯的人類法師，他對新魔法的渴望和漫遊癖驅使他跨越多元宇宙。魔鄧肯既精明又神秘，但他並不殘忍。

english: Mordenkainen has been involved in several friendly rivalries, including with Tasha, another powerful spellcaster from Oerth. Many significant figures across the multiverse are aware of Mordenkainen, but few truly know him—something the vampire Kas exploits to impersonate Mordenkainen. Throughout the adventure, Kas is masquerading as Mordenkainen. The mage is unaware of the vampire warlord's actions.
zh_tw: 魔鄧肯參與了幾次友好競爭，包括與來自奧斯的另一位強大施法者塔莎。多元宇宙中的許多重要人物都知道魔鄧肯，但真正瞭解他的人很少——這一點被吸血鬼凱斯利用來冒充魔鄧肯。在整個冒險中，凱斯偽裝成魔鄧肯。這位法師並不知情吸血鬼領主的行為。

english: History
zh_tw: 歷史

english: Mordenkainen has told conflicting tales about his origins, but most scholars believe he accumulated impressive magical power at a young age. Known for his ingenuity, the wizard is responsible for writing several planar tomes and creating many spells that bear his name, including {@spell Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound} and {@spell Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion}.
zh_tw: 魔鄧肯關於他的起源講述了許多相互矛盾的故事，但大多數學者相信他在年輕時就積累了令人印象深刻的魔法力量。這位以足智多謀著稱的法師負責撰寫了幾部位面書籍，並創造了許多以他的名字命名的法術，包括{@spell Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound||魔鄧肯忠犬}和{@spell Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion||魔鄧肯豪宅術}。

english: As his fame on Oerth grew, Mordenkainen became the leader of a powerful group of spellcasters called the Circle of Eight. The group included several wizards who similarly pioneered new spells, including Tenser and Bigby. Eventually, the circle disbanded after it stopped an uprising organized by Vecna. That development fueled Mordenkainen's lifelong hatred of the lich.
zh_tw: 隨著在奧斯的名聲日益增長，魔鄧肯成為了一個名為"八方圈"的強大施法者團體的領袖。該團體包括幾位同樣開創了新法術的法師，包括譚森和畢格比。最終，在阻止了由維克那組織的起義之後，這個圈子解散了。這一事件加劇了魔鄧肯對這位巫妖的終身仇恨。

english: Mordenkainen travels the multiverse while following his academic whims. The wizard owns a home called the Tower of Urm, which pops into existence in Avernus when Mordenkainen visits to study how the Nine Hells affect various schools of magic.
zh_tw: 魔鄧肯按照他的學術興趣在多元宇宙中旅行。這位法師擁有一個名為烏爾姆之塔的家，當魔鄧肯訪問阿弗納斯研究九層地獄如何影響各種魔法學派時，它就會突然出現。

english: Personality
zh_tw: 個性

english: Mordenkainen is stubborn and egotistical to the point of driving even his friends to annoyance. He has few close relationships, although nearly all wizards recognize his accomplishments. He is lonely and dreams of building a community of spellcasters who support each other. Unfortunately, his ego makes that dream all but impossible.
zh_tw: 魔鄧肯固執且自負到了讓即使是他的朋友也感到惱火的地步。他很少有親密的關係，儘管幾乎所有的法師都認可他的成就。他感到孤獨，夢想建立一個相互支援的施法者社群。不幸的是，他的自負使得這個夢想幾乎不可能實現。

english: Although Mordenkainen can be brash and off-putting, he eschews cruelty and sees no reason to cause pointless suffering. The wizard doesn't like to admit it, but he would put his own safety at risk to quell the pain of innocents.
zh_tw: 儘管魔鄧肯可能表現得魯莽且令人不悅，但他避免殘忍，並且看不出造成無謂痛苦的理由。這位法師不願意承認，但他會冒著自身安全的險去減輕無辜者的痛苦。

english: Strahd von Zarovich
zh_tw: 施特拉德·馮·扎洛維奇

english: {@creature Strahd, Master of Death House|VEoR|Strahd von Zarovich} is the Darklord of Barovia, a Domain of Dread. Little happens there without the Darklord's knowledge, although Strahd rarely pays attention to what he considers the uninteresting dealings of lesser beings. However, once the characters arrive in Barovia, explore a place called Death House, and find a piece of the {@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR} there, Strahd's interest becomes piqued, and he makes an appearance. The characters encounter Strahd in his Master of Death House iteration in {@area chapter 5|2bb|x}.
zh_tw: {@creature Strahd, Master of Death House|VEoR|施特拉德·馮·扎洛維奇}是巴洛維亞的黑暗領主，一個恐懼領域。在那裡，幾乎沒有什麼是黑暗領主不知道的，儘管施特拉德很少關注他認為無趣的次要生物的瑣事。然而，一旦角色們抵達巴洛維亞，探索一個名為死亡之屋的地方，並在那裡找到一塊{@item Rod of Seven Parts|VEoR|七碎片之杖}的碎片，施特拉德的興趣就會被激起，並現身與角色們相遇。角色們將在死亡之屋領主的形態中與施特拉德相遇，相關描述見{@area 第五章|2bb|x}。

english: History
zh_tw: 歷史

english: In life, Strahd von Zarovich was a prince, a soldier, and a conqueror. His thirst for power never sated, Strahd made a pact with the Dark Powers to become immortal. Meanwhile, Strahd's evil deepened, until in a jealous rage he murdered his brother, Sergei. Sergei's betrothed, Tatyana, leapt from a tower to escape Strahd and vanished into the Mists rising around Barovia as Strahd slew everyone else in the castle. He had become a vampire, and Barovia became a Domain of Dread.
zh_tw: 在生前，施特拉德·馮·扎洛維奇是一位王子、一個士兵，也是一個征服者。他對權力的渴望從未得到滿足，施特拉德與黑暗力量達成了協議，成為了不朽的存在。與此同時，施特拉德的邪惡不斷加深，直到在一次嫉妒的憤怒中，他殺害了自己的兄弟謝爾蓋。謝爾蓋的未婚妻塔季揚娜為了逃離施特拉德，從一座塔上跳下，並消失在圍繞巴洛維亞升起的霧氣中，而施特拉德則屠殺了城堡中的其他人。他已經成為了一個吸血鬼，巴洛維亞也成為了一個令人恐懼的領域。

english: Now the Dark Powers keep Strahd trapped in his realm, tormenting him with his inability to escape for all eternity. He spends his days amusing himself as best he can, terrorizing Barovia's people and savoring the fear and worship he commands.
zh_tw: 現在黑暗力量將施特拉德困在自己的領域中，用他無法逃脫的無能折磨他，直到永恆。他儘自己所能地度過每一天，恐嚇巴洛維亞的人民，享受著他所掌控的恐懼和崇拜。

english: Tasha
zh_tw: 塔莎

english: {@creature Tasha the Witch|VEoR|Tasha's} path to greatness began when she was adopted by the arch-hag Baba Yaga, who named her Natasha. Tasha went on to create various spells, including {@spell Tasha's Hideous Laughter}, and her magic-fueled ambitions brought her into contact with demons and demon lords, which she subjugated and used against her enemies. On the Material Plane, she became known as {@creature Iggwilv the Witch Queen|WBtW} and wrote the {@item Demonomicon of Iggwilv|TCE}, the greatest of all treatises on the Abyss and its demonic inhabitants. In recent years, Tasha has sequestered herself in the Feywild, achieving incredible power and slowly turning into a Fey creature. Tasha has become Zybilna, archfey of the domain of Prismeer.
zh_tw: {@creature Tasha the Witch|VEoR|塔莎的} 通往偉大的道路始於她被大巫婆巴巴亞加收養，巴巴亞加給她取名為娜塔莎。塔莎繼續創造了各種法術，包括{@spell Tasha's Hideous Laughter||塔莎狂笑術}，她的魔法雄心讓她與惡魔和惡魔領主接觸，她征服了他們並用來對付她的敵人。在物質界，她被稱為{@creature Iggwilv the Witch Queen|WBtW|巫後伊格薇爾伏}，並撰寫了{@item Demonomicon of Iggwilv|TCE|伊格薇爾伏惡魔志}，這是關於無底深淵及其惡魔居民的所有論述中最偉大的。近年來，塔莎隱居在妖精荒野地，獲得了難以置信的力量，並逐漸變成了精類生物。塔莎已經成為了普里斯米爾領域的精類領主齊比爾娜。

english: Answering the Summons
zh_tw: 回應召喚

english: When Zybilna received Alustriel Silverhand's summons to combat Vecna, the archfey was sorely needed in Prismeer. As a compromise, and to honor Tasha's friendship with Alustriel, Zybilna sent a version of herself from the past to Alustriel's side. The Tasha who appears in the adventure is a powerful wizard, though she is not yet a witch queen or an archfey.
zh_tw: 當齊比爾娜收到艾拉斯卓·銀手召喚她去對抗維克那時，精類領主在普里斯米爾非常需要她。作為妥協，也是為了紀念塔莎與艾拉斯卓的友誼，齊比爾娜從過去派了一個版本的自己到艾拉斯卓身邊。在冒險中出現的塔莎是一位強大的女巫，儘管她還沒有成為女巫王或精類領主。

english: Tiamat
zh_tw: 提亞馬特

english: The terrifying dragon god Tiamat is the progenitor of chromatic dragons across the multiverse. Her earliest background is shrouded in mystery, but Tiamat's grand, five-headed silhouette has become an iconic symbol of avarice and destruction.
zh_tw: 令人恐懼的龍神提亞馬特是多元宇宙中色彩龍的始祖。她的早期背景籠罩在神秘之中，但提亞馬特宏偉的五頭剪影已成為貪婪和毀滅的象徵。

english: History
zh_tw: 歷史

english: Tiamat is one of two primordial dragons, the other being Bahamut, the progenitor of metallic dragons. Together Tiamat and Bahamut created what became known as the First World: the first iteration of physical reality, which was subsequently sundered into the innumerable realities that now make up the Material Plane. The first inhabitant of this First World was Sardior, a ruby-red dragon with jeweled scales they made in their likeness, who worked with Bahamut and Tiamat to create metallic and chromatic dragons. The Draconic poem "Elegy for the First World" describes how hordes of creatures overran this fledgling world, waging war on the dragons and colonizing the realm in the names of their gods. Bahamut and Tiamat were defeated, and Sardior disappeared.
zh_tw: 提亞馬特是兩個原始龍之一，另一個是巴哈姆特，金屬龍的始祖。提亞馬特和巴哈姆特共同創造了被稱為第一世界的存在：物質現實的首次迭代，隨後被分裂成構成物質平面的無數現實。第一世界的第一位居民是薩迪歐，一隻寶石紅色的龍，其鱗片鑲嵌著寶石，按照他們的形象被創造出來，與巴哈姆特和提亞馬特一起創造了金屬龍和色彩龍。龍族詩歌《第一世界的輓歌》描述了無數生物如何湧向這個初生的世界，以他們神的名義對龍族發動戰爭並佔領了這個領域。巴哈姆特和提亞馬特被擊敗，薩迪歐消失了。

english: Sometime after the destruction of the First World, Tiamat carved out a lair in Avernus, the first layer of the Nine Hells, where she commands a fearsome legion of followers. She maintains a courteous relationship with Asmodeus, the ruler of the Nine Hells, and commands draconic devils called {@adventure abishais|VEoR|12} as her agents. Each type of abishai bears the coloring of one of Tiamat's five heads.
zh_tw: 第一世界毀滅後不久，提亞馬特在九層地獄的第一層阿弗納斯開闢了一個巢穴，在那裡她指揮著一群令人畏懼的追隨者軍團。她與九層地獄的統治者阿斯蒙蒂斯保持著禮貌的關係，並指揮著被稱為{@adventure 阿比沙伊|VEoR|12}的龍形惡魔作為她的代理人。每種型別的阿比沙伊都帶有提亞馬特五個頭之一的顏色。

english: Across many worlds, Tiamat is worshiped as a god, with clerics at her disposal. Mortals who covet wealth and power pledge their lives to the dragon queen. Tiamat can send a fragment of her power to the Material Plane, which manifests as a titanic, five-headed dragon driven by rampaging greed.
zh_tw: 在眾多世界中，提亞馬特被當作神來崇拜，她有牧師供自己驅使。渴望財富和權力的凡人將他們的生活獻給了龍後。提亞馬特可以將她力量的一部分傳送到物質平面，表現為一隻巨大的五頭龍，由狂暴的貪婪所驅動。

english: Personality
zh_tw: 個性

english: Tiamat embodies the vices of evil dragons. She is vengeful and covets power and wealth above all else. However, Tiamat isn't reckless in her quests to expand her hoard. The dragon queen exhibits shrewd battle tactics and beguiling charm, easily swaying mortals. Each of Tiamat's five heads has its own voice and mannerisms, but they all share the same consciousness.
zh_tw: 提亞馬特體現了邪惡龍的惡習。她充滿復仇心，並且比任何東西都更渴望權力和財富。然而，提亞馬特在擴大她財寶的追求中並不魯莽。這位龍後展現出精明的戰鬥策略和迷人的魅力，輕易地影響凡人。提亞馬特的五個頭各自擁有自己的聲音和舉止，但它們共享同一個意識。

english: The relationship between Tiamat and Bahamut is complicated. Many texts portray the two as mortal enemies, but other histories of the First World depict the two as partners; some even speculate that she still feels great love for her creations on the Material Plane and grief over the loss of Sardior.
zh_tw: 提亞馬特和巴哈姆特之間的關係是複雜的。許多文獻將兩者描繪為死敵，但其他關於第一世界的歷史則將他們描述為夥伴；一些人甚至推測她仍然對物質平面上的創造物懷有深厚的愛，並對薩迪歐的失去感到悲傷。

english: Vecna
zh_tw: 維克那

english: On countless worlds, his name evokes tales of terror and cruelty: {@creature Vecna the Archlich|VEoR|Vecna}, the Undying King. Vecna, the Whispered One. Vecna, the Lord of the Rotted Tower. But Vecna had humble beginnings on the world of Oerth, where an order of wizards used him as a bootblack and scribe. He spent the better part of his childhood secretly educating himself in his masters' arts. Once Vecna learned all he could, he massacred the wizards. He then recorded his every foul thought and dream as he started to write his {@item Book of Vile Darkness}.
zh_tw: 在無數的世界裡，他的名字喚起了恐怖與殘酷的傳說：{@creature Vecna the Archlich|VEoR|維克那}，不朽之王。維寇，低語者。維寇，腐塔之主。但維寇在奧斯世界有著卑微的起點，一個巫師組織將他用作擦鞋匠和文書。他在童年的大部分時間裡秘密地自學主人的技藝。一旦維寇學會了所有他能學的東西，他便屠殺了那些巫師。然後他開始寫下他的{@item Book of Vile Darkness||穢暗之書}，記錄下他每一個骯髒的思想和夢想。

english: Vecna forged a kingdom on Oerth, but he grew bored with it after several centuries. He started inflicting suffering on other worlds. In this adventure, Vecna has risen to godhood on Oerth, but he seeks to become the most powerful god in existence and bend the multiverse to his will. By the time the characters are involved, Vecna's master plan is almost complete. He has funneled a significant amount of his energy into weaving his ritual. Therefore, when the characters finally confront Vecna and try to save the multiverse, he is in his archlich form and not his divine form.
zh_tw: 維克那在奧斯上建立了一個王國，但在幾個世紀後，他對此感到厭倦。他開始在其他世界製造苦難。在這次冒險中，維克那在奧斯上已經升為神明，但他尋求成為存在的最強大的神，並使多元宇宙屈服於他的意志。當角色們介入時，維克那的大師計劃幾乎已經完成。他已經將大量的能量注入到編織他的儀式中。因此，當角色們最終面對維克那並試圖拯救多元宇宙時，他處於巫妖形態而不是神明形態。

english: Appendix C: Secrets Tracker
zh_tw: 附錄C：秘密追蹤器

english: Use this chart to keep track of the secrets characters learn during this adventure. Since it contains spoilers, keep this sheet hidden from the players!
zh_tw: 使用這個圖表來記錄角色在這次冒險中學到的秘密。因為它包含劇透，所以請將這張紙對玩家保密！

english: When the characters learn a valuable secret, check the "Secret Learned" box in the appropriate row. If the characters use the {@area Power of Secrets|028|x} rules (see the {@adventure introduction|VEoR|0}) to spend a secret they've learned, or if they reveal a secret they've learned to a nonplayer character, mark a corresponding "Secret Revealed" box. The party's total "Secrets Kept"—equal to the number of Secrets Learned minus Secrets Revealed—can impact the characters' fight against Vecna in {@area chapter 11|513|x}.
zh_tw: 當角色們獲悉了一個重要秘密時，請在相應的行中勾選"秘密獲悉"框。如果角色們使用{@area 秘密的力量|028|x}規則（見{@adventure 簡介|VEoR|0}）來消耗他們獲悉的秘密，或者如果他們向一個非玩家角色透露了他們獲悉的秘密，請標記相應的"秘密揭露"框。團隊的總"保持秘密"數——等於獲悉的秘密數減去揭露的秘密數——可能會影響角色們在{@area 第十一章|513|x}中對戰維克那的結果。

english: On the Alt-Cover: The {@i Eye and Hand of Vecna} portend terrible doom for existence while the runes on the {@i Rod of Seven Parts} might offer our heroes some help in this cover by Hydro74.
zh_tw: 在替代封面上：維克那的{@i 維克那法眼和魔掌}預示著存在的可怕厄運，而{@i 七碎片之杖}上的符文可能為我們的英雄在這個由Hydro74創作的封面中提供了一些幫助。
